Thy smoke mount to the sky, to heaven thy lustre. Fill thou the spacious earth full with thine ashes.

verses.sanskrit:
माऽपो मौ॑षधीर्हिᳪसी॒र्धाम्नो॑ धाम्नो राजँ॒स्ततो॑ वरुण नो मुञ्च । यदा॒हुर॒घ्न्या इति॒ वरु॒णेति॒ शपा॑महे॒ ततो॑ वरुण नो मुञ्च ।
सुमि॒त्रि॒या न॒ आप॒ ओष॑धयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रि॒यास्तस्मै॑ सन्तु॒ योस्मान्द्वेष्टि॒ यं च॑ व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā'po mauṣadhīrhiṃsīrdhāmno dhāmno rājam̐stato varuṇa no muñca | yadāhuraghnyā iti varuṇeti śapāmahe tato varuṇa no muñca |
sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyāstasmai santu yosmāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
verses.translation: Harm not the Waters, do the Plants no damage. From every place, King Varuna, thence save us. Their saying that we swear our oath by sacred cows, by Varuna, O Varuna, save us therefrom. To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly; to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.

verses.sanskrit: ह॒विष्म॑तीरि॒मा आपो॑ ह॒विष्माँ॒२ आ वि॑वासति । ह॒विष्मा॑न् दे॒वो अ॑ध्व॒रो ह॒विष्माँ॑२ अस्तु॒ सूर्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: haviṣmatīrimā āpo haviṣmām̐ ā vivāsati | haviṣmān devo adhvaro haviṣmām̐ astu sūryaḥ ||
verses.translation: These waters teem with sacred food: rich in that food, one longs for them. Rich be the holy rite therein. In sacred food be Sûrya rich.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नेर्वोऽप॑न्नगृहस्य॒ सद॑सि सादयामीन्द्रा॒ग्न्योर्भा॑ग॒धेयी॑ स्थ मि॒त्रावरु॑णयोर्भाग॒धेयी॑ स्थ विश्वे॑षां दे॒वानां॑ भाग॒धेयी॑ स्थ । अ॒मूर्या उप॒ सूर्ये॒ याभि॑र्वा॒ सूर्यः॑ स॒ह । ता नो॑ हिन्वन्त्वध्व॒रम् ॥
verses.transliteration: agnervo'pannagṛhasya sadasi sādayāmīndrāgnyorbhāgadheyī stha mitrāvaruṇayorbhāgadheyī stha viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ bhāgadheyī stha | amūryā upa sūrye yābhirvā sūryaḥ saha | tā no hinvantvadhvaram ||
verses.translation: I set you down in Agni's seat whose home is indestructible. Indra-and-Agni's share are ye, Mitra-and-Varuna's share are ye. The share of all the Gods are ye. May waters gathered near the Sun, and those wherewith the Sun is joined, Speed on this sacred rite of ours.

verses.sanskrit: हृ॒दे त्वा॒ मन॑से त्वा दि॒वे त्वा॒ सूर्या॑य त्वा । ऊ॒र्ध्वमि॒मम॑ध्व॒रं दि॒वि दे॒वेषु॒ होत्रा॑ यच्छ ॥
verses.transliteration: hṛde tvā manase tvā dive tvā sūryāya tvā | ūrdhvamimamadhvaraṃ divi deveṣu hotrā yaccha ||
verses.translation: Thee for the heart, thee for the mind, thee for the heaven, thee for the Sun. Bear up erect to heaven, to Gods, this rite these sacrificial calls.

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑ राज॒न् विश्वा॒स्त्वं प्र॒जा उ॒पाव॑रोह विश्वा॒स्त्वां प्र॒जा उ॒पाव॑रोहन्तु ।
शृ॒णोत्व॒ग्निः स॒मिधा॑ ह॒वं मे॑ शृण्व॒न्त्वापो॑ धि॒षणा॑श्च दे॒वीः ।
श्रोता॑ ग्रावाणो वि॒दुषो॒ न य॒ज्ञᳪ शृ॒णोतु॑ दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता हवं॑ मे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
soma rājan viśvāstvaṃ prajā upāvaroha viśvāstvāṃ prajā upāvarohantu |
śṛṇotvagniḥ samidhā havaṃ me śṛṇvantvāpo dhiṣaṇāśca devīḥ |
śrotā grāvāṇo viduṣo na yajñaṃ śṛṇotu devaḥ savitā havaṃ me svāhā ||
verses.translation: Descend, O Soma, King, to all thy people. Down, unto thee, go, one and all, thy people! May Agni with his fuel hear my calling. Hear it the Waters and the Bowls, Divine Ones! Hear, Stones, as knowing sacrifice, my calling. May the God Savitar hear mine invocation. All hail!

verses.sanskrit:
देवी॑रापो अपां नपा॒द्यो व॑ ऊ॒र्मिर्ह॑वि॒ष्य॒ इन्द्रि॒यावा॑न् म॒दिन्त॑मः ।
तं दे॒वेभ्यो॑ देव॒त्रा द॑त्त शुक्र॒पेभ्यो॒ येषां॑ भा॒ग स्थ॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devīrāpo apāṃ napādyo va ūrmirhaviṣya indriyāvān madintamaḥ |
taṃ devebhyo devatrā datta śukrapebhyo yeṣāṃ bhāga stha svāhā ||
verses.translation: Waters Divine, your wave, the Waters offspring, fit for oblation, potent, most delightful Upon those Gods among the Gods bestow it, who drink the pure, of whom ye are the portion. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: कार्षि॑रसि स॑मु॒द्रस्य॒ त्वा क्षि॑त्या॒ उन्न॑यामि । समापो॑ अ॒द्भिर॑ग्मत॒ समोष॑धीभि॒रोष॑धीः ॥
verses.transliteration: kārṣirasi samudrasya tvā kṣityā unnayāmi | samāpo adbhiragmata samoṣadhībhiroṣadhīḥ ||
verses.translation: Drawing art thou: I draw thee up that Ocean neer may waste or wane. Let waters with the waters, and the plants commingle with the plants.

verses.sanskrit: यम॑ग्ने पृ॒त्सु मर्त्य॒मवा॒ वाजे॑षु॒ यं जु॒नाः । स यन्ता॒ शश्व॑ती॒रिषः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yamagne pṛtsu martyamavā vājeṣu yaṃ junāḥ | sa yantā śaśvatīriṣaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: That man is lord of endless strength whom thou protectest in the fight, Agni, or urgest to the fray.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् । आ द॑दे॒ रावा॑सि गभी॒रमि॒मम॑ध्व॒रं कृ॒धीन्द्रा॑य सु॒षूत॑मम् ।
उ॒त्त॒मेन॑ प॒विनोर्ज॑स्वन्तं॒ मधु॑मन्तं॒ पय॑स्वन्तं निग्रा॒भ्या॒ स्थ देव॒श्रुत॑स्त॒र्पय॑त मा ॥
verses.transliteration:
devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | ā dade rāvāsi gabhīramimamadhvaraṃ kṛdhīndrāya suṣūtamam |
uttamena pavinorjasvantaṃ madhumantaṃ payasvantaṃ nigrābhyā stha devaśrutastarpayata mā ||
verses.translation: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan. Free with thy gifts art thou. Perform for Indra this deep, most excellently ordered worship. With the most noble bolt I pay the worship enriched with strengthening food and milk and sweetness. Ye are Nigrâbhyâ waters. heard by Deities: make me content.

verses.sanskrit: मनो॑ मे तर्पयत॒ वाचं॑ मे तर्पयत प्रा॒णं मे॑ तर्पयत॒ चक्षु॑र्मे तर्पयत॒ श्रोत्रं॑ मे तर्पयता॒त्मानं॑ मे तर्पयत प्र॒जां मे॑ तर्पयत प॒शून्मे॑ तर्पयत ग॒णान्मे॑ तर्पयत ग॒णा मे॒ मा वि तृ॑षन् ॥
verses.transliteration: mano me tarpayata vācaṃ me tarpayata prāṇaṃ me tarpayata cakṣurme tarpayata śrotraṃ me tarpayatātmānaṃ me tarpayata prajāṃ me tarpayata paśūnme tarpayata gaṇānme tarpayata gaṇā me mā vi tṛṣan ||
verses.translation: Content my mind, content my speech, content my breath, content mine eye, content mine ear, content my soul, content my progeny, content my herds, content the troops of men about me: never may the bands of men about me suffer thirst.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ वसु॑मते रु॒द्रव॑त॒ इन्द्रा॑य त्वा ऽऽदि॒त्यव॑त॒ इन्द्रा॑य त्वा ऽभिमाति॒घ्ने ।
श्ये॒नाय॑ त्वा सोम॒भृते॒ ऽग्नये॑ त्वा रायस्पोष॒दे ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrāya tvā vasumate rudravata indrāya tvā ''dityavata indrāya tvā 'bhimātighne |
śyenāya tvā somabhṛte 'gnaye tvā rāyaspoṣade ||
verses.translation: For Indra girt by Vasus and accompanied by Rudras, thee. For Indra with Âdityas, thee. For Indra foe-destroyer, thee. Thee for the Soma-bringing Hawk. For plenty-giving Agni, thee.

verses.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ सोम दि॒वि ज्योति॒र्यत्पृ॑थि॒व्यां यदु॒राव॒न्तरि॑क्षे । तेनास्मै॒ यज॑मानायो॒रु रा॒ये कृ॒ध्यधि॑ दा॒त्रे वो॑चः ॥
verses.transliteration: yatte soma divi jyotiryatpṛthivyāṃ yadurāvantarikṣe | tenāsmai yajamānāyoru rāye kṛdhyadhi dātre vocaḥ ||
verses.translation: Soma, what light there is of thine in heaven, what on the earth, what in mid-air's wide region, Therewith give broad space to the Sacrificer for his enrichment: Comfort thou the giver.

verses.sanskrit: श्वा॒त्रा स्थ॑ वृत्र॒तुरो॒ राधो॑गूर्ता अ॒मृत॑स्य॒ पत्नीः॑ । ता दे॑वीर्देव॒त्रेमं य॒ज्ञं न॑य॒तोप॑हूताः॒ सोम॑स्य पिबत ॥
verses.transliteration: śvātrā stha vṛtraturo rādhogūrtā amṛtasya patnīḥ | tā devīrdevatremaṃ yajñaṃ nayatopahūtāḥ somasya pibata ||
verses.translation: Auspicious are ye, conquerors of Vritra, formed for bestowing wealth, the Immortal's Consorts. Lead to the Gods this sacrifice, Divine Ones! and at our invitation drink of Soma.

verses.sanskrit: मा भे॒र्मा सं वि॑क्था॒ ऊर्जं॑ धत्स्व॒ धिष॑णे वी॒ड्वी स॒ती वी॑डयेथा॒मूर्जं॑ दधाथाम् । पा॒प्मा ह॒तो न सोमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: mā bhermā saṃ vikthā ūrjaṃ dhatsva dhiṣaṇe vīḍvī satī vīḍayethāmūrjaṃ dadhāthām | pāpmā hato na somaḥ ||
verses.translation: Be not afraid; shake not with terror. Take thou strength. Ye two Bowls, being firm, stay firm, and take ye strength. Mishap—not Soma—hath been killed.

verses.sanskrit: प्रागपा॒गुद॑गध॒राक्स॒र्वत॑स्त्वा॒ दिश॒ आ धा॑वन्तु । अम्ब॒ निष्प॑र॒ सम॒रीर्वि॑दाम् ॥
verses.transliteration: prāgapāgudagadharāksarvatastvā diśa ā dhāvantu | amba niṣpara samarīrvidām ||
verses.translation: East, west, north, south, from every side to meet thee let the regions run. Fill him, O Mother, let the noble meet together.

verses.sanskrit: त्वम॒ङ्ग प्रश॑ᳪसिषो दे॒वः श॑विष्ठ॒ मर्त्य॑म् । न त्वद॒न्यो म॑घवन्नस्ति मर्डि॒तेन्द्र॒ ब्रवी॑मि ते॒ वचः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvamaṅga praśaṃsiṣo devaḥ śaviṣṭha martyam | na tvadanyo maghavannasti marḍitendra bravīmi te vacaḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou, verily, O Mightiest, as God shalt gladden mortal man. O Bounteous Lord, there is no comforter but thou. Indra, I speak my words to thee.

verses.sanskrit: वा॒चस्पत॑ये पवस्व॒ वृष्णो॑ अ॒ᳪशुभ्यां॒ गभ॑स्तिपूतः । दे॒वो दे॒वेभ्यः॑ पवस्व॒ येषां॑ भा॒गोऽसि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vācaspataye pavasva vṛṣṇo aṃśubhyāṃ gabhastipūtaḥ | devo devebhyaḥ pavasva yeṣāṃ bhāgo'si ||
verses.translation: Flow for Vâchaspati, cleansed by hands from the two off-shoots of the Bull. Flow pure, a Deity thyself, for Deities whose share thou art.

verses.sanskrit:
मधु॑मतीर्न॒ इष॑स्कृधि॒ यत्ते॑ सो॒मादा॑भ्यं॒ नाम॒ जागृ॑वि॒ तस्मै॑ ते सोम॒ सोमा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒
स्वाहो॒र्वन्तरि॑क्ष॒मन्वे॑मि॒ ॥
verses.transliteration:
madhumatīrna iṣaskṛdhi yatte somādābhyaṃ nāma jāgṛvi tasmai te soma somāya svāhā
svāhorvantarikṣamanvemi ||
verses.translation: Sweeten the freshening draughts we drink. Soma, whatever name thou hast, unconquerable, giving life, To that thy Soma, Soma! Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाङ्कृ॑तोऽसि॒ विश्वे॑भ्य इन्द्रि॒येभ्यो॑ दि॒व्येभ्यः॒ पार्थि॑वेभ्यो॒ मन॑स्त्वाष्टु॒ स्वाहा॑
त्वा सुभव॒ सूर्या॑य दे॒वेभ्य॑स्त्वा मरीचि॒पेभ्यो॒ देवा॑ᳪशो॒ यस्मै॒ त्वेडे॒ तत्स॒त्यमु॑परि॒प्रुता॑ भ॒ङ्गेन॑ ह॒तोऽसौ॒ फ़ट्
प्रा॒णाय॑ त्वा व्या॒नाय॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
svāṅkṛto'si viśvebhya indriyebhyo divyebhyaḥ pārthivebhyo manastvāṣṭu svāhā
tvā subhava sūryāya devebhyastvā marīcipebhyo devāṃśo yasmai tveḍe tatsatyamupariprutā bhaṅgena hato'sau faṭ
prāṇāya tvā vyānāya tvā ||
verses.translation: Self-made art thou from all the Powers that are in heaven and on the earth. May the Mind win thee, thee, All-hail! for Sûrya, O thou nobly-born. Thee for the Deities who sip light-atoms. Truly fulfilled, O Plant divine, be that for which I pray to thee. With ruin falling from above may So-and-So be smitten, crash! Thee for out-breathing, thee for breath diffused!

verses.sanskrit: उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒न्तर्य॑च्छ मघवन् पा॒हि सोम॑म् । उ॒रु॒ष्य राय॒ एषो॑ यजस्व ॥
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'syantaryaccha maghavan pāhi somam | uruṣya rāya eṣo yajasva ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Hold in, Rich Lord! be Soma's guard. Be thou protector of our wealth: win strengthening food by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒न्तस्ते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी द॑धाम्य॒न्तर्द॑धाम्यु॒र्व॒न्तरि॑क्षम् । स॒जूर्दे॒वेभि॒रव॑रैः॒ परै॑श्चान्तर्या॒मे म॑घवन् मादयस्व ॥
verses.transliteration: antaste dyāvāpṛthivī dadhāmyantardadhāmyurvantarikṣam | sajūrdevebhiravaraiḥ paraiścāntaryāme maghavan mādayasva ||
verses.translation: The heaven and spacious earth I lay within thee, I lay within thee middle air's wide region. Accordant with the Gods lower and higher, Rich Lord, rejoice thee in the Antaryâma.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाङ्कृ॑तोऽसि॒ विश्वे॑भ्य इन्द्रि॒येभ्यो॑ दि॒व्येभ्यः॒ पार्थि॑वेभ्यो॒ मन॑स्त्वाष्टु॒ स्वाहा॑
त्वा सुभव॒ सूर्या॑य दे॒वेभ्य॑स्त्वा मरीचि॒पेभ्य॑ उदा॒नाय॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
svāṅkṛto'si viśvebhya indriyebhyo divyebhyaḥ pārthivebhyo manastvāṣṭu svāhā
tvā subhava sūryāya devebhyastvā marīcipebhya udānāya tvā ||
verses.translation: Self-made art thou . . . . . light-atoms (verse 3 repeated). Thee for the upward breath.

verses.sanskrit: आ वा॑यो भूष शुचिपा॒ उप॑ नः स॒हस्रं॑ ते नि॒युतो॑ विश्ववार । उपो॑ ते॒ अन्धो॒ मद्य॑मयामि॒ यस्य॑ देव दधि॒षे पू॑र्व॒पेयं॑ वा॒यवे॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā vāyo bhūṣa śucipā upa naḥ sahasraṃ te niyuto viśvavāra | upo te andho madyamayāmi yasya deva dadhiṣe pūrvapeyaṃ vāyave tvā ||
verses.translation: O Vâyu, drinker of the pure, be near us: a thousand teams are thine, All-bounteous Giver. To thee the rapture-giving juice is offered, whose first draught, God, thou takest as thy portion.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑वायू इ॒मे सु॒ता उप॒ प्रयो॑भि॒राग॑तम् । इन्द॑वो वामु॒शन्ति॒ हि ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि वा॒यव॑ इन्द्रवा॒युभ्यां॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनिः॑ स॒जोषो॑भ्यां त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
indravāyū ime sutā upa prayobhirāgatam | indavo vāmuśanti hi |
upayāmagṛhīto'si vāyava indravāyubhyāṃ tvaiṣa te yoniḥ sajoṣobhyāṃ tvā ||
verses.translation: These, Indra-Vâyu! have been shed; come for our offered dainties sake: The drops are yearning for you both. Taken upon a base art thou. For Vâyu, Indra-Vâyu, thee. This is thy home. Thee for the close-knit friends.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒यं वां॑ मित्रावरुणा सु॒तः सोम॑ ऋतावृधा । ममेदि॒ह श्रु॑त॒ᳪ हव॑म् । उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि मि॒त्रावरु॑णाभ्यां त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ vāṃ mitrāvaruṇā sutaḥ soma ṛtāvṛdhā | mamediha śrutaṃ havam | upayāmagṛhīto'si mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā ||
verses.translation: This Soma hath been shed for you, Law-strengtheners, Mitra-Varuna! Here listen ye to this my call. Taken upon a base art thou. For Mitra thee, for Varuna.

verses.sanskrit:
रा॒या व॒यᳪ स॑स॒वाᳪसो॑ मदेम ह॒व्येन॑ दे॒वा यव॑सेन॒ गावः॑ ।
तां धे॒नुं मि॑त्रावरुणा यु॒वं नो॑ वि॒श्वाहा॑ धत्त॒मन॑पस्फ़ुरन्तीमे॒ष ते॒ योनि॑रृता॒युभ्यां॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
rāyā vayaṃ sasavāṃso madema havyena devā yavasena gāvaḥ |
tāṃ dhenuṃ mitrāvaruṇā yuvaṃ no viśvāhā dhattamanapasfurantīmeṣa te yonirṛtāyubhyāṃ tvā ||
verses.translation: May we, possessing much, delight in riches, Gods in oblation, and the kine in pasture; And that Milch-cow who shrinks not from the milking, O Indra-Varuna, give to us daily. This is thy home. Thee for the righteous Twain.

verses.sanskrit: या वां॒ कशा॒ मधु॑म॒त्यश्वि॑ना सू॒नृता॑वती । तया॑ य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्षतम् । उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒श्विभ्यां॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्माध्वी॑भ्यां त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: yā vāṃ kaśā madhumatyaśvinā sūnṛtāvatī | tayā yajñaṃ mimikṣatam | upayāmagṛhīto'syaśvibhyāṃ tvaiṣa te yonirmādhvībhyāṃ tvā ||
verses.translation: Distilling honey is your whip, Asvins, and full of pleasantness: Sprinkle therewith the sacrifice. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. This is thy home. Thee for the Honey-lovers.

verses.sanskrit:
तं प्र॒त्नथा॑ पू॒र्वथा॑ वि॒श्वथे॒मथा॑ ज्येष्ठ॒ता॑तिं बर्हि॒षद॑ᳪ स्व॒र्विद॑म् । प्र॒ती॒ची॒नं वृ॒जनं॑ दोहसे॒ धुनि॑मा॒शुं जय॑न्त॒मनु॒ यासु॒ वर्ध॑से ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ शण्डा॑य त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र्वी॒रतां॑ पा॒ह्यप॑मृष्टः॒ शण्डो॑ दे॒वास्त्वा॑ शुक्र॒पाः प्र ण॑य॒न्त्वना॑धृष्टाऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
taṃ pratnathā pūrvathā viśvathemathā jyeṣṭhatātiṃ barhiṣadaṃ svarvidam | pratīcīnaṃ vṛjanaṃ dohase dhunimāśuṃ jayantamanu yāsu vardhase |
upayāmagṛhīto'si śaṇḍāya tvaiṣa te yonirvīratāṃ pāhyapamṛṣṭaḥ śaṇḍo devāstvā śukrapāḥ pra ṇayantvanādhṛṣṭā'si ||
verses.translation: Thou in the first old time, as all were wont, so now drawest from him, light-finder, throned on sacred grass, Preeminence and strength, from him turned hither, swift, roaring, who winneth those whereby thou waxest strong. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Sanda. This is thy home. Protect thou manly power. Sanda hath been removed, may Deities who drink the pure libation lead thee forward. Invincible art thou.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒वीरो॑ वी॒रान् प्र॑ज॒नय॒न् परी॑ह्य॒भि रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण॒ यज॑मानम् ।
स॒ञ्ज॒ग्मा॒नो दि॒वा पृ॑थि॒व्या शु॒क्रः शु॒क्रशो॑चिषा॒ निर॑स्तः॒ शण्डः॑ शु॒क्रस्या॑धि॒ष्ठान॑मसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
suvīro vīrān prajanayan parīhyabhi rāyaspoṣeṇa yajamānam |
sañjagmāno divā pṛthivyā śukraḥ śukraśociṣā nirastaḥ śaṇḍaḥ śukrasyādhiṣṭhānamasi ||
verses.translation: Well stored with heroes and begetting heroes, with growth of wealth surround the Sacrificer. The Bright, conjoined with Heaven and with Earth, with the brightly-shining one. Expelled is Sanda. Thou art Sukra's dwelling.

verses.sanskrit:
अच्छि॑न्नस्य ते देव सोम सु॒वीर्य॑स्य रा॒यस्पोष॑स्य ददि॒तारः॑ स्याम ।
सा प्र॑थ॒मा सँस्कृ॑तिर्वि॒श्ववा॑रा॒ स प्र॑थ॒मो वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॒ग्निः ॥
verses.transliteration:
acchinnasya te deva soma suvīryasya rāyaspoṣasya daditāraḥ syāma |
sā prathamā sam̐skṛtirviśvavārā sa prathamo varuṇo mitro agniḥ ||
verses.translation: May we, O radiant Soma, be the keepers of thine uninjured strength and growth of riches. This is the first all-bounteous Consecration: he the first, Varuna, Mitra, and Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
स प्र॑थ॒मो बृह॒स्पति॑श्चिकि॒त्वाँस्तस्मा॒ इन्द्रा॑य सु॒तमा जु॑होत॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
तृ॒म्पन्तु॒ होत्रा॒ मध्वो॒ याः स्वि॑ष्टा॒ याः सुप्री॑ताः॒ सुहु॑ता॒ यत्स्वाहा ऽया॑ड॒ग्नीत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa prathamo bṛhaspatiścikitvām̐stasmā indrāya sutamā juhota svāhā |
tṛmpantu hotrā madhvo yāḥ sviṣṭā yāḥ suprītāḥ suhutā yatsvāhā 'yāḍagnīt ||
verses.translation: He is the first Brihaspati, the Prudent. Offer ye juice with Svâhâ! to that Indra. Content be priestly offices, those with good sacrifice of meath, those that are pleased when they have gained fair offerings with the solemn Hail! The Kindler of the Fire hath sacrificed.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं वे॒नश्चो॑दय॒त्पृश्नि॑गर्भा॒ ज्योति॑र्जरायू॒ रज॑सो वि॒माने॑ ।
इ॒मम॒पाᳪ सं॑ग॒मे सूर्य॑स्य॒ शिशुं॒ न विप्रा॑ म॒तिभी॑ रिहन्ति ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ मर्का॑य त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayaṃ venaścodayatpṛśnigarbhā jyotirjarāyū rajaso vimāne |
imamapāṃ saṃgame sūryasya śiśuṃ na viprā matibhī rihanti |
upayāmagṛhīto'si markāya tvā ||
verses.translation: See, Vena, born in light hath driven hither on chariot of the air the calves of Prisni. Singers with hymns caress him as an infant there where the waters and the sunlight mingle. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Marka.

verses.sanskrit:
मनो॒ न येषु॒ हव॑नेषु ति॒ग्मं विपः॒ शच्या॑ वनु॒थो द्रव॑न्ता ।
आ यः शर्या॑भिस्तुविनृ॒म्णो अ॒स्याश्री॑णीता॒दिशं॒ गभ॑स्तावे॒ष ते॒ योनिः॑ प्र॒जाः
पा॒ह्यप॑मृष्टो॒ मर्को॑ दे॒वास्त्वा॑ मन्थि॒पाः प्र ण॑य॒न्त्वना॑धृष्टासि ॥
verses.transliteration:
mano na yeṣu havaneṣu tigmaṃ vipaḥ śacyā vanutho dravantā |
ā yaḥ śaryābhistuvinṛmṇo asyāśrīṇītādiśaṃ gabhastāveṣa te yoniḥ prajāḥ
pāhyapamṛṣṭo marko devāstvā manthipāḥ pra ṇayantvanādhṛṣṭāsi ||
verses.translation: To his oblation, swift as thought ye hurried and welcomed eagerly the prayers he offered. With arrows in his hand the Very Mighty forced from him all obedience of a servant. This is thy dwelling-place. Protect the people. Marka hath been removed. Gods, drinkers of the Man thin, lead thee forward! Invincible art thou.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒प्र॒जाः प्र॒जाः प्र॑ज॒नय॒न् परी॑ह्य॒भि रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण॒ यज॑मानम् ।
स॒ञ्ज॒ग्मा॒नो दि॒वा पृ॑थि॒व्या म॒न्थी म॒न्थिशो॑चिषा निर॑स्तो॒ मर्को॑ म॒न्थिनो॑ऽधि॒ष्ठान॑मसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
suprajāḥ prajāḥ prajanayan parīhyabhi rāyaspoṣeṇa yajamānam |
sañjagmāno divā pṛthivyā manthī manthiśociṣā nirasto marko manthino'dhiṣṭhānamasi ||
verses.translation: Well stored with people and begetting people, with growth of wealth surround the Sacrificer. The Manthin joined with Heaven and Earth and with the Manthin-shining one. Expelled is Marka. Thou art Manthin's dwelling.

verses.sanskrit:
ये दे॑वासो दि॒व्येका॑दश॒ स्थ पृ॑थि॒व्यामध्येका॑दश॒ स्थ ।
अ॒प्सु॒क्षितो॑ महि॒नैका॑दश॒ स्थ ते दे॑वासो य॒ज्ञमि॒मं जु॑षध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye devāso divyekādaśa stha pṛthivyāmadhyekādaśa stha |
apsukṣito mahinaikādaśa stha te devāso yajñamimaṃ juṣadhvam ||
verses.translation: O ye eleven Gods whose home is heaven, O ye eleven who make earth your dwelling. Ye who with might, eleven, live in waters, accept this sacrifice, Ye Gods, with pleasure.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्याग्रय॒णो॒ऽसि॒ स्वा॒ग्रयणः ।
पा॒हि य॒ज्ञं पा॒हि य॒ज्ञप॑तिं॒ विष्णु॒स्त्वामि॑न्द्रि॒येण॑ पातु॒ विष्णुं॒ त्वं पा॑ह्य॒भि सव॑नानि पाहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
upayāmagṛhīto'syāgrayaṇo'si svāgrayaṇaḥ |
pāhi yajñaṃ pāhi yajñapatiṃ viṣṇustvāmindriyeṇa pātu viṣṇuṃ tvaṃ pāhyabhi savanāni pāhi ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art Âgrayana, good first libation. Be thou the guard of sacrifice: protect the sacrifice's lord. Vishnu with might protect thee. Guard thou Vishnu. Guard on all sides the Soma sacrifices.

verses.sanskrit:
सोमः॑ पवते॒ सोमः॑ पवते॒ऽस्मै॒ ब्रह्म॑णे॒ऽस्मै क्ष॒त्राया॒स्मै सु॑न्व॒ते यज॑मानाय पवत इ॒ष ऊ॒र्जे
प॑वते॒ऽद्भ्य ओष॑धीभ्यः पवते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्यां॑ पवते सुभू॒ताय॑ पवते॒ विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्य॑
ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
somaḥ pavate somaḥ pavate'smai brahmaṇe'smai kṣatrāyāsmai sunvate yajamānāya pavata iṣa ūrje
pavate'dbhya oṣadhībhyaḥ pavate dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pavate subhūtāya pavate viśvebhyastvā devebhya
eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: Soma flows pure, Soma flows pure for this Priesthood, for the Nobility, pure for the worshipper who presses out the juice, flows pure for food and energy, for waters and for plants; flows pure for general prosperity. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Universal Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा बृ॒हद्व॑ते॒ वय॑स्वत उक्था॒व्यं॒ गृह्णामि । यत्त॑ इन्द्र बृ॒हद्वय॒स्तस्मै॑ त्वा॒ विष्ण॑वे त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑रु॒क्थेभ्य॑स्त्वा
दे॒वेभ्य॑स्त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā bṛhadvate vayasvata ukthāvyaṃ gṛhṇāmi | yatta indra bṛhadvayastasmai tvā viṣṇave tvaiṣa te yonirukthebhyastvā
devebhyastvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmi ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra Lord of the Brihat, strong with vital vigour, I take thee lover of the invocation. Indra, what mighty vigour thou possessest, for that do I take thee, take thee for Vishnu This is thy home. Thee for the recitations. For the Gods take I thee, the Gods protector; yea, for the sacrifice's life I take thee.

verses.sanskrit: मि॒त्रावरु॑णाभ्यां त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णा॒मीन्द्रा॑य त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णा॒मीन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॑ त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णा॒मीन्द्रा॒वरु॑णाभ्यां त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णा॒मीन्द्रा॒बृह॒स्पति॑भ्यां त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णा॒मीन्द्रा॒विष्णु॑भ्यां त्वा देवा॒व्यं॒ य॒ज्ञस्यायु॑षे गृह्णामि ॥
verses.transliteration: mitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrāya tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrāgnibhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrāvaruṇābhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrābṛhaspatibhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmīndrāviṣṇubhyāṃ tvā devāvyaṃ yajñasyāyuṣe gṛhṇāmi ||
verses.translation: For Mitra-Varuna thee, the Gods protector, yea, for the sacrifice's life I take thee. For Indra, thee, etc. For Indra-Agni, thee, etc. For IndraVaruna, thee, etc. For Indra-Brihaspati thee, etc. For Indra-Vishnu thee, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
मू॒र्धानं॑ दि॒वो अ॑र॒तिं पृ॑थि॒व्या वै॑श्वान॒रमृ॒त आ जा॒तम॒ग्निम् ।
क॒विᳪ स॒म्राज॒मति॑थिं॒ जना॑नामा॒सन्ना पात्रं॑ जनयन्त दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ā jātamagnim |
kaviṃ samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannā pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ ||
verses.translation: Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaisvânara, born in holy Order, The Sage, the King, the Guest of men, a vessel fit for their mouths, the Gods have generated.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि ध्रु॒वो॒ऽसि ध्रु॒वक्षि॑तिर्ध्रु॒वाणां॑ ध्रु॒वत॒मोऽच्यु॑तानामच्युत॒क्षित्त॑म
ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र्वैश्वान॒राय॑ त्वा । ध्रु॒वं ध्रु॒वेण॒ मन॑सा वा॒चा सोम॒मव॑ नयामि ।
अथा॑ न॒ इन्द्र॒ इद्विशो॑ऽसप॒त्नाः सम॑नस॒स्कर॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
upayāmagṛhīto'si dhruvo'si dhruvakṣitirdhruvāṇāṃ dhruvatamo'cyutānāmacyutakṣittama
eṣa te yonirvaiśvānarāya tvā | dhruvaṃ dhruveṇa manasā vācā somamava nayāmi |
athā na indra idviśo'sapatnāḥ samanasaskarat ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Firm, firmly resting, the firmest of the firm, the most securely grounded of those who never have been shaken. This is thy home. Thee for Vaisvânara. I pour forth with firm mind, with voice, firm Soma. So now may Indra verily make our people all of. One heart and mind and free from foemen.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॑ द्र॒प्स स्कन्द॑ति॒ यस्ते॑ अ॒ᳪशुर्ग्राव॑च्युतो धि॒षण॑योरु॒पस्था॑त् ।
अ॒ध्व॒र्योर्वा॒ परि॑ वा॒ यः प॒वित्रा॒त्तं ते॑ जु॑होमि॒ मन॑सा॒ वष॑ट्कृत॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ दे॒वाना॑मु॒त्क्रम॑णमसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaste drapsa skandati yaste aṃśurgrāvacyuto dhiṣaṇayorupasthāt |
adhvaryorvā pari vā yaḥ pavitrāttaṃ te juhomi manasā vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ svāhā devānāmutkramaṇamasi ||
verses.translation: Whatever drop of thine leaps forth, whatever stalk from the bowls lap, shaken by the press-stone, From the Adhvaryu's hand or from the filter, that, consecrated in my mind with Vashat I offer unto thee with cry of Svâhâ! Thou art the way by which the Gods ascended.

verses.sanskrit: प्रा॒णाय॑ मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्व व्या॒नाय॑ मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्वोदा॒नाय॑ मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्व वा॒चे मे॑ वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्व॒ क्रतू॒दक्षा॑भ्यां मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्व॒ श्रोत्रा॑य मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्व॒ चक्षु॑र्भ्यां मे वर्चो॒दसौ॒ वर्च॑से पवेथाम् ॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇāya me varcodā varcase pavasva vyānāya me varcodā varcase pavasvodānāya me varcodā varcase pavasva vāce me varcodā varcase pavasva kratūdakṣābhyāṃ me varcodā varcase pavasva śrotrāya me varcodā varcase pavasva cakṣurbhyāṃ me varcodasau varcase pavethām ||
verses.translation: Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my outward breath. Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my spreading breath. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my upward breath. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my power of speech. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my sense and will. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my hearing power. Givers of splendor, grow ye pure for splendour for my orbs of sight.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒त्मने॑ मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्वौज॑से मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्वायु॑षे मे वर्चो॒दा वर्च॑से पवस्व॒
विश्वा॑भ्यो मे प्र॒जाभ्यो॑ वर्चो॒दसौ॒ वर्च॑से पवेथाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ātmane me varcodā varcase pavasvaujase me varcodā varcase pavasvāyuṣe me varcodā varcase pavasva
viśvābhyo me prajābhyo varcodasau varcase pavethām ||
verses.translation: Giver of splendour, grow thou pure for splendour for my living self. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my energy. Giver, etc. ... ... ... for my vital power. Givers of splendour, grow ye pure for splendour for all sprung from me.

verses.sanskrit: को॑ऽसि कत॒मो॒ऽसि॒ कस्या॑सि॒ को नामा॑सि । यस्य॑ ते॒ नामाम॑न्महि॒ यं त्वा॒ सोमे॑नाती॑तृपाम । भूर्भुवः॒ स्वः॒ सुप्र॒जाः प्र॒जाभिः॑ स्याᳪ सु॒वीरो॑ वी॒रैः सु॒पोषः॒ पोषैः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ko'si katamo'si kasyāsi ko nāmāsi | yasya te nāmāmanmahi yaṃ tvā somenātītṛpāma | bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ suprajāḥ prajābhiḥ syāṃ suvīro vīraiḥ supoṣaḥ poṣaiḥ ||
verses.translation: Who art thou? Which of all art thou? Whose art thou? Who art thou by name? Even thou on whose name we have meditated, then whom we have delighted with our Soma.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ मध॑वे त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ माध॑वाय त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि शु॒क्राय॑ त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ शुच॑ये त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ नभ॑से त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि नभ॒स्या॒य त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसी॒षे त्वो॑पया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्यू॒र्जे त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ सह॑से त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि सह॒स्या॒य त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ तप॑से त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि तप॒स्या॑य त्वोपया॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्यᳪहसस्प॒तये॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'si madhave tvopayāmagṛhīto'si mādhavāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'si śukrāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'si śucaye tvopayāmagṛhīto'si nabhase tvopayāmagṛhīto'si nabhasyāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'sīṣe tvopayāmagṛhīto'syūrje tvopayāmagṛhīto'si sahase tvopayāmagṛhīto'si sahasyāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'si tapase tvopayāmagṛhīto'si tapasyāya tvopayāmagṛhīto'syaṃhasaspataye tvā ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. For Madhu thee: Taken upon a base art thou. For Mâdhava thee. Taken, etc. For Sukra thee. Taken, etc. For Suchi thee. Taken, etc. For Nabhas thee. Taken, etc. For Nabhasya thee. Taken, etc. For Food thee. Taken, etc. For Energy thee. Taken, etc. For Sahas thee. Taken, etc. For Sahasya thee. Taken, etc. For Tapas thee. Taken, etc. For Tapasya thee. Taken, etc. For Amhasaspati thee.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ आ ग॑तᳪ सु॒तं गी॒र्भिर्नभो॒ वरे॑ण्यम् । अ॒स्य पा॑तं धि॒येषि॒ता ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसीन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑रिन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrāgnī ā gataṃ sutaṃ gīrbhirnabho vareṇyam | asya pātaṃ dhiyeṣitā |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāgnibhyāṃ tvaiṣa te yonirindrāgnibhyāṃ tvā ||
verses.translation: Moved, Indra-Agni, by our hymns, come to the juice, the precious dew. Drink ye thereof, impelled by song. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra-Agni thee. This is thy dwelling. Thee for Indra-Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
आ घा॒ ये अ॒ग्निमि॑न्ध॒ते स्तृ॒णन्ति॑ ब॒र्हिरा॑नु॒षक् । येषा॒मिन्द्रो॒ युवा॒ सखा॑ ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्यग्नी॒न्द्राभ्यां॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑रग्नी॒न्द्राभ्यां॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā ghā ye agnimindhate stṛṇanti barhirānuṣak | yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā |
upayāmagṛhīto'syagnīndrābhyāṃ tvaiṣa te yoniragnīndrābhyāṃ tvā ||
verses.translation: Hitherward! they who light the flame and straightway strew the sacred grass, Whose Friend is Indra ever young. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra-Agni thee. This is thy dwelling. Thee for Indra-Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
ओमा॑सश्चर्षणीधृतो॒ विश्वे॑ देवास॒ आ ग॑त । दा॒श्वाᳪसो॑ दा॒शुषः॑ सु॒तम् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्य॑ ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
omāsaścarṣaṇīdhṛto viśve devāsa ā gata | dāśvāṃso dāśuṣaḥ sutam |
upayāmagṛhīto'si viśvebhyastvā devebhya eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: Ye Visvedevas who protect, reward, and cherish men, approach Your worshipper's drink-offering. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Visvedevas.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वे॑ देवास॒ आ ग॑त शृणु॒ता म॑ इ॒मᳪ हव॑म् । एदं ब॒र्हिर्निषी॑दत ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्य॑ ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśve devāsa ā gata śṛṇutā ma imaṃ havam | edaṃ barhirniṣīdata |
upayāmagṛhīto'si viśvebhyastvā devebhya eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: O ye All-Gods, come hitherward: hear this my invocation seat Yourselves upon this sacred grass. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Universal Gods. This is thy home. Thee for the Visvedevas.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑ मरुत्व इ॒ह पा॑हि॒ सोमं॒ यथा॑ शार्या॒ते अपि॑बः सु॒तस्य॑ ।
तव॒ प्रणी॑ती॒ तव॑ शूर॒ शर्म॒न्ना वि॑वासन्ति क॒वयः॑ सुय॒ज्ञाः ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑त ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
indra marutva iha pāhi somaṃ yathā śāryāte apibaḥ sutasya |
tava praṇītī tava śūra śarmannā vivāsanti kavayaḥ suyajñāḥ |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā marutvata eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā marutvate ||
verses.translation: Here drink the Soma, Indra girt by Maruts! as thou didst drink the juice beside Sâryâta. Under thy guidance, in thy keeping, Hero! the singers serve, skilled in fair sacrifices. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home. For Indra girt by Maruts thee.

verses.sanskrit:
म॒रुत्व॑न्तं वृष॒भं वा॑वृधा॒नमक॑वारिं दि॒व्यᳪशा॒समिन्द्र॑म् ।
वि॑श्वा॒साह॒मव॑से॒ नूत॑नायो॒ग्रᳪस॑हो॒दामि॒ह तᳪ हु॑वेम ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑ते ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑ते ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि म॒रुतां॒ त्वौज॑से ॥
verses.transliteration:
marutvantaṃ vṛṣabhaṃ vāvṛdhānamakavāriṃ divyaṃśāsamindram |
viśvāsāhamavase nūtanāyograṃsahodāmiha taṃ huvema |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā marutvate eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā marutvate |
upayāmagṛhīto'si marutāṃ tvaujase ||
verses.translation: The Bull whose strength hath waxed, whom Maruts follow, free-giving Indra, the Celestial Ruler, Mighty, all-conquering, the victory-giver, him we invoke to give us new protection. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Maruts energy.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒जोषा॑ इन्द्र॒ सग॑णो म॒रुद्भिः॒ सोमं॑ पिब वृत्र॒हा शू॑र वि॒द्वान् ।
ज॒हि शत्रूँ॒२रप॒ मृधो॑ नुद॒स्वाथाभ॑यं कृणुहि वि॒श्वतो॑ नः ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑त ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
sajoṣā indra sagaṇo marudbhiḥ somaṃ piba vṛtrahā śūra vidvān |
jahi śatrūm̐rapa mṛdho nudasvāthābhayaṃ kṛṇuhi viśvato naḥ |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā marutvata eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā marutvate ||
verses.translation: Indra, accordant with the banded Maruts, drink Soma, Hero! as wise Vritra-slayer. Slay thou our foemen, drive away assailants, and make us safe on every side from danger. Taken, etc. For Indra girt by Maruts thee. This is thy home. For Indra girt by Maruts thee.

verses.sanskrit:
म॒रुत्वाँ॑२ इन्द्र वृष॒भो रणा॑य॒ पिबा॒ सोम॑मनुष्व॒धं मदा॑य ।
आ सि॑ञ्चस्व ज॒ठरे॒ मध्व॑ ऊ॒र्मिं त्वᳪ राजा॑ऽसि॒ प्रति॑पत्सु॒ताना॑म् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑त
ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा म॒रुत्व॑ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
marutvām̐ indra vṛṣabho raṇāya pibā somamanuṣvadhaṃ madāya |
ā siñcasva jaṭhare madhva ūrmiṃ tvaṃ rājā'si pratipatsutānām |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā marutvata
eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā marutvate ||
verses.translation: Drink, Indra Marut-girt, as Bull, the Soma: for joy, for rapture even as thou pleasest. Pour down the wave of meath within thy belly thou art the King of juices shed fortnightly. Taken, etc.......Maruts thee (as above).

verses.sanskrit:
म॒हाँ२ इन्द्रो॑ नृ॒वदा च॑र्षणि॒प्रा उ॒त द्वि॒बर्हा॑ अमि॒नः सहो॑भिः ।
अ॒स्म॒द्र॒य्ग्वावृधे वी॒र्या॒यो॒रुः पृ॒थुः सुकृ॑तः क॒र्तृभि॑र्भूत् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि महे॒न्द्राय॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र्महे॒न्द्राय॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
mahām̐ indro nṛvadā carṣaṇiprā uta dvibarhā aminaḥ sahobhiḥ |
asmadraygvāvṛdhe vīryāyoruḥ pṛthuḥ sukṛtaḥ kartṛbhirbhūt |
upayāmagṛhīto'si mahendrāya tvaiṣa te yonirmahendrāya tvā ||
verses.translation: Great, hero-like, controlling men is Indra, unwasting in his powers, doubled in vastness. He, turned to us, hath grown to hero vigour: broad, wide, he hath been decked by those who serve him. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Mahendra. This is thy dwelling-place. Thee for Mahendra.

verses.sanskrit:
म॒हाँ२ इन्द्रो॒ य ओज॑सा प॒र्जन्यो॑ वृष्टि॒माँ२ इ॑व । स्तोमै॑र्व॒त्सस्य॑ वावृधे ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि महे॒न्द्राय॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र्महे॒न्द्राय॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
mahām̐ indro ya ojasā parjanyo vṛṣṭimām̐ iva | stomairvatsasya vāvṛdhe |
upayāmagṛhīto'si mahendrāya tvaiṣa te yonirmahendrāya tvā ||
verses.translation: Indra, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich In rain, Is magnified by Vatsa's lauds. Taken, etc. (as in 39).

verses.sanskrit: उदु॒ त्यं जा॒तवे॑दसं दे॒वं व॑हन्ति के॒तवः॑ । दृ॒शे विश्वा॑य॒ सूर्य॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ | dṛśe viśvāya sūryaṃ svāhā ||
verses.translation: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look on him. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
चि॒त्रं दे॒वाना॒मुदगा॒दनी॑कं॒ चक्षु॑र्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्या॒ग्नेः ।
आप्रा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ᳪ सूर्य॑ आ॒त्मा जग॑तस्त॒स्थुष॑श्च॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ |
āprā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca svāhā ||
verses.translation: The brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuna, and Agni. Soul of all moving, soul of all that moves not, the Sun hath filled the air and earth and heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ नय॑ सु॒पथा॑ रा॒ये अ॒स्मान्विश्वा॑नि देव व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् ।
यु॒यो॒ध्यस्मज्जु॑हुरा॒णमेनो॒ भूयि॑ष्ठां ते॒ नम॑ उक्तिं विधेम॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne naya supathā rāye asmānviśvāni deva vayunāni vidvān |
yuyodhyasmajjuhurāṇameno bhūyiṣṭhāṃ te nama uktiṃ vidhema svāhā ||
verses.translation: By goodly paths lead us to riches, Agni, thou God who knowest every sacred duty. Remove the sin that makes us stray and wander: most ample adoration will we bring thee.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यं नो॑ अ॒ग्निर्वरि॑वस्कृणोत्व॒यं मृधः॑ पु॒र ए॑तु प्रभि॒न्दन् ।
अ॒यं वाजा॑न्जयतु॒ वाज॑साताव॒यᳪ शत्रू॑ञ्जयतु॒ जर्हृ॑षाणः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayaṃ no agnirvarivaskṛṇotvayaṃ mṛdhaḥ pura etu prabhindan |
ayaṃ vājānjayatu vājasātāvayaṃ śatrūñjayatu jarhṛṣāṇaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Wide room and comfort may this Agni give us, and go before us cleaving down our foemen. May he win booty in the fight for booty: may he quell foes in his triumphant onset.

verses.sanskrit:
रू॒पेण॑ वो रू॒पम॒भ्यागां॑ तु॒थो वो॑ वि॒श्ववे॑दा॒ वि भ॑जतु ।
ऋ॒तस्य॑ प॒था प्रेत॑ च॒न्द्रद॑क्षिणा॒ वि स्वः॒ पश्य॒ व्यन्तरि॑क्षं॒ यत॑स्व सद॒स्यैः॒ ॥
verses.transliteration:
rūpeṇa vo rūpamabhyāgāṃ tutho vo viśvavedā vi bhajatu |
ṛtasya pathā preta candradakṣiṇā vi svaḥ paśya vyantarikṣaṃ yatasva sadasyaiḥ ||
verses.translation: I through your beauty have attained to beauty. The Tutha, the omniscient, allot you! Go forth, bright-gifted! on the path of Order. Look thou upon the heaven and air's mid-region. Unite thee with the priests who keep the Sadas.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रा॒ह्म॒णम॒द्य वि॑देयं पितृ॒मन्तं॑ पैतृम॒त्यमृषि॑मार्षे॒यᳪ सु॒धातु॑दक्षिणम् ।
अ॒स्मद्रा॑ता देव॒त्रा ग॑च्छत प्रदा॒तार॒मा वि॑शत ॥
verses.transliteration:
brāhmaṇamadya videyaṃ pitṛmantaṃ paitṛmatyamṛṣimārṣeyaṃ sudhātudakṣiṇam |
asmadrātā devatrā gacchata pradātāramā viśata ||
verses.translation: This day may it he mine to find a Brâhman sprung from a lauded father and grandfather, Offspring of Rishis and himself a Rishi, the fit recipient of priestly guerdon. Go to the Gods, bestowed by me, and enter into him who gives.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नये॑ त्वा॒ मह्यं॒ वरु॑णो ददातु॒ सो॒ऽमृत॒त्त्वम॑शी॒यायु॑र्दा॒त्र ए॑धि॒ मयो॒ मह्यं॑ प्रतिग्रही॒त्रे रु॒द्राय॑ त्वा॒ मह्यं॒ वरु॑णो ददातु॒ सो॒ऽमृत॒त्त्वम॑शीय प्रा॒णो दा॒त्र ए॑धि॒ वयो॒ मह्यं॑ प्रतिग्रही॒त्रे बृह॒स्पत॑ये त्वा॒ मह्यं॒ वरु॑णो ददातु॒ सो॒ऽमृत॒त्त्वम॑शीय॒ त्वग्दा॒त्र ए॑धि॒ मयो॒ मह्यं॑ प्रतिग्रही॒त्रे
य॒माय॑ त्वा॒ मह्यं॒ वरु॑णो ददातु॒ सो॒ऽमृत॒त्त्वम॑शीय॒ हयो॑ दा॒त्र ए॑धि॒ वयो॒ मह्यं॑ प्रतिग्रही॒त्रे ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnaye tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so'mṛtattvamaśīyāyurdātra edhi mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre rudrāya tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so'mṛtattvamaśīya prāṇo dātra edhi vayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre bṛhaspataye tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so'mṛtattvamaśīya tvagdātra edhi mayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre
yamāya tvā mahyaṃ varuṇo dadātu so'mṛtattvamaśīya hayo dātra edhi vayo mahyaṃ pratigrahītre ||
verses.translation: To Agni, yea, to me let Varuna give thee. May I gain life that shall endure for ever. Be thou strong vital power to him who gives thee, and comfort unto me the gift's receiver. To Rudra, yea, to me let Varuna........................for ever. Be thou the breath of life to him who gives thee, and vigour unto me the gift's receiver. To me Brihaspati let Varuna........................for ever. Be thou a covering skin to him who gives thee, and comfort unto me the gift's receiver. To Varna, yea, to me let Varuna........................for ever. Be thou a steed to him who gives the guerdon, and vital power to me the gift's receiver.

verses.sanskrit:
को॑ऽदा॒त्कस्मा॑ अदा॒त्कामो॑ऽदा॒त्कामा॑यादात् ।
कामो॑ दा॒ता कामः॑ प्रतिग्रही॒ता कामै॒तत्ते॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ko'dātkasmā adātkāmo'dātkāmāyādāt |
kāmo dātā kāmaḥ pratigrahītā kāmaitatte ||
verses.translation: Who hath bestowed it? Upon whom bestowed it? Desire bestowed it, for Desire he gave it. Desire is giver and Desire receiver. This, O Desire, to thee is dedicated.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्यादि॒त्येभ्य॑स्त्वा । विष्ण॑ उरुगायै॒ष ते॒ सोम॒स्तᳪ र॑क्षस्व॒ मा त्वा॑ दभन् ॥
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'syādityebhyastvā | viṣṇa urugāyaiṣa te somastaṃ rakṣasva mā tvā dabhan ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Âdityas. Here, O Far-striding Vishnu, is thy Soma. Guard it from injury. Let them not harm thee.

verses.sanskrit:
क॒दा च॒न स्त॒रीर॑सि॒ नेन्द्र॑ सश्चसि दा॒शुषे॑ ।
उपो॒पेन्नु म॑घव॒न् भूय॒ इन्नु ते॒ दानं॑ दे॒वस्य॑ पृच्यत आदि॒त्येभ्य॑स्त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
kadā cana starīrasi nendra saścasi dāśuṣe |
upopennu maghavan bhūya innu te dānaṃ devasya pṛcyata ādityebhyastvā ||
verses.translation: Neer art thou fruitless, Indra; neer dost thou desert thy worshipper. But now, O Liberal Lord, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more. Thee for the Âdityas.

verses.sanskrit:
क॒दा च॒न प्र यु॑च्छस्यु॒भे नि पा॑सि॒ जन्म॑नी ।
तुरी॑यादित्य॒ सव॑नं त इन्द्रि॒यमात॑स्थाव॒मृतं॑ दि॒व्या॒दि॒त्येभ्य॑स्त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
kadā cana pra yucchasyubhe ni pāsi janmanī |
turīyāditya savanaṃ ta indriyamātasthāvamṛtaṃ divyādityebhyastvā ||
verses.translation: Never art thou neglectful: thou guardest both races with thy care. The Soma feast, O Fourth Âditya, is thy strength. Amrit is stablished in the heavens. Thee for the Âdityas.

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञो दे॒वानां॒ प्रत्ये॑ति सु॒म्नमादि॑त्यासो॒ भव॑ता मृड॒यन्तः॑ ।
आ वो॒ऽर्वाची॑ सुम॒तिर्व॑वृत्याद॒होश्चि॒द्या व॑रिवो॒वित्त॒रास॑दादि॒त्येभ्य॑स्त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajño devānāṃ pratyeti sumnamādityāso bhavatā mṛḍayantaḥ |
ā vo'rvācī sumatirvavṛtyādahościdyā varivovittarāsadādityebhyastvā ||
verses.translation: The sacrifice obtains the Gods acceptance. Be graciously inclined to us, Âdityas. Hitherward let your favour be directed and be our best deliverer from trouble. Thee for the Âdityas.

verses.sanskrit:
विव॑स्वन्नादित्यै॒ष ते॑ सोमपी॒थस्तस्मि॑न् मत्स्व ।
श्रद॑स्मै नरो॒ वच॑से दधातन॒ यदा॑शी॒र्दा दम्प॑ती वा॒मम॑श्नु॒तः ।
पुमा॑न् पु॒त्रो जा॑यते वि॒न्दते॒ वस्वधा॑ वि॒श्वाहा॑र॒प ए॑धते गृ॒हे ॥
verses.transliteration:
vivasvannādityaiṣa te somapīthastasmin matsva |
śradasmai naro vacase dadhātana yadāśīrdā dampatī vāmamaśnutaḥ |
pumān putro jāyate vindate vasvadhā viśvāhārapa edhate gṛhe ||
verses.translation: This is thy Soma draught, O bright Âditya: take delight therein. To this mine utterance, O ye men, give credence, what good the man and wife obtain by praying: A manly son is burn and gathers riches, and thrives for ever sinless in the dwelling.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒मम॒द्य स॑वितर्वा॒ममु॒ श्वो दि॒वे दि॑वे वा॒मम॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ सावीः ।
वा॒मस्य॒ हि क्षय॑स्य देव॒ भूरे॑र॒या धि॒या वा॑म॒भाजः॑ स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration:
vāmamadya savitarvāmamu śvo dive dive vāmamasmabhyaṃ sāvīḥ |
vāmasya hi kṣayasya deva bhūrerayā dhiyā vāmabhājaḥ syāma ||
verses.translation: Fair wealth, O Savitar, to-day, to-morrow, fair wealth produce for us each day that passes. May we, through this our song, be happy gainers, God! of a fair and spacious habitation.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि सावि॒त्रो॒ऽसि चनो॒धाश्च॑नो॒धा अ॑सि॒ चनो॒ मयि॑ धेहि ।
जिन्व॑ य॒ज्ञं जिन्व॑ य॒ज्ञप॑तिं॒ भगा॑य दे॒वाय॑ त्वा सवि॒त्रे ॥
verses.transliteration:
upayāmagṛhīto'si sāvitro'si canodhāścanodhā asi cano mayi dhehi |
jinva yajñaṃ jinva yajñapatiṃ bhagāya devāya tvā savitre ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Savitar's giver of delight art thou. Giver of joy art thou: vouchsafe me joy. Speed thou the sacrifice, speed thou the sacrifice's lord to win his share. Thee for the God, for Savitar.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि सु॒शर्मा॑ऽसि सुप्रतिष्ठा॒नो बृ॒हदु॑क्षाय॒ नमः॑ ।
विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्य॑ ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
upayāmagṛhīto'si suśarmā'si supratiṣṭhāno bṛhadukṣāya namaḥ |
viśvebhyastvā devebhya eṣa te yonirviśvebhyastvā devebhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art a good protector, firmly stablished. To the Great Bull be reverential homage. Thee for the Visvedevas. This is thy home: Thee for the Visvedevas.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ बृह॒स्पति॑सुतस्य देव सोम त॒ इन्दो॑रिन्द्रि॒याव॑तः॒ पत्नी॑वतो॒ ग्रहाँ॑२ ऋध्यासम् ।
अ॒हं प॒रस्ता॑द॒हम॒वस्ता॒द्यद॒न्तरि॑क्षं॒ तदु॑ मे पि॒ताऽभू॑त् ।
अ॒हᳪ सूर्य॑मुभ॒यतो॑ ददर्शा॒हं दे॒वानां॑ पर॒मं गुहा॒ यत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
upayāmagṛhīto'si bṛhaspatisutasya deva soma ta indorindriyāvataḥ patnīvato grahām̐ ṛdhyāsam |
ahaṃ parastādahamavastādyadantarikṣaṃ tadu me pitā'bhūt |
ahaṃ sūryamubhayato dadarśāhaṃ devānāṃ paramaṃ guhā yat ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. May it be mine to prosper the libations of thee Brihaspati's son, O radiant Soma, of thee, strong Indu, mated with thy Consorts. I am in heaven above, on earth beneath it. The intermediate region was my father. I saw the Sun both from above and under. I am what Gods in secret hold the highest.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ना३इ॒ पत्नी॑वन्त्स॒जूर्दे॒वेन॒ त्वष्ट्रा॒ सोमं॑ पिब॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
प्र॒जाप॑ति॒र्वृषा॑ऽसि रेतो॒धा रेतो॒ मयि॑ धेहि प्र॒जाप॑तेस्ते॒ वृष्णो॑ रेतो॒धसो॑ रेतो॒धाम॑शीय ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnāi patnīvantsajūrdevena tvaṣṭrā somaṃ piba svāhā |
prajāpatirvṛṣā'si retodhā reto mayi dhehi prajāpateste vṛṣṇo retodhaso retodhāmaśīya ||
verses.translation: Agni, associate with the Dames, accordant with the God Tvashtar, drink. All-hail! Thou art Prajâpati, strong male, impregner: may I obtain from thee, strong male, impregner, a son who shall himself become a father.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ हरि॑रसि हारियोज॒नो हरि॑भ्यां त्वा । हर्यो॑र्धा॒ना स्थ॑ स॒हसो॑मा॒ इन्द्रा॑य ॥
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'si harirasi hāriyojano haribhyāṃ tvā | haryordhānā stha sahasomā indrāya ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Thou art bay-coloured, Yoker of Bay Coursers. Thee for the pair of tawny-coloured horses. United with the Soma, ye, for Indra, are corn for his two tawny steeds to feed on.

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते॑ अश्व॒सनि॑र्भ॒क्षो यो गो॒सनि॒स्तस्य॑ त इ॒ष्टय॑जुष स्तु॒तसो॑मस्य श॒स्तोक्थ॒स्योप॑हूत॒स्योप॑हूतो भक्षयामि ॥
verses.transliteration: yaste aśvasanirbhakṣo yo gosanistasya ta iṣṭayajuṣa stutasomasya śastokthasyopahūtasyopahūto bhakṣayāmi ||
verses.translation: That draught of thine which winneth cows or horses, offered with sacrificial text and lauded With chanted hymns and songs of adoration—of that permitted do I take permitted.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वकृ॑त॒स्यैन॑सोऽव॒यज॑नमसि मनु॒ष्य॒कृत॒स्यैन॑सोऽव॒यज॑नमसि पि॒तृकृ॑त॒स्यैन॑सोऽव॒यज॑नमस्या॒त्मकृ॑तस्यैनसोऽव॒यज॑नम॒स्येन॑स एनसोऽव॒यज॑नमसि ।
यच्चा॒हमेनो॑ वि॒द्वाँश्च॒कार॒ यच्चावि॑द्वाँ॒स्तस्य॒ सर्वस्यैन॑सोऽव॒यज॑नमसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
devakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi manuṣyakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasi pitṛkṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasyātmakṛtasyainaso'vayajanamasyenasa enaso'vayajanamasi |
yaccāhameno vidvām̐ścakāra yaccāvidvām̐stasya sarvasyainaso'vayajanamasi ||
verses.translation: Of sin against the Gods thou art atonement. Of sin against mankind thou art atonement. For sin against the Fathers thou atonest. Of sin against oneself thou art atonement. Of every sort of sin thou art atonement. The sin that I have knowingly committed, the sin that unawares I have committed, of all that wickedness thou art the atonement.

verses.sanskrit:
सं वर्च॑सा॒ पय॑सा॒ सं त॒नूभि॒रग॑न्महि॒ मन॑सा॒ सᳪ शि॒वेन॑ ।
त्वष्टा॑ सु॒दत्रो॒ वि द॑धातु॒ रायोऽनु॑मार्ष्टु त॒न्वो यद्विलि॑ष्टम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ varcasā payasā saṃ tanūbhiraganmahi manasā saṃ śivena |
tvaṣṭā sudatro vi dadhātu rāyo'numārṣṭu tanvo yadviliṣṭam ||
verses.translation: We with our bodies have again united, with lustre, vital sap, and happy spirit. Giver of boons, may Tvashtar grant us riches and smooth whateer was injured in our body.

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑न्द्र णो॒ मन॑सा नेषि॒ गोभिः॒ सᳪ सू॒रिभि॑र्मघव॒न्त्सᳪ स्व॒स्त्या ।
सं ब्रह्म॑णा दे॒वकृ॑तं॒ यदस्ति॒ सं दे॒वाना॑ᳪ सुम॒तौ य॒ज्ञिया॑ना॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
samindra ṇo manasā neṣi gobhiḥ saṃ sūribhirmaghavantsaṃ svastyā |
saṃ brahmaṇā devakṛtaṃ yadasti saṃ devānāṃ sumatau yajñiyānāṃ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Lead us with thought to wealth in kine, O Indra, to princes, Lord of Bounty! and to welfare. Lead thou us on to God-inspired devotion, to favour of the Gods who merit worship. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
सं वर्च॑सा॒ पय॑सा॒ सं त॒नूभि॒रग॑न्महि॒ मन॑सा॒ सᳪ शि॒वेन॑ ।
त्वष्टा॑ सु॒दत्रो॒ वि द॑धातु॒ रायोऽनु॑मार्ष्टु त॒न्वो यद्विलि॑ष्टम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ varcasā payasā saṃ tanūbhiraganmahi manasā saṃ śivena |
tvaṣṭā sudatro vi dadhātu rāyo'numārṣṭu tanvo yadviliṣṭam ||
verses.translation: Verse 14 repeated.

verses.sanskrit:
धा॒ता रा॒तिः स॑वि॒तेदं जु॑षन्तां प्र॒जाप॑तिर्निधि॒पा दे॒वो अ॒ग्निः ।
त्वष्टा॒ विष्णुः॑ प्र॒जया॑ सᳪररा॒णा यज॑मानाय॒ द्रवि॑णं दधात॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhātā rātiḥ savitedaṃ juṣantāṃ prajāpatirnidhipā devo agniḥ |
tvaṣṭā viṣṇuḥ prajayā saṃrarāṇā yajamānāya draviṇaṃ dadhāta svāhā ||
verses.translation: May this please Savitar and liberal Dhâtar, Prajâpati the Treasure-Guard, bright Agni, Tvashtar, and Vishnu: blessing him with children, grant store of riches to the Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒गा वो॑ देवाः॒ सद॑ना अकर्म॒ य आ॑ज॒ग्मेदᳪ सव॑नं जुषा॒णाः ।
भर॑माणा॒ वह॑माना ह॒वीᳪष्य॒स्मे ध॑त्त वसवो॒ वसू॑नि॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sugā vo devāḥ sadanā akarma ya ājagmedaṃ savanaṃ juṣāṇāḥ |
bharamāṇā vahamānā havīṃṣyasme dhatta vasavo vasūni svāhā ||
verses.translation: Gods, we have made your seats easy of access, who, pleased with us, have come to this libation. Bearing and bringing hitherward your treasures, grant to this man, good Lords, abundant riches. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
याँ२ आऽव॑ह उश॒तो दे॑व दे॒वाँस्तान् प्रेर॑य॒ स्वे अ॑ग्ने स॒धस्थे॑ ।
ज॒क्षि॒वाᳪसः॑ पपि॒वाᳪस॑श्च॒ विश्वेऽसुं॑ घ॒र्मᳪ स्व॒राति॑ष्ठ॒तानु॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yām̐ ā'vaha uśato deva devām̐stān preraya sve agne sadhasthe |
jakṣivāṃsaḥ papivāṃsaśca viśve'suṃ gharmaṃ svarātiṣṭhatānu svāhā ||
verses.translation: The willing Gods whom, God, thou hast brought hither, send them to their own dwelling-place, O Agni. As all of you have eaten and have drunken, approach the air, the heat, the light of heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
व॒यᳪ हि त्वा॑ प्रय॒ति य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन्न॑ग्ने॒ होता॑र॒मवृ॑णीमही॒ह ।
ऋध॑गया॒ ऋध॑गु॒ताश॑मिष्ठाः प्रजा॒नन् य॒ज्ञमुप॑ याहि वि॒द्वान्त्स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vayaṃ hi tvā prayati yajñe asminnagne hotāramavṛṇīmahīha |
ṛdhagayā ṛdhagutāśamiṣṭhāḥ prajānan yajñamupa yāhi vidvāntsvāhā ||
verses.translation: Here, Agni, as this sacrifice proceedeth, have we elected thee to be our Hotar. Special have been thine offerings and thy labour. Well knowing sacrifice, as sage, come near us.

verses.sanskrit: देवा॑ गातुविदो गा॒तुं वि॒त्त्वा गा॒तुमि॑त । मन॑सस्पत इ॒मं दे॑व य॒ज्ञᳪ स्वाहा॒ वाते॑ धाः ॥
verses.transliteration: devā gātuvido gātuṃ vittvā gātumita | manasaspata imaṃ deva yajñaṃ svāhā vāte dhāḥ ||
verses.translation: Do ye, O Gods, discoverers of the Pathway, go forward on the path when ye have found it. O God, thou Lord and Master of the Spirit, bestow— All-hail!—this sacrifice on Vâta.

verses.sanskrit:
यज्ञ॑ य॒ज्ञं ग॑च्छ य॒ज्ञपतिं॑ गच्छ॒ स्वां योनिं॑ गच्छ॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
ए॒ष ते॑ य॒ज्ञो य॑ज्ञपते स॒हसू॑क्तवाकः॒ सर्व॑वीर॒स्तं जु॑षस्व॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajña yajñaṃ gaccha yajñapatiṃ gaccha svāṃ yoniṃ gaccha svāhā |
eṣa te yajño yajñapate sahasūktavākaḥ sarvavīrastaṃ juṣasva svāhā ||
verses.translation: Go, Sacrifice, to the sacrifice: seek thou the sacrifice's lord, seek thine own home. All-hail! Lord of the sacrifice, this is thy sacrifice, followed by many heroes, loud with hymns of praise. Accept it thou. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
माहि॑र्भू॒र्मा पृदा॑कुः । उ॒रुᳪ हि राजा॒ वरु॑णश्च॒कार॒ सूर्या॑य॒ पन्था॒मन्वे॑त॒वा उ॑ ।
अ॒पदे॒ पादा॒ प्रति॑धातवेऽकरु॒ताप॑व॒क्ता हृ॑दया॒विध॑श्चित् ।
नमो॒ वरु॑णाया॒भिष्ठि॑तो॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ पाशः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
māhirbhūrmā pṛdākuḥ | uruṃ hi rājā varuṇaścakāra sūryāya panthāmanvetavā u |
apade pādā pratidhātave'karutāpavaktā hṛdayāvidhaścit |
namo varuṇāyābhiṣṭhito varuṇasya pāśaḥ ||
verses.translation: Become no serpent thou, become no viper. King Vat-tins hath made a spacious pathway, a pathway for the Sun wherein to travel. Where no way was he made him set his footstep, and warned afar whateer afflicts the spirit. To Varuna be reverential homage! Varuna's noose beneath our feet is trampled.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नेरनी॑कम॒प आ वि॑वेशा॒पां नपा॑त् प्रति॒रक्ष॑न्नसु॒र्य॒म् ।
दमे॑दमे स॒मिधं॑ यक्ष्यग्ने॒ प्रति॑ ते जि॒ह्वा घृ॒तमुच्च॑रण्य॒त् स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
agneranīkamapa ā viveśāpāṃ napāt pratirakṣannasuryam |
damedame samidhaṃ yakṣyagne prati te jihvā ghṛtamuccaraṇyat svāhā ||
verses.translation: The waters, face of Agni, have I entered, O Waters Child, repelling evil spirits. Offer the fuel in each home, O Agni. Let thy tongue dart —All-hail!—to meet the butter.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒मु॒द्रे ते॒ हृद॑यम॒प्स्वन्तः सं त्वा॑ विश॒न्त्वोष॑धीरु॒तापः॑ ।
य॒ज्ञस्य॑ त्वा यज्ञपते सू॒क्तोक्तौ॑ नमोवा॒के वि॑धेम॒ यत्स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
samudre te hṛdayamapsvantaḥ saṃ tvā viśantvoṣadhīrutāpaḥ |
yajñasya tvā yajñapate sūktoktau namovāke vidhema yatsvāhā ||
verses.translation: Thy heart is in the flood, within the waters. With thee let plants and waters be commingled, That, Lard of Sacrifice, we may adore thee with singing praise and telling forth our homage. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
देवी॑राप ए॒ष वो॒ गर्भ॒स्तᳪ सुप्री॑त॒ᳪ सुभृ॑तं बिभृत ।
देव॑ सोमै॒ष ते॑ लो॒कस्तस्मि॒ञ्छं च॒ वक्ष्व॒ परि॑ च॒ वक्ष्व॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devīrāpa eṣa vo garbhastaṃ suprītaṃ subhṛtaṃ bibhṛta |
deva somaiṣa te lokastasmiñchaṃ ca vakṣva pari ca vakṣva ||
verses.translation: This, O celestial Waters, is your offspring. Support him dearly loved and gently nurtured. This is thy station, O celestial Soma; therein bring happiness and ward off evil.

verses.sanskrit:
अव॑भृथ निचुम्पुण निचे॒रुर॑सि निचुम्पु॒णः ।
अव॑ देवैर्दे॒वकृ॑त॒मेनो॑ऽयासिष॒मव॒ मर्त्यै॒र्मर्त्य॑कृतं पुरु॒राव्णो॑ देव रि॒षस्पा॑हि ।
दे॒वाना॑ᳪ स॒मिद॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
avabhṛtha nicumpuṇa nicerurasi nicumpuṇaḥ |
ava devairdevakṛtameno'yāsiṣamava martyairmartyakṛtaṃ pururāvṇo deva riṣaspāhi |
devānāṃ samidasi ||
verses.translation: O restless Purifying Bath, thou glidest onward restlessly. May I with aid of Gods remove the stain of sin against the Gods, and wash away with mortals help the wrong that hath been done to men. Preserve me, God, from injury, from the loud-roaring demon foe. Thou art the fuel of the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
एज॑तु॒ दश॑मास्यो॒ गर्भो॑ ज॒रायु॑णा स॒ह । यथा॒ऽयं वा॒युरेज॑ति॒ यथा॑ समु॒द्र एज॑ति ।
ए॒वा॒यं दश॑मास्यो॒ अस्र॑ज्ज॒रायु॑णा स॒ह ॥
verses.transliteration:
ejatu daśamāsyo garbho jarāyuṇā saha | yathā'yaṃ vāyurejati yathā samudra ejati |
evāyaṃ daśamāsyo asrajjarāyuṇā saha ||
verses.translation: Let, still unborn, the ten-month calf move with the following after-birth. Even as the-wind is moving, as the gathered flood of ocean moves, So may this ten-month calf come forth together with the after-birth.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्यै॑ ते य॒ज्ञियो॒ गर्भो॒ यस्यै॒ योनि॑र्हिरण्यी ।
अङ्गा॒न्यह्रु॑ता॒ यस्य॒ तं मा॒त्रा सम॑जीगम॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasyai te yajñiyo garbho yasyai yonirhiraṇyī |
aṅgānyahrutā yasya taṃ mātrā samajīgamaṃ svāhā ||
verses.translation: O thou who hast a womb of gold and offspring meet for sacrifice, Him with all limbs unbroken have I brought together with his dam. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
पुरुद॒स्मो विषु॑रूप॒ इन्दु॑र॒न्तर्म॑हि॒मान॑मानञ्ज॒ धीरः॑ ।
एक॑पदीं द्वि॒पदीं॑ त्रि॒पदीं॒ चतु॒ष्पदीम॒ष्टाप॑दीं॒ भुव॒नानु॑ प्रथन्ता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
purudasmo viṣurūpa indurantarmahimānamānañja dhīraḥ |
ekapadīṃ dvipadīṃ tripadīṃ catuṣpadīmaṣṭāpadīṃ bhuvanānu prathantāṃ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Multiform, rich in wondrous operation, the strong juice hath enrobed itself with greatness. Let the worlds praise her uniped and biped, three-footed and four-footed and eight-footed. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: मरु॑तो॒ यस्य॒ हि क्षये॑ पा॒था दि॒वो वि॑महसः । स सु॑गो॒पात॑मो॒ जनः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: maruto yasya hi kṣaye pāthā divo vimahasaḥ | sa sugopātamo janaḥ ||
verses.translation: Verily, best of guardians hath he in whose dwelling-place ye drink, O Maruts, giants of the sky.

verses.sanskrit: म॒ही द्यौः पृ॑थि॒वी च॑ न इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्षताम् । पि॒पृ॒तां नो॒ भरी॑मभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām | pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ ||
verses.translation: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, besprinkle this our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.

verses.sanskrit:
आ ति॑ष्ठ वृत्रह॒न्रथं॑ यु॒क्ता ते॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ हरी॑ । अ॒र्वा॒चीन॒ᳪ सु ते॒ मनो॒ ग्रावा॑ कृणोतु व॒ग्नुना॑ ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा षोड॒शिन॑ ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा षोड॒शिने॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā tiṣṭha vṛtrahanrathaṃ yuktā te brahmaṇā harī | arvācīnaṃ su te mano grāvā kṛṇotu vagnunā |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā ṣoḍaśina eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine ||
verses.translation: Slayer of Vritra, mount thy car: thy Bay Steeds have been yoked by prayer. May, with its voice, the pressing-stone draw thine attention hither ward. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra thee, for Shodasî. This is a dwelling-place for thee. For Indra thee, for Shodasî.

verses.sanskrit:
यु॒क्ष्वा हि के॒शिना॒ हरी॒ वृष॑णा कक्ष्य॒प्रा । अथा॑ न इन्द्र सोमपा गि॒रामुप॑श्रुतिं चर ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा षोड॒शिन॑ ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा षोड॒शिने॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yukṣvā hi keśinā harī vṛṣaṇā kakṣyaprā | athā na indra somapā girāmupaśrutiṃ cara |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā ṣoḍaśina eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine ||
verses.translation: Harness thy pair of strong Bay Steeds, long-maned, whose bodies fill the girths, And, Indra, Soma-drinker, come to listen to our songs of praise. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 33.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॒मिद्धरी॑ वह॒तोऽप्र॑तिधृष्टशवसम् । ऋषी॑णां च स्तु॒तीरुप॑ य॒ज्ञं च॒ मानु॑षाणाम् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ सीन्द्रा॑य त्वा षोड॒शिने॑ ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा षोड॒शिने॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indramiddharī vahato'pratidhṛṣṭaśavasam | ṛṣīṇāṃ ca stutīrupa yajñaṃ ca mānuṣāṇām |
upayāmagṛhīto sīndrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā ṣoḍaśine ||
verses.translation: His pair of tawny Coursers bring Indra of unresisted might Hither to Rishis songs of praise and sacrifice performed by men. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 33.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मा॒न्न जा॒तः परो॑ अ॒न्यो अस्ति॒ य आ॑वि॒वेश॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
प्र॒जाप॑तिः प्र॒जया॑ सᳪररा॒णस्त्रीणि॒ ज्योती॑ᳪषि सचते॒ स षो॑डशी ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasmānna jātaḥ paro anyo asti ya āviveśa bhuvanāni viśvā |
prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃrarāṇastrīṇi jyotīṃṣi sacate sa ṣoḍaśī ||
verses.translation: Than whom there is none other born more mighty, who hath pervaded all existing creatures— Prajâpati, rejoicing in his offspring, he, Shodasî, maintains the three great lustres.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑श्च स॒म्राड्वरु॑णश्च॒ राजा तौ ते भ॒क्षं च॑क्रतु॒रग्र॑ ए॒तम् ।
तयो॑र॒हमनु॑ भ॒क्षं भ॑क्षयामि॒ वाग्दे॒वी जु॑षा॒णा सोम॑स्य तृप्यतु स॒ह प्रा॒णेन॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indraśca samrāḍvaruṇaśca rājā tau te bhakṣaṃ cakraturagra etam |
tayorahamanu bhakṣaṃ bhakṣayāmi vāgdevī juṣāṇā somasya tṛpyatu saha prāṇena svāhā ||
verses.translation: Indra chief Lord and Varuna the Sovran have made this draught of thine the first and foremost. I, after, drink their draught. May she, the Goddess of Speech, rejoicing, sate herself with Soma—All-hail!—with Prâna as her feast-companion.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ पव॑स्व॒ स्वपा॑ अ॒स्मे वर्चः॑ सु॒वीर्य॑म् । दध॑द्र॒यिं मयि॒ पोष॑म् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒ग्नये॑ त्वा॒ वर्च॑स ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र॒ग्नये॑ त्वा॒ वर्च॑से ।
अग्ने॑ वर्चस्वि॒न्वर्च॑स्वाँ॒स्त्वं दे॒वेष्वसि॒ वर्च॑स्वान॒हं म॑नु॒ष्ये॑षु भूयासम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne pavasva svapā asme varcaḥ suvīryam | dadhadrayiṃ mayi poṣam |
upayāmagṛhīto'syagnaye tvā varcasa eṣa te yoniragnaye tvā varcase |
agne varcasvinvarcasvām̐stvaṃ deveṣvasi varcasvānahaṃ manuṣyeṣu bhūyāsam ||
verses.translation: Skilled in thy task, O Agni, pour lustre and hero strength on us, Granting me wealth and affluence. Taken upon a base art thou. For Agni thee, for splendour This is thy home. For Agni thee, for splendour. Thou, lustrous Agni, mid the Gods art splendid. May I among mankind be bright with lustre.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒त्तिष्ठ॒न्नोज॑सा स॒ह पी॒त्वी शिप्रे॑ अवेपयः । सोम॑मिन्द्र च॒मू सु॒तम् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य॒ त्वौज॑स ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वौजसे ।
इन्द्रौ॑जिष्ठौजि॑ष्ठ॒स्त्वं दे॒वेष्वस्योजि॑ष्ठो॒ऽहं म॑नु॒ष्ये॒षु भूयासम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
uttiṣṭhannojasā saha pītvī śipre avepayaḥ | somamindra camū sutam |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvaujasa eṣa te yonirindrāya tvaujase |
indraujiṣṭhaujiṣṭhastvaṃ deveṣvasyojiṣṭho'haṃ manuṣyeṣu bhūyāsam ||
verses.translation: Arising in thy might thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having drunk The Soma which the mortar pressed. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra thee, for mighty strength. This is thy home. For Indra thee, for might. Among the Gods thou art the mightiest, Indra. Among mankind I fain would be most mighty.

verses.sanskrit:
अदृ॑श्रमस्य के॒तवो॒ वि र॒श्मयो॒ जनाँ॒२ अनु॑ । भ्राज॑न्तो अ॒ग्नयो॑ यथा ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ सूर्या॑य त्वा भ्रा॒जायै॒ष ते॒ योनिः॒ सूर्या॑य त्वा भ्रा॒जाय॑ ।
सूर्य॑ भ्राजिष्ठ॒ भ्राजि॑ष्ठ॒स्त्वं दे॒वेष्वसि॒ भ्राजि॑ष्ठो॒ऽहं म॑नु॒ष्ये॒षु भूयासम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
adṛśramasya ketavo vi raśmayo janām̐ anu | bhrājanto agnayo yathā |
upayāmagṛhīto'si sūryāya tvā bhrājāyaiṣa te yoniḥ sūryāya tvā bhrājāya |
sūrya bhrājiṣṭha bhrājiṣṭhastvaṃ deveṣvasi bhrājiṣṭho'haṃ manuṣyeṣu bhūyāsam ||
verses.translation: His herald rays are seen afar refulgent oer the world of men, Like flames of fire that burn and blaze. Taken upon a base art thou. For Sûrya, for the Bright One, thee. This is thy home. For Sûrya, for the Bright One, thee. Thou among Gods art brightest, brightest Sûrya. Among mankind I fain would be the brightest.

verses.sanskrit:
उदु॒ त्यं जा॒तवे॑दसं दे॒वं व॑हन्ति के॒तवः॑ । दृ॒शे विश्वा॑य॒ सूर्य॑म् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ सूर्या॑य त्वा भ्रा॒जायै॒ष ते॒ योनिः॒ सूर्या॑य त्वा भ्रा॒जाय॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ | dṛśe viśvāya sūryam |
upayāmagṛhīto'si sūryāya tvā bhrājāyaiṣa te yoniḥ sūryāya tvā bhrājāya ||
verses.translation: His herald rays bear him aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look at him. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 40.

verses.sanskrit:
आ जि॑घ्र क॒लशं॑ म॒ह्या त्वा॑ विश॒न्त्विन्द॑वः ।
पुन॑रू॒र्जा नि व॑र्तस्व॒ सा नः॑ स॒हस्रं॑ धुक्ष्वो॒रुधा॑रा॒ पय॑स्वती॒ पुन॒र्मा वि॑शताद्र॒यिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā jighra kalaśaṃ mahyā tvā viśantvindavaḥ |
punarūrjā ni vartasva sā naḥ sahasraṃ dhukṣvorudhārā payasvatī punarmā viśatādrayiḥ ||
verses.translation: Smell thou the vat. Let Soma drops pass into thee, O Mighty One. Return again with store of sap. Pour for us wealth in thousands thou with full broad streams and floods of milk. A Let riches come again to me.

verses.sanskrit:
इडे॒ रन्ते॒ हव्ये॒ काम्ये॒ चन्द्रे॒ ज्योतेऽदि॑ते॒ सर॑स्वति॒ महि॒ विश्रु॑ति ।
ए॒ता ते॑ अघ्न्ये॒ नामा॑नि दे॒वेभ्यो॑ मा सु॒कृतं॑ ब्रूतात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
iḍe rante havye kāmye candre jyote'dite sarasvati mahi viśruti |
etā te aghnye nāmāni devebhyo mā sukṛtaṃ brūtāt ||
verses.translation: Idâ, delightful, worshipful, loveable, splendid, shining One, Inviolable, full of sap, the Mighty One, most glorious, These are thy names, O Cow: tell thou the Gods that I act righteously.

verses.sanskrit:
वि न॑ इन्द्र॒ मृधो॑ जहि नी॒चा य॑च्छ पृतन्य॒तः ।
यो अ॒स्माँ२ अ॑भि॒दास॒त्यध॑रं गमया॒ तमः॑ ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा वि॒मृधे॑ ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा वि॒मृधे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ |
yo asmām̐ abhidāsatyadharaṃ gamayā tamaḥ |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā vimṛdhe eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā vimṛdhe ||
verses.translation: O Indra, beat our foes away, humble the men who challenge us: Send down to nether darkness him who seeks to do us injury. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra, foe-dispeller, thee. This is thy home. For Indra, foe-dispeller, thee.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒चस्पतिं॑ वि॒श्वक॑र्माणमू॒तये॑ मनो॒जुवं॒ वाजे॑ अ॒द्या हु॑वेम ।
स नो॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ हव॑नानि जोषद्वि॒श्वश॑म्भू॒रव॑से सा॒धुक॑र्मा ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा वि॒श्वक॑र्मणे
ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा वि॒श्वक॑र्मणे ॥
verses.transliteration:
vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmāṇamūtaye manojuvaṃ vāje adyā huvema |
sa no viśvāni havanāni joṣadviśvaśambhūravase sādhukarmā |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇe
eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇe ||
verses.translation: Let us invoke to-day, to aid our labour, the Lord of Speech, the thought-swift Visvakarman. May he hear kindly all our invocations, who gives all bliss for aid, whose works are righteous. Taken upon a base art thou. For Indra Visvakarman thee. This is thy home. For Indra Visvakarman thee.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्व॑कर्मन् ह॒विषा॒ वर्ध॑नेन त्रा॒तार॒मिन्द्र॑मकृणोरव॒ध्यम् ।
तस्मै॒ विशः॒ सम॑नमन्त पू॒र्वीर॒यमु॒ग्रो वि॒हव्यो॒ यथास॑त् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा वि॒श्वक॑र्मण
ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा वि॒श्वक॑र्मणे ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāramindramakṛṇoravadhyam |
tasmai viśaḥ samanamanta pūrvīrayamugro vihavyo yathāsat |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇa
eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā viśvakarmaṇe ||
verses.translation: With strengthening libation, Visvakarman, thou madest Indra an undying guardian. The people of old time bowed down before him because the Mighty One was meet for worship. Taken upon a base, etc., as in 45.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒ग्नये॑ त्वा गाय॒त्रच्छ॑न्दसं गृह्णामीन्द्रा॑य त्वा त्रि॒ष्टुप्छ॑न्दसं गृह्णामि॒
विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्यो॒ जग॑च्छन्दसं गृह्णाम्यनु॒ष्टुप्ते॑ऽभिग॒रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
upayāmagṛhīto'syagnaye tvā gāyatracchandasaṃ gṛhṇāmīndrāya tvā triṣṭupchandasaṃ gṛhṇāmi
viśvebhyastvā devebhyo jagacchandasaṃ gṛhṇāmyanuṣṭupte'bhigaraḥ ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee lord of Gâyatrî for Agni. For Indra take I thee the lord of Trishtup. I lake thee lord of Jagatî for All-Gods. Anushtup is the song that sings thy praises.

verses.sanskrit: व्रेशी॑नां त्वा॒ पत्म॒न्ना धू॑नोमि कुकू॒नना॑नां त्वा॒ पत्म॒न्ना धू॑नोमि भ॒न्दना॑नां त्वा॒ पत्म॒न्ना धू॑नोमि म॒दिन्त॑मानां त्वा॒ पत्म॒न्ना धू॑नोमि म॒धुन्त॑मानां त्वा॒ पत्म॒न्ना धू॑नोमि शु॒क्रं त्वा॑ शु॒क्र आ धू॑नो॒म्यह्नो॑ रू॒पे सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिषु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vreśīnāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi kukūnanānāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi bhandanānāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi madintamānāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi madhuntamānāṃ tvā patmannā dhūnomi śukraṃ tvā śukra ā dhūnomyahno rūpe sūryasya raśmiṣu ||
verses.translation: I stir thee for the fall of cloud-borne waters. I stir thee for the fall of streams that gurgle. I stir thee for the fall of those that gladden. I stir thee for their fall who are most lovely. I stir thee for their fall that are the sweetest. I stir thee for the waters fall, I stir thee, pure one, in the pure, in the day's form, in Sûrya's beams.

verses.sanskrit:
ककु॒भᳪ रू॒पं वृ॑ष॒भस्य॑ रोचते बृ॒हच्छु॒क्रः शु॒क्रस्य॑ पुरो॒गाः सोमः॒ सोम॑स्य पुरो॒गाः ।
यत्ते॑ सोमा॒दा॑भ्यं॒ नाम॒ जागृ॑वि॒ तस्मै॑ त्वा गृह्णामि॒ तस्मै॑ ते सोम॒ सोमा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
kakubhaṃ rūpaṃ vṛṣabhasya rocate bṛhacchukraḥ śukrasya purogāḥ somaḥ somasya purogāḥ |
yatte somādābhyaṃ nāma jāgṛvi tasmai tvā gṛhṇāmi tasmai te soma somāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: The Bull's majestic form is shining brightly, the pure the pure's preceder, Soma Soma's. Whatever name invincible, stimulating, is thine, O Soma, for that name I take thee. All-hail to Soma, unto thee, O Soma.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒शिक् त्वं दे॑व सोमा॒ग्नेः प्रि॒यं पाथोऽपी॑हि
व॒शी त्वं दे॑व सो॒मेन्द्र॑स्य प्रि॒यं पाथोऽपी॑ह्य॒स्मत्स॑खा॒ त्वं दे॑व सोम॒ विश्वे॑षां दे॒वानां॑ प्रि॒यं पाथोऽपी॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration:
uśik tvaṃ deva somāgneḥ priyaṃ pātho'pīhi
vaśī tvaṃ deva somendrasya priyaṃ pātho'pīhyasmatsakhā tvaṃ deva soma viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ priyaṃ pātho'pīhi ||
verses.translation: O radiant Soma, eagerly draw nigh to Agni's well-loved food. O radiant Soma, willingly go to the food that Indra loves. Go, radiant Soma, as our friend, to the All-Gods beloved food.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒ह रति॑रि॒ह र॑मध्वमि॒ह धृति॑रि॒ह स्वधृ॑तिः॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
उ॒प॒सृ॒जन् ध॒रुणं॑ मा॒त्रे ध॒रुणो॑ मा॒तरं॒ धय॑न् । रा॒यस्पोष॑म॒स्मासु॑ दीधर॒त्स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
iha ratiriha ramadhvamiha dhṛtiriha svadhṛtiḥ svāhā |
upasṛjan dharuṇaṃ mātre dharuṇo mātaraṃ dhayan | rāyaspoṣamasmāsu dīdharatsvāhā ||
verses.translation: Here is delight: enjoy yourselves; here surety, surety of your own. All-hail! Loosing the suckling to his dam, the suckling as he milks his dam May he maintain the growth of wealth among us. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
स॒त्रस्य॒ ऋद्धि॑र॒स्यग॑न्म॒ ज्योति॑र॒मृता॑ अभूम॒ ।
दिवं॑ पृथि॒व्या अध्याऽरु॑हा॒मावि॑दाम दे॒वान्त्स्व॒र्ज्योतिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
satrasya ṛddhirasyaganma jyotiramṛtā abhūma |
divaṃ pṛthivyā adhyā'ruhāmāvidāma devāntsvarjyotiḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou art the Session's happy termination. We have attained the light and grown immortal. We have gone up from earth to sky, have found the Gods and heaven and light.

verses.sanskrit:
यु॒वं तमि॑न्द्रापर्वता पुरो॒युधा॒ यो नः॑ पृत॒न्यादप॒ तं त॒मिद्ध॑तं॒ वज्रे॑ण॒ तं त॒मिद्ध॑तम् ।
दू॒रे च॒त्ताय॑ छन्त्स॒द्गह॑नं॒ यदिन॑क्षत् ।
अ॒स्माक॒ᳪ शत्रू॒न्परि॑ शूर वि॒श्वतो॑ द॒र्मा द॑र्षीष्ट वि॒श्वतः॑ ।
भूर्भुवः॒ स्वः॒ सुप्र॒जाः प्र॒जाभिः॑ स्याम सु॒वीरा॑ वीरैः सु॒पोषाः॒ पोषैः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yuvaṃ tamindrāparvatā puroyudhā yo naḥ pṛtanyādapa taṃ tamiddhataṃ vajreṇa taṃ tamiddhatam |
dūre cattāya chantsadgahanaṃ yadinakṣat |
asmākaṃ śatrūnpari śūra viśvato darmā darṣīṣṭa viśvataḥ |
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ suprajāḥ prajābhiḥ syāma suvīrā vīraiḥ supoṣāḥ poṣaiḥ ||
verses.translation: Indra and Parvata, our champions in the fight, drive ye away the man who fain would war with us, drive him far from us with the bolt. Welcome to him concealed afar shall be the lair that he hath found. So may the Render rend our foes on every side, rend them. O Hero, everywhere. Earth! Ether! Sky! May we be rich in offspring, rich in brave sons and rich in food to feed us.

verses.sanskrit:
प॒र॒मे॒ष्ठ्य॒भिधी॑तः प्र॒जाप॑तिर्वा॒चि व्याहृ॑तायामन्धो॒ अच्छे॑तः ।
स॑वि॒ता स॒न्यां वि॒श्वक॑र्मा दी॒क्षायां॑ पू॒षा सो॑म॒क्रय॑ण्याम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
parameṣṭhyabhidhītaḥ prajāpatirvāci vyāhṛtāyāmandho acchetaḥ |
savitā sanyāṃ viśvakarmā dīkṣāyāṃ pūṣā somakrayaṇyām ||
verses.translation: Parameshthin when contemplated. Prajâpati in uttered speech. Food when approached. Savitar in the partition. Visvakarman in Consecration. Pûshan in the Soma-purchasing cow.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑श्च म॒रुत॑श्च क्र॒यायो॒पोत्थि॒तो ऽसु॑रः प॒ण्यमा॑नो मि॒त्रः क्री॒तो विष्णुः॑ शिपिवि॒ष्ट उ॒रावास॑न्नो॒ विष्णु॑र्न॒रन्धि॑षः ॥
verses.transliteration: indraśca marutaśca krayāyopotthito 'suraḥ paṇyamāno mitraḥ krīto viṣṇuḥ śipiviṣṭa urāvāsanno viṣṇurnarandhiṣaḥ ||
verses.translation: As Indra and the Maruts he is stationed ready for the sale: Asura, being bought and sold. Mitra when purchased; Vishnu Sipivishta when on the Sacrificer's thigh he resteth; Vishnu Naraudhisha brought on the barrow;

verses.sanskrit: प्रो॒ह्यमा॑णः॒ सोम॒ आग॑तो॒ वरु॑ण आस॒न्द्यामास॑न्नो॒ ऽग्निराग्नी॑ध्र॒ इन्द्रो॑ हवि॒र्धाने॑ ऽथ॑र्वोपावह्रि॒यमा॑णः ॥
verses.transliteration: prohyamāṇaḥ soma āgato varuṇa āsandyāmāsanno 'gnirāgnīdhra indro havirdhāne 'tharvopāvahriyamāṇaḥ ||
verses.translation: Soma when come: when seated on the platform, Varuna; Agni in the sacred fire-place; Indra upon the sacrificial barrow; Atharvan when deposited for pounding;

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अ॒ᳪशुषु॒ न्युप्तो॒ विष्णु॑राप्रीत॒पा आ॑प्या॒य्यमा॑नो य॒मः सू॒यमा॑ नो॒ विष्णुः॑ सम्भ्रि॒यमा॑णो वा॒युः पू॒यमा॑नः शु॒क्रः पू॒तः शु॒क्रः क्षी॑र॒श्रीर्म॒न्थी स॑क्तु॒श्रीः ॥
verses.transliteration: viśve devā aṃśuṣu nyupto viṣṇurāprītapā āpyāyyamāno yamaḥ sūyamā no viṣṇuḥ sambhriyamāṇo vāyuḥ pūyamānaḥ śukraḥ pūtaḥ śukraḥ kṣīraśrīrmanthī saktuśrīḥ ||
verses.translation: All-Gods when offered in the scattered fragments; Vishnu, the guard of those who soothe his anger, when he is filled and swelling in the waters; Yama in pressing; Vishnu in collection; Vâyu what time they cleanse and purify him; the Bright when cleansed; the Bright with milk about him; Manthin commingled with the meal of barley;

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वे॑ दे॒वाश्च॑म॒सेषून्नी॒तो ऽसु॒र्होमा॒योद्य॑तो रु॒द्रो हू॒यमा॑नो॒ वातो॒ऽभ्यावृ॑त्तो नृ॒चक्षाः॒ प्रति॑ख्यातो
भ॒क्षो भ॒क्ष्यमा॑णः पि॒तरो॑ नाराश॒ᳪसाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśve devāścamaseṣūnnīto 'surhomāyodyato rudro hūyamāno vāto'bhyāvṛtto nṛcakṣāḥ pratikhyāto
bhakṣo bhakṣyamāṇaḥ pitaro nārāśaṃsāḥ ||
verses.translation: All-Gods when he is drawn away in beakers; Life when uplifted for the fire-oblation; Rudra when offered; Vâta when reverted; Man-viewer when beheld; drink when they drink him; deposited, the Nârâsamsa Fathers;

verses.sanskrit:
स॒न्नः सिन्धु॑रवभृ॒थायोद्य॑तः समु॒द्रो॒ऽभ्यवह्रि॒यमा॑णः स॑लि॒लः प्रप्लु॑तो
ययो॒रोज॑सा स्कभि॒ता रजा॑ᳪसि वी॒र्ये॑भिर्वी॒रत॑मा॒ शवि॑ष्ठा ।
या पत्ये॑ते॒ अप्र॑तीता॒ सहो॑भि॒र्विष्णू॑ अग॒न्वरु॑णा पू॒र्वहू॑तौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sannaḥ sindhuravabhṛthāyodyataḥ samudro'bhyavahriyamāṇaḥ salilaḥ prapluto
yayorojasā skabhitā rajāṃsi vīryebhirvīratamā śaviṣṭhā |
yā patyete apratītā sahobhirviṣṇū aganvaruṇā pūrvahūtau ||
verses.translation: Sindhu when ready for the bath that cleanses the sea when he is carried to the waters; Water is he when he is plunged beneath it. To those most mighty hath it gone, most manly in vigour, by whose strength the worlds were stablished, Who rule as Lords resistless in their grandeur, Vishnu and Varuna, at the prayer of morning.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वान्दिव॑मगन्य॒ज्ञस्ततो॑ मा॒ द्रवि॑णमष्टु मनु॒ष्या॒न॒न्तरि॑क्षमगन्य॒ज्ञस्ततो॑ मा॒ द्रवि॑णमष्टु
पि॒तॄन्पृ॑थि॒वीम॑गन्य॒ज्ञस्ततो॑ मा॒ द्रवि॑णमष्टु॒ यं कं च॑ लो॒कमग॑न्य॒ज्ञस्ततो॑ मे भ॒द्रंम॑भूत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
devāndivamaganyajñastato mā draviṇamaṣṭu manuṣyānantarikṣamaganyajñastato mā draviṇamaṣṭu
pitṝnpṛthivīmaganyajñastato mā draviṇamaṣṭu yaṃ kaṃ ca lokamaganyajñastato me bhadraṃmabhūt ||
verses.translation: To Gods, to sky the sacrifice hath gone: come riches thence to me! To men, to air the sacrifice hath gone: come riches thence to me! To Fathers, earth, the sacrifice hath gone: come riches thence to me! Whatever sphere the sacrifice hath reached, may wealth come thence to me

verses.sanskrit:
चतु॑स्त्रिᳪश॒त्तन्त॑वो॒ ये वित॑त्नि॒रे य इ॒मं य॒ज्ञᳪ स्व॒धया॒ दद॑न्ते ।
तेषां॑ छि॒न्नᳪ सम्वे॒तद्द॑धामि॒ स्वाहा॑ घ॒र्मो अप्ये॑तु दे॒वान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
catustriṃśattantavo ye vitatnire ya imaṃ yajñaṃ svadhayā dadante |
teṣāṃ chinnaṃ samvetaddadhāmi svāhā gharmo apyetu devān ||
verses.translation: The threads that have been spun, the four-and-thirty, which stablish this our sacrifice with Svadhâ, Of these I join together what is broken. All-hail! to Gods go the warm milk oblation!

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञस्य॒ दोहो॒ वित॑तः पुरु॒त्रा सो अ॑ष्ट॒धा दिव॑म॒न्वात॑तान ।
स य॑ज्ञ धुक्ष्व॒ महि॑ मे प्र॒जा या॑ᳪ रा॒यस्पोषं॒ विश्व॒मायु॑रशीय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajñasya doho vitataḥ purutrā so aṣṭadhā divamanvātatāna |
sa yajña dhukṣva mahi me prajā yāṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ viśvamāyuraśīya svāhā ||
verses.translation: Spread far and wide is sacrifice's milking: eightfold along the heaven hath it extended. Pour, Sacrifice! in plenty on mine offspring: may I obtain prosperity for ever. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: आ प॑वस्व॒ हिर॑ण्यव॒दश्व॑वत्सोम वी॒रव॑त् । वाजं॒ गोम॑न्त॒मा भ॑र॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ā pavasva hiraṇyavadaśvavatsoma vīravat | vājaṃ gomantamā bhara svāhā ||
verses.translation: Soma, send wealth in gold and steeds and heroes. All-hail! bring hitherward booty in cattle.

verses.sanskrit:
देव॑ सवितः॒ प्रसु॑व य॒ज्ञं प्रसु॑व य॒ज्ञप॑तिं॒ भगा॑य ।
दि॒व्यो ग॑न्ध॒र्वः के॑तु॒पूः केतं॑ नः पुनातु वा॒चस्पति॒र्वाजं॑ नः स्वदतु॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
deva savitaḥ prasuva yajñaṃ prasuva yajñapatiṃ bhagāya |
divyo gandharvaḥ ketupūḥ ketaṃ naḥ punātu vācaspatirvājaṃ naḥ svadatu svāhā ||
verses.translation: Our sacrifice, God Savitar, speed onward: speed to his share the sacrifice's patron. May the celestial Gandharva, cleanser of thought and will, make clean our thought and purpose: the Lord of Speech sweeten the food we offer.

verses.sanskrit:
ध्रु॑व॒सदं॑ त्वा नृ॒षदं॑ मनः॒सद॑मुपया॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ जुष्टं॑ गृह्णाम्ये॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ जुष्ट॑तमम् ।
अ॑प्सु॒षदं॑ त्वा घृत॒सदं॑ व्योम॒सद॑मुपया॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ जुष्टं॑ गृह्णाम्ये॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ जुष्ट॑तमम् ।
पृथि॒वी॒सदं॑ त्वाऽन्तरिक्ष॒सदं॑ दिवि॒सदं॑ देव॒सदं॑ नाक॒सद॑मुपया॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ जुष्टं॑ गृह्णाम्ये॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ जुष्ट॑तमम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhruvasadaṃ tvā nṛṣadaṃ manaḥsadamupayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yonirindrāya tvā juṣṭatamam |
apsuṣadaṃ tvā ghṛtasadaṃ vyomasadamupayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yonirindrāya tvā juṣṭatamam |
pṛthivīsadaṃ tvā'ntarikṣasadaṃ divisadaṃ devasadaṃ nākasadamupayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yonirindrāya tvā juṣṭatamam ||
verses.translation: Thee, firmly set, settled in man, in spirit. Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee, draught acceptable to Indra. This is thy home. Thee, welcomest to Indra. Thee Set in waters, butter, realm of ether. Taken upon ......Indra. Thee seated in the sky, earth, air's mid-region, among the Gods and in the vault of heaven. Taken, etc. as above:

verses.sanskrit: अ॒पाᳪ रस॒मुद्व॑यस॒ᳪ सूर्ये॒ सन्त॑ᳪ स॒माहि॑तम् । अ॒पाᳪ रस॑स्य॒ यो रस॒स्तं वो॑ गृह्णाम्युत्त॒ममु॑पया॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ सीन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ जुष्टं॑ गृह्णाम्ये॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ जुष्ट॑तमम् ॥
verses.transliteration: apāṃ rasamudvayasaṃ sūrye santaṃ samāhitam | apāṃ rasasya yo rasastaṃ vo gṛhṇāmyuttamamupayāmagṛhīto sīndrāya tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yonirindrāya tvā juṣṭatamam ||
verses.translation: The strength-arousing essence of the waters, gathered in the Sun, Essence of waters essence, that, most excellent, I take for you. Taken, etc., as above.

verses.sanskrit: ग्रहा॑ ऊर्जाहुतयो॒ व्यन्तो॒ विप्रा॑य म॒तिम् । तेषां॒ विशि॑प्रियाणां वो॒ऽहमिष॒मूर्ज॒ᳪ सम॑ग्रभमुपया॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ जुष्टं॑ गृह्णाम्ये॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ जुष्ट॑तमम् । स॒म्पृचौ॑ स्थः॒ सं मा॑ भ॒द्रेण॑ पृङ्क्तं वि॒पृचौ॑ स्थो॒ वि मा॑ पा॒प्मना॑ पृङ्क्तम् ॥
verses.transliteration: grahā ūrjāhutayo vyanto viprāya matim | teṣāṃ viśipriyāṇāṃ vo'hamiṣamūrjaṃ samagrabhamupayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yonirindrāya tvā juṣṭatamam | sampṛcau sthaḥ saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅktaṃ vipṛcau stho vi mā pāpmanā pṛṅktam ||
verses.translation: Cups of strength-giving sacrifice, inspirers of the sage's hymn Of you, the handleless, have I collected all the sap and strength. Taken, etc., as above. United are ye twain: with bliss unite me. Parted are ye: keep me apart from evil.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रो॑ऽसि वाज॒सास्त्वया॒यं वाज॑ᳪ से॑त् । वाज॑स्य॒ नु प्र॑स॒वे मा॒तरं॑ म॒हीमदि॑तिं॒ नाम॒ वच॑सा करामहे ।
यस्या॑मि॒दं विश्वं॒ भुव॑नमावि॒वेश॒ तस्यां॑ नो दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता धर्म॑ साविषत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasya vajro'si vājasāstvayāyaṃ vājaṃ set | vājasya nu prasave mātaraṃ mahīmaditiṃ nāma vacasā karāmahe |
yasyāmidaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanamāviveśa tasyāṃ no devaḥ savitā dharma sāviṣat ||
verses.translation: Thou art the thunderbolt of Indra, winner of wealth: with thee may this man win him riches. In gain of wealth we celebrate with praises her, Aditi by name, the Mighty Mother, On whom this Universe of life hath settled. Thereon God Savitar promote our dwelling!

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒प्स्वन्तर॒मृत॑म॒प्सु भे॑ष॒जम॒पामु॒त प्रश॑स्ति॒ष्वश्वा॒ भव॑त वा॒जिनः॑ ।
देवी॑रापो॒ यो व॑ ऊ॒र्मिः प्रतू॑र्तिः क॒कुन्मा॑न् वाज॒सास्तेना॒यं वाज॑ᳪ सेत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
apsvantaramṛtamapsu bheṣajamapāmuta praśastiṣvaśvā bhavata vājinaḥ |
devīrāpo yo va ūrmiḥ pratūrtiḥ kakunmān vājasāstenāyaṃ vājaṃ set ||
verses.translation: Amrit is in the Waters, in the Waters healing medicine. Yea, Horses! at our praises of the Waters grow ye fleet and strong. Whatever wave, O ye celestial Waters, wealth-giving, towering high, and swiftly rushing, is yours, therewith may this man win him riches.

verses.sanskrit: वातो॑ वा॒ मनो॑ वा गन्ध॒र्वाः स॒प्तवि॑ᳪशतिः । ते अग्रेऽश्व॑मयुञ्जँ॒स्ते अ॑स्मिञ्ज॒वमा द॑धुः ॥
verses.transliteration: vāto vā mano vā gandharvāḥ saptaviṃśatiḥ | te agre'śvamayuñjam̐ste asmiñjavamā dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: It was the wind, or it was thought, or the Gandharvas twenty-seven These at the first harnessed the horse: they set the power of speed in him.

verses.sanskrit:
वात॑रᳪहा भव वाजिन्यु॒ज्यमा॑न॒ इन्द्र॑स्येव॒ दक्षि॑णः श्रि॒यैधि॑ ।
यु॒ञ्जन्तु॑ त्वा म॒रुतो॑ विश्व॒वेद॑स॒ आ ते॒ त्वष्टा॑ प॒त्सु ज॒वं द॑धातु ॥
verses.transliteration:
vātaraṃhā bhava vājinyujyamāna indrasyeva dakṣiṇaḥ śriyaidhi |
yuñjantu tvā maruto viśvavedasa ā te tvaṣṭā patsu javaṃ dadhātu ||
