verses.translation: Steed, being yoked grow wind-swift: be beauteous as Indra's right-hand steed. Omniscient Maruts harness thee! Tvashtar put swiftness in thy feet!

verses.sanskrit:
ज॒वो यस्ते॑ वाजि॒न्निहि॑तो॒ गुहा॒ यः श्ये॒ने परी॑त्तो॒ अच॑रच्च॒ वाते॑ ।
तेन॑ नो वाजि॒न् वल॑वा॒न् बले॑न वाज॒जिच्च॒ भव॒ सम॑ने च पारयि॒ष्णुः ।
वाजि॑नो वाजजितो॒ वाज॑ᳪ सरि॒ष्यन्तो॒ बृह॒स्पते॑र्भा॒गमव॑जिघ्रत ॥
verses.transliteration:
javo yaste vājinnihito guhā yaḥ śyene parītto acaracca vāte |
tena no vājin valavān balena vājajicca bhava samane ca pārayiṣṇuḥ |
vājino vājajito vājaṃ sariṣyanto bṛhaspaterbhāgamavajighrata ||
verses.translation: What speed, O Horse, was laid in thee in secret, what passed in wind, bestowed upon the falcon, With that same strength be strong for us, O Courser, wealth-winning and victorious in battle. Starting to run your course, winners of riches, smell ye Brihaspati's portion, O ye Horses.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्या॒हᳪ स॑वि॒तुः स॒वे स॒त्यस॑वसो॒ बृह॒स्पते॑रुत्त॒मं नाक॑ᳪ रुहेयम् ।
दे॒वस्या॒हᳪ स॑वि॒तुः स॒वे स॒त्यस॑वस॒ इन्द्र॑स्योत्त॒मं नाक॑ᳪ रुहेयम् ।
दे॒वस्या॒हᳪ स॑वि॒तुः स॒वे स॒त्यप्र॑सवसो॒ बृह॒स्पते॑रुत्त॒मं नाक॑मरुहम् ।
दे॒वस्या॒हᳪ स॑वि॒तुः स॒वे स॒त्यप्र॑सवस॒ इन्द्र॑स्योत्त॒मं नाक॑मरुहम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
devasyāhaṃ savituḥ save satyasavaso bṛhaspateruttamaṃ nākaṃ ruheyam |
devasyāhaṃ savituḥ save satyasavasa indrasyottamaṃ nākaṃ ruheyam |
devasyāhaṃ savituḥ save satyaprasavaso bṛhaspateruttamaṃ nākamaruham |
devasyāhaṃ savituḥ save satyaprasavasa indrasyottamaṃ nākamaruham ||
verses.translation: By impulse of God Savitar, true Impeller, may ascend Brihaspati's highest heaven. By impulse of God Savitar, true Impeller, may I ascend the highest heaven of Indra. By impulse of God Savitar, true Impeller, Brihaspati's highest heaven have I ascended. By impulse of God Savitar, true Impeller, I have ascended Indra's loftiest heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
बृह॑स्पते॒ वाजं॑ जय॒ बृह॒स्पत॑ये॒ वाचं॑ वदत॒ बृह॒स्पतिं॒ वाजं॑ जापयत ।
इन्द्र॒ वाजं॑ ज॒येन्द्रा॑य॒ वाचं॑ वद॒तेन्द्रं॒ वाजं॑ जापयत ॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhaspate vājaṃ jaya bṛhaspataye vācaṃ vadata bṛhaspatiṃ vājaṃ jāpayata |
indra vājaṃ jayendrāya vācaṃ vadatendraṃ vājaṃ jāpayata ||
verses.translation: Brihaspati, win the prize. Lift up your voices to Brihaspati. Make ye Brihaspati win the prize. Do thou, O Indra, win the prize. To Indra lift your voices up. Make Indra winner of the prize.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒षा वः॒ सा स॒त्या सं॒वाग॑भू॒द्यया॒ बृह॒स्पतिं॒ वाज॒मजी॑जप॒ताजी॑जपत॒ बृह॒स्पतिं॒ वाजं॒ वन॑स्पतयो॒ विमु॑च्यध्वम् ।
ए॒षा वः॒ सा स॒त्या सं॒वाग॑भू॒द्ययेन्द्रं॒ वाज॒मजी॑जप॒ताजी॑जप॒तेन्द्रं॒ वाजं॒ वन॑स्पतयो॒ विमु॑च्यध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
eṣā vaḥ sā satyā saṃvāgabhūdyayā bṛhaspatiṃ vājamajījapatājījapata bṛhaspatiṃ vājaṃ vanaspatayo vimucyadhvam |
eṣā vaḥ sā satyā saṃvāgabhūdyayendraṃ vājamajījapatājījapatendraṃ vājaṃ vanaspatayo vimucyadhvam ||
verses.translation: True hath been this your league whereby ye made Brihaspati win the prize. Brihaspati have ye caused to win the prize. Be freed, ye Forest-lords. Faithful was this your league whereby ye have made Indra win the prize. Ye have made Indra win the prize. Be ye set free, ye Forest-lords.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्या॒हᳪ स॑वि॒तुः स॒वे स॒त्यप्र॑सवसो॒ बृह॒स्पते॑र्वाज॒जितो॒ वाजं॑ जेषम् ।
वाजि॑नो वाजजि॒तोऽध्व॑न स्कभ्नु॒वन्तो॒ योज॑ना॒ मिमा॑नाः॒ काष्ठां॑ गच्छत ॥
verses.transliteration:
devasyāhaṃ savituḥ save satyaprasavaso bṛhaspatervājajito vājaṃ jeṣam |
vājino vājajito'dhvana skabhnuvanto yojanā mimānāḥ kāṣṭhāṃ gacchata ||
verses.translation: Through impulse of God Savitar, true Impeller, mine be Brihaspati's prize who winneth prizes. On to the goal, ye Steeds, winners of prizes, blocking the ways and meting out the courses!

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒ष स्य वा॒जी क्षि॑प॒णिं तु॑रण्यति ग्री॒वायां॑ ब॒द्धो अ॑पिक॒क्ष आ॒सनि॑ ।
क्रतुं॑ दधि॒क्रा अनु॑ स॒ᳪसनि॑ष्यदत्प॒थामङ्का॒ᳪस्यन्वा॒पनी॑पण॒त् स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
eṣa sya vājī kṣipaṇiṃ turaṇyati grīvāyāṃ baddho apikakṣa āsani |
kratuṃ dadhikrā anu saṃsaniṣyadatpathāmaṅkāṃsyanvāpanīpaṇat svāhā ||
verses.translation: Bound by the neck and at the flanks and in the mouth, that vigorous Courser lends new swiftness to his sped. Drawing himself together as his strength allows, Dadhikrâs speeds along the windings of the paths. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒त स्मा॑स्य॒ द्रुव॑तस्तुरण्य॒तः प॒र्णं न वेरनु॑वाति प्रग॒र्धिनः॑ ।
श्ये॒नस्ये॑व॒ ध्रज॑तो अङ्क॒सं परि॑ दधि॒क्राव्णः॑ स॒होर्जा तरि॑त्रतः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
uta smāsya druvatasturaṇyataḥ parṇaṃ na veranuvāti pragardhinaḥ |
śyenasyeva dhrajato aṅkasaṃ pari dadhikrāvṇaḥ sahorjā taritrataḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: His pinion, rapid runner, fans him on his way, as of a bird that hastens onward to its aim, And, as it were a falcon's gliding through the air, strikes Dadhikrâvan's side as he speeds on with might. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॑ भवन्तु वा॒जिनो॒ हवे॑षु दे॒वता॑ता मि॒तद्र॑वः स्व॒र्काः ।
ज॒म्भय॒न्तोऽहिं॒ वृक॒ᳪ रक्षा॑सि॒ सने॑म्य॒स्मद्यु॑यव॒न्नमी॑वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no bhavantu vājino haveṣu devatātā mitadravaḥ svarkāḥ |
jambhayanto'hiṃ vṛkaṃ rakṣāsi sanemyasmadyuyavannamīvāḥ ||
verses.translation: Bless us the Coursers when we call, while slowly they move, strong singers, to the Gods assembly. Crushing the wolf, the serpent, and the demons, may they completely banish all affliction. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
ते नो॒ अर्व॑न्तो हवन॒श्रुतो॒ हवं॒ विश्वे॑ शृण्वन्तु वा॒जिनो॑ मि॒तद्र॑वः ।
स॒ह॒स्र॒सा मे॒धसा॑ता सनि॒ष्यवो॑ म॒हो ये धन॑ᳪ समि॒थेषु॑ जभ्रि॒रे ॥
verses.transliteration:
te no arvanto havanaśruto havaṃ viśve śṛṇvantu vājino mitadravaḥ |
sahasrasā medhasātā saniṣyavo maho ye dhanaṃ samitheṣu jabhrire ||
verses.translation: May all those vigorous Coursers listen to our cry, hearers of invocation, speeders on their way; Winners of thousands, fain to win where meed is won, who gather of themselves great wealth in every race.

verses.sanskrit:
वाजे॑-वाजेऽवत वाजिनो नो॒ धने॑षु विप्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
अ॒स्य मध्वः॑ पिबत मा॒दय॑ध्वं तृ॒प्ता या॑त प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानैः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vāje-vāje'vata vājino no dhaneṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ |
asya madhvaḥ pibata mādayadhvaṃ tṛptā yāta pathibhirdevayānaiḥ ||
verses.translation: Deep-skilled in Law Eternal, wise, immortal, O Coursers, help us in each fray for booty. Drink of this meath, be satisfied, be joyful: then go on paths which Gods are wont to travel.

verses.sanskrit:
आ मा॒ वाज॑स्य प्रस॒वो ज॑गम्या॒देमे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वि॒श्वरू॑पे ।
आ मा॑ गन्तां पि॒तरा॑ मा॒तरा॒ चा मा॒ सोमो॑ अमृत॒त्वेन॑ गम्यात् ।
वाजि॑नो वाजजितो॒ वाज॑ᳪ ससृ॒वाᳪसो॒ बृह॒स्पते॑र्भा॒गमव॑जिघ्रत निमृजा॒नाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā mā vājasya prasavo jagamyādeme dyāvāpṛthivī viśvarūpe |
ā mā gantāṃ pitarā mātarā cā mā somo amṛtatvena gamyāt |
vājino vājajito vājaṃ sasṛvāṃso bṛhaspaterbhāgamavajighrata nimṛjānāḥ ||
verses.translation: To me come plenteous growth of wealth! Approach me these, Heaven and Earth, who wear each form and figure! Hither may Father come to me, and Mother. Soma with immortality approach me!

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒पये॒ स्वाहा॑ स्वा॒पये॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽपि॒जाय॒ स्वाहा॑ क्रत॑वे॒ स्वाहा॒ वस॑वे॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽह॒र्पत॑ये॒ स्वाहा॑
ऽह्ने॑ मु॒ग्धाय॒ स्वाहा॑ मु॒ग्धाय॑ वैनᳪशि॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॑ विन॒ᳪशिन॑ आन्त्याय॒नाय॒ स्वाहा ऽन्त्या॑य भौव॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ पत॑ये॒ स्वाहाऽधि॑पतये॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
āpaye svāhā svāpaye svāhā 'pijāya svāhā kratave svāhā vasave svāhā 'harpataye svāhā
'hne mugdhāya svāhā mugdhāya vainaṃśināya svāhā vinaṃśina āntyāyanāya svāhā 'ntyāya bhauvanāya svāhā bhuvanasya pataye svāhā'dhipataye svāhā ||
verses.translation: To the Friend, Hail! To the Good Fiend, Hail! To the Later-born, Hail! To Resolution, Hail! To the Vasu, Hail! To the Lord of Days, Hail! To the Failing Day, Hail! To the Failing sprung from the Transitory, Hail! To the Transitory sprung from the Final, Hal! To the Final Mundane, Hail! To the Lord of the World, Hail! To the Sovran Lord, Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
आयु॑र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां प्रा॒णो य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां॒ चक्षु॑र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतातां॒ᳪ श्रोत्रं॑ य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां॒ पृ॒ष्ठं य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां॒ य॒ज्ञो य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पताम् ।
प्र॒जाप॑तेः प्र॒जा अ॑भूम॒ स्व॒र्देवा अगन्मा॒मृता॑ अभूम ॥
verses.transliteration:
āyuryajñena kalpatāṃ prāṇo yajñena kalpatāṃ cakṣuryajñena kalpatātāṃṃ śrotraṃ yajñena kalpatāṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ yajñena kalpatāṃ yajño yajñena kalpatām |
prajāpateḥ prajā abhūma svardevā aganmāmṛtā abhūma ||
verses.translation: May life succeed through sacrifice. May life-breath thrive by sacrifice. May the eye thrive by sacrifice. May the ear thrive by sacrifice. May the back thrive by sacrifice. May sacrifice thrive by sacrifice. We have become the children of Prajâpati. Gods, we have gone to heaven. We have become immortal.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒स्मे वो॑ अस्त्विन्द्रि॒यम॒स्मे नृ॒म्णमु॒त क्रतु॑र॒स्मे वर्चा॑ᳪसि सन्तु वः । नमो॑ मा॒त्रे पृ॑थि॒व्यै॒ नमो॑ मा॒त्रे पृ॑थि॒व्या इ॒यं ते॒ राड् य॒न्ताऽसि॒ यम॑नो ध्रु॒वो॒ऽसि ध॒रुणः॑ । कृ॒ष्यै त्वा॒ क्षेमा॑य त्वा र॒य्यै त्वा॒ पोषा॑य त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: asme vo astvindriyamasme nṛmṇamuta kraturasme varcāṃsi santu vaḥ | namo mātre pṛthivyai namo mātre pṛthivyā iyaṃ te rāḍ yantā'si yamano dhruvo'si dharuṇaḥ | kṛṣyai tvā kṣemāya tvā rayyai tvā poṣāya tvā ||
verses.translation: In us be your great might and manly vigour, in us be your intelligence and splendour. Obeisance to our Mother Earth! Obeisance to our Mother Earth! This is thy Sovranty. Thou art the ruler, thou art controller, thou art firm and stedfast. Thee for land-culture, thee for peace and quiet, thee for wealth, thee for increase of our substance.

verses.sanskrit: वाज॑स्ये॒मं प्र॑स॒वः सु॑षु॒वेऽग्रे॒ सोम॒ᳪ राजा॑न॒मोष॑धीष्व॒प्सु । ता अ॒स्मभ्यं॒ मधु॑मतीर्भवन्तु व॒यᳪ रा॒ष्ट्रे जा॑गृयाम पु॒रोहि॑ताः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vājasyemaṃ prasavaḥ suṣuve'gre somaṃ rājānamoṣadhīṣvapsu | tā asmabhyaṃ madhumatīrbhavantu vayaṃ rāṣṭre jāgṛyāma purohitāḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Of old the furtherance of strength urged onward this Sovran Soma in the plants and waters. For us may they be stored with honey: stationed in front may we be watchful in the kingdom. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
वाज॑स्ये॒मां प्र॑स॒वः शि॑श्रिये॒ दिव॑मि॒मा च॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि स॒म्राट् ।
अदि॑त्सन्तं दापयति प्रजा॒नन्त्स नो॑ र॒यिᳪ सर्व॑वीरं॒ नि य॑च्छतु॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vājasyemāṃ prasavaḥ śiśriye divamimā ca viśvā bhuvanāni samrāṭ |
aditsantaṃ dāpayati prajānantsa no rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ ni yacchatu svāhā ||
verses.translation: The furtherance of strength extended over this heaven and all the worlds as sovran ruler. He, knowing, makes the churl a bounteous giver: wealth may he grant us with full store of heroes. All-hail

verses.sanskrit:
वाज॑स्य॒ नु प्र॑स॒व आ ब॑भूवे॒मा च॒ विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि स॒र्वतः॑ ।
सने॑मि॒ राजा॒ परि॑ याति वि॒द्वान् प्र॒जां पुष्टिं॑ व॒र्धय॑मानो अ॒स्मे स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vājasya nu prasava ā babhūvemā ca viśvā bhuvanāni sarvataḥ |
sanemi rājā pari yāti vidvān prajāṃ puṣṭiṃ vardhayamāno asme svāhā ||
verses.translation: Surely the furtherance of strength pervaded all these existing worlds in all directions. From olden time the King moves round, well knowing, strengthening all the people and our welfare.

verses.sanskrit: सोम॒ᳪ राजा॑न॒मव॑से॒ऽग्निम॒न्वा॑रभामहे । आ॒दि॒त्यान्विष्णु॒ᳪ सूर्यं॑ ब्र॒ह्माणं॑ च॒ बृह॒स्पति॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: somaṃ rājānamavase'gnimanvārabhāmahe | ādityānviṣṇuṃ sūryaṃ brahmāṇaṃ ca bṛhaspatiṃ svāhā ||
verses.translation: As suppliants, for aid we grasp Soma the King, and Agni, the Âdityas, Vishnu, Sûrya, and the Brahman-priest Brihaspati.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒र्य॒मणं॒ बृह॒स्पति॒मिन्द्रं॒ दाना॑य चोदय । वाचं॒ विष्णु॒ᳪ सर॑स्वतीᳪ सवि॒तारं॑ च वा॒जिन॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: aryamaṇaṃ bṛhaspatimindraṃ dānāya codaya | vācaṃ viṣṇuṃ sarasvatīṃ savitāraṃ ca vājinaṃ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Urge Aryaman to send us gifts, and Indra. and Brihaspati, Yak, Vishnu, and Sarasvatî, and the strong Courser Savitar.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ अच्छा॑ वदे॒ह नः॒ प्रति॑ नः सु॒मना॑ भव । प्र नो॑ यच्छ सहस्रजि॒त्त्वᳪ हि ध॑न॒दा असि॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: agne acchā vadeha naḥ prati naḥ sumanā bhava | pra no yaccha sahasrajittvaṃ hi dhanadā asi svāhā ||
verses.translation: Agni, speak kindly to us here, be graciously inclined to us. Winner of thousands, grant us boons, for thou art he who giveth wealth.

verses.sanskrit: प्र नो॑ यच्छत्वर्य॒मा प्र पू॒षा प्र बृह॒स्पतिः॑ । प्र वाग्दे॒वी द॑दातु नः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: pra no yacchatvaryamā pra pūṣā pra bṛhaspatiḥ | pra vāgdevī dadātu naḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Let Aryaman vouchsafe us wealth, and Pûshan, and Brihaspati. May Vâk the Goddess give to us. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् ।
सर॑स्वत्यै वा॒चो य॒न्तुर्य॒न्त्रिये॑ दधामि॒ बृह॒स्पते॑ष्ट्वा॒ साम्रा॑ज्येना॒भि षि॑ञ्चाम्यसौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām |
sarasvatyai vāco yanturyantriye dadhāmi bṛhaspateṣṭvā sāmrājyenābhi ṣiñcāmyasau ||
verses.translation: Thee by the radiant Savitar's impulsion, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan. To Vâk Sarasvatî's controlling guidance, hers the controlling leader, I consign thee. I with Brihaspati's supreme dominion endow thee by the balm of consecration

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निरेका॑क्षरेण प्रा॒णमुद॑जय॒त्तमुज्जे॑षम॒श्विनौ॒ द्व्य॒क्षरेण द्वि॒पदो॑ मनु॒ष्यानुद॑जयतां॒ तानुज्जे॑षं॒ विष्णु॒स्त्र्य॒क्षरेण॒ त्रीँल्लो॒कानुद॑जय॒त्तानुज्जे॑षं॒ᳪ
सोम॒श्चतु॑रक्षरेण॒ चतु॑ष्पदः प॒शूनुद॑जय॒त्तानुज्जे॑षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnirekākṣareṇa prāṇamudajayattamujjeṣamaśvinau dvyakṣareṇa dvipado manuṣyānudajayatāṃ tānujjeṣaṃ viṣṇustryakṣareṇa trīm̐llokānudajayattānujjeṣaṃṃ
somaścaturakṣareṇa catuṣpadaḥ paśūnudajayattānujjeṣam ||
verses.translation: With the monosyllable Agni won vital breath: may I win that. With the dissyllable the Asvins won bipeds: may I win those. With the trisyllable Vishnu won the three worlds: may I win those. With quadrisyllabic metre Soma won four-footed cattle: may I win those.

verses.sanskrit: पू॒षा पञ्चा॑क्षरेण॒ पञ्च॒ दिश॒ उद॑जय॒त्ता उज्जे॑षंᳪ सवि॒ता षड॑क्षरेण॒ षडृ॒तूनुद॑जय॒त्तानुज्जे॑षं म॒रुतः॑ स॒प्ताक्ष॑रेण स॒प्त ग्रा॒म्यान् प॒शूनुद॑जयँ॒स्तानुज्जे॑षं॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र॒ष्टाक्ष॑रेण गाय॒त्रीमुद॑जय॒त्तामुज्जे॑षम् ॥
verses.transliteration: pūṣā pañcākṣareṇa pañca diśa udajayattā ujjeṣaṃṃ savitā ṣaḍakṣareṇa ṣaḍṛtūnudajayattānujjeṣaṃ marutaḥ saptākṣareṇa sapta grāmyān paśūnudajayam̐stānujjeṣaṃ bṛhaspatiraṣṭākṣareṇa gāyatrīmudajayattāmujjeṣam ||
verses.translation: With five-syllable metre Pûshan won the five regions: may I win them. With six-syllable metre Savitar won the six seasons: may I win them. With seven-syllable metre the Maruts won the seven domestic animals: May I win them. With octosyllabic metre Brihaspati won the Gâyatrî: may I win that.

verses.sanskrit:
मि॒त्रो नवा॑क्षरेण त्रि॒वृत॒ᳪ स्तोम॒मुद॑जय॒त्तमुज्जे॑षं॒ वरु॑णो॒ दशा॑क्षरेण वि॒राज॒मुद॑जय॒त्तामुज्जे॑ष॒मिन्द्र॒ ए॒काद॑शाक्षरेण त्रि॒ष्टुभ॒मुद॑जय॒त्तामुज्जे॑षं॒
विश्वे॑ दे॒वा द्वाद॑शाक्षरेण॒ जग॑ती॒मुद॑जयँ॒स्तामुज्जे॑षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
mitro navākṣareṇa trivṛtaṃ stomamudajayattamujjeṣaṃ varuṇo daśākṣareṇa virājamudajayattāmujjeṣamindra ekādaśākṣareṇa triṣṭubhamudajayattāmujjeṣaṃ
viśve devā dvādaśākṣareṇa jagatīmudajayam̐stāmujjeṣam ||
verses.translation: With nine-syllable metre Mitra won the Trivrit Stoma: may I win that. With decasyllabic metre Varuna won Virâj: may I win that. With hendecasyllabic metre Indra won Trishtup: may I win that. With dodecasyllabic metre the All-Gods won Jagatî: may I win that.

verses.sanskrit: वस॑व॒स्त्रयो॑दशाक्षरेण त्रयोद॒शᳪ स्तोम॒मुद॑जयँ॒स्तमुज्जे॑षंᳪ रु॒द्राश्चतु॑र्दशाक्षरेण चतुर्द॒शᳪ स्तोम॒मुद॑जयँ॒स्तमुज्जे॑षमादि॒त्याः पञ्च॑दशाक्षरेण पञ्चद॒शᳪ स्तोम॒मुद॑जयँ॒स्तमुज्जे॑ष॒मदि॑तिः॒ षोड॑शाक्षरेण षोड॒शᳪ स्तोम॒मुद॑जय॒त्तमुज्जे॑षं प्र॒जाप॑तिः स॒प्तद॑शाक्षरेण सप्तद॒शᳪ स्तोम॒मुद॑जय॒त्तमुज्जे॑षम् ॥
verses.transliteration: vasavastrayodaśākṣareṇa trayodaśaṃ stomamudajayam̐stamujjeṣaṃṃ rudrāścaturdaśākṣareṇa caturdaśaṃ stomamudajayam̐stamujjeṣamādityāḥ pañcadaśākṣareṇa pañcadaśaṃ stomamudajayam̐stamujjeṣamaditiḥ ṣoḍaśākṣareṇa ṣoḍaśaṃ stomamudajayattamujjeṣaṃ prajāpatiḥ saptadaśākṣareṇa saptadaśaṃ stomamudajayattamujjeṣam ||
verses.translation: The Vasus by thirteen-syllable metre won the Thirteenfold Stoma: may I win that. The Rudras by fourteen-syllable metre won the fourteenfold Stoma: may I win that. The Âdityas with fifteen-syllable metre won the Fifteenfold Stoma: may I win that. Aditi with sixteen-syllable metre won the Sixteenfold Stoma: may I win that. Prajâpati with seventeenfold metre won the Seventeenfold Stoma: may I win that.

verses.sanskrit: ए॒ष ते॑ निरृते भा॒गस्तं जु॑षस्व॒ स्वाहा॒ऽग्निने॑त्रेभ्यो दे॒वेभ्यः॑ पुरः॒ सद्भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ य॒मने॑त्रेभ्यो दे॒वेभ्यो॑ दक्षि॒णासद्भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ वि॒श्वदे॑वनेत्रेभ्यो दे॒वेभ्यः॑ पश्चा॒त्सद्भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णनेत्रेभ्यो वा म॒रुन्ने॑त्रेभ्यो वा दे॒वेभ्य॑ उत्तरा॒सद्भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ सोम॑नेत्रेभ्यो दे॒वेभ्य॑ उपरि॒सद्भ्यो॒ दुव॑स्वद्भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣa te nirṛte bhāgastaṃ juṣasva svāhā'gninetrebhyo devebhyaḥ puraḥ sadbhyaḥ svāhā yamanetrebhyo devebhyo dakṣiṇāsadbhyaḥ svāhā viśvadevanetrebhyo devebhyaḥ paścātsadbhyaḥ svāhā mitrāvaruṇanetrebhyo vā marunnetrebhyo vā devebhya uttarāsadbhyaḥ svāhā somanetrebhyo devebhya uparisadbhyo duvasvadbhyaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: This is thy portion, Nirriti! Accept it graciously. All-hail! To Gods whose guide is Agni, to the eastward-seated Gods, All-hail! To Gods whose guide is Yama, to the southward-seated Gods, All-hail! To Gods whose guides are the All-Gods, those who are seated westward, Hail! Hail to the northward-seated Gods, to those whose guides are Mitra and Varuna or the Marut host! To Gods whose guide is Soma, who, worshipful, sit on high, All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: ये दे॒वा अ॒ग्निने॑त्राः पुरः॒ सद॒स्तेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ ये दे॒वा य॒मने॑त्रा दक्षि॒णासद॒स्तेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ ये दे॒वा वि॒श्वदे॑वनेत्राः पश्चा॒त्सद॒स्तेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ ये दे॒वा मि॒त्रावरु॑णनेत्रा वा म॒रुन्ने॑त्रा वोत्तरा॒सद॒स्तेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ ये दे॒वाः सोम॑नेत्रा उपरि॒सदो॒ दुव॑स्वन्त॒स्तेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ye devā agninetrāḥ puraḥ sadastebhyaḥ svāhā ye devā yamanetrā dakṣiṇāsadastebhyaḥ svāhā ye devā viśvadevanetrāḥ paścātsadastebhyaḥ svāhā ye devā mitrāvaruṇanetrā vā marunnetrā vottarāsadastebhyaḥ svāhā ye devāḥ somanetrā uparisado duvasvantastebhyaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Gods who have Agni as their guide, whose seat is eastward, Hail to them! Gods who have Yama as their guide, whose seat is southward, Hail to them! Gods who have All-Gods as their guides, whose seat is westward, Hail to them! Gods who have Mitra-Varuna for guides, north-seated, Hail to them! Gods who have Soma as their guide, high-seated, worshipful, Hail to them!

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ सह॑स्व॒ पृत॑ना अ॒भिमा॑ती॒रपा॑स्य । दु॒ष्टर॒स्तर॒न्नरा॑ती॒र्वर्चो॑ धा य॒ज्ञवा॑हसि ॥
verses.transliteration: agne sahasva pṛtanā abhimātīrapāsya | duṣṭarastarannarātīrvarco dhā yajñavāhasi ||
verses.translation: Agni, subdue opposing bands and drive our enemies away. Invincible, slay godless foes: give splendour to the worshipper.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् । उ॒पा॒ᳪशोर्वी॒र्ये॒ण जुहोमि ह॒तᳪ रक्षः॒ स्वाहा॒
रक्ष॑सां त्वा ब॒धायाब॑धिष्म॒ रक्षोऽब॑धिष्मा॒मुम॒सौ ह॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | upāṃśorvīryeṇa juhomi hataṃ rakṣaḥ svāhā
rakṣasāṃ tvā badhāyābadhiṣma rakṣo'badhiṣmāmumasau hataḥ ||
verses.translation: Thee at the radiant Savitar's impulsion, with Asvins arms and with the hands of Pûshan, I offer with the strength of the Upâmsu. Slain is the demon brood. All-hail! Thee for the slaughter of the brood of demons. The demons have we slain, have slain. So-and-So, So-and-So is slain.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒वि॒ता त्वा॑ स॒वाना॑ᳪ सुव॒ताम॒ग्निर्गृ॒हप॑तीना॒ᳪ सोमो॒ वन॒स्पती॑नाम् ।
बृह॒स्पति॑र्वा॒च इन्द्रो॒ ज्यैष्ठ्या॑य रु॒द्रः प॒शुभ्यो॑ मि॒त्रः स॒त्यो वरु॑णो॒ धर्म॑पतीनाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
savitā tvā savānāṃ suvatāmagnirgṛhapatīnāṃ somo vanaspatīnām |
bṛhaspatirvāca indro jyaiṣṭhyāya rudraḥ paśubhyo mitraḥ satyo varuṇo dharmapatīnām ||
verses.translation: Savitar quicken thee for sway of rulers, Agni of householders, of the trees Soma, Brihaspati of Speech, for lordship Indra, Rudra for cattle, Mitra for true-speaking, Varuna for the sway of Law's protectors.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं दे॑वा असप॒त्नᳪ सु॑वध्वं मह॒ते क्ष॒त्राय॑ मह॒ते ज्यैष्ठ्या॑य मह॒ते जान॑राज्या॒येन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒याय॑ ।
इ॒मम॒मुष्य॑ पु॒त्रम॒मुष्यै॑ पु॒त्रम॒स्यै वि॒श ए॒ष वो॑ऽमी॒ राजा॒ सोमो॒ऽस्माकं॑ ब्राह्म॒णाना॒ᳪ राजा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ devā asapatnaṃ suvadhvaṃ mahate kṣatrāya mahate jyaiṣṭhyāya mahate jānarājyāyendrasyendriyāya |
imamamuṣya putramamuṣyai putramasyai viśa eṣa vo'mī rājā somo'smākaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃ rājā ||
verses.translation: Gods, quicken him that none may be his rival, for mighty domination, mighty lordship, Him, son of Such-a-man and Such-a-woman, of Such-a-tribe. This is your King, ye Tribesmen. Soma is Lord and King of us the Brâhmans.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पो दे॒वा मधु॑मतीरगृभ्ण॒न्नूर्ज॑स्वती राज॒स्वश्चिता॑नाः ।
याभि॑र्मि॒त्रावरु॑णाव॒भ्यषि॑ञ्च॒न्याभि॒रिन्द्र॒मन॑य॒न्नत्यरा॑तीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
apo devā madhumatīragṛbhṇannūrjasvatī rājasvaścitānāḥ |
yābhirmitrāvaruṇāvabhyaṣiñcanyābhirindramanayannatyarātīḥ ||
verses.translation: The Gods drew waters with their store of sweetness, succulent and observant, king-creating, Wherewith they sprinkled Varuna and Mitra, wherewith they guided Indra past his foemen.

verses.sanskrit:
वृष्ण॑ ऊ॒र्मिर॑सि राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ देहि॒ स्वाहा॒ वृष्ण॑ ऊ॒र्मिर॑सि राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ देहि
वृ॑षसे॒नो॒ऽसि राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ देहि॒ स्वाहा॑ वृषसे॒नो॒ऽसि राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ देहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
vṛṣṇa ūrmirasi rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me dehi svāhā vṛṣṇa ūrmirasi rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dehi
vṛṣaseno'si rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me dehi svāhā vṛṣaseno'si rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dehi ||
verses.translation: Wave of the male art thou, giver of kingship. Do thou— All-hail!—bestow on me the kingdom. Wave of the male art thou, giver of kingship. Do thou on So-and-So bestow the kingdom. Thou hast a host of males, giver of kingship. Do thou— All-hail!—bestow on me the kingdom. A host of males hast thou, giver of kingship. Do thou on So-and-So bestow the kingdom.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒र्थेत॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ ऽर्थेत॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ द॒त्तौज॑स्वती स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहौज॑स्वती स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ द॒त्तापः॑ परिवा॒हिणी॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽपः॑ परिवा॒हिणी॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्ता॒पां पति॑रसि राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ देहि॒ स्वाहा॒ ऽपां पति॑रसि राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ देह्य॒पां गर्भो॑ऽसि राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ देहि॒ स्वाहा॒ ऽपां गर्भो॑ सि राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ देहि॒ ॥
verses.transliteration: artheta stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā 'rtheta stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dattaujasvatī stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhaujasvatī stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dattāpaḥ parivāhiṇī stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā 'paḥ parivāhiṇī stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dattāpāṃ patirasi rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me dehi svāhā 'pāṃ patirasi rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dehyapāṃ garbho'si rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me dehi svāhā 'pāṃ garbho si rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dehi ||
verses.translation: Swift at your work are ye, givers of kingship. Do ye— All-hail!—bestow on me the kingdom. Swift at your work are ye, givers of kingship. Do ye on So-and-So bestow the kingdom. Endowed with strength are ye, givers of kingship, etc. Oerflowing floods are ye, etc. The Waters Lord art thou, giver of kingship. Do thou, etc. The Waters Child art thou, etc.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्य॑त्वचस स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ सूर्य॑त्वचस स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त सूर्य॑वर्चस स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ सूर्य॑वर्चस स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त॒ मान्दा॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ मान्दा॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त व्रज॒क्षित॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॑ व्रज॒क्षित॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त॒ वाशा॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ वाशा॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त॒ शवि॑ष्ठा स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ शवि॑ष्ठा स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त॒ शक्व॑री स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॒ शक्व॑री स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त जन॒भृत॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॑ जन॒भृत॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त विश्व॒भृत॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रं मे॑ दत्त॒ स्वाहा॑ विश्व॒भृत॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ द॒त्तापः॑ स्व॒राज॑ स्थ राष्ट्र॒दा रा॒ष्ट्रम॒मुष्मै॑ दत्त । मधु॑मती॒र्मधु॑मतीभिः पृच्यन्तां॒ महि॑ क्ष॒त्रं क्ष॒त्रिया॑य वन्वा॒नांना॑धृष्टाः सीदत स॒हौज॑सो॒ महि॑ क्ष॒त्रं क्ष॒त्रिया॑य॒ दध॑तीः ॥
verses.transliteration: sūryatvacasa stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā sūryatvacasa stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta sūryavarcasa stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā sūryavarcasa stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta māndā stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā māndā stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta vrajakṣita stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā vrajakṣita stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta vāśā stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā vāśā stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta śaviṣṭhā stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā śaviṣṭhā stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta śakvarī stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā śakvarī stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta janabhṛta stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā janabhṛta stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta viśvabhṛta stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭraṃ me datta svāhā viśvabhṛta stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai dattāpaḥ svarāja stha rāṣṭradā rāṣṭramamuṣmai datta | madhumatīrmadhumatībhiḥ pṛcyantāṃ mahi kṣatraṃ kṣatriyāya vanvānāṃnādhṛṣṭāḥ sīdata sahaujaso mahi kṣatraṃ kṣatriyāya dadhatīḥ ||
verses.translation: With sun-bright skins are ye, givers, etc. Brilliant as Suns are ye, etc. Bringers of joy are ye, etc. Dwellers in cloud are ye, etc Desirable are ye, etc. Most powerful are ye, etc. Endowed with might are ye, etc. Man-nourishing are ye, etc. All-nourishing are ye, etc. Self-ruling Waters are ye, giving kingship. On So-and-So do ye bestow the kingdom. Together with the sweet let sweet ones mingle, obtaining for the Kshatriya mighty power. Rest in your place inviolate and potent, bestowing on the Kshatriya mighty power.

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑स्य॒ त्विषि॑रसि॒ तवे॑व मे॒ त्विषि॑र्भूयात् । अ॒ग्नये॒ स्वाहा॒ सोमा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ सवि॒त्रे स्वाहा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ स्वाहा॑
पू॒ष्णे स्वाहा॒ बृह॒स्पत॑ये॒ स्वाहेन्द्रा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒ घोषा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒ श्लोका॑य॒ स्वाहा
ऽᳪशा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒ भगा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽर्य॒म्णे स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
somasya tviṣirasi taveva me tviṣirbhūyāt | agnaye svāhā somāya svāhā savitre svāhā sarasvatyai svāhā
pūṣṇe svāhā bṛhaspataye svāhendrāya svāhā ghoṣāya svāhā ślokāya svāhā
'ṃśāya svāhā bhagāya svāhā 'ryamṇe svāhā ||
verses.translation: Brilliance of Soma art thou: may my brilliance grow like thine. To Agni Hail! To Soma Hail! To Savitar Hail! To Sarasvatî Hail! To Pûshan Hail! To Brihaspati Hail! To Indra Hail! To the Noise Hail! To Fame Hail To Amsa Hail! To Bhaga Hail! To Aryaman Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
प॒वित्रे॑ स्थो वैष्ण॒व्यौ॒ सवि॒तुर्वः॑ प्रस॒व उत्पु॑ना॒म्यच्छि॑द्रेण प॒वित्रे॑ण॒ सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभिः॑ ।
अनि॑भृष्टमसि वा॒चो बन्धु॑स्तपो॒जाः सोम॑स्य दा॒त्रम॑सि॒ स्वाहा॑ राज॒स्वः॒ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pavitre stho vaiṣṇavyau saviturvaḥ prasava utpunāmyacchidreṇa pavitreṇa sūryasya raśmibhiḥ |
anibhṛṣṭamasi vāco bandhustapojāḥ somasya dātramasi svāhā rājasvaḥ ||
verses.translation: Ye are two strainers, Varuna's own possession. I make you pure at Savitar's impulsion, with flawless strainer, with the beams of Sûrya. Thou, friend of speech, heat-born, art undefeated. Soma's share art thou. Hail, ye king producers!

verses.sanskrit:
स॒ध॒मादो॑ द्यु॒म्निनी॒राप॑ ए॒ता अना॑धृष्टा अप॒स्यो वसा॑नाः ।
प॒स्त्या॒सु चक्रे॒ वरु॑णः स॒धस्थ॑म॒पाᳪ शिशु॑र्मा॒तृत॑मास्व॒न्तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sadhamādo dyumninīrāpa etā anādhṛṣṭā apasyo vasānāḥ |
pastyāsu cakre varuṇaḥ sadhasthamapāṃ śiśurmātṛtamāsvantaḥ ||
verses.translation: Sharers in joy are these majestic Waters, inviolate, industrious, investing. In these as homes hath Varuna made his dwelling, he, Child of Waters, in the best of mothers.

verses.sanskrit:
क्ष॒त्रस्योल्ब॑मसि क्ष॒त्रस्य॑ ज॒राय्व॑सि क्ष॒त्रस्य॒ योनि॑रसि क्ष॒त्रस्य॒ नाभि॑र॒सीन्द्र॑स्य॒ वार्त्र॑घ्नमसि मि॒त्रस्या॑सि॒ वरु॑णस्यासि॒
त्वया॒ऽयं वृ॒त्रं ब॑धेत् । दृ॒बाऽसि॑ रु॒जाऽसि॑ क्षु॒माऽसि॑ । पा॒तैनं॒ प्राञ्चं॑ पा॒तैनं प्र॒त्यञ्चं॑ पा॒तैनं॑ ति॒र्यञ्चं॑ दि॒ग्भ्यः पा॑त ॥
verses.transliteration:
kṣatrasyolbamasi kṣatrasya jarāyvasi kṣatrasya yonirasi kṣatrasya nābhirasīndrasya vārtraghnamasi mitrasyāsi varuṇasyāsi
tvayā'yaṃ vṛtraṃ badhet | dṛbā'si rujā'si kṣumā'si | pātainaṃ prāñcaṃ pātainaṃ pratyañcaṃ pātainaṃ tiryañcaṃ digbhyaḥ pāta ||
verses.translation: Thou art the inner caul of princely power, Thou art the outer caul of princely power. Of princely power thou art the womb, the navel. Thou art the Vritra-slaying arm of Indra. Mitra's art thou, thou Varuna's possession. With thee to aid may this man slaughter Vritra. Cleaver art thou; thou Render; thou art Shaker. Protect him ye in front, protect him rearwards; protect him sidewards; from all quarters guard him.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒विर्म॑या॒ आवि॑त्तो अ॒ग्निर्गृ॒हप॑तिरावि॑त्त॒ इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒द्धश्र॑वा॒ आवि॑त्तौ मि॒त्रावरु॑णौ धृ॒तव्र॑ता॒वावि॑त्तः पू॒षा वि॒श्ववे॑दा॒
आवि॑त्ते॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वि॒श्वश॑म्भुवा॒वावि॒त्तादि॑तिरु॒रुश॑र्मा ॥
verses.transliteration:
āvirmayā āvitto agnirgṛhapatirāvitta indro vṛddhaśravā āvittau mitrāvaruṇau dhṛtavratāvāvittaḥ pūṣā viśvavedā
āvitte dyāvāpṛthivī viśvaśambhuvāvāvittāditiruruśarmā ||
verses.translation: Visible, O ye men, Informed is Agni, Master of the House. hold. Informed is Indra of exalted glory. Informed are Mitra-Varuna, Law-Maintainers. Informed is Pûshan, Lord of all Possessions. Informed are Heaven and Earth, the All-propitious. Informed is Aditi who gives wide shelter.

verses.sanskrit: अवे॑ष्टा दन्द॒शूकाः॑ प्राची॒मा रो॑ह गाय॒त्री त्वा॑ऽवतु रथन्त॒रᳪ साम॑ त्रि॒वृत्स्तोमो॑ वस॒न्त ऋ॒तुर्ब्रह्म॒ द्रवि॑णम् ॥
verses.transliteration: aveṣṭā dandaśūkāḥ prācīmā roha gāyatrī tvā'vatu rathantaraṃ sāma trivṛtstomo vasanta ṛturbrahma draviṇam ||
verses.translation: Appeased by sacrifice are biting creatures, Ascend the East. May Gâyatrî protect thee, the psalm Rathantara, the triple praise-song, the season Spring, and the rich treasure, Priesthood.

verses.sanskrit: दक्षि॑णा॒मा रो॑ह त्रि॒ष्टुप् त्वा॑ऽवतु बृ॒हत्साम॑ पञ्चद॒श स्तोमो॑ ग्री॒ष्म ऋ॒तुः क्ष॒त्रं द्रवि॑णम् ॥
verses.transliteration: dakṣiṇāmā roha triṣṭup tvā'vatu bṛhatsāma pañcadaśa stomo grīṣma ṛtuḥ kṣatraṃ draviṇam ||
verses.translation: Ascend the South. Be thy protectors Trishtup, the Brihat Sâman, the fifteenfold praise-song, the Reason Summer, and the treasure Kingship.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒तीची॒मा रो॑ह॒ जग॑ती त्वाऽवतु वैरू॒पᳪ साम॑ सप्तद॒श स्तोमो॑ व॒र्षा ऋ॒तुर्विड् द्रवि॑णम् ॥
verses.transliteration: pratīcīmā roha jagatī tvā'vatu vairūpaṃ sāma saptadaśa stomo varṣā ṛturviḍ draviṇam ||
verses.translation: Ascend the West. May Jagatî protect thee, the psalm Vairûpa, the seventeenfold praise-song, the Rain-time, and that store of wealth, the People.

verses.sanskrit: उदी॑ची॒मा रो॑हानु॒ष्टुप् त्वा॑ऽवतु वैरा॒जᳪ सामै॑कवि॒ᳪश स्तोमः॑ श॒रदृ॒तुः फलं॒ द्रवि॑णम् ॥
verses.transliteration: udīcīmā rohānuṣṭup tvā'vatu vairājaṃ sāmaikaviṃśa stomaḥ śaradṛtuḥ phalaṃ draviṇam ||
verses.translation: Ascend the North. Thy guardians be Anushtup, Vairâja psalm, the twenty-onefold praise-song, the season Autumn, that rich treasure Fruitage.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊ॒र्ध्वामा रो॑ह प॒ङ्क्तिस्त्वा॑ऽवतु शाक्वररैव॒ते साम॑नी त्रिणवत्रयस्त्रि॒ᳪशौ॒ स्तोमौ॑ हेमन्तशिशि॒रावृ॒तू वर्चो॒ द्रवि॑णं॒
प्रत्य॑स्तं॒ नमु॑चेः॒ शिरः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrdhvāmā roha paṅktistvā'vatu śākvararaivate sāmanī triṇavatrayastriṃśau stomau hemantaśiśirāvṛtū varco draviṇaṃ
pratyastaṃ namuceḥ śiraḥ ||
verses.translation: Ascend the Zenith. Pankti be thy keeper, Sâkvara, Raivata the pair of Sâmans, Praise-songs the thirty-threefold and thrice-ninefold, both seasons, Winter, Dews, that treasure lustre. The head of Namuchi hath been cast from me.

verses.sanskrit: सोम॑स्य॒ त्विषि॑रसि॒ तवे॑व मे॒ त्विषि॑र्भूयात् । मृ॒त्योः पा॒ह्योजो॑ऽसि॒ सहो॑ऽस्य॒मृत॑मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: somasya tviṣirasi taveva me tviṣirbhūyāt | mṛtyoḥ pāhyojo'si saho'syamṛtamasi ||
verses.translation: Brilliance of Soma art thou, may my brilliance grow like thine. Save me from death. Vigour art thou, victory, everlasting life.

verses.sanskrit:
हिर॑ण्यरूपा उ॒षसो॑ विरो॒क उ॒भावि॑न्द्रा॒ उदि॑थः॒ सूर्य॑श्च ।
आ रो॑हतं वरुण मित्र॒ गर्त्तं॒ तत॑श्चक्षाथा॒मदि॑तिं॒ दितिं॑ च मि॒त्रो॒ऽसि॒ वरु॑णोऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyarūpā uṣaso viroka ubhāvindrā udithaḥ sūryaśca |
ā rohataṃ varuṇa mitra garttaṃ tataścakṣāthāmaditiṃ ditiṃ ca mitro'si varuṇo'si ||
verses.translation: With golden bodies, at the flush of morning, ye rise on high, two Sovran Lords, and Sûrya. Ascend your car, O Varuna and Mitra: thence view infinity and limitation. Thou art Mitra, thou art Varuna.

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑स्य त्वा द्यु॒म्नेना॒भि षि॑ञ्चाम्य॒ग्नेर्भ्राज॑सा॒ सूर्य॑स्य॒ वर्च॒सेन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒येण॑ ।
क्ष॒त्राणां॑ क्ष॒त्रप॑तिरे॒ध्यति॑ दि॒द्यून् पा॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration:
somasya tvā dyumnenābhi ṣiñcāmyagnerbhrājasā sūryasya varcasendrasyendriyeṇa |
kṣatrāṇāṃ kṣatrapatiredhyati didyūn pāhi ||
verses.translation: Thee with the strength of Soma, Agni's lustre, with Sûrya's splendour, Indra's might I sprinkle. Be Lord of princes: safe past arrows guard him.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं दे॑वा असप॒त्नᳪ सु॑वध्वं मह॒ते क्ष॒त्राय॑ मह॒ते ज्यै॑ष्ठ्याय मह॒ते जान॑राज्या॒येन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒याय॑ ।
इ॒मम॒मुष्य॑ पु॒त्रम॒मुष्यै॑ पु॒त्रमस्यै वि॒श ए॒ष वो॑ऽमी॒ राजा॒ सोमो॒ऽस्माकं॑ ब्राह्म॒णाना॒ᳪराजा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ devā asapatnaṃ suvadhvaṃ mahate kṣatrāya mahate jyaiṣṭhyāya mahate jānarājyāyendrasyendriyāya |
imamamuṣya putramamuṣyai putramasyai viśa eṣa vo'mī rājā somo'smākaṃ brāhmaṇānāṃrājā ||

verses.sanskrit:
प्र पर्व॑तस्य वृष॒भस्य॑ पृ॒ष्ठान्नाव॑श्चरन्ति स्व॒सिच॑ इया॒नाः ।
ता आऽव॑वृत्रन्नध॒रागुद॑क्ता॒ अहिं॑ बु॒ध्न्य॒मनु॒ रीय॑माणाः ।
विष्णो॑र्वि॒क्रम॑णमसि॒ विष्णो॒र्विक्रा॑न्तमसि॒ विष्णोः॑ क्रा॒न्तम॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra parvatasya vṛṣabhasya pṛṣṭhānnāvaścaranti svasica iyānāḥ |
tā ā'vavṛtrannadharāgudaktā ahiṃ budhnyamanu rīyamāṇāḥ |
viṣṇorvikramaṇamasi viṣṇorvikrāntamasi viṣṇoḥ krāntamasi ||
verses.translation: Forth from the summit of the bull, the mountain, pouring spontaneously, the ships keep moving. They, lifted up, have turned them back and downward, still flowing onward, after Ahibudhnya. Thou art the stepping-forth of Vishnu: thou art Vishnu's outstep; Vishnu's step art thou.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रजा॑पते॒ न त्वदे॒तान्य॒न्यो विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॒ परि॒ ता ब॑भूव । यत्का॑मास्ते जुहु॒मस्तन्नो॑ अस्त्व॒यम॒मुष्य॑ पि॒तासाव॒स्य पि॒ता व॒यᳪ स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाᳪ स्वाहा॑ ।
रुद्र॒ यत्ते॒ क्रिवि॒ परं॒ नाम॒ तस्मि॑न्हु॒तम॑स्यमे॒ष्टम॑सि॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā rūpāṇi pari tā babhūva | yatkāmāste juhumastanno astvayamamuṣya pitāsāvasya pitā vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇāṃ svāhā |
rudra yatte krivi paraṃ nāma tasminhutamasyameṣṭamasi svāhā ||
verses.translation: Prajâpati, thou only comprehendest all these created forms, and none beside thee. Give us our heart's desire when we invoke thee. So-and-So's father is this man. Sire of this man is So-and-So. May we—All-hail!—be lords of rich possessions. What active highest name thou hast, O Rudra, therein thou art an offering, art an offering at home. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रो॑ऽसि मि॒त्रावरु॑णयोस्त्वा प्रशा॒स्त्रोः प्र॒शिषा॑ युनज्मि ।
अव्य॑थायै त्वा स्व॒धायै॒ त्वाऽरि॑ष्टो॒ अर्जु॑नो म॒रुतां॑ प्रस॒वेन॑ ज॒यापा॑म॒ मन॑सा॒ समि॑न्द्रि॒येण॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasya vajro'si mitrāvaruṇayostvā praśāstroḥ praśiṣā yunajmi |
avyathāyai tvā svadhāyai tvā'riṣṭo arjuno marutāṃ prasavena jayāpāma manasā samindriyeṇa ||
verses.translation: Indra's bolt art thou. I by the direction of Mitra-Varuna, Directors, yoke thee. I, the uninjured Arjuna, mount thee for firmness, thee for food. By quickening of the Maruts be thou victor. May we obtain by mind: with power united.

verses.sanskrit:
मा त॑ इन्द्र ते व॒यं तु॑राषा॒डयु॑क्तासो अब्र॒ह्मता॒ विद॑साम ।
तिष्ठा॒ रथ॒मधि॒ यं व॑ज्रह॒स्ता र॒श्मीन् दे॑व युवसे॒ स्वश्वा॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā ta indra te vayaṃ turāṣāḍayuktāso abrahmatā vidasāma |
tiṣṭhā rathamadhi yaṃ vajrahastā raśmīn deva yuvase svaśvān ||
verses.translation: Let us not, Indra, conqueror of the mighty, unfit through lack of prayer fail to obtain thee. Ascend the car which thou whose hand bears thunder controllest, and the reins with noble horses.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नये॑ गृ॒हप॑तये॒ स्वाहा॒ सोमा॑य॒ वन॒स्पत॑ये॒ स्वाहा॑
म॒रुता॒मोज॑से॒ स्वाहेन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒याय॒ स्वाहा॑ । पृथि॑वि मात॒र्मा मा॑ हिᳪसी॒र्मो अ॒हं त्वाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnaye gṛhapataye svāhā somāya vanaspataye svāhā
marutāmojase svāhendrasyendriyāya svāhā | pṛthivi mātarmā mā hiṃsīrmo ahaṃ tvām ||
verses.translation: All hail to Agni, Master of the Household! All-hail to Soma, Sovran of the Forest! All-hail to the great vigour of the Maruts! All-hail to the effectual might of Indra! Injure me not, O Mother Earth, and may I never injure thee.

verses.sanskrit:
ह॒ᳪसः शु॑चि॒षद्वसु॑रन्तरिक्ष॒सद्धोता॑ वेदि॒षदति॑थिर्दुरोण॒सत् ।
नृ॒षद्व॑र॒सदृ॑त॒सद्व्यो॑म॒सद॒ब्जा गो॒जा ऋ॑त॒जा अ॑द्रि॒जा ऋ॒तं बृ॒हत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
haṃsaḥ śuciṣadvasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirduroṇasat |
nṛṣadvarasadṛtasadvyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhat ||
verses.translation: The Hamsa throned in light, the Vasu in mid-air, the Priest beside the altar, Guest within the house, Dwelling in noblest place, mid men, in truth, in sky, born of flood, kine, truth, mountain, be is mighty Law.

verses.sanskrit:
इय॑द॒स्यायु॑र॒स्यायु॒र्मयि॑ धेहि॒ युङ्ङ॑सि॒ वर्चो॑ऽसि॒ वर्चो॒ मयि॑ धे॒ह्यूर्ग॒स्यूर्जं॒ मयि॑ धेहि ।।
इन्द्र॑स्य वां वीर्य॒कृतो॑ बा॒हू अ॑भ्यु॒पाव॑हरामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
iyadasyāyurasyāyurmayi dhehi yuṅṅasi varco'si varco mayi dhehyūrgasyūrjaṃ mayi dhehi ||
indrasya vāṃ vīryakṛto bāhū abhyupāvaharāmi ||
verses.translation: So great art thou: life art thou; give me life, Mate art thou: thou art splendour; give me splendour. Strength art thou: give me strength. I draw you downward, two arms of Indra mighty in achievement.

verses.sanskrit:
स्यो॒नाऽसि॑ सु॒षदा॑ऽसि क्ष॒त्रस्य॒ योनि॑रसि ।
स्यो॒नामा सी॑द सु॒षदा॒मा सी॑द क्ष॒त्रस्य॒ योनि॒मा सी॑द ॥
verses.transliteration:
syonā'si suṣadā'si kṣatrasya yonirasi |
syonāmā sīda suṣadāmā sīda kṣatrasya yonimā sīda ||
verses.translation: Fair art thou, good to sit on, womb of kingship. Sit on the fair one, sit on that which offers a pleasant seat: sit in the womb of kingship.

verses.sanskrit: नि ष॑साद घृ॒तव्र॑तो॒ वरु॑णः प॒स्त्यास्वा । साम्रा॑ज्याय सु॒क्रतुः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ni ṣasāda ghṛtavrato varuṇaḥ pastyāsvā | sāmrājyāya sukratuḥ ||
verses.translation: Varuna, Law's maintainer, hath sat down among his people, he Most wise, for universal sway.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि॒भूर॑स्ये॒तास्ते॒ पञ्च॒ दिशः॑ कल्पन्तां॒ ब्रह्मँ॒स्त्वं ब्र॒ह्माऽसि॑ सवि॒ताऽसि॑ स॒त्यप्र॑सवो॒ वरु॑णोऽसि स॒त्यौजा॒ इन्द्रो॑ऽसि॒ विशौ॑जा रु॒द्रो॒ऽसि सु॒शेवः॑ ।
बहु॑कार॒ श्रेय॑स्कर॒ भूय॑स्क॒रेन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रो॑ऽसि॒ तेन॑ मे रध्य ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhibhūrasyetāste pañca diśaḥ kalpantāṃ brahmam̐stvaṃ brahmā'si savitā'si satyaprasavo varuṇo'si satyaujā indro'si viśaujā rudro'si suśevaḥ |
bahukāra śreyaskara bhūyaskarendrasya vajro'si tena me radhya ||
verses.translation: Supreme Lord art thou. May these five regions of thine be prosperous. Brahman! Thou art Brahman, Savitar art thou, faithful in impulsion, Varuna art thou, he whose power is real. Indra art thou, whose strength is of the people. Rudra art thou, the very kind and gracious. Doer of much, Improver, Wealth-increaser! Indra's holt art thou. Be therewith my vassal.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निः पृ॒थुर्धर्म॑ण॒स्पति॑र्जुषा॒णो अ॒ग्निः पृ॒थुर्धर्म॑ण॒स्पति॒राज्य॑स्य वेतु॒ स्वाहा॑
स्वाहा॑कृताः॒ सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिभि॑र्यतध्वᳪ सजा॒तानां॑ मध्य॒मेष्ठ्या॑य ॥
verses.transliteration:
agniḥ pṛthurdharmaṇaspatirjuṣāṇo agniḥ pṛthurdharmaṇaspatirājyasya vetu svāhā
svāhākṛtāḥ sūryasya raśmibhiryatadhvaṃ sajātānāṃ madhyameṣṭhyāya ||
verses.translation: May spacious Agni, Lord of Duty, gladly, vast Agni, Duty's Lord, accept the butter. All-hail! Hallowed by Svâhâ, with the beams of Sûrya, strive for his central place among the kinsmen.

verses.sanskrit: स॒वि॒त्रा प्र॑सवि॒त्रा सर॑स्वत्या वा॒चा त्वष्ट्रा॑ रू॒पैः पू॒ष्णा प॒शुभि॒रिन्द्रे॑णा॒स्मे बृह॒स्पति॑ना॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ वरु॑णे॒नौज॑सा॒ऽग्निना॒ तेज॑सा॒ सोमे॑न॒ राज्ञा॒ विष्णु॑ना दश॒म्या दे॒वत॑या॒ प्रसू॑तः॒ प्र स॑र्पामि ॥
verses.transliteration: savitrā prasavitrā sarasvatyā vācā tvaṣṭrā rūpaiḥ pūṣṇā paśubhirindreṇāsme bṛhaspatinā brahmaṇā varuṇenaujasā'gninā tejasā somena rājñā viṣṇunā daśamyā devatayā prasūtaḥ pra sarpāmi ||
verses.translation: I creep forth urged onward by Savitar the Impeller; by Sarasvatî, Speech; by Tvashtar, created forms; by Pûshan, cattle; by this Indra; by Brihaspati, Devotion; by Varuna, Power; by Agni, Brilliance; by Soma, the King; by Vishnu the tenth Deity.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्विभ्यां॑ पच्यस्व॒ सर॑स्वत्यै पच्य॒स्वेन्द्रा॑य सु॒त्राम्णे॑ पच्यस्व ।
वा॒युः पू॒तः प॒वित्रे॑ण प्र॒त्यङ्क्सोमो॒ अति॑स्रुतः । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ युज्यः॒ सखा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvibhyāṃ pacyasva sarasvatyai pacyasvendrāya sutrāmṇe pacyasva |
vāyuḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa pratyaṅksomo atisrutaḥ | indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā ||
verses.translation: Get dressed for the Asvins. Get dressed for Sarasvatî: Get dressed for Indra the Good Deliverer: Soma the Wind, purified by the strainer, Indra's meet friend, hath gone oerflowing backward.

verses.sanskrit:
कु॒विद॒ङ्ग यव॑मन्तो यवं॑ चि॒द्यथा॒ दान्त्य॑नुपू॒र्वं वि॒यूय॑ ।
इ॒हेहै॑षां कृणुहि॒ भोज॑नानि॒ ये ब॒र्हिषो॒ नम॑ उक्तिं॒ यज॑न्ति ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒श्विभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ त्वेन्द्रा॑य त्वा सु॒त्राम्णे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavaṃ cidyathā dāntyanupūrvaṃ viyūya |
ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo nama uktiṃ yajanti |
upayāmagṛhīto'syaśvibhyāṃ tvā sarasvatyai tvendrāya tvā sutrāmṇe ||
verses.translation: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley reap the ripe corn, removing it in order, So bring the food of these men, bring it hither, who pay the Sacred Grass their spoken homage. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. Thee for Sarasvatî, and thee for Indra, for the Excellent Protector.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒वᳪ सु॒राम॑मश्विना॒ नमु॑चावासु॒रे सचा॑ । वि॒पि॒पा॒ना शु॑भस्पती॒ इन्द्रं॒ कर्म॑स्वावतम् ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvaṃ surāmamaśvinā namucāvāsure sacā | vipipānā śubhaspatī indraṃ karmasvāvatam ||
verses.translation: Ye Asvins, Lords of Splendour, drank full draughts of grateful Soma juice, And aided Indra in his deeds with Namuchi of Asura birth.

verses.sanskrit:
पु॒त्रमि॑व पि॒तरा॑व॒श्विनो॒भेन्द्रा॒वथुः॒ काव्यै॑र्द॒ᳪसना॑भिः ।
यत्सु॒रामं॒ व्यपि॑बः॒ शची॑भिः॒ सर॑स्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक् ॥
verses.transliteration:
putramiva pitarāvaśvinobhendrāvathuḥ kāvyairdaṃsanābhiḥ |
yatsurāmaṃ vyapibaḥ śacībhiḥ sarasvatī tvā maghavannabhiṣṇak ||
verses.translation: As parents aid a son, both Asvins aided thee, Indra, with their wondrous powers and wisdom. When thou with might hadst drunk the draught that gladdens, Sarasvatî, O Bounteous Lord, refreshed thee.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒ञ्जा॒नः प्र॑थ॒मं मन॑स्त॒त्त्वाय॑ सवि॒ता धियः॑ । अ॒ग्नेर्ज्योति॑र्नि॒चाय्य॑ पृथि॒व्या अध्याऽभ॑रत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yuñjānaḥ prathamaṃ manastattvāya savitā dhiyaḥ | agnerjyotirnicāyya pṛthivyā adhyā'bharat ||
verses.translation: Harnessing, first of all, the mind, Savitar having stretched the thought With reverent look upon the light of Agni bore them up from earth.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒क्तेन॒ मन॑सा व॒यं दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः स॒वे । स्व॒र्ग्या॒य॒ शक्त्या॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yuktena manasā vayaṃ devasya savituḥ save | svargyāya śaktyā ||
verses.translation: By impulse of God Savitar we with our spirit harnessed strive With might to win the heavenly.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒क्त्वाय॑ सवि॒ता दे॒वान्त्स्व॑र्य॒तो धि॒या दिव॑म् । बृ॒हज्ज्योतिः॑ करिष्य॒तः स॑वि॒ता प्र सु॑वाति॒ तान् ॥
verses.transliteration: yuktvāya savitā devāntsvaryato dhiyā divam | bṛhajjyotiḥ kariṣyataḥ savitā pra suvāti tān ||
verses.translation: Savitar, having harnessed Gods who go to light and heavenly thought, Who will create the lofty light—Savitar urge them on their way!

verses.sanskrit:
यु॒ञ्जते॒ मन॑ उ॒त यु॑ञ्जते॒ धियो॒ विप्रा॒ विप्र॑स्य बृह॒तो वि॑प॒श्चितः॑ ।
वि होत्रा॑ दधे वयुना॒विदेक॒ इन्म॒ही दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः परि॑ष्टुतिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścitaḥ |
vi hotrā dadhe vayunāvideka inmahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ ||
verses.translation: The priests of him the lofty priest well skilled in hymns, harness their spirit, yea, harness their holy thoughts. He only, skilled in rules, assigns their priestly tasks. Yea, lofty is the praise of Savitar the God.

verses.sanskrit:
यु॒जे वां॒ ब्रह्म॑ पू॒र्व्यं नमो॑भि॒र्वि श्लोक॑ एतु प॒थ्ये॒व सू॒रेः ।
शृ॒ण्वन्तु॒ विश्वे॑ अ॒मृत॑स्य पु॒त्रा आ ये धामा॑नि दि॒व्यानि॑ त॒स्थुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yuje vāṃ brahma pūrvyaṃ namobhirvi śloka etu pathyeva sūreḥ |
śṛṇvantu viśve amṛtasya putrā ā ye dhāmāni divyāni tasthuḥ ||
verses.translation: I yoke with prayer your ancient inspiration: may the laud rise as on the prince's pathway. All Sons of the Immortal One shall hear it, who have resorted to celestial dwellings.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्य॑ प्र॒याण॒मन्व॒न्य इद्य॒युर्दे॒वा दे॒वस्य॑ महि॒मान॒मोज॑सा ।
यः पार्थि॑वानि विम॒मे स एत॑शो॒ रजा॑ᳪसि दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता म॑हित्व॒ना ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasya prayāṇamanvanya idyayurdevā devasya mahimānamojasā |
yaḥ pārthivāni vimame sa etaśo rajāṃsi devaḥ savitā mahitvanā ||
verses.translation: Even he, the God whose going forth and majesty the other Deities have followed with their might, He who hath measured the celestial regions out by his great power, he is the Courser Savitar.

verses.sanskrit:
देव॑ सवितः॒ प्र सु॑व य॒ज्ञं प्र सु॑व य॒ज्ञप॑तिं॒ भगा॑य ।
दि॒व्यो ग॑न्ध॒र्वः के॑त॒पूः केतं॑ नः पुनातु वा॒चस्पति॒र्वाचं॑ नः स्वदतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
deva savitaḥ pra suva yajñaṃ pra suva yajñapatiṃ bhagāya |
divyo gandharvaḥ ketapūḥ ketaṃ naḥ punātu vācaspatirvācaṃ naḥ svadatu ||
verses.translation: Our sacrifice, God Savitar! speed forward: speed to his share the sacrifice's patron. May the celestial Gandharva, Cleanser of thought and will, make clean our thoughts and wishes. The Lord of Speech sweeten the words we utter!

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं नो॑ देव सवितर्य॒ज्ञं प्र ण॑य देवा॒व्य॒ᳪ सखि॒विद॑ᳪ सत्रा॒जितं॑ धन॒जित॑ᳪ स्व॒र्जित॑म् ।
ऋ॒चा स्तोम॒ᳪ सम॑र्धय गाय॒त्रेण॑ रथन्त॒रं बृ॒हद्गा॑य॒त्रव॑र्तनि॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ no deva savitaryajñaṃ pra ṇaya devāvyaṃ sakhividaṃ satrājitaṃ dhanajitaṃ svarjitam |
ṛcā stomaṃ samardhaya gāyatreṇa rathantaraṃ bṛhadgāyatravartani svāhā ||
verses.translation: God Savitar, speed this God-loved sacrifice of ours, friend-finding, ever-conquering, winning wealth and heaven. Speed praise-song with the sacred verse, Rathantara with Gâyatra, Brihat that runs in Gâyatra. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् ।
आ द॑दे गाय॒त्रेण॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वत्पृ॑थि॒व्याः स॒धस्था॑द॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वदा भ॑र॒ त्रैष्टु॑भेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām |
ā dade gāyatreṇa chandasā'ṅgirasvatpṛthivyāḥ sadhasthādagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadā bhara traiṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvat ||
verses.translation: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan, in Angiras manner, with Gâyatrî metre. From the earth's seat bring thou Purîshya Agni, as Angiras was wont, with Trishtup metre.

verses.sanskrit: अभ्रि॑रसि॒ नार्य॑सि॒ त्वया॑ व॒यम॒ग्निᳪ श॑केम॒ खनि॑तुᳪ स॒धस्थ॒ आ । जाग॑तेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वत् ॥
verses.transliteration: abhrirasi nāryasi tvayā vayamagniṃ śakema khanituṃ sadhastha ā | jāgatena chandasā'ṅgirasvat ||
verses.translation: Spade art thou; woman art thou. Ours be power with thee to dig out Agni in his dwelling, as Angiras was wont, with Jagatî metre.

verses.sanskrit: हस्त॑ आ॒धाय॑ सवि॒ता बिभ्र॒दभ्रि॑ᳪ हिर॒ण्ययी॑म् । अ॒ग्नेर्ज्योति॑र्नि॒चाय्य॑ पृथि॒व्या अध्याऽभ॑र॒दानु॑ष्टुभेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वत् ॥
verses.transliteration: hasta ādhāya savitā bibhradabhriṃ hiraṇyayīm | agnerjyotirnicāyya pṛthivyā adhyā'bharadānuṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvat ||
verses.translation: Savitar, bearing in his hand the gold spade which he took therewith, Looking with reverence on the light of Agni, raised it from the earth, With the Anushtup metre and as Angiras was wont to do.

verses.sanskrit: प्रतू॑र्तं वाजि॒न्ना द्र॑व॒ वरि॑ष्ठा॒मनु॑ सं॒वत॑म् । दि॒वि ते॒ जन्म॑ पर॒मम॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ तव॒ नाभिः॑ पृथि॒व्यामधि॒ योनि॒रित् ॥
verses.transliteration: pratūrtaṃ vājinnā drava variṣṭhāmanu saṃvatam | divi te janma paramamantarikṣe tava nābhiḥ pṛthivyāmadhi yonirit ||
verses.translation: Run hither, urged to speed, O Horse, along the most extended space. Thy loftiest birthplace is in heaven. thy navel is in air's mid-realm, the womb that bare thee is on earth.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒ञ्जाथा॒ᳪ रास॑भं यु॒वम॒स्मिन् यामे॑ वृषण्वसू । अ॒ग्निं भर॑न्तमस्म॒युम् ॥
verses.transliteration: yuñjāthāṃ rāsabhaṃ yuvamasmin yāme vṛṣaṇvasū | agniṃ bharantamasmayum ||
verses.translation: Upon this course, O lords of wealth, harness; ye twain, the Ass who bears Agni, and kindly favours us.

verses.sanskrit: योगे॑-योगे त॒वस्त॑रं॒ वाजे॑-वाजे हवामहे । सखा॑य॒ इन्द्र॑मू॒तये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yoge-yoge tavastaraṃ vāje-vāje havāmahe | sakhāya indramūtaye ||
verses.translation: In every need, in every race we call, as friends, to succour us, Indra, the mightiest of all.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒तूर्व॒न्नेह्य॑व॒क्राम॒न्नश॑स्ती रु॒द्रस्य॒ गाण॑पत्यं मयो॒भूरेहि॑ । उ॒र्वन्तरि॑क्षं॒ वी॑हि स्व॒स्तिग॑व्यूति॒रभ॑यानि कृ॒ण्वन् पू॒ष्णा स॒युजा॑ स॒ह ॥
verses.transliteration: pratūrvannehyavakrāmannaśastī rudrasya gāṇapatyaṃ mayobhūrehi | urvantarikṣaṃ vīhi svastigavyūtirabhayāni kṛṇvan pūṣṇā sayujā saha ||
verses.translation: Come speeding on and trampling imprecations; come gladdening to the chieftainship of Rudra. Speed through the wide air thou whose paths are pleasant, with Pûshan for thy mate, providing safety.

verses.sanskrit: पृ॒थि॒व्याः स॒धस्था॑द॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वदा भ॑रा॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वदच्छे॑मो॒ ऽग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वद्भ॑रिष्यामः ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthādagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadā bharāgniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadacchemo 'gniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadbhariṣyāmaḥ ||
verses.translation: From the Earth's seat, like Anginas, bring thou Purîshya Agni forth. After the wont of Angiras we to Purîshya Agni go. Agni Purîshya we will bear after the went of Angiras.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्व॒ग्निरु॒षसा॒मग्र॑मख्य॒दन्वहा॑नि प्रथ॒मो जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
अनु॒ सूर्य॑स्य पुरु॒त्रा च॑ र॒श्मीननु॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी आ त॑तन्थ ॥
verses.transliteration:
anvagniruṣasāmagramakhyadanvahāni prathamo jātavedāḥ |
anu sūryasya purutrā ca raśmīnanu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatantha ||
verses.translation: Agni hath looked along the van of Mornings, looked on the days, the earliest Jâtavedas, And many a time along the beams of Sûrya: along the heaven and earth hast thou extended.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒गत्य॑ वा॒ज्यध्वा॑न॒ᳪ सर्वा॒ मृधो॒ वि धू॑नुते । अ॒ग्निᳪ स॒धस्थे॑ मह॒ति चक्षु॑षा॒ नि चि॑कीषते ॥
verses.transliteration: āgatya vājyadhvānaṃ sarvā mṛdho vi dhūnute | agniṃ sadhasthe mahati cakṣuṣā ni cikīṣate ||
verses.translation: The Courser, started on his way, shakes from him all hostilities. He longs to look with reverent eye on Agni is the mighty. seat.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒क्रम्य॑ वाजिन् पृथि॒वीम॒ग्निमि॑च्छ रु॒चा त्वम् । भूम्या॑ वृ॒त्वाय॑ नो ब्रूहि॒ यतः॒ खने॑म॒ तं व॒यम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ākramya vājin pṛthivīmagnimiccha rucā tvam | bhūmyā vṛtvāya no brūhi yataḥ khanema taṃ vayam ||
verses.translation: O Courser, having come to earth, seek Agni with a longing wish. Tell us by trampling on the ground where we may dig him from the earth.

verses.sanskrit:
द्यौ॑स्ते पृ॒ष्ठं पृ॑थि॒वी स॒धस्थ॑मा॒त्माऽन्तरि॑क्षᳪ समु॒द्रो योनिः॑ ।
वि॒ख्याय॒ चक्षु॑षा॒ त्वम॒भि ति॑ष्ठ पृतन्य॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dyauste pṛṣṭhaṃ pṛthivī sadhasthamātmā'ntarikṣaṃ samudro yoniḥ |
vikhyāya cakṣuṣā tvamabhi tiṣṭha pṛtanyataḥ ||
verses.translation: Heaven is thy back, the earth thy seat, the air thy soul, the sea thy womb. Looking around thee with thine eye trample the adversaries down.

verses.sanskrit:
उत्क्रा॑म मह॒ते सौ॑भगाया॒स्मादा॒स्थाना॑द् द्रविणो॒दा वा॑जिन् ।
व॒यᳪ स्या॑म सुम॒तौ पृ॑थि॒व्या अ॒ग्निं खन॑न्त उ॒पस्थे॑ अस्याः ॥
verses.transliteration:
utkrāma mahate saubhagāyāsmādāsthānād draviṇodā vājin |
vayaṃ syāma sumatau pṛthivyā agniṃ khananta upasthe asyāḥ ||
verses.translation: Wealth-giver, Courser, from this place step forth to great felicity. May we enjoy Earth's favour while we dig forth Agni from her

verses.sanskrit:
उद॑क्रमीद् द्रविणो॒दा वा॒ज्य॒र्वाकः॒ सुलो॒कᳪ सुकृ॑तं पृथि॒व्याम् ।
ततः॑ खनेम सु॒प्रती॑कम॒ग्निᳪ स्वो॒ रुहा॑णा॒ अधि॒ नाक॑मुत्त॒मम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
udakramīd draviṇodā vājyarvākaḥ sulokaṃ sukṛtaṃ pṛthivyām |
tataḥ khanema supratīkamagniṃ svo ruhāṇā adhi nākamuttamam ||
verses.translation: Down hath he stepped, wealth-giver, racer, courser. Good and auspicious room on earth thou madest. Thence let us dig forth Agni, fair to look on, while to the loftiest vault we mount, to heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
आ त्वा॑ जिघर्मि॒ मन॑सा घृ॒तेन॑ प्रतिक्षि॒यन्तं॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
पृ॒थुं ति॑र॒श्चा वय॑सा बृ॒हन्तं॒ व्यचि॑ष्ठ॒मन्नै॑ रभ॒सं दृशा॑नम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā tvā jigharmi manasā ghṛtena pratikṣiyantaṃ bhuvanāni viśvā |
pṛthuṃ tiraścā vayasā bṛhantaṃ vyaciṣṭhamannai rabhasaṃ dṛśānam ||
verses.translation: I thoughtfully besprinkle thee with butter, thee dwelling near to all existing creatures. Broad, vast through vital power that moves transversely, conspicuous, strong with all the food that feeds thee.

verses.sanskrit:
आ वि॒श्वतः॑ प्र॒त्यञ्चं॑ जिघर्म्यर॒क्षसा॒ मन॑सा॒ तज्जु॑षेत ।
मर्य॑श्री स्पृह॒यद्व॑र्णो अ॒ग्निर्नाभि॒मृशे॑ त॒न्वा जर्भु॑राणः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā viśvataḥ pratyañcaṃ jigharmyarakṣasā manasā tajjuṣeta |
maryaśrī spṛhayadvarṇo agnirnābhimṛśe tanvā jarbhurāṇaḥ ||
verses.translation: I sprinkle him who moves in all directions: may he accept it with a friendly spirit. Agni with bridegroom's face and lovely colour may not be touched when all his form is fury.

verses.sanskrit: परि॒ वाज॑पतिः क॒विर॒ग्निर्ह॒व्यान्य॑क्रमीत् । दध॒द्रत्ना॑नि दा॒शुषे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: pari vājapatiḥ kaviragnirhavyānyakramīt | dadhadratnāni dāśuṣe ||
verses.translation: Round the oblation bath he paced, Agni the wise, the Lord of Strength, Giving the offerer precious boons.

verses.sanskrit: परि॑ त्वाऽग्ने॒ पुरं॑ व॒यं विप्र॑ᳪ सहस्य धीमहि । धृ॒षद्व॑र्णं दि॒वे-दि॑वे ह॒न्तारं॑ भङ्गु॒राव॑ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: pari tvā'gne puraṃ vayaṃ vipraṃ sahasya dhīmahi | dhṛṣadvarṇaṃ dive-dive hantāraṃ bhaṅgurāvatām ||
verses.translation: We set thee round us as a fort, victorious Agni, thee a Sage, Of hero lineage, day by day destroyer of our treacherous foes.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वम॑ग्ने॒ द्युभि॒स्त्वमा॑शुशु॒क्षणि॒स्त्वम॒द्भ्यस्त्वमश्म॑न॒स्परि॑ ।
त्वं वने॑भ्य॒स्त्वमोष॑धीभ्य॒स्त्वं नृ॒णां नृ॑पते जायसे॒ शुचिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvamagne dyubhistvamāśuśukṣaṇistvamadbhyastvamaśmanaspari |
tvaṃ vanebhyastvamoṣadhībhyastvaṃ nṛṇāṃ nṛpate jāyase śuciḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou, Agni, with the days, fain to shine hitherward, art brought to life from out the waters, from the stone, From out the forest trees and herbs that grow on ground. thou, Sovran Lord of men, art generated pure.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् ।
पृ॒थि॒व्याः स॒धस्था॑द॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वत्ख॑नामि ।
ज्योति॑ष्मन्तं त्वाऽग्ने सु॒प्रती॑क॒मज॑स्रेण भा॒नुना॒ दीद्य॑तम् ।
शि॒वं प्र॒जाभ्योऽहि॑ᳪसन्तं पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्था॑द॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वत्ख॑नामः ॥
verses.transliteration:
devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām |
pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthādagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvatkhanāmi |
jyotiṣmantaṃ tvā'gne supratīkamajasreṇa bhānunā dīdyatam |
śivaṃ prajābhyo'hiṃsantaṃ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthādagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvatkhanāmaḥ ||
verses.translation: At Savitar's, the Shining One's, impulsion, with arms of Asvins and with hands of Pûshan, As Angiras was wont to do, I dig thee forth from the seat of Earth, Agni Purîshya. Thee, Agni, luminous and fair of aspect, resplendent with imperishable lustre, gracious to living creatures, never harming, As Angiras was wont to do, we dig thee forth from the seat of Earth, Agni Purîshya.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पां पृ॒ष्ठम॑सि॒ योनि॑र॒ग्नेः स॑मु॒द्रम॒भितः॒ पिन्व॑मानम् ।
वर्ध॑मानो म॒हाँ२ आ च॒ पुष्क॑रे दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
apāṃ pṛṣṭhamasi yoniragneḥ samudramabhitaḥ pinvamānam |
vardhamāno mahām̐ ā ca puṣkare divo mātrayā varimṇā prathasva ||
verses.translation: Thou art the Waters back, the womb of Agni, around the ocean as it swells and surges. Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread thou in amplitude with heaven's own measure.

verses.sanskrit:
शर्म॑ च स्थो॒ वर्म॑ च॒ स्थोऽछि॑द्रे बहु॒ले उ॒भे ।
व्यच॑स्वती॒ सं व॑साथां भृ॒तम॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śarma ca stho varma ca stho'chidre bahule ubhe |
vyacasvatī saṃ vasāthāṃ bhṛtamagniṃ purīṣyam ||
verses.translation: Yea are a shelter and a shield, uninjured both, and widely spread. Do ye; expansive, cover him: bear ye Purîshya Agni up.

verses.sanskrit:
सं व॑साथाᳪ स्व॒र्विदा॑ स॒मीची॒ उर॑सा॒ त्मना॑ ।
अ॒ग्निम॒न्तर्भ॑रि॒ष्यन्ती॒ ज्योति॑ष्मन्त॒मज॑स्र॒मित् ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ vasāthāṃ svarvidā samīcī urasā tmanā |
agnimantarbhariṣyantī jyotiṣmantamajasramit ||
verses.translation: Cover him, finders of the light, united both with breast and self, Bearing between you Agni, the refulgent, everlasting One.

verses.sanskrit:
पु॒री॒ष्यो॒ऽसि वि॒श्वभ॑रा॒ अथ॑र्वा त्वा प्रथ॒मो निर॑मन्थदग्ने ।
त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ पुष्क॑रा॒दध्यथ॑र्वा॒ निर॑मन्थत । मू॒र्ध्नो विश्व॑स्य वा॒घतः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
purīṣyo'si viśvabharā atharvā tvā prathamo niramanthadagne |
tvāmagne puṣkarādadhyatharvā niramanthata | mūrdhno viśvasya vāghataḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou art Purîshya, thou support of all. Atharvan was the first, Agni, who rubbed thee into life. Agni, Atharvan brought thee forth by rubbing from the lotus, from The head of Visva, of the Priest.

verses.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा द॒ध्यङ्ङृषिः॑ पु॒त्र ई॑धे॒ अथ॑र्वणः । वृ॑त्र॒हणं॑ पुरन्द॒रम् ॥
verses.transliteration: tamu tvā dadhyaṅṅṛṣiḥ putra īdhe atharvaṇaḥ | vṛtrahaṇaṃ purandaram ||
verses.translation: Thee too as Vritra-slayer, thee breaker of forts, the Sage Dadhyach, Son of Atharvan, lighted up.

verses.sanskrit: तमु॑ त्वा पा॒थ्यो वृषा॒ समी॑धे दस्यु॒हन्त॑मम् । ध॒न॒ञ्ज॒यᳪ रणे॑-रणे ॥
verses.transliteration: tamu tvā pāthyo vṛṣā samīdhe dasyuhantamam | dhanañjayaṃ raṇe-raṇe ||
verses.translation: Pâthya the Bull, too, kindled thee the Dasyus most destructive foe, Winner of spoil in every fight.

verses.sanskrit:
सीद॑ होतः॒ स्व उ॑ लो॒के चि॑कि॒त्वान्सा॒दया॑ य॒ज्ञᳪ सु॑कृ॒तस्य॒ योनौ॑ ।
दे॒वा॒वीर्दे॒वान्ह॒विषा॑ यजा॒स्यग्ने॑ बृ॒हद्यज॑माने॒ वयो॑ धाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sīda hotaḥ sva u loke cikitvānsādayā yajñaṃ sukṛtasya yonau |
devāvīrdevānhaviṣā yajāsyagne bṛhadyajamāne vayo dhāḥ ||
verses.translation: Sit, Hotar, in the Hotar's place, observant: lay down the sacrifice in the place of worship. Thou, dear to Go is, shalt serve them with oblation. Agni, give long life to the Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit:
नि होता॑ होतृ॒षद॑ने॒ विदा॑नस्त्वे॒षो दी॑दि॒वाँ२ अ॑सदत्सु॒दक्षः॑ ।
अद॑ब्धव्रतप्रमति॒र्वसि॑ष्ठः सहस्रम्भ॒रः शुचि॑जिह्वो अ॒ग्निः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ni hotā hotṛṣadane vidānastveṣo dīdivām̐ asadatsudakṣaḥ |
adabdhavratapramatirvasiṣṭhaḥ sahasrambharaḥ śucijihvo agniḥ ||
verses.translation: Accustomed to the Hotar's place, the Hotar hath seated him, bright, splendid, passing mighty, Whose foresight keeps the Law from violation, excellent, pure-tongued, bringing thousands, Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
सᳪ सी॑दस्व म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि॒ शोच॑स्व देव॒वीत॑मः ।
वि धू॒मम॑ग्ने अरु॒षं मि॑येध्य सृ॒ज प्र॑शस्त दर्श॒तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ sīdasva mahām̐ asi śocasva devavītamaḥ |
vi dhūmamagne aruṣaṃ miyedhya sṛja praśasta darśatam ||
verses.translation: Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke, ruddy and beautiful to see.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पो दे॒वीरुप॑ सृज॒ मधु॑मतीरय॒क्ष्माय॑ प्र॒जाभ्यः॑ ।
तासा॑मा॒स्थाना॒दुज्जि॑हता॒मोष॑धयः सुपिप्प॒लाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
apo devīrupa sṛja madhumatīrayakṣmāya prajābhyaḥ |
tāsāmāsthānādujjihatāmoṣadhayaḥ supippalāḥ ||
verses.translation: Pour heavenly Waters honey-sweet here for our health, for progeny. Forth from the place whereon they fall let plants with goodly berries spring.

verses.sanskrit:
सं ते॑ वा॒युर्मा॑त॒रिश्वा॑ दधातूत्ता॒नाया॒ हृद॑यं॒ यद्विक॑स्तम् ।
यो दे॒वानां॒ चर॑सि प्रा॒णथे॑न॒ कस्मै॑ देव॒ वष॑डस्तु॒ तुभ्य॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ te vāyurmātariśvā dadhātūttānāyā hṛdayaṃ yadvikastam |
yo devānāṃ carasi prāṇathena kasmai deva vaṣaḍastu tubhyam ||
verses.translation: May Vâyu Mâtarisvan heal and comfort thy broken heart as there supine thou liest. Thou unto whom the breath of Gods gives motion, to Ka, yea, unto thee, O God, be Vashat!

verses.sanskrit:
सुजा॑तो॒ ज्योति॑षा स॒ह शर्म॒ वरू॑थ॒माऽस॑द॒त्स्वः॑ ।
वासो॑ अग्ने वि॒श्वरू॑प॒ᳪ सं व्य॑यस्व विभावसो ॥
verses.transliteration:
sujāto jyotiṣā saha śarma varūthamā'sadatsvaḥ |
vāso agne viśvarūpaṃ saṃ vyayasva vibhāvaso ||
verses.translation: He, nobly born with lustre, shield and refuge, hath sat down in light. O Agni, Rich in Splendour, robe thyself in many-hued attire.

verses.sanskrit: उदु॑ तिष्ठ स्वध्व॒रावा॑ नो दे॒व्या धि॒या । दृ॒शे च॑ भा॒सा बृ॑ह॒ता सु॑शु॒क्वनि॒राग्ने॑ याहि सुश॒स्तिभिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: udu tiṣṭha svadhvarāvā no devyā dhiyā | dṛśe ca bhāsā bṛhatā suśukvanirāgne yāhi suśastibhiḥ ||
verses.translation: Lord of fair sacrifice; arise! With Godlike thought protect us well. With great light splendid to behold come, Agni, through sweet hymns of praise.

verses.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्व ऊ॒ षु ण॑ ऊ॒तये॒ तिष्ठा॑ दे॒वो न स॑वि॒ता । ऊ॒र्ध्वो वाज॑स्य॒ सनि॑ता॒ यद॒ञ्जिभि॑र्वा॒घद्भि॑र्वि॒ह्वया॑महे ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrdhva ū ṣu ṇa ūtaye tiṣṭhā devo na savitā | ūrdhvo vājasya sanitā yadañjibhirvāghadbhirvihvayāmahe ||
verses.translation: Rise up erect to give us aid, stand up like Savitar the God; Erect as strength-bestower when we call aloud, with unguents and with priests on thee.

verses.sanskrit:
स जा॒तो गर्भो॑ असि॒ रोद॑स्योरग्ने॒ चारु॒र्विभृ॑त॒ ओष॑धीषु ।
चि॒त्रः शिशुः॒ परि॒ तमा॑ᳪस्य॒क्तून्प्र मा॒तृभ्यो॒ अधि॒ कनि॑क्रद॒द्गाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa jāto garbho asi rodasyoragne cārurvibhṛta oṣadhīṣu |
citraḥ śiśuḥ pari tamāṃsyaktūnpra mātṛbhyo adhi kanikradadgāḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou, being horn, art Child of Earth and Heaven, parted, fair Babe, among the plants, O Agni. The glooms of night thou, brilliant child, subduest, and art come forth, loud roaring, from the Mothers.

verses.sanskrit: स्थि॒रो भ॑व वी॒ड्व॒ङ्ग आ॒शुर्भ॑व वा॒ज्य॒र्वन् । पृ॒थुर्भ॑व सु॒षद॒स्त्वम॒ग्नेः पु॑रीष॒वाह॑णः ॥
verses.transliteration: sthiro bhava vīḍvaṅga āśurbhava vājyarvan | pṛthurbhava suṣadastvamagneḥ purīṣavāhaṇaḥ ||
verses.translation: Steady be thou, and firm of limb. Steed, be a racer fleet of foot. Broad be thou, pleasant as a seat, bearing the store which Agni needs.

verses.sanskrit:
शि॒वो भ॑व प्र॒जाभ्यो॒ मानु॑षीभ्य॒स्त्वम॑ङ्गिरः ।
मा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒भि शो॑ची॒र्माऽन्तरि॑क्षं॒ मा वन॒स्पती॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śivo bhava prajābhyo mānuṣībhyastvamaṅgiraḥ |
mā dyāvāpṛthivī abhi śocīrmā'ntarikṣaṃ mā vanaspatīn ||
verses.translation: Be thou propitious, Angiras, to creatures of the human race. Set not on fire the heaven and earth, nor air's mid-region, nor the trees.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रै॑तु वा॒जी कनि॑क्रद॒न्नान॑द॒द्रास॑भः॒ पत्वा॑ । भर॑न्न॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्यं मा पा॒द्यायु॑षः पु॒रा ।
वृषा॒ग्निं वृष॑णं॒ भर॑न्न॒पां गर्भ॑ᳪ समु॒द्रिय॑म् । अग्न॒ आ या॑हि वी॒तये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
praitu vājī kanikradannānadadrāsabhaḥ patvā | bharannagniṃ purīṣyaṃ mā pādyāyuṣaḥ purā |
vṛṣāgniṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ bharannapāṃ garbhaṃ samudriyam | agna ā yāhi vītaye ||
verses.translation: Forth with loud neighing go the Steed, the Ass that shouteth as he runs. Bearing Purîshya Agni on, let him not perish ere his time, Male bearer of male Agni, Child of Waters, Offspring of the Sea. Agni, come hither to the feast.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तᳪ स॒त्यमृ॒तᳪ स॒त्यम॒ग्निं पु॑री॒ष्य॒मङ्गिर॒स्वद्भ॑रामः ।
ओष॑धयः॒ प्रति॑ मोदध्वम॒ग्निमे॒तᳪ शि॒वमा॒यन्त॑म॒भ्यत्र॑ यु॒ष्माः ।
व्यस्य॒न् विश्वा॒ अनि॑रा॒ अमी॑वा नि॒षीद॑न्नो॒ अप॑ दुर्म॒तिं ज॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛtaṃ satyamṛtaṃ satyamagniṃ purīṣyamaṅgirasvadbharāmaḥ |
oṣadhayaḥ prati modadhvamagnimetaṃ śivamāyantamabhyatra yuṣmāḥ |
vyasyan viśvā anirā amīvā niṣīdanno apa durmatiṃ jahi ||
verses.translation: The Law the Truth, the Law the Truth. As Angiras was wont to do, we bear Purîshya Agni on. Ye Plants, with joyous welcome greet this Agni, auspicious One who cometh on to meet you. Removing all distresses and afflictions, here settle down and banish evil purpose.

verses.sanskrit: ओष॑धयः॒ प्रति॑ गृभ्णीत॒ पुष्प॑वतीः सुपिप्प॒लाः । अ॒यं वो॒ गर्भ॑ ऋ॒त्वियः॑ प्र॒त्नᳪ स॒धस्थ॒माऽस॑दत् ॥
verses.transliteration: oṣadhayaḥ prati gṛbhṇīta puṣpavatīḥ supippalāḥ | ayaṃ vo garbha ṛtviyaḥ pratnaṃ sadhasthamā'sadat ||
verses.translation: Welcome him joyfully, ye Plants, laden with bloom and goodly fruit. This seasonable Child of yours hath settled in his ancient seat.

verses.sanskrit:
वि पाज॑सा पृ॒थुना॒ शोशु॑चानो॒ बाध॑स्व द्वि॒षो र॒क्षसो॒ अमी॑वाः ।
सु॒शर्म॑णो बृह॒तः शर्म॑णि स्याम॒ग्नेर॒हᳪ सु॒हव॑स्य॒ प्रणी॑तौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vi pājasā pṛthunā śośucāno bādhasva dviṣo rakṣaso amīvāḥ |
suśarmaṇo bṛhataḥ śarmaṇi syāmagnerahaṃ suhavasya praṇītau ||
verses.translation: Resplendent with thy wide-extending lustre dispel the terrors of the fiends who hate us. May lofty Agni be my guide and shelter, ready to hear our call, the good Protector.

verses.sanskrit: आपो॒ हि ष्ठा म॑यो॒भुव॒स्ता न॑ ऊ॒र्जे द॑धातन । म॒हे रणा॑य॒ चक्ष॑से ॥
verses.transliteration: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana | mahe raṇāya cakṣase ||
verses.translation: Ye, Waters, are beneficent, so help ye us to energy That we may look on great delight.

verses.sanskrit: यो वः॑ शि॒वत॑मो॒ रस॒स्तस्य॑ भाजयते॒ह नः॑ । उ॒श॒तीरि॑व मा॒तरः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha naḥ | uśatīriva mātaraḥ ||
verses.translation: Give us a portion of the sap, the most propitious that ye have. Like mothers in their longing love.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मा॒ अरं॑ गमाम वो॒ यस्य॒ क्षया॑य॒ जिन्व॑थ । आपो॑ ज॒नय॑था च नः ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha | āpo janayathā ca naḥ ||
verses.translation: To you we gladly come for him to whose abode ye lead us on: And, Waters, give us procreant strength.

verses.sanskrit:
मि॒त्रः स॒ᳪसृज्य॑ पृथि॒वीं भूमिं॑ च॒ ज्योति॑षा स॒ह ।
सुजा॑तं जा॒तवे॑दसमय॒क्ष्माय॑ त्वा॒ सᳪ सृ॑जामि प्र॒जाभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
mitraḥ saṃsṛjya pṛthivīṃ bhūmiṃ ca jyotiṣā saha |
sujātaṃ jātavedasamayakṣmāya tvā saṃ sṛjāmi prajābhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: Mitra, having commingled earth and ground together with the light For health to creatures mix I thee Omniscient and nobly born.

verses.sanskrit: रु॒द्राः स॒ᳪसृज्य॑ पृथि॒वीं बृ॒हज्ज्योतिः॒ समी॑धिरे । तेषां॑ भा॒नुरज॑स्र॒ इच्छु॒क्रो दे॒वेषु॑ रोचते ॥
verses.transliteration: rudrāḥ saṃsṛjya pṛthivīṃ bṛhajjyotiḥ samīdhire | teṣāṃ bhānurajasra icchukro deveṣu rocate ||
verses.translation: The Rudras, having mixed the earth, set all aglow the lofty light. Bright and perpetual their light verily shines among the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: सᳪसृ॑ष्टा॒ वसु॑भी रुद्रै॒र्धीरैः॑ कर्म॒ण्या मृद॑म् । हस्ता॑भ्यां मृ॒द्वीं कृ॒त्वा सि॑नीवा॒ली कृ॑णोतु॒ ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: saṃsṛṣṭā vasubhī rudrairdhīraiḥ karmaṇyā mṛdam | hastābhyāṃ mṛdvīṃ kṛtvā sinīvālī kṛṇotu tām ||
verses.translation: The lump of clay that hath been mixed by Vasus, Rudras, by the wise, May Sinîvâlî with her hands soften and fit it for the work.

verses.sanskrit: सि॒नी॒वा॒ली सु॑कप॒र्दा सु॑कुरी॒रा स्वौ॑प॒शा । सा तुभ्य॑मदिते म॒ह्योखां द॑धातु॒ हस्त॑योः ॥
verses.transliteration: sinīvālī sukapardā sukurīrā svaupaśā | sā tubhyamadite mahyokhāṃ dadhātu hastayoḥ ||
verses.translation: May Sinîvâlî with fair braids, with beauteous crest, with lovely locks, May she, O mighty Aditi, bestow the Fire-pan in thy hands.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒खां कृ॑णोतु॒ शक्त्या॑ बा॒हुभ्या॒मदि॑तिर्धि॒या । मा॒ता पु॒त्रं यथो॒पस्थे॒ साऽग्निं बि॑भर्तु॒ गर्भ॒ आ । म॒खस्य॒ शिरो॑ऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: ukhāṃ kṛṇotu śaktyā bāhubhyāmaditirdhiyā | mātā putraṃ yathopasthe sā'gniṃ bibhartu garbha ā | makhasya śiro'si ||
verses.translation: Aditi shape the Fire-pan with her power, her arms, her intellect, And in her womb bear Agni as a mother, in her lap, her son.

verses.sanskrit:
वस॑वस्त्वा कृण्वन्तु गाय॒त्रेण॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वाऽसि॑ पृथि॒व्य॒सि धा॒रया॒ मयि॑ प्र॒जाᳪ रा॒यस्पोषं॑ गौप॒त्यᳪ सु॒वीर्य॑ᳪ सजा॒तान्यज॑मानाय रु॒द्रास्त्वा॑ कृण्वन्तु॒ त्रैष्टु॑भेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वाऽस्य॒न्तरि॑क्षमसि धा॒रया॒ मयि॑ प्र॒जाᳪ रा॒यस्पोषं॑ गौप॒त्यᳪ सु॒वीर्य॑ᳪ सजा॒तान्यज॑मानायादि॒त्यास्त्वा॑ कृण्वन्तु॒ जाग॑तेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वासि द्यौर॑सि धा॒रया॒ मयि॑ प्र॒जाᳪ रा॒यस्पोषं॑ गौप॒त्यᳪ सु॒वीर्य॑ᳪ
सजा॒तान्यज॑मानाय॒ विश्वे॑ त्वा दे॒वा वै॑श्वान॒राः कृ॑ण्व॒न्त्वानु॑ष्टुभेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्ध्रु॒वाऽसि॒ दिशो॑ऽसि धा॒रया॒ मयि॑ प्र॒जाᳪ रा॒यस्पोषं॑ गौप॒त्यᳪ सु॒वीर्य॑ᳪ सजा॒तान्यज॑मानाय ॥
verses.transliteration:
vasavastvā kṛṇvantu gāyatreṇa chandasā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā'si pṛthivyasi dhārayā mayi prajāṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatyaṃ suvīryaṃ sajātānyajamānāya rudrāstvā kṛṇvantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā'syantarikṣamasi dhārayā mayi prajāṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatyaṃ suvīryaṃ sajātānyajamānāyādityāstvā kṛṇvantu jāgatena chandasā'ṅgirasvaddhruvāsi dyaurasi dhārayā mayi prajāṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatyaṃ suvīryaṃ
sajātānyajamānāya viśve tvā devā vaiśvānarāḥ kṛṇvantvānuṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvaddhruvā'si diśo'si dhārayā mayi prajāṃ rāyaspoṣaṃ gaupatyaṃ suvīryaṃ sajātānyajamānāya ||
verses.translation: With Gâyatrî, like Angiras the Vasus form and fashion thee! Stedfast art then, thou art the Earth. Establish in me progeny, command of cattle, growth of wealth, kinsmen for me the worshipper. With Trishtup may the Rudras, like Angiras, form and fashion thee. Stedfast art thou, thou art the Air. Establish in me, etc., as above. With Jagatî, like Angiras, Âdityas form and fashion thee! Stedfast art thou, thou art the Sky. Establish in me, etc. Friends of all men, the All-Gods with Anushtup form thee Angiras-like. Stedfast art thou, thou art the Quarters. Establish in me, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
अदि॑त्यै॒ रास्ना॒स्यदि॑तिष्टे॒ बिलं॑ गृभ्णातु । कृ॒त्वाय॒ सा म॒हीमु॒खां मृ॒न्मयीं॒ योनि॑म॒ग्नये॑ ।
पु॒त्रेभ्यः॒ प्राय॑च्छ॒ददि॑तिः श्र॒पया॒निति॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
adityai rāsnāsyaditiṣṭe bilaṃ gṛbhṇātu | kṛtvāya sā mahīmukhāṃ mṛnmayīṃ yonimagnaye |
putrebhyaḥ prāyacchadaditiḥ śrapayāniti ||
verses.translation: The zone of Aditi art thou. Aditi seize thy hollow space. She, having made the great Fire-pan, a womb for Agni, formed of clay, Aditi, gave it to her Sons and, Let them bake it, were her words.

verses.sanskrit:
वस॑वस्त्वा धूपयन्तु गाय॒त्रेण॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्रुद्रास्त्वा॑ धूपयन्तु त्रैष्टुभेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वदादि॒त्यास्त्वा॑ धूपयन्तु॒ जाग॑तेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्विश्वे॑ त्वा दे॒वा वै॑श्वान॒रा धू॑पय॒न्त्वानु॑ष्टुभेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वदिन्द्र॑स्त्वा धूपयतु॒ वरु॑णस्त्वा धूपयतु॒ विष्णु॑स्त्वा
धूपयतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
vasavastvā dhūpayantu gāyatreṇa chandasā'ṅgirasvadrudrāstvā dhūpayantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvadādityāstvā dhūpayantu jāgatena chandasā'ṅgirasvadviśve tvā devā vaiśvānarā dhūpayantvānuṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvadindrastvā dhūpayatu varuṇastvā dhūpayatu viṣṇustvā
dhūpayatu ||
verses.translation: The Vasus make thee fragrant, as Angiras did, with Gâyatrî! The Rudras make thee fragrant with the Trishtup, as did Angiras! With Gâyatrî, like Angiras, may the Âdityas perfume thee. Dear to all men, may the All-Gods with the Anushtup sweeten thee, as Angiras was wont to do. May Indra make thee odorous. May Varuna make thee odorous. May Vishnu make thee odorous.

verses.sanskrit:
अदि॑तिष्ट्वा दे॒वी वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावती पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्थे॑ अङ्गिर॒स्वत् ख॑नत्ववट
दे॒वानां॑ त्वा॒ पत्नी॑र्दे॒वीर्वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावतीः पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्थे॑ अङ्गिर॒स्वद्द॑धतूखे
धि॒षणा॑स्त्वा दे॒वीर्वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावतीः पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्थे॑ अङ्गिर॒स्वद॒भी॒न्धतामुखे॒
वरू॑त्रीष्ट्वा दे॒वीर्वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावतीः पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्थे॑ अङ्गिर॒स्वच्छ्र॑पयन्तूखे॒
ग्नास्त्वा॑ दे॒वीर्वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावतीः पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्थे॑ अङ्गिर॒स्वत्प॑चन्तूखे॒
जन॑य॒स्त्वाच्छि॑न्नपत्रा दे॒वीर्वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावतीः पृथि॒व्याः स॒धस्थे॑ अङ्गिर॒स्वत्प॑चन्तूखे ॥
verses.transliteration:
aditiṣṭvā devī viśvadevyāvatī pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvat khanatvavaṭa
devānāṃ tvā patnīrdevīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvaddadhatūkhe
dhiṣaṇāstvā devīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvadabhīndhatāmukhe
varūtrīṣṭvā devīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvacchrapayantūkhe
gnāstvā devīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvatpacantūkhe
janayastvācchinnapatrā devīrviśvadevyāvatīḥ pṛthivyāḥ sadhasthe aṅgirasvatpacantūkhe ||
verses.translation: Pit! Angiras-like may Aditi the Goddess, beloved by all Gods, dig thee in Earth's bosom. Pan! Angiras-like may the Gods heavenly Consorts, dear to all Gads, in the Earth's bosom place thee. Pan! Angiras-like may Dhishanâs, Divine Ones, dear to alt Gods, in the Earth's bosom light thee. Pan! Angiras-like may the divine Varûtrîs, dear to all Gods, in the earth's bosom heat thee, Pan! Angiras-like may the celestial Ladies, dear to all Gods, in the earth's bosom bake thee. Angiras-like may the celestial Matrons, beloved by all the Gods, with unclipped pinions, within the lap of Earth, O Fire pan, bake thee.

verses.sanskrit: मि॒त्रस्य॑ चर्षणी॒धृतोऽवो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ सान॒सि । द्यु॒म्नं चि॒त्रश्र॑वस्तमम् ॥
verses.transliteration: mitrasya carṣaṇīdhṛto'vo devasya sānasi | dyumnaṃ citraśravastamam ||
verses.translation: The gainful grace of Mitra, God, supporter of the race of man, Is glorious, of most wondrous fame.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्त्वा॑ सवि॒तोद्व॑पतु सुपा॒णिः स्व॑ङ्गु॒रिः सु॑बा॒हुरु॒त शक्त्या॑ ।
अव्य॑थमाना पृथि॒व्यामाशा॒ दिश॒ आ पृ॑ण ॥
verses.transliteration:
devastvā savitodvapatu supāṇiḥ svaṅguriḥ subāhuruta śaktyā |
avyathamānā pṛthivyāmāśā diśa ā pṛṇa ||
verses.translation: With lovely arms, with lovely hands, with lovely fingers may the God Savitar make thee clean, yea, by the power be hath. Not trembling on the earth fill thou the regions, fill the Quarters full.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒त्थाय॑ बृह॒ती भ॒वोदु॑ तिष्ठ ध्रु॒वा त्वम् ।
मित्रै॒तां त॑ उ॒खां परि॑ ददा॒म्यभि॑त्त्या ए॒षा मा भे॑दि ॥
verses.transliteration:
utthāya bṛhatī bhavodu tiṣṭha dhruvā tvam |
mitraitāṃ ta ukhāṃ pari dadāmyabhittyā eṣā mā bhedi ||
verses.translation: Having arisen wax thou great, yea, stand thou up immovable. To thee, O Mitra, I entrust this Fire-pan for security. May it remain without a break.

verses.sanskrit: वस॑व॒स्त्वाऽऽछृ॑न्दन्तु गाय॒त्रेण॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्रुद्रास्त्वा॒ऽऽछृ॑न्दन्तु॒ त्रैष्टु॑भेन॒ छन्दसाऽङ्गिर॒स्वदा॑दि॒त्यास्त्वाऽऽछृ॑न्दन्तु॒ जाग॑तेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वद्विश्वे॑ त्वा दे॒वा वै॑श्वान॒रा आछृ॑न्द॒न्त्वानु॑ष्टुभेन॒ छन्द॑साऽङ्गिर॒स्वत् ॥
verses.transliteration: vasavastvā''chṛndantu gāyatreṇa chandasā'ṅgirasvadrudrāstvā''chṛndantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvadādityāstvā''chṛndantu jāgatena chandasā'ṅgirasvadviśve tvā devā vaiśvānarā āchṛndantvānuṣṭubhena chandasā'ṅgirasvat ||
verses.translation: Thee may the Vasus, Angiras-like, fill with the metre Gâyatrî. Thee may the Rudras, Angiras-like, fill with the Trishtup metre full. Thee may Âdityas, Angiras-like, fill with the metre Jagatî. With the Anushtup metre may the All-Gods, dear to all men, fill thee full, as Angiras was wont.

verses.sanskrit: आकू॑तिम॒ग्निं प्र॒युज॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ मनो॑ मे॒धाम॒ग्निं प्र॒युज॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ चि॒त्तं विज्ञा॑तम॒ग्निं प्र॒युज॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ वा॒चो विधृ॑तिम॒ग्निं प्र॒युज॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ मन॑वे॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽग्नये॑ वैश्वान॒राय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ākūtimagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā mano medhāmagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā cittaṃ vijñātamagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā vāco vidhṛtimagniṃ prayujaṃ svāhā prajāpataye manave svāhā 'gnaye vaiśvānarāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: Intention, Agni. Motive, Hail! Mind, Wisdom, Agni, Motive, Hail! Thought, Knowledge, Agni, Motive, Hail! Rule of Speech, Agni, Motive, Hail! To Manu Lord of creatures, Hail! To Agni dear to all men, Hail!

verses.sanskrit: विश्वो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ ने॒तुर्मर्तो॑ वुरीत स॒ख्यम् । विश्वो॑ रा॒य इ॑षुध्यति द्यु॒म्नं वृ॑णीत पु॒ष्यसे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: viśvo devasya neturmarto vurīta sakhyam | viśvo rāya iṣudhyati dyumnaṃ vṛṇīta puṣyase svāhā ||
verses.translation: May every mortal man elect the friendship of the guiding God. Each one solicits him for wealth: let him seek fame to prosper him. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: मा सु भि॑त्था॒ मा सु रि॒षोऽम्ब॑ धृ॒ष्णु वी॒रय॑स्व॒ सु । अ॒ग्निश्चे॒दं क॑रिष्यथः ॥
verses.transliteration: mā su bhitthā mā su riṣo'mba dhṛṣṇu vīrayasva su | agniścedaṃ kariṣyathaḥ ||
verses.translation: Break not, nor suffer any harm. Endure, O Mother, and be brave; This work will thou and Agni do.

verses.sanskrit:
दृᳪह॑स्व देवि पृथिवि स्व॒स्तय॑ आसु॒री मा॒या स्व॒धया॑ कृ॒तासि॑ ।
जुष्टं॑ दे॒वेभ्य॑ इ॒दम॑स्तु ह॒व्यमरि॑ष्टा॒ त्वमुदि॑हि य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dṛṃhasva devi pṛthivi svastaya āsurī māyā svadhayā kṛtāsi |
juṣṭaṃ devebhya idamastu havyamariṣṭā tvamudihi yajñe asmin ||
verses.translation: Be firm for weal, O Goddess Earth. Made in the wonted manner thou Art a celestial design. Acceptable to Gods he this oblation. Arise thou in this sacrifice uninjured.

verses.sanskrit: द्र्व॑न्नः स॒र्पिरा॑सुतिः प्र॒त्नो होता॒ वरे॑ण्यः । सह॑सस्पु॒त्रो अद्भु॑तः ॥
verses.transliteration: drvannaḥ sarpirāsutiḥ pratno hotā vareṇyaḥ | sahasasputro adbhutaḥ ||
verses.translation: Wood-fed, bedewed with sacred oil, ancient, Invoker, excellent, The Son of Strength, the Wonderful.

verses.sanskrit:
पर॑स्या॒ अधि॑ सं॒वतोऽव॑राँ२ अ॒भ्या त॑र ।
यत्रा॒हम॑स्मि॒ ताँ२ अ॑व ॥
verses.transliteration:
parasyā adhi saṃvato'varām̐ abhyā tara |
yatrāhamasmi tām̐ ava ||
verses.translation: Abandoning the foeman's host, pass hither to this company: Assist the men with whom I stand.

verses.sanskrit: प॒र॒मस्याः॑ परा॒वतो॑ रो॒हिद॑श्व इ॒हा ग॑हि । पु॒री॒ष्यः॒ पुरुप्रि॒योऽग्ने॒ त्वं त॑रा॒ मृधः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: paramasyāḥ parāvato rohidaśva ihā gahi | purīṣyaḥ purupriyo'gne tvaṃ tarā mṛdhaḥ ||
verses.translation: From the remotest distance come, Lord of the Red Steeds, hitherward. Do thou Purîshya, Agni, loved of many, overcome our foes.

verses.sanskrit: यद॑ग्ने॒ कानि॒ कानि॑ चि॒दा ते॒ दारू॑णि द॒ध्मसि॑ । सर्वं॒ तद॑स्तु ते घृ॒तं तज्जु॑षस्व यविष्ठ्य ॥
verses.transliteration: yadagne kāni kāni cidā te dārūṇi dadhmasi | sarvaṃ tadastu te ghṛtaṃ tajjuṣasva yaviṣṭhya ||
verses.translation: O Agni, whatsoever be the fuel that we lay on thee, May that he butter unto thee. Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.

verses.sanskrit: यदत्त्यु॑प॒जिह्वि॑का॒ यद्व॒म्रो अ॑ति॒सर्प॑ति । सर्वं॒ तद॑स्तु ते घृ॒तं तज्जु॒षस्व॑ यविष्ठ्य ॥
verses.transliteration: yadattyupajihvikā yadvamro atisarpati | sarvaṃ tadastu te ghṛtaṃ tajjuṣasva yaviṣṭhya ||
verses.translation: That which the termite eats away, that over which the emmet crawls— Butter be all of this to thee. Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God.

verses.sanskrit: अह॑रह॒रप्र॑यावं॒ भर॒न्तोऽश्वा॑येव॒ तिष्ठ॑ते घा॒सम॑स्मै । रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण॒ समि॒षा मद॒न्तोऽग्ने॒ मा ते॒ प्रति॑वेशा रिषाम ॥
verses.transliteration: aharaharaprayāvaṃ bharanto'śvāyeva tiṣṭhate ghāsamasmai | rāyaspoṣeṇa samiṣā madanto'gne mā te prativeśā riṣāma ||
