verses.translation: Bringing to him, with care unceasing, fodder day after day as to a stabled courser, Joying in food and in the growth of riches, may we thy neighbours, Agni, neer be injured.

verses.sanskrit:
नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्याः स॑मिधा॒ने अग्नौ रा॒यस्पोषा॑य बृह॒ते ह॑वामहे ।
इ॒र॒म्म॒दं बृ॒हदु॑क्थ्यं॒ यज॑त्रं॒ जेता॑रम॒ग्निं पृत॑नासु सास॒हिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
nābhā pṛthivyāḥ samidhāne agnau rāyaspoṣāya bṛhate havāmahe |
irammadaṃ bṛhadukthyaṃ yajatraṃ jetāramagniṃ pṛtanāsu sāsahim ||
verses.translation: While on earth's navel Agni is enkindled, we call, for ample increase of our riches, On Agni joying in the draught, much-lauded, worshipful; victor conquering in battle.

verses.sanskrit:
याः सेना॑ अ॒भीत्व॑रीराव्या॒धिनी॒रुग॑णा उ॒त ।
ये स्ते॒ना ये च॒ तस्क॑रा॒स्ताँस्ते॑ अ॒ग्नेऽपि॑ दधाम्या॒स्ये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāḥ senā abhītvarīrāvyādhinīrugaṇā uta |
ye stenā ye ca taskarāstām̐ste agne'pi dadhāmyāsye ||
verses.translation: Whatever hosts there are, fiercely assailant, charging in lengthened lines, drawn up in order, Whatever thieves there are, whatever robbers, all these I cast into thy mouth, O Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
दᳪष्ट्रा॑भ्यां म॒लिम्लू॒ञ्जम्भ्यै॒स्तस्क॑राँ२ उ॒त ।
हनु॑भ्याᳪ स्ते॒नान् भ॑गव॒स्ताँस्त्वं खा॑द॒ सुखा॑दितान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
daṃṣṭrābhyāṃ malimlūñjambhyaistaskarām̐ uta |
hanubhyāṃ stenān bhagavastām̐stvaṃ khāda sukhāditān ||
verses.translation: Devour the burglars with both tusks, destroy the robbers with thy teeth. With both thy jaws, thou Holy One, eat up those thieves well champed and chewed.

verses.sanskrit: ये जने॑षु म॒लिम्ल॑व स्ते॒नास॒स्तस्क॑रा॒ वने॑ । ये कक्षे॑ष्वघा॒यव॒स्ताँस्ते॑ दधामि॒ जम्भ॑योः ॥
verses.transliteration: ye janeṣu malimlava stenāsastaskarā vane | ye kakṣeṣvaghāyavastām̐ste dadhāmi jambhayoḥ ||
verses.translation: The burglars living among men, the thieves and robbers in the wood, Criminals lurking in their lairs, these do I lay between thy jaws.

verses.sanskrit: यो अ॒स्मभ्य॑मराती॒याद्यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष॑ते॒ जनः॑ । निन्दा॒द्यो अ॒स्मान्धिप्सा॑च्च॒ सर्वं॒ तं भ॑स्म॒सा कु॑रु ॥
verses.transliteration: yo asmabhyamarātīyādyaśca no dveṣate janaḥ | nindādyo asmāndhipsācca sarvaṃ taṃ bhasmasā kuru ||
verses.translation: Him who would seek to injure us, the man who looks oh us with hate Turn thou to ashes, and the man who slanders and would injure us.

verses.sanskrit: सᳪशि॑तं मे॒ ब्रह्म॒ सᳪशि॑तं वी॒र्यं बल॑म् । सᳪशि॑तं क्ष॒त्रं जि॒ष्णु यस्या॒हमस्मि॑ पु॒रोहि॑तः ॥
verses.transliteration: saṃśitaṃ me brahma saṃśitaṃ vīryaṃ balam | saṃśitaṃ kṣatraṃ jiṣṇu yasyāhamasmi purohitaḥ ||
verses.translation: Quickened is this my priestly rank, quickened is manly strength and force, Quickened is his victorious power of whom I am the Household priest.

verses.sanskrit: उदे॑षां बा॒हू अ॑तिर॒मुद्वर्चो॒ अथो॒ बल॑म् । क्षि॒णोमि॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ऽमित्रा॒नुन्न॑यामि॒ स्वाँ२ अ॒हम् ॥
verses.transliteration: udeṣāṃ bāhū atiramudvarco atho balam | kṣiṇomi brahmaṇā'mitrānunnayāmi svām̐ aham ||
verses.translation: The arms of these men have I raised, have raised their lustre and their strength With priestly power I ruin foes and lift my friends to high estate.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्न॑प॒तेऽन्न॑स्य नो देह्यनमी॒वस्य॑ शु॒ष्मिणः॑ ।
प्र-प्र॑ दा॒तारं॑ तारिष॒ ऊर्जं॑ नो धेहि द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे ॥
verses.transliteration:
annapate'nnasya no dehyanamīvasya śuṣmiṇaḥ |
pra-pra dātāraṃ tāriṣa ūrjaṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade ||
verses.translation: A share of food, O Lord of Food, vouchsafe us, invigorating food that brings no sickness. Onward, still onward lead the giver. Grant us maintenance both for quadruped and biped.

verses.sanskrit:
दृ॒शा॒नो रु॒क्म उ॒र्व्या व्य॑द्यौद् दु॒र्मर्ष॒मायुः॑ श्रि॒ये रु॑चा॒नः ।
अ॒ग्निर॒मृतो॑ अभव॒द्वयो॑भि॒र्यदे॑नं॒ द्यौरज॑नयत्सु॒रेताः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
dṛśāno rukma urvyā vyadyaud durmarṣamāyuḥ śriye rucānaḥ |
agniramṛto abhavadvayobhiryadenaṃ dyaurajanayatsuretāḥ ||
verses.translation: Far hath he shone abroad like gold to look on, beaming imperishable life for glory. Agni by vital powers became immortal when his prolific Father Dyaus begat him.

verses.sanskrit:
नक्तो॒षासा॒ सम॑नसा॒ विरू॑पे धा॒पये॑ते॒ शिशु॒मेक॑ᳪ समी॒ची ।
द्यावा॒क्षामा॑ रु॒क्मो अ॒न्तर्वि भा॑ति दे॒वा अ॒ग्निं धा॑रयन्द्रविणो॒दाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe dhāpayete śiśumekaṃ samīcī |
dyāvākṣāmā rukmo antarvi bhāti devā agniṃ dhārayandraviṇodāḥ ||
verses.translation: Night and Dawn, different in hue, accordant, meeting together, suckle one same infant. Golden between the heaven and earth he shineth. The wealth-possessing Gods supported Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॒ प्रति॑ मुञ्चते क॒विः प्रासा॑वीद्भ॒द्रं द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे ।
वि नाक॑मख्यत्सवि॒ता वरे॒ण्योऽनु॑ प्र॒याण॑मु॒षसो॒ वि रा॑जति ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvā rūpāṇi prati muñcate kaviḥ prāsāvīdbhadraṃ dvipade catuṣpade |
vi nākamakhyatsavitā vareṇyo'nu prayāṇamuṣaso vi rājati ||
verses.translation: The Sapient One arrays himself in every form: for quadruped and biped he hath brought forth good. Excellent Savitar hath looked on heaven's high vault: he shineth after the outgoings of the Dawn.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒प॒र्णो॒ऽसि ग॒रुत्माँ॑स्त्रि॒वृत्ते॒ शिरो॑ गाय॒त्रं चक्षु॑र्बृहद्रथन्त॒रे पक्षौ ।
स्तोम॑ आ॒त्मा छन्दा॒ᳪस्यङ्गा॑नि॒ यजूँ॑ᳪषि॒ नाम॑ । साम॑ ते त॒नूर्वा॑मदे॒व्यं य॑ज्ञाय॒ज्ञियं॒ पुच्छं॒ धिष्ण्याः॑ श॒पाः ।
सु॒प॒र्णो॒ऽसि ग॒रुत्मा॒न्दिवं॑ गच्छ॒ स्वः॑ पत ॥
verses.transliteration:
suparṇo'si garutmām̐strivṛtte śiro gāyatraṃ cakṣurbṛhadrathantare pakṣau |
stoma ātmā chandāṃsyaṅgāni yajūm̐ṃṣi nāma | sāma te tanūrvāmadevyaṃ yajñāyajñiyaṃ pucchaṃ dhiṣṇyāḥ śapāḥ |
suparṇo'si garutmāndivaṃ gaccha svaḥ pata ||
verses.translation: Thou art the goodly-pinioned Bird: thou hast the Trivrit for thy head. Gâyatra is thine eye, thy wings are Brihat and Rathantara. The hymn is self, the metres are his limbs, the formulas his name. The Vâmadevya Sâman is thy form, the Yajñâyajñiya thy tail, the fire-hearths are thy hooves. Thou art the goodly-pinioned Bird: go skyward, soar to heavenly light.

verses.sanskrit:
विष्णोः॒ क्रमो॑ऽसि सपत्न॒हा गा॑य॒त्रं छन्द॒ आ रो॑ह पृथि॒वीमनु॒ वि क्र॑मस्व॒
विष्णोः॒ क्रमो॑ऽस्यभिमाति॒हा त्रै॑ष्टुभं॒ छन्द॒ आ रो॑हा॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मनु॒ वि क्र॑मस्व
विष्णोः॒ क्रमो॑ऽस्यरातीय॒तो ह॒न्ता जाग॑तं॒ छन्द॒ आ रो॑ह॒ दिव॒मनु॒ वि क्र॑मस्व
विष्णोः॒ क्रमो॑ऽसि शत्रूय॒तो ह॒न्ताऽऽनु॑ष्टुभं॒ छन्द॒ आ रो॑ह॒ दिशोऽनु॒ वि क्र॑मस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
viṣṇoḥ kramo'si sapatnahā gāyatraṃ chanda ā roha pṛthivīmanu vi kramasva
viṣṇoḥ kramo'syabhimātihā traiṣṭubhaṃ chanda ā rohāntarikṣamanu vi kramasva
viṣṇoḥ kramo'syarātīyato hantā jāgataṃ chanda ā roha divamanu vi kramasva
viṣṇoḥ kramo'si śatrūyato hantā''nuṣṭubhaṃ chanda ā roha diśo'nu vi kramasva ||
verses.translation: Thou art the riyal-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Gâyatra metre: stride along the earth. Thou art the foe-destroying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Trishtup metre: stride along mid-air. Thou art the traitor-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount the Jagatî metre: stride along the sky. Thou art the foeman-slaying stride of Vishnu. Mount Anushtup metre: stride along the Quarters.

verses.sanskrit:
अक्र॑न्दद॒ग्नि स्त॒नय॑न्निव॒ द्यौः॒ क्षामा॒ रेरि॑हद्वी॒रुधः॑ सम॒ञ्जन् ।
स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो वि हीमि॒द्धो अख्य॒दा रोद॑सी भा॒नुना॑ भात्य॒न्तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
akrandadagni stanayanniva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihadvīrudhaḥ samañjan |
sadyo jajñāno vi hīmiddho akhyadā rodasī bhānunā bhātyantaḥ ||
verses.translation: Agni roared out like Dyaus what time he thunders: licking full oft the earth round plants he flickered. At once, when born, he looked about, enkindled: he shineth forth between the earth and heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॑ऽभ्यावर्तिन्न॒भि मा॒ नि व॑र्त॒स्वायु॑षा॒ वर्च॑सा प्र॒जया॒ धने॑न ।
स॒न्या मे॒धया॑ र॒य्या पोषे॑ण ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne'bhyāvartinnabhi mā ni vartasvāyuṣā varcasā prajayā dhanena |
sanyā medhayā rayyā poṣeṇa ||
verses.translation: Return to me, thou still-returning Agni, with life, with lustre, progeny, and treasure, With profit, wisdom, riches, and abundance.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॑ अङ्गिरः श॒तं ते॑ सन्त्वा॒वृतः॑ स॒हस्रं॑ त उपा॒वृतः॑ ।
अधा॒ पोष॑स्य॒ पोषे॑ण॒ पुन॑र्नो न॒ष्टमा कृ॑धि॒ पुन॑र्नो र॒यिमा कृ॑धि ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne aṅgiraḥ śataṃ te santvāvṛtaḥ sahasraṃ ta upāvṛtaḥ |
adhā poṣasya poṣeṇa punarno naṣṭamā kṛdhi punarno rayimā kṛdhi ||
verses.translation: A hundred, Agni Angiras! be thy ways, a thousand thy returns. With increment of increase bring thou back to us what we have lost. Again bring hitherward our wealth.

verses.sanskrit: पुन॑रू॒र्जा नि व॑र्तस्व॒ पुन॑रग्न इ॒षाऽऽयु॑षा । पुन॑र्नः पा॒ह्यᳪह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration: punarūrjā ni vartasva punaragna iṣā''yuṣā | punarnaḥ pāhyaṃhasaḥ ||
verses.translation: Return again with nourishment; Agni, again with food and life. Again preserve us from distress.

verses.sanskrit: स॒ह र॒य्या नि व॑र्त॒स्वाग्ने॒ पिन्व॑स्व॒ धार॑या । वि॒श्वप्स्न्या॑ वि॒श्वत॒स्परि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: saha rayyā ni vartasvāgne pinvasva dhārayā | viśvapsnyā viśvataspari ||
verses.translation: Agni, return with store of wealth. Swell with thine overflowing stream that feedeth all on every side.

verses.sanskrit: आ त्वा॑ऽहार्षम॒न्तर॑भूर्ध्रु॒वस्ति॒ष्ठावि॑चाचलिः । विश॑स्त्वा॒ सर्वा॑ वाञ्छन्तु॒ मा त्वद्रा॒ष्ट्रमधि॑भ्रशत् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā tvā'hārṣamantarabhūrdhruvastiṣṭhāvicācaliḥ | viśastvā sarvā vāñchantu mā tvadrāṣṭramadhibhraśat ||
verses.translation: I brought thee: thou hast entered in. Stand stedfast and immovable. Lot all the people long for thee. Let not thy kingship fall away.

verses.sanskrit:
उदु॑त्त॒मं व॑रुण॒ पाश॑म॒स्मदवा॑ध॒मं वि म॑ध्य॒मᳪ श्र॑थाय ।
अथा॑ व॒यमा॑दित्य व्र॒ते तवाना॑गसो॒ अदि॑तये स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration:
uduttamaṃ varuṇa pāśamasmadavādhamaṃ vi madhyamaṃ śrathāya |
athā vayamāditya vrate tavānāgaso aditaye syāma ||
verses.translation: Varuna, from the upmost bond release us, let down the lowest and remove the midmost. So in thy holy law may we made sinless belong to Aditi, O thou Âditya.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्रे॑ बृ॒हन्नु॒षसा॑मू॒र्ध्वो अ॑स्थान्निर्जग॒न्वान् तम॑सो॒ ज्योति॒षाऽऽगा॑त् ।
अ॒ग्निर्भा॒नुना॒ रुश॑ता॒ स्वङ्ग॒ आ जा॒तो विश्वा॒ सद्मा॑न्यप्राः ॥
verses.transliteration:
agre bṛhannuṣasāmūrdhvo asthānnirjaganvān tamaso jyotiṣā''gāt |
agnirbhānunā ruśatā svaṅga ā jāto viśvā sadmānyaprāḥ ||
verses.translation: High hath the Mighty risen before the Mornings, and come to us with light from out the darkness. Fair-shapen Agni with white-shining splendour hath filled at birth all human habitations.

verses.sanskrit:
ह॒ᳪसः शु॑चि॒षद्वसु॑रन्तरिक्ष॒सद्धोता॑ वेदि॒षदति॑थिर्दूरोण॒सत् ।
नृ॒षद्व॑र॒सदृ॑त॒सद् व्योम॒सद॒ब्जा गो॒जा ऋ॑त॒जा अ॑द्रि॒जा ऋ॒तं बृ॒हत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
haṃsaḥ śuciṣadvasurantarikṣasaddhotā vediṣadatithirdūroṇasat |
nṛṣadvarasadṛtasad vyomasadabjā gojā ṛtajā adrijā ṛtaṃ bṛhat ||
verses.translation: The Hamsa homed in light, the Vasu in mid-air, the Priest beside the altar, Guest within the house, Dweller in noblest place, mid men, in truth, in sky, born of flood, kine, truth, mountain, he is holy Law. The Great.

verses.sanskrit:
सीद॒ त्वं मा॒तुर॒स्या उ॒पस्थे॒ विश्वा॑न्यग्ने व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् ।
मै॑नां॒ तप॑सा॒ मार्चिषा॒ऽभि शो॑चीर॒न्तर॑स्याᳪ शु॒क्रज्यो॑ति॒र्वि भा॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration:
sīda tvaṃ māturasyā upasthe viśvānyagne vayunāni vidvān |
maināṃ tapasā mārciṣā'bhi śocīrantarasyāṃ śukrajyotirvi bhāhi ||
verses.translation: Knowing all holy ordinances, Agni, be seated in the lap of this thy mother. Do not with heat or glowing flame consume her: shine thou within her with refulgent lustre.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒न्तर॑ग्ने रु॒चा त्वमु॒खायाः॒ सद॑ने॒ स्वे । तस्या॒स्त्वᳪ हर॑सा॒ तप॒ञ्जात॑वेदः शि॒वो भ॑व ॥
verses.transliteration: antaragne rucā tvamukhāyāḥ sadane sve | tasyāstvaṃ harasā tapañjātavedaḥ śivo bhava ||
verses.translation: Within this Fire-pan with thy light, O Agni, in thy proper seat, Glowing with warmth, be gracious thou, O Jâtavedas, unto her.

verses.sanskrit:
शि॒वो भू॒त्वा मह्य॑मग्ने॒ अथो॑ सीद शि॒वस्त्वम् ।
शि॒वाः कृ॒त्वा दिशः॒ सर्वाः॒ स्वं योनि॑मि॒हास॑दः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śivo bhūtvā mahyamagne atho sīda śivastvam |
śivāḥ kṛtvā diśaḥ sarvāḥ svaṃ yonimihāsadaḥ ||
verses.translation: Being propitious unto me, O Agni, sit propitiously. Having made all the regions blest, in thine own dwelling seat thyself.

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒वस्परि॑ प्रथ॒मं ज॑ज्ञे अ॒ग्निर॒स्मद् द्वि॒तीयं॒ परि॑ जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
तृ॒तीय॑म॒प्सु नृ॒मणा॒ अज॑स्र॒मिन्धा॑न एनं जरते स्वा॒धीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
divaspari prathamaṃ jajñe agnirasmad dvitīyaṃ pari jātavedāḥ |
tṛtīyamapsu nṛmaṇā ajasramindhāna enaṃ jarate svādhīḥ ||
verses.translation: First Agni sprang to life from out of heaven, the second time from us came Jâtavedas. Thirdly the Manly-souled was in the waters. The pious lauds and kindles him Eternal.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒द्मा ते॑ अग्ने त्रे॒धा त्र॒याणि॑ वि॒द्मा ते॒ धाम॒ विभृ॑ता पुरु॒त्रा ।
वि॒द्मा ते॒ नाम॑ पर॒मं गुहा॒ यद्वि॒द्मा तमुत्सं॒ यत॑ आज॒गन्थ॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vidmā te agne tredhā trayāṇi vidmā te dhāma vibhṛtā purutrā |
vidmā te nāma paramaṃ guhā yadvidmā tamutsaṃ yata ājagantha ||
verses.translation: Agni, we know thy three powers in three stations, we know thy forms in many a place divided. We know what name supreme thou hast in secret: we know the source from which thou hast proceeded.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒मु॒द्रे त्वा॑ नृ॒मणा॑ अ॒प्स्वन्तर्नृ॒चक्षा॑ ईधे दि॒वो अ॑ग्न॒ ऊध॑न् ।
तृ॒तीये॑ त्वा॒ रज॑सि तस्थि॒वाᳪस॑म॒पामु॒पस्थे॑ महि॒षा अ॑वर्धन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
samudre tvā nṛmaṇā apsvantarnṛcakṣā īdhe divo agna ūdhan |
tṛtīye tvā rajasi tasthivāṃsamapāmupasthe mahiṣā avardhan ||
verses.translation: The Manly-souled lit thee in sea and waters, Man's Viewer lit thee in the breast of heaven. There as thou stoodest in the third high region the Bulls increased thee in the waters bosom.

verses.sanskrit:
अक्र॑न्दद॒ग्नि स्त॒नय॑न्निव॒ द्यौः क्षामा॒ रेरि॑हद्वी॒रुधः॑ सम॒ञ्जन् ।
स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो वि हीमि॒द्धो अख्य॒दा रोद॑सी भा॒नुना॑ भात्य॒न्तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
akrandadagni stanayanniva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihadvīrudhaḥ samañjan |
sadyo jajñāno vi hīmiddho akhyadā rodasī bhānunā bhātyantaḥ ||
verses.translation: Agni roared out, etc. (verse 6 repeated).

verses.sanskrit:
श्री॒णामु॑दा॒रो ध॒रुणो॑ रयी॒णां म॑नी॒षाणां॒ प्रार्प॑णः॒ सोम॑गोपाः ।
वसुः॑ सू॒नुः सह॑सो अ॒प्सु राजा॒ वि भा॒त्यग्र॑ उ॒षसा॑मिधा॒नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrīṇāmudāro dharuṇo rayīṇāṃ manīṣāṇāṃ prārpaṇaḥ somagopāḥ |
vasuḥ sūnuḥ sahaso apsu rājā vi bhātyagra uṣasāmidhānaḥ ||
verses.translation: The spring of glories and support of riches, rouser of thoughts and guardian of the Soma, Good Son of Strength, a King amid the waters, in forefront of the Dawns he shines enkindled.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्व॑स्य के॒तुर्भुव॑नस्य॒ गर्भ॒ आ रोद॑सी अपृणा॒ज्जाय॑मानः ।
वी॒डुं चि॒दद्रि॑मभिनत् परा॒यञ्जना॒ यद॒ग्निमय॑जन्त॒ पञ्च॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvasya keturbhuvanasya garbha ā rodasī apṛṇājjāyamānaḥ |
vīḍuṃ cidadrimabhinat parāyañjanā yadagnimayajanta pañca ||
verses.translation: Germ of the world, ensign of all creation, he sprang to life and filled the earth and heaven. Even the firm rock he cleft when passing over, when the Five Tribes brought sacrifice to Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒शिक्पा॑व॒को अ॑र॒तिः सु॑मे॒धा मर्त्ये॑ष्व॒ग्निर॒मृतो॒ नि धा॑यि ।
इय॑र्ति धू॒मम॑रु॒षं भरि॑भ्र॒दुच्छु॒क्रेण॑ शो॒चिषा॒ द्यामिन॑क्षन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
uśikpāvako aratiḥ sumedhā martyeṣvagniramṛto ni dhāyi |
iyarti dhūmamaruṣaṃ bharibhraducchukreṇa śociṣā dyāminakṣan ||
verses.translation: So among mortals was immortal Agni stablished as cleansing, wise, and eager envoy. He waves the red smoke that he lifts above him, striving to reach the heaven with radiant lustre.

verses.sanskrit:
दृ॒शा॒नो रु॒क्म उ॒र्व्या व्य॑द्यौद्दु॒र्मर्ष॒मायुः॑ श्रि॒ये रु॑चा॒नः ।
अ॒ग्निर॒मृतो॑ अभव॒द्वयो॑भि॒र्यदे॑नं द्यौरज॑नय॑त्सु॒रेताः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
dṛśāno rukma urvyā vyadyauddurmarṣamāyuḥ śriye rucānaḥ |
agniramṛto abhavadvayobhiryadenaṃ dyaurajanayatsuretāḥ ||
verses.translation: Far hath he shone, etc. (verse 1 repeated).

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॑ अ॒द्य कृ॒णव॑द्भद्रशोचेऽपू॒पं दे॑व घृ॒तव॑न्तमग्ने ।
प्र तं न॑य प्रत॒रं वस्यो॒ अच्छा॒भि सु॒म्नं दे॒वभ॑क्तं यविष्ठ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaste adya kṛṇavadbhadraśoce'pūpaṃ deva ghṛtavantamagne |
pra taṃ naya prataraṃ vasyo acchābhi sumnaṃ devabhaktaṃ yaviṣṭha ||
verses.translation: Whoso this day, O God whose flames are lovely, makes thee a cake, O Agni, mixed with butter, Lead thou and further him to higher fortune, to bliss bestowed by Gods, O thou Most Youthful.

verses.sanskrit:
आ तं भ॑ज सौश्रव॒सेष्व॑ग्न उ॒क्थ उ॑क्थ॒ आ भ॑ज श॒स्यमा॑ने ।
प्रि॒यः सूर्ये॑ प्रि॒यो अ॒ग्ना भ॑वा॒त्युज्जा॒तेन॑ भि॒नद॒दुज्जनि॑त्वैः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā taṃ bhaja sauśravaseṣvagna uktha uktha ā bhaja śasyamāne |
priyaḥ sūrye priyo agnā bhavātyujjātena bhinadadujjanitvaiḥ ||
verses.translation: Endow him, Agni, with a share of glory, at every, song of praise sung forth enrich him. Dear let him be to Sûrya, dear to Agni, preëminent with son and children's children.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वाम॑ग्ने॒ यज॑माना॒ अनु॒ द्यून् विश्वा॒ वसु॑ दधिरे॒ वार्या॑णि ।
त्वया॑ स॒ह द्रवि॑णमि॒च्छमा॑ना व्र॒जं गोम॑न्तमु॒शिजो॒ वि व॑व्रुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvāmagne yajamānā anu dyūn viśvā vasu dadhire vāryāṇi |
tvayā saha draviṇamicchamānā vrajaṃ gomantamuśijo vi vavruḥ ||
verses.translation: While, Agni, day by day men pay thee worship they win themselves all treasures worth the wishing. Allied with thee, eager and craving riches, they have disclosed the stable filled with cattle.

verses.sanskrit:
अस्ता॑व्य॒ग्निर्न॒राᳪ सु॒शेवो॑ वैश्वान॒र ऋषि॑भिः॒ सोम॑गोपाः ।
अ॒द्वे॒षे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी हु॑वेम॒ देवा॑ ध॒त्त र॒यिम॒स्मे सु॒वीर॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
astāvyagnirnarāṃ suśevo vaiśvānara ṛṣibhiḥ somagopāḥ |
adveṣe dyāvāpṛthivī huvema devā dhatta rayimasme suvīram ||
verses.translation: Agni, man's gracious Friend, the Soma's keeper, Vaisvânara, hath been lauded by the Rishis. We will invoke benignant Earth and Heaven: ye Deities, give us wealth with hero children.

verses.sanskrit: स॒मिधा॒ऽग्निं दु॑वस्यत घृ॒तैर्बो॑धय॒ताति॑थिम् । आऽस्मि॑न् हव्या जु॑होतन ॥
verses.transliteration: samidhā'gniṃ duvasyata ghṛtairbodhayatātithim | ā'smin havyā juhotana ||
verses.translation: Pay service unto Agni with your fuel, rouse your Guest with oil: In him present your offerings.

verses.sanskrit: उदु॑ त्वा॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अग्ने॒ भर॑न्तु॒ चित्ति॑भिः । स नो॑ भव शि॒वस्त्वᳪ सु॒प्रती॑को वि॒भाव॑सुः ॥
verses.transliteration: udu tvā viśve devā agne bharantu cittibhiḥ | sa no bhava śivastvaṃ supratīko vibhāvasuḥ ||
verses.translation: May all the Gods, O Agni, bear thee upward with their earnest thoughts: Not to be looked on, rich in light, be thou propitious unto us,

verses.sanskrit:
प्रेद॑ग्ने॒ ज्योति॑ष्मान् याहि शि॒वेभि॑र॒र्चिभि॒ष्ट्वम् ।
बृ॒हद्भि॑र्भा॒नुभि॒र्भास॒न्मा हि॑ᳪसीस्त॒न्वा॒ प्र॒जाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
predagne jyotiṣmān yāhi śivebhirarcibhiṣṭvam |
bṛhadbhirbhānubhirbhāsanmā hiṃsīstanvā prajāḥ ||
verses.translation: Agni, go forth resplendent, thou with thine auspicious flames of fire. Shining with mighty beams of light harm not my people with thy form.

verses.sanskrit:
अक्र॑न्दद॒ग्नि स्त॒नय॑न्निव॒ द्यौः क्षामा॒ रेरि॑हद्वी॒रुधः॑ सम॒ञ्जन् ।
स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो वि हीमि॒द्धो अख्य॒दा रोद॑सी भा॒नुना॑ भात्य॒न्तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
akrandadagni stanayanniva dyauḥ kṣāmā rerihadvīrudhaḥ samañjan |
sadyo jajñāno vi hīmiddho akhyadā rodasī bhānunā bhātyantaḥ ||
verses.translation: Agni roared out, etc. (verse 21 repeated.)

verses.sanskrit:
प्र-प्रा॒यम॒ग्निर्भ॑र॒तस्य॑ शृण्वे॒ वि यत्सूर्यो॒ न रोच॑ते बृ॒हद्भाः ।
अ॒भि यः पू॒रुं पृत॑नासु त॒स्थौ दी॒दाय दैव्यो॒ अति॑थिः शि॒वो नः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra-prāyamagnirbharatasya śṛṇve vi yatsūryo na rocate bṛhadbhāḥ |
abhi yaḥ pūruṃ pṛtanāsu tasthau dīdāya daivyo atithiḥ śivo naḥ ||
verses.translation: Far famed is this the Bharata's own Agni: he shineth like the Sun with lofty splendour. He who hath vanquished Pûru in the battle, the heavenly Guest hath shone for us benignly.

verses.sanskrit:
आपो॑ देवीः॒ प्रति॑ गृभ्णीत॒ भस्मै॒तत्स्यो॒ने कृ॑णुध्वᳪ सुर॒भा उ॑ लो॒के ।
तस्मै॑ नमन्तां॒ जन॑यः सु॒पत्नी॑र्मा॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रं बि॑भृता॒प्स्वे॒नत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āpo devīḥ prati gṛbhṇīta bhasmaitatsyone kṛṇudhvaṃ surabhā u loke |
tasmai namantāṃ janayaḥ supatnīrmāteva putraṃ bibhṛtāpsvenat ||
verses.translation: Receive these ashes, ye celestial Waters, and lay them in a fair place full of fragrance. To him bow down the nobly-wedded Matrons! Bear this on waters as her son a mother.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒प्स्व॒ग्ने॒ सधि॒ष्टव॒ सौष॑धी॒रनु॑ रुध्यसे । गर्भे॒ सञ्जा॑यसे॒ पुनः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: apsvagne sadhiṣṭava sauṣadhīranu rudhyase | garbhe sañjāyase punaḥ ||
verses.translation: Agni, thy home is in the floods: into the plants thou forcest way, And as their child art born anew.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भो॑ अ॒स्योष॑धीनां॒ गर्भो॒ वन॒स्पती॑नाम् । गर्भो॒ विश्व॑स्य भू॒तस्याग्ने॒ गर्भो॑ अ॒पाम॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration: garbho asyoṣadhīnāṃ garbho vanaspatīnām | garbho viśvasya bhūtasyāgne garbho apāmasi ||
verses.translation: Thou art the offspring of the plants, thou art the offspring of the trees: The offspring thou of all that is, thou, Agni, art the Waters Child,

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒सद्य॒ भस्म॑ना॒ योनि॑म॒पश्च॑ पृथि॒वीम॑ग्ने । स॒ᳪसृज्य॑ मा॒तृभि॒ष्ट्वं ज्योति॑ष्मा॒न् पुन॒रा ऽस॑दः ॥
verses.transliteration: prasadya bhasmanā yonimapaśca pṛthivīmagne | saṃsṛjya mātṛbhiṣṭvaṃ jyotiṣmān punarā 'sadaḥ ||
verses.translation: With ashes having reached the womb, the waters, Agni and the earth, United with the mothers, thou blazing hast seated thee again.

verses.sanskrit: पुन॑रा॒सद्य॒ सद॑नम॒पश्च॑ पृथि॒वीम॑ग्ने । शेषे॑ मा॒तुर्यथो॒पस्थे॒ऽन्तर॑स्याᳪ शि॒वत॑मः ॥
verses.transliteration: punarāsadya sadanamapaśca pṛthivīmagne | śeṣe māturyathopasthe'ntarasyāṃ śivatamaḥ ||
verses.translation: Seated again upon thy seat, the waters, Agni! and the earth, In her, thou, most auspicious One, liest as in a mother's lap

verses.sanskrit: पुन॑रू॒र्जा नि व॑र्तस्व॒ पुन॑रग्न इ॒षाऽऽयु॑षा । पुन॑र्नः पा॒ह्यᳪह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration: punarūrjā ni vartasva punaragna iṣā''yuṣā | punarnaḥ pāhyaṃhasaḥ ||
verses.translation: Return again, etc. Agni, return, etc. (verses 9 and 10 repeated).

verses.sanskrit: स॒ह र॒य्या नि व॑र्त॒स्वाग्ने॒ पिन्व॑स्व॒ धार॑या । वि॒श्वप्स्न्या॑ वि॒श्वत॒स्परि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: saha rayyā ni vartasvāgne pinvasva dhārayā | viśvapsnyā viśvataspari ||
verses.hindi: हे अग्नि, धन के साथ लौट आओ। सब ओर से सबका पोषण करने वाली धारा से (हमें) भर दो।
verses.translation: Agni, return with wealth. Fill us on every side with your all-nourishing stream.

verses.sanskrit:
बोधा॑ मे अ॒स्य वच॑सो यविष्ठ॒ मᳪहि॑ष्ठस्य॒ प्रभृ॑तस्य स्वधावः ।
पीय॑ति त्वो॒ अनु॑ त्वो गृणाति व॒न्दारु॑ष्टे त॒न्वं॒ वन्दे अग्ने ॥
verses.transliteration:
bodhā me asya vacaso yaviṣṭha maṃhiṣṭhasya prabhṛtasya svadhāvaḥ |
pīyati tvo anu tvo gṛṇāti vandāruṣṭe tanvaṃ vande agne ||
verses.translation: Mark this my speech, Divine One, thou Most Youthful, offered to thee by him who gives most freely: One hates thee, and another sings thy praises. I thine adorer laud thy form, O Agni.

verses.sanskrit: स बो॑धि सू॒रिर्म॒घवा॒ वसु॑पते॒ वसु॑दावन् । यु॒यो॒ध्यस्मद् द्वेषा॑ᳪसि वि॒श्वक॑र्मणे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa bodhi sūrirmaghavā vasupate vasudāvan | yuyodhyasmad dveṣāṃsi viśvakarmaṇe svāhā ||
verses.translation: Be thou for us a liberal Prince, Giver and Lord of precious things. Drive those who hate us far away. To the Omnific One All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
पुन॑स्त्वाऽऽदि॒त्या रु॒द्रा वस॑वः॒ समि॑न्धतां॒ पुन॑र्ब्र॒ह्माणो॑ वसुनीथ य॒ज्ञैः ।
घृ॒तेन॒ त्वं त॒न्वं॒ वर्धयस्व स॒त्याः स॑न्तु॒ यज॑मानस्य॒ कामाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
punastvā''dityā rudrā vasavaḥ samindhatāṃ punarbrahmāṇo vasunītha yajñaiḥ |
ghṛtena tvaṃ tanvaṃ vardhayasva satyāḥ santu yajamānasya kāmāḥ ||
verses.translation: Again let the Âdityas, Rudras, Yams, and Brahmans with their rites light thee, Wealth-bringer! Increase thy body with presented butter: effectual be the Sacrificer's wishes.

verses.sanskrit:
अपे॑त॒ वी॒त॒ वि च॑ सर्प॒तातो॒ येऽत्र॒ स्थ पु॑रा॒णा ये च॒ नूत॑नाः ।
अदा॑द्य॒मो॒ऽव॒सानं॑ पृथि॒व्या अक्र॑न्नि॒मं पि॒तरो॑ लो॒कम॑स्मै ॥
verses.transliteration:
apeta vīta vi ca sarpatāto ye'tra stha purāṇā ye ca nūtanāḥ |
adādyamo'vasānaṃ pṛthivyā akrannimaṃ pitaro lokamasmai ||
verses.translation: Go hence, depart, creep off in all directions, both ancient visitors and recent comers: Yama hath given a place on earth to rest in. This place for him the Fathers have provided.

verses.sanskrit:
सं॒ज्ञान॑मसि काम॒धर॑णं॒ मयि॑ ते काम॒धर॑णं भूयात् ।
अ॒ग्नेर्भस्मा॑स्य॒ग्नेः पुरी॑षमसि॒ । चित॑ स्थ परि॒चित॑ ऊर्ध्व॒चितः॑ श्रयध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃjñānamasi kāmadharaṇaṃ mayi te kāmadharaṇaṃ bhūyāt |
agnerbhasmāsyagneḥ purīṣamasi | cita stha paricita ūrdhvacitaḥ śrayadhvam ||
verses.translation: Knowledge art thou: accomplishment of wishes. In me be the fulfilment of thy wishes. Thou art the ashes, thou the mould of Agni. Rankers are ye, rankers around. Rankers right upward, be ye fixed.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यᳪ सो अ॒ग्निर्यस्मि॒न्त्सोम॒मिन्द्रः॑ सु॒तं द॒धे ज॒ठरे॑ वावशा॒नः ।
स॒ह॒स्रियं॒ वाज॒मत्यं॒ न सप्ति॑ᳪ सस॒वान्त्सन्त्स्तू॑यसे जातवेदः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayaṃ so agniryasmintsomamindraḥ sutaṃ dadhe jaṭhare vāvaśānaḥ |
sahasriyaṃ vājamatyaṃ na saptiṃ sasavāntsantstūyase jātavedaḥ ||
verses.translation: This is that Agni where the longing Indra took the pressed Soma deep within his body. Winner of spoils in thousands like a courser, with prayer art thou exalted, Jâtavedas.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ यत्ते॑ दि॒वि वर्चः॑ पृथि॒व्यां यदोष॑धीष्व॒प्स्वा य॑जत्र ।
येना॒न्तरि॑क्षमु॒र्वा॑त॒तन्थ॑ त्वे॒षः स भा॒नुर॑र्ण॒वो नृ॒चक्षाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne yatte divi varcaḥ pṛthivyāṃ yadoṣadhīṣvapsvā yajatra |
yenāntarikṣamurvātatantha tveṣaḥ sa bhānurarṇavo nṛcakṣāḥ ||
verses.translation: The splendour which is thine in heaven, O Agni, in earth, O Holy One, in plants, in waters, Wherewith thou hast oerspread mid-air's broad region, that light is brilliant, billowy, man-surveying.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॑ दि॒वो अर्ण॒मच्छा॑ जिगा॒स्यच्छा॑ दे॒वाँ२ ऊ॑चिषे॒ धिष्ण्या॒ ये ।
या रो॑च॒ने प॒रस्ता॒त् सूर्य॑स्य॒ याश्चा॒वस्ता॑दुप॒तिष्ठ॑न्त॒ आपः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne divo arṇamacchā jigāsyacchā devām̐ ūciṣe dhiṣṇyā ye |
yā rocane parastāt sūryasya yāścāvastādupatiṣṭhanta āpaḥ ||
verses.translation: O Agni, to the flood of heaven thou mountest, thou tallest hither Gods, the thought-inspirers. The waters, those beyond the light of Sûrya, and those that are beneath it here, approach thee.

verses.sanskrit: पु॒री॒ष्या॒सो अ॒ग्नयः॑ प्राव॒णेभिः॑ स॒जोष॑सः । जु॒षन्तां॑ य॒ज्ञम॒द्रुहो॑ऽनमी॒वा इषो॑ म॒हीः ॥
verses.transliteration: purīṣyāso agnayaḥ prāvaṇebhiḥ sajoṣasaḥ | juṣantāṃ yajñamadruho'namīvā iṣo mahīḥ ||
verses.translation: May the Purîshya Agnis in accord with those that spring from floods, May they, benevolent, accept the sacrifice, full, wholesome draughts.

verses.sanskrit:
इडा॑मग्ने पुरु॒दᳪस॑ᳪ स॒निं गोः श॑श्वत्त॒मᳪ हव॑मानाय साध ।
स्यान्नः॑ सू॒नुस्तन॑यो वि॒जावाग्ने॒ सा ते॑ सुम॒तिर्भू॑त्व॒स्मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
iḍāmagne purudaṃsaṃ saniṃ goḥ śaśvattamaṃ havamānāya sādha |
syānnaḥ sūnustanayo vijāvāgne sā te sumatirbhūtvasme ||
verses.translation: As holy food, Agni, to thine invoker give wealth in cattle, lasting, rich in marvels. To us be born a son and spreading offspring. Agni, be this thy gracious will to us-ward.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒यं ते॒ योनि॑रृ॒त्वियो॒ यतो॑ जा॒तो अरो॑चथाः । तं जा॒नन्न॑ग्न॒ आ रो॒हाथा॑ नो वर्धया र॒यिम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ayaṃ te yonirṛtviyo yato jāto arocathāḥ | taṃ jānannagna ā rohāthā no vardhayā rayim ||
verses.translation: This is thine ordered place of birth whence, sprung to life, thou shonest forth. Knowing this, Agni, mount on high and cause our riches to increase.

verses.sanskrit: चिद॑सि॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वा सी॑द प॑रि॒चिद॑सि॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वा सी॑द ॥
verses.transliteration: cidasi tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda paricidasi tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda ||
verses.translation: Ranker art thou: Angiras-like sit steady with that Deity. Ranker-round art thou: Angiras-like sit steady with that Deity.

verses.sanskrit: लो॒कं पृ॑ण छि॒द्रं पृ॒णाथो॑ सीद ध्रु॒वा त्वम् । इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी त्वा॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र॒स्मिन् योना॑वसीषदन् ॥
verses.transliteration: lokaṃ pṛṇa chidraṃ pṛṇātho sīda dhruvā tvam | indrāgnī tvā bṛhaspatirasmin yonāvasīṣadan ||
verses.translation: Fill up the room, supply the void, then settle steady in thy place. Indr-Âgni and Brihaspati have set thee down in this abode.

verses.sanskrit: ता अ॑स्य॒ सूद॑दोहसः॒ सोम॑ श्रीणन्ति॒ पृश्न॑यः । जन्म॑न्दे॒वानां॒ विश॑स्त्रि॒ष्वा रो॑च॒ने दि॒वः ॥
verses.transliteration: tā asya sūdadohasaḥ soma śrīṇanti pṛśnayaḥ | janmandevānāṃ viśastriṣvā rocane divaḥ ||
verses.translation: The dappled kine who stream with milk prepare his draught of Soma juice— Clans in the birthplace of the Gods, in the three luminous realms of heaven.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रं॒ विश्वा॑ अवीवृधन्त्समु॒द्रव्य॑चसं॒ गिरः॑ । र॒थीत॑मᳪ र॒थीनां॒ वाजा॑ना॒ᳪ सत्प॑तिं॒ पति॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhantsamudravyacasaṃ giraḥ | rathītamaṃ rathīnāṃ vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim ||
verses.translation: All sacred songs have magnified Indra expansive as the sea, The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the very Lord of Strength.

verses.sanskrit: समि॑तᳪ सं क॑ल्पेथा॒ᳪ संप्रि॑यौ रोचि॒ष्णू सु॑मन॒स्यमा॑नौ । इष॒मूर्ज॑म॒भि सं॒वसा॑नौ ॥
verses.transliteration: samitaṃ saṃ kalpethāṃ saṃpriyau rociṣṇū sumanasyamānau | iṣamūrjamabhi saṃvasānau ||
verses.translation: Combine ye two and harmonize together, dear to each other, brilliant, friendly-minded, Abiding in one place for food and vigour.

verses.sanskrit:
सं वां॒ मना॑ᳪसि॒ सं व्र॒ता समु॑ चि॒त्तान्याक॑रम् ।
अग्ने॑ पुरीष्याधि॒पा भ॑व॒ त्वं न॒ इष॒मूर्जं॒ यज॑मानाय धेहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ vāṃ manāṃsi saṃ vratā samu cittānyākaram |
agne purīṣyādhipā bhava tvaṃ na iṣamūrjaṃ yajamānāya dhehi ||
verses.translation: Together have I brought your minds, your ordinances, and your thoughts. Be thou our Sovran Lord, Agni Purîshya; give food and vigour to the Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ त्वं पु॑री॒ष्यो॒ रयि॒मान् पु॑ष्टि॒माँ२ अ॑सि । शि॒वाः कृ॒त्वा दिशः॒ सर्वाः॒ स्वं योनि॑मि॒हाऽस॑दः ॥
verses.transliteration: agne tvaṃ purīṣyo rayimān puṣṭimām̐ asi | śivāḥ kṛtvā diśaḥ sarvāḥ svaṃ yonimihā'sadaḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou art Purîshya Agni, thou art wealthy, thou art prosperous. Having made all the regions blest, here seat thee in thine own abode.

verses.sanskrit:
भव॑तं नः॒ सम॑नसौ॒ सचे॑तसावरे॒पसौ॑ ।
मा य॒ज्ञᳪ हि॑ᳪसिष्टं॒ मा य॒ज्ञप॑तिं जातवेदसौ शि॒वौ भ॑वतम॒द्य नः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhavataṃ naḥ samanasau sacetasāvarepasau |
mā yajñaṃ hiṃsiṣṭaṃ mā yajñapatiṃ jātavedasau śivau bhavatamadya naḥ ||
verses.translation: Be ye one-minded unto us, both of one thought, free from deceit. Harm not the sacrifice, harm not the Patron of the sacrifice. Be gracious unto us to-day, ye knowers of all things that be.

verses.sanskrit:
मा॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रं पृ॑थि॒वी पु॑री॒ष्य॒म॒ग्निᳪ स्वे योना॑वभारु॒खा ।
तां विश्वै॑र्दे॒वैरृ॒तुभिः॑ संविदा॒नः प्र॒जाप॑तिर्वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ वि मु॑ञ्चतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
māteva putraṃ pṛthivī purīṣyamagniṃ sve yonāvabhārukhā |
tāṃ viśvairdevairṛtubhiḥ saṃvidānaḥ prajāpatirviśvakarmā vi muñcatu ||
verses.translation: Even as a mother bears her son, Earth, Ukhâ hath borne within her womb Purîshya Agni. Maker of all, accordant with the All-Gods and Seasons, may Prajâpati release her.

verses.sanskrit:
असु॑न्वन्त॒मय॑जमानमिच्छ स्ते॒नस्ये॒त्यामन्वि॑हि॒ तस्क॑रस्य ।
अ॒न्यम॒स्मदि॑च्छ॒ सा त॑ इ॒त्या नमो॑ देवि निरृते॒ तुभ्य॑मस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
asunvantamayajamānamiccha stenasyetyāmanvihi taskarasya |
anyamasmadiccha sā ta ityā namo devi nirṛte tubhyamastu ||
verses.translation: Seek him who pours not, offers not oblation; follow the going of the thief and robber. This is thy way; leave us and seek some other. To thee, O Goddess Nirriti, be homage.

verses.sanskrit:
नमः॒ सु ते॑ निरृते तिग्मतेजोऽय॒स्मयं॒ वि चृ॑ता ब॒न्धमे॒तम् ।
य॒मेन॒ त्वं य॒म्या सं॑विदा॒नोत्त॒मे ना॒के अधि॑ रोहयैनम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
namaḥ su te nirṛte tigmatejo'yasmayaṃ vi cṛtā bandhametam |
yamena tvaṃ yamyā saṃvidānottame nāke adhi rohayainam ||
verses.translation: To thee, sharp-pointed Nirriti, full homage! Loose and detach this iron bond that binds him. Unanimous with Yama and with Yamî to the sublimest vault of heaven uplift him.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्या॑स्ते घोर आ॒सञ्जु॒होम्ये॒षां ब॒न्धाना॑मव॒सर्ज॑नाय ।
यां त्वा॒ जनो॒ भूमि॒रिति॑ प्र॒मन्द॑ते॒ निरृ॑तिं त्वा॒ऽहं परि॑वेद वि॒श्वतः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasyāste ghora āsañjuhomyeṣāṃ bandhānāmavasarjanāya |
yāṃ tvā jano bhūmiriti pramandate nirṛtiṃ tvā'haṃ pariveda viśvataḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou, Awful One, thou in whose mouth I offer for the unloosing of these binding fetters, Whom people hail as Earth with their glad voices, as Nirriti in every place I know thee.

verses.sanskrit:
यं ते॑ दे॒वी निरृ॑तिराब॒बन्ध॒ पाशं॑ ग्री॒वास्व॑विचृ॒त्यम् ।
तं ते॒ वि ष्या॒म्यायु॑षो॒ न मध्या॒दथै॒तं पि॒तुम॑द्धि॒ प्रसू॑तः । नमो॒ भूत्यै॒ येदं च॒कार॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ te devī nirṛtirābabandha pāśaṃ grīvāsvavicṛtyam |
taṃ te vi ṣyāmyāyuṣo na madhyādathaitaṃ pitumaddhi prasūtaḥ | namo bhūtyai yedaṃ cakāra ||
verses.translation: The binding noose which Nirriti the Goddess hath fastened on thy neck that none may loose it, I loose for thee as from the midst of Âyus. Sped forward now, eat thou the food we offer: To Fortune, her who hath done this, be homage.

verses.sanskrit:
नि॒वेश॑नः स॒ङ्गम॑नो॒ वसू॑नां॒ विश्वा॑ रू॒पाऽभि च॑ष्टे॒ शची॑भिः ।
दे॒व इ॑व सवि॒ता स॒त्यध॒र्मेन्द्रो॒ न त॑स्थौ सम॒रे प॑थी॒नाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
niveśanaḥ saṅgamano vasūnāṃ viśvā rūpā'bhi caṣṭe śacībhiḥ |
deva iva savitā satyadharmendro na tasthau samare pathīnām ||
verses.translation: Establisher, the gatherer of treasures, he looks with might on every form and figure. Like Savitar the God whose laws are constant, like Indra, he hath stood where meet the pathways.

verses.sanskrit: सीरा॑ युञ्जन्ति क॒वयो॑ यु॒गा वि त॑न्वते॒ पृथ॑क् । धीरा॑ दे॒वेषु॑ सुम्न॒या ॥
verses.transliteration: sīrā yuñjanti kavayo yugā vi tanvate pṛthak | dhīrā deveṣu sumnayā ||
verses.translation: Wise, through desire of bliss with Gods, the skilful bind the traces fast, and lay the yokes on either side.

verses.sanskrit:
यु॒नक्त॒ सीरा॒ वि यु॒गा त॑नुध्वं कृ॒ते योनौ॑ वपते॒ह बीज॑म् ।
गि॒रा च॑ श्रु॒ष्टिः सभ॑रा॒ अस॑न्नो॒ नेदी॑य॒ इत्सृ॒ण्यः॒ प॒क्वमेया॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yunakta sīrā vi yugā tanudhvaṃ kṛte yonau vapateha bījam |
girā ca śruṣṭiḥ sabharā asanno nedīya itsṛṇyaḥ pakvameyāt ||
verses.translation: Lay on the yokes and fasten well the traces; formed is the furrow sow the seed within it. Through song may we find hearing fraught with plenty: near to the ripened grain approach the sickle.

verses.sanskrit:
शु॒नᳪ सु फाला॒ वि कृ॑षन्तु॒ भूमि॑ᳪ शु॒नं की॒नाशा॑ अ॒भि य॑न्तु वा॒हैः ।
शुना॑सीरा ह॒विषा॒ तोश॑माना सुपिप्प॒ला ओष॑धीः कर्तना॒स्मै ॥
verses.transliteration:
śunaṃ su phālā vi kṛṣantu bhūmiṃ śunaṃ kīnāśā abhi yantu vāhaiḥ |
śunāsīrā haviṣā tośamānā supippalā oṣadhīḥ kartanāsmai ||
verses.translation: Happily let the shares turn up the ploughland, happily go the ploughers with the oxen! Suna and Sîra, pleased with our oblation, cause ye our plants to bear abundant fruitage.

verses.sanskrit:
घृ॒तेन॒ सीता॒ मधु॑ना॒ सम॑ज्यतां॒ विश्वै॑र्दे॒वैरनु॑मता म॒रुद्भिः॑ ।
ऊर्ज॑स्वती॒ पय॑सा॒ पिन्व॑माना॒स्मान्त्सी॑ते॒ पय॑सा॒ऽभ्या व॑वृत्स्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
ghṛtena sītā madhunā samajyatāṃ viśvairdevairanumatā marudbhiḥ |
ūrjasvatī payasā pinvamānāsmāntsīte payasā'bhyā vavṛtsva ||
verses.translation: Approved by Visvedevas and by Maruts, balmed be the furrow with sweet-flavoured fatness. Succulent, teeming with thy milky treasure, turn hitherward to us with milk, O Furrow.

verses.sanskrit: लाङ्ग॑लं॒ पवी॑रवत्सु॒शेव॑ᳪ सोम॒पित्स॑रु । तदुद्व॑पति॒ गामविं॑ प्रफ॒र्व्यं॒ च॒ पीव॑रीं प्र॒स्थाव॑द्रथ॒वाह॑णम् ॥
verses.transliteration: lāṅgalaṃ pavīravatsuśevaṃ somapitsaru | tadudvapati gāmaviṃ prapharvyaṃ ca pīvarīṃ prasthāvadrathavāhaṇam ||
verses.translation: The keen-shared plough that bringeth bliss, good for the Soma-drinker's need, Shear out for me a cow, a sheep, a rapid drawer of the car, a blooming woman, plump and strong!

verses.sanskrit: कामं॑ कामदुघे धुक्ष्व मि॒त्राय॒ वरु॑णाय च । इन्द्रा॑या॒श्विभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णे प्र॒जाभ्य॒ ओष॑धीभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: kāmaṃ kāmadughe dhukṣva mitrāya varuṇāya ca | indrāyāśvibhyāṃ pūṣṇe prajābhya oṣadhībhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: Milk out their wish, O Wishing-Cow, to Mitra and to Varuna, To Indra, to the Asvins, to Pûshan, to people and to plants.

verses.sanskrit: वि मु॑च्यध्वमघ्न्या देवयाना॒ अग॑न्म॒ तम॑सस्पा॒रम॒स्य ।ज्योति॑रापाम ॥
verses.transliteration: vi mucyadhvamaghnyā devayānā aganma tamasaspāramasya |jyotirāpāma ||
verses.translation: Be loosed, inviolable, Godward-farers! We have attained the limit of this darkness: we have won the light.

verses.sanskrit: स॒जूरब्दो॒ अय॑वोभिः स॒जूरु॒षा अरु॑णीभिः । स॒जोष॑साव॒श्विना॒ दᳪसो॑भिः स॒जूः सूर॒ एत॑शेन स॒जूर्वै॑श्वान॒र इड॑या घृ॒तेन॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: sajūrabdo ayavobhiḥ sajūruṣā aruṇībhiḥ | sajoṣasāvaśvinā daṃsobhiḥ sajūḥ sūra etaśena sajūrvaiśvānara iḍayā ghṛtena svāhā ||
verses.translation: The year together with the darksome fortnights; Dawn with the ruddy-coloured cows about her; the Asvins with their wonderful achievements; the Sun together with his dappled Courser; Vaisvânara with Idâ and with butter. Svâhâ!

verses.sanskrit: या ओष॑धीः॒ पूर्वा॑ जा॒ता दे॒वेभ्य॑स्त्रियु॒गं पु॒रा । मनै॒ नु ब॒भ्रूणा॑म॒हᳪ श॒तं धामा॑नि स॒प्त च॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yā oṣadhīḥ pūrvā jātā devebhyastriyugaṃ purā | manai nu babhrūṇāmahaṃ śataṃ dhāmāni sapta ca ||
verses.translation: Herbs that sprang up in time of old, three ages earlier than the Gods,— Of these, whose hue is brown, will I declare the hundred powers and seven.

verses.sanskrit: श॒तं वो॑ अम्ब॒ धामा॑नि स॒हस्र॑मु॒त वो॒ रुहः॑ । अधा॑ शतक्रत्वो यू॒यमि॒मं मे॑ अग॒दं कृ॑त ॥
verses.transliteration: śataṃ vo amba dhāmāni sahasramuta vo ruhaḥ | adhā śatakratvo yūyamimaṃ me agadaṃ kṛta ||
verses.translation: Ye, Mothers, have a hundred homes, yea, and a thousand are your growths. Do ye who have a thousand powers free this my patient from disease.

verses.sanskrit: ओष॑धीः॒ प्रति॑ मोदध्वं॒ पुष्प॑वतीः प्र॒सूव॑रीः । अश्वा॑ इव स॒जित्व॑रीर्वी॒रुधः॑ पारयि॒ष्ण्वः॒ ॥
verses.transliteration: oṣadhīḥ prati modadhvaṃ puṣpavatīḥ prasūvarīḥ | aśvā iva sajitvarīrvīrudhaḥ pārayiṣṇvaḥ ||
verses.translation: Be glad and joyful in the Plants, both blossoming and bearing fruit, Plants that will lead us to success like mares who conquer in the race.

verses.sanskrit: ओष॑धी॒रिति॑ मातर॒स्तद्वो॑ देवी॒रुप॑ ब्रुवे । स॒नेय॒मश्वं॒ गां वास॑ आ॒त्मानं॒ तव॑ पूरुष ॥
verses.transliteration: oṣadhīriti mātarastadvo devīrupa bruve | saneyamaśvaṃ gāṃ vāsa ātmānaṃ tava pūruṣa ||
verses.translation: Plants, by this name I speak to you, Mothers, to you the Goddesses: Steed, cow, and garment may I win, win back thy very self, O man.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒श्व॒त्थे वो॑ नि॒षद॑नं प॒र्णे वो॑ वस॒तिष्कृ॒ता । गो॒भाज॒ इत्किला॑सथ॒ यत्स॒नव॑थ॒ पूरु॑षम् ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvatthe vo niṣadanaṃ parṇe vo vasatiṣkṛtā | gobhāja itkilāsatha yatsanavatha pūruṣam ||
verses.translation: The Holy Fig tree is your home, your mansion is the Parna tree: Winners of cattle shall ye be if ye regain for me this man.

verses.sanskrit: यत्रौ॑षधीः स॒मग्म॑त॒ राजा॑नः॒ समि॑ताविव । विप्रः॒ स उ॑च्यते भि॒षग्र॑क्षो॒हामी॑व॒चात॑नः ॥
verses.transliteration: yatrauṣadhīḥ samagmata rājānaḥ samitāviva | vipraḥ sa ucyate bhiṣagrakṣohāmīvacātanaḥ ||
verses.translation: He who hath store of Herbs at hand like Kings amid a crowd of men,— Physician is that sage's name, fiend-slayer, chaser of disease.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒श्वा॒व॒तीᳪ सो॑माव॒तीमू॒र्जय॑न्ती॒मुदो॑जसम् । आऽवि॑त्सि॒ सर्वा॒ ओष॑धीर॒स्मा अ॑रि॒ष्टता॑तये ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvāvatīṃ somāvatīmūrjayantīmudojasam | ā'vitsi sarvā oṣadhīrasmā ariṣṭatātaye ||
verses.translation: Herbs rich in Soma, rich in steeds, in nourishment in strengthening power, All these have I provided here, that this man may be whole again.

verses.sanskrit:
उच्छुष्मा॒ ओष॑धीनां॒ गावो॑ गो॒ष्ठादि॑वेरते ।
धन॑ᳪ सनि॒ष्यन्ती॑नामा॒त्मानं॒ तव॑ पूरुष ॥
verses.transliteration:
ucchuṣmā oṣadhīnāṃ gāvo goṣṭhādiverate |
dhanaṃ saniṣyantīnāmātmānaṃ tava pūruṣa ||
verses.translation: The healing virtues of the Plants stream forth like cattle from the stall,— Plants that shall win me store of wealth, and save thy vital breath, O man.

verses.sanskrit: इ॒ष्कृ॑ति॒र्नाम॑ वो मा॒ताऽथो॑ यू॒यᳪ स्थ॒ निष्कृ॑तीः । सी॒राः प॑त॒त्रिणी॑ स्थन॒ यदा॒मय॑ति॒ निष्कृ॑थ ॥
verses.transliteration: iṣkṛtirnāma vo mātā'tho yūyaṃ stha niṣkṛtīḥ | sīrāḥ patatriṇī sthana yadāmayati niṣkṛtha ||
verses.translation: Reliever is your mother's name, and hence Restorers are ye called. Rivers are ye with wings that fly: keep far whatever brings disease.

verses.sanskrit: अति॒ विश्वाः॑ परि॒ष्ठा स्ते॒न इ॑व व्र॒जम॑क्रमुः । ओष॑धीः॒ प्राचु॑च्यवु॒र्यत्किं च॑ त॒न्वो रपः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ati viśvāḥ pariṣṭhā stena iva vrajamakramuḥ | oṣadhīḥ prācucyavuryatkiṃ ca tanvo rapaḥ ||
verses.translation: Over all fences have they passed, as steals a thief into the fold. The Plants have driven from the frame whatever malady was there.

verses.sanskrit: यदि॒मा वा॒जय॑न्न॒हमोष॑धी॒र्हस्त॑ आद॒धे । आ॒त्मा यक्ष्म॑स्य नश्यति पु॒रा जी॑व॒गृभो॑ यथा ॥
verses.transliteration: yadimā vājayannahamoṣadhīrhasta ādadhe | ātmā yakṣmasya naśyati purā jīvagṛbho yathā ||
verses.translation: When, bringing back the vanished strength, I hold these herbs within my hand, The spirit of disease departs ere he can seize upon the life.

verses.sanskrit: यस्यौ॑षधीः प्र॒सर्प॒थाङ्ग॑मङ्गं॒ परु॑ष्परुः । ततो॒ यक्ष्मं॒ वि बा॑धध्व उ॒ग्रो म॑ध्यम॒शीरि॑व ॥
verses.transliteration: yasyauṣadhīḥ prasarpathāṅgamaṅgaṃ paruṣparuḥ | tato yakṣmaṃ vi bādhadhva ugro madhyamaśīriva ||
verses.translation: He through whose frame, O Plants, ye creep member by member, joint by joint, From him ye drive away disease like some strong arbiter of strife.

verses.sanskrit: सा॒कं य॑क्ष्म॒ प्र प॑त॒ चाषे॑ण किकिदी॒विना॑ । सा॒कं वात॑स्य॒ ध्राज्या॑ सा॒कं न॑श्य नि॒हाक॑या ॥
verses.transliteration: sākaṃ yakṣma pra pata cāṣeṇa kikidīvinā | sākaṃ vātasya dhrājyā sākaṃ naśya nihākayā ||
verses.translation: Fly, Spirit of Disease, begone, with the blue jay and kingfisher. Fly, with the wind's impetuous speed, vanish together with the storm.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒न्या वो॑ अ॒न्याम॑वत्व॒न्यान्यस्या॒ उपा॑वत । ताः सर्वाः॑ संविदा॒ना इ॒दं मे॒ प्राव॑ता॒ वचः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: anyā vo anyāmavatvanyānyasyā upāvata | tāḥ sarvāḥ saṃvidānā idaṃ me prāvatā vacaḥ ||
verses.translation: Help every one the other, lend assistance each of you to each, All of you be accordant, give furtherance to this speech of mine.

verses.sanskrit: याः फ॒लिनी॒र्या अ॑फ॒ला अ॑पु॒ष्पा याश्च॑ पु॒ष्पिणीः॑ । बृह॒स्पति॑प्रसूता॒स्ता नो॑ मुञ्च॒न्त्वᳪह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration: yāḥ phalinīryā aphalā apuṣpā yāśca puṣpiṇīḥ | bṛhaspatiprasūtāstā no muñcantvaṃhasaḥ ||
verses.translation: Let fruitful Plants, and fruitless, those that blossom, and the blossomless, Urged onward by Brihaspati, release us from our pain and grief;

verses.sanskrit: मु॒ञ्चन्तु॑ मा शप॒थ्यादथो॑ वरु॒ण्या॒दु॒त । अथो॑ य॒मस्य॒ पड्वी॑शा॒त्सर्व॑स्माद्देवकिल्बि॒षात् ॥
verses.transliteration: muñcantu mā śapathyādatho varuṇyāduta | atho yamasya paḍvīśātsarvasmāddevakilbiṣāt ||
verses.translation: Release me from the curse's plague and woe that comes from Varuna; Free me from Yama's fetter, from sin and offence against the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒व॒पत॑न्तीरवदन्दि॒व ओष॑धय॒स्परि॑ । यं जी॒वम॒श्नवा॑महै॒ न स रि॑ष्याति॒ पूरु॑षः ॥
verses.transliteration: avapatantīravadandiva oṣadhayaspari | yaṃ jīvamaśnavāmahai na sa riṣyāti pūruṣaḥ ||
verses.translation: What time, descending from the sky, the Plants flew earthward, thus they spake: No evil shall befall the man whom while he liveth we pervade.

verses.sanskrit: या ओष॑धीः॒ सोम॑राज्ञीर्ब॒ह्वीः श॒तवि॑चक्षणाः । तासा॑मसि॒ त्वमु॑त्त॒मारं॒ कामा॑य॒ शᳪ हृ॒दे ॥
verses.transliteration: yā oṣadhīḥ somarājñīrbahvīḥ śatavicakṣaṇāḥ | tāsāmasi tvamuttamāraṃ kāmāya śaṃ hṛde ||
verses.translation: Of all the many Plants whose King is Soma, Plants of hundred forms, Thou art the Plant most excellent, prompt to the wish, sweet to the heart.

verses.sanskrit: या ओष॑धीः॒ सोम॑राज्ञी॒र्विष्ठि॑ताः पृथि॒वीमनु॑ । बृह॒स्पति॑प्रसूता अस्यै॒ संद॑त्त वी॒र्य॒म् ॥
verses.transliteration: yā oṣadhīḥ somarājñīrviṣṭhitāḥ pṛthivīmanu | bṛhaspatiprasūtā asyai saṃdatta vīryam ||
verses.translation: O all ye various Herbs whose King is Soma, that oerspread the earth, Urged onward by Brihaspati, combine your virtue in this Plant.

verses.sanskrit: याश्चे॒दमु॑पशृ॒ण्वन्ति॒ याश्च॑ दू॒रं परा॑गताः । सर्वाः॑ सं॒गत्य॑ वीरुधोऽस्यै॒ संद॑त्त वी॒र्य॒म् ॥
verses.transliteration: yāścedamupaśṛṇvanti yāśca dūraṃ parāgatāḥ | sarvāḥ saṃgatya vīrudho'syai saṃdatta vīryam ||
verses.translation: All Plants that hear this speech, and those that have departed far away, Come all assembled and confer your healing power upon this Herb.

verses.sanskrit: मा वो॑ रिषत् खनि॒ता यस्मै॑ चा॒हं खना॑मि वः । द्वि॒पाच्चतु॑ष्पाद॒स्माक॒ᳪ सर्व॑मस्त्वनातु॒रम् ॥
verses.transliteration: mā vo riṣat khanitā yasmai cāhaṃ khanāmi vaḥ | dvipāccatuṣpādasmākaṃ sarvamastvanāturam ||
verses.translation: Unharmed be he who digs you up, unharmed the man for whom I dig: And let no malady attack biped or quadruped of ours.

verses.sanskrit: ओष॑धयः॒ सम॑वदन्त॒ सोमे॑न स॒ह राज्ञा॑ । यस्मै॑ कृ॒णोति॑ ब्राह्म॒णस्तᳪ रा॑जन् पारयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: oṣadhayaḥ samavadanta somena saha rājñā | yasmai kṛṇoti brāhmaṇastaṃ rājan pārayāmasi ||
verses.translation: With Soma as their Sovran Lord the Plants hold colloquy and say: O King, we save from death the man whose cure a Brâhman undertakes.

verses.sanskrit: ना॒श॒यि॒त्री ब॒लास॒स्यार्श॑स उप॒चिता॑मसि । अथो॑ श॒तस्य॒ यक्ष्मा॑णां पाका॒रोर॑सि॒ नाश॑नी ॥
verses.transliteration: nāśayitrī balāsasyārśasa upacitāmasi | atho śatasya yakṣmāṇāṃ pākārorasi nāśanī ||
verses.translation: Banisher of catarrh art thou, of tumours and of hemorrhoids; Thou banished Pâkâru and Consumption in a hundred forms.

verses.sanskrit: त्वां ग॑न्ध॒र्वा अ॑खनँ॒स्त्वामिन्द्र॒स्त्वां बृह॒स्पतिः॑ । त्वामो॑षधे॒ सोमो॒ राजा॑ वि॒द्वान् यक्ष्मा॑दमुच्यत ॥
verses.transliteration: tvāṃ gandharvā akhanam̐stvāmindrastvāṃ bṛhaspatiḥ | tvāmoṣadhe somo rājā vidvān yakṣmādamucyata ||
verses.translation: Thee did Gandharvas dig from earth, thee Indra and Brihaspati. King Soma, knowing thee, O Plant, from his Consumption was made free.

verses.sanskrit: सह॑स्व मे॒ अरा॑तीः॒ सह॑स्व पृतनाय॒तः । सह॑स्व॒ सर्वं॑ पा॒प्मान॒ᳪ सह॑मानास्योषधे ॥
verses.transliteration: sahasva me arātīḥ sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ | sahasva sarvaṃ pāpmānaṃ sahamānāsyoṣadhe ||
verses.translation: Conquer mine enemies, the men who challenge me do thou subdue. Conquer thou all unhappiness: victorious art thou, O Plant.

verses.sanskrit: दी॒र्घायु॑स्त ओषधे खनि॒ता यस्मै॑ च त्वा॒ खना॑म्य॒हम् । अथो॒ त्वं दी॒र्घायु॑र्भू॒त्वा श॒तव॑ल्शा॒ विरो॑हतात् ॥
verses.transliteration: dīrghāyusta oṣadhe khanitā yasmai ca tvā khanāmyaham | atho tvaṃ dīrghāyurbhūtvā śatavalśā virohatāt ||
verses.translation: Long-lived be he who digs thee, Plant, and he for whom I dig thee up. So mayst thou also, grown long-lived, rise upward with a hundred shoots.

verses.sanskrit: त्वमु॑त्त॒मास्यो॑षधे॒ तव॑ वृ॒क्षा उप॑स्तयः । उप॑स्तिरस्तु॒ सोऽस्माकं॒ यो अ॒स्माँ२ अ॑भि॒दास॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration: tvamuttamāsyoṣadhe tava vṛkṣā upastayaḥ | upastirastu so'smākaṃ yo asmām̐ abhidāsati ||
verses.translation: Most excellent of all art thou, O Plant; thy vassals are the trees. Let him be subject to our power, the man who seeks to injure us.

verses.sanskrit:
मा मा॑ हिᳪसीज्जनि॒ता यः पृ॑थि॒व्या यो वा॒ दिव॑ᳪ स॒त्यध॑र्मा॒ व्यान॑ट् ।
यश्चा॒पश्च॒न्द्राः प्र॑थ॒मो ज॒जान॒ कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā mā hiṃsījjanitā yaḥ pṛthivyā yo vā divaṃ satyadharmā vyānaṭ |
yaścāpaścandrāḥ prathamo jajāna kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
verses.translation: May he not harm me who is earth's begetter, nor he whose laws are faithful, sky's pervades; Nor he who first begot the lucid waters. To Ka the God let us present oblation.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒भ्या व॑र्तस्व पृथिवि य॒ज्ञेन॒ पय॑सा स॒ह । व॒पां ते॑ अ॒ग्निरि॑षि॒तो अ॑रोहत् ॥
verses.transliteration: abhyā vartasva pṛthivi yajñena payasā saha | vapāṃ te agniriṣito arohat ||
verses.translation: Turn thyself hitherward, O Earth, to us with sacrifice and milk. Thy covering skin Agni, urged forth, hath mounted.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ यत्ते॑ शु॒क्रं यच्च॒न्द्रं यत्पू॒तं यच्च॑ य॒ज्ञिय॑म् ।
तद्दे॒वेभ्यो॑ भरामसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne yatte śukraṃ yaccandraṃ yatpūtaṃ yacca yajñiyam |
taddevebhyo bharāmasi ||
verses.translation: All, Agni, that in thee is bright, pure, cleansed, and meet for sacrifice, That do we bring unto the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
इष॒मूर्ज॑म॒हमि॒त आद॑मृ॒तस्य॒ योनिं॑ महि॒षस्य॒ धारा॑म् ।
आ मा॒ गोषु॑ विश॒त्वा त॒नूषु॒ जहा॑मि से॒दिमनि॑रा॒ममी॑वाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
iṣamūrjamahamita ādamṛtasya yoniṃ mahiṣasya dhārām |
ā mā goṣu viśatvā tanūṣu jahāmi sedimanirāmamīvām ||
verses.translation: I from this place have fed on strength and vigour, the womb of holy Law, stream of the mighty. In cows let it possess me and in bodies. I quit decline and lack of food, and sickness.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ तव॒ श्रवो॒ वयो॒ महि॑ भ्राजन्ते अ॒र्चयो॑ विभावसो ।
बृह॑द्भानो॒ शव॑सा॒ वाज॑मु॒क्थ्यं दधा॑सि दा॒शुषे॑ कवे ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne tava śravo vayo mahi bhrājante arcayo vibhāvaso |
bṛhadbhāno śavasā vājamukthyaṃ dadhāsi dāśuṣe kave ||
verses.translation: Agni, life-power and fame are thine: thy fires blaze mightily, thou rich in wealth of beams! Sage, passing bright, thou givest to the worshipper, with strength, the food that merits laud.

verses.sanskrit:
पा॒व॒कव॑र्चाः शु॒क्रव॑र्चा॒ अनू॑नवर्चा॒ उदि॑यर्षि भा॒नुना॑ ।
पु॒त्रो मा॒तरा॑ वि॒चर॒न्नुपा॑वसि पृ॒णक्षि॒ रोद॑सी उ॒भे ॥
verses.transliteration:
pāvakavarcāḥ śukravarcā anūnavarcā udiyarṣi bhānunā |
putro mātarā vicarannupāvasi pṛṇakṣi rodasī ubhe ||
verses.translation: With brilliant, purifying sheen, with perfect sheen thou liftest up thyself in light. Thou, visiting both thy Mothers, aidest them as Son: thou joinest close the earth and heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊर्जो॑ नपाज्जातवेदः सुश॒स्तिभि॒र्मन्द॑स्व धी॒तिभि॑र्हि॒तः ।
त्वे इषः॒ सन्द॑धु॒र्भूरि॑वर्पसश्चि॒त्रोत॑यो वा॒मजा॑ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrjo napājjātavedaḥ suśastibhirmandasva dhītibhirhitaḥ |
tve iṣaḥ sandadhurbhūrivarpasaścitrotayo vāmajātāḥ ||
verses.translation: O Jâtavedas, Son of Strength, rejoice thyself, gracious, in our fair hymns and songs. In thee are treasured various forms of strengthening food, born nobly and of wondrous help.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒र॒ज्यन्न॑ग्ने प्रथयस्व ज॒न्तुभि॑र॒स्मे रायो॑ अमर्त्य ।
स द॑र्श॒तस्य॒ वपु॑षो॒ वि रा॑जसि पृ॒णक्षि॑ सान॒सिं क्रतु॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
irajyannagne prathayasva jantubhirasme rāyo amartya |
sa darśatasya vapuṣo vi rājasi pṛṇakṣi sānasiṃ kratum ||
verses.translation: Agni, spread forth, as Ruler, over living things: give wealth to us, Immortal God. Thou shinest out from beauty fair to look upon: thou leadest us to conquering power.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒ष्क॒र्तार॑मध्व॒रस्य॒ प्रचे॑तसं॒ क्षय॑न्त॒ᳪ राध॑सो म॒हः ।
रा॒तिं वा॒मस्य॑ सु॒भगां॑ म॒हीमिषं॒ दधा॑सि सान॒सिᳪ र॒यिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
iṣkartāramadhvarasya pracetasaṃ kṣayantaṃ rādhaso mahaḥ |
rātiṃ vāmasya subhagāṃ mahīmiṣaṃ dadhāsi sānasiṃ rayim ||
verses.translation: To him, the wise, who orders sacrifice, who hath great riches under his control, Thou givest blest award of good, and plenteous food, givest him wealth that conquers all.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तावा॑नं महि॒षं वि॒श्वद॑र्शतम॒ग्निᳪ सु॒म्नाय॑ दधिरे पु॒रो जनाः॑ ।
श्रुत्क॑र्णᳪ स॒प्रथ॑स्तमं त्वा गि॒रा दै॑व्यं॒ मानु॑षा यु॒गा ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛtāvānaṃ mahiṣaṃ viśvadarśatamagniṃ sumnāya dadhire puro janāḥ |
śrutkarṇaṃ saprathastamaṃ tvā girā daivyaṃ mānuṣā yugā ||
verses.translation: The men have set before them for their welfare Agni, strong, visible to all, the Holy. Thee, Godlike One, with ears to hear, most famous, men's generations magnify with praise-songs.

verses.sanskrit: आ प्या॑यस्व॒ समे॑तु ते वि॒श्वतः॑ सोम॒ वृष्ण्य॑म् । भवा॒ वाज॑स्य सङ्ग॒थे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā pyāyasva sametu te viśvataḥ soma vṛṣṇyam | bhavā vājasya saṅgathe ||
verses.translation: Soma, wax great. From every side may vigorous powers unite in thee. Be in the gathering-place of strength.

verses.sanskrit:
सं ते॒ पया॑ᳪसि॒ समु॑ यन्तु॒ वाजाः॒ सं वृष्ण्या॑न्यभिमाति॒षाहः॑ ।
आ॒प्याय॑मानो अ॒मृता॑य सोम दि॒वि श्रवा॑ᳪस्युत्त॒मानि॑ धिष्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ te payāṃsi samu yantu vājāḥ saṃ vṛṣṇyānyabhimātiṣāhaḥ |
āpyāyamāno amṛtāya soma divi śravāṃsyuttamāni dhiṣva ||
verses.translation: In thee be juicy nutriments united, and power and mighty foe-subduing vigour. Waxing to immortality, O Soma, win highest glory for thyself in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: आ प्या॑यस्व मदिन्तम॒ सोम॒ विश्वे॑भिर॒ᳪशुभिः॑ । भवा॑ नः स॒प्रथ॑स्तमः॒ सखा॑ वृ॒धे ॥
verses.transliteration: ā pyāyasva madintama soma viśvebhiraṃśubhiḥ | bhavā naḥ saprathastamaḥ sakhā vṛdhe ||
verses.translation: Wax, O most gladdening Soma, great through all thy filaments, and be A friend of most illustrious fame to prosper us.

verses.sanskrit: आ ते॑ व॒त्सो मनो॑ यमत्पर॒माच्चि॑त्स॒धस्था॑त् । अग्ने॒ त्वाङ्का॑मया गि॒रा ॥
verses.transliteration: ā te vatso mano yamatparamāccitsadhasthāt | agne tvāṅkāmayā girā ||
verses.translation: May Vatsa draw thy mind away, even from thy loftiest dwelling-place, Agni, with song that yearns for thee.

verses.sanskrit: तुभ्यं॒ ता अ॑ङ्गिरस्तम॒ विश्वाः॑ सुक्षि॒तयः॒ पृथ॑क् । अग्ने॒ कामा॑य येमिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: tubhyaṃ tā aṅgirastama viśvāḥ sukṣitayaḥ pṛthak | agne kāmāya yemire ||
verses.translation: Agni, best Angiras, to thee all people who have pleasant homes Apart have turned to gain their wish.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निः प्रि॒येषु॒ धाम॑सु॒ कामो॑ भू॒तस्य॒ भव्य॑स्य । स॒म्राडेको॒ वि रा॑जति ॥
verses.transliteration: agniḥ priyeṣu dhāmasu kāmo bhūtasya bhavyasya | samrāḍeko vi rājati ||
verses.translation: In dear homes, Agni, the desire of all that is and is to be, Shines forth the One Imperial Lord.

verses.sanskrit: मयि॑ गृह्णा॒म्यग्रे॑ अ॒ग्निᳪ रा॒यस्पोषा॑य सुप्रजा॒स्त्वाय॑ सु॒वीर्या॑य । मामु॑ दे॒वताः॑ सचन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: mayi gṛhṇāmyagre agniṃ rāyaspoṣāya suprajāstvāya suvīryāya | māmu devatāḥ sacantām ||
verses.translation: I TAKE within me Agni first, for increase of my wealth, good offspring, manly strength: So may the Deities wait on me.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पां पृ॒ष्ठम॑सि॒ योनि॑र॒ग्नेः स॑मु॒द्रम॒भितः॒ पिन्व॑मानम् ।
वर्ध॑मानो म॒हाँ२ आ च॒ पुष्क॑रे दि॒वो मात्र॑या वरि॒म्णा प्र॑थस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
apāṃ pṛṣṭhamasi yoniragneḥ samudramabhitaḥ pinvamānam |
vardhamāno mahām̐ ā ca puṣkare divo mātrayā varimṇā prathasva ||
verses.translation: Thou art the waters back, the womb of Agni, around the ocean as it swells and surges. Waxing to greatness, resting on the lotus, spread forth in amplitude with heaven's own measure.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्म॑ जज्ञा॒नं प्र॑थ॒मं पु॒रस्ता॒द्वि सी॑म॒तः सु॒रुचो॑ वे॒न आ॑वः ।
स बु॒ध्न्या॒ उप॒मा अ॑स्य वि॒ष्ठाः स॒तश्च॒ योनि॒मस॑तश्च॒ वि वः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahma jajñānaṃ prathamaṃ purastādvi sīmataḥ suruco vena āvaḥ |
sa budhnyā upamā asya viṣṭhāḥ sataśca yonimasataśca vi vaḥ ||
verses.translation: Eastward at first was Brahma generated. Vena oerspread the bright Ones from the summit, Disclosed his deepest nearest revelations, womb of existent and of non-existent.

verses.sanskrit:
हि॒र॒ण्य॒ग॒र्भः सम॑वर्त॒ताग्रे॑ भू॒तस्य॑ जा॒तः पति॒रेक॑ आसीत् ।
स दा॑धार पृथि॒वीं द्यामु॒तेमां कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt |
sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
verses.translation: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, born Only Lord of all created being. He fixed and holdeth up this earth and heaven. Worship we Ka the God with our oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
द्र॒प्सश्च॑स्कन्द पृथि॒वीमनु॒ द्यामि॒मं च॒ योनि॒मनु॒ यश्च॒ पूर्वः॑ ।
स॒मा॒नं योनि॒मनु॑ स॒ञ्चर॑न्तं द्र॒प्सं जु॑हो॒म्यनु॑ स॒प्त होत्राः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
drapsaścaskanda pṛthivīmanu dyāmimaṃ ca yonimanu yaśca pūrvaḥ |
samānaṃ yonimanu sañcarantaṃ drapsaṃ juhomyanu sapta hotrāḥ ||
verses.translation: The Drop leaped onward through the earth and heaven, along this place and that which was before it. I offer up, throughout the seven oblations, the Drop still moving to the common dwelling.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ऽस्तु स॒र्पेभ्यो॒ ये के च॑ पृथि॒वीमनु॑ । ये अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ ये दि॒वि तेभ्यः॑ स॒र्पेभ्यो॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: namo'stu sarpebhyo ye ke ca pṛthivīmanu | ye antarikṣe ye divi tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ ||
verses.translation: Homage be paid to Serpents unto all of them that are on earth, To those that dwell in air, to those that dwell in sky be homage paid.

verses.sanskrit: या इष॑वो यातु॒धाना॑नां॒ ये वा॒ वन॒स्पतीँ॒१ रनु॑ । ये वा॑व॒टेषु॒ शेर॑ते॒ तेभ्यः॑ स॒र्पेभ्यो॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yā iṣavo yātudhānānāṃ ye vā vanaspatīm̐ ranu | ye vāvaṭeṣu śerate tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ ||
verses.translation: To those that are the demons darts, to those that live upon the trees, To all the Serpents that lie low in holes be adoration paid.

verses.sanskrit: ये वा॒मी रो॑च॒ने दि॒वो ये वा॒ सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मिषु॑ । येषा॑म॒प्सु सद॑स्कृ॒तं तेभ्यः॑ स॒र्पेभ्यो॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ye vāmī rocane divo ye vā sūryasya raśmiṣu | yeṣāmapsu sadaskṛtaṃ tebhyaḥ sarpebhyo namaḥ ||
verses.translation: Or those that are in heaven's bright sphere, or those that dwell in the Sun's beams: Serpents, whose home has been prepared in waters, homage unto them!

verses.sanskrit:
कृ॒णु॒ष्व पाजः॒ प्रसि॑तिं॒ न पृ॒थ्वीं या॒हि राजे॒वाम॑वाँ॒२ इभे॑न ।
तृ॒ष्वीमनु॒ प्रसि॑तिं द्रूणा॒नोऽस्ता॑सि॒ विध्य॑ र॒क्षस॒स्तपि॑ष्ठैः ॥
verses.transliteration:
kṛṇuṣva pājaḥ prasitiṃ na pṛthvīṃ yāhi rājevāmavām̐ ibhena |
tṛṣvīmanu prasitiṃ drūṇāno'stāsi vidhya rakṣasastapiṣṭhaiḥ ||
verses.translation: Put forth like a wide-spreading net thy vigour: go like a mighty King with his attendants. Thou, following thy swift net, shootest arrows: transfix the fiends with darts that burn most fiercely.

verses.sanskrit:
तव॑ भ्र॒मास॑ आशु॒या प॑त॒न्त्यनु॑स्पृश धृष॒ता शोशु॑चानः ।
तपू॑ᳪष्यग्ने जु॒ह्वा॒ पत॒ङ्गानस॑न्दितो॒ वि सृ॑ज॒ विष्व॑गु॒ल्काः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tava bhramāsa āśuyā patantyanuspṛśa dhṛṣatā śośucānaḥ |
tapūṃṣyagne juhvā pataṅgānasandito vi sṛja viṣvagulkāḥ ||
verses.translation: Forth go in rapid flight thy whirling weapons: follow them closely glowing in thy fury. Spread with thy tongue the wingèd flames, O Agni: unfettered cast thy firebrands all around thee.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रति॒ स्पशो॒ वि सृ॑ज॒ तूर्णि॑तमो॒ भवा॑ पा॒युर्वि॒शो अ॒स्या अद॑ब्धः ।
यो नो॑ दू॒रे अ॒घश॑ᳪसो॒ यो अन्त्यग्ने॒ मा कि॑ष्टे॒ व्यथि॒रा द॑धर्षीत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prati spaśo vi sṛja tūrṇitamo bhavā pāyurviśo asyā adabdhaḥ |
yo no dūre aghaśaṃso yo antyagne mā kiṣṭe vyathirā dadharṣīt ||
verses.translation: Send thy spies forward, fleetest in thy motion: be, neer deceived, the guardian of this people From him who, near or far, is bent on evil, and let no trouble sent from thee oercome us.

verses.sanskrit:
उद॑ग्ने तिष्ठ॒ प्रत्या त॑नुष्व॒ न्यमित्राँ॑२ ओषतात्तिग्महेते ।
यो नो॒ अरा॑तिᳪ समिधान च॒क्रे नी॒चा तं ध॑क्ष्यत॒सं न शुष्क॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
udagne tiṣṭha pratyā tanuṣva nyamitrām̐ oṣatāttigmahete |
yo no arātiṃ samidhāna cakre nīcā taṃ dhakṣyatasaṃ na śuṣkam ||
verses.translation: Rise up, O Agni, spread thee out before us, burn down our foes, thou who hast sharpened arrows. Him, blazing Agni! who hath worked us mischief, consume thou utterly like dried-up stubble.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊ॒र्ध्वो भ॑व॒ प्रति॑ वि॒ध्याध्य॒स्मदा॒विष्कृ॑णुष्व॒ दैव्या॑न्यग्ने ।
अव॑ स्थि॒रा त॑नुहि यातु॒जूनां॑ जा॒मिमजा॑मिं॒ प्र मृ॑णीहि॒ शत्रू॑न् ।
अ॒ग्नेष्ट्वा॒ तेज॑सा सादयामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrdhvo bhava prati vidhyādhyasmadāviṣkṛṇuṣva daivyānyagne |
ava sthirā tanuhi yātujūnāṃ jāmimajāmiṃ pra mṛṇīhi śatrūn |
agneṣṭvā tejasā sādayāmi ||
verses.translation: Rise, Agni, drive off those who fight against us: make manifest thine own celestial vigour. Slacken the strong bows of the demon-driven: destroy our foemen whether kin or stranger. I settle thee with Agni's fiery ardour.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निर्मू॒र्धा दि॒वः क॒कुत्पतिः॑ पृथि॒व्या अ॒यम् । अ॒पाᳪ रेता॑ᳪसि जिन्वति ।
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ त्वौज॑सा सादयामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnirmūrdhā divaḥ kakutpatiḥ pṛthivyā ayam | apāṃ retāṃsi jinvati |
indrasya tvaujasā sādayāmi ||
verses.translation: Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he: He quickeneth the waters seed. I settle thee with the great strength of Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
भुवो॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॒ रज॑सश्च ने॒ता यत्रा॑ नि॒युद्भिः॒ सच॑से शि॒वाभिः॑ ।
दि॒वि मू॒र्धानं॑ दधिषे स्व॒र्षां जि॒ह्वाम॑ग्ने चकृषे हव्य॒वाह॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhuvo yajñasya rajasaśca netā yatrā niyudbhiḥ sacase śivābhiḥ |
divi mūrdhānaṃ dadhiṣe svarṣāṃ jihvāmagne cakṛṣe havyavāham ||
verses.translation: Thou art the leader of the rite and region to which with thine auspicious teams thou tendest. Thy light-bestowing head to heaven thou liftest, making thy tongue the oblation-bearer, Agni!

verses.sanskrit:
ध्रु॒वाऽसि॑ ध॒रुणाऽऽस्तृ॑ता वि॒श्वक॑र्मणा ।
मा त्वा॑ समु॒द्र उद्व॑धी॒न्मा सु॑प॒र्णोऽव्य॑थमाना पृथि॒वीं दृ॑ᳪह ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhruvā'si dharuṇā''stṛtā viśvakarmaṇā |
mā tvā samudra udvadhīnmā suparṇo'vyathamānā pṛthivīṃ dṛṃha ||
verses.translation: Steady art thou, sustainer, laid by Visvakarman in thy place. Let not the ocean nor the bird harm thee: unshaking, steady earth.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒जाप॑तिष्ट्वा सादयत्व॒पां पृ॒ष्ठे स॑मु॒द्रस्येम॑न् । व्यच॑स्वतीं॒ प्रथ॑स्वतीं॒ प्रथ॑स्व पृथि॒व्य॒सि ॥
verses.transliteration: prajāpatiṣṭvā sādayatvapāṃ pṛṣṭhe samudrasyeman | vyacasvatīṃ prathasvatīṃ prathasva pṛthivyasi ||
verses.translation: Thee let Prajâpati settle on the waters back, in Ocean's course, Thee the capacious, widely spread. Thou art the Wide One: spread thee wide

verses.sanskrit:
भूर॑सि॒ भूमि॑र॒स्यदि॑तिरसि वि॒श्वधा॑या॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य ध॒र्त्री ।
पृ॒थि॒वीं य॑च्छ पृथि॒वीं दृ॑ᳪह पृथि॒वीं मा हि॑ᳪसीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhūrasi bhūmirasyaditirasi viśvadhāyā viśvasya bhuvanasya dhartrī |
pṛthivīṃ yaccha pṛthivīṃ dṛṃha pṛthivīṃ mā hiṃsīḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou art the earth, the ground, thou art the all-sustaining Aditi, she who supporteth all the world. Control the earth, steady the earth, do thou the earth no injury.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नायो॑दा॒नाय॑ प्रति॒ष्ठायै॑ च॒रित्रा॑य ।
अ॒ग्निष्ट्वा॒ऽभि पा॑तु म॒ह्या स्व॒स्त्या छ॒र्दिषा॒ शन्त॑मेन॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वा सी॑द ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāyodānāya pratiṣṭhāyai caritrāya |
agniṣṭvā'bhi pātu mahyā svastyā chardiṣā śantamena tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda ||
verses.translation: For all breath, out-breath; through-breath, upward-breathing, for high position, for prescribed observance, May Agni keep thee safe with great well-being, with the securest shelter. As aforetime with Angiras, with that Deity lie steady.

verses.sanskrit: काण्डा॑त्काण्डात्प्र॒रोह॑न्ती॒ परु॑षः परुष॒स्परि॑ । ए॒वा नो॑ दूर्वे॒ प्र त॑नु स॒हस्रे॑ण श॒तेन॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration: kāṇḍātkāṇḍātprarohantī paruṣaḥ paruṣaspari | evā no dūrve pra tanu sahasreṇa śatena ca ||
verses.translation: Upspringing from thine every joint, upspringing from each knot of thine, Thus with a thousand, Dûrvâ! with a hundred do thou stretch us out.

verses.sanskrit: या श॒तेन॑ प्रत॒नोषि॑ स॒हस्रे॑ण वि॒रोह॑सि । तस्या॑स्ते देवीष्टके वि॒धेम॑ ह॒विषा॑ व॒यम् ॥
verses.transliteration: yā śatena pratanoṣi sahasreṇa virohasi | tasyāste devīṣṭake vidhema haviṣā vayam ||
verses.translation: Thou spreading with a hundred, thou that branched with a thousand shoots, Thee, such, with our oblation will we worship, O celestial Brick.

verses.sanskrit: यास्ते॑ अग्ने॒ सूर्ये॒ रुचो॒ दिव॑मात॒न्वन्ति॑ र॒श्मिभिः॑ । ताभि॑र्नो अ॒द्य सर्वा॑भी रु॒चे जना॑य नस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: yāste agne sūrye ruco divamātanvanti raśmibhiḥ | tābhirno adya sarvābhī ruce janāya naskṛdhi ||
verses.translation: Thy lights, O Agni, in the Sun that with their beams oerspread the sky,— With all of those assist thou us to-day to light and progeny.

verses.sanskrit: या वो॑ दे॒वाः सूर्ये॒ रुचो॒ गोष्वश्वे॑षु॒ या रुचः॑ । इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ ताभिः॒ सर्वा॑भी॒ रुचं॑ नो धत्त बृहस्पते ॥
verses.transliteration: yā vo devāḥ sūrye ruco goṣvaśveṣu yā rucaḥ | indrāgnī tābhiḥ sarvābhī rucaṃ no dhatta bṛhaspate ||
verses.translation: Lights of yours in the Sun, O Gods, or lights that are in kine and steeds, O Indra-Agni, with all those vouchsafe us light, Brihaspati!

verses.sanskrit: वि॒राड्ज्योति॑रधारयत्स्व॒राड्ज्योति॑रधारयत् । प्र॒जाप॑तिष्ट्वा सादयतु पृ॒ष्ठे पृ॑थि॒व्या ज्योति॑ष्मतीम् । विश्व॑स्मै प्रा॒णाया॑पा॒नाय॑ व्या॒नाय॒ विश्वं॒ ज्योति॑र्यच्छ । अ॒ग्निष्टेऽधि॑पति॒स्तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वा सी॑द ॥
verses.transliteration: virāḍjyotiradhārayatsvarāḍjyotiradhārayat | prajāpatiṣṭvā sādayatu pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyā jyotiṣmatīm | viśvasmai prāṇāyāpānāya vyānāya viśvaṃ jyotiryaccha | agniṣṭe'dhipatistayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvā sīda ||
verses.translation: The Far.-Refulgent held the light. The Self-Refulgent held the light. Thee, luminous, may Prajâpati settle upon the back of Earth. Give, to all breathing, all the light, to out-breath, to diffusive breath. Thy Sovran Lord is Agni. With that Deity, as with Angiras, lie firmly settled in thy place.

verses.sanskrit:
मधु॑श्च॒ माध॑वश्च॒ वास॑न्तिकावृ॒तू अ॒ग्नेर॑न्तः श्ले॒षो॒ऽसि॒ कल्पे॑तां॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी कल्प॑न्ता॒माप॒ ओष॑धयः॒ कल्प॑न्ताम॒ग्नयः॒ पृथ॒ङ्नम॒ ज्यैष्ठ्या॑य॒ सव्र॑ताः । ये अ॒ग्नयः॒ सम॑नसोऽन्त॒रा द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी इ॒मे ।
वास॑न्तिकावृ॒तू अ॑भि॒कल्प॑माना॒ इन्द्र॑मिव दे॒वा अ॑भि॒संवि॑शन्तु॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वे सी॑दतम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
madhuśca mādhavaśca vāsantikāvṛtū agnerantaḥ śleṣo'si kalpetāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī kalpantāmāpa oṣadhayaḥ kalpantāmagnayaḥ pṛthaṅnama jyaiṣṭhyāya savratāḥ | ye agnayaḥ samanaso'ntarā dyāvāpṛthivī ime |
vāsantikāvṛtū abhikalpamānā indramiva devā abhisaṃviśantu tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruve sīdatam ||
verses.translation: Madhu and Mâdhava, the two Spring seasons—thou art the innermost cement of Agni. May Heaven and Earth, may Waters, Plants and Agnis help, separate, accordant, my precedence. May all the Fires twixt heaven and earth, one-minded, well-fitted, gather round these two Spring seasons, As the Gods gathering encompass Indra: firm with that Deity, Angiras-like, be seated.

verses.sanskrit:
अषा॑ढाऽसि॒ सह॑माना॒ सह॒स्वारा॑तीः॒ सह॑स्व पृतनाय॒तः ।
स॒हस्र॑वीर्याऽसि॒ सा मा॑ जिन्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṣāḍhā'si sahamānā sahasvārātīḥ sahasva pṛtanāyataḥ |
sahasravīryā'si sā mā jinva ||
verses.translation: Thou art Ashâdhâ, Conquering One. Conquer our foemen, conquer thou the men who fain would-fight with us. A thousand manly powers hast thou: so do thou aid and quicken me.

verses.sanskrit:
मधु॒ वाता॑ ऋताय॒ते मधु॑ क्षरन्ति॒ सिन्ध॑वः ।
माध्वी॑र्नः स॒न्त्वोष॑धीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
madhu vātā ṛtāyate madhu kṣaranti sindhavaḥ |
mādhvīrnaḥ santvoṣadhīḥ ||
verses.translation: The winds waft sweets, the rivers pour sweets for the man who keeps the Law: So may the plants be sweet for us.

verses.sanskrit: मधु॒ नक्त॑मु॒तोषसो॒ मधु॑म॒त्पार्थि॑व॒ᳪ रजः॑ । मधु॒ द्यौर॑स्तु नः पि॒ता ॥
verses.transliteration: madhu naktamutoṣaso madhumatpārthivaṃ rajaḥ | madhu dyaurastu naḥ pitā ||
verses.translation: Sweet be the night and sweet the dawns, sweet the terrestrial atmosphere: Sweet be our Father Heaven to us.

verses.sanskrit: मधु॑मान्नो॒ वन॒स्पति॒र्मधु॑माँ२ अस्तु॒ सूर्यः॑ । माध्वी॒र्गावो॑ भवन्तु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: madhumānno vanaspatirmadhumām̐ astu sūryaḥ | mādhvīrgāvo bhavantu naḥ ||
verses.translation: May the tall tree be full of sweets for us and, and full of sweets the Sun: May our milch-kine be sweet for us.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पां गम्भ॑न्त्सीद॒ मा त्वा॒ सूर्यो॒ऽभि ता॑प्सी॒न्माऽग्निर्वै॑श्वान॒रः ।
अच्छि॑न्नपत्राः प्र॒जा अ॑नु॒वीक्ष॒स्वानु॑ त्वा दि॒व्या वृष्टिः॑ सचताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
apāṃ gambhantsīda mā tvā sūryo'bhi tāpsīnmā'gnirvaiśvānaraḥ |
acchinnapatrāḥ prajā anuvīkṣasvānu tvā divyā vṛṣṭiḥ sacatām ||
verses.translation: Seat thyself in the deepness of the waters, lest Sûrya, lest Vaisvânara Agni scorch thee. With wing unclipped, survey created beings: may rain that cometh down from heaven attend thee.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रीन्त्स॑मु॒द्रान्त्सम॑सृपत् स्व॒र्गान॒पां पति॑र्वृष॒भ इष्ट॑कानाम् ।
पुरी॑षं॒ वसा॑नः सुकृ॒तस्य॑ लो॒के तत्र॑ गच्छ॒ यत्र॒ पूर्वे॒ परे॑ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
trīntsamudrāntsamasṛpat svargānapāṃ patirvṛṣabha iṣṭakānām |
purīṣaṃ vasānaḥ sukṛtasya loke tatra gaccha yatra pūrve paretāḥ ||
verses.translation: He crept across the three heaven-reaching oceans, the Bull of Bricks, the Master of the Waters. Clad in the world with his, the Well-Made's, vesture, go whither those before thee have departed.

verses.sanskrit: म॒ही द्यौः पृ॑थि॒वी च॑ न इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं मि॑मिक्षताम् । पि॒पृ॒तां नो॒ भरी॑मभिः ॥
verses.transliteration: mahī dyauḥ pṛthivī ca na imaṃ yajñaṃ mimikṣatām | pipṛtāṃ no bharīmabhiḥ ||
verses.translation: May Heaven and Earth, the Mighty Pair, besprinkle this our sacrifice, And feed us full with nourishments.

verses.sanskrit: विष्णोः॒ कर्मा॑णि पश्यत॒ यतो॑ व्र॒तानि॑ पस्प॒शे । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ युज्यः॒ सखा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: viṣṇoḥ karmāṇi paśyata yato vratāni paspaśe | indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā ||
verses.translation: Look ye on Vishnu's works whereby the Friend of Indra, close allied, Hath let his holy ways be seen.

verses.sanskrit:
ध्रु॒वाऽसि॑ ध॒रुणे॒तो ज॑ज्ञे प्रथ॒ममे॒भ्यो योनि॑भ्यो॒ अधि॑ जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
स गा॑य॒त्र्या त्रि॒ष्टुभा॑ऽनु॒ष्टुभा॑ च दे॒वेभ्यो॑ ह॒व्यं व॑हतु प्रजा॒नन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhruvā'si dharuṇeto jajñe prathamamebhyo yonibhyo adhi jātavedāḥ |
sa gāyatryā triṣṭubhā'nuṣṭubhā ca devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan ||
verses.translation: Firm art thou, a sustainer. Hence engendered, forth from these wombs at first came Jâtavedas. By Gâyatrî, by Trishtup, by Anushtup, may he who knows bear to the Gods oblation.

verses.sanskrit: इ॒षे रा॒ये र॑मस्व॒ सह॑से द्यु॒म्न ऊ॒र्जे अप॑त्याय । स॒म्राड॑सि स्व॒राड॑सि सारस्व॒तौ त्वोत्सौ॒ प्राव॑ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: iṣe rāye ramasva sahase dyumna ūrje apatyāya | samrāḍasi svarāḍasi sārasvatau tvotsau prāvatām ||
verses.translation: Take thou thine ease for food, for store of riches, for might in splendour, and for strength and offspring. Thou art all-ruling, independent Ruler: both fountains of Sarasvatî protect thee!

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ यु॒क्ष्वा हि ये तवाश्वा॑सो देव सा॒धवः॑ । अरं॒ वह॑न्ति म॒न्यवे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: agne yukṣvā hi ye tavāśvāso deva sādhavaḥ | araṃ vahanti manyave ||
verses.translation: O radiant Agni, harness thou thy steeds which are most excellent! They bear thee as thy spirit wills.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒क्ष्वा हि दे॑व॒हूत॑माँ२ अश्वाँ॑२ अग्ने र॒थीरि॑व । नि होता॑ पू॒र्व्यः स॑दः ॥
verses.transliteration: yukṣvā hi devahūtamām̐ aśvām̐ agne rathīriva | ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ ||
verses.translation: Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invoke the Gods: As ancient Hotar take thy seat.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒म्यक् स्र॑वन्ति स॒रितो॒ न धेना॑ अ॒न्तर्हृ॒दा मन॑सा पू॒यमा॑नाः ।
घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑ अ॒भि चा॑कशीमि हिर॒ण्ययो॑ वेत॒सो मध्ये॑ अ॒ग्नेः ॥
verses.transliteration:
samyak sravanti sarito na dhenā antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ |
ghṛtasya dhārā abhi cākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhye agneḥ ||
verses.translation: Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing themselves in inmost heart and spirit. I look upon the flowing streams of butter: the golden reed is in the midst of Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒चे त्वा॑ रु॒चे त्वा॑ भा॒से त्वा॒ ज्योति॑षे त्वा ।
अभू॑दि॒दं विश्व॑स्य॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ वाजि॑नम॒ग्नेर्वै॑श्वान॒रस्य॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛce tvā ruce tvā bhāse tvā jyotiṣe tvā |
abhūdidaṃ viśvasya bhuvanasya vājinamagnervaiśvānarasya ca ||
verses.translation: Thee for the praise-verse, thee for sheen, thee for bright splendour, thee for light. This hath become the energetic spirit of all the world and of Vaisvânara Agni.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्ज्योति॑षा॒ ज्योति॑ष्मान् रु॒क्मो वर्च॑सा॒ वर्च॑स्वान् । स॒ह॒स्र॒दा अ॑सि स॒हस्रा॑य त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: agnirjyotiṣā jyotiṣmān rukmo varcasā varcasvān | sahasradā asi sahasrāya tvā ||
verses.translation: Agni, all-luminous with light, splendid with splendour, golden One. Giver of thousands art thou: for a thousand thee.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒दि॒त्यं गर्भं॒ पय॑सा॒ सम॑ङ्धि स॒हस्र॑स्य प्रति॒मां वि॒श्वरू॑पम् ।
परि॑ वृङ्धि॒ हर॑सा॒ माऽभि म॑ᳪस्थाः श॒तायु॑षं कृणुहि ची॒यमा॑नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ādityaṃ garbhaṃ payasā samaṅdhi sahasrasya pratimāṃ viśvarūpam |
pari vṛṅdhi harasā mā'bhi maṃsthāḥ śatāyuṣaṃ kṛṇuhi cīyamānaḥ ||
verses.translation: Balm thou with milk the unborn babe Âditya, wearing all forms, creator of a thousand. Spare, him with heat, nor plot against him: give him a hundred years of life while thou art building.

verses.sanskrit:
वात॑स्य जू॒तिं वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभि॒मश्वं॑ जज्ञा॒नᳪ स॑रि॒रस्य॒ मध्ये॑ ।
शिशुं॑ न॒दीना॒ᳪ ह॒रि॒मद्रि॑बुध्न॒मग्ने॒ मा हि॑ᳪसीः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vātasya jūtiṃ varuṇasya nābhimaśvaṃ jajñānaṃ sarirasya madhye |
śiśuṃ nadīnāṃ harimadribudhnamagne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman ||
verses.translation: The wind's impetuous rush, Varuna's navel! the horse that springs to life amid the waters! The rivers tawny child, based on the mountain, harm not, O Agni, in the loftiest region.

verses.sanskrit:
अज॑स्र॒मिन्दु॑मरु॒षं भु॑र॒ण्युम॒ग्निमी॑डे पू॒र्वचि॑त्तिं॒ नमो॑भिः ।
स पर्व॑भिरृतु॒शः कल्प॑मानो॒ गां मा हि॑ᳪसी॒रदि॑तिं वि॒राज॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajasramindumaruṣaṃ bhuraṇyumagnimīḍe pūrvacittiṃ namobhiḥ |
sa parvabhirṛtuśaḥ kalpamāno gāṃ mā hiṃsīraditiṃ virājam ||
verses.translation: Unwasting Drop, red, eager, pressing forward, Agni I worship with repeated homage. Forming thyself with joints in proper order, harm not the Cow, Aditi widely ruling!

verses.sanskrit:
वरू॑त्रीं॒ त्वष्टु॒र्वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभि॒मविं॑ जज्ञा॒नाᳪ रज॑सः॒ पर॑स्मात् ।
म॒हीᳪ सा॑ह॒स्रीमसु॑रस्य मा॒यामग्ने॒ मा हि॑ᳪसीः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
varūtrīṃ tvaṣṭurvaruṇasya nābhimaviṃ jajñānāṃ rajasaḥ parasmāt |
mahīṃ sāhasrīmasurasya māyāmagne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman ||
verses.translation: Her who is Tvashtar's guardian, Varuna's navel, the Ewe brought forth from out the loftiest region, The Asura's mighty thousandfold contrivance, injure not in the highest sphere, O Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
यो अ॒ग्निर॒ग्नेरध्यजा॑यत॒ शोका॑त्पृथि॒व्या उ॒त वा॑ दि॒वस्परि॑ ।
येन॑ प्र॒जा वि॒श्वक॑र्मा ज॒जान॒ तम॑ग्ने॒ हेडः॒ परि॑ ते वृणक्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo agniragneradhyajāyata śokātpṛthivyā uta vā divaspari |
yena prajā viśvakarmā jajāna tamagne heḍaḥ pari te vṛṇaktu ||
verses.translation: The Agni who from Agni had his being, from heat of Earth or also heat of Heaven, Whereby the Omnific One engendered creatures, him may thy fierce displeasure spare, O Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
चि॒त्रं दे॒वाना॒मुद॑गा॒दनी॑कं॒ चक्षु॑र्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्या॒ग्नेः ।
आऽप्रा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ᳪ सूर्य॑ आ॒त्मा जग॑तस्त॒स्थुष॑श्च ॥
verses.transliteration:
citraṃ devānāmudagādanīkaṃ cakṣurmitrasya varuṇasyāgneḥ |
ā'prā dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣaṃ sūrya ātmā jagatastasthuṣaśca ||
verses.translation: The brilliant presence of the Gods hath risen, the eye of Mitra, Varuna, and Agni. The soul of all that moveth not or moveth, the Sun hath filled the air, and earth and heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं मा हि॑ᳪसीर्द्वि॒पादं॑ प॒शुᳪ स॑हस्रा॒क्षो मेधा॑य ची॒यमा॑नः ।
म॒युं प॒शुं मेध॑मग्ने जुषस्व॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो नि षी॑द ।
म॒युं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ mā hiṃsīrdvipādaṃ paśuṃ sahasrākṣo medhāya cīyamānaḥ |
mayuṃ paśuṃ medhamagne juṣasva tena cinvānastanvo ni ṣīda |
mayuṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu ||
verses.translation: Injure not, thousand-eyed, while thou art building for sacrifice, this animal, the biped. Accept as pith man's counterfeit the victim, Agni: therewith building thy forms, be settled. Let thy flame reach man's counterfeit: let thy flame reach the man we hate.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं मा हि॑ᳪसी॒रेक॑शफं प॒शुं क॑निक्र॒दं वा॒जिनं॒ वाजि॑नेषु ।
गौ॒रमा॑र॒ण्यमनु॑ ते दिशामि॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो नि षी॑द ।
गौ॒रं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ mā hiṃsīrekaśaphaṃ paśuṃ kanikradaṃ vājinaṃ vājineṣu |
gauramāraṇyamanu te diśāmi tena cinvānastanvo ni ṣīda |
gauraṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu ||
verses.translation: Harm not this animal whose hooves are solid, the courser neighing in the midst of coursers. I dedicate to thee the forest Gaura: building thy bodies up with him be settled. Let thy flame reach the Gaura, let thy flame reach him whom we detest.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मᳪ सा॑ह॒स्रᳪ श॒तधा॑र॒मुत्सं॑ व्य॒च्यमा॑नᳪ सरि॒रस्य॒ मध्ये॑ ।
घृ॒तं दुहा॑ना॒मदि॑तिं॒ जना॒याग्ने॒ मा हि॑ᳪसीः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् ।
ग॒व॒यमा॑र॒ण्यमनु॑ ते दिशामि॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो नि षी॑द ।
ग॒व॒यं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ sāhasraṃ śatadhāramutsaṃ vyacyamānaṃ sarirasya madhye |
ghṛtaṃ duhānāmaditiṃ janāyāgne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman |
gavayamāraṇyamanu te diśāmi tena cinvānastanvo ni ṣīda |
gavayaṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu ||
verses.translation: Thousandfold, with a hundred streams, this fountain, expanded in the middle of the waters, Infinite, yielding butter for the people, harm not, O Agni, in the highest region. This wild bull of the forest I assign thee: building thy bodies up therewith be settled. Let thy flame reach the wild hull, etc. (as in 48).

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒ममू॑र्णा॒युं वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभिं॒ त्वचं॑ पशू॒नां द्वि॒पदां॒ चतु॑ष्पदाम् ।
त्वष्टुः॑ प्र॒जानां॑ प्रथ॒मं ज॒नित्र॒मग्ने॒ मा हि॑ᳪसीः पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् ।
उष्ट्र॑मार॒ण्यमनु॑ ते दिशामि॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒वो नि षी॑द ।
उष्ट्रं॑ ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
imamūrṇāyuṃ varuṇasya nābhiṃ tvacaṃ paśūnāṃ dvipadāṃ catuṣpadām |
tvaṣṭuḥ prajānāṃ prathamaṃ janitramagne mā hiṃsīḥ parame vyoman |
uṣṭramāraṇyamanu te diśāmi tena cinvānastavo ni ṣīda |
uṣṭraṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu ||
verses.translation: This creature clothed in wool, Varuna's navel, the skin of animals quadruped and biped, The first that was produced of Tvashtar's creatures, O Agni, harm not in the highest region. The forest buffalo do I assign thee: building, etc., as above mutato mutando.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒जो ह्य॒ग्नेरज॑निष्ट॒ शोका॒त्सो अ॑पश्यज्जनि॒तार॒मग्रे॑ ।
तेन॑ दे॒वा दे॒वता॒मग्र॑मायँ॒स्तेन॒ रोह॑माय॒न्नुप॒ मेध्या॑सः ।
श॒र॒भमा॑र॒ण्यमनु॑ ते दिशामि॒ तेन॑ चिन्वा॒नस्त॒न्वो नि षी॑द ।
श॒र॒भं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु॒ यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajo hyagnerajaniṣṭa śokātso apaśyajjanitāramagre |
tena devā devatāmagramāyam̐stena rohamāyannupa medhyāsaḥ |
śarabhamāraṇyamanu te diśāmi tena cinvānastanvo ni ṣīda |
śarabhaṃ te śugṛcchatu yaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu ||
verses.translation: From Agni's warmth the he-goat had his being: he looked at first upon his generator. Thereby the Gods at first attained to Godhead: those meet for worship to the height ascended. The forest Sarabha do I assign thee: building, etc.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं य॑विष्ठ दा॒शुषो॒ नॄँः पा॑हि शृणु॒धी गिरः॑ । रक्षा॑ तो॒कमु॒त त्मना॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ yaviṣṭha dāśuṣo nṝm̐ḥ pāhi śṛṇudhī giraḥ | rakṣā tokamuta tmanā ||
verses.translation: Do thou, Most Youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs, Protect his offspring and himself.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पां त्वेम॑न्त्सादयाम्य॒पां त्वोद्म॑न्त्सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ भस्म॑न्त्सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ ज्योति॑षि सादयाम्य॒पां त्वाऽय॑ने सादयाम्यर्ण॒वे त्वा॒ सद॑ने सादयामि समु॒द्रे त्वा॒ सद॑ने सादयामि सरि॒रे त्वा॒ सद॑ने सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ क्षये॑ सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ सधि॑षि सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ सद॑ने सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॑ स॒धस्थे॑ सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ योनौ॑ सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ पुरी॑षे सादयाम्य॒पां त्वा॒ पाथ॑सि सादयामि
