verses.translation: Homage to the troops and to you lords of troops be homage. Homage to the companies and to you lords of companies, homage. Homage to sharpers and to you lords of sharpers, homage. Homage to you the deformed, and to you who wear all forms, homage!

verses.sanskrit: नमः॒ सेना॑भ्यः सेना॒निभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ र॒थिभ्यो॑ अर॒तेभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमः॑ क्ष॒त्तृभ्यः॑ संग्रही॒तृभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ म॒हद्भ्यो॑ अर्भ॒केभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: namaḥ senābhyaḥ senānibhyaśca vo namo namo rathibhyo aratebhyaśca vo namo namaḥ kṣattṛbhyaḥ saṃgrahītṛbhyaśca vo namo namo mahadbhyo arbhakebhyaśca vo namaḥ ||
verses.translation: Homage to armies and to you the leaders of armies, homage. Homage to you car-borne and to you who are carless, homage. Homage to the charioteers and to you drivers of horses, homage. Homage to you the great and to you the small, homage.

verses.sanskrit: नम॒स्तक्ष॑भ्यो रथका॒रेभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमः॒ कुला॑लेभ्यः कु॒र्मारे॑भ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ निषा॒देभ्यः॑ पु॒ञ्जिष्टे॑भ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमः॑ श्व॒निभ्यो॑ मृग॒युभ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: namastakṣabhyo rathakārebhyaśca vo namo namaḥ kulālebhyaḥ kurmārebhyaśca vo namo namo niṣādebhyaḥ puñjiṣṭebhyaśca vo namo namaḥ śvanibhyo mṛgayubhyaśca vo namaḥ ||
verses.translation: Homage to you carpenters, and to you chariot-makers homage. Homage to you potters and to you blacksmiths, homage. Homage to you Nishâdas and to you Puñjishthas, homage. Homage to you dog-leaders, and to you hunters, homage.

verses.sanskrit: नमः॒ श्वभ्यः॒ श्वप॑तिभ्यश्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ भ॒वाय॑ च रु॒द्राय॑ च॒ नमः॑ श॒र्वाय॑ च पशु॒पत॑ये च॒ नमो॒ नील॑ग्रीवाय च शिति॒कण्ठा॑य च ॥
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śvabhyaḥ śvapatibhyaśca vo namo namo bhavāya ca rudrāya ca namaḥ śarvāya ca paśupataye ca namo nīlagrīvāya ca śitikaṇṭhāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to dogs, and to you masters of dogs, homage. Homage to Bhava, and to Rudra homage, homage to Sarva and to Pasupati, and to Nîlagrîva and Sitikantha, homage.

verses.sanskrit:
नमः॑ कप॒र्दिने॑ च॒ व्यु॒प्तकेशाय च॒ नमः॑ सहस्रा॒क्षाय॑ च श॒तध॑न्वने च॒ नमो॑ गिरिश॒याय॑ च शिपिवि॒ष्टाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ मी॒ढुष्ट॑माय॒ चेषु॑मते
च ॥
verses.transliteration:
namaḥ kapardine ca vyuptakeśāya ca namaḥ sahasrākṣāya ca śatadhanvane ca namo giriśayāya ca śipiviṣṭāya ca namo mīḍhuṣṭamāya ceṣumate
ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to him with braided hair and to him with shaven hair, homage! homage to the thousand-eyed and to him with a hundred bows, homage! To the mountain-haunter and to Sipivishta, homage! To the most bountiful, armed with arrows, homage!

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ ह्र॒स्वाय॑ च वाम॒नाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ बृह॒ते च॒ वर्षी॑यसे च॒ नमो॑ वृ॒द्धाय॑ च स॒वृधे॑ च॒ नमोऽग्र्या॑य च प्रथ॒माय॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration: namo hrasvāya ca vāmanāya ca namo bṛhate ca varṣīyase ca namo vṛddhāya ca savṛdhe ca namo'gryāya ca prathamāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to the short, and to the dwarf, homage, homage to the great and to the adult, homage! Homage to the full-grown and to the growing, to the foremost and to the first be homage.

verses.sanskrit: नम॑ आ॒शवे॑ चाजि॒राय॑ च॒ नमः॒ शीघ्र्या॑य च॒ शीभ्या॑य च॒ नम॒ ऊर्म्या॑य चावस्व॒न्या॒य च॒ नमो॑ नादे॒याय॑ च॒ द्वीप्या॑य च ॥
verses.transliteration: nama āśave cājirāya ca namaḥ śīghryāya ca śībhyāya ca nama ūrmyāya cāvasvanyāya ca namo nādeyāya ca dvīpyāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to the swift, and to the active be homage, and to the hasty and to the rapid mover be homage! Homage to him who dwells in waves, and in still waters, to him who dwells in rivers and on islands.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ ज्ये॒ष्ठाय॑ च कनि॒ष्ठाय॑ च॒ नमः॑ पूर्व॒जाय॑ चापर॒जाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ मध्य॒माय॑ चापग॒ल्भाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ जघ॒न्या॒य च बु॒ध्न्या॒य च ॥
verses.transliteration: namo jyeṣṭhāya ca kaniṣṭhāya ca namaḥ pūrvajāya cāparajāya ca namo madhyamāya cāpagalbhāya ca namo jaghanyāya ca budhnyāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to the eldest and to the youngest, to the first-born and to the last-born, homage! Homage to the middle-most and to the immature, to the lowest and to him who is in the depth, be homage!

verses.sanskrit: नमः॒ सोभ्या॑य च प्रतिस॒र्या॒य च॒ नमो॒ याम्या॑य च॒ क्षेम्या॑य च॒ नमः॒ श्लोक्या॑य चावसा॒न्या॒य च॒ नम॑ उर्व॒र्या॒य च॒ खल्या॑य च ॥
verses.transliteration: namaḥ sobhyāya ca pratisaryāya ca namo yāmyāya ca kṣemyāya ca namaḥ ślokyāya cāvasānyāya ca nama urvaryāya ca khalyāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to Sobhya and to the dweller in the magic amulet, homage! Homage to him who is allied to Yama, to him who prospers be homage! Homage to the famous and to the endmost, to him of the sown corn-land and to him of the threshing-floor be homage.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॒ वन्या॑य च॒ कक्ष्या॑य च॒ नमः॑ श्र॒वाय॑ च प्रतिश्र॒वाय॑ च॒ नम॑ आ॒शुषे॑णाय चा॒शुर॑थाय च॒ नमः॒ शूरा॑य चावभे॒दिने॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration: namo vanyāya ca kakṣyāya ca namaḥ śravāya ca pratiśravāya ca nama āśuṣeṇāya cāśurathāya ca namaḥ śūrāya cāvabhedine ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to him in woods and to him in bushes, homage! Homage to him as sound and to him as echo, homage! Homage to him with swift armies and to him with swift chariots, homage! Homage to the hero, and to him who rends asunder be homage.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ बि॒ल्मिने॑ च कव॒चिने॑ च॒ नमो॑ व॒र्मिणे॑ च वरू॒थिने॑ च॒ नमः॑ श्रु॒ताय॑ च श्रुतसे॒नाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ दुन्दु॒भ्या॒य चाहन॒न्या॒य च ॥
verses.transliteration: namo bilmine ca kavacine ca namo varmiṇe ca varūthine ca namaḥ śrutāya ca śrutasenāya ca namo dundubhyāya cāhananyāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to him who wears a helmet, and to him who wears a cuirass, homage! To him who wears mail and defensive armour, homage! To the renowned one and to him whose army is renowned be homage, to him who is in drums and to him who makes himself known by beating them.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॑ धृ॒ष्णवे॑ च प्रमृ॒शाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ निष॒ङ्गिणे॑ चेषुधि॒मते॑ च॒ नम॑स्ती॒क्ष्णेष॑वे चायु॒धिने॑ च॒ नमः॑ स्वायु॒धाय॑ च सु॒धन्व॑ने च ॥
verses.transliteration: namo dhṛṣṇave ca pramṛśāya ca namo niṣaṅgiṇe ceṣudhimate ca namastīkṣṇeṣave cāyudhine ca namaḥ svāyudhāya ca sudhanvane ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to the bold one and to the prudent, homage to him who carries sword and quiver, homage to him who hath keen arrows and is armed with weapons, homage to him who hath good weapons and a good bow.

verses.sanskrit: नमः॒ स्रुत्या॑य च॒ पथ्या॑य च॒ नमः॒ काट्या॑य च॒ नीप्या॑य च॒ नमः॒ कुल्या॑य च सर॒स्या॒य च॒ नमो॑ नादे॒याय॑ च वैश॒न्ताय॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration: namaḥ srutyāya ca pathyāya ca namaḥ kāṭyāya ca nīpyāya ca namaḥ kulyāya ca sarasyāya ca namo nādeyāya ca vaiśantāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to him who dwells on paths and roads, homage to him who dwells in rugged spots and on the skirts of mountains, homage to him who dwells in water courses and lakes, homage to him who dwells in rivers and mores.

verses.sanskrit: नमः॒ कूप्या॑य चाव॒ट्या॑य च॒ नमो॒ वीध्र्या॑य चात॒प्या॒य च॒ नमो॒ मेघ्या॑य च च विद्यु॒त्या॒य च॒ नमो॒ वर्ष्या॑य चाव॒र्ष्याय॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration: namaḥ kūpyāya cāvaṭyāya ca namo vīdhryāya cātapyāya ca namo meghyāya ca ca vidyutyāya ca namo varṣyāya cāvarṣyāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to him who dwells in wells and pits, homage to him who dwells in bright sky and sunlight. Homage to him who dwells in cloud and lightning, homage to him who dwells in rain and to him who dwells in fair weather.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॒ वात्या॑य च॒ रेष्म्या॑य च॒ नमो॑ वास्त॒व्या॒य च वास्तु॒पाय॑ च॒ नमः॒ सोमा॑य च रु॒द्राय॑ च॒ नम॑स्ता॒म्राय॑ चारु॒णाय॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration: namo vātyāya ca reṣmyāya ca namo vāstavyāya ca vāstupāya ca namaḥ somāya ca rudrāya ca namastāmrāya cāruṇāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to him who dwells in wind and to him who dwells in tempest, homage to the dweller in houses and to the house-protector. Homage to Soma and to Rudra, homage to the copper-coloured and to the ruddy One.

verses.sanskrit: नमः॑ श॒ङ्गवे॑ च पशु॒पत॑ये च॒ नम॑ उ॒ग्राय॑ च भी॒माय॑ च॒ नमो॑ऽग्रेव॒धाय॑ च दूरेव॒धाय॑ च॒ नमो॑ ह॒न्त्रे च॒ हनी॑यसे च॒ नमो॑ वृ॒क्षेभ्यो॒ हरि॑केशेभ्यो॒ नम॑स्ता॒राय॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śaṅgave ca paśupataye ca nama ugrāya ca bhīmāya ca namo'grevadhāya ca dūrevadhāya ca namo hantre ca hanīyase ca namo vṛkṣebhyo harikeśebhyo namastārāya ||
verses.translation: Homage to the giver of weal, and to Pasupati, homage to the fierce and to the terrific. Homage to him who slays in front and to him who slays at a distance, homage to the slayer and to the frequent slayer, homage to the green-tressed trees, homage to the deliverer.

verses.sanskrit: नमः॑ शम्भ॒वाय॑ च मयोभ॒वाय॑ च॒ नमः॑ शङ्क॒राय॑ च मयस्क॒राय॑ च॒ नमः॑ शि॒वाय॑ च शि॒वत॑राय च ॥
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śambhavāya ca mayobhavāya ca namaḥ śaṅkarāya ca mayaskarāya ca namaḥ śivāya ca śivatarāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to the source of happiness and to the source of delight, homage to the causer of happiness and to the causer of delight, homage to the auspicious, homage to the most auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: नमः॒ पार्या॑य चावा॒र्या॒य च॒ नमः॑ प्र॒तर॑णाय चो॒त्तर॑णाय च॒ नम॒स्तीर्थ्या॑य च॒ कूल्या॑य च॒ नमः॒ शष्प्या॑य च॒ फेन्या॑य च ॥
verses.transliteration: namaḥ pāryāya cāvāryāya ca namaḥ prataraṇāya cottaraṇāya ca namastīrthyāya ca kūlyāya ca namaḥ śaṣpyāya ca phenyāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to him who is beyond and to him who is on this side, homage to him who crosses over and to him who crosses back. Homage to him who is in fords and on river banks, homage to him who is in tender grass and in foam.

verses.sanskrit: नमः॑ सिक॒त्या॒य च प्रवा॒ह्या॒य च॒ नमः॑ किᳪशि॒लाय॑ च क्षय॒णाय॑ च॒ नमः॑ कप॒र्दिने॑ च पुल॒स्तये॑ च॒ नम॑ इरि॒ण्या॒य च प्रप॒थ्या॒य च ॥
verses.transliteration: namaḥ sikatyāya ca pravāhyāya ca namaḥ kiṃśilāya ca kṣayaṇāya ca namaḥ kapardine ca pulastaye ca nama iriṇyāya ca prapathyāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to him who is in sand and to him who is in running water, homage to him who is on pebbly ground and to him who is where still water stands. Homage to him who wears braided hair and to him whose hair is smooth. Homage to him who is in deserts and to him who is on broad roads.

verses.sanskrit: नमो॒ व्रज्या॑य च॒ गोष्ठ्या॑य च॒ नम॒स्तल्प्या॑य च॒ गेह्या॑य च॒ नमो॑ हृद॒य्या॒य च निवे॒ष्प्या॒य च॒ नमः॒ काट्या॑य च गह्वरे॒ष्ठाय॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration: namo vrajyāya ca goṣṭhyāya ca namastalpyāya ca gehyāya ca namo hṛdayyāya ca niveṣpyāya ca namaḥ kāṭyāya ca gahvareṣṭhāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to him who is in herds of cattle and to him who is in cow-pens, homage to him who is on beds and to him who is in houses. Homage to him who is in hearts, and to him who is in whirlpools, homage to him who is in wells and to him who is in abysses.

verses.sanskrit: नमः॒ शुष्क्या॑य च हरि॒त्या॒य च॒ नमः॑ पाᳪस॒व्या॒य च रज॒स्या॒य च॒ नमो॒ लोप्या॑य चोल॒प्या॒य च॒ नम॒ ऊर्व्या॑य च॒ सूर्व्या॑य च ॥
verses.transliteration: namaḥ śuṣkyāya ca harityāya ca namaḥ pāṃsavyāya ca rajasyāya ca namo lopyāya colapyāya ca nama ūrvyāya ca sūrvyāya ca ||
verses.translation: Homage to him who is in dry things and to him who is in green things. Homage to him who is in dust and to him who is in vapour. Homage to him who is in inaccessible places, homage to him who is in creeping plants, homage to him who is in the earth and to him who is in good soil.

verses.sanskrit: नमः॑ प॒र्णाय॑ च पर्णश॒दाय॑ च॒ नम॑ उद्गु॒रमा॑णाय चाभिघ्न॒ते च॒ नम॑ आखिद॒ते च॑ प्रखिद॒ते च॒ नम॑ इषु॒कृद्भ्यो॑ धनु॒ष्कृद्भ्य॑श्च वो॒ नमो॒ नमो॑ वः किरि॒केभ्यो॑ दे॒वाना॒ᳪ हृद॑येभ्यो॒ नमो॑ विचिन्व॒त्केभ्यो॒ नमो॑ विक्षिण॒त्केभ्यो॒ नम॑ आनिर्ह॒तेभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: namaḥ parṇāya ca parṇaśadāya ca nama udguramāṇāya cābhighnate ca nama ākhidate ca prakhidate ca nama iṣukṛdbhyo dhanuṣkṛdbhyaśca vo namo namo vaḥ kirikebhyo devānāṃ hṛdayebhyo namo vicinvatkebhyo namo vikṣiṇatkebhyo nama ānirhatebhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: Homage to him who is in leaves and to him who is in the falling of leaves. Homage to him with the threatening voice and to him who slays, homage to him who troubles and to him who afflicts. Homage to you arrow-makers and to you bow-makers, homage to you sprinklers, to the hearts of the Gods. Homage to the discerners, homage to the destroyers; homage to the indestructible.

verses.sanskrit:
द्रापे॒ अन्ध॑सस्पते॒ दरि॑द्र॒ नील॑लोहित ।
आ॒सां प्र॒जाना॑मे॒षां प॑शू॒नां मा भे॒र्मा रो॒ङ्मो च॑ नः॒ किंच॒नाम॑मत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
drāpe andhasaspate daridra nīlalohita |
āsāṃ prajānāmeṣāṃ paśūnāṃ mā bhermā roṅmo ca naḥ kiṃcanāmamat ||
verses.translation: Pursuer, Lord of Soma juice, thou cleaver, coloured blue and red, Cleave not, destroy not one of these our children, nor of these our beasts, let nothing that is ours be sick.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा रु॒द्राय॑ त॒वसे॑ कप॒र्दिने॑ क्ष॒यद्वी॑राय॒ प्र भ॑रामहे म॒तीः ।
यथा॒ शमस॑द् द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे॒ विश्वं॑ पु॒ष्टं ग्रामे॑ अ॒स्मिन्न॑नातु॒रम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
imā rudrāya tavase kapardine kṣayadvīrāya pra bharāmahe matīḥ |
yathā śamasad dvipade catuṣpade viśvaṃ puṣṭaṃ grāme asminnanāturam ||
verses.translation: To the strong Rudra bring we these our songs of praise, to him the Lord of Heroes, with the braided hair, That it be well with all our cattle and our men, that in this village all be healthy and well-fed.

verses.sanskrit: या ते॑ रुद्र शि॒वा त॒नूः शि॒वा वि॒श्वाहा॑ भेष॒जी । शि॒वा रु॒तस्य॑ भेष॒जी तया॑ नो मृड जी॒वसे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yā te rudra śivā tanūḥ śivā viśvāhā bheṣajī | śivā rutasya bheṣajī tayā no mṛḍa jīvase ||
verses.translation: Rudra, with that auspicious form of thine which healeth every day, Auspicious, healer of disease, be kind to us that we may live.

verses.sanskrit:
परि॑ नो रु॒द्रस्य॑ हे॒तिर्वृ॑णक्तु॒ परि॑ त्वे॒षस्य॑ दुर्म॒तिर॑घा॒योः ।
अव॑ स्थि॒रा म॒घव॑द्भ्यस्तनुष्व॒ मीढ्व॑स्तो॒काय॒ तन॑याय मृड ॥
verses.transliteration:
pari no rudrasya hetirvṛṇaktu pari tveṣasya durmatiraghāyoḥ |
ava sthirā maghavadbhyastanuṣva mīḍhvastokāya tanayāya mṛḍa ||
verses.translation: May Rudra's missile turn aside and spare us, the great wrath of the impetuous One avoid us. Turn, Bounteous God, thy strong bow from our princes, and be thou gracious to our seed and offspring.

verses.sanskrit:
मीढु॑ष्टम॒ शिव॑तम शि॒वो नः॑ सु॒मना॑ भव ।
प॒र॒मे वृ॒क्ष आयु॑धं नि॒धाय॒ कृत्तिं॒ वसा॑न॒ आ च॑र॒ पिना॑कं॒ बिभ्र॒दा ग॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration:
mīḍhuṣṭama śivatama śivo naḥ sumanā bhava |
parame vṛkṣa āyudhaṃ nidhāya kṛttiṃ vasāna ā cara pinākaṃ bibhradā gahi ||
verses.translation: Most bounteous, most auspicious, be auspicious, well inclined to us. On some remotest tree lay down thy weapon. and clad in robe of skin approach, bearing thy bow come hitherward.

verses.sanskrit: विकि॑रिद्र॒ विलो॑हित॒ नम॑स्ते अस्तु भगवः । यास्ते॑ स॒हस्र॑ᳪ हे॒तयो॒ऽन्यम॒स्मन्नि व॑पन्तु॒ ताः ॥
verses.transliteration: vikiridra vilohita namaste astu bhagavaḥ | yāste sahasraṃ hetayo'nyamasmanni vapantu tāḥ ||
verses.translation: O Wound averter, purple-hued, to thee be homage, holy Lord! May all those thousand darts of thine strike dead another one than us.

verses.sanskrit: स॒हस्रा॑णि सहस्र॒शो बा॒ह्वोस्तव॑ हे॒तयः॑ । तासा॒मीशा॑नो भगवः परा॒चीना॒ मुखा॑ कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration: sahasrāṇi sahasraśo bāhvostava hetayaḥ | tāsāmīśāno bhagavaḥ parācīnā mukhā kṛdhi ||
verses.translation: Thousands of thousands are the shafts, the missiles ready in thy hands: Thou holy Lord, who hast the power, turn thou their points away from us.

verses.sanskrit: असं॑ख्याता स॒हस्रा॑णि॒ ये रु॒द्रा अधि॒ भूम्या॑म् । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: asaṃkhyātā sahasrāṇi ye rudrā adhi bhūmyām | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi ||
verses.translation: Innumerable thousands are the Rudras on the face of earth: Of all these Rudras we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒स्मिन् म॑ह॒त्य॒र्ण॒वे ऽन्तरि॑क्षे भ॒वा अधि॑ । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: asmin mahatyarṇave 'ntarikṣe bhavā adhi | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi ||
verses.translation: Bhavas there are above us in this mighty billowy sea of air, Of all of these do we unbend, etc.

verses.sanskrit: नील॑ग्रीवाः शिति॒कण्ठा॒ दिव॑ᳪ रु॒द्रा उप॑श्रिताः । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhā divaṃ rudrā upaśritāḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi ||
verses.translation: Rudras are dwelling in the sky, whose necks are blue, whose throats are white: Of these do we unbend the bows a thousand leagues away from us.

verses.sanskrit: नील॑ग्रीवाः शिति॒कण्ठाः॑ श॒र्वा अ॒धः क्ष॑माच॒राः । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: nīlagrīvāḥ śitikaṇṭhāḥ śarvā adhaḥ kṣamācarāḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi ||
verses.translation: Sarvas haunt realms beneath the earth—their necks are blue, their throats are white: Of these, etc.

verses.sanskrit: ये वृ॒क्षेषु॑ श॒ष्पिञ्ज॑रा॒ नील॑ग्रीवा॒ विलो॑हिताः । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: ye vṛkṣeṣu śaṣpiñjarā nīlagrīvā vilohitāḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi ||
verses.translation: These, green like young grass, in the trees, with azure necks and purple hue, Of those, etc.

verses.sanskrit: ये भू॒ताना॒मधि॑पतयो विशि॒खासः॑ कप॒र्दिनः॑ । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: ye bhūtānāmadhipatayo viśikhāsaḥ kapardinaḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi ||
verses.translation: Those, ministering spirits lords, with no hair-tufts, with braided locks, Of these, etc.

verses.sanskrit: ये प॒थां प॑थि॒रक्ष॑य ऐलबृ॒दा आ॑यु॒र्युधः॑ । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: ye pathāṃ pathirakṣaya ailabṛdā āyuryudhaḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi ||
verses.translation: Those, the protectors of the paths, bringers of food, who fight for life. Of these, etc.

verses.sanskrit: ये ती॒र्थानि॑ प्र॒चर॑न्ति सृ॒काह॑स्ता निष॒ङ्गिणः॑ । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: ye tīrthāni pracaranti sṛkāhastā niṣaṅgiṇaḥ | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi ||
verses.translation: Those who with arrows in their hand, and armed with words, frequent the fords, Of these, etc.

verses.sanskrit: येऽन्ने॑षु वि॒विध्य॑न्ति॒ पात्रे॑षु॒ पिब॑तो॒ जना॑न् । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: ye'nneṣu vividhyanti pātreṣu pibato janān | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi ||
verses.translation: Those who, inhabiting the food, vex men while drinking from their cups, etc.

verses.sanskrit: य ए॒ताव॑न्तश्च॒ भूया॑ᳪसश्च॒ दिशो॑ रु॒द्रा वि॑तस्थि॒रे । तेषा॑ᳪ सहस्रयोज॒नेऽव॒ धन्वा॑नि तन्मसि ॥
verses.transliteration: ya etāvantaśca bhūyāṃsaśca diśo rudrā vitasthire | teṣāṃ sahasrayojane'va dhanvāni tanmasi ||
verses.translation: Rudras so many and still more, lodged in the quarters of the sky, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
नमो॑ऽस्तु रु॒द्रेभ्यो॒ ये दि॒वि येषां॑ व॒र्षमिष॑वः । तेभ्यो॒ दश॒ प्राची॒र्दश॑ दक्षि॒णा दश॑ प्र॒तीची॒र्दशोदी॑ची॒र्दशो॒र्ध्वाः ।
तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ऽवन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः ॥
verses.transliteration:
namo'stu rudrebhyo ye divi yeṣāṃ varṣamiṣavaḥ | tebhyo daśa prācīrdaśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīrdaśodīcīrdaśordhvāḥ |
tebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ ||
verses.translation: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is sky, whose arrows floods of rain. To them ten eastward, southward ten, ten to the south, ten to the north, ten to the region uppermost! To them be homage! May they spare and guard us. Within their jaws we lay the man who hates us and whom we abhor.

verses.sanskrit:
नमो॑ऽस्तु रु॒द्रेभ्यो॒ येऽन्तरि॑क्षे॒ येषां॒ वात॒ इष॑वः । तेभ्यो॒ दश॒ प्राची॒र्दश॑ दक्षि॒णा दश॑ प्र॒तीची॒र्दशोदी॑ची॒र्दशो॒र्ध्वाः ।
तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ऽवन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः ॥
verses.transliteration:
namo'stu rudrebhyo ye'ntarikṣe yeṣāṃ vāta iṣavaḥ | tebhyo daśa prācīrdaśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīrdaśodīcīrdaśordhvāḥ |
tebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ ||
verses.translation: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is air, whose arrows is the rain. To them, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
नमो॑ऽस्तु रु॒द्रेभ्यो॒ ये पृ॑थि॒व्यां येषा॒मन्न॒मिष॑वः । तेभ्यो॒ दश॒ प्राची॒र्दश॑ दक्षि॒णा दश॑ प्र॒तीची॒र्दशोदी॑ची॒र्दशो॒र्ध्वाः ।
तेभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्तु॒ ते नो॑ऽवन्तु॒ ते नो॑ मृडयन्तु॒ ते यं द्वि॒ष्मो यश्च॑ नो॒ द्वेष्टि॒ तमे॑षां॒ जम्भे॑ दध्मः ॥
verses.transliteration:
namo'stu rudrebhyo ye pṛthivyāṃ yeṣāmannamiṣavaḥ | tebhyo daśa prācīrdaśa dakṣiṇā daśa pratīcīrdaśodīcīrdaśordhvāḥ |
tebhyo namo astu te no'vantu te no mṛḍayantu te yaṃ dviṣmo yaśca no dveṣṭi tameṣāṃ jambhe dadhmaḥ ||
verses.translation: Homage to Rudras, those whose home is earth, whose arrows is men's food. To them be homage, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्म॒न्नूर्जं॒ पर्व॑ते शिश्रिया॒णाम॒द्भ्य ओष॑धीभ्यो॒ वन॒स्पतिभ्यो॒ अधि॒ सम्भृ॑तं॒ पयः॑ ।
तां न॒ इष॒मूर्जं॑ धत्त मरुतः सᳪररा॒णाः अश्मँ॑स्ते॒ क्षुन्मयि॑ त॒ ऊर्ग्यं द्वि॒ष्मस्तं ते॒ शुगृ॑च्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśmannūrjaṃ parvate śiśriyāṇāmadbhya oṣadhībhyo vanaspatibhyo adhi sambhṛtaṃ payaḥ |
tāṃ na iṣamūrjaṃ dhatta marutaḥ saṃrarāṇāḥ aśmam̐ste kṣunmayi ta ūrgyaṃ dviṣmastaṃ te śugṛcchatu ||
verses.translation: The food and strength contained in stone and mountain, drink gathered from the plants and trees and waters, That food and strength, Maruts! free-givers, grant us. In the stone is thy hunger. In me is thy food. Let thy pain reach the man we hate.

verses.sanskrit: इ॒मा मे॑ अग्न॒ इष्ट॑का धे॒नवः॑ स॒न्त्वेका॑ च॒ दश॑ च॒ दश॑ च श॒तं च॑ श॒तं च॑ स॒हस्रं॑ च स॒हस्रं॑ चा॒युतं॑ चा॒युतं॑ च नि॒युतं॑ च नि॒युतं॑ च प्र॒युतं॒ चार्बु॑दं च॒ न्य॑र्बुदं समु॒द्रश्च॒ मध्यं॒ चान्त॑श्च परा॒र्धश्चै॒ता मे॑ अग्न॒ इष्ट॑का धे॒नवः॑ सन्त्व॒मुत्रा॒मुष्मिँ॑ल्लो॒के ॥
verses.transliteration: imā me agna iṣṭakā dhenavaḥ santvekā ca daśa ca daśa ca śataṃ ca śataṃ ca sahasraṃ ca sahasraṃ cāyutaṃ cāyutaṃ ca niyutaṃ ca niyutaṃ ca prayutaṃ cārbudaṃ ca nyarbudaṃ samudraśca madhyaṃ cāntaśca parārdhaścaitā me agna iṣṭakā dhenavaḥ santvamutrāmuṣmim̐lloke ||
verses.translation: O Agni, may these bricks be mine own milch kine: one, and ten, and ten tens, a hundred, and ten hundreds, a thousand, and ten thousand a myriad, and a hundred thousand, and a million, and a hundred millions, and an ocean middle and end, and a hundred thousand millions, and a billion. May these bricks be mine own milch-kine in yonder world and in this world.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तव॑ स्थ ऋता॒वृध॑ ऋतु॒ष्ठा स्थ॑ ऋता॒वृधः॑ ।
घृ॒त॒श्च्युतो॑ मधु॒श्च्युतो॑ वि॒राजो॒ नाम॑ काम॒दुघा॒ अक्षी॑यमाणाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛtava stha ṛtāvṛdha ṛtuṣṭhā stha ṛtāvṛdhaḥ |
ghṛtaścyuto madhuścyuto virājo nāma kāmadughā akṣīyamāṇāḥ ||
verses.translation: Ye are the Seasons, strengthening Law, fixed in due season, strengthening Law, Called Splendid, dropping butter down and honey, yielders of every wish, imperishable.

verses.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्रस्य॒ त्वाऽव॑क॒याग्ने॒ परि॑ व्ययामसि । पा॒व॒को अ॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ शि॒वो भ॑व ॥
verses.transliteration: samudrasya tvā'vakayāgne pari vyayāmasi | pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava ||
verses.translation: With the lake's mantling need we robe thee, Agni: to us he purifying and auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: हि॒मस्य॑ त्वा ज॒रायु॒णाऽग्ने॒ परि॑ व्ययामसि । पा॒व॒को अ॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ शि॒वो भ॑व ॥
verses.transliteration: himasya tvā jarāyuṇā'gne pari vyayāmasi | pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava ||
verses.translation: With cold's investing garb we gird thee, Agni: to us be purifying and auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: उप॒ ज्मन्नुप॑ वेत॒सेऽव॑ तर न॒दीष्वा । अग्ने॑ पि॒त्तम॒पाम॑सि॒ मण्डू॑कि॒ ताभि॒रा ग॑हि॒ सेमं नो॑ य॒ज्ञं पा॑व॒कव॑र्णᳪ शि॒वं कृ॑धि ॥
verses.transliteration: upa jmannupa vetase'va tara nadīṣvā | agne pittamapāmasi maṇḍūki tābhirā gahi semaṃ no yajñaṃ pāvakavarṇaṃ śivaṃ kṛdhi ||
verses.translation: Descend upon the earth, the reed, the rivers: thou art the gall, O Agni, of the waters. With them come hither, female Frog, and render this sacrifice of ours bright-hued, successful.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पामि॒दं न्यय॑नᳪ समु॒द्रस्य॑ नि॒वेश॑नम् ।
अ॒न्याँस्ते॑ अ॒स्मत्त॑पन्तु हे॒तयः॑ पाव॒को अ॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ शि॒वो भ॑व ॥
verses.transliteration:
apāmidaṃ nyayanaṃ samudrasya niveśanam |
anyām̐ste asmattapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava ||
verses.translation: This is the place where waters meet; here is the gathering of the flood. Let thy shaft burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॑ पावक रो॒चिषा॑ म॒न्द्रया॑ देव जि॒ह्वया॑ । आ दे॒वान् व॑क्षि॒ यक्षि॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration: agne pāvaka rociṣā mandrayā deva jihvayā | ā devān vakṣi yakṣi ca ||
verses.translation: O Agni, purifier, God, with splendour and thy pleasant tongue Bring hither, and adore, the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
स नः॑ पावक दीदि॒वोऽग्ने॑ दे॒वाँ२ इ॒हा व॑ह ।
उप॑ य॒ज्ञᳪ ह॒विश्च॑ नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa naḥ pāvaka dīdivo'gne devām̐ ihā vaha |
upa yajñaṃ haviśca naḥ ||
verses.translation: So, Agni, purifying, bright, bring hither to our sacrifice, To our oblation bring the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
पा॒व॒कया॒ यश्चि॒तय॑न्त्या कृ॒पा क्षाम॑न् रुरु॒च उ॒षसो॒ न भा॒नुना॑ ।
तूर्व॒न् न याम॒न्नेत॑शस्य॒ नू रण॒ आ यो घृ॒णे न त॑तृषा॒णो अ॒जरः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pāvakayā yaścitayantyā kṛpā kṣāman ruruca uṣaso na bhānunā |
tūrvan na yāmannetaśasya nū raṇa ā yo ghṛṇe na tatṛṣāṇo ajaraḥ ||
verses.translation: He who with purifying, eye-attracting form hath shone upon the earth as with the light of Dawn; Who speeding on, as in the fleet steed's race, in fight, cometh untouched by age, as one athirst in heat.

verses.sanskrit:
नम॑स्ते॒ हर॑से शो॒चिषे॒ नम॑स्ते अस्त्व॒र्चिषे॑ ।
अ॒न्याँस्ते॑ अ॒स्मत्त॑पन्तु हे॒तयः॑ पाव॒को अ॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ शि॒वो भ॑व ॥
verses.transliteration:
namaste harase śociṣe namaste astvarciṣe |
anyām̐ste asmattapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava ||
verses.translation: Obeisance to thy wrath and glow! Obeisance to thy fiery flame! Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.

verses.sanskrit: नृ॒षदे॒ वेड॑प्सु॒षदे॒ वेड् ब॑र्हि॒षदे॒ वेड् व॑न॒सदे॒ वेड् स्व॒र्विदे॒ वेट् ॥
verses.transliteration: nṛṣade veḍapsuṣade veḍ barhiṣade veḍ vanasade veḍ svarvide veṭ ||
verses.translation: To him who dwells in man, Hail! To him who dwells in waters, Hail! To him who dwells in sacred grass, Hail! To him who dwells in the wood, Hail! To him who finds the light, Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
ये दे॒वा दे॒वानां॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑नाᳪ संवत्स॒रीण॒मुप॑ भा॒गमास॑ते ।
अ॑हु॒तादो॑ ह॒विषो॑ य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन्त्स्व॒यं पि॑बन्तु॒ मधु॑नो घृ॒तस्य॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye devā devānāṃ yajñiyā yajñiyānāṃ saṃvatsarīṇamupa bhāgamāsate |
ahutādo haviṣo yajñe asmintsvayaṃ pibantu madhuno ghṛtasya ||
verses.translation: Worshipful Gods of Gods who merit worship, those who sit down beside their yearly portion, Let them who eat not sacrificial presents drink in this rite of honey and of butter.

verses.sanskrit:
ये दे॒वा दे॒वेष्वधि॑ देव॒त्वमाय॒न् ये ब्रह्म॑णः पुर ए॒तारो॑ अ॒स्य ।
येभ्यो॒ न ऋ॒ते पव॑ते॒ धाम॒ किञ्च॒न न ते दि॒वो न पृ॑थि॒व्या अधि॒ स्नुषु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye devā deveṣvadhi devatvamāyan ye brahmaṇaḥ pura etāro asya |
yebhyo na ṛte pavate dhāma kiñcana na te divo na pṛthivyā adhi snuṣu ||
verses.translation: Those Gods who have attained to Godhead over Gods, they who have led the way in this our holy work, Without whose aid no body whatsoever moves, not on heaven's heights are they, nor on the face of earth.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒ण॒दा अ॑पान॒दा व्या॑न॒दा व॑र्चो॒दा व॑रिवो॒दाः ।
अ॒न्याँस्ते॑ अ॒स्मत्त॑पन्तु हे॒तयः॑ पाव॒को अ॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ शि॒वो भ॑व ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāṇadā apānadā vyānadā varcodā varivodāḥ |
anyām̐ste asmattapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava ||
verses.translation: Giver of breath, of out-breath, breath diffusive, giver of lustre, giving room and freedom, Let thy shot missiles burn others than us: be thou cleanser, propitious unto us.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निस्ति॒ग्मेन॑ शो॒चिषा॒ यास॒द्विश्वं॒ न्यत्रिण॑म् । अ॒ग्निर्नो॑ वनते र॒यिम् ॥
verses.transliteration: agnistigmena śociṣā yāsadviśvaṃ nyatriṇam | agnirno vanate rayim ||
verses.translation: May Agni with his sharpened blaze cast down each fierce devouring fiend. May Agni win us wealth by war.

verses.sanskrit:
य इ॒मा विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि॒ जुह्व॒दृषि॒र्होता॒ न्यसी॑दत् पि॒ता नः॑ ।
स आ॒शिषा॒ द्रवि॑णमि॒च्छमा॑नः प्रथम॒च्छदव॑राँ॒२ आ वि॑वेश ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya imā viśvā bhuvanāni juhvadṛṣirhotā nyasīdat pitā naḥ |
sa āśiṣā draviṇamicchamānaḥ prathamacchadavarām̐ ā viveśa ||
verses.translation: He who sate down as Hotar priest, the Rishi, our Father offering, up all things existent He, seeking with his wish a great possession, came among men on earth as archetypal.

verses.sanskrit:
किᳪस्वि॑दासीदधि॒ष्ठान॑मा॒रम्भ॑णं कत॒मत्स्वि॑त्क॒थाऽऽसी॑त् ।
यतो॒ भूमिं॑ ज॒नय॑न् वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ वि द्यामौर्णो॑न्महि॒ना वि॒श्वच॑क्षाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
kiṃsvidāsīdadhiṣṭhānamārambhaṇaṃ katamatsvitkathā''sīt |
yato bhūmiṃ janayan viśvakarmā vi dyāmaurṇonmahinā viśvacakṣāḥ ||
verses.translation: What was the place whereon he took his station? What was it that upheld him? What the manner, Whence Visvakarman, seeing all, producing the earth, with mighty power disclosed the heavens?

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒श्वत॑श्चक्षुरु॒त वि॒श्वतो॑मुखो वि॒श्वतो॑बाहुरु॒त वि॒श्वत॑स्पात् ।
सं बा॒हुभ्यां॒ धम॑ति॒ सं पत॑त्रै॒र्द्यावा॒भूमी॑ ज॒नय॑न् दे॒व एकः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvataścakṣuruta viśvatomukho viśvatobāhuruta viśvataspāt |
saṃ bāhubhyāṃ dhamati saṃ patatrairdyāvābhūmī janayan deva ekaḥ ||
verses.translation: He who hath eyes on all sides round about him, a mouth on all sides, arms and feet on all sides, He the sole God, producing earth and heaven, weldeth them with his arms as wings together.

verses.sanskrit:
किᳪस्वि॒द्वनं॒ क उ॒ स वृ॒क्ष आ॑स॒ यतो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी नि॑ष्टत॒क्षुः ।
मनी॑षिणो॒ मन॑सा पृ॒च्छतेदु॒ तद्यद॒ध्यति॑ष्ठ॒द्भुव॑नानि धा॒रय॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kiṃsvidvanaṃ ka u sa vṛkṣa āsa yato dyāvāpṛthivī niṣṭatakṣuḥ |
manīṣiṇo manasā pṛcchatedu tadyadadhyatiṣṭhadbhuvanāni dhārayan ||
verses.translation: What was the tree, what wood in sooth produced it, from which they fashioned out the earth and heaven? Ye thoughtful men, inquire within your spirit whereon he stood when he established all things.

verses.sanskrit:
या ते॒ धामा॑नि पर॒माणि॒ याऽव॒मा या म॑ध्य॒मा वि॑श्वकर्मन्नु॒तेमा ।
शिक्षा॒ सखि॑भ्यो ह॒विषि॑ स्वधावः स्व॒यं य॑जस्व त॒न्वं॒ वृधा॒नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā te dhāmāni paramāṇi yā'vamā yā madhyamā viśvakarmannutemā |
śikṣā sakhibhyo haviṣi svadhāvaḥ svayaṃ yajasva tanvaṃ vṛdhānaḥ ||
verses.translation: Thine highest, lowest sacrificial natures, and these thy midmost here, O Visvakarman, Teach thou thy friends at sacrifice, O Blessèd, and come thyself, exalted, to our worship.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्व॑कर्मन् ह॒विषा॑ वावृधा॒नः स्व॒यं य॑जस्व पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्याम् ।
मुह्य॑न्त्व॒न्ये अ॒भितः॑ स॒पत्ना॑ इ॒हास्माकं॑ म॒घवा॑ सू॒रिर॑स्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvakarman haviṣā vāvṛdhānaḥ svayaṃ yajasva pṛthivīmuta dyām |
muhyantvanye abhitaḥ sapatnā ihāsmākaṃ maghavā sūrirastu ||
verses.translation: Bring those, thyself exalted with oblation, O Visvakarman, Earth and Heaven to worship. Let enemies around us live in folly: here let us have a rich and liberal patron. 23, 24. = VIII. 45, 46.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒चस्पतिं॑ वि॒श्वक॑र्माणमू॒तये॑ मनो॒जुवं॒ वाजे॑ अ॒द्या हु॑वेम ।
स नो॒ विश्वा॑नि॒ हव॑नानि जोषद्वि॒श्वश॑म्भू॒रव॑से सा॒धुक॑र्मा ॥
verses.transliteration:
vācaspatiṃ viśvakarmāṇamūtaye manojuvaṃ vāje adyā huvema |
sa no viśvāni havanāni joṣadviśvaśambhūravase sādhukarmā ||
verses.hindi: आज हम सहायता के लिए, संघर्ष में, वाणी के स्वामी, विश्वकर्मा को, जो मन के समान वेगवान हैं, बुलाएँ। सबको सुख देने वाले, अच्छे कर्म वाले वे हमारी रक्षा के लिए हमारी सब पुकारों को स्वीकार करें।
verses.translation: Today, for help in the contest, let us call Vishvakarman, lord of speech, swift as thought. May he who brings good to all and works rightly welcome all our calls, to protect us.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्व॑कर्मन् ह॒विषा॒ वर्ध॑नेन त्रा॒तार॒मिन्द्र॑मकृणोरव॒ध्यम् ।
तस्मै॒ विशः॒ सम॑नमन्त पू॒र्वीर॒यमु॒ग्रो वि॒हव्यो॒ यथाऽस॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvakarman haviṣā vardhanena trātāramindramakṛṇoravadhyam |
tasmai viśaḥ samanamanta pūrvīrayamugro vihavyo yathā'sat ||
verses.hindi: हे विश्वकर्मा, बढ़ाने वाली आहुति से तुमने रक्षक इन्द्र को अवध्य बना दिया। प्राचीन प्रजाएँ उसके सामने झुक गईं, ताकि यह उग्र (इन्द्र) सबके द्वारा पुकारा जाने वाला बने।
verses.translation: Vishvakarman, with strengthening offering you made Indra, the protector, invulnerable. The peoples of old bowed before him, so that this mighty one might be called on by all.

verses.sanskrit:
चक्षु॑षः पि॒ता मन॑सा॒ हि धीरो॑ घृ॒तमे॑ने अजन॒न्नम्न॑माने ।
य॒देदन्ता॒ अद॑दृहन्त॒ पूर्व॒ आदिद् द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑प्रथेताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
cakṣuṣaḥ pitā manasā hi dhīro ghṛtamene ajanannamnamāne |
yadedantā adadṛhanta pūrva ādid dyāvāpṛthivī aprathetām ||
verses.translation: The Father of the eye, the Wise in spirit, created both these worlds submerged in fatness. Then when the eastern ends were firmly fastened, the heavens and the earth were far extended.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ विम॑ना॒ आद्विहा॑या धा॒ता वि॑धा॒ता प॑र॒मोत स॒न्दृक् ।
तेषा॑मि॒ष्टानि॒ समि॒षा म॑दन्ति॒ यत्रा॑ सप्त ऋ॒षीन् प॒र एक॑मा॒हुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvakarmā vimanā ādvihāyā dhātā vidhātā paramota sandṛk |
teṣāmiṣṭāni samiṣā madanti yatrā sapta ṛṣīn para ekamāhuḥ ||
verses.translation: Mighty in mind and power is Visvakarman, Maker, Disposer, and most lofty Presence. Their offerings joy in rich juice where they value One, only One beyond the Seven Rishis.

verses.sanskrit:
यो नः॑ पि॒ता ज॑नि॒ता यो वि॑धा॒ता धामा॑नि॒ वेद॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
यो दे॒वानां॑ नाम॒धा एक॑ ए॒व तᳪ स॑म्प्र॒श्नं भुव॑ना यन्त्य॒न्या ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo naḥ pitā janitā yo vidhātā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā |
yo devānāṃ nāmadhā eka eva taṃ sampraśnaṃ bhuvanā yantyanyā ||
verses.translation: Father who made us, he who, as Disposer, knoweth all races and all things existing, Even he alone, the Deities name-giver,—him other beings seek for information.

verses.sanskrit:
त आऽय॑जन्त॒ द्रवि॑ण॒ᳪ सम॑स्मा॒ ऋष॑यः॒ पूर्वे॑ जरि॒तारो॒ न भू॒ना ।
अ॒सूर्ते॒ सूर्ते॒ रज॑सि निष॒त्ते ये भू॒तानि॑ स॒मकृ॑ण्वन्नि॒मानि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ta ā'yajanta draviṇaṃ samasmā ṛṣayaḥ pūrve jaritāro na bhūnā |
asūrte sūrte rajasi niṣatte ye bhūtāni samakṛṇvannimāni ||
verses.translation: To him in sacrifice they offered treasures,—Rishis of old, in numerous troops, as singers, Who, in the distant, near, and lower region, made ready all these things that have existence.

verses.sanskrit:
प॒रो दि॒वा प॒र ए॒ना पृ॑थि॒व्या प॒रो दे॒वेभि॒रसु॑रै॒र्यदस्ति॑ ।
कᳪस्वि॒द् गर्भं॑ प्रथ॒मं द॑ध्र॒ आपो॒ यत्र॑ दे॒वाः स॒मप॑श्यन्त॒ पूर्वे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
paro divā para enā pṛthivyā paro devebhirasurairyadasti |
kaṃsvid garbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samapaśyanta pūrve ||
verses.translation: That which is earlier than this earth and heaven, before the Asuras and Gods had being, What was the germ primeval which the waters received where the first Gods beheld each other?

verses.sanskrit:
तमिद्गर्भं॑ प्रथ॒मं द॑ध्र॒ आपो॒ यत्र॑ दे॒वाः स॒मग॑च्छन्त॒ विश्वे॑ ।
अ॒जस्य॒ नाभा॒वध्येक॒मर्पि॑तं॒ यस्मि॒न् विश्वा॑नि॒ भुव॑नानि त॒स्थुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tamidgarbhaṃ prathamaṃ dadhra āpo yatra devāḥ samagacchanta viśve |
ajasya nābhāvadhyekamarpitaṃ yasmin viśvāni bhuvanāni tasthuḥ ||
verses.translation: The waters, they received that germ primeval wherein the Gods were gathered all together. It rested set upon the Unborn's navel, that One wherein abide all things existing.

verses.sanskrit:
न तं वि॑दाथ॒ य इ॒मा ज॒जाना॒न्यद्यु॒ष्माक॒मन्त॑रं बभूव ।
नी॒हा॒रेण॒ प्रावृ॑ता॒ जल्प्या॑ चासु॒तृप॑ उक्थ॒शास॑श्चरन्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
na taṃ vidātha ya imā jajānānyadyuṣmākamantaraṃ babhūva |
nīhāreṇa prāvṛtā jalpyā cāsutṛpa ukthaśāsaścaranti ||
verses.translation: Ye will not find him who produced these creatures: another thing hath risen up among you. Enwrapt in misty cloud, with lips that stammer, hymn-chanters wander and are discontented.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ ह्यज॑निष्ट दे॒व आदिद्ग॑न्ध॒र्वो अ॑भवद् द्वि॒तीयः॑ ।
तृ॒तीयः॑ पि॒ता ज॑नि॒तौष॑धीनाम॒पां गर्भं॒ व्य॒दधात् पुरु॒त्रा ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvakarmā hyajaniṣṭa deva ādidgandharvo abhavad dvitīyaḥ |
tṛtīyaḥ pitā janitauṣadhīnāmapāṃ garbhaṃ vyadadhāt purutrā ||
verses.translation: First was the God engendered, Visvakarman: then the Gandharva sprang to life as second. Third in succession was the plants begetter: he laid the waters germ in many places.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒शुः शिशा॑नो वृष॒भो न भी॒मो घ॑नाघ॒नः क्षोभ॑णश्चर्षणी॒नाम् ।
सं॒क्रन्द॑नोऽनिमि॒ष ए॑कवी॒रः श॒तᳪ सेना॑ अजयत् सा॒कमिन्द्रः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
āśuḥ śiśāno vṛṣabho na bhīmo ghanāghanaḥ kṣobhaṇaścarṣaṇīnām |
saṃkrandano'nimiṣa ekavīraḥ śataṃ senā ajayat sākamindraḥ ||
verses.translation: Swift, rapidly striking, like a bull who sharpens his horns, terrific, stirring up the people, With eyes that close not, bellowing, Sole Hero, Indra subdued at once a hundred armies.

verses.sanskrit:
सं॒क्रन्द॑नेनानिमि॒षेण॑ जि॒ष्णुना॑ युत्का॒रेण॑ दुश्च्यव॒नेन॑ धृ॒ष्णुना॑ ।
तदिन्द्रे॑ण जयत॒ तत्स॑हध्वं॒ युधो॑ नर॒ इषु॑हस्तेन॒ वृष्णा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃkrandanenānimiṣeṇa jiṣṇunā yutkāreṇa duścyavanena dhṛṣṇunā |
tadindreṇa jayata tatsahadhvaṃ yudho nara iṣuhastena vṛṣṇā ||
verses.translation: With him loud-roaring, ever watchful, Victor, bold, hard to overthrow, Rouser of battle, Indra the Strong, whose hand bears arrows, conquer, ye warriors, now, now vanquish in the combat.

verses.sanskrit:
स इषु॑हस्तैः॒ स नि॑ष॒ङ्गिभि॑र्व॒शी सᳪस्र॑ष्टा॒ स युध॒ इन्द्रो॑ ग॒णेन॑ ।
स॒ᳪसृष्ट॒जित्सो॑म॒पा बा॑हुश॒र्ध्युग्रध॑न्वा॒ प्रति॑हिताभि॒रस्ता॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa iṣuhastaiḥ sa niṣaṅgibhirvaśī saṃsraṣṭā sa yudha indro gaṇena |
saṃsṛṣṭajitsomapā bāhuśardhyugradhanvā pratihitābhirastā ||
verses.translation: He rules with those who carry shafts and quivers, Indra who with his band brings hosts together, Foe-conquering, strong of arm, the Soma-drinker, with mighty bow, shooting with well-laid arrows.

verses.sanskrit:
बृह॑स्पते॒ परि॑ दीया॒ रथे॑न रक्षो॒हाऽमित्राँ॑२ अप॒बाध॑मानः ।
प्र॒भ॒ञ्जन्त्सेनाः॑ प्रमृ॒णो यु॒धा जय॑न्न॒स्माक॑मेध्यवि॒ता रथा॑नाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhaspate pari dīyā rathena rakṣohā'mitrām̐ apabādhamānaḥ |
prabhañjantsenāḥ pramṛṇo yudhā jayannasmākamedhyavitā rathānām ||
verses.translation: Brihaspati, fly with thy chariot hither, slayer of demons, driving off our foemen. Be thou protector of our cars, destroyer, victor in battle, breaker-up of armies.

verses.sanskrit:
ब॒ल॒वि॒ज्ञा॒य स्थवि॑रः॒ प्रवी॑रः॒ सह॑स्वान् वा॒जी सह॑मान उ॒ग्रः ।
अ॒भिवी॑रो अ॒भिस॑त्वा सहो॒जा जै॑त्रमिन्द्र॒ रथ॒मा ति॑ष्ठ गो॒वित् ॥
verses.transliteration:
balavijñāya sthaviraḥ pravīraḥ sahasvān vājī sahamāna ugraḥ |
abhivīro abhisatvā sahojā jaitramindra rathamā tiṣṭha govit ||
verses.translation: Conspicuous by thy strength, firm, foremost fighter, mighty and fierce, victorious, all-subduing, The Son of Conquest, passing men and heroes, kine-winner, mount thy conquering car, O Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
गो॒त्र॒भिदं॑ गो॒विदं॒ वज्र॑बाहुं॒ जय॑न्त॒मज्म॑ प्रमृ॒णन्त॒मोज॑सा ।
इ॒मᳪ स॑जाता॒ अनु॑ वीरयध्व॒मिन्द्र॑ᳪ सखायो॒ अनु॒ सᳪ र॑भध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
gotrabhidaṃ govidaṃ vajrabāhuṃ jayantamajma pramṛṇantamojasā |
imaṃ sajātā anu vīrayadhvamindraṃ sakhāyo anu saṃ rabhadhvam ||
verses.translation: Cleaver of stalls, kine-winner, armed with thunder, who quells an army and with might destroys it, Follow him, brothers! quit yourselves like heroes, and like this Indra show your zeal and courage.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि गो॒त्राणि॒ सह॑सा॒ गाह॑मानोऽद॒यो वी॒रः श॒तम॑न्यु॒रिन्द्रः॑ ।
दु॒श्च्य॒व॒नः पृ॑तना॒षाड॑यु॒ध्योऽस्माक॒ᳪ सेना॑ अवतु॒ प्र यु॒त्सु ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhi gotrāṇi sahasā gāhamāno'dayo vīraḥ śatamanyurindraḥ |
duścyavanaḥ pṛtanāṣāḍayudhyo'smākaṃ senā avatu pra yutsu ||
verses.translation: Piercing the cow-stalls with surpassing vigour, Indra, the pitiless Hero, wild with anger, Victor in fight, unshaken and resistless,—may he protect our armies in our battles.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑ आसां ने॒ता बृह॒स्पति॒र्दक्षि॑णा य॒ज्ञः पु॒र ए॑तु॒ सोमः॑ ।
दे॒व॒से॒नाना॑मभिभञ्जती॒नां जय॑न्तीनां म॒रुतो॑ य॒न्त्वग्र॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indra āsāṃ netā bṛhaspatirdakṣiṇā yajñaḥ pura etu somaḥ |
devasenānāmabhibhañjatīnāṃ jayantīnāṃ maruto yantvagram ||
verses.translation: Indra guide these: Brihaspati precede them, the guerdon, and the sacrifice, and Soma; And let the banded Maruts march in forefront of heavenly hosts that conquer and demolish.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वृष्णो॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ राज्ञ॑ आदि॒त्यानां॑ म॒रुता॒ᳪ शर्ध॑ उ॒ग्रम् ।
म॒हाम॑नसां भुवनच्य॒वानां॒ घोषो॑ दे॒वानां॒ जय॑ता॒मुद॑स्थात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasya vṛṣṇo varuṇasya rājña ādityānāṃ marutāṃ śardha ugram |
mahāmanasāṃ bhuvanacyavānāṃ ghoṣo devānāṃ jayatāmudasthāt ||
verses.translation: Ours be the potent host of mighty Indra, King Varuna, and Maruts, and Âdityas. Uplifted is the shout of Gods who conquer, high-minded Gods who cause the worlds to tremble.

verses.sanskrit:
उद्ध॑र्षय मघव॒न्नायु॑धा॒न्युत्सत्व॑नां माम॒कानां॒ मना॑ᳪसि ।
उद्वृ॑त्रहन् वा॒जिनां॒ वाजि॑ना॒न्युद्रथा॑नां॒ जय॑तां यन्तु॒ घोषाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
uddharṣaya maghavannāyudhānyutsatvanāṃ māmakānāṃ manāṃsi |
udvṛtrahan vājināṃ vājinānyudrathānāṃ jayatāṃ yantu ghoṣāḥ ||
verses.translation: Bristle thou up, O Bounteous Lord, our weapons: excite the spirits of my warring heroes. Urge on the strong steeds might, O Vritra-slayer, and let the din of conquering cars go upward.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒स्माक॒मिन्द्रः॒ समृ॑तेषु ध्व॒जेष्व॒स्माकं॒ या इष॑व॒स्ता ज॑यन्तु ।
अ॒स्माकं॑ वी॒रा उत्त॑रे भवन्त्व॒स्माँ२ उ॑ देवा अवता॒ हवे॑षु ॥
verses.transliteration:
asmākamindraḥ samṛteṣu dhvajeṣvasmākaṃ yā iṣavastā jayantu |
asmākaṃ vīrā uttare bhavantvasmām̐ u devā avatā haveṣu ||
verses.translation: May Indra aid us when our flags are gathered: victorious be the arrows of our army. May our brave men of war prevail in battle. Ye Gods protect us in the shout of onset.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒मीषां॑ चि॒त्तं प्र॑तिलो॒भय॑न्ती गृहा॒णाङ्गा॑न्यप्वे॒ परे॑हि ।
अ॒भि प्रेहि॒ निर्द॑ह हृ॒त्सु शोकै॑र॒न्धेना॒मित्रा॒स्तम॑सा सचन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
amīṣāṃ cittaṃ pratilobhayantī gṛhāṇāṅgānyapve parehi |
abhi prehi nirdaha hṛtsu śokairandhenāmitrāstamasā sacantām ||
verses.translation: Bewildering the senses of our foemen, seize thou their bodies and depart, O Apvâ. Attack them, set their hearts on fire and burn them: so let our foes abide in utter darkness.

verses.sanskrit: अव॑सृष्टा॒ परा॑ पत॒ शर॑व्ये॒ ब्रह्म॑सᳪशिते । गच्छा॒मित्रा॒न् प्र प॑द्यस्व॒ माऽमीषां॒ कं च॒नोच्छि॑षः ॥
verses.transliteration: avasṛṣṭā parā pata śaravye brahmasaṃśite | gacchāmitrān pra padyasva mā'mīṣāṃ kaṃ canocchiṣaḥ ||
verses.translation: Loosed from the bowstring fly awry, O Arrow, sharpened by our prayer. Go to the foemen, strike them home, and let not one of them escape.

verses.sanskrit: प्रेता॒ जय॑ता नर॒ इन्द्रो॑ वः॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतु । उ॒ग्रा वः॑ सन्तु बा॒हवो॑ऽनाधृ॒ष्या यथाऽस॑थ ॥
verses.transliteration: pretā jayatā nara indro vaḥ śarma yacchatu | ugrā vaḥ santu bāhavo'nādhṛṣyā yathā'satha ||
verses.translation: Advance, O heroes, win the day. May Indra be your sure defence. Exceeding mighty be your arms, that none may wound or injure you.

verses.sanskrit:
असौ॒ या सेना॑ मरुतः॒ परे॑षाम॒भ्यैति॑ न॒ ओज॑सा॒ स्पर्ध॑माना ।
तां गू॑हत॒ तम॒साऽप॑व्रतेन॒ यथा॒ऽमी अ॒न्यो अ॒न्यं न जा॒नन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
asau yā senā marutaḥ pareṣāmabhyaiti na ojasā spardhamānā |
tāṃ gūhata tamasā'pavratena yathā'mī anyo anyaṃ na jānan ||
verses.translation: That army of our enemies, O Maruts, that comes against us with its might, contending, Meet ye and wrap it in unwelcome darkness so that not one of them may know another.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्र॑ बा॒णाः स॒म्पत॑न्ति कुमा॒रा वि॑शि॒खा इ॑व ।
तन्न॒ इन्द्रो॒ बृह॒स्पति॒रदि॑तिः॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतु वि॒श्वाहा॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatra bāṇāḥ sampatanti kumārā viśikhā iva |
tanna indro bṛhaspatiraditiḥ śarma yacchatu viśvāhā śarma yacchatu ||
verses.translation: There where the flights of arrows fall like boys whose locks are yet unshorn, May Indra, may Brihaspati, may Aditi protect us well, protect us well through all our days.

verses.sanskrit:
मर्मा॑णि ते॒ वर्म॑णा छादयामि॒ सोम॑स्त्वा॒ राजा॒ऽमृते॒नानु॑वस्ताम् ।
उ॒रोर्वरी॑यो॒ वरु॑णस्ते कृणोतु॒ जय॑न्तं॒ त्वाऽनु॑ दे॒वा म॑दन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
marmāṇi te varmaṇā chādayāmi somastvā rājā'mṛtenānuvastām |
urorvarīyo varuṇaste kṛṇotu jayantaṃ tvā'nu devā madantu ||
verses.translation: Thy vital parts I cover with thine armour: with immortality King Soma clothe thee. Varuna give thee what is more than ample, and in thy triumph may the Gods be joyful.

verses.sanskrit: उदे॑नमुत्त॒रां न॒याग्ने॑ घृतेनाहुत । रा॒यस्पोषे॑ण॒ सᳪ सृ॑ज प्र॒जया॑ च ब॒हुं कृ॑धि ॥
verses.transliteration: udenamuttarāṃ nayāgne ghṛtenāhuta | rāyaspoṣeṇa saṃ sṛja prajayā ca bahuṃ kṛdhi ||
verses.translation: Worshipped with butter, Agni, lead this man to high preeminence. Vouchsafe him growth of riches and multiply him with progeny.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रे॒मं प्र॑त॒रां न॑य सजा॒ताना॑मसद्व॒शी । समे॑नं॒ वर्च॑सा सृज दे॒वानां॑ भाग॒दा अ॑सत् ॥
verses.transliteration: indremaṃ pratarāṃ naya sajātānāmasadvaśī | samenaṃ varcasā sṛja devānāṃ bhāgadā asat ||
verses.translation: Indra, lead him to eminence: controller of his foes be he. Vouchsafe him lustre: let him give their sacred portions to the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: यस्य॑ कु॒र्मो गृ॒हे ह॒विस्तम॑ग्ने वर्धया॒ त्वम् । तस्मै॑ दे॒वा अधि॑ ब्रुवन्न॒यं च॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yasya kurmo gṛhe havistamagne vardhayā tvam | tasmai devā adhi bruvannayaṃ ca brahmaṇaspatiḥ ||
verses.translation: The man within whose house we pay oblation, Indra, prosper him. May the Gods bless and comfort him, they and this Brahmanaspati.

verses.sanskrit: उदु॑ त्वा॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अग्ने॑ भरन्तु॒ चित्ति॑भिः । स नो॑ भव शि॒वस्त्वᳪ सु॒प्रती॑को वि॒भाव॑सुः ॥
verses.transliteration: udu tvā viśve devā agne bharantu cittibhiḥ | sa no bhava śivastvaṃ supratīko vibhāvasuḥ ||
verses.translation: May the All-Gods, O Agni, bear and lift thee upward with their thoughts. Fair to be looked on, rich in light, he thou propitious unto us.

verses.sanskrit:
पञ्च॒ दिशो॒ दैवी॑र्य॒ज्ञम॑वन्तु दे॒वीरपाम॑तिं॒ दुर्म॑तिं॒ बाध॑मानाः ।
रा॒यस्पोषे॑ य॒ज्ञप॑तिमा॒भज॑न्ती रा॒यस्पोषे॒ अधि॑ य॒ज्ञो अ॑स्थात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pañca diśo daivīryajñamavantu devīrapāmatiṃ durmatiṃ bādhamānāḥ |
rāyaspoṣe yajñapatimābhajantī rāyaspoṣe adhi yajño asthāt ||
verses.translation: May the Five Regions guard, divine, our worship, Goddesses chasing lack of thought and hatred, Giving the Sacrificer growth of riches. Let sacrifice be based on growth of riches.

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑द्धे अ॒ग्नावधि॑ मामहा॒न उ॒क्थप॑त्र॒ ईड्यो॑ गृभी॒तः ।
त॒प्तं घ॒र्मं प॑रि॒गृह्या॑यजन्तो॒र्जा यद्य॒ज्ञमय॑जन्त दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
samiddhe agnāvadhi māmahāna ukthapatra īḍyo gṛbhītaḥ |
taptaṃ gharmaṃ parigṛhyāyajantorjā yadyajñamayajanta devāḥ ||
verses.translation: Inspirited above enkindled Agni, adorable, winged with hymns, was it accepted, When the Gods offered sacrifice with viands, circling the heated caldron, paving worship.

verses.sanskrit:
दै॑व्याय ध॒र्त्रे जोष्ट्रे॑ देव॒श्रीः श्रीम॑नाः श॒तप॑याः ।
प॒रि॒गृह्य॑ दे॒वा य॒ज्ञमा॑यन् दे॒वा दे॒वेभ्यो॑ अध्व॒र्यन्तो॑ अस्थुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
daivyāya dhartre joṣṭre devaśrīḥ śrīmanāḥ śatapayāḥ |
parigṛhya devā yajñamāyan devā devebhyo adhvaryanto asthuḥ ||
verses.translation: Lord of a hundred draughts. benign, God-serving—to him divine, establisher, protector, The Gods approached the sacrifice, encircling. Gods for the Gods stood fain for sacred service.

verses.sanskrit:
वी॒तᳪ ह॒विः श॑मि॒तᳪ श॑मि॒ता य॒जध्यै॑ तु॒रीयो॑ य॒ज्ञो यत्र॑ ह॒व्यमेति॑ ।
ततो॑ वा॒का आ॒शिषो॑ नो जुषन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vītaṃ haviḥ śamitaṃ śamitā yajadhyai turīyo yajño yatra havyameti |
tato vākā āśiṣo no juṣantām ||
verses.translation: When the fourth sacrifice reaches the oblation, accepted offering which hath been made ready, fit for the Inmolator's sacrificing, Thence bless us prayers and holy recitations!

verses.sanskrit:
सूर्य॑रश्मि॒र्हरि॑केशः पु॒रस्ता॑त्सवि॒ता ज्योति॒रुद॑याँ॒२ अज॑स्रम् ।
तस्य॑ पू॒षा प्र॑स॒वे या॑ति वि॒द्वान्त्स॒म्पश्य॒न्विश्वा॒ भुव॑नानि गो॒पाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sūryaraśmirharikeśaḥ purastātsavitā jyotirudayām̐ ajasram |
tasya pūṣā prasave yāti vidvāntsampaśyanviśvā bhuvanāni gopāḥ ||
verses.translation: Savitar, golden-hued, hath lifted eastward, bright with the sunbeams, his eternal lustre, He at whose furtherance wise Pûshan marches surveying all existence like a herdsman.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒मान॑ ए॒ष दि॒वो मध्य॑ आस्त आपप्रि॒वान् रोद॑सी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षम् ।
स वि॒श्वाची॑र॒भि च॑ष्टे घृ॒ताची॑रन्त॒रा पूर्व॒मप॑रं च के॒तुम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vimāna eṣa divo madhya āsta āpaprivān rodasī antarikṣam |
sa viśvācīrabhi caṣṭe ghṛtācīrantarā pūrvamaparaṃ ca ketum ||
verses.translation: He sits, the measurer, in the midst of heaven, filling the two world-halves and air's mid-region. He looks upon the rich far-spreading pastures between the eastern and the western limit.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒क्षा स॑मु॒द्रो अ॑रु॒णः सु॑प॒र्णः पूर्व॑स्य॒ योनिं॑ पि॒तुरा वि॑वेश ।
मध्ये॑ दि॒वो निहि॑तः॒ पृश्नि॒रश्मा॒ वि च॑क्रमे॒ रज॑सस्पा॒त्यन्तौ॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ukṣā samudro aruṇaḥ suparṇaḥ pūrvasya yoniṃ piturā viveśa |
madhye divo nihitaḥ pṛśniraśmā vi cakrame rajasaspātyantau ||
verses.translation: Steer, Sea, Red Bird with strong wings, he hath entered the dwelling-place of the Primeval Father. A gay-hued Stone set in the midst of heaven, he hath gone forth and guards the air's two limits.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रं॒ विश्वा॑ अवीवृधन्त्समु॒द्रव्य॑चसं॒ गिरः॑ ।
र॒थीत॑मᳪ र॒थीनां॒ वाजा॑ना॒ᳪ सत्प॑तिं॒ पति॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indraṃ viśvā avīvṛdhantsamudravyacasaṃ giraḥ |
rathītamaṃ rathīnāṃ vājānāṃ satpatiṃ patim ||
verses.translation: All sacred songs have glorified Indra expansive as the sea, The best of warriors borne on cars, the Lord, the Very Lord of strength.

verses.sanskrit: दे॒व॒हूर्य॒ज्ञ आ च॑ वक्षत्सुम्न॒हूर्य॒ज्ञ आ च॑ वक्षत् । यक्ष॑द॒ग्निर्दे॒वो दे॒वाँ२ आ च॑ वक्षत् ॥
verses.transliteration: devahūryajña ā ca vakṣatsumnahūryajña ā ca vakṣat | yakṣadagnirdevo devām̐ ā ca vakṣat ||
verses.translation: May God-invoking sacrifice bring the Gods hitherward to us. May bless-invoking sacrifice bring the Gods hitherward to us. May Agni, God, make offering and hither bring the Gods to us.

verses.sanskrit: वाज॑स्य मा प्रस॒व उ॑द्ग्रा॒भेणोद॑ग्रभीत् । अधा॑ स॒पत्ना॒निन्द्रो॑ मे निग्रा॒भेणाध॑राँ२ अकः ॥
verses.transliteration: vājasya mā prasava udgrābheṇodagrabhīt | adhā sapatnānindro me nigrābheṇādharām̐ akaḥ ||
verses.translation: May the abundant growth of wealth with elevation lift me up, And with his subjugating power may Indra keep my foemen down.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒द्ग्रा॒भं च॑ निग्रा॒भं च॒ ब्रह्म॑ दे॒वा अ॑वीवृधन् ।
अधा॑ स॒पत्ना॑निन्द्रा॒ग्नी मे॑ विषू॒चीना॒न्व्य॒स्यताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
udgrābhaṃ ca nigrābhaṃ ca brahma devā avīvṛdhan |
adhā sapatnānindrāgnī me viṣūcīnānvyasyatām ||
verses.translation: Upraising and depression and devotion may the Gods increase. May Indra, too, and Agni drive my foes away to every side.

verses.sanskrit:
क्रम॑ध्वम॒ग्निना॒ नाक॒मुख्य॒ᳪ हस्ते॑षु॒ बिभ्र॑तः ।
दि॒वस्पृ॒ष्ठᳪ स्व॑र्ग॒त्वा मि॒श्रा दे॒वेभि॑राध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kramadhvamagninā nākamukhyaṃ hasteṣu bibhrataḥ |
divaspṛṣṭhaṃ svargatvā miśrā devebhirādhvam ||
verses.translation: Go ye by Agni to the sky bearing the Ukhya in your hands. Reaching the heights of sky and heaven stay intermingled with the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
प्राची॒मनु॑ प्र॒दिशं॒ प्रेहि॑ वि॒द्वान॒ग्नेर॑ग्ने पुरो अ॑ग्निर्भवे॒ह ।
विश्वा॒ आशा॒ दीद्या॑नो॒ वि भा॒ह्यूर्जं॑ नो धेहि द्वि॒पदे॒ चतु॑ष्पदे ॥
verses.transliteration:
prācīmanu pradiśaṃ prehi vidvānagneragne puro agnirbhaveha |
viśvā āśā dīdyāno vi bhāhyūrjaṃ no dhehi dvipade catuṣpade ||
verses.translation: Agni, go forward to the eastern region, well-skilled, be here the fire in front of Agni. Illuming all the quarters, shine with splendour: supply with food our quadrupeds and bipeds.

verses.sanskrit:
पृ॒थि॒व्या अ॒हमुद॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒माऽरु॑हम॒न्तरि॑क्षा॒द्दिव॒मारु॑हम् ।
दि॒वो नाक॑स्य पृ॒ष्ठात् स्व॒र्ज्योति॑रगाम॒हम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛthivyā ahamudantarikṣamā'ruhamantarikṣāddivamāruham |
divo nākasya pṛṣṭhāt svarjyotiragāmaham ||
verses.translation: From earth to air's mid-region have I mounted, and from mid-air ascended up to heaven. From the high pitch of heaven's cope I came into the world of light.

verses.sanskrit:
स्व॒र्यन्तो॒ नापे॑क्षन्त॒ आ द्याᳪ रो॑हन्ति॒ रोद॑सी ।
य॒ज्ञं ये वि॒श्वतो॑धार॒ᳪ सुवि॑द्वाᳪसो वितेनि॒रे ॥
verses.transliteration:
svaryanto nāpekṣanta ā dyāṃ rohanti rodasī |
yajñaṃ ye viśvatodhāraṃ suvidvāṃso vitenire ||
verses.translation: Mounting the sky they look not round: they rise to heaven through both the worlds— Sages who span the sacrifice that pours its stream on every side.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ प्रेहि॑ प्रथ॒मो दे॑वय॒तां चक्षु॑र्दे॒वाना॑मु॒त मर्त्या॑नाम् ।
इय॑क्षमाणा॒ भृगु॑भिः स॒जोषाः॒ स्व॒र्यन्तु॒ यज॑मानाः स्व॒स्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne prehi prathamo devayatāṃ cakṣurdevānāmuta martyānām |
iyakṣamāṇā bhṛgubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ svaryantu yajamānāḥ svasti ||
verses.translation: Foremost of those who seek the Gods come forward, thou who art eye of Gods and men, O Agni. Accordant with the Bhrigus, fain to worship, to heaven in safety go the Sacrificers.

verses.sanskrit:
नक्तो॒षासा॒ सम॑नसा॒ विरू॑पे धा॒पये॑ते॒ शिशु॒मेक॑ᳪ समी॒ची ।
द्यावा॒क्षामा॑ रु॒क्मो अ॒न्तर्वि भा॑ति दे॒वा अ॒ग्निं धा॑रयन् द्रविणो॒दाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
naktoṣāsā samanasā virūpe dhāpayete śiśumekaṃ samīcī |
dyāvākṣāmā rukmo antarvi bhāti devā agniṃ dhārayan draviṇodāḥ ||
verses.translation: Night and Dawn, different in hue, accordant, etc., as in XII. 2.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॑ सहस्राक्ष शतमूर्धञ्छ॒तं ते॑ प्रा॒णाः स॒हस्रं॑ व्या॒नाः ।
त्वᳪ सा॑ह॒स्रस्य॑ रा॒य ई॑शिषे॒ तस्मै॑ ते विधेम॒ वाजा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne sahasrākṣa śatamūrdhañchataṃ te prāṇāḥ sahasraṃ vyānāḥ |
tvaṃ sāhasrasya rāya īśiṣe tasmai te vidhema vājāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: O Agni, thousand-eyed and hundred-headed, thy breaths are hundred, thy through-breaths a thousand. Thou art the Lord of thousandfold possessions. To thee; for strength, may we present oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒प॒र्णो॒ऽसि ग॒रुत्मा॑न् पृ॒ष्ठे पृ॑थि॒व्याः सी॑द ।
भा॒साऽन्तरि॑क्ष॒मा पृ॑ण॒ ज्योति॑षा॒ दिव॒मुत्त॑भान॒ तेज॑सा॒ दिश॒ उद्दृ॑ᳪह ॥
verses.transliteration:
suparṇo'si garutmān pṛṣṭhe pṛthivyāḥ sīda |
bhāsā'ntarikṣamā pṛṇa jyotiṣā divamuttabhāna tejasā diśa uddṛṃha ||
verses.translation: Thou art the Bird of goodly wing: be seated on the ridge of earth. Fill air's mid-region with thy glow, supporting with thy light the sky, confirm the quarters with thy sheen.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒जुह्वा॑नः सु॒प्रती॑कः पु॒रस्ता॒दग्ने॒ स्वं योनि॒मा सी॑द साधु॒या ।
अ॒स्मिन्त्स॒धस्थे॒ अध्युत्त॑रस्मि॒न्विश्वे॑ देवा॒ यज॑मानश्च सीदत ॥
verses.transliteration:
ājuhvānaḥ supratīkaḥ purastādagne svaṃ yonimā sīda sādhuyā |
asmintsadhasthe adhyuttarasminviśve devā yajamānaśca sīdata ||
verses.translation: Receiving offerings, fair of aspect, eastward be duly seated in thy place, O Agni. In this the more exalted habitation be seated All-Gods and the Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit:
ताᳪ स॑वि॒तुर्वरे॑ण्यस्य चि॒त्रामाऽहं वृ॑णे सुम॒तिं वि॒श्वज॑न्याम् ।
याम॑स्य॒ कण्वो॒ अदु॑ह॒त्प्रपी॑नाᳪ स॒हस्र॑धारां॒ पय॑सा म॒हीं गाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tāṃ saviturvareṇyasya citrāmā'haṃ vṛṇe sumatiṃ viśvajanyām |
yāmasya kaṇvo aduhatprapīnāṃ sahasradhārāṃ payasā mahīṃ gām ||
verses.translation: That wondrous all-mankind-embracing favour of Savitar, choice-worthy, I solicit, Even his which Kanva wont to milk, the mighty, the teeming Cow who yields a thousand milk-streams.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒धेम॑ ते पर॒मे जन्म॑न्नग्ने वि॒धेम॒ स्तोमै॒रव॑रे स॒धस्थे॑ ।
यस्मा॒द्योने॑रु॒दारि॑था॒ यजे॒ तं प्र त्वे ह॒वीᳪषि॑ जुहुरे॒ समि॑द्धे ॥
verses.transliteration:
vidhema te parame janmannagne vidhema stomairavare sadhasthe |
yasmādyonerudārithā yaje taṃ pra tve havīṃṣi juhure samiddhe ||
verses.translation: May we adore thee in thy loftiest birth place, Agni! with praise-songs in thy lower station. The place whence those hast issued forth I worship. In thee, well kindled, have they paid oblations

verses.sanskrit: प्रेद्धो॑ अग्ने दीदिहि पु॒रो नऽज॑स्रया सू॒र्म्या॒ यविष्ठ । त्वाᳪ शश्व॑न्त॒ उप॑ यन्ति॒ वाजाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: preddho agne dīdihi puro na'jasrayā sūrmyā yaviṣṭha | tvāṃ śaśvanta upa yanti vājāḥ ||
verses.translation: Shine thou before us, Agni, well enkindled, with flame, most youthful God, that never fadeth. Unceasing unto thee come sacred viands.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ तम॒द्याश्वं॒ न स्तोमैः॒ क्रतुं॒ न भ॒द्रᳪ हृ॑दि॒स्पृश॑म् । ऋ॒ध्यामा॑ त॒ ओहैः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: agne tamadyāśvaṃ na stomaiḥ kratuṃ na bhadraṃ hṛdispṛśam | ṛdhyāmā ta ohaiḥ ||
verses.translation: Agni, this day with lands, etc., as in XV. 44.

verses.sanskrit:
चित्तिं॑ जुहोमि॒ मन॑सा घृ॒तेन॒ यथा॑ दे॒वा इ॒हागम॑न्वी॒तिहो॑त्रा ऋता॒वृधः॑ ।
पत्ये॒ विश्व॑स्य॒ भूम॑नो जु॒होमि॑ वि॒श्वक॑र्मणे वि॒श्वाहाऽदा॑भ्यᳪ ह॒विः ॥
verses.transliteration:
cittiṃ juhomi manasā ghṛtena yathā devā ihāgamanvītihotrā ṛtāvṛdhaḥ |
patye viśvasya bhūmano juhomi viśvakarmaṇe viśvāhā'dābhyaṃ haviḥ ||
verses.translation: I dedicate the thought with mind and butter so that the Gods may come who love oblation, strengthing Law, To Visvakarman, Lord of all the earth, I offer up day after day the inviolable sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒प्त ते॑ अग्ने स॒मिधः॑ स॒प्त जि॒ह्वाः स॒प्त ऋष॑यः स॒प्त धाम॑ प्रि॒याणि॑ ।
स॒प्त होत्राः॑ सप्त॒धा त्वा॑ यजन्ति स॒प्त योनी॒रा पृ॑णस्व घृ॒तेन॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sapta te agne samidhaḥ sapta jihvāḥ sapta ṛṣayaḥ sapta dhāma priyāṇi |
sapta hotrāḥ saptadhā tvā yajanti sapta yonīrā pṛṇasva ghṛtena svāhā ||
verses.translation: Seven fuel logs hast thou, seven tongues, O Agni, seven Rishis hast thou, seven belovèd mansions. Seven-priests in sevenfold manner pay thee worship. Fill full—All-hail to thee!—seven wombs with butter.

verses.sanskrit: शु॒क्रज्यो॑तिश्च चि॒त्रज्यो॑तिश्च स॒त्यज्यो॑तिश्च॒ ज्योति॑ष्माँश्च । शु॒क्रश्च॑ ऋत॒पाश्चात्य॑ᳪहाः ॥
verses.transliteration: śukrajyotiśca citrajyotiśca satyajyotiśca jyotiṣmām̐śca | śukraśca ṛtapāścātyaṃhāḥ ||
verses.translation: Purely-Bright, Wonderfully-Bright, Really-Bright, All-Luminous, Bright, Law's-Protector, Safe-from-Ill;

verses.sanskrit: ई॒दृङ् चा॑न्या॒दृङ् च॑ स॒दृङ् च॑ प्रति॑सदृङ् च॑ । मि॒तश्च॒ सम्मि॑तश्च॒ सभ॑राः ॥
verses.transliteration: īdṛṅ cānyādṛṅ ca sadṛṅ ca pratisadṛṅ ca | mitaśca sammitaśca sabharāḥ ||
verses.translation: Such, Other-Looking, Equal, Similar, Measured, Commensurate, Jointly-Bearing-up.

verses.sanskrit: ऋ॒तश्च॑ स॒त्यश्च॑ ध्रु॒वश्च॑ ध॒रुण॑श्च । ध॒र्ता च॑ विध॒र्ता च॑ विधार॒यः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtaśca satyaśca dhruvaśca dharuṇaśca | dhartā ca vidhartā ca vidhārayaḥ ||
verses.translation: Right, Real, Firm, Strong-to-Support, Bearer, Disposer, Manager.

verses.sanskrit: ऋ॒त॒जिच्च॑ सत्य॒जिच्च॑ सेन॒जिच्च॑ सु॒षेण॑श्च । अन्ति॑मित्रश्च दू॒रे अ॑मित्रश्च ग॒णः ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtajicca satyajicca senajicca suṣeṇaśca | antimitraśca dūre amitraśca gaṇaḥ ||
verses.translation: Winner-of-Right, Winner-of-Truth, Host-Conquering, Lord-of-Goodly-Host, Whose-Friends-are-Near-at-Hand, Whose-Banded-Enemies-are-Far-Away:

verses.sanskrit:
ई॒दृक्षा॑स एता॒दृक्षा॑स ऊ॒ षु णः॑ स॒दृक्षा॑सः॒ प्रति॑सदृक्षास॒ एत॑न ।
मि॒तास॑श्च॒ सम्मि॑तासो नो अ॒द्य सभ॑रसो मरुतो य॒ज्ञे अ॒स्मिन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
īdṛkṣāsa etādṛkṣāsa ū ṣu ṇaḥ sadṛkṣāsaḥ pratisadṛkṣāsa etana |
mitāsaśca sammitāso no adya sabharaso maruto yajñe asmin ||
verses.translation: To day in this our sacrifice be present, Such, Looking-Thus, Same, Similar-in-appearance, Measured, Commensurate, Joint-Bearers, Maruts!

verses.sanskrit: स्वत॑वाँश्च प्रघा॒सी च॑ सान्तप॒नश्च॑ गृहमे॒धी च॑ । क्री॒डी च॑ शा॒की चो॑ज्जे॒षी ॥
verses.transliteration: svatavām̐śca praghāsī ca sāntapanaśca gṛhamedhī ca | krīḍī ca śākī cojjeṣī ||
verses.translation: Self-Powerful, Voracious-One, Kin-to-the-Sun, The House-holder, Play-Lover, Mighty, Conqueror. Fierce, Terrible, The Resonant, The Roaring. Victorious, Assailant, and Dispeller, All-Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रं॒ दैवी॒र्विशो॑ म॒रुतोऽनु॑वर्त्मानोऽभव॒न्यथेन्द्रं॒ दैवी॒र्विशो॑ म॒रुतोऽनु॑वर्त्मा॒नोऽभ॑वन् ।
ए॒वमि॒मं यज॑मानं॒ दैवी॑श्च॒ विशो॑ मानु॒षीश्चानु॑वर्त्मानो भवन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
indraṃ daivīrviśo maruto'nuvartmāno'bhavanyathendraṃ daivīrviśo maruto'nuvartmāno'bhavan |
evamimaṃ yajamānaṃ daivīśca viśo mānuṣīścānuvartmāno bhavantu ||
verses.translation: The Maruts, clans divine, became the followers of Indra; as The Maruts, clans divine, became the followers of Indra, so May clans divine and human he the Sacrificer's followers.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मᳪ स्तन॒मूर्ज॑स्वन्तं धया॒पां प्रपी॑नमग्ने सरि॒रस्य॒ मध्ये॑ ।
उत्सं॑ जुषस्व॒ मधु॑मन्तमर्वन्त्समु॒द्रिय॒ᳪ सद॑न॒मा वि॑शस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ stanamūrjasvantaṃ dhayāpāṃ prapīnamagne sarirasya madhye |
utsaṃ juṣasva madhumantamarvantsamudriyaṃ sadanamā viśasva ||
verses.translation: Drink in the middle of the flood, O Agni, this breast stored full of sap, teeming with water. Welcome this fountain redolent of sweetness. O Courser, enter those thy watery dwelling.

verses.sanskrit:
घृ॒तं मि॑मिक्षे घृ॒तम॑स्य॒ योनि॑र्घृ॒ते श्रि॒तो घृ॒तम्व॑स्य॒ धाम॑ ।
अ॒नुष्व॒धमा व॑ह मा॒दय॑स्व॒ स्वाहा॑कृतं वृषभ वक्षि ह॒व्यम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ghṛtaṃ mimikṣe ghṛtamasya yonirghṛte śrito ghṛtamvasya dhāma |
anuṣvadhamā vaha mādayasva svāhākṛtaṃ vṛṣabha vakṣi havyam ||
verses.translation: Oil hath been mixed: oil is his habitation. In oil he rests: oil is his proper province. Come as thy wont is. O thou Steer, rejoice thee. Bear off the oblation duly consecrated.

verses.sanskrit:
समु॒द्रादू॒र्मिर्मधु॑माँ॒२ उदा॑र॒दुपा॒ᳪशुना॒ सम॑मृत॒त्वमा॑नट् ।
घृ॒तस्य॒ नाम॒ गुह्यं॒ यदस्ति॑ जि॒ह्वा दे॒वाना॑म॒मृत॑स्य॒ नाभिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
samudrādūrmirmadhumām̐ udāradupāṃśunā samamṛtatvamānaṭ |
ghṛtasya nāma guhyaṃ yadasti jihvā devānāmamṛtasya nābhiḥ ||
verses.translation: Forth from the ocean sprang the wave of sweetness: together with the stalk it turned to Amrit, That which is holy oil's mysterious title: but the Gods tongue is truly Amities centre.

verses.sanskrit:
व॒यं नाम॒ प्र ब्र॑वामा घृ॒तस्या॒स्मिन् य॒ज्ञे धा॑रयामा॒ नमो॑भिः ।
उप॑ ब्र॒ह्मा शृ॑णवच्छ॒स्यमा॑नं॒ चतुः॑शृङ्गो॒ऽवमीद्गौ॒र ए॒तत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vayaṃ nāma pra bravāmā ghṛtasyāsmin yajñe dhārayāmā namobhiḥ |
upa brahmā śṛṇavacchasyamānaṃ catuḥśṛṅgo'vamīdgaura etat ||
verses.translation: Let us Declare aloud the name of Ghrita, and at this sacrifice held it up with homage. So let the Brahman hear the praise we utter. This hath the four-horned Buffalo emitted.

verses.sanskrit:
च॒त्वारि॒ शृङ्गा॒ त्रयो॑ अस्य॒ पादा॒ द्वे शी॒र्षे स॒प्त हस्ता॑सो अस्य ।
त्रिधा॑ ब॒द्धो वृ॑ष॒भो रो॑रवीति म॒हो दे॒वो मर्त्याँ॒२ आ वि॑वेश ॥
verses.transliteration:
catvāri śṛṅgā trayo asya pādā dve śīrṣe sapta hastāso asya |
tridhā baddho vṛṣabho roravīti maho devo martyām̐ ā viveśa ||
verses.translation: Four are his horns, three are the feet that bear him: his heads are two, his hands are seven in number. Bound with a triple bond the Bull roars loudly: the mighty God hath entered into mortals.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रिधा॑ हि॒तं प॒णिभि॑र्गु॒ह्यमा॑नं॒ गवि॑ दे॒वासो॑ घृ॒तमन्व॑विन्दन् ।
इन्द्र॒ एक॒ᳪ सूर्य॒ एकं॑ जजान वे॒नादेक॑ᳪ स्व॒धया॒ निष्ट॑तक्षुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tridhā hitaṃ paṇibhirguhyamānaṃ gavi devāso ghṛtamanvavindan |
indra ekaṃ sūrya ekaṃ jajāna venādekaṃ svadhayā niṣṭatakṣuḥ ||
verses.translation: That oil in triple shape the Gods discovered laid down within the Cow, concealed by Panis. Indra produced one shape, Sûrya another: by their own power they formed the third from Vena.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒ता अ॑र्षन्ति॒ हृद्या॑त्समु॒द्राच्छ॒तव्र॑जा रि॒पुणा॒ नाव॒चक्षे॑ ।
घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑ अ॒भि चा॑कशीमि हिर॒ण्ययो॑ वेत॒सो मध्य॑ आसाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
etā arṣanti hṛdyātsamudrācchatavrajā ripuṇā nāvacakṣe |
ghṛtasya dhārā abhi cākaśīmi hiraṇyayo vetaso madhya āsām ||
verses.translation: From inmost reservoir in countless channels flow down these rivers which the foe beholds not. I look upon the streams of oil descending, and lo! the Golden Reed is there among them.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒म्यक् स्र॑वन्ति स॒रितो॒ न धेना॑ अ॒न्तर्हृ॒दा मन॑सा पू॒यमा॑नाः ।
ए॒ते अ॑र्षन्त्यू॒र्मयो॑ घृ॒तस्य॑ मृ॒गा इ॑व क्षिप॒णोरीष॑माणाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
samyak sravanti sarito na dhenā antarhṛdā manasā pūyamānāḥ |
ete arṣantyūrmayo ghṛtasya mṛgā iva kṣipaṇorīṣamāṇāḥ ||
verses.translation: Like rivers our libations flow together, cleansing themselves in inmost heart and spirit. The streams of holy oil pour swiftly downward like the wild beasts that fly before the bowman.

verses.sanskrit:
सिन्धो॑रिव प्राध्व॒ने शू॑घ॒नासो॒ वात॑प्रमियः पतयन्ति य॒ह्वाः ।
घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑ अरु॒षो न वा॒जी काष्ठा॑ भि॒न्दन्नू॒र्मिभिः॒ पिन्व॑मानः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sindhoriva prādhvane śūghanāso vātapramiyaḥ patayanti yahvāḥ |
ghṛtasya dhārā aruṣo na vājī kāṣṭhā bhindannūrmibhiḥ pinvamānaḥ ||
verses.translation: As rushing down the rapids of a river, flow swifter than the wind the vigorous currents, The streams of oil in swelling fluctuation like a red courser bursting through the fences.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि प्र॑वन्त॒ सम॑नेव॒ योषाः॑ कल्या॒ण्यः स्मय॑मानासो अ॒ग्निम् ।
घृ॒तस्य॒ धाराः॑ स॒मिधो॑ नसन्त॒ ता जु॑षा॒णो ह॑र्यति जा॒तवे॑दाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhi pravanta samaneva yoṣāḥ kalyāṇyaḥ smayamānāso agnim |
ghṛtasya dhārāḥ samidho nasanta tā juṣāṇo haryati jātavedāḥ ||
verses.translation: Like women at a gathering fair to look on and gently smiling, they incline to Agni. The streams of holy oil attain the fuel, and Jâtavedas joyfully receives them.

verses.sanskrit:
क॒न्या॒ इव वह॒तुमेत॒वा उ॑ अ॒ञ्ज्य॒ञ्जा॒ना अ॒भि चा॑कशीमि ।
यत्र॒ सोमः॑ सू॒यते॒ यत्र॑ य॒ज्ञो घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॑ अ॒भि तत्प॑वन्ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
kanyā iva vahatumetavā u añjyañjānā abhi cākaśīmi |
yatra somaḥ sūyate yatra yajño ghṛtasya dhārā abhi tatpavante ||
verses.translation: As maidens deck themselves with gay adornment to join the bridal feast, I now behold them. Where Soma flows and sacrifice is ready, thither the streams of holy oil are running.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भ्य॒र्षत सुष्टु॒तिं गव्य॑मा॒जिम॒स्मासु॑ भ॒द्रा द्रवि॑णानि धत्त ।
इ॒मं य॒ज्ञं न॑यत दे॒वता॑ नो घृ॒तस्य॒ धारा॒ मधु॑मत्पवन्ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhyarṣata suṣṭutiṃ gavyamājimasmāsu bhadrā draviṇāni dhatta |
imaṃ yajñaṃ nayata devatā no ghṛtasya dhārā madhumatpavante ||
verses.translation: Send to our eulogy a herd of cattle: bestow upon us excellent possessions. Bear to the Gods the sacrifice we offers the streams of oil flow pure and full of sweetness.

verses.sanskrit:
धामं॑ ते॒ विश्वं॒ भुव॑न॒मधि॑ श्रि॒तम॒न्तः स॑मु॒द्रे हृ॒द्यन्तरायु॑षि ।
अ॒पामनी॑के समि॒थे य आभृ॑त॒स्तम॑श्याम॒ मधु॑मन्तं त ऊ॒र्मिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhāmaṃ te viśvaṃ bhuvanamadhi śritamantaḥ samudre hṛdyantarāyuṣi |
apāmanīke samithe ya ābhṛtastamaśyāma madhumantaṃ ta ūrmim ||
verses.translation: The universe depends upon thy power and might within the sea, within the heart, within all life. May we attain that sweetly-flavoured wave of thine, brought, at this gathering, oer the surface of the floods.

verses.sanskrit: वाज॑श्च मे प्रस॒वश्च॑ मे॒ प्रय॑तिश्च मे॒ प्रसि॑तिश्च मे धी॒तिश्च॑ मे॒ क्रतु॑श्च मे॒ स्वर॑श्च मे॒ श्लोक॑श्च मे श्र॒वश्च॑ मे॒ श्रुति॑श्च मे॒ ज्योति॑श्च मे॒ स्व॒श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: vājaśca me prasavaśca me prayatiśca me prasitiśca me dhītiśca me kratuśca me svaraśca me ślokaśca me śravaśca me śrutiśca me jyotiśca me svaśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my strength and my gain, and my inclination and my influence, and my thought and my mental power, and my praise and my fame, and my renown and my light, and my heaven prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: प्रा॒णश्च॑ मेऽपा॒नश्च॑ मे व्या॒नश्च॒ मेऽसु॑श्च मे चि॒त्तं च॑ म॒ आधी॑तं च मे॒ वाक् च॑ मे॒ मन॑श्च मे॒ चक्षु॑श्च मे॒ श्रोत्रं॑ च मे॒ दक्ष॑श्च मे॒ बलं॑ च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇaśca me'pānaśca me vyānaśca me'suśca me cittaṃ ca ma ādhītaṃ ca me vāk ca me manaśca me cakṣuśca me śrotraṃ ca me dakṣaśca me balaṃ ca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my breathing and my out-breathing, and my through-breathing and my vital spirit, and my thought and my reflection, and my voice and my mind, and my eye and my ear, and my ability and my strength prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: ओज॑श्च मे॒ सह॑श्च म आ॒त्मा च॑ मे त॒नूश्च॑ मे॒ शर्म॑ च मे॒ वर्म॑ च॒ मेऽङ्गा॑नि च॒ मेऽस्थी॑नि च मे॒ परू॑ᳪषि च मे॒ शरी॑राणि च म॒ आयु॑श्च मे ज॒रा च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ojaśca me sahaśca ma ātmā ca me tanūśca me śarma ca me varma ca me'ṅgāni ca me'sthīni ca me parūṃṣi ca me śarīrāṇi ca ma āyuśca me jarā ca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my energy and my force, and my self and my body, and my shelter and my shield, and my limbs and my bones, and my joints and my members, and my life and my old age prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: ज्यै॑ष्ठ्यं च मे॒ आधि॑पत्यं च मे म॒न्युश्च॑ मे॒ भाम॑श्च॒ मेऽम॑श्च॒ मेऽम्भ॑श्च मे जे॒मा च॑ मे महि॒मा च॑ मे वरि॒मा च॑ मे प्रथि॒मा च॑ मे वर्षि॒मा च॑ मे द्राघि॒मा च॑ मे वृ॒द्धं च॑ मे॒ वृद्धि॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: jyaiṣṭhyaṃ ca me ādhipatyaṃ ca me manyuśca me bhāmaśca me'maśca me'mbhaśca me jemā ca me mahimā ca me varimā ca me prathimā ca me varṣimā ca me drāghimā ca me vṛddhaṃ ca me vṛddhiśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my preëminence and my overlordship, and my wrath and my angry passion, and my violence and my impetuosity, and my victorious power and my greatness, and my breadth and my width, and my height and my length, and my increase and my improvement prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: स॒त्यं च॑ मे श्र॒द्धा च॑ मे॒ जग॑च्च मे॒ धनं॑ च मे॒ विश्वं॑ च मे॒ मह॑श्च मे क्री॒डा च॑ मे॒ मोद॑श्च मे जा॒तं च॑ मे जनि॒ष्यमा॑णं च मे सू॒क्तं च॑ मे सुकृ॒तं च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: satyaṃ ca me śraddhā ca me jagacca me dhanaṃ ca me viśvaṃ ca me mahaśca me krīḍā ca me modaśca me jātaṃ ca me janiṣyamāṇaṃ ca me sūktaṃ ca me sukṛtaṃ ca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my truth and my faith, and my cattle and my wealth, and my goods and my pleasure, and my play and my enjoyment, and my children and my future children, and my hymn and my pious act prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: ऋ॒तं च॑ मेऽमृतं॑ च मे ऽय॒क्ष्मं च॒ मे ऽना॑मयच्च मे जी॒वातु॑श्च मे दीर्घायु॒त्वं च॑ मेऽनमि॒त्रं च॒ मे ऽभ॑यं च मे सु॒खं च॑ मे॒ शय॑नं च मे सू॒षाश्च॑ मे सु॒दिनं॑ च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtaṃ ca me'mṛtaṃ ca me 'yakṣmaṃ ca me 'nāmayacca me jīvātuśca me dīrghāyutvaṃ ca me'namitraṃ ca me 'bhayaṃ ca me sukhaṃ ca me śayanaṃ ca me sūṣāśca me sudinaṃ ca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my religious rite and my immortality, and my freedom from consumption and my freedom from disease, and my life and my longevity, and my freedom from enemies and my freedom from danger, and my happiness and my lying down, and my fair dawn and my fair day prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: य॒न्ता च॑ मे ध॒र्ता च॑ मे॒ क्षेम॑श्च मे॒ धृति॑श्च मे॒ विश्वं॑ च मे॒ मह॑श्च मे सं॒विच्च॑ मे॒ ज्ञात्रं॑ च मे॒ सूश्च॑ मे प्र॒सूशच॒॑ मे॒ सीरं॑ च मे॒ लय॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: yantā ca me dhartā ca me kṣemaśca me dhṛtiśca me viśvaṃ ca me mahaśca me saṃvicca me jñātraṃ ca me sūśca me prasūśaca me sīraṃ ca me layaśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my controller and my supporter, and my security and my firmness, and my goods and my pleasure, and my knowledge and my understanding, and my begetting and my propagation, and my plough and my harrow prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: शं च॑ मे॒ मय॑श्च मे प्रि॒यं च॑ मेऽनुका॒मश्च॑ मे॒ काम॑श्च मे सौमन॒सश्च॑ मे॒ भग॑श्च मे॒ द्रवि॑णं च मे भ॒द्रं च॑ मे॒ श्रेय॑श्च मे॒ वसी॑यश्च मे॒ यश॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: śaṃ ca me mayaśca me priyaṃ ca me'nukāmaśca me kāmaśca me saumanasaśca me bhagaśca me draviṇaṃ ca me bhadraṃ ca me śreyaśca me vasīyaśca me yaśaśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my welfare and my comfort, and what I hold dear and what I desire, and my love and my gratification, and my enjoyment and my substance, and my happiness and my felicity, and my higher bliss and my fame prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: ऊर्क् च॑ मे सू॒नृता॑ च मे॒ पय॑श्च मे॒ रस॑श्च मे घृ॒तं च॑ मे॒ मधु॑ च मे॒ सग्धि॑श्च मे॒ सपी॑तिश्च मे कृ॒षिश्च॑ मे॒ वृष्टि॑श्च मे॒ जैत्रं॑ च म॒ औद्भि॑द्यं च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrk ca me sūnṛtā ca me payaśca me rasaśca me ghṛtaṃ ca me madhu ca me sagdhiśca me sapītiśca me kṛṣiśca me vṛṣṭiśca me jaitraṃ ca ma audbhidyaṃ ca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my vigour and my pleasantness, and my milk and my sap, and my butter and my honey, and my meal in company and my drinking in company, and my ploughing and my husbandry, and my superiority and my preëminence prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: र॒यिश्च॑ मे॒ राय॑श्च मे पु॒ष्टं च॑ मे॒ पुष्टि॑श्च मे वि॒भु च॑ मे प्र॒भु च॑ मे पू॒र्णं च॑ मे पू॒र्णत॑रं च मे॒ कुय॑वं च॒ मेऽक्षि॑तं च॒ मेऽन्नं॑ च॒ मेऽक्षु॑च्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: rayiśca me rāyaśca me puṣṭaṃ ca me puṣṭiśca me vibhu ca me prabhu ca me pūrṇaṃ ca me pūrṇataraṃ ca me kuyavaṃ ca me'kṣitaṃ ca me'nnaṃ ca me'kṣucca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my wealth and my property, and my prosperity and my growth, and my pervading power and my lordship, and my abundance and my greater abundance, and my bad harvest and my unwasted crop, and my food and my satiety prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: वि॒त्तं च॑ मे॒ वेद्यं॑ च मे भू॒तं च॑ मे भवि॒ष्यच्च॑ मे सु॒गं च॑ मे सुप॒थ्यं॒ च म ऋ॒द्धं च॑ म॒ ऋद्धि॑श्च मे क्लृ॒प्तं च॑ मे॒ क्लृप्ति॑श्च मे म॒तिश्च॑ मे सुम॒तिश्च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: vittaṃ ca me vedyaṃ ca me bhūtaṃ ca me bhaviṣyacca me sugaṃ ca me supathyaṃ ca ma ṛddhaṃ ca ma ṛddhiśca me klṛptaṃ ca me klṛptiśca me matiśca me sumatiśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my gain and my future gain, and what I have and what I shall have, and my good road and my good path, and my success and my succeeding, and my achievement and my contrivance, and my thought and my good counsel prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: व्री॒हय॑श्च मे॒ यवा॑श्च मे॒ माषा॑श्च मे॒ तिला॑श्च मे मु॒द्राश्च॑ मे॒ खल्वा॑श्च मे प्रि॒यङ्ग॑वश्च॒ मेऽण॑वश्च मे श्या॒माका॑श्च मे नी॒वारा॑श्च मे गो॒धूमा॑श्च मे म॒सूरा॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: vrīhayaśca me yavāśca me māṣāśca me tilāśca me mudrāśca me khalvāśca me priyaṅgavaśca me'ṇavaśca me śyāmākāśca me nīvārāśca me godhūmāśca me masūrāśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my rice-plants and my barley, and my beans and my sesamum, and my kidney-beans and my vetches, and my millet and my Panicum Milliaceum, and my Panicum Frumentaceum and my wild rice, and my wheat and my lentils prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अश्मा॑ च मे॒ मृत्ति॑का च मे गि॒रय॑श्च मे॒ पर्व॑ताश्च मे॒ सिक॑ताश्च मे॒ वन॒स्पत॑यश्च मे॒ हिर॑ण्यं च॒ मेऽय॑श्च मे श्या॒मं च॑ मे लो॒हं च॑ मे॒ सीसं॑ च मे॒ त्रपु॑ च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: aśmā ca me mṛttikā ca me girayaśca me parvatāśca me sikatāśca me vanaspatayaśca me hiraṇyaṃ ca me'yaśca me śyāmaṃ ca me lohaṃ ca me sīsaṃ ca me trapu ca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my stone and my clay, and my hills and my mountains, and my pebbles and my trees, and my gold and my bronze, and my copper and my iron, and my lead and my tin prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निश्च॑ म॒ आप॑श्च मे वी॒रुध॑श्च म॒ ओष॑धयश्च मे कृष्टप॒च्याश्च॑ मेऽकृष्टप॒च्याश्च॑ मे ग्रा॒म्याश्च॑ मे प॒शव॑ आर॒ण्याश्च॑ मे वि॒त्तं च॑ मे॒ वित्ति॑श्च मे भू॒तं च॑ मे॒ भूति॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: agniśca ma āpaśca me vīrudhaśca ma oṣadhayaśca me kṛṣṭapacyāśca me'kṛṣṭapacyāśca me grāmyāśca me paśava āraṇyāśca me vittaṃ ca me vittiśca me bhūtaṃ ca me bhūtiśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my fire and my water, and my creepers and my plants, and lily plants with culture-ripened fruit and my plants with fruit ripened without culture, and my domestic animals and my wild animals, and my substance and my future substance, and my belongings and my power be produced by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: वसु॑ च मे वस॒तिश्च॑ मे॒ कर्म॑ च मे॒ शक्ति॑श्च॒ मे ऽर्थ॑श्च म॒ एम॑श्च म इ॒त्या च॑ मे॒ गति॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: vasu ca me vasatiśca me karma ca me śaktiśca me 'rthaśca ma emaśca ma ityā ca me gatiśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my treasure and my dwelling, and my religious service and my ability to perform it, and my object and my course, and my way and my going prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निश्च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ सोम॑श्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे सवि॒ता च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ सर॑स्वती च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे पू॒षा च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ बृह॒स्पति॑श्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: agniśca ma indraśca me somaśca ma indraśca me savitā ca ma indraśca me sarasvatī ca ma indraśca me pūṣā ca ma indraśca me bṛhaspatiśca ma indraśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my Agni and my Indra, and my Soma and my Indra, and my Savitar and my Indra, and my Sarasvatî and my Indra, and my Pûshan and my Indra prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: मि॒त्रश्च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ वरु॑णश्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे धा॒ता च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ त्वष्टा॑ च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे म॒रुत॑श्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ विश्वे॑ च मे दे॒वा इन्द्र॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: mitraśca ma indraśca me varuṇaśca ma indraśca me dhātā ca ma indraśca me tvaṣṭā ca ma indraśca me marutaśca ma indraśca me viśve ca me devā indraśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my Mitra and my Indra, and my Varuna and my Indra, and my Dhâtar and my Indra, and my Maruts and my Indra, and my All-Gods and my Indra prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: पृ॒थि॒वी च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च॒ मेऽन्तरि॑क्षं च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ द्यौश्च॑ म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ समा॑श्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ नक्ष॑त्राणि च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे॒ दिश॑श्च म॒ इन्द्र॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthivī ca ma indraśca me'ntarikṣaṃ ca ma indraśca me dyauśca ma indraśca me samāśca ma indraśca me nakṣatrāṇi ca ma indraśca me diśaśca ma indraśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my earth and my Indra, and my Air and my Indra, and my Sky and my Indra, and my Half-months and my Indra, and my Lunar Mansions and my Indra, and my Sky-regions and my Indra prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ᳪशुश्च॑ मे र॒श्मिश्च॒ मेऽदा॑भ्यश्च॒ मेऽधि॑पतिश्च म उपा॒ᳪशुश्च॑ मेऽन्तर्या॒मश्च॑ म ऐन्द्रवाय॒वश्च॑ मे मैत्रावरु॒णश्च॑ म आश्वि॒नश्च॑ मे प्रतिप्र॒स्थान॑श्च मे शु॒क्रश्च॑ मे म॒न्थी च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: aṃśuśca me raśmiśca me'dābhyaśca me'dhipatiśca ma upāṃśuśca me'ntaryāmaśca ma aindravāyavaśca me maitrāvaruṇaśca ma āśvinaśca me pratiprasthānaśca me śukraśca me manthī ca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my Amsu and my Rasmi, and my Adhipati and my Upâmsu, and my Antaryâma and my Aindra-Vâyava, and my Maitrâ-Varuna, and my Âsvina and my Pratiprasthâna, and my Sukra and my Manthin proper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒ग्र॒या॒णश्च॑ मे वैश्वदे॒वश्च॑ मे ध्रु॒वश्च॑ मे वैश्वान॒रश्च॑ म ऐन्द्रा॒ग्नश्च॑ मे म॒हावै॑श्वदेश्च मे मरुत्व॒तीया॑श्च मे॒ निष्के॑वल्यश्च मे सावि॒त्रश्च॑ मे सारस्व॒तश्च॑ मे पात्नीव॒तश्च॑ मे हारियोज॒नश्च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: āgrayāṇaśca me vaiśvadevaśca me dhruvaśca me vaiśvānaraśca ma aindrāgnaśca me mahāvaiśvadeśca me marutvatīyāśca me niṣkevalyaśca me sāvitraśca me sārasvataśca me pātnīvataśca me hāriyojanaśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my Âgrayana and my Vaisvadeva, and my Dhruvâ and my Vaisvânara, and my Aindrâgna and my Mahâvaisvadeva, and my Marutvatîya and my Nishkevalya, and my Sâvitra and my Sârasvata, and my Pâtnîvata and my Hâriyojana prosper by sacrifice.
