verses.sanskrit: स्रुच॑श्च मे चम॒साश्च॑ मे वाय॒व्या॒नि च मे द्रोणकल॒शश्च॑ मे॒ ग्रावा॑णश्च मेऽधि॒षव॑णे च मे पूत॒भृच्च॑ म आधव॒नीय॑श्च मे॒ वेदि॑श्च मे ब॒र्हिश्च॑ मेऽवभृ॒तश्च॑ मे स्वगाका॒रश्च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: srucaśca me camasāśca me vāyavyāni ca me droṇakalaśaśca me grāvāṇaśca me'dhiṣavaṇe ca me pūtabhṛcca ma ādhavanīyaśca me vediśca me barhiśca me'vabhṛtaśca me svagākāraśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my ladles and my cups, and my Vâyu, vessels and my Soma reservoirs, and my pressing-stones and my two press-boards, and my Pûtabhrit and my Âdhavanîya, and my altar and altar-grass, and my Avabhritha and my cries of Good-speed prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निश्च॑ मे घ॒र्मश्च॑ मे॒ऽर्कश्च॑ मे॒ सूर्य॑श्च मे प्रा॒णश्च॑ मेऽश्वमे॒धश्च॑ मे पृथि॒वी च॒ मेऽदि॑तिश्च मे॒ दिति॑श्च मे॒ द्यौश्च॑ मे॒ऽङ्गुल॑यः॒ शक्व॑रयो॒ दिश॑श्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: agniśca me gharmaśca me'rkaśca me sūryaśca me prāṇaśca me'śvamedhaśca me pṛthivī ca me'ditiśca me ditiśca me dyauśca me'ṅgulayaḥ śakvarayo diśaśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my Agni and my charms, and my Arka and my Sûrya, and my Prâna and my Asvamedha, and my Prithivî and my Aditi, and my Diti and my Sky, and my fingers, powers, and sky-regions prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: व्र॒तं च॑ म ऋ॒तव॑श्च मे॒ तप॑श्च मे संवत्स॒रश्च॑ मेऽहोरा॒त्रे ऊ॑र्वष्ठी॒वे बृ॑हद्रथन्त॒रे च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: vrataṃ ca ma ṛtavaśca me tapaśca me saṃvatsaraśca me'horātre ūrvaṣṭhīve bṛhadrathantare ca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my vow and my seasons, and my austere devotion, and my day and night, thighs and knees, and two Great Rathantaras prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: एका॑ च मे ति॒स्रश्च॑ मे ति॒स्रश्च॑ मे॒ पञ्च॑ च मे॒ पञ्च॑ च मे स॒प्त च॑ मे स॒प्त च॑ मे॒ नव॑ च मे॒ नव॑ च म॒ एका॑दश च म॒ एका॑दश च मे॒ त्रयो॑दश च मे॒ त्रयो॑दश च मे॒ पञ्च॑दश च मे॒ पञ्च॑दश च मे स॒प्तद॑श च मे स॒प्तद॑श च मे॒ नव॑दश च मे॒ नव॑दश च म॒ एक॑विᳪशतिश्च म॒ एक॑विᳪशतिश्च मे॒ त्रयो॑विᳪशतिश्च मे॒ त्रयो॑विᳪशतिश्च मे॒ पञ्च॑विᳪशतिश्च मे॒ पञ्च॑विᳪशतिश्च मे स॒प्तवि॑ᳪशतिश्च मे स॒प्तवि॑ᳪशतिश्च मे॒ नव॑विᳪशतिश्च मे॒ नव॑विᳪशतिश्च म॒ एक॑त्रिᳪशच्च म॒ एक॑त्रिᳪशच्च मे॒ त्रय॑स्त्रिᳪशच्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ekā ca me tisraśca me tisraśca me pañca ca me pañca ca me sapta ca me sapta ca me nava ca me nava ca ma ekādaśa ca ma ekādaśa ca me trayodaśa ca me trayodaśa ca me pañcadaśa ca me pañcadaśa ca me saptadaśa ca me saptadaśa ca me navadaśa ca me navadaśa ca ma ekaviṃśatiśca ma ekaviṃśatiśca me trayoviṃśatiśca me trayoviṃśatiśca me pañcaviṃśatiśca me pañcaviṃśatiśca me saptaviṃśatiśca me saptaviṃśatiśca me navaviṃśatiśca me navaviṃśatiśca ma ekatriṃśacca ma ekatriṃśacca me trayastriṃśacca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May me One and my Three, and my Three and my Five, and my Five and my Seven (and similarly up to thirty-three) prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: चत॑स्रश्च मे॒ऽष्टौ च॑ मे॒ऽष्टौ च॑ मे॒ द्वाद॑श च मे॒ द्वाद॑श च मे॒ षोड॑श च मे॒ षोड॑श च मे विᳪश॒तिश्च॑ मे विᳪशतिश्च॑ मे॒ चतु॑र्विᳪशतिश्च मे॒ चतु॑र्विᳪश॒तिश्च॑ मे॒ऽष्टावि॑ᳪशतिश्च मे॒ऽष्टावि॑ᳪशतिश्च मे॒ द्वात्रि॑ᳪशच्च मे॒ द्वात्रि॑ᳪशच्च मे॒ षट्त्रि॑ᳪशच्च मे॒ षट्त्रि॑ᳪशच्च मे चत्वारि॒ᳪशच्च॑ मे चत्वारि॒ᳪशच्च॑ मे॒ चतु॑श्चत्वारिᳪशच्च मे॒ चतु॑श्चत्वारिᳪशच्च मे॒ऽष्टाच॑त्वारिᳪशच्च मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: catasraśca me'ṣṭau ca me'ṣṭau ca me dvādaśa ca me dvādaśa ca me ṣoḍaśa ca me ṣoḍaśa ca me viṃśatiśca me viṃśatiśca me caturviṃśatiśca me caturviṃśatiśca me'ṣṭāviṃśatiśca me'ṣṭāviṃśatiśca me dvātriṃśacca me dvātriṃśacca me ṣaṭtriṃśacca me ṣaṭtriṃśacca me catvāriṃśacca me catvāriṃśacca me catuścatvāriṃśacca me catuścatvāriṃśacca me'ṣṭācatvāriṃśacca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my Four and my Eight and my Twelve (and similarly up to forty-eight) prosper by sacrifice

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यवि॑श्च मे त्र्य॒वी च॑ मे दित्य॒वाट् च॑ मे दित्यौ॒ही च॑ मे पञ्चा॒विश्च॑ मे पञ्चा॒वी च॑ मे त्रिव॒त्सश्च॑ मे त्रिव॒त्सा च॑ मे तुर्य॒वाट् च॑ मे तुर्यौ॒ही च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: tryaviśca me tryavī ca me dityavāṭ ca me dityauhī ca me pañcāviśca me pañcāvī ca me trivatsaśca me trivatsā ca me turyavāṭ ca me turyauhī ca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my eighteen-months steer and my eighteen-months heifer, and my two-year bull and cow (and similarly up to four-year) prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: प॒ष्ठ॒वाट् च॑ मे पष्ठौ॒ही च॑ म उ॒क्षा च॑ मे व॒शा च॑ म ऋष॒भश्च॑ मे वे॒हच्च॑ मेऽन॒ड्वाँश्च॑ मे धे॒नुश्च॑ मे य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: paṣṭhavāṭ ca me paṣṭhauhī ca ma ukṣā ca me vaśā ca ma ṛṣabhaśca me vehacca me'naḍvām̐śca me dhenuśca me yajñena kalpantām ||
verses.translation: May my six-year bull and my six-year cow, and my bull and my barren cow, and my young bull and my calf-slipping cow, and my ox and my milch-cow prosper by sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
वाजा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ प्रस॒वाय॒ स्वाहा॑ऽपि॒जाय॒ स्वाहा॒ क्रत॑वे॒ स्वाहा॒ वस॑वे॒ स्वाहा॑ऽह॒र्पत॑ये॒ स्वाहाऽह्ने॑ मु॒ग्धाय॒ स्वाहा॑ मु॒ग्धाय॑ वैनᳪशि॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॑ विन॒ᳪशिन॑ आन्त्याय॒नाय॒ स्वाहाऽऽन्त्या॑य भौव॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ पत॑ये॒ स्वाहाऽधि॑पतये॒ स्वाहा॑ प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
इ॒यं ते॒ राण्मि॒त्राय॑ य॒न्ताऽसि॒ यम॑न ऊ॒र्जे त्वा॒ वृष्ट्यै॑ त्वा प्र॒जानां॒ त्वाऽऽधि॑पत्याय ॥
verses.transliteration:
vājāya svāhā prasavāya svāhā'pijāya svāhā kratave svāhā vasave svāhā'harpataye svāhā'hne mugdhāya svāhā mugdhāya vainaṃśināya svāhā vinaṃśina āntyāyanāya svāhā''ntyāya bhauvanāya svāhā bhuvanasya pataye svāhā'dhipataye svāhā prajāpataye svāhā |
iyaṃ te rāṇmitrāya yantā'si yamana ūrje tvā vṛṣṭyai tvā prajānāṃ tvā''dhipatyāya ||
verses.translation: To strength, Hail! To Gain, Hail! To After-born, Hail! To Power, Hail! To Vasu, Hail! To the Lord of Days, Hail! To the Failing Day, Hail! To the Failing Sprung from the Transitory, Hail! To the Transitory sprung from the Final, Hail! To the Final Mundane, Hail! To the Lord of the World, Hail! To the Sovran Lord, Hail! To Prajâpati, Hail! This is thy kingdom. Thou art a guiding controller for the friend. Thee for vigour, thee for rain, thee for the sovran lordship of creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
आयु॑र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां प्रा॒णो य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां॒ चक्षु॑र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ श्रोत्रं॑ य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां॒ वाग्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां॒ मनो॑ य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतामा॒त्मा य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां ब्र॒ह्मा य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां॒ ज्योति॑र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्व॒र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां पृ॒ष्ठं य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पतां य॒ज्ञो य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पताम् ।
स्तोम॑श्च यजु॑श्च॒ ऋक् च॒ साम॑ च बृ॒हच्च॑ रथन्त॒रं च॑ ।
स्व॑र्देवा अगन्मा॒मृता॑ अभूम प्र॒जाप॑तेः प्र॒जा अ॑भूम॒ वेट् स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
āyuryajñena kalpatāṃ prāṇo yajñena kalpatāṃ cakṣuryajñena kalpatāṃ śrotraṃ yajñena kalpatāṃ vāgyajñena kalpatāṃ mano yajñena kalpatāmātmā yajñena kalpatāṃ brahmā yajñena kalpatāṃ jyotiryajñena kalpatāṃ svaryajñena kalpatāṃ pṛṣṭhaṃ yajñena kalpatāṃ yajño yajñena kalpatām |
stomaśca yajuśca ṛk ca sāma ca bṛhacca rathantaraṃ ca |
svardevā aganmāmṛtā abhūma prajāpateḥ prajā abhūma veṭ svāhā ||
verses.translation: May life succeed through sacrifice. May life-breath thrive by sacrifice. May the eye thrive by sacrifice. May the ear thrive by sacrifice. May the voice thrive by sacrifice. May the mind thrive by sacrifice. May the self thrive by sacrifice. May Brahma thrive by sacrifice. May light succeed by sacrifice. May heaven succeed by sacrifice. May the hymn thrive by sacrifice. May sacrifice thrive by sacrifice; And laud and sacrificial text, and verse of praise and Sâma chant, The Brihat and Rathantara. Gods, we have gone to light. We have become the children of Prajâpati. We have become immortal.

verses.sanskrit:
वाज॑स्य॒ नु प्र॑स॒वे मा॒तरं॑ म॒हीमदि॑तिं॒ नाम॒ वच॑सा करामहे ।
यस्या॑मि॒दं विश्वं॒ भुव॑नमावि॒वेश॒ तस्यां॑ नो दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता धर्म॑ साविषत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vājasya nu prasave mātaraṃ mahīmaditiṃ nāma vacasā karāmahe |
yasyāmidaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanamāviveśa tasyāṃ no devaḥ savitā dharma sāviṣat ||
verses.translation: In gain of wealth we celebrate, etc: = IX. 5.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वे॑ अ॒द्य म॒रुतो॒ विश्व॑ ऊ॒ती विश्वे॑ भवन्त्व॒ग्नयः॒ समि॑द्धाः ।
विश्वे॑ नो दे॒वा अव॒साऽऽग॑मन्तु॒ विश्व॑मस्तु॒ द्रवि॑णं॒ वाजो॑ अ॒स्मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantvagnayaḥ samiddhāḥ |
viśve no devā avasā''gamantu viśvamastu draviṇaṃ vājo asme ||
verses.translation: This day come all the Maruts, all to aid us! Let all the fires be thoroughly enkindled. May the All-Gods come hither with protection. May we possess all property and riches.

verses.sanskrit: वाजो॑ नः स॒प्त प्र॒दिश॒श्चत॑स्रो वा परा॒वतः॑ । वाजो॑ नो॒ विश्वै॑र्दे॒वैर्धन॑सातावि॒हाव॑तु ॥
verses.transliteration: vājo naḥ sapta pradiśaścatasro vā parāvataḥ | vājo no viśvairdevairdhanasātāvihāvatu ||
verses.translation: May our strength fill the regions seven, fill the four distant places full. Here may our riches guard us with the All-Gods in the gain of wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
वाजो॑ नो अ॒द्य प्र सु॑वाति॒ दानं॒ वाजो॑ दे॒वाँ२ ऋ॒तुभिः॑ कल्पयाति ।
वाजो॒ हि मा॒ सर्व॑वीरं ज॒जान॒ विश्वा॒ आशा॒ वाज॑पतिर्जयेयम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vājo no adya pra suvāti dānaṃ vājo devām̐ ṛtubhiḥ kalpayāti |
vājo hi mā sarvavīraṃ jajāna viśvā āśā vājapatirjayeyam ||
verses.translation: May strength to-day procure for us donations strength range the Gods together with the Seasons. Yea, strength hath made me rich in store of heroes. As lord of strength may I gain all the regions.

verses.sanskrit:
वाजः॑ पु॒रस्ता॑दु॒त म॑ध्य॒तो नो॒ वाजो॑ दे॒वान् ह॒विषा॑ वर्धयाति ।
वाजो॒ हि मा॒ सर्व॑वीरं च॒कार॒ सर्वा॒ आशा॒ वाज॑पतिर्भवेयम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vājaḥ purastāduta madhyato no vājo devān haviṣā vardhayāti |
vājo hi mā sarvavīraṃ cakāra sarvā āśā vājapatirbhaveyam ||
verses.translation: Strength be before us, in the midst among us. May strength exalt the Gods with our oblation. Yea, strength hath made me rich in store of heroes. As lord of strength may I gain all the regions.

verses.sanskrit: सं मा॑ सृजामि॒ पय॑सा पृथि॒व्याः सं मा॑ सृजाम्य॒द्भिरोष॑धीभिः । सो॒ऽहं वाज॑ᳪ सनेयमग्ने ॥
verses.transliteration: saṃ mā sṛjāmi payasā pṛthivyāḥ saṃ mā sṛjāmyadbhiroṣadhībhiḥ | so'haṃ vājaṃ saneyamagne ||
verses.translation: With milk of Prithivî do I unite me, unite myself with waters and with plants. As such may I gain strength, O Agni.

verses.sanskrit: पयः॑ पृथि॒व्यां पय॒ ओष॑धीषु॒ पयो॑ दि॒व्यन्तरि॑क्षे॒ पयो॑ धाः । पय॑स्वतीः प्र॒दिशः॑ सन्तु॒ मह्य॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: payaḥ pṛthivyāṃ paya oṣadhīṣu payo divyantarikṣe payo dhāḥ | payasvatīḥ pradiśaḥ santu mahyam ||
verses.translation: Store milk in earth and milk in plants, milk in the sky and milk in air. Teeming with milk for me he all the regions.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् ।
सर॑स्वत्यै वा॒चो य॒न्तुर्य॒न्त्रेणा॒ग्नेः साम्रा॑ज्येना॒भिषि॑ञ्चामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām |
sarasvatyai vāco yanturyantreṇāgneḥ sāmrājyenābhiṣiñcāmi ||
verses.translation: Thee by the radiant Savitar's impulsion, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan, Controlled by Vâk Sarasvatî's Controller, with Agni's sole dominion I besprinkle.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒ता॒षाडृ॒तधा॑मा॒ऽग्निर्ग॑न्ध॒र्वस्तस्यौ॑षधयोऽप्स॒रसो॒ मुदो॒ नाम॑ ।
स न॑ इ॒दं ब्रह्म॑ क्ष॒त्रं पा॑तु॒ तस्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ वाट् ताभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛtāṣāḍṛtadhāmā'gnirgandharvastasyauṣadhayo'psaraso mudo nāma |
sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā vāṭ tābhyaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Maintainer of Law, true by nature, Agni is the Gandharva. The plants are his Apsarases, namely Delights. May he protect this our Priesthood and Nobility. To him All-hail! Ave! To those All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
स॒ᳪहि॒तो वि॒श्वसा॑मा॒ सूर्यो॑ गन्ध॒र्वस्तस्य॒ मरी॑चयोऽप्स॒रस॑ आ॒युवो॒ नाम॑ ।
स न॑ इ॒दं ब्रह्म॑ क्ष॒त्रं पा॑तु॒ तस्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ वाट् ताभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃhito viśvasāmā sūryo gandharvastasya marīcayo'psarasa āyuvo nāma |
sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā vāṭ tābhyaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: The Conjoined, Visvasâman, Sûrya is the Gandharva. His motes are his Apsarases, Swift-moving. May he protect, etc., as in 38.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒षु॒म्णः सूर्य॑रश्मिश्च॒न्द्रमा॑ गन्ध॒र्वस्तस्य॒ नक्ष॑त्राण्यप्स॒रसो॑ भे॒कुर॑यो॒ नाम॑ ।
स न॑ इ॒दं ब्रह्म॑ क्ष॒त्रं पा॑तु॒ तस्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ वाट् ताभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
suṣumṇaḥ sūryaraśmiścandramā gandharvastasya nakṣatrāṇyapsaraso bhekurayo nāma |
sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā vāṭ tābhyaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: The Highly-Blessed, the Moon whose rays are like the Sun's, is the Gandharva. The Asterisms are his Apsarases, Luminous. May he protect, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒षि॒रो वि॒श्वव्य॑चा॒ वातो॑ गन्ध॒र्वस्तस्यापो॑ अप्स॒रस॒ ऊर्जो॒ नाम॑ ।
स न॑ इ॒दं ब्रह्म॑ क्ष॒त्रं पा॑तु॒ तस्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ वाट् ताभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
iṣiro viśvavyacā vāto gandharvastasyāpo apsarasa ūrjo nāma |
sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā vāṭ tābhyaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: The Quick, All-reaching, Wind is the Gandharva. The Waters are his Apsarases, named Energies. May he protect, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
भु॒ज्युः सु॑प॒र्णो य॒ज्ञो ग॑न्ध॒र्वतस्य॒ दक्षि॑णा अप्स॒रस॑ स्ता॒वा नाम॑ ।
स न॑ इ॒दं ब्रह्म॑ क्ष॒त्रं पा॑तु॒ तस्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ वाट् ताभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhujyuḥ suparṇo yajño gandharvatasya dakṣiṇā apsarasa stāvā nāma |
sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā vāṭ tābhyaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: The Protecting, Strong-winged, Sacrifice is the Gandharva. Guerdons are his Apsarases, called Praisers. May he protect, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जाप॑तिर्वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ मनो॑ गन्ध॒र्वस्तस्य॑ ऋक्सा॒मान्य॑प्स॒रस॒ एष्ट॑यो॒ नाम॑ ।
स न॑ इ॒दं ब्रह्म॑ क्ष॒त्रं पा॑तु॒ तस्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ वाट् ताभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajāpatirviśvakarmā mano gandharvastasya ṛksāmānyapsarasa eṣṭayo nāma |
sa na idaṃ brahma kṣatraṃ pātu tasmai svāhā vāṭ tābhyaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: The Lord of Creatures, Omnific, Mind is the Gandharva. Richas and Sâmans are his Apsarases, called Wishings. May he protect, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
स नो॑ भुवनस्य पते प्रजापते॒ यस्य॑ त उ॒परि॑ गृ॒हा यस्य॑ वे॒ह ।
अस्मै॒ ब्रह्म॑णेऽस्मै क्ष॒त्राय॒ महि॒ शर्म॑ यच्छ॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa no bhuvanasya pate prajāpate yasya ta upari gṛhā yasya veha |
asmai brahmaṇe'smai kṣatrāya mahi śarma yaccha svāhā ||
verses.translation: Lord of the World, Prajâpati, whose are the homes above and here, Give great protection unto these, the Priesthood and Nobility.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒मु॒द्रो॒ऽसि॒ नभ॑स्वाना॒र्द्रदा॑नुः श॒म्भूर्म॑यो॒भूर॒भि मा॑ वाहि॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
मारु॒तो॒ऽसि म॒रुतां॑ ग॒णः श॒म्भूर्म॑यो॒भूर॒भि मा॑ वाहि॒ स्वाहा॑ऽव॒स्यूर॑सि॒ दुव॑स्वाञ्छ॒म्भूर्म॑यो॒भूर॒भि मा॑ वाहि॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
samudro'si nabhasvānārdradānuḥ śambhūrmayobhūrabhi mā vāhi svāhā |
māruto'si marutāṃ gaṇaḥ śambhūrmayobhūrabhi mā vāhi svāhā'vasyūrasi duvasvāñchambhūrmayobhūrabhi mā vāhi svāhā ||
verses.translation: Thou art the vapoury sea that giveth moisture. Blow on me, thou, healthful and blessing-laden. Thou art the Maruts own, the band of Maruts. Blow on me, etc. Seeker of aid art thou, receiving worship. Blow on me, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
यास्ते॑ अग्ने॒ सूर्ये॒ रुचो॒ दिव॑मात॒न्वन्ति॑ र॒श्मिभिः॑ ।
ताभि॑र्नो अ॒द्य सर्वा॑भी रु॒चे जना॑य नस्कृधि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāste agne sūrye ruco divamātanvanti raśmibhiḥ |
tābhirno adya sarvābhī ruce janāya naskṛdhi ||
verses.translation: Thy lights, O Agni, in the Sun, etc., as in XIII. 22.

verses.sanskrit:
या वो॑ दे॒वाः सूर्ये॒ रुचो॒ गोष्वश्वे॑षु॒ या रुचः॑ ।
इन्द्रा॑ग्नी॒ ताभिः॒ सर्वा॑भी॒ रुचं॑ नो धत्त बृहस्पते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā vo devāḥ sūrye ruco goṣvaśveṣu yā rucaḥ |
indrāgnī tābhiḥ sarvābhī rucaṃ no dhatta bṛhaspate ||
verses.translation: Lights of yours in the Sun, O Gods, etc., as in XIII. 23.

verses.sanskrit: रुचं॑ नो धेहि ब्राह्म॒णेषु॒ रुच॒ᳪ राज॑सु नस्कृधि । रुचं॒ विश्ये॑षु शू॒द्रेषु॒ मयि॑ धेहि रु॒चा रुच॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: rucaṃ no dhehi brāhmaṇeṣu rucaṃ rājasu naskṛdhi | rucaṃ viśyeṣu śūdreṣu mayi dhehi rucā rucam ||
verses.translation: Give lustre to our holy priests, set lustre in our ruling chiefs Lustre to Vaisyas, Sûdras: give, through lustre; lustre unto me.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्त्वा॑ यामि॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ वन्द॑मान॒स्तदा शा॑स्ते॒ यज॑मानो ह॒विर्भिः॑ ।
अहे॑डमानो वरुणे॒ह बो॒ध्युरु॑शᳪस॒ मा न॒ आयुः॒ प्र मो॑षीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadā śāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ |
aheḍamāno varuṇeha bodhyuruśaṃsa mā na āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ ||
verses.translation: I ask this of thee with my prayer, adoring: thy worshipper asks this with his oblations. Varuna, stay thou here and be not angry: steal not our life from us, O thou Wide-Ruler.

verses.sanskrit:
स्व॒र्ण घ॒र्मः स्वाहा॑ स्वर्णार्कः स्वाहा॑ स्वर्ण शु॒क्रः स्वाहा स्वर्ण ज्योतिः॒ स्वाहा॒
स्वर्ण सूर्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
svarṇa gharmaḥ svāhā svarṇārkaḥ svāhā svarṇa śukraḥ svāhā svarṇa jyotiḥ svāhā
svarṇa sūryaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Heaven-like is Warmth, Hail! Heaven-like is Arka, Hail! Heaven-like is the Bright One, Hail! Heaven-like is Light, Hail! Heaven-like is Sûrya, Hail!

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निं यु॑नज्मि॒ शव॑सा घृ॒तेन॑ दि॒व्यᳪ सु॑प॒र्णं वय॑सा बृ॒हन्त॑म् ।
तेन॑ व॒यं ग॑मेम ब्र॒ध्नस्य॑ वि॒ष्टप॒ᳪ स्वो रुहा॑णा॒ अधि॒ नाक॑मुत्त॒मम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agniṃ yunajmi śavasā ghṛtena divyaṃ suparṇaṃ vayasā bṛhantam |
tena vayaṃ gamema bradhnasya viṣṭapaṃ svo ruhāṇā adhi nākamuttamam ||
verses.translation: I yoke with power and flowing butter Agni, divine, strongpinioned, great with vital vigour. Through him may we approach the Bright One's station, ascending to the loftiest sky, to heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मौ ते॑ प॒क्षाव॒जरौ॑ पत॒त्रिणौ॒ याभ्या॒ᳪ रक्षा॑ᳪस्यप॒हᳪस्य॑ग्ने ।
ताभ्यां॑ पतेम सु॒कृता॑मु लो॒कं यत्र॒ ऋष॑यो ज॒ग्मुः प्र॑थम॒जाः पु॑रा॒णाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
imau te pakṣāvajarau patatriṇau yābhyāṃ rakṣāṃsyapahaṃsyagne |
tābhyāṃ patema sukṛtāmu lokaṃ yatra ṛṣayo jagmuḥ prathamajāḥ purāṇāḥ ||
verses.translation: With these thy two neer-wasting feathered pinions wherewith thou drivest fiends away, O Agni, Let us fly to the regions of the pious whither have gone the first-born ancient Rishis.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्दु॒र्दक्षः॑ श्ये॒न ऋ॒तावा॒ हिर॑ण्यपक्षः शकु॒नो भु॑र॒ण्युः ।
म॒हान्त्स॒धस्थे॑ ध्रु॒व आ निष॑त्तो॒ नम॑स्ते अस्तु॒ मा मा॑ हिᳪसीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
indurdakṣaḥ śyena ṛtāvā hiraṇyapakṣaḥ śakuno bhuraṇyuḥ |
mahāntsadhasthe dhruva ā niṣatto namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ ||
verses.translation: The Drop, the powerful, the falcon, righteous, impetuous bird borne on his golden pinions, Great, stedfast, settled in the habitation—to thee be reverence! Forbear to harm thee!

verses.sanskrit: दि॒वो मू॒र्धाऽसि॑ पृथि॒व्या नाभि॒रूर्ग॒पामोष॑धीनाम् । वि॒श्वायुः॒ शर्म॑ स॒प्रथा॒ नम॑स्प॒थे ॥
verses.transliteration: divo mūrdhā'si pṛthivyā nābhirūrgapāmoṣadhīnām | viśvāyuḥ śarma saprathā namaspathe ||
verses.translation: Centre of earth, heaven's head art thou, essence of waters and of plants. Eternal, far spread refuge. Homage to the Path!

verses.sanskrit:
विश्व॑स्य मू॒र्धन्नधि॑ तिष्ठसि श्रि॒तः स॑मु॒द्रे ते॒ हृद॑यम॒प्स्वायु॑र॒पो द॑त्तोद॒धिं भि॑न्त ।
दि॒वस्प॒र्जन्या॑द॒न्तरि॑क्षात्पृथि॒व्यास्ततो॑ नो॒ वृष्ट्या॑व ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvasya mūrdhannadhi tiṣṭhasi śritaḥ samudre te hṛdayamapsvāyurapo dattodadhiṃ bhinta |
divasparjanyādantarikṣātpṛthivyāstato no vṛṣṭyāva ||
verses.translation: Attached thou standest at the head of all the world. Thy heart is in the sea, thy life is in the floods. Give water: cleave the reservoir. Help us with rain sent from the sky, Parjanya, firmament, or earth.

verses.sanskrit: इ॒ष्टो य॒ज्ञो भृगु॑भिराशी॒र्दा वसु॑भिः । तस्य॑ न इ॒ष्टस्य॑ प्री॒तस्य॒ द्रवि॑णे॒हा ग॑मेः ॥
verses.transliteration: iṣṭo yajño bhṛgubhirāśīrdā vasubhiḥ | tasya na iṣṭasya prītasya draviṇehā gameḥ ||
verses.translation: By Bhrigus and by Vasus hath prayer-granting sacrifice been paid. Come, Wealth, into the house of him our dear, our well-beloved one.

verses.sanskrit: इ॒ष्टो अ॒ग्निराहु॑तः पिपर्तु न इ॒ष्टᳪ ह॒विः । स्व॒गेदं दे॒वेभ्यो॒ नमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: iṣṭo agnirāhutaḥ pipartu na iṣṭaṃ haviḥ | svagedaṃ devebhyo namaḥ ||
verses.translation: May Agni, served with sacrifice and gifts, protect our offered food: This homage be Good-speed to Gods!

verses.sanskrit:
यदाकू॑तात्स॒मसु॑स्रोद्धृ॒दो वा॒ मन॑सो वा॒ सम्भृ॑तं॒ चक्षु॑षो वा ।
तदनु॒ प्रेत॑ सु॒कृता॑मु लो॒कं यत्र॒ ऋष॑यो ज॒ग्मुः प्र॑थम॒जाः पु॑रा॒णाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadākūtātsamasusroddhṛdo vā manaso vā sambhṛtaṃ cakṣuṣo vā |
tadanu preta sukṛtāmu lokaṃ yatra ṛṣayo jagmuḥ prathamajāḥ purāṇāḥ ||
verses.translation: That which hath flowed from purpose or from judgment, or gathered from the wind or from the vision, Follow ye to the region of the pious whither have gone the first-born ancient Rishis.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒तᳪ स॑धस्थ॒ परि॑ ते ददामि॒ यमा॒वहा॑च्छेव॒धिं जा॒तवे॑दाः ।
अ॒न्वा॒ग॒न्ता य॒ज्ञप॑तिर्वो॒ अत्र॒ तᳪ स्म॑ जानीत पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
etaṃ sadhastha pari te dadāmi yamāvahācchevadhiṃ jātavedāḥ |
anvāgantā yajñapatirvo atra taṃ sma jānīta parame vyoman ||
verses.translation: To thee I trust this man. Celestial Dwelling! treasure which Jâtavedas shall bring hither. After you will the Sacrificer follow. Here recognize him in the highest heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒तं जा॑नाथ पर॒मे व्यो॑म॒न् देवाः॑ सधस्था वि॒द रू॒पम॑स्य ।
यदा॒गच्छा॑त्प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानै॑रिष्टापू॒र्ते कृ॑णवाथा॒विर॑स्मै ॥
verses.transliteration:
etaṃ jānātha parame vyoman devāḥ sadhasthā vida rūpamasya |
yadāgacchātpathibhirdevayānairiṣṭāpūrte kṛṇavāthāvirasmai ||
verses.translation: Acknowledge him, ye Gods, in highest heaven. Ye who are present, know the shape he weareth. When he approacheth by the God-ward pathways, reveal to him the meed of pious actions.

verses.sanskrit:
उद्बु॑ध्यस्वाग्ने॒ प्रति॑ जागृहि॒ त्वमि॑ष्टापू॒र्ते सᳪ सृ॑जेथाम॒यं च॑ ।
अ॒स्मिन्त्स॒धस्थे॒ अध्युत्त॑रस्मि॒न्विश्वे॑ देवा॒ यज॑मानाश्च सीदत ॥
verses.transliteration:
udbudhyasvāgne prati jāgṛhi tvamiṣṭāpūrte saṃ sṛjethāmayaṃ ca |
asmintsadhasthe adhyuttarasminviśve devā yajamānāśca sīdata ||
verses.translation: Wake up, O Agni, etc., as in XV. 54.

verses.sanskrit: येन॒ वह॑सि स॒हस्रं॒ येना॑ग्ने सर्ववेद॒सम् । तेने॒मं य॒ज्ञं नो॑ नय॒ स्व॒र्दे॒वेषु॒ गन्त॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration: yena vahasi sahasraṃ yenāgne sarvavedasam | tenemaṃ yajñaṃ no naya svardeveṣu gantave ||
verses.translation: Convey our sacrifice to heaven, etc., as in XV. 55,

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒स्त॒रेण॑ परि॒धिना॑ स्रु॒चा वेद्या॑ च ब॒र्हिषा॑ । ऋ॒चेमं य॒ज्ञं नो॑ नय॒ स्व॒र्दे॒वेषु॒ गन्त॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration: prastareṇa paridhinā srucā vedyā ca barhiṣā | ṛcemaṃ yajñaṃ no naya svardeveṣu gantave ||
verses.translation: With Darbha-bunch, with fencing-wood, with spoon, with altar, holy grass, With laud, lead this our sacrifice to go to heaven among the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: यद्द॒त्तं यत्प॑रा॒दानं॒ यत्पू॒र्तं याश्च॒ दक्षि॑णाः । तद॒ग्निर्वै॑श्वकर्म॒णः स्व॑र्दे॒वेषु॑ नो दधत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yaddattaṃ yatparādānaṃ yatpūrtaṃ yāśca dakṣiṇāḥ | tadagnirvaiśvakarmaṇaḥ svardeveṣu no dadhat ||
verses.translation: Our gifts, our charitable grants, our pious works, our fees to priests, May the Omnific's Agni set all this among the Gods in heaven.

verses.sanskrit: यत्र॒ धारा॒ अन॑पेता॒ मधो॑र्घृ॒तस्य॑ च॒ याः । तद॒ग्निर्वै॑श्वकर्म॒णः स्व॑दे॒र्वेषु॑ नो दधत् ॥
verses.transliteration: yatra dhārā anapetā madhorghṛtasya ca yāḥ | tadagnirvaiśvakarmaṇaḥ svaderveṣu no dadhat ||
verses.translation: There where all never-failing streams of honey and of butter flow, May Agni, Visvakarman's own, place us in heaven among the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निर॑स्मि॒ जन्म॑ना जा॒तवे॑दा घृ॒तं मे॒ चक्षु॑र॒मृतं॑ म आ॒सन् ।
अ॒र्कस्त्रि॒धातू॒ रज॑सो वि॒मानोऽज॑स्रो घ॒र्मो ह॒विर॑स्मि॒ नाम॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnirasmi janmanā jātavedā ghṛtaṃ me cakṣuramṛtaṃ ma āsan |
arkastridhātū rajaso vimāno'jasro gharmo havirasmi nāma ||
verses.translation: Agni am who know by birth all creatures. Mine eye is butter, in my mouth is nectar. I am the triple light, the region's meter: exhaustless heat am I, named burnt oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋचो॒ नामा॑स्मि॒ यजू॑ ᳪषि॒ नामा॑स्मि॒ सामा॑नि॒ नामा॑स्मि ।
ये अ॒ग्नयः॒ पाञ्च॑जन्या अ॒स्यां पृ॑थि॒व्यामधि॑ ।
तेषा॑मसि॒ त्वमु॑त्त॒मः प्र नो॑ जी॒वात॑वे सुव ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛco nāmāsmi yajū ṃṣi nāmāsmi sāmāni nāmāsmi |
ye agnayaḥ pāñcajanyā asyāṃ pṛthivyāmadhi |
teṣāmasi tvamuttamaḥ pra no jīvātave suva ||
verses.translation: Praise-verses, sacrificial texts, and chanted hymns am I in name. Thou art the best of all the Fires among the fivefold race of man That burn upon this earth of ours. Speed thou us on to lengthened life.

verses.sanskrit: वार्त्र॑हत्याय॒ शव॑से पृतना॒षाह्या॑य च । इन्द्र॒ त्वाऽऽव॑र्तयामसि ॥
verses.transliteration: vārtrahatyāya śavase pṛtanāṣāhyāya ca | indra tvā''vartayāmasi ||
verses.translation: O Indra, for the strength that slays Vritra and conquers in the fight We torn thee hitherward to us.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒हदा॑नुं पुरुहूत क्षि॒यन्त॑मह॒स्तमि॑न्द्र॒ सं पि॑ण॒क् कुणा॑रुम् ।
अ॒भि वृ॒त्रं वर्ध॑मानं॒ पिया॑रुम॒पाद॑मिन्द्र त॒वसा॑ जघन्थ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahadānuṃ puruhūta kṣiyantamahastamindra saṃ piṇak kuṇārum |
abhi vṛtraṃ vardhamānaṃ piyārumapādamindra tavasā jaghantha ||
verses.translation: Thou, Indra, much-invoked, didst crush to pieces, Kunâru, handless fiend who dwelt with Dânus. Thou with might, Indra, smotest dead the scorner, the footless Vritra as he waxed in vigour.

verses.sanskrit:
वि न॑ इन्द्र॒ मृधो॑ जहि नी॒चा य॑च्छ पृतन्य॒तः ।
यो अ॒स्माँ२ अ॑भि॒दास॒त्यध॑रं गमया॒ तमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vi na indra mṛdho jahi nīcā yaccha pṛtanyataḥ |
yo asmām̐ abhidāsatyadharaṃ gamayā tamaḥ ||
verses.translation: O Indra, beat our foes away, etc. as in VIII. 44.

verses.sanskrit:
मृ॒गो न भी॒मः कु॑च॒रो गि॑रि॒ष्ठाः प॑रा॒वत॒ आ ज॑गन्था॒ पर॑स्याः ।
सृ॒कᳪ स॒ᳪशाय॑ प॒विमि॑न्द्र ति॒ग्मं वि शत्रू॑न् ताढि॒ वि मृधो॑ नुदस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
mṛgo na bhīmaḥ kucaro giriṣṭhāḥ parāvata ā jaganthā parasyāḥ |
sṛkaṃ saṃśāya pavimindra tigmaṃ vi śatrūn tāḍhi vi mṛdho nudasva ||
verses.translation: Like some dread wild beast roaming on the mountain thou hast approached us from the farthest distance. Whetting thy bolt and thy sharp blade, O Indra, crush thou the foes and scatter those who hate us.

verses.sanskrit: वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो न॑ ऊ॒तय॒ आ प्र या॑तु परा॒वतः॑ । अ॒ग्निर्नः॑ सुष्टु॒तीरुप॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vaiśvānaro na ūtaya ā pra yātu parāvataḥ | agnirnaḥ suṣṭutīrupa ||
verses.translation: To aid us let Vaisvânara come from the distance far away: Come Agni, to our eulogies!

verses.sanskrit:
पृ॒ष्टो दि॒वि पृ॒ष्टो अ॒ग्निः पृ॑थि॒व्यां पृ॒ष्टो विश्वा॒ ओष॑धी॒रा वि॑वेश ।
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रः सह॑सा पृ॒ष्टो अ॒ग्निः स नो॒ दिवा॒ स रि॒षस्पा॑तु॒ नक्त॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛṣṭo divi pṛṣṭo agniḥ pṛthivyāṃ pṛṣṭo viśvā oṣadhīrā viveśa |
vaiśvānaraḥ sahasā pṛṣṭo agniḥ sa no divā sa riṣaspātu naktam ||
verses.translation: Sought in the sky, sought on the earth, sought after, all plants that grow on ground hath Agni entered. May Agni, may Vaisvânara with vigour, sought for, by day and night from harm preserve us.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्याम॒ तं काम॑मग्ने॒ तवो॒ती अ॒श्याम॑ र॒यिᳪ र॑यिवः सु॒वीर॑म् ।
अ॒श्याम॒ वाज॑म॒भि वा॒जय॑न्तो॒ऽश्याम॑ द्यु॒म्नम॑जरा॒जरं॑ ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśyāma taṃ kāmamagne tavotī aśyāma rayiṃ rayivaḥ suvīram |
aśyāma vājamabhi vājayanto'śyāma dyumnamajarājaraṃ te ||
verses.translation: Help its that we may gain this wish, O Agni, gain riches, Wealthy One! with store of heroes. Desiring strength from thee may we be strengthened, and win, Eternal! thine eternal glory.

verses.sanskrit:
व॒यं ते॑ अ॒द्य र॑रि॒मा हि काम॑मुत्ता॒नह॑स्ता॒ नम॑सोप॒सद्य॑ ।
यजि॑ष्ठेन॒ मन॑सा यक्षि दे॒वानस्रे॑धता॒ मन्म॑ना॒ विप्रो॑ अग्ने ॥
verses.transliteration:
vayaṃ te adya rarimā hi kāmamuttānahastā namasopasadya |
yajiṣṭhena manasā yakṣi devānasredhatā manmanā vipro agne ||
verses.translation: Approaching with raised hands and adoration, we have this day fulfilled for thee thy longing. Worship the Gods with most devoted spirit as Priest with no unfriendly thought. O Agni.

verses.sanskrit: धा॒म॒च्छद॒ग्निरिन्द्रो॑ ब्र॒ह्मा दे॒वो बृह॒स्पतिः॑ । सचे॑तसो॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा य॒ज्ञं प्राव॑न्तु नः शु॒भे ॥
verses.transliteration: dhāmacchadagnirindro brahmā devo bṛhaspatiḥ | sacetaso viśve devā yajñaṃ prāvantu naḥ śubhe ||
verses.translation: Home-hider Agni, Indra, and Brahma, and bright Brihaspati— May the All Gods, one-minded, guard our sacrifice in happy place.

verses.sanskrit: त्वं य॑विष्ठ दा॒शुषो॒ नॄँः पा॑हि शृणु॒धी गिरः॑ । रक्षा॑ तो॒कमु॒त त्मना॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: tvaṃ yaviṣṭha dāśuṣo nṝm̐ḥ pāhi śṛṇudhī giraḥ | rakṣā tokamuta tmanā ||
verses.translation: Guard thou the Sacrificer's men, O Youthfullest, etc., as in XIII. 52.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वा॒द्वीं त्वा॑ स्वा॒दुना॑ ती॒व्रां ती॒व्रेणा॒मृता॑म॒मृते॑न । मधु॑मतीं॒ मधु॑मता सृ॒जामि॒ सᳪ सोमे॑न ।
सोमो॑ऽस्य॒श्विभ्यां॑ पच्यस्व॒ सर॑स्वत्यै पच्य॒स्वेन्द्रा॑य सु॒त्राम्णे॑ पच्यस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
svādvīṃ tvā svādunā tīvrāṃ tīvreṇāmṛtāmamṛtena | madhumatīṃ madhumatā sṛjāmi saṃ somena |
somo'syaśvibhyāṃ pacyasva sarasvatyai pacyasvendrāya sutrāmṇe pacyasva ||
verses.translation: Sweet with the sweet, I sprinkle thee with Soma, strong with the strong, the nectar with the nectar, The honey-sweet with what is sweet as honey. Soma art thou. Get dressed for the Asvins. Get dressed for Sarasvatî. Get dressed for Indra the Good Deliverer.

verses.sanskrit:
परी॒तो षि॑ञ्च॒ता सु॒तᳪ सोमो॒ य उ॑त्त॒मᳪ ह॒विः ।
द॒ध॒न्वा यो नर्यो॑ अ॒प्स्वन्तरा सु॒षाव॒ सोम॒मद्रि॑भिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
parīto ṣiñcatā sutaṃ somo ya uttamaṃ haviḥ |
dadhanvā yo naryo apsvantarā suṣāva somamadribhiḥ ||
verses.translation: Hence pour ye forth the flowing juice, Soma, best Sacrificial food. He who, man's friend, hath run within the waters hath with the pressing-stones poured out the Soma.

verses.sanskrit: वा॒योः पू॒तः प॒वित्रे॑ण प्र॒त्यङ्क्सोमो॒ अति॑द्रुतः । इन्द्र॑स्य॒ युज्यः॒ सखा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vāyoḥ pūtaḥ pavitreṇa pratyaṅksomo atidrutaḥ | indrasya yujyaḥ sakhā ||
verses.translation: Purified by Vâyu's strainer, Soma that has passed away forward is Indra's proper friend. Purified by Vâyu's strainer, Soma that has passed away backward is Indra's proper friend.

verses.sanskrit: पु॒नाति॑ ते परि॒स्रुत॒ᳪ सोम॒ᳪ सूर्य॑स्य दुहि॒ता । वारे॑ण॒ शश्व॑ता॒ तना॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: punāti te parisrutaṃ somaṃ sūryasya duhitā | vāreṇa śaśvatā tanā ||
verses.translation: By means of this eternal sieve may Sûrya's Daughter purify The Soma that flows forth from thee.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्म॑ क्ष॒त्रं प॑वते॒ तेज॑ इन्द्रि॒यᳪ सुर॑या॒ सोमः॑ सु॒त आसु॑तो॒ मदा॑य ।
शु॒क्रेण॑ देव दे॒वताः॑ पिपृग्धि॒ रसे॒नान्नं॒ यज॑मानाय धेहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahma kṣatraṃ pavate teja indriyaṃ surayā somaḥ suta āsuto madāya |
śukreṇa deva devatāḥ pipṛgdhi rasenānnaṃ yajamānāya dhehi ||
verses.translation: Soma with Wine, pressed; filtered for the banquet, cleanses priest, noble, brilliancy and vigour. God, with the Bright give Deities enjoyment: give food with flavour to the Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit:
कु॒विद॒ङ्ग यव॑मन्तो॒ यवं॑ चि॒द्यथा॒ दान्त्य॑नुपू॒र्वं वि॒यूय॑ ।
इ॒हेहै॑षां कृणुहि॒ भोज॑नानि॒ ये ब॒र्हिषो॒ नम॑ उक्तिं॒ यज॑न्ति ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒श्विभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ त्वेन्द्रा॑य त्वा सु॒त्राम्ण॑ ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒स्तेज॑से त्वा वी॒र्या॒य त्वा॒ बला॑य त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavaṃ cidyathā dāntyanupūrvaṃ viyūya |
ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo nama uktiṃ yajanti |
upayāmagṛhīto'syaśvibhyāṃ tvā sarasvatyai tvendrāya tvā sutrāmṇa eṣa te yonistejase tvā vīryāya tvā balāya tvā ||
verses.translation: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley, etc., as in X. 32. Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee for the Asvin Pair. Thee for Sarasvatî. Thee for Indra the Good Deliverer. This is thy home. For splendour thee. Thee for mans vigour. Thee for strength.

verses.sanskrit:
नाना॒ हि वां॑ दे॒वहि॑त॒ᳪ सद॑स्कृ॒तं मा सᳪ सृ॑क्षाथां पर॒मे व्यो॑मन् ।
सुरा॒ त्वमसि॑ शु॒ष्मिणी॒ सोम॑ ए॒ष मा मा॑ हिᳪसीः॒ स्वां योनि॑मावि॒शन्ती॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
nānā hi vāṃ devahitaṃ sadaskṛtaṃ mā saṃ sṛkṣāthāṃ parame vyoman |
surā tvamasi śuṣmiṇī soma eṣa mā mā hiṃsīḥ svāṃ yonimāviśantī ||
verses.translation: For each of you is made a God-appointed place: so grant to me a portion in the highest sphere. Surâ the strong art thou. This here is Soma. Entering thine own place do me no mischief.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽस्याश्वि॑नं॒ तेजः॑ सारस्व॒तं वी॒र्य॒मै॒न्द्रं बल॑म् ।
ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्मोदा॑य त्वा ऽऽन॒न्दाय॑ त्वा॒ मह॑से त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
upayāmagṛhīto'syāśvinaṃ tejaḥ sārasvataṃ vīryamaindraṃ balam |
eṣa te yonirmodāya tvā ''nandāya tvā mahase tvā ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Splendour of Asvins, Sarasvatî's manly vigour, might of Indra. This is thy home. I take thee for enjoyment. I take thee for delight, take thee for greatness.

verses.sanskrit: तेजो॑ऽसि॒ तेजो॒ मयि॑ धेहि वी॒र्य॒मसि वी॒र्यं मयि॑ धेहि बल॑मसि॒ बलं॒ मयि॑ धे॒ह्योजो॒ऽस्योजो॒ मयि॑ धेहि म॒न्युर॑सि म॒न्युं मयि॑ धेहि॒ सहो॑ऽसि॒ सहो॒ मयि॑ धेहि ॥
verses.transliteration: tejo'si tejo mayi dhehi vīryamasi vīryaṃ mayi dhehi balamasi balaṃ mayi dhehyojo'syojo mayi dhehi manyurasi manyuṃ mayi dhehi saho'si saho mayi dhehi ||
verses.translation: Thou art lustre: give me lustre, Thou art manly vigour: give me manly vigour. Thou art strength: give me strength. Thou art energy: give me energy. Thou art passion: Give me passion. Thou art conquering might: give me conquering might.

verses.sanskrit: या व्या॒घ्रं विषू॑चिकोभौ॒ वृकं॑ च॒ रक्ष॑ति । श्ये॒नं प॑त॒त्रिण॑ᳪ सि॒ᳪहᳪ सेमं पा॒त्वᳪह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration: yā vyāghraṃ viṣūcikobhau vṛkaṃ ca rakṣati | śyenaṃ patatriṇaṃ siṃhaṃ semaṃ pātvaṃhasaḥ ||
verses.translation: My she, Vishûchikâ, who guards these two, the tiger and the wolf, The lion and the wingèd hawk, may she guard this man from distress.

verses.sanskrit:
यदा॑पि॒पेष॑ मा॒तरं॑ पु॒त्रः प्रमु॑दितो॒ धय॑न् । ए॒तत्तद॑ग्ने अनृ॒णो भ॑वा॒म्यह॑तौ पि॒तरौ॒ मया॑ ।
स॒म्पृच॑ स्थ॒ सं मा॑ भ॒द्रेण॑ पृङ्क्त वि॒पृच॑ स्थ॒ वि मा॑ पा॒प्मना॑ पृङ्क्त ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadāpipeṣa mātaraṃ putraḥ pramudito dhayan | etattadagne anṛṇo bhavāmyahatau pitarau mayā |
sampṛca stha saṃ mā bhadreṇa pṛṅkta vipṛca stha vi mā pāpmanā pṛṅkta ||
verses.translation: When, a delighted boy, I bruised my mother as I sucked her breast, Free from my debt, O Agni, I become thereby. My parents are by me unharmed. United are ye all: with bliss unite me. Parted are ye, keep me apart from evil.

verses.sanskrit: दे॒वा य॒ज्ञम॑तन्वत भेष॒जं भि॒षजा॒ऽश्विना॑ । वा॒चा सर॑स्वती भि॒षगिन्द्रा॑येन्द्रि॒याणि॒ दध॑तः ॥
verses.transliteration: devā yajñamatanvata bheṣajaṃ bhiṣajā'śvinā | vācā sarasvatī bhiṣagindrāyendriyāṇi dadhataḥ ||
verses.translation: The Asvins, the Physicians, Gods, stretched out the healing sacrifice, Sarasvatî with speech was a Physician, all with heroic powers investing Indra.

verses.sanskrit: दी॒क्षायै॑ रू॒पᳪ शष्पा॑णि प्राय॒णीय॑स्य॒ तोक्मा॑नि । क्र॒यस्य॑ रू॒पᳪ सोम॑स्य ला॒जाः सो॑मा॒ᳪशवो॒ मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: dīkṣāyai rūpaṃ śaṣpāṇi prāyaṇīyasya tokmāni | krayasya rūpaṃ somasya lājāḥ somāṃśavo madhu ||
verses.translation: Symbols of Dîkshâ are grass buds, of Prâyanîya sprouts of corn, Of Soma-purchasing fried grains are symbols, Soma-shoots and meath.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒ति॒थ्य॒रू॒पं मास॑रं महावी॒रस्य॑ न॒ग्नहुः॑ । रू॒पमु॑प॒सदा॑मे॒तत्ति॒स्रो रात्रीः॒ सुराऽऽसु॑ता ॥
verses.transliteration: ātithyarūpaṃ māsaraṃ mahāvīrasya nagnahuḥ | rūpamupasadāmetattisro rātrīḥ surā''sutā ||
verses.translation: Âtithya's sign is Mâsara, the Gharma's symbol Nagnahu. Three nights with Surâ poured, this is the symbol of the Upasads.

verses.sanskrit: सोम॑स्य रू॒पं क्री॒तस्य॑ परि॒स्रुत्परि॑ षिच्यते । अ॒श्विभ्यां॑ दु॒ग्धं भे॑ष॒जमिन्द्रा॑यै॒न्द्रᳪ सर॑स्वत्या ॥
verses.transliteration: somasya rūpaṃ krītasya parisrutpari ṣicyate | aśvibhyāṃ dugdhaṃ bheṣajamindrāyaindraṃ sarasvatyā ||
verses.translation: Emblem of purchased Soma is Parisrut, foaming drink effused: Indra's balm milked for Indra by the Asvins and Sarasvatî.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒स॒न्दी रू॒पᳪ रा॑जासन्द्यै॒ वेद्यै॑ कु॒म्भी सु॑रा॒धानी॑ । अन्त॑र उत्तरवे॒द्या रू॒पं का॑रोत॒रो भि॒षक् ॥
verses.transliteration: āsandī rūpaṃ rājāsandyai vedyai kumbhī surādhānī | antara uttaravedyā rūpaṃ kārotaro bhiṣak ||
verses.translation: The Sacrificer's seat is the throne's symbol, the jar containing Surâ of the Altar. The mid-space is the northern Altar's symbol: the cloth for filtering is the physician.

verses.sanskrit: वेद्या॒ वेदिः॒ समा॑प्यते ब॒र्हिषा॑ ब॒र्हिरि॑न्द्रि॒यम् । यूपे॑न॒ यूप॑ आप्यते॒ प्रणी॑तो अ॒ग्निर॒ग्निना॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vedyā vediḥ samāpyate barhiṣā barhirindriyam | yūpena yūpa āpyate praṇīto agniragninā ||
verses.translation: Altar by Altar is produced, power, holy grass by holy grass. The stake is by the stake obtained, by Agni Agni carried forth.

verses.sanskrit: ह॒वि॒र्धानं॒ यद॒श्विनाऽऽग्नी॑ध्रं॒ यत्सर॑स्वती । इन्द्रा॑यै॒न्द्रᳪ सद॑स्कृ॒तं प॑त्नी॒शालं॒ गार्ह॑पत्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: havirdhānaṃ yadaśvinā''gnīdhraṃ yatsarasvatī | indrāyaindraṃ sadaskṛtaṃ patnīśālaṃ gārhapatyaḥ ||
verses.translation: The Asvins are the Soma store, Sarasvatî the sacred hearth. For Indra formed is Indra s seat, the Matrons' Hall, the house-lord's fire.

verses.sanskrit: प्रै॒षेभिः॑ प्रै॒षाना॑प्नोत्या॒प्रीभि॑रा॒प्रीर्य॒ज्ञस्य॑ । प्र॒या॒जेभि॑रनुया॒जान् व॑षट्का॒रेभि॒राहु॑तीः ॥
verses.transliteration: praiṣebhiḥ praiṣānāpnotyāprībhirāprīryajñasya | prayājebhiranuyājān vaṣaṭkārebhirāhutīḥ ||
verses.translation: Orders he gains by orders, by Âprîs Âprîs of sacrifice, Post-offerings by fore-offerings, and by calls of Vashat Âhutis.

verses.sanskrit: प॒शुभिः॑ प॒शूना॑प्नोति पुरो॒डाशै॑र्ह॒वीᳪष्या । छन्दो॑भिः सामिधे॒नीर्या॒ज्या॒भिर्वषट्का॒रान् ॥
verses.transliteration: paśubhiḥ paśūnāpnoti puroḍāśairhavīṃṣyā | chandobhiḥ sāmidhenīryājyābhirvaṣaṭkārān ||
verses.translation: By victims he gains victims, by ground rice-cakes sacrificial food, By metres kindling-verses, and Vashat-calls by Inviting prayers.

verses.sanskrit: धा॒नाः क॑र॒म्भः सक्त॑वः परीवा॒पः पयो॒ दधि॑ । सोम॑स्य रू॒पᳪ ह॒विष॑ आ॒मिक्षा॒ वाजि॑नं॒ मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: dhānāḥ karambhaḥ saktavaḥ parīvāpaḥ payo dadhi | somasya rūpaṃ haviṣa āmikṣā vājinaṃ madhu ||
verses.translation: Grain roasted, gruel, barley-meal, grains of rice roasted, milk and curd Are types of Soma: mingled milk, sweet whey, of sacrificial food.

verses.sanskrit: धा॒नाना॑ᳪ रू॒पं कुव॑लं परीवा॒पस्य॑ गो॒धूमाः॑ । सक्तू॑नाᳪ रू॒पं बद॑रमुप॒वाकाः॑ कर॒म्भस्य॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: dhānānāṃ rūpaṃ kuvalaṃ parīvāpasya godhūmāḥ | saktūnāṃ rūpaṃ badaramupavākāḥ karambhasya ||
verses.translation: Type of parched corn is jujube-fruit; wheat of the roasted grains of rice; Jujube the type of barley-meal, and Indra-grains of gruel-groats.

verses.sanskrit: पय॑सो रू॒पं यद्यवा॑ द॒ध्नो रू॒पं क॒र्कन्धू॑नि । सोम॑स्य रू॒पं वाजि॑नᳪ सौ॒म्यस्य॑ रू॒पमा॒मिक्षा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: payaso rūpaṃ yadyavā dadhno rūpaṃ karkandhūni | somasya rūpaṃ vājinaṃ saumyasya rūpamāmikṣā ||
verses.translation: Symbol of milk are barley-grains, symbol of curd are jujube-fruits. Whey is the type of Soma, and milk-mixture type of Soma's pap.

verses.sanskrit: आ श्रा॑व॒येति॑ स्तो॒त्रियाः॑ प्रत्याश्रा॒वो अनु॑रूपः । यजेति॑ धाय्यारू॒पं प्र॑गा॒था ये॑यजाम॒हाः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā śrāvayeti stotriyāḥ pratyāśrāvo anurūpaḥ | yajeti dhāyyārūpaṃ pragāthā yeyajāmahāḥ ||
verses.translation: The Strophe is the cry, Bid hear? the answer is the antistrophe. Sacrifice! is the Dhâyyâ's form, Pragâthas the Yajâmahas.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒र्ध॒-ऋ॒चैरु॒क्थाना॑ᳪ रू॒पं प॒दैरा॑प्नोति नि॒विदः॑ । प्र॒ण॒वैः श॒स्त्राणा॑ᳪ रू॒पं पय॑सा॒ सोम॑ आप्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: ardha-ṛcairukthānāṃ rūpaṃ padairāpnoti nividaḥ | praṇavaiḥ śastrāṇāṃ rūpaṃ payasā soma āpyate ||
verses.translation: By verse-halves comes the Ukthas type, Nivids by Padas he obtains. The type of Sastras is obtained by Pranavas, Soma by milk.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒श्विभ्यां॑ प्रातः सव॒नमिन्द्रे॑णै॒न्द्रं माध्यं॑न्दिनम् । वै॒श्व॒दे॒वᳪ सर॑स्वत्या तृ॒तीय॑मा॒प्तᳪ सव॑नम् ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvibhyāṃ prātaḥ savanamindreṇaindraṃ mādhyaṃndinam | vaiśvadevaṃ sarasvatyā tṛtīyamāptaṃ savanam ||
verses.translation: Gained by the Asvins is the morn's libation, Indra's libation of mid-day by Indra. Sarasvatî obtains the third outpouring, the offering sacred to the Visve Devas.

verses.sanskrit: वा॒य॒व्यै॒र्वाय॒व्या॒न्याप्नोति॒ सते॑न द्रोणकल॒शम् । कु॒म्भीभ्या॑मम्भृ॒णौ सु॒ते स्था॒लीभि॑ स्था॒लीरा॑प्नोति ॥
verses.transliteration: vāyavyairvāyavyānyāpnoti satena droṇakalaśam | kumbhībhyāmambhṛṇau sute sthālībhi sthālīrāpnoti ||
verses.translation: By Vâyu cups he gains the cups of Vâyu, and by the basket gains the vat for Soma. By the two jars he gains two cleansing-vessels, and by the cooking-pot the pot for cooking.

verses.sanskrit: यजु॑र्भिराप्यन्ते॒ ग्रहा॒ ग्रहै॒ स्तोमा॑श्च॒ विष्टु॑तीः । छन्दो॑भिरुक्थाश॒स्त्राणि॒ साम्ना॑वभृ॒थ आ॑प्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: yajurbhirāpyante grahā grahai stomāśca viṣṭutīḥ | chandobhirukthāśastrāṇi sāmnāvabhṛtha āpyate ||
verses.translation: By sacrificial texts are gained the Grahas, and by the Grahas lauds and laud-arrangements. By metres are obtained Ukthas and praise-songs, and by the Sâma-chant the Avabhritha.

verses.sanskrit: इडा॑भिर्भ॒क्षाना॑प्नोति सूक्तवा॒केना॒शिषः॑ । शं॒युना॑ पत्नीसंया॒जान्त्स॑मिष्टय॒जुषा॑ स॒ᳪस्थाम् ॥
verses.transliteration: iḍābhirbhakṣānāpnoti sūktavākenāśiṣaḥ | śaṃyunā patnīsaṃyājāntsamiṣṭayajuṣā saṃsthām ||
verses.translation: Draughts he obtains by pouring out libations, and wishes by the utterance of praises, By Samyu he obtains Patnîsamyâjas, and Consummation by Samishtayajus.

verses.sanskrit: व्र॒तेन॑ दी॒क्षामा॑प्नोति दी॒क्षया॑ऽऽप्नोति॒ दक्षि॑णाम् । दक्षि॑णा श्र॒द्धामा॑प्नोति श्र॒द्धया॑ स॒त्यमा॑प्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: vratena dīkṣāmāpnoti dīkṣayā''pnoti dakṣiṇām | dakṣiṇā śraddhāmāpnoti śraddhayā satyamāpyate ||
verses.translation: He gains by vow of fasting Consecration, by Consecration gains the priestly guerdon. He gains by priestly guerdon faith: by faith comes knowledge of the truth.

verses.sanskrit: ए॒ताव॑द्रू॒पं य॒ज्ञस्य॒ यद्दे॒वैर्ब्रह्म॑णा कृ॒तम् । तदे॒तत्सर्व॑माप्नोति य॒ज्ञे सौ॑त्राम॒णी सु॒ते ॥
verses.transliteration: etāvadrūpaṃ yajñasya yaddevairbrahmaṇā kṛtam | tadetatsarvamāpnoti yajñe sautrāmaṇī sute ||
verses.translation: So far the type of sacrifice was formed by Brahma, and the Gods. All this he gains, when juice is shed, in the Santrâmanî sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
सुरा॑वन्तं बर्हि॒षद॑ᳪ सु॒वीरं॑ य॒ज्ञᳪ हि॑न्वन्ति महि॒षा नमो॑भिः ।
दधा॑नाः॒ सोमं॑ दि॒वि दे॒वता॑सु॒ मदे॒मेन्द्रँ॒ यज॑मानाः स्व॒र्काः ॥
verses.transliteration:
surāvantaṃ barhiṣadaṃ suvīraṃ yajñaṃ hinvanti mahiṣā namobhiḥ |
dadhānāḥ somaṃ divi devatāsu mademendram̐ yajamānāḥ svarkāḥ ||
verses.translation: The rite with sacred grass, wine, store of heroes, the mighty ones speed on with adorations. May we, sweet-singing sacrificers, setting Soma mid Gods in heaven, give joy to Indra.

verses.sanskrit: यस्ते॒ रसः॒ सम्भृ॑त॒ ओष॑धीषु॒ सोम॑स्य॒ शुष्मः॒ सुर॑या सु॒तस्य॑ । तेन॑ जिन्व॒ यज॑मानं॒ मदे॑न॒ सर॑स्वतीम॒श्विना॒विन्द्र॑म॒ग्निम् ॥
verses.transliteration: yaste rasaḥ sambhṛta oṣadhīṣu somasya śuṣmaḥ surayā sutasya | tena jinva yajamānaṃ madena sarasvatīmaśvināvindramagnim ||
verses.translation: All essence of thine own in plants collected, all strength of Soma when poured out with Surâ— Therewith impel with joy the sacrifice, Sarasvatî, the Asvins, Indra, Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
यम॒श्विना॒ नमु॑चेरासु॒रादधि॒ सर॑स्व॒त्यसु॑नोदिन्द्रि॒याय॑ ।
इ॒मं तᳪ शु॒क्रं मधु॑मन्त॒मिन्दु॒ᳪ सोम॒ᳪ राजा॑नमि॒ह भ॑क्षयामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yamaśvinā namucerāsurādadhi sarasvatyasunodindriyāya |
imaṃ taṃ śukraṃ madhumantaminduṃ somaṃ rājānamiha bhakṣayāmi ||
verses.translation: That which Sarasvatî poured out for Indra, by Asvins brought from Namuchi the demon, This flowing drop, brilliant and full of sweetness, I drink and feed on here, the King, the Soma.

verses.sanskrit:
यदत्र॑ रि॒प्तᳪ र॒सिनः॑ सु॒तस्य॒ यदिन्द्रो॒ अपि॑ब॒च्छची॑भिः ।
अ॒हं तद॑स्य॒ मन॑सा शि॒वेन॒ सोम॒ᳪ राजा॑नमि॒ह भ॑क्षयामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadatra riptaṃ rasinaḥ sutasya yadindro apibacchacībhiḥ |
ahaṃ tadasya manasā śivena somaṃ rājānamiha bhakṣayāmi ||
verses.translation: Whatever portion of the savoury fluid is clinging here, what Indra drank with powers, That drop thereof with pure and holy spirit I drink and feed upon, the King, the Soma.

verses.sanskrit: पि॒तृभ्यः॑ स्वधा॒यिभ्यः॑ स्व॒धा नमः॑ पिताम॒हेभ्यः॑ स्वधा॒यिभ्यः॑ स्व॒धा नमः॒ प्रपि॑तामहेभ्यः स्वधा॒यिभ्यः॑ स्व॒धा नमः॑ । अक्ष॑न् पि॒तरो ऽमी॑मदन्त पि॒तरो ऽती॑तृपन्त पि॒तरः॒ पित॑रः॒ शुन्ध॑ध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration: pitṛbhyaḥ svadhāyibhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ pitāmahebhyaḥ svadhāyibhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ prapitāmahebhyaḥ svadhāyibhyaḥ svadhā namaḥ | akṣan pitaro 'mīmadanta pitaro 'tītṛpanta pitaraḥ pitaraḥ śundhadhvam ||
verses.translation: To Fathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! To Grandfathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! To Great-grandfathers who claim Svadhâ be Svadhâ and homage! The Fathers have eaten. The Fathers have rejoiced. The Fathers have been satisfied, Fathers, be ye purified.

verses.sanskrit:
पु॒नन्तु॑ मा पि॒तरः॑ सो॒म्यासः॑ पु॒नन्तु॑ मा पिताम॒हाः पु॒नन्तु॒ प्रपि॑तामहाः । प॒वित्रे॑ण श॒तायु॑षा ।
पु॒नन्तु॑ मा पिताम॒हाः पु॒नन्तु॒ प्रपि॑तामहाः । प॒वित्रे॑ण श॒तायु॑षा॒ विश्व॒मायु॒र्व्य॒श्नवै ॥
verses.transliteration:
punantu mā pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ punantu mā pitāmahāḥ punantu prapitāmahāḥ | pavitreṇa śatāyuṣā |
punantu mā pitāmahāḥ punantu prapitāmahāḥ | pavitreṇa śatāyuṣā viśvamāyurvyaśnavai ||
verses.translation: Cleanse me the Fathers who enjoy Soma! Grandfathers make me clean! May Great-grandfathers cleanse me with a sieve that brings a century. May my Grandfathers cleanse me, may my Great-grand-fathers make me clean. With sieve that brings a century may I obtain full length of life.

verses.sanskrit: अग्न॒ आयू॑ ᳪषि पवस॒ आ सु॒वोर्ज॒मिषं॑ च नः । आ॒रे बा॑धस्व दु॒च्छुना॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: agna āyū ṃṣi pavasa ā suvorjamiṣaṃ ca naḥ | āre bādhasva ducchunām ||
verses.translation: Agni, thou poorest life: send down upon us food and vigorous strength. Drive thou misfortune far away.

verses.sanskrit: पु॒नन्तु॑ मा देवज॒नाः॑ पु॒नन्तु॒ मन॑सा॒ धियः॑ । पु॒नन्तु॒ विश्वा॑ भू॒तानि॒ जात॑वेदः पुनी॒हि मा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: punantu mā devajanāḥ punantu manasā dhiyaḥ | punantu viśvā bhūtāni jātavedaḥ punīhi mā ||
verses.translation: Cleanse me the companies of Gods! May thoughts with spirit make me clean. Cleanse me all things that be! Do thou, O Jâtavedas, make me clean.

verses.sanskrit: प॒वित्रे॑ण पुनीहि मा शु॒क्रेण॑ देव॒ दीद्य॑त् । अग्ने॒ क्रत्वा॒ क्रतूँ॒१ रनु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: pavitreṇa punīhi mā śukreṇa deva dīdyat | agne kratvā kratūm̐ ranu ||
verses.translation: Purify me, O Agni, God, refulgent with thy pure bright sieve, With powers according to thine own.

verses.sanskrit: यत्ते॑ प॒वित्र॑म॒र्चिष्यग्ने॒ वित॑तमन्त॒रा । ब्रह्म॒ तेन॑ पुनातु मा ॥
verses.transliteration: yatte pavitramarciṣyagne vitatamantarā | brahma tena punātu mā ||
verses.translation: O Agni, may the cleansing sieve, diffused through all thy fiery glow, Holy devotion, make me clean.

verses.sanskrit: पव॑मानः॒ सो अ॒द्य नः॑ प॒वित्रे॑ण॒ विच॑र्षणिः । यः पोता॒ स पु॑नातु मा ॥
verses.transliteration: pavamānaḥ so adya naḥ pavitreṇa vicarṣaṇiḥ | yaḥ potā sa punātu mā ||
verses.translation: May Pavamâna with his sieve, Guest of all tribes, cleanse us to-day, He who is Cleanser make us clean.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒भाभ्यां॑ देव सवितः प॒वित्रे॑ण स॒वेन॑ च । मां पु॑नीहि वि॒श्वतः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ubhābhyāṃ deva savitaḥ pavitreṇa savena ca | māṃ punīhi viśvataḥ ||
verses.translation: Savitar, God, by both of these, libation, purifying power, Purify me on every side.

verses.sanskrit:
वै॒श्व॒दे॒वी पु॑न॒ती दे॒व्यागा॒द्यस्या॑मि॒मा ब॒ह्व्य॒स्त॒न्वो॑ वी॒तपृ॑ष्ठाः ।
तया॒ मद॑न्तः सध॒मादे॑षु व॒यᳪ स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vaiśvadevī punatī devyāgādyasyāmimā bahvyastanvo vītapṛṣṭhāḥ |
tayā madantaḥ sadhamādeṣu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
verses.translation: Dear to all Gods hath come the cleansing Goddess, she who contains these many smooth-backed figures. Through her may we in sacrificial banquets taking our pleasure be the lords of riches.

verses.sanskrit: ये स॑मा॒नाः सम॑नसः पि॒तरो॑ यम॒राज्ये॑ । तेषाँ॑ल्लो॒कः स्व॒धा नमो॑ य॒ज्ञो दे॒वेषु॑ कल्पताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ye samānāḥ samanasaḥ pitaro yamarājye | teṣām̐llokaḥ svadhā namo yajño deveṣu kalpatām ||
verses.translation: The Fathers who in Yama's realm are equal and unanimous— Their world is Svadhâ, reverence. To Gods let sacrifice be paid.

verses.sanskrit: ये स॑मा॒नाः सम॑नसो जी॒वा जी॒वेषु॑ माम॒काः । तेषा॒ᳪ श्रीर्मयि॑ कल्पताम॒स्मिँल्लो॒के श॒तᳪ समाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ye samānāḥ samanaso jīvā jīveṣu māmakāḥ | teṣāṃ śrīrmayi kalpatāmasmim̐lloke śataṃ samāḥ ||
verses.translation: Equals, unanimous, my folk yet living among those who live— On me be set their glory through a hundred years in this our world.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वे सृ॒ती अ॑शृणवं पितॄ॒णाम॒हं दे॒वाना॑मु॒त मर्त्या॑नाम् ।
ताभ्या॑मि॒दं विश्व॒मेज॒त्समे॑ति॒ यद॑न्त॒रा पि॒तरं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च ॥
verses.transliteration:
dve sṛtī aśṛṇavaṃ pitṝṇāmahaṃ devānāmuta martyānām |
tābhyāmidaṃ viśvamejatsameti yadantarā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca ||
verses.translation: I have heard mention of two several pathways, way of the Fathers, way of Gods and mortals. On these two roads each moving creature travels, each thing between the Father and the Mother.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दᳪ ह॒विः प्र॒जन॑नं मे अस्तु॒ दश॑वीर॒ᳪ सर्व॑गणᳪ स्व॒स्तये॑ ।
आ॒त्म॒सनि॑ प्रजा॒सनि॑ पशु॒सनि॑ लोक॒सन्य॑भय॒सनि॑ ।
अ॒ग्निः प्र॒जां ब॑हु॒लां मे॑ करो॒त्वन्नं॒ पयो॒ रेतो॑ अ॒स्मासु॑ धत्त ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ haviḥ prajananaṃ me astu daśavīraṃ sarvagaṇaṃ svastaye |
ātmasani prajāsani paśusani lokasanyabhayasani |
agniḥ prajāṃ bahulāṃ me karotvannaṃ payo reto asmāsu dhatta ||
verses.translation: May this my sacrifice bring store of children, with ten brave sons, full-companied, for welfare— Life-winning, winning offspring, winning cattle, winning this world of ours and peace and safety. May Agni make nay progeny abundant. Do ye confer food, milk, and wanly vigour.

verses.sanskrit:
उदी॑रता॒मव॑र॒ उत्परा॑स॒ उन्म॑ध्य॒माः पि॒तरः॑ सो॒म्यासः॑ ।
असुं॒ य ई॒युर॑वृ॒का ऋ॑त॒ज्ञास्ते नो॑ऽवन्तु पि॒तरो॒ हवे॑षु ॥
verses.transliteration:
udīratāmavara utparāsa unmadhyamāḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ |
asuṃ ya īyuravṛkā ṛtajñāste no'vantu pitaro haveṣu ||
verses.translation: May they ascend, the lowest, highest, midmost, the Fathers who deserve a share of Soma. May Fathers who have gained the world of spirits, gentle and righteous, aid us when we call them.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गि॑रसो नः पि॒तरो॒ नव॑ग्वा॒ अथ॑र्वाणो॒ भृग॑वः सो॒म्यासः॑ ।
तेषां॑ व॒यᳪ सु॑म॒तौ य॒ज्ञिया॑ना॒मपि॑ भ॒द्रे सौ॑मन॒से स्या॑म ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṅgiraso naḥ pitaro navagvā atharvāṇo bhṛgavaḥ somyāsaḥ |
teṣāṃ vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyānāmapi bhadre saumanase syāma ||
verses.translation: Our Fathers are Angirases, Navagvas, Atharvans, Bhrigus, who deserve the Soma. May these the holy look on us with favour: may we enjoy their gracious loving-kindness.

verses.sanskrit:
ये नः॒ पूर्वे॑ पि॒तरः॑ सो॒म्यासो॑ऽनूहि॒रे सो॑मपी॒थं वसि॑ष्ठाः ।
तेभि॑र्य॒मः स॑ररा॒णो ह॒वीᳪष्यु॒शन्नु॒शद्भिः॑ प्रतिका॒मम॑त्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ somyāso'nūhire somapīthaṃ vasiṣṭhāḥ |
tebhiryamaḥ sararāṇo havīṃṣyuśannuśadbhiḥ pratikāmamattu ||
verses.translation: Our ancient Fathers who deserve the Soma, who came, most noble, to our Soma banquet— With these let Yama, yearning with the yearning, rejoicing eat our offerings at his pleasure.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वᳪ सो॑म॒ प्र चि॑कितो मनी॒षा त्वᳪ रजि॑ष्ठ॒मनु॑ नेषि॒ पन्था॑म् ।
तव॒ प्रणी॑ती पि॒तरो॑ न इन्दो दे॒वेषु॒ रत्न॑मभजन्त॒ धीराः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṃ soma pra cikito manīṣā tvaṃ rajiṣṭhamanu neṣi panthām |
tava praṇītī pitaro na indo deveṣu ratnamabhajanta dhīrāḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou, Soma, art preeminent for wisdom: along the straightest path thou art our leader. Our prudent Fathers by thy wisdom, Soma, dealt out among the Gods their share of treasure.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वया॒ हि नः॑ पि॒तरः॑ सोम॒ पूर्वे॒ कर्मा॑णि च॒क्रुः प॑वमान॒ धीराः॑ ।
व॒न्वन्नवा॑तः परि॒धीँ१ रपो॑र्णु वी॒रेभि॒रश्वै॑र्म॒घवा॑ भवा नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvayā hi naḥ pitaraḥ soma pūrve karmāṇi cakruḥ pavamāna dhīrāḥ |
vanvannavātaḥ paridhīm̐ raporṇu vīrebhiraśvairmaghavā bhavā naḥ ||
verses.translation: For our sage Fathers, Soma Pavamâna, of old performed by thee their sacred duties. Fighting unvanquished, open the enclosures: enrich us with large gifts of steeds and heroes.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वᳪ सो॑म पि॒तृभिः॑ संविदा॒नोऽनु॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी आ त॑तन्थ ।
तस्मै॑ त इन्दो ह॒विषा॑ विधेम व॒यᳪ स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṃ soma pitṛbhiḥ saṃvidāno'nu dyāvāpṛthivī ā tatantha |
tasmai ta indo haviṣā vidhema vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
verses.translation: Associate with the Fathers thou, O Soma, hast spread thyself abroad through earth and heaven. So with oblation let us serve thee, Indu, and so let us become the lords of riches.

verses.sanskrit:
बर्हि॑षदः पितर ऊ॒त्य र्वागि॒मा वो॑ ह॒व्या च॑कृमा जु॒षध्व॑म् ।
त आ ग॒ताव॑सा॒ शन्त॑मे॒नाथा॑ नः॒ शं योर॑र॒पो द॑धात ॥
verses.transliteration:
barhiṣadaḥ pitara ūtya rvāgimā vo havyā cakṛmā juṣadhvam |
ta ā gatāvasā śantamenāthā naḥ śaṃ yorarapo dadhāta ||
verses.translation: Fathers who sit on sacred grass, come help us: these offerings we have made for you; accept them. So come to us with most auspicious favour, and give us health and strength without a trouble.

verses.sanskrit:
आऽहं पि॒तॄन्त्सु॑वि॒दत्राँ॑२ अवित्सि॒ नपा॑तं च वि॒क्रम॑णं च॒ विष्णोः॑ ।
ब॒र्हि॒षदो॒ ये स्व॒धया॑ सु॒तस्य॒ भज॑न्त पि॒त्वस्त इ॒हाग॑मिष्ठाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā'haṃ pitṝntsuvidatrām̐ avitsi napātaṃ ca vikramaṇaṃ ca viṣṇoḥ |
barhiṣado ye svadhayā sutasya bhajanta pitvasta ihāgamiṣṭhāḥ ||
verses.translation: I have attained the gracious-minded Fathers, have gained a son and progeny from Vishnu. They who enjoy pressed juices with oblation, seated on sacred grass, come oftenest hither.

verses.sanskrit:
उप॑हूताः पि॒तरः॑ सो॒म्यासो॑ बर्हि॒ष्ये॒षु नि॒धिषु॑ प्रि॒येषु॑ ।
त आ ग॑मन्तु॒ त इ॒ह श्रु॑व॒न्त्वधि॑ ब्रुवन्तु॒ ते॑ऽवन्त्व॒स्मान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
upahūtāḥ pitaraḥ somyāso barhiṣyeṣu nidhiṣu priyeṣu |
ta ā gamantu ta iha śruvantvadhi bruvantu te'vantvasmān ||
verses.translation: May they, the Fathers, worthy of the Soma, invited to their favourite oblations Laid on the sacred grass, come nigh and listen: may they be gracious unto us and bless us.

verses.sanskrit:
आ य॑न्तु नः पि॒तरः॑ सो॒म्यासो॑ऽग्निष्वा॒त्ताः प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानैः॑ ।
अ॒स्मिन् य॒ज्ञे स्व॒धया॒ मद॒न्तोऽधि॑ ब्रुवन्तु॒ ते॒ऽवन्त्व॒स्मान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā yantu naḥ pitaraḥ somyāso'gniṣvāttāḥ pathibhirdevayānaiḥ |
asmin yajñe svadhayā madanto'dhi bruvantu te'vantvasmān ||
verses.translation: May they our Fathers whom the flames have tasted, worthy of Soma, come on God-ward pathways. Enjoying at this sacrifice their portion, may they be gracious unto us and bless us.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्नि॑ष्वात्ताः पितर॒ एह ग॑च्छत॒ सदः॑-सदः सदत सुप्रणीतयः ।
अ॒त्ता ह॒वीᳪषि॒ प्रय॑तानि ब॒र्हिष्यथा॑ र॒यिᳪ सर्व॑वीरं दधातन ॥
verses.transliteration:
agniṣvāttāḥ pitara eha gacchata sadaḥ-sadaḥ sadata supraṇītayaḥ |
attā havīṃṣi prayatāni barhiṣyathā rayiṃ sarvavīraṃ dadhātana ||
verses.translation: Fathers whom Agni's flames have tasted, come ye nigh: ye kindly leaders, take ye each your proper place. Eat sacrificial food presented on the grass: grant riches with a multitude of hero sons.

verses.sanskrit:
ये अ॑ग्निष्वा॒त्ता ये अन॑ग्निष्वात्ता॒ मध्ये॑ दि॒वः स्व॒धया॑ मा॒दय॑न्ते ।
तेभ्यः॑ स्व॒राडसु॑नीतिमे॒तां य॑थाव॒शं त॒न्वं॒ कल्पयाति ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye agniṣvāttā ye anagniṣvāttā madhye divaḥ svadhayā mādayante |
tebhyaḥ svarāḍasunītimetāṃ yathāvaśaṃ tanvaṃ kalpayāti ||
verses.translation: For those who, burnt with fire or not cremated, joy in their portion in the midst of heaven, May the Self-Ruler form the world of spirits and this their body as his pleasure wills it.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नि॒ष्वा॒त्तानृ॑तु॒मतो॑ हवामहे नाराश॒ᳪसे सो॑मपी॒थं य आ॒शुः ।
ते नो॒ विप्रा॑सः सु॒हवा॑ भवन्तु व॒यᳪ स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agniṣvāttānṛtumato havāmahe nārāśaṃse somapīthaṃ ya āśuḥ |
te no viprāsaḥ suhavā bhavantu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
verses.translation: We call the Agnishvâttas, true to seasons, those who drank Soma in the Nârâsamsa. Prompt to give ear to us be they, the sages, and then let us be lords of wealth and treasure.

verses.sanskrit:
आच्या॒ जानु॑ दक्षिण॒तो नि॒षद्ये॒मं य॒ज्ञम॒भि गृ॑णीत॒ विश्वे॑ ।
मा हि॑ᳪसिष्ट पितरः॒ केन॑ चिन्नो॒ यद्व॒ आगः॑ पुरु॒षता॒ करा॑म ॥
verses.transliteration:
ācyā jānu dakṣiṇato niṣadyemaṃ yajñamabhi gṛṇīta viśve |
mā hiṃsiṣṭa pitaraḥ kena cinno yadva āgaḥ puruṣatā karāma ||
verses.translation: Bowing the bended knee and seated southward, accept ye, all, this sacrifice with favour. Injure us not for any sin, O Fathers, which we through human frailty have committed.

verses.sanskrit:
आसी॑नासो अरु॒णीना॑मु॒पस्थे॑ र॒यिं ध॑त्त दा॒शुषे॒ मर्त्या॑य ।
पु॒त्रेभ्यः॑ पितर॒स्तस्य॒ वस्वः॒ प्र य॑च्छत॒ त इ॒होर्जं॑ दधात ॥
verses.transliteration:
āsīnāso aruṇīnāmupasthe rayiṃ dhatta dāśuṣe martyāya |
putrebhyaḥ pitarastasya vasvaḥ pra yacchata ta ihorjaṃ dadhāta ||
verses.translation: Lapped in the bosom of the purple Mornings give riches to the man who brings oblation. Grant to his sons a portion of your treasure, and, present, give us energy, ye Fathers.

verses.sanskrit: यम॑ग्ने कव्यवाहन॒ त्वं चि॒न्मन्य॑से र॒यिम् । तन्नो॑ गी॒र्भिः श्र॒वाय्यं॑ देव॒त्रा प॑नया॒ युज॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: yamagne kavyavāhana tvaṃ cinmanyase rayim | tanno gīrbhiḥ śravāyyaṃ devatrā panayā yujam ||
verses.translation: O Agni Kavyavâhana, cause us to praise before the Gods, As our associate meet for lauds, wealth which een thou reputest wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
यो अ॒ग्निः क॑व्य॒वाह॑नः पि॒तॄन् यक्ष॑दृता॒वृधः॑ ।
प्रेदु॑ ह॒व्यानि॑ वोचति दे॒वेभ्य॑श्च पि॒तृभ्य॒ आ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo agniḥ kavyavāhanaḥ pitṝn yakṣadṛtāvṛdhaḥ |
predu havyāni vocati devebhyaśca pitṛbhya ā ||
verses.translation: May Agni, Kavya-bearer, who hath worshipped Fathers true to Law. Announce to Gods and Fathers these our sacrificial offerings.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वम॑ग्न ईडि॒तः क॑व्यवाह॒नावा॑ड्ढ॒व्यानि॑ सुर॒भीणि॑ कृ॒त्वी ।
प्रादाः॑ पि॒तृभ्यः॑ स्व॒धया॒ ते अ॑क्षन्न॒द्धि त्वं दे॑व॒ प्रय॑ता ह॒वीᳪषि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvamagna īḍitaḥ kavyavāhanāvāḍḍhavyāni surabhīṇi kṛtvī |
prādāḥ pitṛbhyaḥ svadhayā te akṣannaddhi tvaṃ deva prayatā havīṃṣi ||
verses.translation: Thou. Agni Kavya-bearer, when entreated, didst bear the offerings which thou madest fragrant, And gayest to the Fathers who did eat them with Svadhâ. Eat, thou God, the gifts we bring thee.

verses.sanskrit:
ये चे॒ह पि॒तरो॒ ये च॒ नेह याँश्च॑ वि॒द्म याँ२ उ॑ च॒ न प्र॑वि॒द्म ।
त्वं वे॑त्थ॒ यति॒ ते जा॑तवेदः स्व॒धाभि॑र्य॒ज्ञँ सुकृ॑तं जुषस्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye ceha pitaro ye ca neha yām̐śca vidma yām̐ u ca na pravidma |
tvaṃ vettha yati te jātavedaḥ svadhābhiryajñam̐ sukṛtaṃ juṣasva ||
verses.translation: Thou, Jâtavedas, knowest well the number of Fathers who are here and who are absent, Of Fathers whom we know and whom we know not. Accept the sacrifice arranged with portions.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं पि॒तृभ्यो॒ नमो॑ अस्त्व॒द्य ये पूर्वा॑सो॒ य उप॑रास ई॒युः ।
ये पार्थि॑वे॒ रज॒स्या निष॑त्ता॒ ये वा॑ नू॒नᳪ सु॑वृ॒जना॑सु वि॒क्षु ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ pitṛbhyo namo astvadya ye pūrvāso ya uparāsa īyuḥ |
ye pārthive rajasyā niṣattā ye vā nūnaṃ suvṛjanāsu vikṣu ||
verses.translation: Now let us pay this homage to the Fathers, to those who passed of old and those who followed, Those who have rested in the earthly region and those who dwell among the Mighty Races.

verses.sanskrit:
अधा॒ यथा॑ नः पि॒तरः॒ परा॑सः प्र॒त्नासो॑ अग्न ऋ॒तमा॑शुषा॒णाः ।
शुचीद॑य॒न् दीधि॑तिमुक्थ॒शासः॒ क्षामा॑ भि॒न्दन्तो॑ अरु॒णीरप॑ व्रन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
adhā yathā naḥ pitaraḥ parāsaḥ pratnāso agna ṛtamāśuṣāṇāḥ |
śucīdayan dīdhitimukthaśāsaḥ kṣāmā bhindanto aruṇīrapa vran ||
verses.translation: As in the days of old our ancient Fathers speeding the work of holy worship, Agni! Sought pure light and devotion, singing praises, they cleft the ground and made red Dawns apparent.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒शन्त॑स्त्वा॒ नि धी॑मह्यु॒शन्तः॒ समि॑धीमहि । उ॒शन्नु॑श॒त आ व॑ह पि॒तॄन् ह॒विषे॒ अत्त॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration: uśantastvā ni dhīmahyuśantaḥ samidhīmahi | uśannuśata ā vaha pitṝn haviṣe attave ||
verses.translation: Right gladly do we set thee down, right gladly make thee burn and glow. Gladly bring yearning Fathers nigh to eat the food of sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒पां फेने॑न॒ नमु॑चेः॒ शिर॑ इ॒न्द्रोद॑वर्तयः । विश्वा॒ यदज॑य॒ स्पृधः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: apāṃ phenena namuceḥ śira indrodavartayaḥ | viśvā yadajaya spṛdhaḥ ||
verses.translation: Indra, with waters foam didst thou wrench off the head of Namuchi, Subduing all contending hosts.

verses.sanskrit:
सोमो॒ राजा॒मृत॑ᳪ सु॒त ऋ॑जी॒षेणा॑जहान्मृ॒त्युम् ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
somo rājāmṛtaṃ suta ṛjīṣeṇājahānmṛtyum |
ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu ||
verses.translation: King Soma, pressed, the Drink of Life, left Death behind with Soma-dregs. By Law came truth and Indra-power, the pure bright drinking-off of juice. The power of Indra was this sweet immortal milk.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒द्भ्यः क्षी॒रं व्य॑पिब॒त् क्रुङ्ङा॑ङ्गिर॒सो धि॒या ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
adbhyaḥ kṣīraṃ vyapibat kruṅṅāṅgiraso dhiyā |
ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu ||
verses.translation: The Snipe of Angiras by thought from out the waters drank up milk. By Law came truth, etc., as in 72.

verses.sanskrit:
सोम॑म॒द्भ्यो व्य॑पिब॒च्छन्द॑सा ह॒ᳪसः शु॑चि॒षत् ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
somamadbhyo vyapibacchandasā haṃsaḥ śuciṣat |
ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu ||
verses.translation: The Hamsa throned in light drank up by metre Soma from the floods. By Law, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्ना॑त्परि॒स्रुतो॒ रसं॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ व्य॑पिबत् क्ष॒त्रं पयः॒ सोमं॑ प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
annātparisruto rasaṃ brahmaṇā vyapibat kṣatraṃ payaḥ somaṃ prajāpatiḥ |
ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu ||
verses.translation: Prajâpati by Brahma drank the essence from the foaming food, the princely power, milk, Soma juice. By Law, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
रेतो॒ मूत्रं॒ वि ज॑हाति॒ योनिं॑ प्रवि॒शदि॑न्द्र॒यिम् । गर्भो॑ ज॒रायु॒णाऽऽवृ॑त॒ उल्बं॑ जहाति॒ जन्म॑ना ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
reto mūtraṃ vi jahāti yoniṃ praviśadindrayim | garbho jarāyuṇā''vṛta ulbaṃ jahāti janmanā |
ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu ||
verses.translation: The generative part enters the yoni: it leaves aside the retas and the mûtra. The caul-invested embryo leaves by its birth the covering folds. By Law, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दृ॒ष्ट्वा रू॒पे व्याक॑रोत् सत्यानृ॒ते प्र॒जाप॑तिः । अश्र॑द्धा॒मनृ॒तेऽद॑धाच्छ्र॒द्धाᳪ स॒त्ये प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā rūpe vyākarot satyānṛte prajāpatiḥ | aśraddhāmanṛte'dadhācchraddhāṃ satye prajāpatiḥ |
ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu ||
verses.translation: Viewing both forms Prajâpati gave truth and falsehood different shapes. Prajâpati assigned the lack of faith to falsehood, faith to truth. By Law, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदे॑न रू॒पे व्य॑पिबत् सुतासु॒तौ प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vedena rūpe vyapibat sutāsutau prajāpatiḥ |
ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu ||
verses.translation: By holy lore Prajâpati drank up both forms, pressed and unpressed. By Law, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दृ॒ष्ट्वा प॑रि॒स्रुतो॒ रस॑ᳪ शु॒क्रेण॑ शु॒क्रं व्य॑पिबत् पयः॒ सोमं॑ प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
ऋ॒तेन॑ स॒त्यमि॑न्द्रि॒यं वि॒पान॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमन्ध॑स॒ इन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒यमि॒दं पयो॒ऽमृतं॒ मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
dṛṣṭvā parisruto rasaṃ śukreṇa śukraṃ vyapibat payaḥ somaṃ prajāpatiḥ |
ṛtena satyamindriyaṃ vipānaṃ śukramandhasa indrasyendriyamidaṃ payo'mṛtaṃ madhu ||
verses.translation: Seeing the farming liquor's sap, Prajâpati with the bright drank nut the bright the milk, the Soma juice. By Law, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
सीसे॑न॒ तन्त्रं॒ मन॑सा मनी॒षिण॑ ऊर्णासू॒त्रेण॑ क॒वयो॑ वयन्ति ।
अ॒श्विना॑ य॒ज्ञᳪ स॑वि॒ता सर॑स्व॒तीन्द्र॑स्य रू॒पं वरु॑णो भिष॒ज्यन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sīsena tantraṃ manasā manīṣiṇa ūrṇāsūtreṇa kavayo vayanti |
aśvinā yajñaṃ savitā sarasvatīndrasya rūpaṃ varuṇo bhiṣajyan ||
verses.translation: Wise, with mind, lead, and thread of wool the sages twine an amulet. Sarasvatî, Savitar, Varuna, the Asvins span sacrifice and healed his form for Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
तद॑स्य रू॒पम॒मृत॒ᳪ शची॑भिस्त॒स्रो द॑धुर्दे॒वताः॑ सᳪररा॒णाः ।
लोमा॑नि॒ शष्पै॑र्बहु॒धा न तोक्म॑भि॒स्त्वग॑स्य मा॒ᳪसम॑भव॒न्न ला॒जाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tadasya rūpamamṛtaṃ śacībhistasro dadhurdevatāḥ saṃrarāṇāḥ |
lomāni śaṣpairbahudhā na tokmabhistvagasya māṃsamabhavanna lājāḥ ||
verses.translation: This his immortal shape with mighty powers three Deities bestowing gifts compounded. His hair they made with sprouts of grass and barley, and roasted grain with skin and flesh supplied him.

verses.sanskrit:
तद॒श्विना॑ भि॒षजा॑ रु॒द्रव॑र्तनी॒ सर॑स्वती वयति॒ पेशो॒ अन्त॑रम् ।
अस्थि॑ म॒ज्जानं॒ मास॑रैः कारोत॒रेण॒ दध॑तो॒ गवां॑ त्व॒चि ॥
verses.transliteration:
tadaśvinā bhiṣajā rudravartanī sarasvatī vayati peśo antaram |
asthi majjānaṃ māsaraiḥ kārotareṇa dadhato gavāṃ tvaci ||
verses.translation: His inner shape Sarasvatî arranges and, borne on bright paths, the Physician Asvins: With Mâsaras and sieve his bone and marrow, as on the Oxen's hide they lay the liquor.

verses.sanskrit:
सर॑स्वती॒ मन॑सा पेश॒लं वसु॒ नास॑त्याभ्यां वयति दर्श॒तं वपुः॑ ।
रसं॑ परि॒स्रुता॒ न रोहि॑तं न॒ग्नहु॒र्धीर॒स्तस॑रं॒ न वेम॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarasvatī manasā peśalaṃ vasu nāsatyābhyāṃ vayati darśataṃ vapuḥ |
rasaṃ parisrutā na rohitaṃ nagnahurdhīrastasaraṃ na vema ||
verses.translation: By thought Sarasvatî with both Nâsatyas forms lovely treasure and a beauteous body. Like shuttle through the loom the steady ferment mixes the red juice with the foaming spirit.

verses.sanskrit:
पय॑सा शु॒क्रम॒मृतं॑ ज॒नित्र॒ᳪ सुर॑या॒ मूत्रा॑ज्जनयन्त॒ रेतः॑ ।
अपाम॑तिं दुर्म॒तिं बाध॑माना॒ ऊव॑ध्यं॒ वात॑ᳪ स॒ब्वं तदा॒रात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
payasā śukramamṛtaṃ janitraṃ surayā mūtrājjanayanta retaḥ |
apāmatiṃ durmatiṃ bādhamānā ūvadhyaṃ vātaṃ sabvaṃ tadārāt ||
verses.translation: By milk they generated bright immortal, productive seed, by Surâ seed from urine, Chasing afar folly and ill intention, crude food and wind and meat that loads the stomach.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रः॑ सु॒त्रामा॒ हृद॑येन स॒त्यं पु॑रो॒डाशे॑न सवि॒ता ज॑जान ।
यकृ॑त् क्लो॒मानं॒ वरु॑णो भिष॒ज्यन् मत॑स्ने वाय॒व्यैर्न मि॑नाति पि॒त्तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indraḥ sutrāmā hṛdayena satyaṃ puroḍāśena savitā jajāna |
yakṛt klomānaṃ varuṇo bhiṣajyan matasne vāyavyairna mināti pittam ||
verses.translation: Heart with his heart Indra Good Guardian gendered: with rice-cake Savitar gave truth its being. Varuna, doctoring the lungs and liver, forms, as with Vâyu cups, the gall and kidneys.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒न्त्राणि॑ स्था॒लीर्मधु॒ पिन्व॑माना॒ गुदाः॒ पात्रा॑णि सु॒दुघा॒ न धे॒नुः ।
श्ये॒नस्य॒ पत्रं॒ न प्ली॒हा शची॑भिरास॒न्दी नाभि॑रु॒दरं॒ न मा॒ता ॥
verses.transliteration:
āntrāṇi sthālīrmadhu pinvamānā gudāḥ pātrāṇi sudughā na dhenuḥ |
śyenasya patraṃ na plīhā śacībhirāsandī nābhirudaraṃ na mātā ||
verses.translation: Cooking-pots pouring honey were the entrails: like a well-milking cow the pans were bowels. A hawk's wing was the spleen: through mighty powers the stool as mother was navel and belly.

verses.sanskrit:
कु॒म्भो व॑नि॒ष्ठुर्ज॑नि॒ता शची॑भि॒र्यस्मि॒न्नग्रे॒ योन्यां॒ गर्भो॑ अ॒न्तः ।
प्ला॒शिर्व्य॑क्तः श॒तधा॑र॒ उत्सो॑ दु॒हे न कु॒म्भी स्व॒धां पि॒तृभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
kumbho vaniṣṭhurjanitā śacībhiryasminnagre yonyāṃ garbho antaḥ |
plāśirvyaktaḥ śatadhāra utso duhe na kumbhī svadhāṃ pitṛbhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: The pitcher was the father of the rectum by powers, the womb which first contained the infant. Plain was the hundred-streaming fount as penis: the jar poured forth libations to the Father.

verses.sanskrit:
मुख॒ᳪ सद॑स्य॒ शिर॒ इत् सते॑न जि॒ह्वा प॒वित्र॑म॒श्विना॒सन्त्सर॑स्वती ।
चप्पं॒ न पा॒युर्भि॒षग॑स्य॒ वालो॑ व॒स्तिर्न शेपो॒ हर॑सा तर॒स्वी ॥
verses.transliteration:
mukhaṃ sadasya śira it satena jihvā pavitramaśvināsantsarasvatī |
cappaṃ na pāyurbhiṣagasya vālo vastirna śepo harasā tarasvī ||
verses.translation: His face the basket, thence his head; the strainer his tongue, his mouth Sarasvatî and Asvins. The Chapya was his rump, his leech the filter, the bladder was his penis keen with ardour.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्विभ्यां॒ चक्षु॑र॒मृतं॒ ग्रहा॑भ्यां॒ छागे॑न॒ तेजो॑ ह॒विषा॑ शृ॒तेन॑ ।
पक्ष्मा॑णि गो॒धूमैः॒ कुव॑लैरु॒तानि॒ पेशो॒ न शु॒क्रमसि॑तं वसाते ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvibhyāṃ cakṣuramṛtaṃ grahābhyāṃ chāgena tejo haviṣā śṛtena |
pakṣmāṇi godhūmaiḥ kuvalairutāni peśo na śukramasitaṃ vasāte ||
verses.translation: Asvins with both cups made his eye immortal, the goat and cooked oblation gave it keenness. With wheat eyelashes and with jujube eyebrows they clothe as twere a black and brilliant figure.

verses.sanskrit:
अवि॒र्न मे॒षो न॒सि वी॒र्या॒य प्रा॒णस्य॒ पन्था॑ अ॒मृतो॒ ग्रहा॑भ्याम् ।
सर॑स्वत्युप॒वाकै॑र्व्या॒नं नस्या॑नि ब॒र्हिर्बद॑रैर्जजान ॥
verses.transliteration:
avirna meṣo nasi vīryāya prāṇasya panthā amṛto grahābhyām |
sarasvatyupavākairvyānaṃ nasyāni barhirbadarairjajāna ||
verses.translation: The sheep, the ram to give his nostril vigour. the immortal path of breath by both libations. By Indra-grains and sacrificial jujubes Sarasvatî produced through-breath and nose hairs.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य रू॒पमृ॑ष॒भो बला॑य॒ कर्णा॑भ्या॒ᳪ श्रोत्र॑म॒मृतं॒ ग्रहा॑भ्याम् ।
यवा॒ न ब॒र्हिर्भ्रु॒वि केस॑राणि क॒र्कन्धु॑ जज्ञे॒ मधु॑ सार॒घं मुखा॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasya rūpamṛṣabho balāya karṇābhyāṃ śrotramamṛtaṃ grahābhyām |
yavā na barhirbhruvi kesarāṇi karkandhu jajñe madhu sāraghaṃ mukhāt ||
verses.translation: The hull for strength made Indra's form: the immortal bearing for both his ears by two libations. Barley and sacred grass composed his eyebrows: from his mouth came the jujube and sweet honey.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒त्मन्नु॒पस्थे॒ न वृक॑स्य॒ लोम॒ मुखे॒ श्मश्रू॑णि॒ न व्या॑घ्रलो॒म ।
केशा॒ न शी॒र्षन्यश॑से श्रियै॒ शिखा॑ सि॒ᳪहस्य॒ लोम॒ त्विषि॑रिन्द्रि॒याणि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ātmannupasthe na vṛkasya loma mukhe śmaśrūṇi na vyāghraloma |
keśā na śīrṣanyaśase śriyai śikhā siṃhasya loma tviṣirindriyāṇi ||
verses.translation: Hair of the wolf was on his waist and body: the beard upon his face was hair of tigers. Lions hair were his locks, for fame and beauty, worn on his head, his crest and sheen and vigour.

verses.sanskrit:
अङ्गा॑न्या॒त्मन् भि॒षजा॒ तद॒श्विना॒त्मान॒मङ्गैः॒ सम॑धा॒त् सर॑स्वती ।
इन्द्र॑स्य रू॒पᳪ श॒तमा॑न॒मायु॑श्च॒न्द्रेण॒ ज्योति॑र॒मृतं॒ दधा॑नाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṅgānyātman bhiṣajā tadaśvinātmānamaṅgaiḥ samadhāt sarasvatī |
indrasya rūpaṃ śatamānamāyuścandreṇa jyotiramṛtaṃ dadhānāḥ ||
verses.translation: The Asvins, Leeches, joined his limbs and body, Sarasvatî put limbs and frame together, Giving the form and vital power of Indra, hundredfold, deathless and delightful lustre.

verses.sanskrit:
सर॑स्वती॒ योन्यां॒ गर्भ॑म॒न्तर॒श्विभ्यां॒ पत्नी॒ सुकृ॑तं बिभर्ति ।
अ॒पाᳪ रसे॑न॒ वरु॑णो॒ न साम्नेन्द्र॑ᳪ श्रि॒यै ज॒नय॑न्न॒प्सु राजा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarasvatī yonyāṃ garbhamantaraśvibhyāṃ patnī sukṛtaṃ bibharti |
apāṃ rasena varuṇo na sāmnendraṃ śriyai janayannapsu rājā ||
verses.translation: Sarasvatî, as Consort of the Asvins, bears in her womb the nobly fashioned Infant. King Varuna with waters wealthy essence begetting Indra in the floods for glory.

verses.sanskrit:
तेजः॑ पशू॒नाᳪ ह॒विरि॑न्द्रि॒याव॑त् परि॒स्रुता॒ पय॑सा सार॒घं मधु॑ ।
अ॒श्विभ्यां॑ दु॒ग्धं भि॒षजा॒ सर॑स्वत्या सुतासु॒ताभ्या॑म॒मृतः॒ सोम॒ इन्दुः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tejaḥ paśūnāṃ havirindriyāvat parisrutā payasā sāraghaṃ madhu |
aśvibhyāṃ dugdhaṃ bhiṣajā sarasvatyā sutāsutābhyāmamṛtaḥ soma induḥ ||
verses.translation: Splendour of victims, powerful oblation, honey and meath with milk and foaming liquor, Healing Sarasvatî effused, and Asvins; from pressed and unpressed Soma, deathless Indu.

verses.sanskrit: क्ष॒त्रस्य॒ योनि॑रसि क्ष॒त्रस्य॒ नाभि॑रसि । मा त्वा॑ हिᳪसी॒न्मा मा॑ हिᳪसीः ॥
verses.transliteration: kṣatrasya yonirasi kṣatrasya nābhirasi | mā tvā hiṃsīnmā mā hiṃsīḥ ||
verses.translation: Birth PLACE of princely power art thou: centre art thou of princely power. Harm not thyself: do me no harm.

verses.sanskrit: नि ष॑साद घृ॒तव्र॑तो॒ वरु॑णः प॒स्त्यास्वा । साम्रा॑ज्याय सु॒क्रतुः॑ । मृ॒त्योः पा॑हि वि॒द्योत्पा॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration: ni ṣasāda ghṛtavrato varuṇaḥ pastyāsvā | sāmrājyāya sukratuḥ | mṛtyoḥ pāhi vidyotpāhi ||
verses.translation: Varuna, Law's maintainer, hath sat down, etc., as in X. 27. Save me from death. Save me from lightning.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् ।
अ॒श्विनोर्भैष॑ज्येन॒ तेज॑से ब्रह्मवर्च॒साया॒भि षि॑ञ्चामि॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ भैष॑ज्येन वी॒र्या॒या॒न्नाद्या॑या॒भि षि॑ञ्चा॒मीन्द्र॑स्येन्द्रि॒येण॒ बला॑य श्रियै॒ यश॑से॒ऽभि षि॑ञ्चामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām |
aśvinorbhaiṣajyena tejase brahmavarcasāyābhi ṣiñcāmi sarasvatyai bhaiṣajyena vīryāyānnādyāyābhi ṣiñcāmīndrasyendriyeṇa balāya śriyai yaśase'bhi ṣiñcāmi ||
verses.translation: Thee, by the radiant Savitar's impulsion, with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan, With leech-craft of the Asvins, I besprinkle for splendour, for the lustre of a Brâhman; With leech-craft of Sarasvatî, besprinkle for manly vigour and for food to feed thee; Besprinkle thee, by special power of Indra, for strength of body and for fame and glory.

verses.sanskrit: को॑ऽसि कत॒मो॒ऽसि॒ कस्मै॑ त्वा॒ काय॑ त्वा । सुश्लो॑क॒ सुम॑ङ्गल॒ सत्य॑राजन् ॥
verses.transliteration: ko'si katamo'si kasmai tvā kāya tvā | suśloka sumaṅgala satyarājan ||
verses.translation: Thou art Ka. Noblest Ka art thou. Thee for the state and rank of Ka. Sumangala! Susloka! Satyarâjan!

verses.sanskrit: शिरो॑ मे॒ श्रीर्यशो॒ मुखं॒ त्विषिः॒ केशा॑श्च॒ श्मश्रू॑णि । राजा॑ मे प्रा॒णो अ॒मृत॑ᳪ स॒म्राट् चक्षु॑र्वि॒राट् श्रोत्र॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: śiro me śrīryaśo mukhaṃ tviṣiḥ keśāśca śmaśrūṇi | rājā me prāṇo amṛtaṃ samrāṭ cakṣurvirāṭ śrotram ||
verses.translation: My head be grace, my mouth be fame, my hair and beard be brilliant sheen! My breath be King and deathlessness, mine eye Sole Lord, mine ear the Prince!

verses.sanskrit: जि॒ह्वा मे॑ भ॒द्रं वाङ्महो॒ मनो॑ म॒न्युः स्व॒राड् भामः॑ । मोदाः॑ प्रमो॒दा अ॒ङ्गुली॒रङ्गा॑नि मि॒त्रं मे॒ सहः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: jihvā me bhadraṃ vāṅmaho mano manyuḥ svarāḍ bhāmaḥ | modāḥ pramodā aṅgulīraṅgāni mitraṃ me sahaḥ ||
verses.translation: My tongue be bliss, my voice be might, my mind be wrath, my rage self-lord! Joys be my fingers, and delight my members, conquering strength my friend!

verses.sanskrit: बा॒हू मे॒ बल॑मिन्द्रि॒यᳪ हस्तौ॑ मे॒ कर्म॑ वी॒र्य॒म् । आ॒त्मा क्ष॒त्रमुरो॒ मम॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: bāhū me balamindriyaṃ hastau me karma vīryam | ātmā kṣatramuro mama ||
verses.translation: Let my two arms be Indra's power, my hands be deed of manly might, my soul and breast be princely rule! neck

verses.sanskrit: पृ॒ष्ठीर्मे॑ रा॒ष्ट्रमु॒दर॒मᳪसौ॑ ग्री॒वाश्च॒ श्रोणी॑ । ऊ॒रू अ॑र॒त्नी जानु॑नी॒ विशो॒ मेऽङ्गा॑नि स॒र्वतः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛṣṭhīrme rāṣṭramudaramaṃsau grīvāśca śroṇī | ūrū aratnī jānunī viśo me'ṅgāni sarvataḥ ||
verses.translation: My ribs be royal government, my belly, shoulders, neck, and hips, Thighs, elbows, knees, the people, yea, my members universally!

verses.sanskrit:
नाभि॑र्मे चि॒त्तं वि॒ज्ञानं॑ पा॒युर्मेऽप॑चितिर्भ॒सत् । आ॒न॒न्द॒न॒न्दावा॒ण्डौ मे॒ भगः॒ सौभा॑ग्यं॒ पसः॑ ।
जङ्घा॑भ्यां प॒द्भ्यां धर्मो॑ऽस्मि वि॒शि राजा॒ प्रति॑ष्ठितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
nābhirme cittaṃ vijñānaṃ pāyurme'pacitirbhasat | ānandanandāvāṇḍau me bhagaḥ saubhāgyaṃ pasaḥ |
jaṅghābhyāṃ padbhyāṃ dharmo'smi viśi rājā pratiṣṭhitaḥ ||
verses.translation: My navel intellect, etc., etc. ... ... ... ... Duty am I in legs and feet, established King among the folk.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रति॑ क्ष॒त्रे प्रति॑ तिष्ठामि रा॒ष्ट्रे प्रत्यश्वे॑षु॒ प्रति॑ तिष्ठामि॒ गोषु॑ ।
प्रत्यङ्गे॑षु॒ प्रति॑ तिष्ठाम्या॒त्मन् प्रति॑ प्रा॒णेषु॒ प्रति॑ तिष्ठामि पु॒ष्टे प्रति॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒व्योः प्रति॑ तिष्ठामि य॒ज्ञे ॥
verses.transliteration:
prati kṣatre prati tiṣṭhāmi rāṣṭre pratyaśveṣu prati tiṣṭhāmi goṣu |
pratyaṅgeṣu prati tiṣṭhāmyātman prati prāṇeṣu prati tiṣṭhāmi puṣṭe prati dyāvāpṛthivyoḥ prati tiṣṭhāmi yajñe ||
verses.translation: I take my stand on princely power and Kingship, on cows am I dependent, and on horses. on vital breath On members I depend, and on the body, dependent and on welfare, on heaven and earth and sacrifice dependent.

verses.sanskrit:
त्र॒या दे॒वा एका॑दश त्रयस्त्रि॒ᳪशाः सु॒राध॑सः ।
बृह॒स्पति॑पुरोहिता दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः स॒वे । दे॒वा दे॒वैर॑वन्तु मा ॥
verses.transliteration:
trayā devā ekādaśa trayastriṃśāḥ surādhasaḥ |
bṛhaspatipurohitā devasya savituḥ save | devā devairavantu mā ||
verses.translation: May Deities, eleven threes, the three and thirty bounteous Ones Whose House-Priest is Brihaspati, by impulse of bright Savitar, the Gods protect me with the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒थ॒मा द्वि॒तीयै॑र्द्वि॒तीया॑स्तृ॒तीयै॑स्तृ॒तीयाः॑ स॒त्येन॑ स॒त्यं य॒ज्ञेन॑ य॒ज्ञो यजु॑र्भि॒र्यजू॑ᳪषि॒ साम॑भिः॒ सामा॑न्यृ॒ग्भिरृचः॑ पुरोऽनुवा॒क्या॒भिः पुरोऽनुवा॒क्या॒ या॒ज्या॒भिर्या॒ज्या॒ वषट्का॒रैर्व॑षट्का॒रा आहु॑तिभि॒राहु॑तयो मे॒ कामा॒न्त्सम॑र्धयन्तु॒ भूः स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: prathamā dvitīyairdvitīyāstṛtīyaistṛtīyāḥ satyena satyaṃ yajñena yajño yajurbhiryajūṃṣi sāmabhiḥ sāmānyṛgbhirṛcaḥ puro'nuvākyābhiḥ puro'nuvākyā yājyābhiryājyā vaṣaṭkārairvaṣaṭkārā āhutibhirāhutayo me kāmāntsamardhayantu bhūḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: May the first Gods with the second, the second with the third, the third with Truth, Truth with Sacrifice, Sacrifice with sacrificial texts, sacrificial texts with Sâmans, Sâmans with praise-verses, praise-verses with fore and after-sentences. fore-sentences with inviting-texts, inviting-texts with Vashat-calls, Vashat calls with oblations, and oblations, fulfil my desires, Earth! All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: लोमा॑नि॒ प्रय॑ति॒र्मम॒ त्वङ्म॒ आन॑ति॒राग॑तिः । मा॒ᳪसं म॒ उप॑नति॒र्वस्वस्थि॑ म॒ज्जा म॒ आन॑तिः ॥
verses.transliteration: lomāni prayatirmama tvaṅma ānatirāgatiḥ | māṃsaṃ ma upanatirvasvasthi majjā ma ānatiḥ ||
verses.translation: My hair is effort and attempt, my skin is reverence and approach. My flesh is inclination, wealth my bone, my marrow reverence.

verses.sanskrit: यद्दे॑वा देव॒हेड॑नं॒ देवा॑सश्चकृ॒मा व॒यम् । अ॒ग्निर्मा॒ तस्मा॒देन॑सो॒ विश्वा॑न्मुञ्च॒त्वᳪह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration: yaddevā devaheḍanaṃ devāsaścakṛmā vayam | agnirmā tasmādenaso viśvānmuñcatvaṃhasaḥ ||
verses.translation: Gods, Deities, whatever fault of ours have stirred the wrath of Gods, May Agni set me free from that iniquity and all distress.

verses.sanskrit: यदि॒ दिवा॒ यदि॒ नक्त॒मेना॑ᳪसि चकृ॒मा व॒यम् । वा॒युर्मा॒ तस्मा॒देन॑सो॒ विश्वा॑न्मुञ्च॒त्वᳪह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi divā yadi naktamenāṃsi cakṛmā vayam | vāyurmā tasmādenaso viśvānmuñcatvaṃhasaḥ ||
