verses.translation: If in the day-time or at night we have committed acts of sin, May Vâyu set me free from that iniquity and all distress.

verses.sanskrit: यदि॒ जाग्र॒द्यदि॒ स्वप्न॒ एना॑ᳪसि चकृ॒मा व॒यम् । सूर्यो॑ मा॒ तस्मा॒देन॑सो॒ विश्वा॑न्मुञ्च॒त्वᳪह॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration: yadi jāgradyadi svapna enāṃsi cakṛmā vayam | sūryo mā tasmādenaso viśvānmuñcatvaṃhasaḥ ||
verses.translation: If when awake or in our sleep we have committed acts of sin, May Sûrya set me free from that iniquity and all distress.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्ग्रामे॒ यदर॑ण्ये॒ यत्स॒भायां॒ यदि॑न्द्रि॒ये ।
यच्छू॒द्रे यदर्ये॒ यदेन॑श्चकृ॒मा व॒यं यदेक॒स्याधि॒ धर्म॑णि॒ तस्या॑व॒यज॑नमसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadgrāme yadaraṇye yatsabhāyāṃ yadindriye |
yacchūdre yadarye yadenaścakṛmā vayaṃ yadekasyādhi dharmaṇi tasyāvayajanamasi ||
verses.translation: Each fault in village or in wild, company or corporeal sense, Each sinful act that we have done to Sûdra or Arya, or to either's disadvantage, een of that sin thou art the expiation.

verses.sanskrit:
यदापो॑ अ॒घ्न्या इति॒ वरु॒णेति॒ शपा॑महे॒ ततो॑ वरुण नो मुञ्च । अव॑भृथ निचुम्पुण निचे॒रुर॑सि निचुम्पु॒णः ।
अव॑ दे॒वैर्दे॒वकृ॑त॒मेनो॑ऽय॒क्ष्यव॒ मर्त्यै॒र्मर्त्य॑कृतं पुरु॒राव्णो॑ देव रि॒षस्पा॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadāpo aghnyā iti varuṇeti śapāmahe tato varuṇa no muñca | avabhṛtha nicumpuṇa nicerurasi nicumpuṇaḥ |
ava devairdevakṛtameno'yakṣyava martyairmartyakṛtaṃ pururāvṇo deva riṣaspāhi ||
verses.translation: Waters, Inviolable ones, etc. Said to be repeated from VI. 22. O ever-moving Cleansing Bath, etc. Repeated from III. 48.

verses.sanskrit:
स॑मु॒द्रे ते॒ हृद॑यम॒प्स्वन्तः सं त्वा॑ विश॒न्त्वोष॑धीरु॒तापः॑ ।
सु॒मि॒त्रि॒या न॒ आप॒ ओष॑धयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रि॒यास्तस्मै॑ सन्तु॒ योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि॒ यं च॑ व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ॥
verses.transliteration:
samudre te hṛdayamapsvantaḥ saṃ tvā viśantvoṣadhīrutāpaḥ |
sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyāstasmai santu yo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
verses.translation: Thy heart is in the flood, etc. Repeated from VIII. 25. To us let Waters, etc. Repeated from VI. 22.

verses.sanskrit: द्रु॒प॒दादि॑व मुमुचा॒नः स्वि॒न्नः स्ना॒तो मला॑दिव । पू॒तं प॒वित्रे॑णे॒वाज्य॒मापः॑ शुन्धन्तु मैन॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration: drupadādiva mumucānaḥ svinnaḥ snāto malādiva | pūtaṃ pavitreṇevājyamāpaḥ śundhantu mainasaḥ ||
verses.translation: As one unfastened from a stake, or cleansed by bathing after toil, As butter which the sieve hath purged, let water clean me from my sin.

verses.sanskrit: उद्व॒यं तम॑स॒स्परि॒ स्वः पश्य॑न्त॒ उत्त॑रम् । दे॒वं दे॑व॒त्रा सूर्य॒मग॑न्म॒ ज्योति॑रुत्त॒मम् ॥
verses.transliteration: udvayaṃ tamasaspari svaḥ paśyanta uttaram | devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam ||
verses.translation: Looking upon the loftier light above the darkness we have come To Sûrya, God among the Gods, the light that is most excellent.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒पो अ॒द्यान्व॑चारिष॒ᳪ रसे॑न॒ सम॑सृक्ष्महि ।
पय॑स्वानग्न॒ आऽग॑मं॒ तं मा॒ सᳪ सृ॑ज॒ वर्च॑सा प्र॒जया॑ च॒ धने॑न च ॥
verses.transliteration:
apo adyānvacāriṣaṃ rasena samasṛkṣmahi |
payasvānagna ā'gamaṃ taṃ mā saṃ sṛja varcasā prajayā ca dhanena ca ||
verses.translation: The waters I this day have sought, and to their essence have we come. Agni, come hither rich in milk, splendour and brilliancy bestow on me, and progeny and wealth.

verses.sanskrit:
एधो॑ऽस्येधिषी॒महि॑ स॒मिद॑सि॒ तेजो॑ऽसि॒ तेजो॒ मयि॑ धेहि ।
स॒माव॑वर्ति पृथि॒वी समु॒षाः समु॒ सूर्यः॑ । समु॒ विश्व॑मि॒दं जग॑त् ।
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रज्यो॑तिर्भूयासं वि॒भून् कामा॒न् व्य॒श्नवै॒ भूः स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
edho'syedhiṣīmahi samidasi tejo'si tejo mayi dhehi |
samāvavarti pṛthivī samuṣāḥ samu sūryaḥ | samu viśvamidaṃ jagat |
vaiśvānarajyotirbhūyāsaṃ vibhūn kāmān vyaśnavai bhūḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: A brand art thou: fain would we thrive. Fuel art thou and splendour: give me splendour. Earth comes again, the Dawn, the Sun. This Universe all comes again. May I possess Vaisvânara's light, may I attain my vast desires. Earth! All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भ्या द॑धामि स॒मिध॒मग्ने॑ व्रतपते॒ त्वयि॑ ।
व्र॒तं च॑ श्र॒द्धां चोपै॑मी॒न्धे त्वा॑ दीक्षि॒तो अ॒हम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhyā dadhāmi samidhamagne vratapate tvayi |
vrataṃ ca śraddhāṃ copaimīndhe tvā dīkṣito aham ||
verses.translation: O Agni, Master of the Vow, on thee I lay the kindlingstick. To the fast-vow and faith I come. I, consecrated, kindle thee.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्र॒ ब्रह्म॑ च क्ष॒त्रं च॑ स॒म्यञ्चो॒ चर॑तः स॒ह ।
तँल्लो॒कं पुण्यं॒ प्रज्ञे॑षं॒ यत्र॑ दे॒वाः स॒हाग्निना॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatra brahma ca kṣatraṃ ca samyañco carataḥ saha |
tam̐llokaṃ puṇyaṃ prajñeṣaṃ yatra devāḥ sahāgninā ||
verses.translation: Fain would I know that holy world where Deities with Agni dwell, Where priestly rank and princely power together in accordance move.

verses.sanskrit: यत्रेन्द्र॑श्च वा॒युश्च॑ स॒म्यञ्चो॒ चर॑तः स॒ह । तँल्लो॒कं पुण्यं॒ प्रज्ञे॑षं॒ यत्र॑ से॒दिर्न वि॒द्यते॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yatrendraśca vāyuśca samyañco carataḥ saha | tam̐llokaṃ puṇyaṃ prajñeṣaṃ yatra sedirna vidyate ||
verses.translation: Fain would I know that holy world where want and languor are unknown, Where in complete accordance move Indra and Vâyu side by side

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ᳪशुना॑ ते अ॒ᳪशुः पृ॑च्यतां॒ परु॑षा॒ परुः॑ । ग॒न्धस्ते॒ सोम॑मवतु॒ मदा॑य॒ रसो॒ अच्यु॑तः ॥
verses.transliteration: aṃśunā te aṃśuḥ pṛcyatāṃ paruṣā paruḥ | gandhaste somamavatu madāya raso acyutaḥ ||
verses.translation: Let thy shoot be united with his tendril, joint combine with joint. Imperishable sap for joy, thine odour be the Soma's guard!

verses.sanskrit: सि॒ञ्चन्ति॒ परि॑ षिञ्च॒न्त्युत्सि॑ञ्चन्ति पु॒नन्ति॑ च । सुरा॑यै ब॒भ्र्वै॒ मदे॑ कि॒न्त्वो व॑दति कि॒न्त्वः ॥
verses.transliteration: siñcanti pari ṣiñcantyutsiñcanti punanti ca | surāyai babhrvai made kintvo vadati kintvaḥ ||
verses.translation: They pour it out, they sprinkle it, they scatter it, they make it pure. In the brown Surâ's ecstasy he says What art thou? What art thou?

verses.sanskrit: धा॒नाव॑न्तं कर॒म्भिण॑मपू॒पव॑न्तमु॒क्थिन॑म् । इन्द्र॑ प्रा॒तर्जु॑षस्व नः ॥
verses.transliteration: dhānāvantaṃ karambhiṇamapūpavantamukthinam | indra prātarjuṣasva naḥ ||
verses.translation: Indra, at morn accept our cake accompanied with grain and groats, with wheaten bread and hymns of praise.

verses.sanskrit: बृ॒हदिन्द्रा॑य गायत॒ मरु॑तो वृत्र॒हन्त॑मम् । येन॒ ज्योति॒रज॑नयन्नृता॒वृधो॑ दे॒वं दे॒वाय॒ जागृ॑वि ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhadindrāya gāyata maruto vṛtrahantamam | yena jyotirajanayannṛtāvṛdho devaṃ devāya jāgṛvi ||
verses.translation: To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts? that slayeth Vritra best, Whereby the Holy Ones created for the God the radiant light that never dies.

verses.sanskrit: अध्व॑र्यो॒ अद्रि॑भिः सु॒तᳪ सोमं॑ प॒वित्र॒ आ न॑य । पु॒ना॒हीन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration: adhvaryo adribhiḥ sutaṃ somaṃ pavitra ā naya | punāhīndrāya pātave ||
verses.translation: Adhvaryu, on the straining cloth pour thou the Soma pressed with stones: Purify it for Indra's drink.

verses.sanskrit:
यो भू॒ताना॒मधि॑पति॒र्यस्मिँ॑ल्लो॒का अधि॑ श्रि॒ताः ।
य ईशे॑ मह॒तो म॒हाँस्तेन॑ गृह्णामि॒ त्वाम॒हं मयि॑ गृह्णामि॒ त्वाम॒हम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo bhūtānāmadhipatiryasmim̐llokā adhi śritāḥ |
ya īśe mahato mahām̐stena gṛhṇāmi tvāmahaṃ mayi gṛhṇāmi tvāmaham ||
verses.translation: The Sovran Lord of living things, he upon whom the worlds depend, Mighty, the mighty's King—by him I take thee, take thee on myself.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒श्विभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ त्वेन्द्रा॑य त्वा सु॒त्राम्ण॑ ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र॒श्विभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ त्वेन्द्रा॑य त्वा सु॒त्राम्णे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: upayāmagṛhīto'syaśvibhyāṃ tvā sarasvatyai tvendrāya tvā sutrāmṇa eṣa te yoniraśvibhyāṃ tvā sarasvatyai tvendrāya tvā sutrāmṇe ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for the Asvins. This is thy home, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒ण॒पा मे॑ अपान॒पाश्च॑क्षु॒ष्पाः श्रो॑त्र॒पाश्च॑ मे ।
वाचो॑ मे वि॒श्वभे॑षजो॒ मन॑सोऽसि वि॒लाय॑कः ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāṇapā me apānapāścakṣuṣpāḥ śrotrapāśca me |
vāco me viśvabheṣajo manaso'si vilāyakaḥ ||
verses.translation: Guard of my breath and outward breath, the guardian of mine eye and ear, All-healer of my voice, thou. art the mollifier of my mind.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्विन॑कृतस्य ते॒ सर॑स्वतिकृत॒स्येन्द्रे॑ण सु॒त्राम्णा॑ कृ॒तस्य॑ ।
उप॑हूत॒ उप॑हूतस्य भक्षयामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvinakṛtasya te sarasvatikṛtasyendreṇa sutrāmṇā kṛtasya |
upahūta upahūtasya bhakṣayāmi ||
verses.translation: Invited I feed upon thee invited, Whom Asvins, whom Sarasvatî, whom Indra, Good Protector, made.

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑द्ध॒ इन्द्र॑ उ॒षसा॒मनी॑के पुरो॒रुचा॑ पूर्व॒कृद्वा॑वृधा॒नः ।
त्रि॒भिर्दे॒वैस्त्रि॒ᳪशता॒ वज्र॑बाहुर्ज॒घान॑ वृ॒त्रं वि दुरो॑ ववार ॥
verses.transliteration:
samiddha indra uṣasāmanīke purorucā pūrvakṛdvāvṛdhānaḥ |
tribhirdevaistriṃśatā vajrabāhurjaghāna vṛtraṃ vi duro vavāra ||
verses.translation: Kindred in forefront of the Mornings, Indra with forward light, long-active, waxing mighty, With three-and thirty Gods, the Thunder-wielder, smote. Vritra dead and threw the portals open.

verses.sanskrit:
नरा॒शᳪसः॒ प्रति॒ शूरो॒ मिमा॑न॒स्तनू॒नपा॒त्प्रति॑ य॒ज्ञस्य॒ धाम॑ ।
गोभि॑र्व॒पावा॒न् मधु॑ना सम॒ञ्जन् हिर॑ण्यैश्च॒न्द्री य॑जति॒ प्रचे॑ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
narāśaṃsaḥ prati śūro mimānastanūnapātprati yajñasya dhāma |
gobhirvapāvān madhunā samañjan hiraṇyaiścandrī yajati pracetāḥ ||
verses.translation: Son of Himself, the Praise of Men, the hero, measuring out the sacrificial stations, Rich in bulls fat, anointing with sweet butter, wise, bright with gauds of gold, he sacrificeth.

verses.sanskrit:
ई॒डि॒तो दे॒वैर्हरि॑वाँ२ अभि॒ष्टिरा॒जुह्वा॑नो ह॒विषा॒ शर्ध॑मानः ।
पु॒र॒न्द॒रो गो॑त॒भिद्वज्र॑बाहु॒रा या॑तु य॒ज्ञमुप॑ नो जुषा॒णः ॥
verses.transliteration:
īḍito devairharivām̐ abhiṣṭirājuhvāno haviṣā śardhamānaḥ |
purandaro gotabhidvajrabāhurā yātu yajñamupa no juṣāṇaḥ ||
verses.translation: Lauded by Gods, Lord of Bay Steeds, the Helper, showing his greatness. worshipped with oblations. Fort-render, Cowpen-cleaver, Thunder-wielder, may he approach our sacrifice rejoicing

verses.sanskrit:
जु॒षा॒णो ब॒र्हिर्हरि॑वान् न॒ इन्द्रः॑ प्रा॒चीन॑ᳪ सीदत् प्र॒दिशा॑ पृथि॒व्याः ।
उ॒रु॒प्रथाः॒ प्रथ॑मानᳪ स्यो॒नमा॑दि॒त्यैर॒क्तं वसु॑भिः स॒जोषाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
juṣāṇo barhirharivān na indraḥ prācīnaṃ sīdat pradiśā pṛthivyāḥ |
uruprathāḥ prathamānaṃ syonamādityairaktaṃ vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ ||
verses.translation: May Indra, Lord of Bays, sit by direction eastward on earth, accepting our oblation, And sacred grass, fair, far-spread, widely-stretching, anointed by Âdityas and by Vasus.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रं॒ दुरः॑ कव॒ष्यो धाव॑माना॒ वृषा॑णं यन्तु॒ जन॑यः सु॒पत्नीः॑ ।
द्वारो॑ दे॒वीर॒भितो॒ वि श्र॑यन्ताᳪ सु॒वीरा॑ वी॒रं प्रथ॑माना॒ महो॑भिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
indraṃ duraḥ kavaṣyo dhāvamānā vṛṣāṇaṃ yantu janayaḥ supatnīḥ |
dvāro devīrabhito vi śrayantāṃ suvīrā vīraṃ prathamānā mahobhiḥ ||
verses.translation: To the strong Indra go the sounding Portals, dames with a goodly husband, swiftly moving! Well-manned, divine, wide be the Doors thrown open, expanding in their greatness fir the Hero!

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒षासा॒नक्ता॑ बृह॒ती बृ॒हन्तं॒ पय॑स्वती सु॒दुघे॒ शूर॒मिन्द्र॑म् ।
तन्तुं॑ त॒तं पेश॑सा सं॒वय॑न्ती दे॒वानां॑ दे॒वं य॑जतः सुरु॒क्मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
uṣāsānaktā bṛhatī bṛhantaṃ payasvatī sudughe śūramindram |
tantuṃ tataṃ peśasā saṃvayantī devānāṃ devaṃ yajataḥ surukme ||
verses.translation: Dawn and Night, lofty, sapful, richly-yielding, fair-showing, as they weave with varied colour The long-extended thread in concert, worship the God of Gods, the lofty Hero Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
दैव्या॒ मिमा॑ना॒ मनु॑षः पुरु॒त्रा होता॑रा॒विन्द्रं॑ प्रथ॒मा सु॒वाचा॑ ।
मू॒र्धन् य॒ज्ञस्य॒ मधु॑ना॒ दधा॑ना प्रा॒चीनं॒ ज्योति॑र्ह॒विषा॑ वृधातः ॥
verses.transliteration:
daivyā mimānā manuṣaḥ purutrā hotārāvindraṃ prathamā suvācā |
mūrdhan yajñasya madhunā dadhānā prācīnaṃ jyotirhaviṣā vṛdhātaḥ ||
verses.translation: The two first pleasant-voiced celestial Hotars, arranging rites for man in sundry places, At head of sacrifice stablishing Indra, increase the eastern light with sweet oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्ह॒विषा॒ वर्ध॑माना॒ इन्द्रं॑ जुषा॒णा जन॑यो॒ न पत्नीः॑ ।
अच्छि॑न्नं॒ तन्तुं॒ पय॑सा॒ सर॑स्व॒तीडा॑ दे॒वी भार॑ती वि॒श्वतू॑र्तिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tisro devīrhaviṣā vardhamānā indraṃ juṣāṇā janayo na patnīḥ |
acchinnaṃ tantuṃ payasā sarasvatīḍā devī bhāratī viśvatūrtiḥ ||
verses.translation: Thriving by sacrifice may the three Bright Ones, taking delight like wedded dames in Indra, Sarasvatî, Idâ, Bhâratî all-surpassing, with milk preserve our sacred thread unbroken.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वष्टा॒ दध॒च्छुष्म॒मिन्द्रा॑य॒ वृष्णेऽपा॒कोऽचि॑ष्टुर्य॒शसे॑ पु॒रूणि॑ ।
वृषा॒ यज॒न्वृष॑णं॒ भूरि॑रेता मू॒र्धन् य॒ज्ञस्य॒ सम॑नक्तु दे॒वान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṣṭā dadhacchuṣmamindrāya vṛṣṇe'pāko'ciṣṭuryaśase purūṇi |
vṛṣā yajanvṛṣaṇaṃ bhūriretā mūrdhan yajñasya samanaktu devān ||
verses.translation: May Tvashtar coming frail afar, the active, give strength and plenty to strong glorious Indra, And strong, prolific, worshipping, the Mighty at sacrifice's head give the Gods honour.

verses.sanskrit:
वन॒स्पति॒रव॑सृष्टो॒ न पाशै॒स्त्मन्या॑ सम॒ञ्जञ्छ॑मि॒ता न दे॒वः ।
इन्द्र॑स्य ह॒व्यैर्ज॒ठरं॑ पृणा॒नः स्वदा॑ति य॒ज्ञं मधु॑ना घृ॒तेन॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vanaspatiravasṛṣṭo na pāśaistmanyā samañjañchamitā na devaḥ |
indrasya havyairjaṭharaṃ pṛṇānaḥ svadāti yajñaṃ madhunā ghṛtena ||
verses.translation: Let the divine Stake, like an Immolator, bind, as one ordered, to himself the victim, And, filling Indra's belly with ablations, season the sacrifice with sweets and butter.

verses.sanskrit:
स्तो॒काना॒मिन्दुं॒ प्रति॒ शूर॒ इन्द्रो॑ वृषा॒यमा॑णो वृष॒भस्तु॑रा॒षाट् ।
घृ॒त॒प्रुषा॒ मन॑सा॒ मोद॑मानाः॒ स्वाहा॑ दे॒वा अ॒मृता॑ मादयन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
stokānāminduṃ prati śūra indro vṛṣāyamāṇo vṛṣabhasturāṣāṭ |
ghṛtapruṣā manasā modamānāḥ svāhā devā amṛtā mādayantām ||
verses.translation: Indra the Bull, swift conqueror, wildly rushing bull-like to meet the Indu of the droppings— Delighting in a mind that scatters fatness, let the immortal Gods rejoice in Svâhâ.

verses.sanskrit:
आ या॒त्विन्द्रोऽव॑स॒ उप॑ न इ॒ह स्तु॒तः स॑ध॒मद॑स्तु॒ शूरः॑ ।
वा॒वृ॒धा॒नस्तवि॑षी॒र्यस्य॑ पू॒र्वीर्द्यौर्न क्ष॒त्रम॒भिभू॑ति॒ पुष्या॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā yātvindro'vasa upa na iha stutaḥ sadhamadastu śūraḥ |
vāvṛdhānastaviṣīryasya pūrvīrdyaurna kṣatramabhibhūti puṣyāt ||
verses.translation: May Indra come to us for our protection, here, lauded Hero, be our feast-companion. May he whose powers are many, waxen mighty, cherish, like Dyaus, the sovran sway of princes.

verses.sanskrit:
आ न॒ इन्द्रो॑ दू॒रादा न॑ आ॒साद॑भिष्टि॒कृदव॑से यासदु॒ग्रः ।
ओजि॑ष्ठेभिर्नृ॒पति॒र्वज्र॑बाहुः स॒ङ्गे स॒मत्सु॑ तु॒र्वणिः॑ पृत॒न्यून् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā na indro dūrādā na āsādabhiṣṭikṛdavase yāsadugraḥ |
ojiṣṭhebhirnṛpatirvajrabāhuḥ saṅge samatsu turvaṇiḥ pṛtanyūn ||
verses.translation: From near or far away may mighty Indra, giver of succour, come for our protection, Lord of men, armed with thunder, with the Strongest, slaying his foes in conflict, in the battles.

verses.sanskrit:
आ न॒ इन्द्रो॒ हरि॑भिर्या॒त्वच्छा॑र्वाची॒नोऽव॑से॒ राध॑से च ।
तिष्ठा॑ति व॒ज्री म॒घवा॑ विर॒प्शीमं य॒ज्ञमनु॑ नो॒ वाज॑सातौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā na indro haribhiryātvacchārvācīno'vase rādhase ca |
tiṣṭhāti vajrī maghavā virapśīmaṃ yajñamanu no vājasātau ||
verses.translation: May Indra come to us with Tawny Coursers, inclined to us, to favour and enrich us. May Maghavan, loud-voiced and wielding thunder, stand by us at this sacrifice, in combat.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रा॒तार॒मिन्द्र॑मवि॒तार॒मिन्द्र॒ᳪ हवे॑-हवे सु॒हव॒ᳪ शूर॒मिन्द्र॑म् ।
ह्वया॑मि श॒क्रं पु॑रुहू॒तमिन्द्र॑ᳪ स्व॒स्ति नो॑ म॒घवा॑ धा॒त्विन्द्रः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
trātāramindramavitāramindraṃ have-have suhavaṃ śūramindram |
hvayāmi śakraṃ puruhūtamindraṃ svasti no maghavā dhātvindraḥ ||
verses.translation: Indra the Rescuer, Indra the Helper, Hero who listens at each invocation, Sakra I call, Indra invoked of many. May Indra, Bounteous Lord, prosper and bless us.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रः॑ सु॒त्रामा॒ स्ववाँ॒२ अवो॑भिः सुमृडी॒को भ॑वतु वि॒श्ववे॑दाः ।
बाध॑तां॒ द्वेषो॒ अभ॑यं कृणोतु सु॒वीर्य॑स्य॒ पत॑यः स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration:
indraḥ sutrāmā svavām̐ avobhiḥ sumṛḍīko bhavatu viśvavedāḥ |
bādhatāṃ dveṣo abhayaṃ kṛṇotu suvīryasya patayaḥ syāma ||
verses.translation: May helpful Indra as our Good Protector, Lord of all treasures, favour us with succour, Baffle our foes and give us rest and safety, and may we be the lords of hero vigour.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्य॑ व॒यᳪ सु॑म॒तौ य॒ज्ञिय॒स्यापि॑ भ॒द्रे सौ॑मन॒से स्या॑म ।
स सु॒त्रामा॒ स्ववाँ॒२ इन्द्रो॑ अ॒स्मे आ॒राच्चि॒द् द्वेषः॑ सनु॒तर्यु॑योतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
tasya vayaṃ sumatau yajñiyasyāpi bhadre saumanase syāma |
sa sutrāmā svavām̐ indro asme ārāccid dveṣaḥ sanutaryuyotu ||
verses.translation: May we enjoy the grace of him the Holy, yea, may we dwell in his auspicious favour. May helpful Indra as our Good Preserver drive from us even from afar, our foemen.

verses.sanskrit:
आ म॒न्द्रैरि॑न्द्र॒ हरि॑भिर्या॒हि म॒यूर॑रोमभिः ।
मा त्वा॒ के चि॒न्नि य॑म॒न् विं ना पा॒शिनोऽति॒ धन्वे॑व॒ ताँ२ इ॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā mandrairindra haribhiryāhi mayūraromabhiḥ |
mā tvā ke cinni yaman viṃ nā pāśino'ti dhanveva tām̐ ihi ||
verses.translation: Come hither, Indra, with Bay Steeds, joyous, with tails like peacock plumes, Let no men check thy course as fowlers stay the bird: pass oer them as oer desert lands.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒वेदिन्द्रं॒ वृष॑णं॒ वज्र॑बाहुं॒ वसि॑ष्ठासो अ॒भ्य॒र्चन्त्य॒र्कैः ।
स न॑ स्तु॒तो वी॒रव॑द्धातु॒ गोम॑द्यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभिः॒ सदा॑ नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
evedindraṃ vṛṣaṇaṃ vajrabāhuṃ vasiṣṭhāso abhyarcantyarkaiḥ |
sa na stuto vīravaddhātu gomadyūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
verses.translation: Verily the Vasishthas hymn with praises Indra the mighty One whose arm wields thunder. Praised, may he guard our wealth in men and cattle. Ye Gods, preserve us evermore with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: समि॑द्धो अ॒ग्निर॑श्विना त॒प्तो घ॒र्मो वि॒राट् सु॒तः । दु॒हे धे॒नुः सर॑स्वती॒ सोम॑ᳪ शु॒क्रमि॒हेन्द्रि॒यम् ॥
verses.transliteration: samiddho agniraśvinā tapto gharmo virāṭ sutaḥ | duhe dhenuḥ sarasvatī somaṃ śukramihendriyam ||
verses.translation: Fire hath been kindled, Asvins Twain! the Gharma warmed, the Radiant pressed, Here the Milch-Cow Sarasvatî hath poured bright Soma, Indra's own.

verses.sanskrit: त॒नू॒पा भि॒षजा॑ सु॒तेऽश्विनो॒भा सर॑स्वती । मध्वा॒ रजा॑ᳪसीन्द्रि॒यमिन्द्रा॑य प॒थिभि॑र्वहान् ॥
verses.transliteration: tanūpā bhiṣajā sute'śvinobhā sarasvatī | madhvā rajāṃsīndriyamindrāya pathibhirvahān ||
verses.translation: When Soma flows Sarasvatî and both the Asvins, Leeches and Body-guards, bear to Indra strength by passage through the realms of air.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रा॒येन्दु॒ᳪ सर॑स्वती॒ नरा॒शᳪसे॑न न॒ग्नहु॑म् । अधा॑ताम॒श्विना॒ मधु॑ भेष॒जं भि॒षजा॑ सु॒ते ॥
verses.transliteration: indrāyenduṃ sarasvatī narāśaṃsena nagnahum | adhātāmaśvinā madhu bheṣajaṃ bhiṣajā sute ||
verses.translation: When Soma flowed the Asvins Twain, the Leeches, brought sweet medicine, With Men's Desire Sarasvatî for Indra, Soma, Nagnahu.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒जुह्वा॑ना॒ सर॑स्व॒तीन्द्रा॑येन्द्रि॒याणि॑ वी॒र्य॒म् । इडा॑भिर॒श्विना॒विष॒ᳪ समूर्ज॒ᳪ सᳪ र॒यिं द॑धुः ॥
verses.transliteration: ājuhvānā sarasvatīndrāyendriyāṇi vīryam | iḍābhiraśvināviṣaṃ samūrjaṃ saṃ rayiṃ dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: Worshipped, Sarasvatî bestowed on Indra, senses, manly power. The Asvins, through oblations paid, combined food, energy, and wealth.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒श्विना॒ नमु॑चेः सु॒तᳪ सोम॑ᳪ शु॒क्रं प॑रि॒स्रुता॑ । सर॑स्वती॒ तमा ऽभ॑रद्ब॒र्हिषेन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvinā namuceḥ sutaṃ somaṃ śukraṃ parisrutā | sarasvatī tamā 'bharadbarhiṣendrāya pātave ||
verses.translation: The Asvins brought from Namuchi pressed Soma bright with foaming juice. Sarasvatî with sacred grass brought that to Indra for his drink.

verses.sanskrit: क॒व॒ष्यो न॒ व्यच॑स्वतीर॒श्विभ्यां॒ न दुरो॒ दिशः॑ । इन्द्रो॒ न रोद॑सी उ॒भे दु॒हे का॒मान्त्सर॑स्वती ॥
verses.transliteration: kavaṣyo na vyacasvatīraśvibhyāṃ na duro diśaḥ | indro na rodasī ubhe duhe kāmāntsarasvatī ||
verses.translation: Sarasvatî and Indra with the Asvins Twain milked out desires From heaven and earth, the regions, the resounding and expansive doors.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒षासा॒नक्त॑मश्विना॒ दिवेन्द्र॑ सा॒यमि॑न्द्रियैः । स॒ञ्जा॒ना॒ने सु॒पेश॑सा॒ सम॑ञ्जाते॒ सर॑स्वत्या ॥
verses.transliteration: uṣāsānaktamaśvinā divendra sāyamindriyaiḥ | sañjānāne supeśasā samañjāte sarasvatyā ||
verses.translation: Ye Asvins, Dawn and Night, by day and in the evening, fair of hue, Accordant, with Sarasvatî, deck Indra with surpassing powers.

verses.sanskrit: पा॒तं नो॑ अश्विना॒ दिवा॑ पा॒हि नक्त॑ᳪ सरस्वति । दैव्या॑ होतारा भिषजा पा॒तमिन्द्र॒ᳪ सचा॑ सु॒ते ॥
verses.transliteration: pātaṃ no aśvinā divā pāhi naktaṃ sarasvati | daivyā hotārā bhiṣajā pātamindraṃ sacā sute ||
verses.translation: Guard us, O Asvins, through the day, guards us by night, Sarasvatî. Celestial Hotars, Leeches! both guard Indra when the juice is pressed.

verses.sanskrit: ति॒स्रस्त्रे॒धा सर॑स्वत्य॒श्विना॒ भार॒तीडा॑ । ती॒व्रं प॑रि॒स्रुता॒ सोम॒मिन्द्रा॑य सुषुवु॒र्मद॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: tisrastredhā sarasvatyaśvinā bhāratīḍā | tīvraṃ parisrutā somamindrāya suṣuvurmadam ||
verses.translation: The Asvins, and the Three, apart, Sarasvatî, Idâ, Bhâratî, As drink to gladden Indra, poured strong Soma with the foaming juice.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒श्विना॑ भेष॒जं मधु॑ भेष॒जं नः॒ सर॑स्वती । इन्द्रे॒ त्वष्टा॒ यशः॒ श्रिय॑ᳪ रू॒पᳪ-रू॑पमधुः सु॒ते ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvinā bheṣajaṃ madhu bheṣajaṃ naḥ sarasvatī | indre tvaṣṭā yaśaḥ śriyaṃ rūpaṃ-rūpamadhuḥ sute ||
verses.translation: The Asvins, our Sarasvatî, and Tvashtar, when the juice was shed, Gave Indra balm, yea, mead as balm, glory and fame and many a shape.

verses.sanskrit: ऋ॒तु॒थेन्द्रो॒ वन॒स्पतिः॑ शशमा॒नः प॑रि॒स्रुता॑ । की॒लाल॑म॒श्विभ्यां॒ मधु॑ दु॒हे धे॒नुः सर॑स्वती ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtuthendro vanaspatiḥ śaśamānaḥ parisrutā | kīlālamaśvibhyāṃ madhu duhe dhenuḥ sarasvatī ||
verses.translation: Praising with foaming liquor at due times, Indra, Vanaspatî, Sarasvatî as cow gave forth sweet beverage with the Asvins Twain.

verses.sanskrit: गोभि॒र्न सोम॑मश्विना॒ मास॑रेण परि॒स्रुता॑ । सम॑धात॒ᳪ सर॑स्वत्या॒ स्वाहेन्द्रे॑ सु॒तं मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: gobhirna somamaśvinā māsareṇa parisrutā | samadhātaṃ sarasvatyā svāhendre sutaṃ madhu ||
verses.translation: Asvins, to Indra ye with cows, with Mâsara and foaming drink Gave, with Sarasvatî—All hail!—the pressed-out Soma juice and mead.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒श्विना॑ ह॒विरि॑न्द्रि॒यं नमु॑चेर्धि॒या सर॑स्वती । आ शु॒क्रमा॑सु॒राद्वसु॑ म॒घमिन्द्रा॑य जभ्रिरे ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvinā havirindriyaṃ namucerdhiyā sarasvatī | ā śukramāsurādvasu maghamindrāya jabhrire ||
verses.translation: The Asvins and Sarasvatî by wit from fiendish Namuchi Brought unto Indra sacred food, strength, brilliant treasure, ample wealth.

verses.sanskrit: यम॒श्विना॒ सर॑स्वती ह॒विषेन्द्र॒मव॑र्धयन् । स बि॑भेद व॒लं म॒घं नमु॑चावासु॒रे सचा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yamaśvinā sarasvatī haviṣendramavardhayan | sa bibheda valaṃ maghaṃ namucāvāsure sacā ||
verses.translation: That Indra, strong through sacrifice by Asvins and Sarasvatî, Cleft Vala through to win him wealth, with Namuchi of Asura birth.

verses.sanskrit: तमिन्द्रं॑ प॒शवः॒ सचा॒श्विनो॒भा सर॑स्वती । दधा॑ना अ॒भ्य॒नूषत ह॒विषा॑ य॒ज्ञ इ॑न्द्रि॒यैः ॥
verses.transliteration: tamindraṃ paśavaḥ sacāśvinobhā sarasvatī | dadhānā abhyanūṣata haviṣā yajña indriyaiḥ ||
verses.translation: Supporting him in sacrifice with sacred food and mighty powers, Sarasvatî, both Asvins and the cattle hymned that Indra's praise.

verses.sanskrit: य इन्द्र॑ इन्द्रि॒यं द॒धुः स॑वि॒ता वरु॑णो॒ भगः॑ । स सु॒त्रामा॑ ह॒विष्प॑ति॒र्यज॑मानाय सश्चत ॥
verses.transliteration: ya indra indriyaṃ dadhuḥ savitā varuṇo bhagaḥ | sa sutrāmā haviṣpatiryajamānāya saścata ||
verses.translation: Indra whom Bhaga, Savitar, and Varuna supplied with power, Lord of the sacrifice, may he, Good Guardian, love the worshipper.

verses.sanskrit: स॒वि॒ता वरु॑णो दध॒द्यज॑मानाय दा॒शुषे॑ । आद॑त्त॒ नमु॑चे॒र्वसु॑ सु॒त्रामा॒ बल॑मिन्द्रि॒यम् ॥
verses.transliteration: savitā varuṇo dadhadyajamānāya dāśuṣe | ādatta namucervasu sutrāmā balamindriyam ||
verses.translation: Savitar, Varuna bestow gifts on the liberal offerer, Strength, power and treasure which the Good Protector took from Namuchi!

verses.sanskrit: वरु॑णः क्ष॒त्रमि॑न्द्रि॒यं भगे॑न सवि॒ता श्रिय॑म् । सु॒त्रामा॒ यश॑सा॒ बलं॒ दधा॑ना य॒ज्ञमा॑शत ॥
verses.transliteration: varuṇaḥ kṣatramindriyaṃ bhagena savitā śriyam | sutrāmā yaśasā balaṃ dadhānā yajñamāśata ||
verses.translation: Varuna giving sway and power, Savitar grace with happiness, The Good Protector giving strength with fame, obtained the sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒श्विना॒ गोभि॑रिन्द्रि॒यमश्वे॑भिर्वी॒र्यं बल॑म् । ह॒विषेन्द्र॒ᳪ सर॑स्वती॒ यज॑मानमवर्धयन् ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvinā gobhirindriyamaśvebhirvīryaṃ balam | haviṣendraṃ sarasvatī yajamānamavardhayan ||
verses.translation: With cows the Asvins, mighty power, with horses manly vigour, strength, With sacred food Sarasvatî, made Indra, Sacrificer, strong.

verses.sanskrit: ता नास॑त्या सु॒पेश॑सा॒ हिर॑ण्यवर्तनी॒ नरा॑ । सर॑स्वती ह॒विष्म॒तीन्द्र॒ कर्म॑सु नोऽवत ॥
verses.transliteration: tā nāsatyā supeśasā hiraṇyavartanī narā | sarasvatī haviṣmatīndra karmasu no'vata ||
verses.translation: May those Nâsatyas, fair of form, the Men who ride on paths of gold, Oblation-rich Sarasvatî, thou, Indra! help us in our rites.

verses.sanskrit: ता भि॒षजा॑ सु॒कर्म॑णा॒ सा सु॒दुघा॒ सर॑स्वती । स वृ॑त्र॒हा श॒तक्र॑तु॒रिन्द्रा॑य दधुरिन्द्रि॒यम् ॥
verses.transliteration: tā bhiṣajā sukarmaṇā sā sudughā sarasvatī | sa vṛtrahā śatakraturindrāya dadhurindriyam ||
verses.translation: Those Leeches righteous in their deeds, She, rich in milk, Sarasvatî, That Vritra-Mayer hundred-powered, invested Indra with his might.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒वᳪ सु॒राम॑मश्विना॒ नमु॑चावासु॒रे सचा॑ । वि॒पि॒पा॒नाः सर॑स्व॒तीन्द्रं॒ कर्म॑स्वावत ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvaṃ surāmamaśvinā namucāvāsure sacā | vipipānāḥ sarasvatīndraṃ karmasvāvata ||
verses.translation: Ye Asvins and Sarasvatî, joint drinkers of the Sara draught, In Namuchi of Asura birth, give aid to Indra in his deeds.

verses.sanskrit: पु॒त्रमि॑व पि॒तरा॑व॒श्विनो॒भेन्द्रा॒वथुः॒ काव्यै॑र्द॒ᳪसना॑भिः ।यत्सु॒रामं॒ व्यपि॑बः॒ शची॑भिः॒ सर॑स्वती त्वा मघवन्नभिष्णक् ॥
verses.transliteration: putramiva pitarāvaśvinobhendrāvathuḥ kāvyairdaṃsanābhiḥ |yatsurāmaṃ vyapibaḥ śacībhiḥ sarasvatī tvā maghavannabhiṣṇak ||
verses.translation: As parents aid a son, etc., as in X. 34.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मि॒न्नश्वा॑स ऋष॒भास॑ उ॒क्षणो॑ व॒शा मे॒षा अ॑वसृ॒ष्टास॒ आहु॑ताः ।
की॒ला॒ल॒पे सोम॑पृष्ठाय वे॒धसे॑ हृ॒दा म॒तिं ज॑नय॒ चारु॑म॒ग्नये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasminnaśvāsa ṛṣabhāsa ukṣaṇo vaśā meṣā avasṛṣṭāsa āhutāḥ |
kīlālape somapṛṣṭhāya vedhase hṛdā matiṃ janaya cārumagnaye ||
verses.translation: He in whom horses, bulls, oxen, and barren cows, and rams, when duly set apart, are offered up, To Agni, Soma-sprinkled, drinker of sweet juice, Disposer, with thy heart bring forth a pleasant hymn.

verses.sanskrit:
अहा॑व्यग्ने ह॒विरा॒स्ये॒ ते स्रु॒ची॒व घृ॒तं च॒म्वी॒व॒ सोमः॑ ।
वा॒ज॒सनि॑ᳪ र॒यिम॒स्मे सु॒वीरं॑ प्रश॒स्तं धे॑हि य॒शसं॑ बृ॒हन्त॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahāvyagne havirāsye te srucīva ghṛtaṃ camvīva somaḥ |
vājasaniṃ rayimasme suvīraṃ praśastaṃ dhehi yaśasaṃ bṛhantam ||
verses.translation: Within thy mouth is poured the offering, Agni, as Soma into cup, oil into ladle. Vouchsafe us wealth, strength-winning, blest with heroes, wealth lofty, praised by men, and full of splendour.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒श्विना॒ तेज॑सा॒ चक्षुः॑ प्रा॒णेन॒ सर॑स्वती वी॒र्य॒म् । वा॒चेन्द्रो॒ बले॒नेन्द्रा॑य दधुरिन्द्रि॒यम् ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvinā tejasā cakṣuḥ prāṇena sarasvatī vīryam | vācendro balenendrāya dadhurindriyam ||
verses.translation: The Asvins gave, with lustre, sight, Sarasvatî manly strength with breath. Indra with voice and might gave Indra vigorous power.

verses.sanskrit: गोम॑दू॒ षु णा॑सत्या॒श्वा॑वद्यातमश्विना । व॒र्ती रु॑द्रा नृ॒पाय्य॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: gomadū ṣu ṇāsatyāśvāvadyātamaśvinā | vartī rudrā nṛpāyyam ||
verses.translation: With kine, Nâsatyas! and with steeds, come, Asvins, Rudras! to the house, the sure protector of its men;

verses.sanskrit: न यत्परो॒ नान्त॑र आद॒धर्ष॑द्वृषण्वसू । दुः॒शᳪसो॒ मर्त्यो॑ रि॒पुः ॥
verses.transliteration: na yatparo nāntara ādadharṣadvṛṣaṇvasū | duḥśaṃso martyo ripuḥ ||
verses.translation: Such, wealthy Gods! as none afar or standing near to us may harm, yea, no malicious mortal foe.

verses.sanskrit: ता न॒ आ वो॑ढमश्विना र॒यिं पि॒शङ्ग॑संदृशम् । धिष्ण्या॑ वरिवो॒विद॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: tā na ā voḍhamaśvinā rayiṃ piśaṅgasaṃdṛśam | dhiṣṇyā varivovidam ||
verses.translation: Do ye, O longed-for Asvins, lead us on to wealth of varied form, wealth that shall bring us room and rest.

verses.sanskrit: पा॒व॒का नः॒ सर॑स्वती॒ वाजे॑भिर्वा॒जिनी॑वती । य॒ज्ञं व॑ष्टु धि॒याव॑सुः ॥
verses.transliteration: pāvakā naḥ sarasvatī vājebhirvājinīvatī | yajñaṃ vaṣṭu dhiyāvasuḥ ||
verses.translation: Wealthy in spoil, enriched with hymns, may pure Sarasvatî desire with eager love our sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: चो॒द॒यि॒त्री सू॒नृता॑नां॒ चेत॑न्ती सुमती॒नाम् । य॒ज्ञं द॑धे॒ सर॑स्वती ॥
verses.transliteration: codayitrī sūnṛtānāṃ cetantī sumatīnām | yajñaṃ dadhe sarasvatī ||
verses.translation: She who awakens sounds of joy, inspires our hymns, Sarasvatî, she hath allowed our sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: म॒हो अर्णः॒ सर॑स्वती॒ प्र चे॑तयति के॒तुना॑ । धियो॒ विश्वा॒ वि रा॑जति ॥
verses.transliteration: maho arṇaḥ sarasvatī pra cetayati ketunā | dhiyo viśvā vi rājati ||
verses.translation: Sarasvatî, the mighty flood, she with her light illuminates, she brightens every pious thought.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रा या॑हि चित्रभानो सु॒ता इ॒मे त्वा॒यवः॑ । अण्वी॑भि॒स्तना॑ पू॒तासः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: indrā yāhi citrabhāno sutā ime tvāyavaḥ | aṇvībhistanā pūtāsaḥ ||
verses.translation: O Indra, marvellously bright, come, these libations long for thee, thus by fine fingers purified.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रा या॑हि धि॒येषि॒तो विप्र॑जूतः सु॒ताव॑तः । उप॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि वा॒घतः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: indrā yāhi dhiyeṣito viprajūtaḥ sutāvataḥ | upa brahmāṇi vāghataḥ ||
verses.translation: Urged by the holy singer, sped by song, come, Indra, to the prayers of the libation-pouring priest.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रा या॑हि॒ तूतु॑जान॒ उप॒ ब्रह्मा॑णि हरिवः । सु॒ते द॑धिष्व न॒श्चनः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: indrā yāhi tūtujāna upa brahmāṇi harivaḥ | sute dadhiṣva naścanaḥ ||
verses.translation: Approach, O Indra, hasting thee, Lord of Bay Horses, to the prayer: in our libations take delight.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्विना॑ पिबतां॒ मधु॒ सर॑स्वत्या स॒जोष॑सा ।
इन्द्रः॑ सु॒त्रामा॑ वृत्र॒हा जु॒षन्ता॑ᳪ सो॒म्यं मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvinā pibatāṃ madhu sarasvatyā sajoṣasā |
indraḥ sutrāmā vṛtrahā juṣantāṃ somyaṃ madhu ||
verses.translation: Accordant with Sarasvatî let the two Asvins drink the meath, May Indra, Vritra-slayer, Good Guardian, accept the Soma meath.

verses.sanskrit: इ॒मं मे॑ वरुण श्रु॒धी हव॑म॒द्या च॑ मृडय । त्वाम॑स्व॒स्युरा च॑के ॥
verses.transliteration: imaṃ me varuṇa śrudhī havamadyā ca mṛḍaya | tvāmasvasyurā cake ||
verses.translation: Varuna, hear this call of mine: be gracious unto us this day. Longing for help I yearn for thee.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्त्वा॑ यामि॒ ब्रह्म॑णा॒ वन्द॑मान॒स्तदा शा॑स्ते॒ यज॑मानो ह॒विर्भिः॑ ।
अहे॑डमानो वरुणे॒ह बो॒ध्युरु॑शᳪस॒ मा न॒ आयुः॒ प्र मो॑षीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tattvā yāmi brahmaṇā vandamānastadā śāste yajamāno havirbhiḥ |
aheḍamāno varuṇeha bodhyuruśaṃsa mā na āyuḥ pra moṣīḥ ||
verses.translation: I ask this of thee with my prayer, etc., as in XVIII. 49.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं नो॑ अग्ने॒ वरु॑णस्य वि॒द्वान् दे॒वस्य॒ हेडो व॑ यासिसीष्ठाः ।
यजि॑ष्ठो॒ वह्नि॑तमः॒ शोशु॑चानो॒ विश्वा॒ द्वेषा॑ᳪसि॒ प्र मु॑मुग्ध्य॒स्मत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṃ no agne varuṇasya vidvān devasya heḍo va yāsisīṣṭhāḥ |
yajiṣṭho vahnitamaḥ śośucāno viśvā dveṣāṃsi pra mumugdhyasmat ||
verses.translation: Do thou who knowest Varuna, O Agni, put far away from us the God's displeasure. Best Sacrificer, brightest One, refulgent, remove thou far from us all those who hate us.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं नो॑ अग्नेऽव॒मो भ॑वो॒ती नेदि॑ष्ठो अ॒स्या उ॒षसो॒ व्यु॒ष्टौ ।
अव॑ यक्ष्व नो॒ वरु॑ण॒ᳪ ररा॑णो वी॒हि मृ॑डी॒क सु॒हवो॑ न एधि ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṃ no agne'vamo bhavotī nediṣṭho asyā uṣaso vyuṣṭau |
ava yakṣva no varuṇaṃ rarāṇo vīhi mṛḍīka suhavo na edhi ||
verses.translation: Be thou the nearest unto us, O Agni, our closest Friend while now this Morn is breaking. Reconcile Varuna to us, be bounteous: show thy compassion and be swift to hear us.

verses.sanskrit:
म॒हीमू॒ षु मा॒तर॑ᳪ सुव्र॒ताना॑मृ॒तस्य॒ पत्नी॒मव॑से हुवेम ।
तु॒वि॒क्ष॒त्राम॒जर॑न्तीमुरू॒चीᳪ सु॒शर्मा॑ण॒मदि॑तिᳪ सु॒प्रणी॑तिम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
mahīmū ṣu mātaraṃ suvratānāmṛtasya patnīmavase huvema |
tuvikṣatrāmajarantīmurūcīṃ suśarmāṇamaditiṃ supraṇītim ||
verses.translation: We call to succour us the mighty Mother of those whose sway is just, the Queen of Order, Strong-ruler, far-expanding, neer decaying, Aditi gracious guide and good protectress.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒त्रामा॑णं पृथि॒वीं द्याम॑ने॒हस॑ᳪ सु॒शर्मा॑ण॒मदि॑ति सु॒प्रणी॑तिम् ।
दैवीं॒ नाव॑ᳪ स्वरि॒त्रामना॑गस॒मस्र॑वन्ती॒मा रु॑हेमा स्व॒स्तये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sutrāmāṇaṃ pṛthivīṃ dyāmanehasaṃ suśarmāṇamaditi supraṇītim |
daivīṃ nāvaṃ svaritrāmanāgasamasravantīmā ruhemā svastaye ||
verses.translation: Sinless may we ascend, for weal, this vessel rowed with good oars, divine, that never leaketh, Earth our strong guard, incomparable Heaven. Aditi gracious guide and good protectress.

verses.sanskrit: सु॒नाव॒मा रु॑हेय॒मस्र॑वन्ती॒मना॑गसम् । श॒तारि॑त्राᳪ स्व॒स्तये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: sunāvamā ruheyamasravantīmanāgasam | śatāritrāṃ svastaye ||
verses.translation: May I ascend the goodly ship, free from defect, that leaketh not, Moved by a hundred oars, for weal.

verses.sanskrit: आ नो॑ मित्रावरुणा घृतै॒र्गव्यू॑तिमुक्षतम् । मध्वा॒ रजा॑ᳪसि सुक्रतू ॥
verses.transliteration: ā no mitrāvaruṇā ghṛtairgavyūtimukṣatam | madhvā rajāṃsi sukratū ||
verses.translation: O Mitra-Varuna, gracious Pair, with fatness dew our pasturage, With mead the regions of the air.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र बा॒हवा॑ सिसृतं जी॒वसे॑ न॒ आ नो॒ गव्यू॑तिमुक्षतं घृ॒तेन॑ ।
आ मा॒ जने॑ श्रवयतं युवाना श्रु॒तं मे॑ मित्रावरुणा॒ हवे॒मा ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra bāhavā sisṛtaṃ jīvase na ā no gavyūtimukṣataṃ ghṛtena |
ā mā jane śravayataṃ yuvānā śrutaṃ me mitrāvaruṇā havemā ||
verses.translation: Stretch forth your arms and let our lives be lengthened: with fatness dew the pastures of our cattle. Ye Youthful, make us famed among the people: hear, Mitra-Varuna, these mine invocations.

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॑ भवन्तु वा॒जिनो॒ हवे॑षु दे॒वता॑ता मि॒तद्र॑वः स्व॒र्काः ।
ज॒म्भय॒न्तोऽहिं॒ वृक॒ᳪ रक्षा॑ᳪसि॒ सने॑म्य॒स्मद्यु॑यव॒न्नमी॑वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no bhavantu vājino haveṣu devatātā mitadravaḥ svarkāḥ |
jambhayanto'hiṃ vṛkaṃ rakṣāṃsi sanemyasmadyuyavannamīvāḥ ||
verses.translation: Bless us the Coursers when we call, etc., as in IX. 16.

verses.sanskrit:
वाजे॑-वाजेऽवत वाजिनो नो॒ धने॑षु विप्रा अमृता ऋतज्ञाः ।
अ॒स्य मध्वः॑ पिबत मा॒दय॑ध्वं तृ॒प्ता या॑त प॒थिभि॑र्देव॒यानैः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vāje-vāje'vata vājino no dhaneṣu viprā amṛtā ṛtajñāḥ |
asya madhvaḥ pibata mādayadhvaṃ tṛptā yāta pathibhirdevayānaiḥ ||
verses.translation: Deep-skilled in Law, etc., as in IX. 18.

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑द्धो अ॒ग्निः स॒मिधा॒ सुस॑मिद्धो॒ वरे॑ण्यः ।
गा॒य॒त्री छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं त्र्यविर्गौ॒र्वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
samiddho agniḥ samidhā susamiddho vareṇyaḥ |
gāyatrī chanda indriyaṃ tryavirgaurvayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: Kindled is Agni with the brand, yea, kindled well, the excellent. The metre Gâyatrî, the steer of eighteen months, give power and life!

verses.sanskrit:
तनू॒नपा॒च्छुचि॑व्रतस्तनू॒पाश्च॒ सर॑स्वती ।
उ॒ष्णिहा॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं दि॑त्य॒वाड्गौर्वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tanūnapācchucivratastanūpāśca sarasvatī |
uṣṇihā chanda indriyaṃ dityavāḍgaurvayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: Tanûnapât whose acts are pure, our bodies guard Sarasvatî, Ushnihâ metre and the steer of two years age give power and life!

verses.sanskrit: इडा॑भिर॒ग्निरीड्यः॒ सोमो॑ दे॒वो अम॑र्त्यः । अ॒नु॒ष्टुप्छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं पञ्चा॑विर्गौ॒र्वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration: iḍābhiragnirīḍyaḥ somo devo amartyaḥ | anuṣṭupchanda indriyaṃ pañcāvirgaurvayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: Agni with offerings, meet for praise, and Soma the immortal God, Anushtup metre and the steer of thirty months give power and life!

verses.sanskrit: सु॒ब॒र्हिर॒ग्निः पू॑ष॒ण्वान्त्स्ती॒र्णब॑र्हि॒रम॑र्त्यः । बृ॒ह॒ती छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं त्रि॑व॒त्सो गौर्वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration: subarhiragniḥ pūṣaṇvāntstīrṇabarhiramartyaḥ | bṛhatī chanda indriyaṃ trivatso gaurvayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: Agni with goodly grass spread out, deathless with Pûshan at his side, Brihatî metre and a steer of three years age give power and life!

verses.sanskrit:
दुरो॑ दे॒वीर्दिशो॑ म॒हीर्ब्र॒ह्मा दे॒वो बृह॒स्पतिः॑ ।
प॒ङ्क्तिश्छन्द॑ इ॒हेन्द्रि॒यं तु॑र्य॒वाड्गौ॒र्वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
duro devīrdiśo mahīrbrahmā devo bṛhaspatiḥ |
paṅktiśchanda ihendriyaṃ turyavāḍgaurvayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: The Doors divine, the mighty Regions, Brahma, God Brihaspati, The metre Pankti, here a bull in his fourth year, give power and life

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒षे य॒ह्वी सु॒पेश॑सा॒ विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अम॑र्त्याः ।
त्रि॒ष्टुप्छन्द॑ इ॒हेन्द्रि॒यं प॑ष्ठ॒वाड्गौ॒र्वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
uṣe yahvī supeśasā viśve devā amartyāḥ |
triṣṭupchanda ihendriyaṃ paṣṭhavāḍgaurvayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: The two young Darns of lovely form, the deathless Universal Gods, The Trishtup metre, here, a bull in his sixth year, give power and life!

verses.sanskrit:
दैव्या॒ होता॑रा भि॒षजेन्द्रे॑ण स॒युजा॑ यु॒जा ।
जग॑ती॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यम॑न॒ड्वान्गौ॒र्वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
daivyā hotārā bhiṣajendreṇa sayujā yujā |
jagatī chanda indriyamanaḍvāngaurvayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: The two celestial Hotars, both Physicians, Indra's close-knit friends, The metre Jagatî, an ox who draws the wain, give power and life!

verses.sanskrit:
ति॒स्र इडा॒ सर॑स्वती॒ भार॑ती म॒रुतो॒ विशः॑ ।
वि॒राट् छन्द॑ इ॒हेन्द्रि॒यं धे॒नुर्गौर्न वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tisra iḍā sarasvatī bhāratī maruto viśaḥ |
virāṭ chanda ihendriyaṃ dhenurgaurna vayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: The Three, Ida, Sarasvatî, and Bhâratî, the Marut folk, Virâj the metre, here, a cow in milk, a bull, give power and life!

verses.sanskrit:
त्वष्टा॑ तु॒रीपो॒ अद्भु॑त इन्द्रा॒ग्नी पु॑ष्टि॒वर्ध॑ना ।
द्विप॑दा॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यमु॒क्षा गौ॒र्न वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṣṭā turīpo adbhuta indrāgnī puṣṭivardhanā |
dvipadā chanda indriyamukṣā gaurna vayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: Tvashtar the wondrous, full of seed, Indrâgnî furtherers of weal, Dvipadâ metre, and a cow and vigorous bull give power and life!

verses.sanskrit:
श॒मि॒ता नो॒ वन॒स्पतिः॑ सवि॒ता प्र॑सु॒वन् भग॑म् ।
क॒कुप्छन्द॑ इ॒हेन्द्रि॒यं व॒शा वे॒हद्वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śamitā no vanaspatiḥ savitā prasuvan bhagam |
kakupchanda ihendriyaṃ vaśā vehadvayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: Our slaughterer, Vanaspatî, Savitar who promoteth wealth, The metre Kakup, here, a cow who casts her calf, give power and life!

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाहा॑ य॒ज्ञं वरु॑णः सुक्ष॒त्रो भे॑ष॒जं क॑रत् ।
अति॑च्छन्दा इन्द्रि॒यं बृ॒हदृ॑ष॒भो गौर्वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
svāhā yajñaṃ varuṇaḥ sukṣatro bheṣajaṃ karat |
aticchandā indriyaṃ bṛhadṛṣabho gaurvayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: With Svâhâ mighty Varuna give healing power to Sacrifice! The Atichhandas, Brihat, and a steer and bull give power and life!

verses.sanskrit:
व॒स॒न्तेन॑ ऋ॒तुना॑ दे॒वा वस॑ववस्त्रि॒वृता॑ स्तु॒ताः ।
र॒थ॒न्त॒रेण॒ तेज॑सा ह॒विरिन्द्रे॒ वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vasantena ṛtunā devā vasavavastrivṛtā stutāḥ |
rathantareṇa tejasā havirindre vayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: With the Spring Season may the Gods the Vasus praised with triple hymn And with Rathantara, give life to Indra, splendour, sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
ग्री॒ष्मेण॑ ऋ॒तुना॑ दे॒वा रु॒द्राः प॑ञ्चद॒शे स्तु॒ताः ।
बृ॒ह॒ता यश॑सा॒ बल॑ᳪ ह॒विरिन्द्रे॒ वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
grīṣmeṇa ṛtunā devā rudrāḥ pañcadaśe stutāḥ |
bṛhatā yaśasā balaṃ havirindre vayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: With Summer may the Rudras, Gods, praised in the Pañchadasa hymn With Brihat, give to Indra strength; with fame, and sacrifice and life.

verses.sanskrit:
व॒र्षाभि॑रृ॒तुना॑ऽऽदि॒त्या स्तोमे॑ सप्तद॒शे स्तु॒ताः ।
वै॒रू॒पेण॑ वि॒शौज॑सा ह॒विरिन्द्रे॒ वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
varṣābhirṛtunā''dityā stome saptadaśe stutāḥ |
vairūpeṇa viśaujasā havirindre vayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: May the Âdityas with the Rains, lauded in Saptadasa hymn And with Vairûpa, with folk, strength, give Indra sacrifice and life.

verses.sanskrit:
शा॒र॒देन॑ ऋ॒तुना॑ दे॒वा ए॑कवि॒ᳪश ऋ॒भव॑ स्तु॒ताः ।
वै॒रा॒जेन॑ श्रि॒या श्रिय॑ᳪ ह॒विरिन्द्रे॒ वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śāradena ṛtunā devā ekaviṃśa ṛbhava stutāḥ |
vairājena śriyā śriyaṃ havirindre vayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: With Autumn may the Ribhus, Gods, praised in the Ekavimsa hymn And with Virâja, give with grace to Indra grace, life, sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
हे॒म॒न्तेन॑ ऋ॒तुना॑ दे॒वास्त्रि॑ण॒वे म॒रुत॑ स्तु॒ताः ।
बले॑न॒ शक्व॑रीः॒ सहो॑ ह॒विरिन्द्रे॒ वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
hemantena ṛtunā devāstriṇave maruta stutāḥ |
balena śakvarīḥ saho havirindre vayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: With Winter may the Maruts, Gods, praised in the laud of thrice nine parts, The Sakvarîs, with strength give might to Indra, sacrifice and life.

verses.sanskrit:
शै॒शि॒रेण॑ ऋ॒तुना॑ दे॒वास्त्र॑यस्त्रि॒ᳪशेऽमृता॑ स्तु॒ताः ।
स॒त्येन॑ रे॒वतीः॑ क्ष॒त्रᳪ ह॒विरिन्द्रे॒ वयो॑ दधुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaiśireṇa ṛtunā devāstrayastriṃśe'mṛtā stutāḥ |
satyena revatīḥ kṣatraṃ havirindre vayo dadhuḥ ||
verses.translation: With Dew-time may the deathless Gods praised in the Thirty-three-part laud, The Revatîs, with truth give sway to Indra, sacrifice and life.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षत्स॒मिधा॒ऽग्निमि॒डस्प॒देऽश्विनेन्द्र॒ᳪ सर॑स्वतीम॒जो धू॒म्रो न गो॒धूमैः॒ कुव॑लैर्भेष॒जं मधु॒ शष्पै॒र्न तेज॑ इन्द्रि॒यं पयः॒ सोमः॑ परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॑र्यज ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatsamidhā'gnimiḍaspade'śvinendraṃ sarasvatīmajo dhūmro na godhūmaiḥ kuvalairbheṣajaṃ madhu śaṣpairna teja indriyaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar sacrifice with fuel to Agni in the place of libation, to the Asvins, Indra, Sarasvatî. A grey-coloured he-goat with wheat, jujube-fruit and sprouts of rice becomes a sweet salutary remedy, splendour, might, milk, Soma. Let them enjoy sweet butter with foaming liquor. Hotar, present offerings of butter.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒त्तनू॒नपा॒त्सर॑स्वती॒मवि॑र्मे॒षो न भे॑ष॒जं प॒था मधु॑मता॒ भर॑न्न॒श्विनेन्द्रा॑य वी॒र्यं बद॑रैरुप॒वाका॑भिर्भेष॒जं तोक्म॑भिः॒ पयः॒ सोमः॑ परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣattanūnapātsarasvatīmavirmeṣo na bheṣajaṃ pathā madhumatā bharannaśvinendrāya vīryaṃ badarairupavākābhirbheṣajaṃ tokmabhiḥ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar, Tanûnapât, worship Sarasvatî. A sheep, a ram, a salutary remedy on the honey-sweet path, bearing to the Asvins and Indra heroic strength, with jujube-fruit, Indra-grains, sprouts of rice, becomes a salutary remedy, milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc., as in verse 29.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒न्नरा॒शᳪसं॒ न न॒ग्नहुं॒ पति॒ᳪ सुर॑या भेष॒जं मे॒षः सर॑स्वती भि॒षग्रथो॒ न च॒न्द्रयश्विनो॑र्व॒पा इन्द्र॑स्य वी॒र्यं बद॑रैरुप॒वाका॑भिर्भेष॒जं तोक्म॑भिः॒ पयः॒ सोमः॑ परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣannarāśaṃsaṃ na nagnahuṃ patiṃ surayā bheṣajaṃ meṣaḥ sarasvatī bhiṣagratho na candrayaśvinorvapā indrasya vīryaṃ badarairupavākābhirbheṣajaṃ tokmabhiḥ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Narâsamsa and the Lord Nagnahu. A ram with Surâ a salutary remedy, Sarasvatî the Physician, the golden car of the Asvins, the victim's omentum, with jujube-fruit, Indra-grains, and rice-sprouts, become a salutary remedy, the manly strength of Indra, milk, Soma. Let them, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षदि॒डेडि॒त आ॒जुह्वा॑नः॒ सर॑स्वती॒मिन्द्रं॒ बले॑न व॒र्धय॑न्नृष॒भेण॒ गवे॑न्द्रि॒यम॒श्विनेन्द्रा॑य भेष॒जं यवै॑ र्क॒र्कन्धु॑भि॒र्मधु॑ लाजै॒र्न मास॑रं॒ पयः॒ सोमः॑ परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadiḍeḍita ājuhvānaḥ sarasvatīmindraṃ balena vardhayannṛṣabheṇa gavendriyamaśvinendrāya bheṣajaṃ yavai rkarkandhubhirmadhu lājairna māsaraṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar, magnified with oblations, offering sacrifice, worship Sarasvatî and Indra, increasing them with strength, with a bull and a cow. Strength and medicine to the Asvins and Indra are meath with jujube-fruit, Mâsara with parched grain, milk, Soma. Let them, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षद्ब॒र्हिरूर्ण॑म्म्रदा भि॒षङ्नास॑त्या भि॒षजा॒ऽश्विनाऽश्वा॒ शिशु॑मती भि॒षग्धे॒नुः सर॑स्वती भि॒षग्दु॒ह इन्द्रा॑य भेष॒जं पयः॒ सोमः॑ परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॑र्यज ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadbarhirūrṇammradā bhiṣaṅnāsatyā bhiṣajā'śvinā'śvā śiśumatī bhiṣagdhenuḥ sarasvatī bhiṣagduha indrāya bheṣajaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the wool-soft Altar-grass, the Physicians Nâsatyas, the Physicians Asvins. A mare with a foal, a milch-cow is a physician. Sarasvatî the Physician yields medicine to Indra, milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒द्दुरो॒ दिशः॑ कव॒ष्यो न व्यच॑स्वतीर॒श्विभ्यां॒ न दुरो॒ दिश॒ इन्द्रो॒ न रोद॑सी॒ दुघे॑ दु॒हे धे॒नुः सर॑स्वत्य॒श्विनेन्द्रा॑य भेष॒जᳪ शु॒क्रं न ज्योति॑रिन्द्रि॒यं पयः॒ सोमः॑ परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadduro diśaḥ kavaṣyo na vyacasvatīraśvibhyāṃ na duro diśa indro na rodasī dughe duhe dhenuḥ sarasvatyaśvinendrāya bheṣajaṃ śukraṃ na jyotirindriyaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the Doors, the Regions, the resounding, expansive Doors, the Regions, with the Asvins. Indra milks the two milky worlds. The Mulch-cow Sarasvatî yields medicine for the Asvins and Indra, pure light and strength. Milk, Soma. Let them, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षत्सु॒पेश॑सो॒षे नक्तं॒ दिवा॒ऽश्विना॒ सम॑ञ्जाते॒ सर॑स्वत्या॒ त्विषि॒मिन्द्रे॒ न भे॑ष॒जᳪ श्ये॒नो न रज॑सा हृ॒दा श्रि॒या न मास॑रं॒ पयः॒ सोमः॑ परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatsupeśasoṣe naktaṃ divā'śvinā samañjāte sarasvatyā tviṣimindre na bheṣajaṃ śyeno na rajasā hṛdā śriyā na māsaraṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the two fair-formed Dawns. At night and by day the Asvins with Sarasvatî compose impetuous power, like healing balm, in Indra, like a falcon, Mâsara with light, thought, and grace. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒द्दैव्या॒ होता॑रा भि॒षजा॒ऽश्विनेन्द्रं॒ न जागृ॑वि॒ दिवा॒ नक्तं॒ न भे॑ष॒जैः शूष॒ᳪ सर॑स्वती भि॒षक् सीसे॑न दुह इन्द्रि॒यं पयः॒ सोमः॑ परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣaddaivyā hotārā bhiṣajā'śvinendraṃ na jāgṛvi divā naktaṃ na bheṣajaiḥ śūṣaṃ sarasvatī bhiṣak sīsena duha indriyaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the two divine Hotars, the Physician Asvins, and Indra. Watchfully by day and night Sarasvatî as Physician, with balms, with lead, yields strength and power. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षत्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्न भे॑ष॒जं त्रय॑स्त्रि॒धात॑वो॒ऽपसो॑ रू॒पमिन्द्रे॑ हिर॒ण्यय॑म॒श्विनेडा॒ न भार॑ती वा॒चा सर॑स्वती॒ मह॒ इन्द्रा॑य दुह इन्द्रि॒यं पयः॒ सोमः॑ परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣattisro devīrna bheṣajaṃ trayastridhātavo'paso rūpamindre hiraṇyayamaśvineḍā na bhāratī vācā sarasvatī maha indrāya duha indriyaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the three Goddesses. The three active ones, with three sacrificial elements, lay balm and golden hue on Indra. The Asvins, Idâ, Bhâratî—Sarasvatî with Speech yields might and power to Indra. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षत् सु॒रेर॑समृष॒भं नर्या॑पसं॒ त्वष्टा॑र॒मिन्द्र॑म॒श्विना॑ भि॒षजं॒ न सर॑स्वती॒मोजो॒ न जू॒तिरि॑न्द्रि॒यं वृको॒ न र॑भ॒सो भि॒षग् यशः॒ सुर॑या भेष॒जᳪ श्रि॒या न मास॑रं॒ पयः॒ सोमः॑ परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣat surerasamṛṣabhaṃ naryāpasaṃ tvaṣṭāramindramaśvinā bhiṣajaṃ na sarasvatīmojo na jūtirindriyaṃ vṛko na rabhaso bhiṣag yaśaḥ surayā bheṣajaṃ śriyā na māsaraṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Tvashtar full of good seed, the Bull active for men, Indra, the Asvins, Sarasvatî the Physician. Vigour, speed, power, a fierce wolf as physician, fame with Surâ is a medicine, Mâsara with grace. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒द्वन॒स्पति॑ᳪ शमि॒तार॑ᳪ श॒तक्र॑तुं भी॒मं न म॒न्युᳪ राजा॑नं व्या॒घ्रं नम॑सा॒ऽश्विना॒ भाम॒ᳪ सर॑स्वती भि॒षगिन्द्रा॑य दुह इन्द्रि॒यं पयः॒ सोमः॑ परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadvanaspatiṃ śamitāraṃ śatakratuṃ bhīmaṃ na manyuṃ rājānaṃ vyāghraṃ namasā'śvinā bhāmaṃ sarasvatī bhiṣagindrāya duha indriyaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Vanaspatî the Immolator, the Lord of Hundred Powers, and awful Passion, the King, the Tiger, and the Asvins, with reverence. Sarasvatî the Physician yields wrath and power to Indra. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षद॒ग्निᳪ स्वाहाऽऽज्य॑स्य स्तो॒काना॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ मेद॑सां॒ पृथ॒क् स्वाहा॒ छाग॑म॒श्विभ्या॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ मे॒षᳪ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ स्वाह॑ ऋष॒भमिन्द्रा॑य सि॒ᳪहाय॒ सह॑स इन्द्रि॒यᳪ स्वाहा॒ऽग्निं न भे॑ष॒जᳪ स्वाहा॒ सोम॑मिन्द्रि॒यᳪ स्वाहेन्द्र॑ᳪ सु॒त्रामा॑ण सवि॒तारं॒ वरु॑णं भि॒षजां॒ पति॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ वन॒स्पतिं॑ प्रि॒यं पाथो॒ न भे॑ष॒जᳪ स्वाहा॑ दे॒वा आ॑ज्य॒पा जु॑षा॒णो अ॒ग्निर्भे॑ष॒जं पयः॒ सोमः॑ परि॒स्रुता॑ घृ॒तं मधु॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadagniṃ svāhā''jyasya stokānāṃ svāhā medasāṃ pṛthak svāhā chāgamaśvibhyāṃ svāhā meṣaṃ sarasvatyai svāha ṛṣabhamindrāya siṃhāya sahasa indriyaṃ svāhā'gniṃ na bheṣajaṃ svāhā somamindriyaṃ svāhendraṃ sutrāmāṇa savitāraṃ varuṇaṃ bhiṣajāṃ patiṃ svāhā vanaspatiṃ priyaṃ pātho na bheṣajaṃ svāhā devā ājyapā juṣāṇo agnirbheṣajaṃ payaḥ somaḥ parisrutā ghṛtaṃ madhu vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Agni. Of the drops of clarified butter, Svâhâ! Of the fat, omentum, etc., severally, Svâhâ! Svâhâ! the goat for the Asvins. Svâhâ! the ram for Sarasvatî. Svâhâ! the bull for Indra. To the Lion, to his might, power. Svâhâ! Agni the salutary remedy. Svâhâ! Soma, the power. Svâhâ! Indra the Good Deliverer. Savitar, Varuna Lord of Physicians. Svâhâ! Vanaspatî, beloved, food and medicine. Svâhâ! Gods who drink clarified butter. Agni accepting the medicine. Milk, Soma. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षद॒श्विनौ॒ छाग॑स्य व॒पाया॒ मेद॑सो जु॒षेता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑ ।
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्सर॑स्वतीं मे॒षस्य॑ व॒पाया॒ मेद॑सो जु॒षता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑ ।
होता॑ यक्ष॒दिन्द्र॑मृष॒भस्य॑ व॒पाया॒ मेद॑सो जु॒षता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣadaśvinau chāgasya vapāyā medaso juṣetāṃ havirhotaryaja |
hotā yakṣatsarasvatīṃ meṣasya vapāyā medaso juṣatāṃ havirhotaryaja |
hotā yakṣadindramṛṣabhasya vapāyā medaso juṣatāṃ havirhotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins with the omentum of a he-goat. Let them enjoy the fat. Hotar, offer the sacrificial oblation. Let the Hotar worship Sarasvatî with the omentum of a ram. Let her enjoy the fat. Hotar offer the sacrificial oblation. Let the Hotar worship Indra with the omentum of a bull. Let him, etc.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षद॒श्विनौ॒ सर॑स्वती॒मिन्द्र॑ᳪ सु॒त्रामा॑णमि॒मे सोमाः॑ सु॒रामा॑ण॒श्छागै॒र्न मे॒षैरृ॑षभैः सु॒ताः शष्पै॒र्न तोक्म॑भिर्ला॒जैर्मह॑स्वन्तो॒ मदा॒ मास॑रेण॒ परि॑ष्कृताः शु॒क्राः पय॑स्वन्तो॒ऽमृताः॒ प्रस्थि॑ता वो मधु॒श्चुत॒स्तान॒श्विना॒ सर॑स्व॒तीन्द्रः॑ सु॒त्रामा॑ वृत्र॒हा जु॒षन्ता॑ᳪ सो॒म्यं मधु॒ पिब॑न्तु॒ व्यन्तु॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadaśvinau sarasvatīmindraṃ sutrāmāṇamime somāḥ surāmāṇaśchāgairna meṣairṛṣabhaiḥ sutāḥ śaṣpairna tokmabhirlājairmahasvanto madā māsareṇa pariṣkṛtāḥ śukrāḥ payasvanto'mṛtāḥ prasthitā vo madhuścutastānaśvinā sarasvatīndraḥ sutrāmā vṛtrahā juṣantāṃ somyaṃ madhu pibantu vyantu hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins, Sarasvatî, Indra the Good Deliverer. These your Somas, pressed, rejoicing with goats, rams, bulls, giving pleasure with rice-shoots, young blades of corn, parched grain, joy-givers adorned with Mâsara, bright, milky, immortal, presented, dropping honey. these let the Asvins, Sarasvatî, Indra the Good Deliverer, Vritra-slayer, accept. Let them drink, rejoice in, enjoy the Soma meath. Hotar, sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षद॒श्विनौ॒ छाग॑स्य ह॒विष॒ आत्ता॑म॒द्य म॑ध्य॒तो मेद॒ उद्भृ॑तं पु॒रा द्वेषो॑भ्यः पु॒रा पौ॑रुषेय्या गृ॒भो घस्तां॑ नू॒नं घा॒से अ॑ज्राणां॒ यव॑सप्रथमानाᳪ सु॒मत्क्ष॑राणाᳪ शतरु॒द्रिया॑णामग्निष्वा॒त्तानां॒ पीवो॑पवसानां पार्श्व॒तः श्रो॑णि॒तः शि॑ताम॒त उ॑त्साद॒तोऽङ्गा॑दङ्गा॒दव॑त्तानां॒ कर॑त ए॒वाश्विना॑ जु॒षेता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadaśvinau chāgasya haviṣa āttāmadya madhyato meda udbhṛtaṃ purā dveṣobhyaḥ purā pauruṣeyyā gṛbho ghastāṃ nūnaṃ ghāse ajrāṇāṃ yavasaprathamānāṃ sumatkṣarāṇāṃ śatarudriyāṇāmagniṣvāttānāṃ pīvopavasānāṃ pārśvataḥ śroṇitaḥ śitāmata utsādato'ṅgādaṅgādavattānāṃ karata evāśvinā juṣetāṃ havirhotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship the Asvins. Let them eat of the he-goat, the sacrifice. Let them to-day eat the fat, taken from the middle, before those who hate us, before human handling. Yea, let them eat amid the fodder of fields fresh with moisture, with their expanse of barley, limbs of those tasted by Agni, belonging to the Hundred Rudras, portions covered with fat, from the sides, from the thighs, from the fore-feet from the chine. From every member of the divided victims these two make their repast. Thus let the Asvins accept. Hotar, offer the sacrificial oblation.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒त् सर॑स्वतीं मे॒षस्य॑ ह॒विष॒ आव॑यद॒द्य म॑ध्य॒तो मेद॒ उद्भृ॑तं पु॒रा द्वेषो॑भ्यः पु॒रा पौ॑रुषेय्या गृ॒भो घस॑न्नू॒नं घा॒से अ॑ज्राणां॒ यव॑सप्रथमानाᳪ सु॒मत्क्ष॑राणाᳪ शतरु॒द्रिया॑णामग्निष्वा॒त्तानां॒ पीवो॑पवसनानां पार्श्व॒तः श्रो॑णि॒तः शि॑ताम॒त उ॑त्साद॒तोऽङ्गा॑दङ्गा॒दव॑त्तानां॒ कर॑दे॒वᳪ सर॑स्वती जु॒षता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣat sarasvatīṃ meṣasya haviṣa āvayadadya madhyato meda udbhṛtaṃ purā dveṣobhyaḥ purā pauruṣeyyā gṛbho ghasannūnaṃ ghāse ajrāṇāṃ yavasaprathamānāṃ sumatkṣarāṇāṃ śatarudriyāṇāmagniṣvāttānāṃ pīvopavasanānāṃ pārśvataḥ śroṇitaḥ śitāmata utsādato'ṅgādaṅgādavattānāṃ karadevaṃ sarasvatī juṣatāṃ havirhotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Sarasvatî. Let her approach the ram, the sacrifice. To-day let her eat, etc., the rest of verse 43 repeated mutatis mutandis.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒दिन्द्र॑मृष॒भस्य॑ ह॒विष॒ आव॑यद॒द्य म॑ध्य॒तो मेद॒ उद्भृ॑तं पु॒रा द्वेषो॑भ्यः पु॒रा पौ॑रुषेय्या गृ॒भो घस॑न्नू॒नं घा॒से अ॑ज्राणां॒ यव॑सप्रथमानाᳪ सु॒मत्क्ष॑राणाᳪ शतरु॒द्रिया॑णामग्निष्वा॒त्तानां॒ पीवो॑पवसानानां पार्श्व॒तः श्रो॑णि॒तः शि॑ताम॒त उ॑त्साद॒तोऽङ्गा॑दङ्गा॒दव॑त्तानां॒ कर॑दे॒वमिन्द्रो॑ जु॒षता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadindramṛṣabhasya haviṣa āvayadadya madhyato meda udbhṛtaṃ purā dveṣobhyaḥ purā pauruṣeyyā gṛbho ghasannūnaṃ ghāse ajrāṇāṃ yavasaprathamānāṃ sumatkṣarāṇāṃ śatarudriyāṇāmagniṣvāttānāṃ pīvopavasānānāṃ pārśvataḥ śroṇitaḥ śitāmata utsādato'ṅgādaṅgādavattānāṃ karadevamindro juṣatāṃ havirhotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Indra, etc., as in 44 mutatis mutandis.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्ष॒द्वन॒स्पति॑म॒भि हि पि॒ष्टत॑मया॒ रभि॑ष्ठया रश॒नयाधि॑त । यत्रा॒श्विनो॒श्छाग॑स्य ह॒विषः॑ प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्र॒ सर॑स्वत्या मे॒षस्य॑ ह॒विषः॑ प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्रेन्द्र॑स्य ऋष॒भस्य॑ ह॒विषः॑ प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्रा॒ग्नेः प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्र॒ सोम॑स्य प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्रेन्द्र॑स्य सु॒त्राम्णः॑ प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्र॑ सवि॒तुः प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्र॒ वरु॑णस्य प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्र॒ वन॒स्पतेः॑ प्रि॒या पाथा॑ᳪसि॒ यत्र॑ दे॒वाना॑माज्य॒पानां॑ प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यत्रा॒ग्नेर्होतुः॑ प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ तत्रै॒तान्प्र॒स्तुत्ये॑वोप॒स्तुत्ये॑वो॒पाव॑स्रक्ष॒द्रभी॑यस इव कृ॒त्वी कर॑दे॒वं दे॒वो वन॒स्पति॑र्जु॒षता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadvanaspatimabhi hi piṣṭatamayā rabhiṣṭhayā raśanayādhita | yatrāśvinośchāgasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāni yatra sarasvatyā meṣasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāni yatrendrasya ṛṣabhasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmāni yatrāgneḥ priyā dhāmāni yatra somasya priyā dhāmāni yatrendrasya sutrāmṇaḥ priyā dhāmāni yatra savituḥ priyā dhāmāni yatra varuṇasya priyā dhāmāni yatra vanaspateḥ priyā pāthāṃsi yatra devānāmājyapānāṃ priyā dhāmāni yatrāgnerhotuḥ priyā dhāmāni tatraitānprastutyevopastutyevopāvasrakṣadrabhīyasa iva kṛtvī karadevaṃ devo vanaspatirjuṣatāṃ havirhotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Vanaspatî. He has held with a very well formed and very strong rope. There where the favourite stations of the Asvins are, of the he-goat the sacrifice; of Sarasvatî, of the ram the sacrifice; of Indra, of the bull the sacrifice; there where the favourite stations of Agni are, of Soma, of Indra the Good Deliverer, of Savitar, of Varuna, the favourite places of Vanaspatî, the favourite stations of Gods who drink clarified butter, and of Agni the Hotar, there let him arrange these victims when he has praised and lauded them, and perform when he has made them very strong. Let divine Vanaspatî accept. Hotar, offer oblation.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षद॒ग्निᳪ स्वि॑ष्ट॒कृत॒मया॑ड॒ग्निर॒श्विनो॒श्छाग॑स्य ह॒विषः॑ प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॒ट् सर॑स्वत्या मे॒षस्य॑ ह॒विषः॑ प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॒डिन्द्र॑स्य ऋष॒भस्य॑ ह॒विषः॑ प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॑ड॒ग्नेः प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॒ट् सोम॑स्य प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॒डिन्द्र॑स्य सु॒त्राम्णः॑ प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॑ट् सवि॒तुः प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॒ड् वरु॑णस्य प्रि॒या धामा॒न्यया॒ड् वन॒स्पतेः॑ प्रि॒या पाथा॒ᳪस्यया॑ड् दे॒वाना॑माज्य॒पानां॑ प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यक्ष॑द॒ग्नेर्होतुः॑ प्रि॒या धामा॑नि॒ यक्ष॒त् स्वं म॑हि॒मान॒माय॑जता॒मेज्या॒ इषः॑ कृ॒णोतु॒ सो अ॑ध्व॒रा जा॒तवे॑दा जु॒षता॑ᳪ ह॒विर्होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣadagniṃ sviṣṭakṛtamayāḍagniraśvinośchāgasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmānyayāṭ sarasvatyā meṣasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmānyayāḍindrasya ṛṣabhasya haviṣaḥ priyā dhāmānyayāḍagneḥ priyā dhāmānyayāṭ somasya priyā dhāmānyayāḍindrasya sutrāmṇaḥ priyā dhāmānyayāṭ savituḥ priyā dhāmānyayāḍ varuṇasya priyā dhāmānyayāḍ vanaspateḥ priyā pāthāṃsyayāḍ devānāmājyapānāṃ priyā dhāmāni yakṣadagnerhotuḥ priyā dhāmāni yakṣat svaṃ mahimānamāyajatāmejyā iṣaḥ kṛṇotu so adhvarā jātavedā juṣatāṃ havirhotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar worship Agni Svishtakrit. Let Agni worship the favourite stations of the Asvins, of the he-goat the sacrifice; of Sarasvatî, of the ram the sacrifice; of Indra, of the bull the sacrifice; there, etc., to 'butter' as in 46. Let him worship the favourite stations of Agni the Hotar. Let him worship his own majesty. Let him win for himself by sacrifice food worthy of sacrifice. Let him, Knower of Beings, perform the sacred rites. Let him accept the sacrificial food. Hotar, offer oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वं ब॒र्हिः सर॑स्वती सुदे॒वमिन्द्रे॑ अ॒श्विना॑ ।
तेजो॒ न चक्षु॑र॒क्ष्यो॒र्ब॒र्हिषा॑ दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devaṃ barhiḥ sarasvatī sudevamindre aśvinā |
tejo na cakṣurakṣyorbarhiṣā dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: The Grass divine, for the right Gods, Sarasvatî, the Asvins Twain, Give Indra splendour, with the Grass, sight of his eyes and mighty strength! For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Thou, Hotar, offer sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वीर्द्वारो॑ अ॒श्विना॑ भि॒षजेन्द्रे॒ सर॑स्वती ।
प्रा॒णं न वी॒र्यं॒ न॒सि द्वारो॑ दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devīrdvāro aśvinā bhiṣajendre sarasvatī |
prāṇaṃ na vīryaṃ nasi dvāro dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: The Doors, the Doors divine, the Two Asvins, Leeches, Sarasvatî— May they give breath to Indra in his nostrils, and heroic strength. For gain of wealth, etc., as in verse 48.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी उ॒षासा॑व॒श्विना॑ सु॒त्रामेन्द्रे॒ सर॑स्वती ।
बलं॒ न वाच॑मा॒स्य॒ उ॒षाभ्यां॑ दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devī uṣāsāvaśvinā sutrāmendre sarasvatī |
balaṃ na vācamāsya uṣābhyāṃ dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: May Dawn and Night, the Goddesses, both Asvins, and Sarasvatî Lay, with both Dawns, strength, voice within Indra the Good Deliverer's mouth. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी जोष्ट्री॒ सर॑स्वत्य॒श्विनेन्द्र॑मवर्धयन् ।
श्रोत्रं॒ न कर्ण॑यो॒र्यशो॒ जोष्ट्री॑भ्यां दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devī joṣṭrī sarasvatyaśvinendramavardhayan |
śrotraṃ na karṇayoryaśo joṣṭrībhyāṃ dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: Both nursing Goddesses, the Pair of Asvins, and Sarasvatî Have with both nurses given strength to Indra, fame, and power to hear. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी ऊ॒र्जाहु॑ती॒ दुघे॑ सु॒दुघेन्द्रे॒ सर॑स्वत्य॒श्विना॑ भि॒षजा॑ऽवतः ।
शु॒क्रं न ज्योति॒ स्तन॑यो॒राहु॑ती धत्त इन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devī ūrjāhutī dughe sudughendre sarasvatyaśvinā bhiṣajā'vataḥ |
śukraṃ na jyoti stanayorāhutī dhatta indriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, both Goddesses, well-yielding cows, Sarasvatî, both Asvins, the Physicians, these are Indra's guards. Forth from their breasts by sacrifice they give him brilliant light and power. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वा दे॒वानां॑ भि॒षजा॒ होता॑रा॒विन्द्र॑म॒श्विना॑ ।
व॒ष॒ट्का॒रैः॒ सर॑स्वती॒ त्विषिं॒ न हृद॑ये म॒तिᳪ होतृ॑भ्यां दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devā devānāṃ bhiṣajā hotārāvindramaśvinā |
vaṣaṭkāraiḥ sarasvatī tviṣiṃ na hṛdaye matiṃ hotṛbhyāṃ dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: Both Gods, the Hotars of the Gods, the Asvins the Physicians and Sarasvatî with Vashat-calls, with the two Hotars have bestowed on Indra brilliant light and power, and planted wisdom in his heart. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वीस्ति॒स्रस्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर॒श्विनेडा॒ सर॑स्वती ।
शूषं॒ न मध्ये॒ नाभ्या॒मिन्द्रा॑य दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devīstisrastisro devīraśvineḍā sarasvatī |
śūṣaṃ na madhye nābhyāmindrāya dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: Goddesses three, three Goddesses—Asvins, Idâ, Sarasvatî In Indra's midmost navel have laid store of energy and power. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒व इन्द्रो॒ नरा॒शᳪस॑स्त्रिवरू॒थः सर॑स्वत्य॒श्विभ्या॑मीयते॒ रथः॑ ।
रेतो॒ न रू॒पम॒मृतं॑ ज॒नित्र॒मिन्द्रा॑य॒ त्वष्टा॒ दध॑दिन्द्रि॒याणि॑ वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
deva indro narāśaṃsastrivarūthaḥ sarasvatyaśvibhyāmīyate rathaḥ |
reto na rūpamamṛtaṃ janitramindrāya tvaṣṭā dadhadindriyāṇi vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: God Narâsamsa, Indra thrice-protecting, whose car moves by Sarasvatî and Asvins May Tvashtar lay seed, deathless form in Indra, a fitting place of birth and mighty powers. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वो दे॒वैर्वन॒स्पति॒र्हिर॑ण्यपर्णो अ॒श्विभ्या॒ᳪ सर॑स्वत्या सुपिप्प॒ल इन्द्रा॑य पच्यते॒ मधु॑ ।
ओजो॒ न जू॒तिरृ॑ष॒भो न भामं॒ वन॒स्पति॑र्नो॒ दध॑दिन्द्रि॒याणि॑ वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devo devairvanaspatirhiraṇyaparṇo aśvibhyāṃ sarasvatyā supippala indrāya pacyate madhu |
ojo na jūtirṛṣabho na bhāmaṃ vanaspatirno dadhadindriyāṇi vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: God with the Gods, Vanaspatî of golden leaves and goodly fruit Ripens till Indra finds it sweet, with Asvins and Sarasvatî.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वं ब॒र्हिर्वारि॑तीनामध्व॒रे स्ती॒र्णम॒श्विभ्या॒मूर्ण॑म्रदाः॒ सर॑स्वत्या स्यो॒नमि॑न्द्र ते॒ सदः॑ ।
ई॒शायै॑ म॒न्युᳪ राजा॑नं ब॒र्हिषा॑ दधुरिन्द्रि॒यं व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devaṃ barhirvāritīnāmadhvare stīrṇamaśvibhyāmūrṇamradāḥ sarasvatyā syonamindra te sadaḥ |
īśāyai manyuṃ rājānaṃ barhiṣā dadhurindriyaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: Strewn, soft as wool, in sacrifice, with Asvins and Sarasvatî, The sacred robe of water-plants be, Indra, a fair seat for thee! Together with the sacred grass limy they, for sovranty, bestow King Passion and great power on thee. For gain of wealth, etc.

verses.sanskrit: दे॒वो अ॒ग्निः स्वि॑ष्ट॒कृद्दे॒वान्य॑क्षद्यथाय॒थᳪ होता॑रा॒विन्द्र॑म॒श्विना॑ वा॒चा वाच॒ᳪ सर॑स्वतीम॒ग्निᳪ सोम॑ᳪ स्विष्ट॒कृत् स्वि॑ष्ट॒ इन्द्रः॑ सु॒त्रामा॑ सवि॒ता वरु॑णो भि॒षगि॒ष्टो दे॒वो वन॒स्पतिः॒ स्वि॒ष्टा दे॒वा आ॑ज्य॒पाः स्वि॑ष्टो अ॒ग्निर॒ग्निना॒ होता॑ हो॒त्रे स्वि॑ष्ट॒कृद्यशो॒ न दध॑दिन्द्रि॒यमूर्ज॒मप॑चितिᳪ स्व॒धां व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛddevānyakṣadyathāyathaṃ hotārāvindramaśvinā vācā vācaṃ sarasvatīmagniṃ somaṃ sviṣṭakṛt sviṣṭa indraḥ sutrāmā savitā varuṇo bhiṣagiṣṭo devo vanaspatiḥ sviṣṭā devā ājyapāḥ sviṣṭo agniragninā hotā hotre sviṣṭakṛdyaśo na dadhadindriyamūrjamapacitiṃ svadhāṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: Let the God Agni Svishtakrit worship the Gods as is meet and right for each, the two Hotars, Indra, the Asvins, Vâk with speech, Sarasvatî, Agni, Soma. Svishtakrit has been well worshipped, Indra Good Deliverer, Savitar, Varuna the Physician have been worshipped. The God Vanaspatî, the Gods who drink clarified butter have been well worshipped, Agni by Agni. Let the Hotar Svishtakrit give the Hotar fame, great power, energy, honour, Ancestral libation.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निम॒द्य होता॑रमवृणीता॒यं यज॑मानः॒ पच॒न् पक्तीः॒ पच॑न् पुरो॒डाशा॑न् ब॒ध्नन्न॒श्विभ्यां॒ छाग॒ᳪ सर॑स्वत्यै मे॒षमिन्द्रा॑य ऋष॒भᳪ सु॒न्वन्न॒श्विभ्या॒ᳪ सर॑स्वत्या॒ इन्द्रा॑य सु॒त्राम्णे॑ सुरासो॒मान् ॥
verses.transliteration: agnimadya hotāramavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamānaḥ pacan paktīḥ pacan puroḍāśān badhnannaśvibhyāṃ chāgaṃ sarasvatyai meṣamindrāya ṛṣabhaṃ sunvannaśvibhyāṃ sarasvatyā indrāya sutrāmṇe surāsomān ||
verses.translation: To-day this Sacrificer cooking viands, cooking sacrificial rice-cakes, binding a goat for the Asvins, a ram for Sarasvatî, a hull for Indra, pressing Surâ and Soma juices for the Asvins, Sarasvatî, and Indra the Good Deliverer, has chosen Agni as Hotar.

verses.sanskrit: सू॒प॒स्था अ॒द्य दे॒वो वन॒स्पति॑रभवद॒श्विभ्यां॒ छागे॑न॒ सर॑स्वत्यै मे॒षेणेन्द्रा॑य ऋष॒भेणाक्षँ॒स्तान् मे॑द॒स्तः प्रति॑ पच॒तागृ॑भीष॒तावी॑वृधन्त पुरो॒डाशै॒रपु॑र॒श्विना॒ सर॑स्व॒तीन्द्रः॑ सु॒त्रामा॑ सुरासो॒मान् ॥
verses.transliteration: sūpasthā adya devo vanaspatirabhavadaśvibhyāṃ chāgena sarasvatyai meṣeṇendrāya ṛṣabheṇākṣam̐stān medastaḥ prati pacatāgṛbhīṣatāvīvṛdhanta puroḍāśairapuraśvinā sarasvatīndraḥ sutrāmā surāsomān ||
verses.translation: To-day the divine Vanaspatî has done good service to the Asvins with a goat, to Sarasvatî with a ram, to Indra with a bull. They have eaten these from the marrow onwards, they have accepted the cooked viands, they have waxed strong with the rice-cakes. The Agnis, Sarasvatî, and Indra have drunk the Surâ and Soma draughts.

verses.sanskrit: त्वाम॒द्य ऋ॑ष आर्षेय ऋषीणां नपादवृणीता॒यं यज॑मानो ब॒हुभ्य॒ आ सङ्ग॑तेभ्य ए॒ष मे॑ दे॒वेषु॒ वसु॒ वार्याय॑क्ष्यत॒ इति॒ ता या दे॒वा दे॑व॒ दाना॒न्यदु॒स्तान्य॑स्मा॒ आ च॒ शास्वा च॑ गुरस्वेषि॒तश्च॑ होत॒रसि॑ भद्र॒वाच्या॑य॒ प्रेषि॑तो॒ मानु॑षः सूक्तवा॒काय॑ सू॒क्ता ब्रू॑हि ॥
verses.transliteration: tvāmadya ṛṣa ārṣeya ṛṣīṇāṃ napādavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamāno bahubhya ā saṅgatebhya eṣa me deveṣu vasu vāryāyakṣyata iti tā yā devā deva dānānyadustānyasmā ā ca śāsvā ca gurasveṣitaśca hotarasi bhadravācyāya preṣito mānuṣaḥ sūktavākāya sūktā brūhi ||
verses.translation: Thee, to-day, O Rishi, Rishi's son, descendant of Rishis, hath this Sacrificer chosen for many collected, saying: This (Agni) shall win by sacrifice for me choice-worthy treasures among the Gods. O God, what gifts the Gods have given, these do thou desire and approve. And thou art a commissioned Hotar, a human Hotar sent forward for benediction, for good speech, Speak thou good words.

verses.sanskrit:
तेजो॑ऽसि शु॒क्रम॒मृत॑मायु॒ष्पा आयु॑र्मे पाहि ।
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्या॒मा द॑दे ॥
verses.transliteration:
tejo'si śukramamṛtamāyuṣpā āyurme pāhi |
devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyāmā dade ||
verses.translation: Splendour art thou, bright, deathless, life-protector. Protector of my life be thou. By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the hands of Pûshan.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒माम॑गृभ्णन् रश॒नामृ॒तस्य॒ पूर्व॒ आयु॑षि वि॒दथे॑षु क॒व्या ।
सा नो॑ अ॒स्मिन्त्सु॒त आ ब॑भूव ऋ॒तस्य॒ साम॑न्त्स॒रमा॒रप॑न्ती ॥
verses.transliteration:
imāmagṛbhṇan raśanāmṛtasya pūrva āyuṣi vidatheṣu kavyā |
sā no asmintsuta ā babhūva ṛtasya sāmantsaramārapantī ||
verses.translation: This girdle, which in their religious meetings sages assumed in earlier time of worship, Is present with us here at this libation, in the Law's hymn, proclaiming rich abundance.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि॒धा अ॑सि॒ भुव॑नमसि य॒न्ताऽसि॑ ध॒र्ता ।
स त्वम॒ग्निं वै॑श्वान॒रᳪ सप्र॑थसं गच्छ॒ स्वाहा॑कृतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhidhā asi bhuvanamasi yantā'si dhartā |
sa tvamagniṃ vaiśvānaraṃ saprathasaṃ gaccha svāhākṛtaḥ ||
verses.translation: Famous art thou, thou art the world, controller and upholder thou. Go, consecrate by Svâhâ to Agni Vaisvânara widely-famed.

verses.sanskrit:
स्व॒गा त्वा॑ दे॒वेभ्यः॑ प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ ब्रह्म॒न्नश्वं॑ भ॒न्त्स्यामि॑ दे॒वेभ्यः॑ प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ तेन॑ राध्यासम् ।
तं ब॑धान दे॒वेभ्यः॑ प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ तेन॑ राध्नुहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
svagā tvā devebhyaḥ prajāpataye brahmannaśvaṃ bhantsyāmi devebhyaḥ prajāpataye tena rādhyāsam |
taṃ badhāna devebhyaḥ prajāpataye tena rādhnuhi ||
verses.translation: For Gods and for Prajâpati I fit thee. For Gods and for Prajâpati, O Brahman, Will I tie up the horse. Thence may I prosper! Binding him for Prajâpati and Gods be thou successful.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जाप॑तये त्वा॒ जुष्टं॒ प्रोक्षा॑मीन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ जुष्टं॒ प्रोक्षा॑मि वा॒यवे॑ त्वा॒ जुष्टं॒ प्रोक्षा॑मि॒
विश्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्यो॒ जुष्टं॒ प्रोक्षा॑मि॒ सर्वे॑भ्यस्त्वा दे॒वेभ्यो॒ जुष्टं॒ प्रोक्षा॑मि ।
यो अर्व॑न्तं॒ जिघा॑ᳪसति॒ तम॒भ्य॒मीति॒ वरु॑णः । प॒रो मर्तः॑ प॒रः श्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmīndrāgnibhyāṃ tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi vāyave tvā juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi
viśvebhyastvā devebhyo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi sarvebhyastvā devebhyo juṣṭaṃ prokṣāmi |
yo arvantaṃ jighāṃsati tamabhyamīti varuṇaḥ | paro martaḥ paraḥ śvā ||
verses.translation: Thee welcome to Prajâpati I sprinkle. I sprinkle thee welcome to Indra-Agni. I sprinkle thee acceptable to Vâyu. Thee welcome to the All-Gods I besprinkle. Thee welcome to all Deities I sprinkle. With fury Varuna attacks the man who fain would slay the steed. Avaunt the man! Avaunt the dog!

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नये॒ स्वाहा॒ सोमा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒ ऽपां मोदा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ सवि॒त्रे स्वाहा॑ वा॒यवे॒ स्वाहा॒ विष्ण॑वे॒ स्वाहेन्द्रा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒ बृह॒स्पत॑ये॒ स्वाहा॑ मि॒त्राय॒ स्वाहा॒ वरु॑णाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: agnaye svāhā somāya svāhā 'pāṃ modāya svāhā savitre svāhā vāyave svāhā viṣṇave svāhendrāya svāhā bṛhaspataye svāhā mitrāya svāhā varuṇāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: To Agni Hail! To Soma Hail! Hail to the Waters Joy! Hail to Savitar! Hail to Vâyu! Hail to Vishnu! Hail to Indra! Hail to Brihaspati! Hail to Mitra! Hail to Varuna!

verses.sanskrit: हि॒ङ्का॒राय॒ स्वाहा॒ हिङ्कृ॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ क्रन्द॑ते॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽवक्र॒न्दाय॒ स्वाहा॒ प्रोथ॑ते॒ स्वाहा॑ प्रप्रो॒थाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ग॒न्धाय॒ स्वाहा॑ घ्रा॒ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ निवि॑ष्टाय॒ स्वाहोप॑विष्टाय॒ स्वाहा॒ सन्दि॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ वल्ग॑ते॒ स्वाहा ऽऽसी॑नाय॒ स्वाहा॑ शया॑नाय॒ स्वाहा॒ स्वप॑ते॒ स्वाहा॒ जाग्र॑ते॒ स्वाहा॒ कूज॑ते॒ स्वाहा॒ प्रबु॑द्धाय॒ स्वाहा॑ वि॒जृम्भ॑माणाय॒ स्वाहा॒ विचृ॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ सᳪहा॑नाय॒ स्वाहोप॑स्थिताय॒ स्वाहाऽऽय॑नाय॒ स्वाहा॒ प्राय॑णाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hiṅkārāya svāhā hiṅkṛtāya svāhā krandate svāhā 'vakrandāya svāhā prothate svāhā praprothāya svāhā gandhāya svāhā ghrātāya svāhā niviṣṭāya svāhopaviṣṭāya svāhā sanditāya svāhā valgate svāhā ''sīnāya svāhā śayānāya svāhā svapate svāhā jāgrate svāhā kūjate svāhā prabuddhāya svāhā vijṛmbhamāṇāya svāhā vicṛtāya svāhā saṃhānāya svāhopasthitāya svāhā''yanāya svāhā prāyaṇāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to the sound hiṅ! Hail to the uttered hiṅ! Hail to the neigh! Hail to the down-neigh! Hail to the snort! Hail to the roar! Hail to his smell! Hail to him smelt at! Hail to him seated! Hail to him seated down! Hail to him weary! Hail to him going! Hail to him sitting! Hail to him lying! Hail to him sleeping! Hail to him waking! Hail to him whinnying! Hail to him wakened! Hail to him yawning! Hail to him outstretched! Hail to him drawn together! Hail to him risen! Hail to his going! Hail to his good going! Hail!

verses.sanskrit: य॒ते स्वाहा॒ धाव॑ते॒ स्वाहो॑द्द्रा॒वाय॒ स्वाहोद्द्रु॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॑ शूका॒राय॒ स्वाहा॒ शूकृ॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ निष॑ण्णाय॒ स्वाहोत्थि॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॑ ज॒वाय॒ स्वाहा॒ बला॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ वि॒वर्त॑मानाय॒ स्वाहा॒ विवृ॑त्ताय॒ स्वाहा॑ विधून्वा॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॒ विधू॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ शुश्रू॑षमाणाय॒ स्वाहा॑ शृण्व॒ते स्वाहेक्ष॑माणाय॒ स्वाहे॑क्षि॒ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ वी॒क्षिताय॒ स्वाहा॑ निमे॒षाय॒ स्वाहा॒ यदत्ति॒ तस्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ यत् पिब॑ति॒ तस्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ यन्मूत्रं॑ क॒रोति॒ तस्मै॒ स्वाहा॑ कुर्व॒ते स्वाहा॑ कृ॒ताय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yate svāhā dhāvate svāhoddrāvāya svāhoddrutāya svāhā śūkārāya svāhā śūkṛtāya svāhā niṣaṇṇāya svāhotthitāya svāhā javāya svāhā balāya svāhā vivartamānāya svāhā vivṛttāya svāhā vidhūnvānāya svāhā vidhūtāya svāhā śuśrūṣamāṇāya svāhā śṛṇvate svāhekṣamāṇāya svāhekṣitāya svāhā vīkṣitāya svāhā nimeṣāya svāhā yadatti tasmai svāhā yat pibati tasmai svāhā yanmūtraṃ karoti tasmai svāhā kurvate svāhā kṛtāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to him as he goes! Hail to him running! Hail to him running away! Hail to him when he has run away! Hail to the cry Shoo! Hail to him scared with Shoo! Hail to him seated! Hail to him risen! Hail to his speed! Hail to his strength! Hail to him rolling! Hail to him when he has rolled! Hail to him tossing about! Hail to him when he has tossed about! Hail to him listening! Hail to him hearing. Hail to him looking! Hail to him looked at! Hail to him closely looked at! Hail to his closing his eye! Hail to his food! Hail to his drink! Hail to his stale! Hail to him in action! Hail to what he has done!

verses.sanskrit: तत्स॑वि॒तुर्वरे॑ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि । धियो॒ यो नः॑ प्रचो॒दया॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration: tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
verses.translation: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers.

verses.sanskrit: हिर॑ण्यपाणिमू॒तये॑ सवि॒तार॒मुप॑ ह्वये । स चेत्ता॑ दे॒वता॑ प॒दम् ॥
verses.transliteration: hiraṇyapāṇimūtaye savitāramupa hvaye | sa cettā devatā padam ||
verses.translation: For our protection I invoke the golden-handed Savitar: He knoweth, as a God, the place.

verses.sanskrit: दे॒वस्य॒ चेत॑तो म॒हीं प्र स॑वि॒तुर्ह॑वामहे । सु॒म॒तिᳪ स॒त्यरा॑धसम् ॥
verses.transliteration: devasya cetato mahīṃ pra saviturhavāmahe | sumatiṃ satyarādhasam ||
verses.translation: We specially invoke the grace of Savitar, observant God, The great good-will that gives true boons.

verses.sanskrit: सु॒ष्टु॒तिᳪ सु॑मती॒वृधो॑ रा॒तिᳪ स॑वि॒तुरी॑महे । प्र दे॒वाय॑ मती॒विदे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: suṣṭutiṃ sumatīvṛdho rātiṃ saviturīmahe | pra devāya matīvide ||
verses.translation: We seek the eulogy and gift of Savitar who strengthens grace, Yea, of the God who knows our thoughts.

verses.sanskrit: रा॒तिᳪ सत्प॑तिं म॒हे स॑वि॒तार॒मुप॑ ह्वये । आ॒स॒वं दे॒ववी॑तये ॥
verses.transliteration: rātiṃ satpatiṃ mahe savitāramupa hvaye | āsavaṃ devavītaye ||
verses.translation: I invocate the heroes Lord, free-giving Savitar, and call The Cheerer to the feast of Gods.

verses.sanskrit: दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुर्म॒तिमा॑स॒वं वि॒श्वदे॑व्यम् । धि॒या भगं॑ मनामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: devasya saviturmatimāsavaṃ viśvadevyam | dhiyā bhagaṃ manāmahe ||
verses.translation: The judgment of bright Savitar, that cheers the All-Gods company, With prayer we estimate as bliss.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निᳪ स्तोमे॑न बोधय समिधा॒नो अम॑र्त्यम् । ह॒व्या दे॒वेषु॑ नो दधत् ॥
verses.transliteration: agniṃ stomena bodhaya samidhāno amartyam | havyā deveṣu no dadhat ||
verses.translation: Wake Agni with thy laud and set the Immortal One aflame, let him Bestow our offerings on the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: स ह॑व्य॒वाडम॑र्त्य उ॒शिग्दू॒तश्चनो॑हितः । अ॒ग्निर्धि॒या समृ॑ण्वति ॥
verses.transliteration: sa havyavāḍamartya uśigdūtaścanohitaḥ | agnirdhiyā samṛṇvati ||
verses.translation: Oblation-bearer, well-inclined, immortal, eager Messenger, Agni comes near us with the thought.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निं दू॒तं पु॒रो द॑धे हव्य॒वाह॒मुप॑ ब्रुवे । दे॒वाँ२ आ सा॑दयादि॒ह ॥
verses.transliteration: agniṃ dūtaṃ puro dadhe havyavāhamupa bruve | devām̐ ā sādayādiha ||
verses.translation: Agni, Envoy, I place in front, the oblation-bearer I address: Here let him seat the Deities.

verses.sanskrit: अजी॑जनो॒ हि प॑वमान॒ सूर्यं॑ वि॒धारे॒ शक्म॑ना॒ पयः॑ । गोजी॑रया॒ रᳪह॑माणः॒ पुर॑न्ध्या ॥
verses.transliteration: ajījano hi pavamāna sūryaṃ vidhāre śakmanā payaḥ | gojīrayā raṃhamāṇaḥ purandhyā ||
verses.translation: Yea, Pavamâna, thou didst generate the Sun and spread the moisture out with power, Basting to us with plenty vivified with milk.

verses.sanskrit: वि॒भूर्मा॒त्रा प्र॒भूः पि॒त्राऽश्वो॑ऽसि॒ हयो॒ऽस्यत्यो॑ऽसि॒ मयो॒ऽस्यर्वा॑ऽसि॒ सप्ति॑रसि वा॒ज्य॒सि॒ वृषा॑ऽसि नृ॒मणा॑ असि । ययु॒र्नामा॑ऽसि॒ शिशु॒र्नामा॑स्यादि॒त्यानां॒ पत्वाऽन्वि॑हि॒ देवा॑ आशापाला ए॒तं दे॒वेभ्योऽश्वं॒ मेधा॑य॒ प्रोक्षि॑तᳪ रक्षते॒ह रन्ति॑ रि॒ह र॑मतामि॒ह धृति॑रि॒ह स्वधृ॑तिः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vibhūrmātrā prabhūḥ pitrā'śvo'si hayo'syatyo'si mayo'syarvā'si saptirasi vājyasi vṛṣā'si nṛmaṇā asi | yayurnāmā'si śiśurnāmāsyādityānāṃ patvā'nvihi devā āśāpālā etaṃ devebhyo'śvaṃ medhāya prokṣitaṃ rakṣateha ranti riha ramatāmiha dhṛtiriha svadhṛtiḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Mighty through thy dam, eminent through thy sire, thou art a horse, thou art a steed, thou art a courser, thou art a comfort, thou art a racer, thou art a yoke-horse, thou art a strong steed, thou art a stallion, thou art manly-minded. Thou art called Yayu, thou art called Sisu. Follow thou the flight of the Âdityas. Gods, Warders of the Regions, protect for the Gods this horse besprinkled for sacrifice. Here is delight. Here take thy pleasure. Here is content. Here is self-content.

verses.sanskrit: काय॒ स्वाहा॒ कस्मै॒ स्वाहा॑ कत॒मस्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ स्वाहा॒ऽऽधिमाधी॑ताय॒ स्वाहा॒ मनः॑ प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ स्वाहा॑ चि॒त्तं विज्ञा॑ता॒यादि॑त्यै॒ स्वाहा ऽदि॑त्यै मह्यै॒ स्वाहा ऽदि॑त्यै सुमृडी॒कायै॒ स्वाहा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै॒ स्वाहा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै पाव॒कायै॒ स्वाहा॒ सर॑स्वत्यै बृहत्यै॒ स्वाहा॑ पू॒ष्णे स्वाहा॑ पू॒ष्णे प्र॑प॒थ्या॒य॒ स्वाहा॑ पू॒ष्णे न॒रन्धि॑षाय॒ स्वाहा॒ त्वष्ट्रे॒ स्वाहा॒ त्वष्ट्रे॑ तु॒रीपा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒ त्वष्ट्रे॑ पुरु॒रूपा॑य॒ स्वाहा॒ विष्ण॑वे॒ स्वाहा॒ विष्ण॑वे निभूय॒पाय॒ स्वाहा॒ विष्ण॑वे शिपिवि॒ष्टाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
