verses.transliteration: kāya svāhā kasmai svāhā katamasmai svāhā svāhā''dhimādhītāya svāhā manaḥ prajāpataye svāhā cittaṃ vijñātāyādityai svāhā 'dityai mahyai svāhā 'dityai sumṛḍīkāyai svāhā sarasvatyai svāhā sarasvatyai pāvakāyai svāhā sarasvatyai bṛhatyai svāhā pūṣṇe svāhā pūṣṇe prapathyāya svāhā pūṣṇe narandhiṣāya svāhā tvaṣṭre svāhā tvaṣṭre turīpāya svāhā tvaṣṭre pururūpāya svāhā viṣṇave svāhā viṣṇave nibhūyapāya svāhā viṣṇave śipiviṣṭāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to Ka! Hail to Who?! Hail to Which?! Hail to him who has experienced pain! Hail to Prajâpati who knows the mind! Hail to him who discerns the thought! Hail to Aditi! Hail to good Aditi! Hail to gracious Aditi! Hail to Sarasvatî! Hail to purifying Sarasvatî! Hail to great Sarasvatî! Hail to Pûshan! Hail to Pûshan of the highways! Hail to Pûshan observer of men! Hail to Tvashtar! Hail to swift Tvashtar! Hail to Tvashtar of many forms! Hail to Vishnu! Hail to Vishnu Nibhûyapa! Hail to Vishnu Sipivishta!

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ ने॒तुर्मर्तो॑ वुरीत स॒ख्यम् ।
विश्वो॑ रा॒य इ॑षुध्यति द्यु॒म्नं वृ॑णीत पु॒ष्यसे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvo devasya neturmarto vurīta sakhyam |
viśvo rāya iṣudhyati dyumnaṃ vṛṇīta puṣyase svāhā ||
verses.translation: Let every mortal man elect, etc., repeated from IV. 8.

verses.sanskrit: आ ब्रह्म॑न् ब्राह्म॒णो ब्र॑ह्मवर्च॒सी जा॑यता॒मा रा॒ष्ट्रे रा॑ज॒न्यः शूर॑ इष॒व्योऽतिव्या॒धी म॑हार॒थो जा॑यतां॒ दोग्ध्री॑ धे॒नुर्वोढा॑न॒ड्वाना॒शुः सप्तिः॒ पुर॑न्धि॒र्योषा॑ जि॒ष्णू र॑थे॒ष्ठाः स॒भेयो॒ युवास्य यज॑मानस्य वी॒रो जा॑यतां॒ निका॒मे-नि॑कामे नः प॒र्जन्यो॑ वर्षतु॒ फल॑वत्यो न॒ ओष॑धयः पच्यन्तां योगक्षे॒मो नः॑ कल्पताम् ॥
verses.transliteration: ā brahman brāhmaṇo brahmavarcasī jāyatāmā rāṣṭre rājanyaḥ śūra iṣavyo'tivyādhī mahāratho jāyatāṃ dogdhrī dhenurvoḍhānaḍvānāśuḥ saptiḥ purandhiryoṣā jiṣṇū ratheṣṭhāḥ sabheyo yuvāsya yajamānasya vīro jāyatāṃ nikāme-nikāme naḥ parjanyo varṣatu phalavatyo na oṣadhayaḥ pacyantāṃ yogakṣemo naḥ kalpatām ||
verses.translation: O Brahman, let there be born in the kingdom the Brahman illustrious for religious knowledge; let there be born the Râjanya, heroic, skilled archer, piercing with shafts, mighty warrior; the cow giving abundant milk; the ox good at carrying; the swift courser; the industrious woman. May Parjanya send rain according to our desire; may our fruit-bearing plants ripen; may acquisition and preservation of property be secured to us.

verses.sanskrit: प्रा॒णाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽपा॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॑ व्या॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॒ चक्षु॑षे॒ स्वाहा॒ श्रोत्रा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ वा॒चे स्वाहा॒ मन॑से॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: prāṇāya svāhā 'pānāya svāhā vyānāya svāhā cakṣuṣe svāhā śrotrāya svāhā vāce svāhā manase svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to vital breath! Hail to out-breathing! Hail to diffusive breath! Hail to the eye! Hail to the ear! Hail to Speech! Hail to Mind!

verses.sanskrit: प्राच्यै॑ दि॒शे स्वाहा॒ ऽर्वाच्यै॑ दि॒शे स्वाहा॒ दक्षि॑णायै दि॒शे स्वाहा॒ ऽर्वाच्यै॑ दि॒शे स्वाहा॑ प्र॒तीच्यै॑ दि॒शे स्वाहा॒ ऽर्वाच्यै॑ दि॒शे स्वाहोदी॑च्यै दि॒शे स्वाहा॒ ऽर्वाच्यै॑ दि॒शे स्वाहो॒र्ध्वायै॑ दि॒शे स्वाहा॒ ऽर्वाच्यै॑ दि॒शे स्वाहा ऽवा॑च्यै दि॒शे स्वाहा॒ ऽर्वाच्यै॑ दि॒शे स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: prācyai diśe svāhā 'rvācyai diśe svāhā dakṣiṇāyai diśe svāhā 'rvācyai diśe svāhā pratīcyai diśe svāhā 'rvācyai diśe svāhodīcyai diśe svāhā 'rvācyai diśe svāhordhvāyai diśe svāhā 'rvācyai diśe svāhā 'vācyai diśe svāhā 'rvācyai diśe svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to the Eastern Region! Hail to the hitherward Region! Hail to the Southern Region! Hail to the hitherward Region! Hail to the Western Region! Hail to the hitherward Region! Hail to the Northern Region! Hail to the hitherward Region! Hail to the Upward Region! Hail to the hitherward Region! Hail to the Downward Region! Hail to the hitherward Region!

verses.sanskrit: अ॒द्भ्यः स्वाहा॑ वा॒र्भ्यः स्वाहो॑द॒काय॒ स्वाहा॒ तिष्ठ॑न्तीभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ स्रव॑न्तीभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ स्यन्द॑मानाभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ कूप्या॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ सूद्या॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ धार्या॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽर्ण॒वाय॒ स्वाहा॑ समु॒द्राय॒ स्वाहा॑ सरि॒राय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: adbhyaḥ svāhā vārbhyaḥ svāhodakāya svāhā tiṣṭhantībhyaḥ svāhā sravantībhyaḥ svāhā syandamānābhyaḥ svāhā kūpyābhyaḥ svāhā sūdyābhyaḥ svāhā dhāryābhyaḥ svāhā 'rṇavāya svāhā samudrāya svāhā sarirāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to waters! Hail to floods! Hail to water! Hail to standing waters! flail to flowing waters! Hail to trickling waters! Hail to well waters! Hail to spring waters! Hail to the foaming sea! Hail to the ocean! Hail to the deep!

verses.sanskrit: वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ धू॒माय॒ स्वाहा॒ ऽभ्राय॒ स्वाहा॑ मे॒घाय॒ स्वाहा॑ वि॒द्योत॑मानाय॒ स्वाहा॑ स्त॒नय॑ते॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽव॒स्फूर्ज॑ते॒ स्वाहा॒ वर्ष॑ते॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽव॒वर्ष॑ते॒ स्वाहो॒ग्रं वर्ष॑ते॒ स्वाहा॑ शी॒घ्रं वर्ष॑ते॒ स्वाहो॑द्गृह्ण॒ते स्वाहोद्गृ॑हीताय॒ स्वाहा॑ प्रुष्ण॒ते स्वाहा॑ शीकाय॒ते स्वाहा॒ प्रुष्वा॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ह्रा॒दुनी॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ नीहा॒राय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vātāya svāhā dhūmāya svāhā 'bhrāya svāhā meghāya svāhā vidyotamānāya svāhā stanayate svāhā 'vasphūrjate svāhā varṣate svāhā 'vavarṣate svāhograṃ varṣate svāhā śīghraṃ varṣate svāhodgṛhṇate svāhodgṛhītāya svāhā pruṣṇate svāhā śīkāyate svāhā pruṣvābhyaḥ svāhā hrādunībhyaḥ svāhā nīhārāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to wind! Hail to mist! Hail to vapour! Hail to cloud! Hail to cloud lightening! Hail to cloud thundering! Hail to it bursting! Hail to it raining! Hail to it pouring! Hail to it violently raining! Hail to it swiftly raining! Hail to it holding up! Hail to it when it has held up! Hail to it sprinkling! Hail to it drizzling! Hail to its drops! Hail to thunderbolts! Hail to hoar frosts!

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नये॒ स्वाहा॒ सोमा॑य॒ स्वाहेन्द्रा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ पृथिव्यै॒ स्वाहा॒ ऽन्तरि॑क्षाय॒ स्वाहा॑ दि॒वे स्वाहा॑ दि॒ग्भ्यः स्वाहा ऽऽशा॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहो॒र्व्यै॒ दि॒शे स्वाहा॒ ऽर्वाच्यै॑ दि॒शे स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: agnaye svāhā somāya svāhendrāya svāhā pṛthivyai svāhā 'ntarikṣāya svāhā dive svāhā digbhyaḥ svāhā ''śābhyaḥ svāhorvyai diśe svāhā 'rvācyai diśe svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to Agni! Hail to Soma! Hail to Indra! Hail to Earth! Hail to Firmament! Hail to Sky! Hail to Regions? Hail to Quarters! Hail to the Upward Region! Hail to the Downward Region!

verses.sanskrit: नक्ष॑त्रेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ नक्ष॒त्रिये॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽहोरा॒त्रेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽर्धमा॒सेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ मासे॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ऋ॒तुभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽऽर्त॒वेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ संवत्स॒राय॒ स्वाहा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्या॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ च॒न्द्राय॒ स्वाहा॒ सूर्या॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ र॒श्मिभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ वसु॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ रु॒द्रेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽऽदि॒त्येभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ म॒रुद्भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ विश्वे॑भ्यो दे॒वेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ मूले॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ शाखा॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ वन॒स्पति॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ पुष्पे॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ फले॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहौष॑धीभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: nakṣatrebhyaḥ svāhā nakṣatriyebhyaḥ svāhā 'horātrebhyaḥ svāhā 'rdhamāsebhyaḥ svāhā māsebhyaḥ svāhā ṛtubhyaḥ svāhā ''rtavebhyaḥ svāhā saṃvatsarāya svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ svāhā candrāya svāhā sūryāya svāhā raśmibhyaḥ svāhā vasubhyaḥ svāhā rudrebhyaḥ svāhā ''dityebhyaḥ svāhā marudbhyaḥ svāhā viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ svāhā mūlebhyaḥ svāhā śākhābhyaḥ svāhā vanaspatibhyaḥ svāhā puṣpebhyaḥ svāhā phalebhyaḥ svāhauṣadhībhyaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to the lunar asterisms! Hail to those connected with the lunar asterisms! Hail to Day and Night! Hail to the half-months! Hail to the mouths! Hail to the Seasons! Hail to the Season-groups! Hail to the Year! Hail to Heaven and Earth! Hail to the Moon! Hail to the Sun! Hail to his rays! Hail to the Vasus! Hail to the Rudras! Hail to the Âdityas! Hail to the Maruts! Earl to the All-Gods! Hail to roots! Hail to branches! Hail to forest trees! Hail to flowers! Hail to fruits! Hail to herbs!

verses.sanskrit: पृ॒थि॒व्यै स्वाहा॒ ऽन्तरि॑क्षाय॒ स्वाहा॑ दि॒वे स्वाहा॒ सूर्या॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ च॒न्द्राय॒ स्वाहा॒ नक्ष॑त्रेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ ऽद्भ्यः स्वाहौ॑षधीभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ वन॒स्पति॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ परिप्ल॒वेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ चराच॒रेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ सरीसृ॒पेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyai svāhā 'ntarikṣāya svāhā dive svāhā sūryāya svāhā candrāya svāhā nakṣatrebhyaḥ svāhā 'dbhyaḥ svāhauṣadhībhyaḥ svāhā vanaspatibhyaḥ svāhā pariplavebhyaḥ svāhā carācarebhyaḥ svāhā sarīsṛpebhyaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to Earth! Hail to Firmament t Hail to Sky! Hail to Sun! Hail to Moon! Hail to lunar asterisms! Hail to waters! Hail to herbs! Hail to forest trees! Hail to creatures that swim! Hail to things moving and stationary! Hail to things that creep and crawl!

verses.sanskrit: अस॑वे॒ स्वाहा॒ वस॑वे॒ स्वाहा॑ वि॒भुवे॒ स्वाहा॒ विव॑स्वते॒ स्वाहा॑ गण॒श्रिये॒ स्वाहा॑ ग॒णप॑तये॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽभि॒भुवे॒ स्वाहा ऽधि॑पतये॒ स्वाहा॑ शू॒षाय॒ स्वाहा॑ सᳪस॒र्पाय॒ स्वाहा॑ च॒न्द्राय॒ स्वाहा॒ ज्योति॑षे॒ स्वाहा॑ मलिम्लु॒चाय॒ स्वाहा॒ दिवा॑ प॒तय॑ते॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: asave svāhā vasave svāhā vibhuve svāhā vivasvate svāhā gaṇaśriye svāhā gaṇapataye svāhā 'bhibhuve svāhā 'dhipataye svāhā śūṣāya svāhā saṃsarpāya svāhā candrāya svāhā jyotiṣe svāhā malimlucāya svāhā divā patayate svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to breath! Hail to the Vasu! Hail to the Mighty! Hail to Vivasvân! Hail to the trooping one! Hail to the Troop's Lord! Hail to the Superior! Hail to the Overlord! Hail to Strength! Hail to Samsarpa! Hail to the Moon! Hail to light! Hail to Malimlucha! Hail to him who flies by day!

verses.sanskrit: मध॑वे॒ स्वाहा॒ माध॑वाय॒ स्वाहा॑ शु॒क्राय॒ स्वाहा॒ शुच॑ये॒ स्वाहा॒ नभ॑से॒ स्वाहा॑ नभ॒स्या॒य॒ स्वाहे॒षाय॒ स्वाहो॒र्जाय॒ स्वाहा॒ सह॑से॒ स्वाहा॑ सह॒स्या॒य॒ स्वाहा॒ तप॑से॒ स्वाहा॑ तप॒स्या॒य॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽᳪहसस्प॒तये॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: madhave svāhā mādhavāya svāhā śukrāya svāhā śucaye svāhā nabhase svāhā nabhasyāya svāheṣāya svāhorjāya svāhā sahase svāhā sahasyāya svāhā tapase svāhā tapasyāya svāhā 'ṃhasaspataye svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to Madhu! Hail to Mâdhava! Hail to Sukra! Hail to Suchi! Hail to Nabhas! Hail to Nabhasya! Hail to Isha! Hail to Ûrja! Hail to Sahas! Hail to Sahasya! Hail to Tapas! Hail to Tapasya! Hail to Amhasaspati!

verses.sanskrit: वाजा॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ प्रस॒वाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽपि॒जाय॒ स्वाहा॒ क्रत॑वे॒ स्वाहा॒ स्वः स्वाहा॑ मू॒र्ध्ने स्वाहा॑ व्यश्नु॒विने॒ स्वाहा ऽन्त्या॑य॒ स्वाहा ऽन्त्या॑य भौव॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ पत॑ये॒ स्वाहा ऽधि॑पतये॒ स्वाहा॑ प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vājāya svāhā prasavāya svāhā 'pijāya svāhā kratave svāhā svaḥ svāhā mūrdhne svāhā vyaśnuvine svāhā 'ntyāya svāhā 'ntyāya bhauvanāya svāhā bhuvanasya pataye svāhā 'dhipataye svāhā prajāpataye svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to Strength! Hail to impulse! Hail to After-born! Hail to will! Heaven, Hail? Hail to the head! Hail to Vyasnuvin! To the final, Hail! Hail to the mundane final! Hail to the Lord of the world! Hail to the Overlord! Hail to the Lord of Creatures!

verses.sanskrit: आयु॑र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ प्रा॒णो य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ ऽपा॒नो य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ व्या॒नो य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहो॑दा॒नो य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ समा॒नो य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ चक्षु॑र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ श्रोत्रं॑ य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ वाग्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ मनो॑ य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ ऽऽत्मा य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ ब्र॒ह्मा य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ ज्योति॑र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ स्व॒र्य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ पृ॒ष्ठं य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ य॒ज्ञो य॒ज्ञेन॑ कल्पता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: āyuryajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā prāṇo yajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā 'pāno yajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā vyāno yajñena kalpatāṃ svāhodāno yajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā samāno yajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā cakṣuryajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā śrotraṃ yajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā vāgyajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā mano yajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā ''tmā yajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā brahmā yajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā jyotiryajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā svaryajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā pṛṣṭhaṃ yajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā yajño yajñena kalpatāṃ svāhā ||
verses.translation: May life succeed by sacrifice, Hail! May breath succeed by sacrifice, Hail! May downward breath, diffusive. breath, upward breath, digestive breath, vision, hearing, speech, mind, self, devotion, light, heaven, hymn-arrangement, sacrifice succeed by sacrifice. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: एक॑स्मै॒ स्वाहा॒ द्वाभ्या॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ श॒ताय॒ स्वाहैक॑शताय॒ स्वाहा॒ व्यु॒ष्ट्यै॒ स्वाहा॑ स्व॒र्गाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ekasmai svāhā dvābhyāṃ svāhā śatāya svāhaikaśatāya svāhā vyuṣṭyai svāhā svargāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: Hail to One! Hail to Two! Hail to Hundred! Hail to Hundred-and-One! Hail to Daybreak! Hail to Heaven!

verses.sanskrit:
हि॒र॒ण्य॒ग॒र्भः सम॑वर्त॒ताग्रे॑ भू॒तस्य॑ जा॒तः पति॒रेक॑ आसीत् ।
स दा॑धार पृथि॒वीं द्यामु॒तेमां कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt |
sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
verses.translation: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, etc:

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि प्र॒जाप॑तये त्वा॒ जुष्टं॑ गृह्णाम्ये॒ष ते॒ योनिः॒ सूर्य॑स्ते महि॒मा ।
यस्तेऽह॑न्त्संवत्स॒रे म॑हि॒मा स॑म्ब॒भूव॒ यस्ते॑ वा॒याव॒न्तरि॑क्षे महि॒मा स॑म्ब॒भूव॒ यस्ते॑ दि॒वि सूर्ये॑ महि॒मा स॑म्ब॒भूव॒ तस्मै॑ ते महि॒म्ने प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ स्वाहा॑ दे॒वेभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
upayāmagṛhīto'si prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yoniḥ sūryaste mahimā |
yaste'hantsaṃvatsare mahimā sambabhūva yaste vāyāvantarikṣe mahimā sambabhūva yaste divi sūrye mahimā sambabhūva tasmai te mahimne prajāpataye svāhā devebhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee welcome to Prajâpati. This is thy place: Sûrya thy majesty. The majesty that has accrued to thee in the day, in a year, that majesty which has accrued in the wind, in the firmament, to that majesty of thine, to Prajâpati, to the Gods, All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
यः प्रा॑ण॒तो नि॑मिष॒तो म॑हि॒त्वैक॒ इद्राजा॒ जग॑तो ब॒भूव॑ ।
य ईशे॑ अ॒स्य द्वि॒पद॒श्चतु॑ष्पदः॒ कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika idrājā jagato babhūva |
ya īśe asya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
verses.translation: Who, by his, grandeur hath become sole Ruler of all the. moving world that breathes and slumbers; He who is Sovran of these men and cattle—what God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि प्र॒जाप॑तये त्वा॒ जुष्टं॑ गृह्णाम्ये॒ष ते॒ योनि॑श्च॒न्द्रमा॑स्ते महि॒मा ।
यस्ते॒ रात्रौ॑ संवत्स॒रे म॑हि॒मा स॑म्ब॒भूव॒ यस्ते॑ पृथि॒व्याम॒ग्नौ म॑हि॒मा स॑म्ब॒भूव॒ यस्ते॒ नक्ष॑त्रेषु च॒न्द्रम॑सि महि॒मा स॑म्ब॒भूव॒ तस्मै॑ ते महि॒म्ने प्र॒जाप॑तये दे॒वेभ्यः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
upayāmagṛhīto'si prajāpataye tvā juṣṭaṃ gṛhṇāmyeṣa te yoniścandramāste mahimā |
yaste rātrau saṃvatsare mahimā sambabhūva yaste pṛthivyāmagnau mahimā sambabhūva yaste nakṣatreṣu candramasi mahimā sambabhūva tasmai te mahimne prajāpataye devebhyaḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Taken upon a base art thou. I take thee welcome to Prajâpati, This is thy place: the Moon thy majesty. Thy majesty that has accrued to thee by night, in a year, thy majesty that has accrued in the earth, in Agni, in the stars and in the Moon, to that majesty of thine, to Prajâpati and to the Gods, All-hail!

verses.sanskrit: यु॒ञ्जन्ति॑ ब्र॒ध्नम॑रु॒षं चर॑न्तं॒ परि॑ त॒स्थुषः॑ । रोच॑न्ते रोच॒ना दि॒वि ॥
verses.transliteration: yuñjanti bradhnamaruṣaṃ carantaṃ pari tasthuṣaḥ | rocante rocanā divi ||
verses.translation: They who stand round hills as he moves harness the bright, the ruddy Steed: The lights are shining in the sky.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒ञ्जन्त्य॑स्य॒ काम्या॒ हरी॒ विप॑क्षसा॒ रथे॑ । शोणा॑ धृ॒ष्णू नृ॒साह॑सा ॥
verses.transliteration: yuñjantyasya kāmyā harī vipakṣasā rathe | śoṇā dhṛṣṇū nṛsāhasā ||
verses.translation: On both sides to the car they yoke the two. Bay Coursers dear to him, Bold; tawny, bearers of the Chief.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वातो॑ अ॒पो अ॑गनीगन्प्रि॒यामिन्द्र॑स्य त॒न्व॒म् । ए॒तᳪ स्तो॑तर॒नेन॑ प॒था पुन॒रश्व॒माव॑र्तयासि नः ॥
verses.transliteration: yadvāto apo aganīganpriyāmindrasya tanvam | etaṃ stotaranena pathā punaraśvamāvartayāsi naḥ ||
verses.translation: When, swift as wind, the Horse has reached the form that Indra loves, the flood, Again, O singer, by this path bring thou our Courser hitherward.

verses.sanskrit:
वस॑वस्त्वाञ्जन्तु गाय॒त्रेण॒ छन्द॑सा रु॒द्रास्त्वा॑ञ्जन्तु॒ त्रैष्टु॑भेन॒ छन्द॑सा ऽऽदि॒त्यास्त्वा॑ञ्जन्तु॒ जाग॑तेन॒ छन्द॑सा ।
भूर्भुवः॒ स्वर्ला॒जी३ञ्छा॒ची३न्यव्ये॒ गव्य॑ ए॒तदन्न॑मत्त देवा ए॒तदन्न॑मद्धि प्रजापते ॥
verses.transliteration:
vasavastvāñjantu gāyatreṇa chandasā rudrāstvāñjantu traiṣṭubhena chandasā ''dityāstvāñjantu jāgatena chandasā |
bhūrbhuvaḥ svarlājīñchācīnyavye gavya etadannamatta devā etadannamaddhi prajāpate ||
verses.translation: Let the Vasus anoint thee with Gâyatrî metre. Let the Rudras anoint thee with Trishtup metre. Let the Âdityas anoint thee with Jagatî metre. Earth! Ether! Heaven! O Gods, eat this food, parched grains and groats in the product of barley and in the product of cows: eat this food, Prajâpati.

verses.sanskrit: कः स्वि॑देका॒की च॑रति॒ क उ॑ स्विज्जायते॒ पुनः॑ । किᳪ स्वि॑द्धि॒मस्य॑ भेष॒जं किम्वा॒वप॑नं म॒हत् ॥
verses.transliteration: kaḥ svidekākī carati ka u svijjāyate punaḥ | kiṃ sviddhimasya bheṣajaṃ kimvāvapanaṃ mahat ||
verses.translation: Who moveth single and alone? Who is brought forth to life again? What is the remedy of cold, or what the great receptacle?

verses.sanskrit: सूर्य॑ एका॒की च॑रति च॒न्द्रमा॑ जायते॒ पुनः॑ । अ॒ग्निर्हि॒मस्य॑ भेष॒जं भूमि॑रा॒वप॑नं म॒हत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sūrya ekākī carati candramā jāyate punaḥ | agnirhimasya bheṣajaṃ bhūmirāvapanaṃ mahat ||
verses.translation: The Sun moves single and alone. The Moon is brought to life again, Fire is the remedy of cold; Earth is the great receptacle.

verses.sanskrit:
का स्वि॑दासीत्पू॒र्वचि॑त्तिः॒ किᳪ स्वि॑दासीद् बृ॒हद्वयः॑ ।
का स्वि॑दासीत्पिलिप्पि॒ला का स्वि॑दासीत्पिशङ्गि॒ला ॥
verses.transliteration:
kā svidāsītpūrvacittiḥ kiṃ svidāsīd bṛhadvayaḥ |
kā svidāsītpilippilā kā svidāsītpiśaṅgilā ||
verses.translation: What was the antecedent thought? What was the bird of mighty size? The slippery matron, who was she? Who was the reddish-coloured one?

verses.sanskrit:
द्यौरा॑सीत्पू॒र्वचि॑त्ति॒रश्व॑ आसीद् बृ॒हद्वयः॑ ।
अवि॑रासीत्पिलिप्पि॒ला रात्रि॑रासीत्पिशङ्गि॒ला ॥
verses.transliteration:
dyaurāsītpūrvacittiraśva āsīd bṛhadvayaḥ |
avirāsītpilippilā rātrirāsītpiśaṅgilā ||
verses.translation: Heaven was the antecedent thought. The Courser was the mighty bird. The slippery matron was the earth, Night was the reddish-coloured one.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒युष्ट्वा॑ पच॒तैर॑व॒त्वसि॑तग्रीव॒श्छागै॑र्न्य॒ग्रोध॑श्चम॒सैः श॑ल्म॒लिर्वृद्ध्या॑ ।
ए॒ष स्य रा॒थ्यो वृषा॑ प॒ड्भिश्च॒तुर्भि॒रेद॑गन्ब्र॒ह्मा कृ॑ष्णश्च नोऽवतु॒ नमो॒ऽग्नये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vāyuṣṭvā pacatairavatvasitagrīvaśchāgairnyagrodhaścamasaiḥ śalmalirvṛddhyā |
eṣa sya rāthyo vṛṣā paḍbhiścaturbhiredaganbrahmā kṛṣṇaśca no'vatu namo'gnaye ||
verses.translation: Vâyu help thee with cooked viands! Blackneck with goats; Nyagrodha with cups; Salmali with increase; this Stallion here, good for the chariot—let him verily come with his four feet. Brahmâkrishna help us! Obeisance to Agni!

verses.sanskrit:
सᳪशि॑तो र॒श्मिना॒ रथः॒ सᳪशि॑तो र॒श्मिना॒ हयः॑ ।
सᳪशि॑तो अ॒प्स्व॒प्सु॒जा ब्र॒ह्मा सोम॑पुरोगवः ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃśito raśminā rathaḥ saṃśito raśminā hayaḥ |
saṃśito apsvapsujā brahmā somapurogavaḥ ||
verses.translation: The car is fitted with the rein, the steed is fitted with the rein. Fitted in waters, water-born, is Brahmâ following Soma's lead.

verses.sanskrit: स्व॒यं वा॑जिँस्त॒न्वं॒ कल्पयस्व स्व॒यं य॑जस्व स्व॒यं जु॑षस्व । म॒हि॒मा ते॒ऽन्येन॒ न स॒न्नशे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: svayaṃ vājim̐stanvaṃ kalpayasva svayaṃ yajasva svayaṃ juṣasva | mahimā te'nyena na sannaśe ||
verses.translation: Steed, from thy body, of thyself, sacrifice and accept thyself. Thy greatness can be gained by none but thee.

verses.sanskrit:
न वा उ॑ ए॒तन्म्रि॑यसे॒ न रि॑ष्यसि दे॒वाँ२ इदे॑षि प॒थिभिः॑ सु॒गेभिः॑ ।
यत्रास॑ते सु॒कृतो॒ यत्र॒ ते य॒युस्तत्र॑ त्वा दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता द॑धातु ॥
verses.transliteration:
na vā u etanmriyase na riṣyasi devām̐ ideṣi pathibhiḥ sugebhiḥ |
yatrāsate sukṛto yatra te yayustatra tvā devaḥ savitā dadhātu ||
verses.translation: No, here thou diest not, thou art not injured: only by fair paths to the Gods thou guest, May Savitar the God in that world place thee where dwell the pious, whether they have journeyed.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निः प॒शुरा॑सी॒त्तेना॑यजन्त॒ स ए॒तँल्लो॒कम॑जय॒द्यस्मि॑न्न॒ग्निः स ते॑ लो॒को भ॑विष्यति॒ तं जे॑ष्यसि॒ पिबै॒ता अ॒पः ।
वा॒युः प॒शुरा॑सी॒त्तेना॑यजन्त॒ स ए॒तँल्लो॒कम॑जय॒द्यस्मि॑न्वा॒युः स ते॑ लो॒को भ॑विष्यति॒ तं जे॑ष्यसि॒ पिबै॒ता अ॒पः ।
सूर्यः॑ प॒शुरा॑सी॒त्तेना॑यजन्त॒ स ए॒तँल्लो॒कम॑जय॒द्यस्मि॒न्त्सूर्यः॒ स ते॑ लो॒को भ॑विष्यति॒ तं जे॑ष्यसि॒ पिबै॒ता अ॒पः ॥
verses.transliteration:
agniḥ paśurāsīttenāyajanta sa etam̐llokamajayadyasminnagniḥ sa te loko bhaviṣyati taṃ jeṣyasi pibaitā apaḥ |
vāyuḥ paśurāsīttenāyajanta sa etam̐llokamajayadyasminvāyuḥ sa te loko bhaviṣyati taṃ jeṣyasi pibaitā apaḥ |
sūryaḥ paśurāsīttenāyajanta sa etam̐llokamajayadyasmintsūryaḥ sa te loko bhaviṣyati taṃ jeṣyasi pibaitā apaḥ ||
verses.translation: Agni was the victim. With him they sacrificed. He won this world in which Agni is. This shall become thy world. This shalt thou win. Drink these waters. Vâyu was the victim. With him they sacrificed. He won this world in which Vâyu is. This shall become, etc., as above. Sûrya was the victim, etc, He won the world in which Sûrya is. This shall become, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒णाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽपा॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॑ व्या॒नाय॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
अम्बे॒ अम्बि॒केऽम्बा॑लिके॒ न मा॑ नयति॒ कश्च॒न ।
सस॑स्त्यश्व॒कः सुभ॑द्रिकां काम्पीलवा॒सिनी॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prāṇāya svāhā 'pānāya svāhā vyānāya svāhā |
ambe ambike'mbālike na mā nayati kaścana |
sasastyaśvakaḥ subhadrikāṃ kāmpīlavāsinīm ||
verses.translation: To vital breath, Hail! To out-breathing, Hail! To diffusive breath, Hail! Ambâ! Ambikâ! Ambâlikâ! No one is taking me away. The sorry horse will lie beside another, as Subhadrâ, the dweller in Kâmpila.

verses.sanskrit:
ग॒णानां॑ त्वा ग॒णप॑तिᳪ हवामहे प्रि॒याणां॑ त्वा प्रि॒यप॑तिᳪ हवामहे नि॒धीनां॑ त्वा॑ निधि॒पति॑ᳪ हवामहे वसो मम ।
आहम॑जानि गर्भ॒धमा त्वम॑जासि गर्भ॒धम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
gaṇānāṃ tvā gaṇapatiṃ havāmahe priyāṇāṃ tvā priyapatiṃ havāmahe nidhīnāṃ tvā nidhipatiṃ havāmahe vaso mama |
āhamajāni garbhadhamā tvamajāsi garbhadham ||
verses.translation: Thee we invoke, troop-lord of troops, Thee we invoke, the loved ones lord. Thee, lord of treasures, we invoke. My precious wealth! . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .

verses.sanskrit: ता उ॒भौ च॒तुरः॑ प॒दः सं॒प्रसा॑रयाव स्व॒र्गे लो॒के प्रोर्णु॑वाथां॒ वृषा॑ वा॒जी रे॑तो॒धा रेतो॑ दधातु ॥
verses.transliteration: tā ubhau caturaḥ padaḥ saṃprasārayāva svarge loke prorṇuvāthāṃ vṛṣā vājī retodhā reto dadhātu ||

verses.sanskrit: उत्स॑क्थ्या॒ अव॑ गु॒दं धे॑हि॒ सम॒ञ्जिं चा॑रया वृषन् । य स्त्री॒णां जी॑व॒भोज॑नः ॥
verses.transliteration: utsakthyā ava gudaṃ dhehi samañjiṃ cārayā vṛṣan | ya strīṇāṃ jīvabhojanaḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: य॒कास॒कौ श॑कुन्ति॒काऽऽहल॒गिति॒ वञ्च॑ति । आह॑न्ति ग॒भे पसो॒ निग॑ल्गलीति॒ धार॑का ॥
verses.transliteration: yakāsakau śakuntikā''halagiti vañcati | āhanti gabhe paso nigalgalīti dhārakā ||

verses.sanskrit: य॒को॒ऽस॒कौ श॑कुन्त॒क आ॒हल॒गिति॒ वञ्च॑ति । विव॑क्षत इव ते॒ मुख॒मध्व॑र्यो॒ मा न॒स्त्वम॒भि भा॑षथाः ॥
verses.transliteration: yako'sakau śakuntaka āhalagiti vañcati | vivakṣata iva te mukhamadhvaryo mā nastvamabhi bhāṣathāḥ ||

verses.sanskrit: मा॒ता च॑ ते पि॒ता च॒ तेऽग्रं॑ वृ॒क्षस्य॑ रोहतः । प्रति॑ला॒मीति॑ ते पि॒ता ग॒भे मु॒ष्टिम॑तᳪसयत् ॥
verses.transliteration: mātā ca te pitā ca te'graṃ vṛkṣasya rohataḥ | pratilāmīti te pitā gabhe muṣṭimataṃsayat ||

verses.sanskrit: मा॒ता च॑ ते पि॒ता च॒ तेऽग्रे॑ वृ॒क्षस्य॑ क्रीडतः । विव॑क्षत इव ते॒ मुखं॒ ब्रह्म॒न्मा त्वं व॑दो ब॒हु ॥
verses.transliteration: mātā ca te pitā ca te'gre vṛkṣasya krīḍataḥ | vivakṣata iva te mukhaṃ brahmanmā tvaṃ vado bahu ||

verses.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वमे॑ना॒मुच्छ्रा॑पय गि॒रौ भा॒रᳪ हर॑न्निव । अथा॑स्यै॒ मध्य॑मेधताᳪ शी॒ते वाते॑ पु॒नन्नि॑व ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvamenāmucchrāpaya girau bhāraṃ haranniva | athāsyai madhyamedhatāṃ śīte vāte punanniva ||

verses.sanskrit: ऊ॒र्ध्वमे॑न॒मुच्छ्र॑यताद्गि॒रौ भा॒रᳪ हर॑न्निव । अथा॑स्य॒ मध्य॑मेजतु शी॒ते वाते॑ पु॒नन्नि॑व ॥
verses.transliteration: ūrdhvamenamucchrayatādgirau bhāraṃ haranniva | athāsya madhyamejatu śīte vāte punanniva ||

verses.sanskrit: यद॑स्या अᳪहु॒भेद्याः॑ कृ॒धु स्थू॒लमु॒पात॑सत् । मु॒ष्काविद॑स्या एजतो गोश॒फे श॑कु॒लावि॑व ॥
verses.transliteration: yadasyā aṃhubhedyāḥ kṛdhu sthūlamupātasat | muṣkāvidasyā ejato gośaphe śakulāviva ||

verses.sanskrit: यद्दे॒वासो॑ ल॒लाम॑गुं॒ प्र वि॑ष्टी॒मिन॒मावि॑षुः । स॒क्थ्ना दे॑दिश्यते॒ नारी॑ स॒त्यस्या॑क्षि॒भुवो॒ यथा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yaddevāso lalāmaguṃ pra viṣṭīminamāviṣuḥ | sakthnā dediśyate nārī satyasyākṣibhuvo yathā ||

verses.sanskrit: यद्ध॑रि॒णो यव॒मत्ति॒ न पु॒ष्टं प॒शु मन्य॑ते । शू॒द्रा यदर्य॑जारा॒ न पोषा॑य धनायति ॥
verses.transliteration: yaddhariṇo yavamatti na puṣṭaṃ paśu manyate | śūdrā yadaryajārā na poṣāya dhanāyati ||

verses.sanskrit: यद्ध॑रि॒णो यव॒मत्ति॒ न पु॒ष्टं ब॒हु मन्य॑ते । शू॒द्रो यदर्या॑यै जा॒रो न पोष॒मनु॑ मन्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: yaddhariṇo yavamatti na puṣṭaṃ bahu manyate | śūdro yadaryāyai jāro na poṣamanu manyate ||

verses.sanskrit:
द॒धि॒क्राव्णो॑ अकारिषं जि॒ष्णोरश्व॑स्य वा॒जिनः॑ ।
सु॒र॒भि नो॒ मुखा॑ कर॒त्प्र ण॒ आयू॑ᳪषि तारिषत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dadhikrāvṇo akāriṣaṃ jiṣṇoraśvasya vājinaḥ |
surabhi no mukhā karatpra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣat ||
verses.translation: Now have I glorified with praise strong Dadhikrâvan, conquering steed, Sweet may he make our mouths: may he prolong the days we have to live.

verses.sanskrit: गा॒य॒त्री त्रि॒ष्टुब्जग॑त्यनु॒ष्टुप्प॒ङ्क्त्या स॒ह । बृ॒ह॒त्युष्णिहा॑ क॒कुप्सू॒चीभिः॑ शम्यन्तु त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: gāyatrī triṣṭubjagatyanuṣṭuppaṅktyā saha | bṛhatyuṣṇihā kakupsūcībhiḥ śamyantu tvā ||
verses.translation: Gâyatrî, Trishtup, Jagatî, and Pankti with Anushtup joined, Brihatî, Kakup, Ushnihâ pacify thee with needle-points!

verses.sanskrit:
द्विप॑दा॒ याश्चतु॑ष्पदा॒स्त्रिप॑दा॒ याश्च॒ षट्प॑दाः ।
विच्छ॑न्दा॒ याश्च॒ सच्छ॑न्दाः सू॒चीभिः॑ शम्यन्तु त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
dvipadā yāścatuṣpadāstripadā yāśca ṣaṭpadāḥ |
vicchandā yāśca sacchandāḥ sūcībhiḥ śamyantu tvā ||
verses.translation: Two-footed, those that have four feet, those with three feet and those with five, Metteless, with one metre; these pacify thee with needle-points!

verses.sanskrit:
म॒हाना॑म्न्यो रे॒वत्यो॒ विश्वा॒ आशाः॑ प्र॒भूव॑रीः ।
मैघी॑र्वि॒द्युतो॒ वाचः॑ सू॒चीभिः॑ शम्यन्तु त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
mahānāmnyo revatyo viśvā āśāḥ prabhūvarīḥ |
maighīrvidyuto vācaḥ sūcībhiḥ śamyantu tvā ||
verses.translation: May Mahânâmnîs, Revatîs, all far-spread Regions of the sky, Voices, and lightnings from the cloud pacify thee with needle-points!

verses.sanskrit:
नार्य॑स्ते॒ पत्न्यो॒ लोम॒ विचि॑न्वन्तु मनी॒षया॑ ।
दे॒वानां॒ पत्न्यो॒ दिशः॑ सू॒चीभिः॑ शम्यन्तु त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
nāryaste patnyo loma vicinvantu manīṣayā |
devānāṃ patnyo diśaḥ sūcībhiḥ śamyantu tvā ||
verses.translation: May married dames of human birth skilfully separate thy hair: The Regions, Consorts of the Gods, pacify thee with needle-points!

verses.sanskrit:
र॒ज॒ता हरि॑णीः॒ सीसा॒ युजो॑ युज्यन्ते॒ कर्म॑भिः ।
अश्व॑स्य वा॒जिन॑स्त्व॒चि सिमाः॑ शम्यन्तु॒ शम्य॑न्तीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
rajatā hariṇīḥ sīsā yujo yujyante karmabhiḥ |
aśvasya vājinastvaci simāḥ śamyantu śamyantīḥ ||
verses.translation: They, made of silver, gold, and lead, are used as helpers in the work. As lines on the strong Courser's skin may they console and give thee rest.

verses.sanskrit:
कु॒विद॒ङ्ग यव॑मन्तो॒ यव॑ञ्चि॒द्यथा॒ दान्त्य॑नुपू॒र्वं वि॒यूय॑ ।
इ॒हेहै॑षां कृणुहि॒ भोज॑नानि॒ ये ब॒र्हिषो॒ नम॑ उक्तिं॒ यज॑न्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
kuvidaṅga yavamanto yavañcidyathā dāntyanupūrvaṃ viyūya |
ihehaiṣāṃ kṛṇuhi bhojanāni ye barhiṣo nama uktiṃ yajanti ||
verses.translation: What then? As men whose fields are full of barley, etc., as in X. 32.

verses.sanskrit: कस्त्वा छ्य॑ति॒ कस्त्वा॒ विशा॑स्ति॒ कस्ते॒ गात्रा॑णि शम्यति । क उ॑ ते शमि॒ता क॒विः ॥
verses.transliteration: kastvā chyati kastvā viśāsti kaste gātrāṇi śamyati | ka u te śamitā kaviḥ ||
verses.translation: Who flays thee? Who dissects thee? Who prepares thy limbs for sacrifice? Who is the Sage that slaughters thee?

verses.sanskrit: ऋ॒तव॑स्त ऋतु॒था पर्व॑ शमि॒तारो॒ वि शा॑सतु । सं॒व॒त्स॒रस्य॒ तेज॑सा श॒मीभिः॑ शम्यन्तु त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtavasta ṛtuthā parva śamitāro vi śāsatu | saṃvatsarasya tejasā śamībhiḥ śamyantu tvā ||
verses.translation: In due time let the seasons as thy Slaughterers divide thy joints, And with the splendour of the Year sacrifice thee with holy rites.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒र्ध॒मा॒साः परू॑ᳪषि ते॒ मासा॒ आ च्छ्य॑न्तु॒ शम्य॑न्तः । अ॒हो॒रा॒त्राणि॑ म॒रुतो॒ विलि॑ष्टᳪ सूदयन्तु ते ॥
verses.transliteration: ardhamāsāḥ parūṃṣi te māsā ā cchyantu śamyantaḥ | ahorātrāṇi maruto viliṣṭaṃ sūdayantu te ||
verses.translation: Let the Half-months and let the Months, while sacrificing, flay thy limbs: Let Day and Night and Maruts mend each fault in sacrificing thee.

verses.sanskrit: दैव्या॑ अध्व॒र्यव॒स्त्वा च्छ्य॑न्तु॒ वि च॑ शासतु । गात्रा॑णि पर्व॒शस्ते॒ सिमाः॑ कृण्वन्तु॒ शम्य॑न्तीः ॥
verses.transliteration: daivyā adhvaryavastvā cchyantu vi ca śāsatu | gātrāṇi parvaśaste simāḥ kṛṇvantu śamyantīḥ ||
verses.translation: Let the divine Adhvaryus flay thy body and dissect thy frame, And let the sacrificing lines prepare thy members joint by joint,

verses.sanskrit: द्यौ॑स्ते पृथि॒व्यन्तरि॑क्षं वा॒युश्छि॒द्रं पृ॑णातु ते । सूर्य॑स्ते॒ नक्ष॑त्रैः स॒ह लो॒कं कृ॑णोतु साधु॒या ॥
verses.transliteration: dyauste pṛthivyantarikṣaṃ vāyuśchidraṃ pṛṇātu te | sūryaste nakṣatraiḥ saha lokaṃ kṛṇotu sādhuyā ||
verses.translation: May Sky, Earth, Air, and Wind supply each failing and defect of thine: May Sûrya with the Stars of heaven duly prepare a world for thee.

verses.sanskrit: शं ते॒ परे॑भ्यो॒ गात्रे॑भ्यः॒ शम॒स्त्वव॑रेभ्यः । शम॒स्थभ्यो॑ म॒ज्जभ्यः॒ शम्व॑स्तु त॒न्वै तव॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: śaṃ te parebhyo gātrebhyaḥ śamastvavarebhyaḥ | śamasthabhyo majjabhyaḥ śamvastu tanvai tava ||
verses.translation: Well be it with thine upper parts, well be it with the parts below! Well he it with thy bones and with thy marrow and with all thy frame!

verses.sanskrit: कः स्वि॑देका॒की च॑रति॒ क उ॑ स्विज्जायते॒ पुनः॑ । किᳪ स्वि॑द्धि॒मस्य॑ भेष॒जं किम्वा॒वप॑नं म॒हत् ॥
verses.transliteration: kaḥ svidekākī carati ka u svijjāyate punaḥ | kiṃ sviddhimasya bheṣajaṃ kimvāvapanaṃ mahat ||
verses.translation: Who moveth singly? etc., as in verse 9.

verses.sanskrit: सूर्य॑ एका॒की च॑रति च॒न्द्रमा॑ जायते॒ पुनः॑ । अ॒ग्निर्हि॒मस्य॑ भेष॒जं भूमि॑रा॒वप॑नं म॒हत् ॥
verses.transliteration: sūrya ekākī carati candramā jāyate punaḥ | agnirhimasya bheṣajaṃ bhūmirāvapanaṃ mahat ||
verses.translation: The Sun moves singly, etc., as in verse 10.

verses.sanskrit: किᳪ स्वि॒त्सूर्य॑समं॒ ज्योतिः॒ किᳪ स॑मु॒द्रस॑म॒ᳪ सरः॑ । किᳪ स्वि॑त्पृथि॒व्यै वर्षी॑यः॒ कस्य॒ मात्रा॒ न वि॑द्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: kiṃ svitsūryasamaṃ jyotiḥ kiṃ samudrasamaṃ saraḥ | kiṃ svitpṛthivyai varṣīyaḥ kasya mātrā na vidyate ||
verses.translation: What lustre is like Sûrya's light? What lake is equal to the Sea? What is more spacious than the Earth? What thing is that which naught can mete?

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॒ सूर्य॑समं॒ ज्योति॒र्द्यौः स॑मु॒द्रस॑म॒ᳪ सरः॑ । इन्द्रः॑ पृथिव्यै॒ वर्षी॑या॒न् गोस्तु मात्रा॒ न वि॑द्यते ॥
verses.transliteration: brahma sūryasamaṃ jyotirdyauḥ samudrasamaṃ saraḥ | indraḥ pṛthivyai varṣīyān gostu mātrā na vidyate ||
verses.translation: Brahma is lustre like the Sea. Heaven is a flood to match the Sea. Indra is vaster than the Earth. Beyond all measure is the Cow.

verses.sanskrit:
पृ॒च्छामि॑ त्वा चि॒तये॑ देवसख॒ यदि॒ त्वमत्र॒ मन॑सा ज॒गन्थ॑ ।
येषु॒ विष्णु॑स्त्रि॒षु प॒देष्वेष्ट॒स्तेषु॒ विश्वं॒ भुव॑न॒मा वि॑वेशा३ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛcchāmi tvā citaye devasakha yadi tvamatra manasā jagantha |
yeṣu viṣṇustriṣu padeṣveṣṭasteṣu viśvaṃ bhuvanamā viveśā ||
verses.translation: Friend of the Gods, I ask, for information, if thou in spirit hast obtained the knowledge, Hath Vishnu this whole Universe pervaded in the three steps wherein the God is worshipped?

verses.sanskrit:
अपि॒ तेषु॑ त्रि॒षु प॒देष्व॑स्मि॒ येषु॒ विश्वं॒ भुव॑नमा वि॒वेश॑ ।
स॒द्यः पर्ये॑मि पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्यामेके॒नाङ्गे॑न दि॒वो अ॒स्य पृ॒ष्ठम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
api teṣu triṣu padeṣvasmi yeṣu viśvaṃ bhuvanamā viveśa |
sadyaḥ paryemi pṛthivīmuta dyāmekenāṅgena divo asya pṛṣṭham ||
verses.translation: I also am in those three steps of Vishnu wherewith this Universe he permeated. The earth and heaven I circle in a moment and this heaven's summit with a single organ.

verses.sanskrit:
केष्व॒न्तः पुरु॑ष॒ आ वि॑वेश॒ कान्य॒न्तः पुरु॑षे॒ अर्पि॑तानि ।
ए॒तद्ब्र॑ह्म॒न्नुप॑ वल्हामसि त्वा॒ किᳪ स्वि॑न्नः॒ प्रति॑ वोचा॒स्यत्र॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
keṣvantaḥ puruṣa ā viveśa kānyantaḥ puruṣe arpitāni |
etadbrahmannupa valhāmasi tvā kiṃ svinnaḥ prati vocāsyatra ||
verses.translation: What are the things which Purusha hath entered? What things hath Purusha contained within him? This riddle we propound to thee, O Brahman. Why dost thou give no answer to my question?

verses.sanskrit:
प॒ञ्चस्व॒न्तः पुरु॑ष॒ आ वि॑वेश॒ तान्य॒न्तः पुरु॑षे॒ अर्पि॑तानि ।
ए॒तत्त्वात्र॑ प्रतिमन्वा॒नो अ॑स्मि॒ न मा॒यया॑ भव॒स्युत्त॑रो॒ मत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pañcasvantaḥ puruṣa ā viveśa tānyantaḥ puruṣe arpitāni |
etattvātra pratimanvāno asmi na māyayā bhavasyuttaro mat ||
verses.translation: Within five things hath Purusha found entrance; these Purusha hath within himself connected. This is the thought which I return in answer. Thou art not my superior in wisdom.

verses.sanskrit:
का स्वि॑दासीत्पू॒र्वचि॑त्तिः॒ किᳪ स्वि॑दासीद् बृ॒हद्वयः॑ ।
का स्वि॑दासीत्पिलिप्पि॒ला का स्वि॑दासीत्पिशङ्गि॒ला ॥
verses.transliteration:
kā svidāsītpūrvacittiḥ kiṃ svidāsīd bṛhadvayaḥ |
kā svidāsītpilippilā kā svidāsītpiśaṅgilā ||
verses.translation: What was the antecedent thought? etc., as in verse 11.

verses.sanskrit:
द्यौ॑रासीत्पू॒र्वचि॑त्ति॒रश्व॑ आसीद् बृ॒हद्वयः॑ ।
अवि॑रासीत्पिलिप्पि॒ला रात्रि॑रासीत्पिशङ्गि॒ला ॥
verses.transliteration:
dyaurāsītpūrvacittiraśva āsīd bṛhadvayaḥ |
avirāsītpilippilā rātrirāsītpiśaṅgilā ||
verses.translation: Heaven was the antecedent thought, etc., as in 12.

verses.sanskrit:
का ई॑मरे पिशङ्गि॒ला का ईं॑ कुरुपिशङ्गि॒ला ।
क ई॑मा॒स्कन्द॑मर्षति॒ क ईं॒ पन्थां॒ वि स॑र्पति ॥
verses.transliteration:
kā īmare piśaṅgilā kā īṃ kurupiśaṅgilā |
ka īmāskandamarṣati ka īṃ panthāṃ vi sarpati ||
verses.translation: Who, tell me, is the yellowish she? Who is the darklyyellowish? Who moves with rapid spring and bound? Who glides and winds along the path?

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒जारे॑ पिशङ्गि॒ला श्वा॒वित्कु॑रुपिशङ्गि॒ला ।
श॒श आ॒स्कन्द॑मर्ष॒त्यहिः॒ पन्थां॒ वि स॑र्पति ॥
verses.transliteration:
ajāre piśaṅgilā śvāvitkurupiśaṅgilā |
śaśa āskandamarṣatyahiḥ panthāṃ vi sarpati ||
verses.translation: The she-goat, Sir, is yellowish, dark-yellowish is the porcupine. The hare moves swift with leap and bound: the snake creeps winding on the path.

verses.sanskrit:
कत्य॑स्य वि॒ष्ठाः कत्य॒क्षरा॑णि॒ कति॒ होमा॑सः कति॒धा समि॑द्धः ।
य॒ज्ञस्य॑ त्वा वि॒दथा॑ पृच्छ॒मत्र॒ कति॒ होता॑र ऋतु॒शो य॑जन्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
katyasya viṣṭhāḥ katyakṣarāṇi kati homāsaḥ katidhā samiddhaḥ |
yajñasya tvā vidathā pṛcchamatra kati hotāra ṛtuśo yajanti ||
verses.translation: How many different forms hath this, how many syllables, burnt-oblations, brands for kindling? Here, of the rites of sacrifice I ask thee. How many Hotars in due season worship?

verses.sanskrit:
षड॑स्य वि॒ष्ठाः श॒तम॒क्षरा॑ण्यशी॒तिर्होमाः॑ स॒मिधो॑ ह ति॒स्रः ।
य॒ज्ञस्य॑ ते वि॒दथा॒ प्र ब्र॑वीमि स॒प्त होता॑र ऋतु॒शो य॑जन्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṣaḍasya viṣṭhāḥ śatamakṣarāṇyaśītirhomāḥ samidho ha tisraḥ |
yajñasya te vidathā pra bravīmi sapta hotāra ṛtuśo yajanti ||
verses.translation: Sixfold its form, its syllables a hundred, eighty burnt-offerings, just three brands for kindling. To thee I tell the rites of sacrificing. Seven Hotars worship in appointed season.

verses.sanskrit:
को अ॒स्य वे॑द॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ नाभिं॒ को द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षम् ।
कः सूर्य॑स्य वेद बृह॒तो ज॒नित्रं॒ को वे॑द च॒न्द्रम॑सं यतो॒जाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ko asya veda bhuvanasya nābhiṃ ko dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣam |
kaḥ sūryasya veda bṛhato janitraṃ ko veda candramasaṃ yatojāḥ ||
verses.translation: Who knoweth this world's central point? Who knoweth the heaven, the earth, and the wide air between them? Who knows the birthplace of the mighty Sûrya? Who knows the Moon, whence he was generated?

verses.sanskrit:
वेदा॒हम॒स्य भुव॑नस्य॒ नाभिं॒ वेद॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरि॑क्षम् ।
वेद॒ सूर्य॑स्य बृह॒तो ज॒नित्र॒मथो॑ वेद च॒न्द्रम॑सं यतो॒जाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vedāhamasya bhuvanasya nābhiṃ veda dyāvāpṛthivī antarikṣam |
veda sūryasya bṛhato janitramatho veda candramasaṃ yatojāḥ ||
verses.translation: I know the centre of the world about us. I know heaven, earth, and the wide air between them. I know the birthplace of the mighty Sûrya. I know the Moon, whence he was generated.

verses.sanskrit:
पृ॒च्छामि॑ त्वा॒ पर॒मन्तं॑ पृथि॒व्याः पृ॒च्छामि॒ यत्र॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ नाभिः॑ ।
पृ॒च्छामि॑ त्वा॒ वृष्णो॒ अश्व॑स्य॒ रेतः॑ पृ॒च्छामि॑ वा॒चः प॑र॒मं व्यो॑म ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛcchāmi tvā paramantaṃ pṛthivyāḥ pṛcchāmi yatra bhuvanasya nābhiḥ |
pṛcchāmi tvā vṛṣṇo aśvasya retaḥ pṛcchāmi vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma ||
verses.translation: I ask thee of the earth's extremest limit, where is the centre of the world, I ask thee. I ask thee of the Stallion's genial humour, I ask of highest heaven where Speech abideth.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒यं वेदिः॒ परो॒ अन्तः॑ पृथि॒व्या अ॒यं य॒ज्ञो भुव॑नस्य॒ नाभिः॑ ।
अ॒यᳪ सोमो॒ वृष्णो॒ अश्व॑स्य॒ रेतो॑ ब्र॒ह्मायं वा॒चः प॑र॒मं व्यो॑म ॥
verses.transliteration:
iyaṃ vediḥ paro antaḥ pṛthivyā ayaṃ yajño bhuvanasya nābhiḥ |
ayaṃ somo vṛṣṇo aśvasya reto brahmāyaṃ vācaḥ paramaṃ vyoma ||
verses.translation: This altar is the earth's extremest limit; this sacrifice of ours is the world's centre. This Soma is the Stallion's genial humour, this Brahman highest heaven where Speech abideth.

verses.sanskrit: सु॒भूः स्व॑य॒म्भूः प्र॑थ॒मोऽन्तर्म॑ह॒त्य॒र्ण॒वे । द॒धे ह॒ गर्भ॑मृ॒त्वियं॒ यतो॑ जा॒तः प्र॒जाप॑तिः ॥
verses.transliteration: subhūḥ svayambhūḥ prathamo'ntarmahatyarṇave | dadhe ha garbhamṛtviyaṃ yato jātaḥ prajāpatiḥ ||
verses.translation: The Strong, the Self-existent One, the First, within the mighty flood Laid down the timely embryo from which Prajâpati was born.

verses.sanskrit: होता॑ यक्षत्प्र॒जाप॑ति॒ᳪ सोम॑स्य महि॒म्नः । जु॒षतां॒ पिब॑तु॒ सोम॒ᳪ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: hotā yakṣatprajāpatiṃ somasya mahimnaḥ | juṣatāṃ pibatu somaṃ hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Hotar sacrifice to Prajâpati from the Mahiman-Soma. Let him accept. Let him drink the Soma. Hotar, sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रजा॑पते॒ न त्वदे॒तान्य॒न्यो विश्वा॑ रू॒पाणि॒ परि॒ ता ब॑भूव ।
यत्का॑मास्ते जुहु॒मस्तन्नो॑ अस्तु व॒यᳪ स्या॑म॒ पत॑यो रयी॒णाम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajāpate na tvadetānyanyo viśvā rūpāṇi pari tā babhūva |
yatkāmāste juhumastanno astu vayaṃ syāma patayo rayīṇām ||
verses.translation: Prajâpati, thou only, etc., as in X. 20.

verses.sanskrit: अश्व॑स्तूप॒रो गो॑मृ॒गस्ते प्रा॑जाप॒त्याः कृ॒ष्णग्री॑व आग्ने॒यो र॒राटे॑ पु॒रस्ता॑त्सारस्व॒ती मे॒ष्यधस्ता॒द्धन्वो॑राश्वि॒नाव॒धोरा॑मौ बा॒ह्वोः सौ॑मापौ॒ष्णः श्या॒मो नाभ्या॑ᳪ सौर्यया॒मौ श्वे॒तश्च॑ कृ॒ष्णश्च॑ पा॒र्श्वयो॑स्त्वा॒ष्ट्रौ लो॑म॒शस॑क्थौ स॒क्थ्योर्वा॑य॒व्यः॒ श्वे॒तः पुच्छ॒ इन्द्रा॑य स्वप॒स्या॒य वे॒हद्वै॑ष्ण॒वो वा॑म॒नः ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvastūparo gomṛgaste prājāpatyāḥ kṛṣṇagrīva āgneyo rarāṭe purastātsārasvatī meṣyadhastāddhanvorāśvināvadhorāmau bāhvoḥ saumāpauṣṇaḥ śyāmo nābhyāṃ sauryayāmau śvetaśca kṛṣṇaśca pārśvayostvāṣṭrau lomaśasakthau sakthyorvāyavyaḥ śvetaḥ puccha indrāya svapasyāya vehadvaiṣṇavo vāmanaḥ ||
verses.translation: Horse, hornless goat, Gomriga, these belong to Prajâpati. A black-necked goat, devoted to Agni, (is to be bound) in front to the forehead (of the horse); Sarasvatî's ewe below his jaws; two goats belonging to the Asvins, with marks on the lower parts of the body, to his fore-legs; a dark-coloured goat, Soma's and Pûshan's, to his navel; a white and a black, sacred to Soma and Varna, to his sides; Tvashtar's two, with bushy tails, to his hind feet; Vâyu's white goat to his tail; for Indra the Good Worker a cow who slips her calf; a dwarf belonging to Vishnu.

verses.sanskrit: रोहि॑तो धू॒म्ररो॑हितः क॒र्कन्धु॑रोहित॒स्ते सौ॒म्या ब॒भ्रुर॑रु॒णब॑भ्रुः॒ शुक॑बभ्रु॒स्ते वा॑रु॒णाः शि॑ति॒रन्ध्रो॒ऽन्यतः॑ शितिरन्ध्रः सम॒न्तशि॑तिरन्ध्र॒स्ते सा॑वि॒त्राः शि॑तिबा॒हुर॒न्यतः॑ शितिबाहु सम॒न्तशि॑तिबाहु॒स्ते बा॑र्हस्प॒त्याः पृष॑ती क्षु॒द्रपृ॑षती स्थू॒लपृ॑षती॒ ता मै॑त्रावरु॒ण्यः॒ ॥
verses.transliteration: rohito dhūmrarohitaḥ karkandhurohitaste saumyā babhruraruṇababhruḥ śukababhruste vāruṇāḥ śitirandhro'nyataḥ śitirandhraḥ samantaśitirandhraste sāvitrāḥ śitibāhuranyataḥ śitibāhu samantaśitibāhuste bārhaspatyāḥ pṛṣatī kṣudrapṛṣatī sthūlapṛṣatī tā maitrāvaruṇyaḥ ||
verses.translation: The red goat, the smoky-red, the jujube-red, these belong to Soma. The brown, the ruddy-brown, the parrot-brown, these are Varuna's. One with white ear holes, one with partly white, one with wholly white, belong to Savitar. One with fore feet white, partly white, wholly white, belongs to Brihaspati. She goats speckled, with small spots, with big spots, these belong to Mitra-Varuna.

verses.sanskrit:
शु॒द्धवा॑लः स॒र्वशु॑द्धवालो मणि॒वाल॒स्त आ॑श्वि॒नाः श्येतः॑ श्येता॒क्षो॒ऽरु॒णस्ते रु॒द्राय॑ पशु॒पत॑ये क॒र्णा या॒मा अ॑वलि॒प्ता रौ॒द्रा नभो॑रूपाः
पार्ज॒न्याः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śuddhavālaḥ sarvaśuddhavālo maṇivālasta āśvināḥ śyetaḥ śyetākṣo'ruṇaste rudrāya paśupataye karṇā yāmā avaliptā raudrā nabhorūpāḥ
pārjanyāḥ ||
verses.translation: The bright-tailed, the wholly bright-tailed, the jewel-tailed, these belong to the Asvins. The white, the white-eyed, the reddish, these are for Rudra Lord of Beasts. Long-eared goats are for Yama; proud ones for Rudra; cloud-coloured ones for Parjanya.

verses.sanskrit: पृश्नि॑स्तिर॒श्चीन॑पृश्निरू॒र्ध्वपृ॑श्नि॒स्ते मा॑रु॒ताः फ॒ल्गूर्लो॑हितो॒र्णी प॑ल॒क्षी ताः सा॑रस्व॒त्यः॒ प्लीहा॒कर्णः॑ शुण्ठा॒कर्णो॑ऽध्यालोह॒कर्ण॒स्ते त्वा॒ष्ट्राः कृ॒ष्णग्री॑वः शिति॒कक्षो॑ऽञ्जिस॒क्थस्त ऐ॑न्द्रा॒ग्नाः कृ॒ष्णाञ्जि॒रल्पा॑ञ्जिर्म॒हाञ्जि॒स्त उ॑ष॒स्याः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛśnistiraścīnapṛśnirūrdhvapṛśniste mārutāḥ phalgūrlohitorṇī palakṣī tāḥ sārasvatyaḥ plīhākarṇaḥ śuṇṭhākarṇo'dhyālohakarṇaste tvāṣṭrāḥ kṛṣṇagrīvaḥ śitikakṣo'ñjisakthasta aindrāgnāḥ kṛṣṇāñjiralpāñjirmahāñjista uṣasyāḥ ||
verses.translation: Goats speckled, transversely speckled, upward speckled are for the Maruts. The reddish she-goat, the red-haired, the white, these belong to Sarasvatî. The goat with diseased ears, the short-eared, the red eared are Tvashtar's. The black-necked, the white-flanked, one with bright-coloured thighs belong to Indra and Agni. Those with black marks, small marks, large marks belong to Dawn.

verses.sanskrit: शि॒ल्पा वै॑श्वदे॒व्यो रोहि॑ण्य॒स्त्र्यव॑यो वा॒चेऽवि॑ज्ञाता॒ अदि॑त्यै॒ सरू॑पा धा॒त्रे व॑त्सत॒र्यो दे॒वानां॒ पत्नी॑भ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: śilpā vaiśvadevyo rohiṇyastryavayo vāce'vijñātā adityai sarūpā dhātre vatsataryo devānāṃ patnībhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: Parti-coloured female victims belong to the All-Gods; red-coloured, eighteen mouths old to Vâk; victims without distinguishing marks to Aditi; those of one same colour to Dhâtar; weaned kids sacred to the Consorts of the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: कृ॒ष्णग्री॑वा आग्ने॒याः शि॑ति॒भ्रवो॒ वसू॑ना॒ᳪ रोहि॑ता रु॒द्राणा॑ᳪ श्वे॒ता अ॑वरो॒किण॑ आदि॒त्यानां॒ नभो॑रूपाः पार्ज॒न्याः ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyāḥ śitibhravo vasūnāṃ rohitā rudrāṇāṃ śvetā avarokiṇa ādityānāṃ nabhorūpāḥ pārjanyāḥ ||
verses.translation: Black-necked victims for Agni; white browed for the Vasus; red for Rudra; bright ones for the Âdityas; cloud-coloured for Parjanya.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒न्न॒त ऋ॑ष॒भो वा॑म॒नस्त ऐ॑न्द्रवैष्ण॒वा उ॑न्न॒तः शि॑तिबा॒हुः शि॑तिपृ॒ष्ठस्त ऐ॑न्द्राबार्हस्प॒त्याः शुक॑रूपा वाजि॒नाः क॒ल्माषा॑ आग्निमारु॒ताः श्या॒माः
पौ॒ष्णाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
unnata ṛṣabho vāmanasta aindravaiṣṇavā unnataḥ śitibāhuḥ śitipṛṣṭhasta aindrābārhaspatyāḥ śukarūpā vājināḥ kalmāṣā āgnimārutāḥ śyāmāḥ
pauṣṇāḥ ||
verses.translation: The tall goat, the sturdy, the dwarf, these are Indra-Vishnu's; the tall, the white fore-footed, the black-backed, Indra-Brihaspati's; parrot-coloured the Vâjins; speckled Agni-Maruts; dark-coloured Pûshan's.

verses.sanskrit: एता॑ ऐन्द्रा॒ग्ना द्वि॑रू॒पा अ॑ग्नीषो॒मीया॑ वाम॒ना अ॑न॒ड्वाह॑ आग्नावैष्ण॒वा व॒शा मै॑त्रावरु॒ण्योऽन्यत॑एन्यो मै॒त्र्यः॒ ॥
verses.transliteration: etā aindrāgnā dvirūpā agnīṣomīyā vāmanā anaḍvāha āgnāvaiṣṇavā vaśā maitrāvaruṇyo'nyataenyo maitryaḥ ||
verses.translation: Variegated, Indra-Agni's; two-coloured, Agni-Soma's; dwarf oxen, Agni-Vishnu's; barren cows, Mitra-Varuna's; partly variegated, Mitra's.

verses.sanskrit: कृ॒ष्णग्री॑वा आग्ने॒या ब॒भ्रवः॑ सौ॒म्याः श्वे॒ता वा॑य॒व्या अवि॑ज्ञाता॒ अदि॑त्यै॒ सरू॑पा धा॒त्रे व॑त्सत॒र्यो॒ दे॒वानां॒ पत्नी॑भ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyā babhravaḥ saumyāḥ śvetā vāyavyā avijñātā adityai sarūpā dhātre vatsataryo devānāṃ patnībhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: Black-necked ones, Agni's; brown, Soma's; white, Vâyu's; undistinguished, Aditi's; self-coloured, Dhâtar's; weanlings, the Gods Consorts.

verses.sanskrit: कृ॒ष्णा भौ॒मा धू॒म्रा आ॑न्तरि॒क्षा बृ॒हन्तो॑ दि॒व्याः श॒बला॑ वैद्यु॒ताः सि॒ध्मास्ता॑र॒काः ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛṣṇā bhaumā dhūmrā āntarikṣā bṛhanto divyāḥ śabalā vaidyutāḥ sidhmāstārakāḥ ||
verses.translation: Black ones for Earth; smoke-coloured for Firmament; tall ones for Sky; brindled ones for Lightning; blotched ones for Stars.

verses.sanskrit: धू॒म्रान्व॑स॒न्तायाल॑भते श्वे॒तान्ग्री॒ष्माय॑ कृ॒ष्णान्व॒र्षाभ्यो॑ऽरु॒णाञ्छ॒रदे॒ पृष॑तो हेम॒न्ताय॑ पि॒शङ्गा॒ञ्छिशि॑राय ॥
verses.transliteration: dhūmrānvasantāyālabhate śvetāngrīṣmāya kṛṣṇānvarṣābhyo'ruṇāñcharade pṛṣato hemantāya piśaṅgāñchiśirāya ||
verses.translation: Smoke-coloured ones he sacrifices to Spring; white to Summer; black to the Rains; red ones to Autumn; speckled to Winter; reddish-yellow to the Dewy Season.

verses.sanskrit: त्र्यव॑यो गाय॒त्र्यै पञ्चा॑वयस्त्रि॒ष्टुभे॑ दित्य॒वाहो॒ जग॑त्यै त्रिव॒त्सा अ॑नु॒ष्टुभे॑ तुर्य॒वाह॑ उ॒ष्णिहे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: tryavayo gāyatryai pañcāvayastriṣṭubhe dityavāho jagatyai trivatsā anuṣṭubhe turyavāha uṣṇihe ||
verses.translation: Calves eighteen months old to Gâyatrî; steers of two and a half years to Trishtup; two year old steers to Jagatî; three year olds to Anushtup; four year olds to Ushnih.

verses.sanskrit: प॒ष्ठ॒वाहो॑ वि॒राज॑ उ॒क्षाणो॑ बृह॒त्या ऋ॑ष॒भाः क॒कुभे॑ऽन॒ड्वाहः॑ प॒ङ्क्त्यै धे॒नवो॑ऽतिच्छन्दसे ॥
verses.transliteration: paṣṭhavāho virāja ukṣāṇo bṛhatyā ṛṣabhāḥ kakubhe'naḍvāhaḥ paṅktyai dhenavo'ticchandase ||
verses.translation: Four year old steers to Virâj; full grown bulls to Brihatî; strong bulls to Kakup; draught oxen to Pankti; milch-cows to Atichhandas.

verses.sanskrit:
कृ॒ष्णग्री॑वा आग्ने॒या ब॒भ्रवः॑ सौ॒म्या उ॑पध्व॒स्ताः सा॑वि॒त्रा व॑त्सत॒र्यः॒ सारस्व॒त्यः॒ श्या॒माः पौ॒ष्णाः पृश्न॑यो मारु॒ता ब॑हुरू॒पा वै॑श्वदे॒वा व॒शा
द्या॑वापृथि॒वीयाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
kṛṣṇagrīvā āgneyā babhravaḥ saumyā upadhvastāḥ sāvitrā vatsataryaḥ sārasvatyaḥ śyāmāḥ pauṣṇāḥ pṛśnayo mārutā bahurūpā vaiśvadevā vaśā
dyāvāpṛthivīyāḥ ||
verses.translation: Black-necked victims sacred to Agni; brown to Soma; spotted to Savitar; weaned she-kids to Sarasvatî; dark-coloured goats to Pûshan; speckled victims to the Maruts; many-coloured to the All-Gods; barren cows to Heaven and Earth.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒क्ताः स॑ञ्च॒रा एता॑ ऐन्द्रा॒ग्नाः कृ॒ष्णाः वा॑रु॒णाः पृश्न॑यो मारु॒ताः का॒यास्तू॑प॒राः ॥
verses.transliteration: uktāḥ sañcarā etā aindrāgnāḥ kṛṣṇāḥ vāruṇāḥ pṛśnayo mārutāḥ kāyāstūparāḥ ||
verses.translation: Called contemporary, the dappled belong to Indra-Agni; black ones to Varuna; speckled to the Maruts; hornless he-goats to Ka.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्नयेऽनी॑कवते प्रथम॒जानाल॑भते म॒रुद्भ्यः॑ सान्तप॒नेभ्यः॑ सवा॒त्यान्म॒रुद्भ्यो॑ गृहमे॒धिभ्यो॒ बष्कि॑हान्म॒रुद्भ्यः॑ क्री॒डिभ्यः॑ सᳪसृ॒ष्टान्म॒रुद्भ्यः॒
स्वत॑वद्भ्योऽनुसृ॒ष्टान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnaye'nīkavate prathamajānālabhate marudbhyaḥ sāntapanebhyaḥ savātyānmarudbhyo gṛhamedhibhyo baṣkihānmarudbhyaḥ krīḍibhyaḥ saṃsṛṣṭānmarudbhyaḥ
svatavadbhyo'nusṛṣṭān ||
verses.translation: To Agni foremost in place he sacrifices firstling goats; to the consuming Maruts those born of one mother; to the Maruts who perform domestic rites those born after a long time; to the sportive Maruts those born together; to the self-strong Maruts those born in succession.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒क्ताः स॑ञ्च॒रा एता॑ ऐन्द्रा॒ग्नाः प्रा॑शृ॒ङ्गा मा॑हे॒न्द्रा ब॑हुरू॒पा वै॑श्वकर्म॒णाः ॥
verses.transliteration: uktāḥ sañcarā etā aindrāgnāḥ prāśṛṅgā māhendrā bahurūpā vaiśvakarmaṇāḥ ||
verses.translation: Called contemporaneous, the dappled belonging to Indra-Agni; those with projecting horns to Mahendra; the many-coloured to Visvakarman.

verses.sanskrit:
धू॒म्रा ब॒भ्रुनी॑काशाः पितॄ॒णाᳪ सोम॑वतां ब॒भ्रवो॑ धू॒म्रनी॑काशाः पितॄ॒णां ब॑र्हि॒षदां॑ कृ॒ष्णा ब॒भ्रुनी॑काशाः पितॄ॒णाम॑ग्निष्वा॒त्तानां॑ कृ॒ष्णाः
पृष॑न्तस्त्रैयम्ब॒काः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhūmrā babhrunīkāśāḥ pitṝṇāṃ somavatāṃ babhravo dhūmranīkāśāḥ pitṝṇāṃ barhiṣadāṃ kṛṣṇā babhrunīkāśāḥ pitṝṇāmagniṣvāttānāṃ kṛṣṇāḥ
pṛṣantastraiyambakāḥ ||
verses.translation: Smoke-coloured, those of brownish hue, to be offered to the Soma-possessing Fathers; the brown and the smoky-looking to the Fathers who sit on sacred grass; the black and the brownish-looking to the Fathers who have been tasted by Agni; the black and the spotted belong to Tryambaka.

verses.transliteration: uktāḥ sañcarā etāḥ śunāsīrīyāḥ śvetā vāyavyāḥ śvetāḥ sauryāḥ ||
verses.translation: Called contemporaneous, the dappled belong to Suna and Sîra; white ones to Vâyu; white ones to Sûrya.

verses.sanskrit: व॒स॒न्ताय॑ क॒पिञ्ज॑ला॒नाल॑भते ग्री॒ष्माय॑ कल॒विङ्का॑न्व॒र्षाभ्य॑स्ति॒त्तिरी॑ञ्छ॒रदे॒ वर्ति॑का हेम॒न्ताय॒ कक॑रा॒ञ्छिशि॑राय॒ विक॑करान् ॥
verses.transliteration: vasantāya kapiñjalānālabhate grīṣmāya kalaviṅkānvarṣābhyastittirīñcharade vartikā hemantāya kakarāñchiśirāya vikakarān ||
verses.translation: To Spring he offers Kapiñjalas; to Summer sparrows; to the Rains partridges; to Autumn quails; to Winter. Kakaras; to the Dewy Season Vikakaras.

verses.sanskrit: स॒मु॒द्राय॑ शिशु॒मारा॒नाल॑भते प॒र्जन्या॑य म॒ण्डूका॑न॒द्भ्यो मत्स्या॑न्मि॒त्राय॑ कुली॒पया॒न्वरु॑णाय ना॒क्रान् ॥
verses.transliteration: samudrāya śiśumārānālabhate parjanyāya maṇḍūkānadbhyo matsyānmitrāya kulīpayānvaruṇāya nākrān ||
verses.translation: To the Sea he sacrifices porpoises; to Parjanya frogs; to the Waters fishes; to Mitra Kulîpayas; to Varuna crocodiles.

verses.sanskrit: सोमा॑य ह॒ᳪसानाल॑भते वा॒यवे॑ ब॒लाका॑ इन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्यां॒ क्रुञ्चा॑न्मि॒त्राय॑ म॒द्गून्वरु॑णाय चक्रवा॒कान् ॥
verses.transliteration: somāya haṃsānālabhate vāyave balākā indrāgnibhyāṃ kruñcānmitrāya madgūnvaruṇāya cakravākān ||
verses.translation: To Soma he sacrifices wild geese; to Vâyu female cranes; to Indra-Agni curlews; to Mitra divers; to Varuna Chakravâkas.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नये॑ कु॒टरू॒नाल॑भते॒ वन॒स्पति॑भ्य॒ उलू॑कान॒ग्नीषोमा॑भ्यां॒ चाषा॑न॒श्विभ्यां॑ म॒यूरा॑न्मि॒त्रावरु॑णाभ्यां क॒पोता॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration: agnaye kuṭarūnālabhate vanaspatibhya ulūkānagnīṣomābhyāṃ cāṣānaśvibhyāṃ mayūrānmitrāvaruṇābhyāṃ kapotān ||
verses.translation: To Agni he sacrifices cocks; to Vanaspatis owls; to Agni-Soma blue jays; to the Asvins peacocks; to Mitra-Varuna pigeons.

verses.sanskrit: सोमा॑य ल॒बानाल॑भते॒ त्वष्ट्रे॑ कौली॒कान्गो॑षा॒दीर्दे॒वानां॒ पत्नी॑भ्यः कु॒लीका॑ देवजा॒मिभ्यो॒ऽग्नये॑ गृ॒हप॑तये पारु॒ष्णान् ॥
verses.transliteration: somāya labānālabhate tvaṣṭre kaulīkāngoṣādīrdevānāṃ patnībhyaḥ kulīkā devajāmibhyo'gnaye gṛhapataye pāruṣṇān ||
verses.translation: To Soma he sacrifices quails; to Tvashtar Kaulîkas; Mainas to the Gods Consorts; Kulîkas to the Gods Sisters; Pârushnas to Agni Lord of the Homestead.

verses.sanskrit: अह्ने॑ पा॒राव॑ता॒नाल॑भते॒ रात्र्यै॑ सीचा॒पूर॑होरा॒त्रयोः॑ स॒न्धिभ्यो॑ ज॒तूर्मासे॑भ्यो दात्यौ॒हान्त्सं॑वत्स॒राय॑ मह॒तः सु॑प॒र्णान् ॥
verses.transliteration: ahne pārāvatānālabhate rātryai sīcāpūrahorātrayoḥ sandhibhyo jatūrmāsebhyo dātyauhāntsaṃvatsarāya mahataḥ suparṇān ||
verses.translation: To Day he sacrifices doves; to Night Sîchâpûs; to the Joints of Day and Night bats; to the Months gallinules; to the Year great eagles.

verses.sanskrit: भूम्या॑ आ॒खूनाल॑भते॒ऽन्तरि॑क्षाय पा॒ङ्क्त्रान्दि॒वे कशा॑न्दि॒ग्भ्यो न॑कु॒लान्बभ्रु॑कानवान्तरदि॒शाभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: bhūmyā ākhūnālabhate'ntarikṣāya pāṅktrāndive kaśāndigbhyo nakulānbabhrukānavāntaradiśābhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: To Ground he sacrifices rats; to Firmament field-rats; to Day voles; to the Quarters mungooses; to the Intermediate Spaces brownish ichneumons.

verses.sanskrit: वसु॑भ्य॒ ऋश्या॒नाल॑भते रु॒द्रेभ्यो॒ रुरू॑नादि॒त्येभ्यो॒ न्यङ्कू॒॒न्विश्वे॑भ्यो दे॒वेभ्यः॑ पृष॒तान्त्सा॒ध्येभ्यः॑ कुलु॒ङ्गान् ॥
verses.transliteration: vasubhya ṛśyānālabhate rudrebhyo rurūnādityebhyo nyaṅkūnviśvebhyo devebhyaḥ pṛṣatāntsādhyebhyaḥ kuluṅgān ||
verses.translation: To the Vasus he sacrifices black-bucks; to the Rudras stags; to the Âdityas Nyanku deer; to the All-Gods spotted deer; to the Sâdhyas Kulinga antelopes,

verses.sanskrit: ईशा॑नाय॒ पर॑स्वत॒ आल॑भते मि॒त्राय॑ गौ॒रान्वरु॑णाय महि॒षान्बृह॒स्पत॑ये गव॒याँस्त्वष्ट्र॒ उष्ट्रा॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration: īśānāya parasvata ālabhate mitrāya gaurānvaruṇāya mahiṣānbṛhaspataye gavayām̐stvaṣṭra uṣṭrān ||
verses.translation: To Îsâna he sacrifices wild asses; to Mitra Gauras; to Varuna buffaloes; to Brihaspati Gayals; to Tvashtar camels.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒जाप॑तये॒ पुरु॑षान्ह॒स्तिन॒ आल॑भते वा॒चे प्लुषीँ॒श्चक्षु॑षे म॒शका॒ञ्छ्रोत्रा॑य॒ भृङ्गाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: prajāpataye puruṣānhastina ālabhate vāce pluṣīm̐ścakṣuṣe maśakāñchrotrāya bhṛṅgāḥ ||
verses.translation: To Prajâpati he sacrifices men elephants; to Vâk white ants; to Sight flies; to Hearing black bees.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒जाप॑तये च वा॒यवे॑ च गोमृ॒गो वरु॑णायार॒ण्यो मे॒षो य॒माय॒ कृष्णो॑ मनुष्यरा॒जाय॑ म॒र्कटः॑ शार्दू॒लाय॑ रो॒हिदृ॑ष॒भाय॑ गव॒यी क्षि॑प्रश्ये॒नाय॒ वर्ति॑का॒ नील॑ङ्गोः॒ कृमिः॑ समु॒द्राय॑ शिशु॒मारो॑ हि॒मव॑ते ह॒स्ती ॥
verses.transliteration: prajāpataye ca vāyave ca gomṛgo varuṇāyāraṇyo meṣo yamāya kṛṣṇo manuṣyarājāya markaṭaḥ śārdūlāya rohidṛṣabhāya gavayī kṣipraśyenāya vartikā nīlaṅgoḥ kṛmiḥ samudrāya śiśumāro himavate hastī ||
verses.translation: To Prajâpati and to Vâyu a Gayal is to be offered; to Varuna a wild ram; to Yama a black ram; to a human king a monkey; to the Tiger a red doe; to the Bull a female Gayal, to the Kshiprasyena a quail; to the Nilangu a worm; to the Sea a porpoise; to the Snowy Mountain an elephant.

verses.sanskrit: म॒युः प्रा॑जाप॒त्य उ॒लो ह॒लिक्ष्णो॑ वृषद॒ᳪशस्ते धा॒त्रे दि॒शां क॒ङ्को धुङ्क्षा॑ग्ने॒यी क॑ल॒विङ्को॑ लोहिता॒हिः पु॑ष्करसा॒दस्ते त्वा॒ष्ट्रा वा॒चे क्रुञ्चः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: mayuḥ prājāpatya ulo halikṣṇo vṛṣadaṃśaste dhātre diśāṃ kaṅko dhuṅkṣāgneyī kalaviṅko lohitāhiḥ puṣkarasādaste tvāṣṭrā vāce kruñcaḥ ||
verses.translation: The Kinnara belongs to Prajâpati; the Ula, the Halikshna, the cat belong to Dhâtar; the heron belongs to the Quarters; the Dhunkshâ to Agni; sparrow, red snake, Sâras, these are Tvashtar's; the curlew belongs to Vâk.

verses.sanskrit:
सोमा॑य कुलु॒ङ्ग आ॑र॒ण्योऽजो न॑कु॒लः शका॒ ते पौ॒ष्णाः क्रो॒ष्टा मा॒योरिन्द्र॑स्य गौरमृ॒गः पि॒द्वो न्यङ्कुः॑ कक्क॒टस्तेऽनु॑मत्यै प्रति॒श्रुत्का॑यै
चक्रवा॒कः ॥
verses.transliteration:
somāya kuluṅga āraṇyo'jo nakulaḥ śakā te pauṣṇāḥ kroṣṭā māyorindrasya gauramṛgaḥ pidvo nyaṅkuḥ kakkaṭaste'numatyai pratiśrutkāyai
cakravākaḥ ||
verses.translation: To Soma an antelope is to be offered; wild goat, mungoose, Sakâ. these are Pûshan's; the jackal is the Mâyu's; the Gaura Indra's; Pidva, antelope, cock, these are Anumati's; the Chakravâka is for Echo.

verses.sanskrit:
सौ॒री ब॒लाका॑ शा॒र्गः सृ॑ज॒यः श॒याण्ड॑क॒स्ते मै॒त्राः सर॑स्वत्यै॒ शारिः॑ पुरुष॒वाक् श्वा॒विद्भौ॒मी शा॑र्दू॒लो वृकः॒ पृदा॑कु॒स्ते म॒न्यवे॒ सर॑स्वते॒ शुकः॑
पुरुष॒वाक् ॥
verses.transliteration:
saurī balākā śārgaḥ sṛjayaḥ śayāṇḍakaste maitrāḥ sarasvatyai śāriḥ puruṣavāk śvāvidbhaumī śārdūlo vṛkaḥ pṛdākuste manyave sarasvate śukaḥ
puruṣavāk ||
verses.translation: The female crane is Sûrya's; Sârga, Srijays, Sayândaka, these are Mitra's; to Sarasvatî belongs the human-voiced Maina; to Ground the porcupine; tiger, wolf, viper belong to Passion; to Sarasvân the human-voiced parrot.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒प॒र्णः पा॑र्ज॒न्य आ॒तिर्वा॑ह॒सो दर्वि॑दा॒ ते वा॒यवे॒ बृह॒स्पत॑ये वा॒चस्पत॑ये पैङ्गरा॒जो॒ऽल॒ज आ॑न्तरि॒क्षः प्ल॒वो म॒द्गुर्मत्स्य॒स्ते न॑दीप॒त॑ये द्यावापृथि॒वीयः॑
कू॒र्मः ॥
verses.transliteration:
suparṇaḥ pārjanya ātirvāhaso darvidā te vāyave bṛhaspataye vācaspataye paiṅgarājo'laja āntarikṣaḥ plavo madgurmatsyaste nadīpataye dyāvāpṛthivīyaḥ
kūrmaḥ ||
verses.translation: The eagle is Parjanya's; the Âti, the Vâhasa, the wood-pecker, these are for Vâyu; for Brihaspati Lord of Speech is the Paingarâja; the Alaja belongs to Firmament; pelican, cormorant, fish, these belong to the Lord of Rivers; the tortoise belongs to Heaven and Earth.

verses.sanskrit:
पु॒रु॒ष॒मृ॒गश्च॒न्द्रम॑सो गो॒धा काल॑का दार्वाघा॒टस्ते वन॒स्पती॑नां कृक॒वाकुः॑ सावि॒त्रो ह॒ᳪसो वात॑स्य ना॒क्रो मक॑रः कुली॒पय॒स्तेऽकू॑पारस्य ह्रि॒यै
शल्य॑कः ॥
verses.transliteration:
puruṣamṛgaścandramaso godhā kālakā dārvāghāṭaste vanaspatīnāṃ kṛkavākuḥ sāvitro haṃso vātasya nākro makaraḥ kulīpayaste'kūpārasya hriyai
śalyakaḥ ||
verses.translation: The book belongs to the Moon; iguana, Kâlakâ, woodpecker, these belong to the Vanaspatis; the cock belongs to Savitar; the swan is Vâta's; crocodile, dolphin, Kulîpaya, these belong to the Sea; the porcupine to Modesty.

verses.sanskrit: ए॒ण्यह्नो॑ म॒ण्डूको॒ मूषि॑का ति॒त्तिरि॒स्ते स॒र्पाणां॑ लोपा॒श आ॑श्वि॒नः कृष्णो॒ रात्र्या॒ ऋक्षो॑ ज॒तूः सु॑षि॒लीका॒ त इ॑तरज॒नानां॒ जह॑का वैष्ण॒वी ॥
verses.transliteration: eṇyahno maṇḍūko mūṣikā tittiriste sarpāṇāṃ lopāśa āśvinaḥ kṛṣṇo rātryā ṛkṣo jatūḥ suṣilīkā ta itarajanānāṃ jahakā vaiṣṇavī ||
verses.translation: The Black-doe belongs to Day; frog, female rat, partridge, these belong to the Serpents; the jackal belongs to the Asvins; the Black-buck to Night; bear, bat, Sushilikâ, these belong to the Other Folk (i.e. fairies--JBH); the polecat belongs to Vishnu.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒न्य॒वा॒पो॒ऽर्धमा॒साना॒मृश्यो॑ म॒यूरः॑ सुप॒र्णस्ते ग॑न्ध॒र्वाणा॑म॒पामु॒द्रो मा॒सां क॒श्यपो॑ रो॒हित्कु॑ण्डृ॒णाची॑ गो॒लत्ति॑का॒ ते॑ऽप्स॒रसां॑ मृ॒त्यवे॑ऽसि॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration: anyavāpo'rdhamāsānāmṛśyo mayūraḥ suparṇaste gandharvāṇāmapāmudro māsāṃ kaśyapo rohitkuṇḍṛṇācī golattikā te'psarasāṃ mṛtyave'sitaḥ ||
verses.translation: The cuckoo belongs to the Half Months; antelope, peacock, eagle, these are the Gandharvas; the otter belongs to the Months; tortoise, doe-antelope, iguana, Golathikâ belong to the Apsarases; the black snake belongs to Death.

verses.sanskrit: व॒र्षा॒हूरृ॒तू॒ना॑मा॒खुः कशो॑ मान्था॒लस्ते पि॑तॄ॒णां बला॑याजग॒रो वसू॑नां क॒पिञ्ज॑लः क॒पोत॒ उलू॑कः श॒शस्ते निरृ॑त्यै॒ वरु॑णायार॒ण्यो मे॒षः ॥
verses.transliteration: varṣāhūrṛtūnāmākhuḥ kaśo mānthālaste pitṝṇāṃ balāyājagaro vasūnāṃ kapiñjalaḥ kapota ulūkaḥ śaśaste nirṛtyai varuṇāyāraṇyo meṣaḥ ||
verses.translation: The frog belongs to the Seasons; the vole, the rat, the mouse, these are the Fathers; the Python, the Balâva belong to the Vasus; Kapiñjala, pigeons owl, hare belong to Nirriti; the wild ram to Varuna.

verses.sanskrit: श्वि॒त्र आ॑दि॒त्याना॒मुष्ट्रो॒ घृणी॑वान्वार्ध्रीन॒सस्ते म॒त्या अर॑ण्याय सृम॒रो रुरू॑ रौ॒द्रः क्वयिः॑ कु॒टरु॑र्दात्यौ॒हस्ते वा॒जिनां॒ कामा॑य पि॒कः ॥
verses.transliteration: śvitra ādityānāmuṣṭro ghṛṇīvānvārdhrīnasaste matyā araṇyāya sṛmaro rurū raudraḥ kvayiḥ kuṭarurdātyauhaste vājināṃ kāmāya pikaḥ ||
verses.translation: The white animal belongs to the Âdityas; the camel, the Ghrintîvân, the rhinoceros to Mati; the Srimara belong to the Forest-God; the Raru buck is Rudra's; Kvayi, cock, gallinule, these are the Vâjins; the cuckoo belongs to Kâma.

verses.sanskrit:
ख॒ङ्गो वै॑श्वदे॒वः श्वा कृ॒ष्णः क॒र्णो ग॑र्द॒भस्त॒रक्षु॒स्ते रक्ष॑सा॒मिन्द्रा॑य सूक॒रः सि॒ᳪहो मा॑रु॒तः कृ॑कला॒सः पिप्प॑का श॒कुनि॒स्ते श॑र॒व्या॒यै॒ विश्वे॑षां दे॒वानां॑
पृष॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
khaṅgo vaiśvadevaḥ śvā kṛṣṇaḥ karṇo gardabhastarakṣuste rakṣasāmindrāya sūkaraḥ siṃho mārutaḥ kṛkalāsaḥ pippakā śakuniste śaravyāyai viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ
pṛṣataḥ ||
verses.translation: The Khanga is the All-Gods'; the black dog, the long eared, the ass, the hyena, these are the Râkshasas; the boar is for Indra; the lion is for the Maruts; the chameleon, the Pipoaka, the vulture, these belong to Saravyâ; the spotted antelope belongs to the All-Gods.

verses.sanskrit: शादं॑ द॒द्भिरव॑कां दन्तमूलै॒र्मृदं॒ बर्स्वै॑स्ते॒गान्दᳪष्ट्रा॑भ्या॒ᳪ सर॑स्वत्या अग्रजि॒ह्वं जि॒ह्वाया॑ उत्सा॒दम॑वक्र॒न्देन॒ तालु॒ वाज॒ᳪ हनु॑भ्याम॒प आ॒स्ये॒न॒ वृष॑णमा॒ण्डाभ्या॑मादि॒त्याँ श्मश्रु॑भिः॒ पन्था॑नं भ्रू॒भ्यां द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वर्तो॑भ्यां वि॒द्युतं॑ क॒नीन॑काभ्याᳪ शु॒क्लाय॒ स्वाहा॑ कृ॒ष्णाय॒ स्वाहा॒ पार्या॑णि॒ पक्ष्मा॑ण्यवा॒र्या॒ इ॒क्षवो॑ऽवा॒र्या॒णि॒ पक्ष्मा॑णि॒ पार्या॑ इ॒क्षवः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: śādaṃ dadbhiravakāṃ dantamūlairmṛdaṃ barsvaistegāndaṃṣṭrābhyāṃ sarasvatyā agrajihvaṃ jihvāyā utsādamavakrandena tālu vājaṃ hanubhyāmapa āsyena vṛṣaṇamāṇḍābhyāmādityām̐ śmaśrubhiḥ panthānaṃ bhrūbhyāṃ dyāvāpṛthivī vartobhyāṃ vidyutaṃ kanīnakābhyāṃ śuklāya svāhā kṛṣṇāya svāhā pāryāṇi pakṣmāṇyavāryā ikṣavo'vāryāṇi pakṣmāṇi pāryā ikṣavaḥ ||
verses.translation: I GRATIFY Fresh Grass with his teeth, Avakâ with his gums, Clay with his tooth-sockets, Tegas with his fangs. The tongue-tip for Sarasvatî; I gratify the root of the tongue and the palate with his neigh, Vâja with his jaws, the Waters with his mouth, the Stallion with his testicles, the Âdityas with the beard, Path with his eyebrows, Heaven and Earth with his eyelashes, Lightning with the pupils of his eyes. Hail to the white! Hail to the black! Effectual are his eyelashes, irresistible are his lower eyelashes; irresistible are his eyelashes, effectual are his lower eyelashes.

verses.sanskrit: वातं॑ प्रा॒णेना॑पा॒नेन॒ नासि॑के उपया॒ममध॑रे॒णौष्ठे॑न॒ सदुत्त॑रेण प्रका॒शेनान्त॑रमनूका॒शेन॒ बाह्यं॑ निवे॒ष्यं मू॒र्ध्ना स्त॑नयि॒त्नुं नि॑र्बा॒धेना॒शनिं॑ म॒स्तिष्के॑ण वि॒द्युतं॑ क॒नीन॑काभ्यां॒ कर्णा॑भ्या॒ᳪ श्रोत्रँ॒ श्रोत्रा॑भ्यां॒ कर्णौ॑ तेद॒नीम॑धरक॒ण्ठेना॒पः शु॑ष्कक॒ण्ठेन॑ चि॒त्तं मन्या॑भि॒रदि॑तिᳪ शी॒र्ष्णा निरृ॑तिं॒ निर्ज॑र्जल्येन शी॒र्ष्णा सं॑क्रोशैः प्रा॒णान् रेष्माण॑ᳪ स्तु॒पेन॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vātaṃ prāṇenāpānena nāsike upayāmamadhareṇauṣṭhena saduttareṇa prakāśenāntaramanūkāśena bāhyaṃ niveṣyaṃ mūrdhnā stanayitnuṃ nirbādhenāśaniṃ mastiṣkeṇa vidyutaṃ kanīnakābhyāṃ karṇābhyāṃ śrotram̐ śrotrābhyāṃ karṇau tedanīmadharakaṇṭhenāpaḥ śuṣkakaṇṭhena cittaṃ manyābhiraditiṃ śīrṣṇā nirṛtiṃ nirjarjalyena śīrṣṇā saṃkrośaiḥ prāṇān reṣmāṇaṃ stupena ||
verses.translation: With his breath I gratify Vâta; with his outbreath the two Nostrils; with his lower lip the Upayâma; with his upper lip Existence. With his bright look I please Antara, with his reflection Bâhya; the Whirlpool with his head; Thunder with his frontal bone; the Lightning-flash with his brain; Lightning with the pupils of his eyes; Hearing with his external ears; Ears with his internal ears; Blood with his lower neck; Waters with the fleshless part of his neck; Thought with the back neck-tendons; Aditi with his head; Nirriti with his ragged head; Vital Breathings with his roars; Tempest with his crest.

verses.sanskrit: म॒शका॒न् केशै॒रिन्द्र॒ᳪ स्वप॑सा॒ वहे॑न॒ बृह॒स्पति॑ᳪ शकुनिसा॒देन॑ कू॒र्माञ्छ॒फैरा॒क्रम॑णᳪ स्थू॒राभ्या॑मृ॒क्षला॑भिः क॒पिञ्ज॑लाञ्ज॒वं जङ्घा॑भ्या॒मध्वा॑नं बा॒हुभ्यां॒ जाम्बी॑ले॒नार॑ण्यम॒ग्निम॑ति॒रुग्भ्यां॑ पू॒षणं॑ दो॒र्भ्याम॒श्विना॒वᳪसा॑भ्याᳪ रु॒द्रᳪ रोरा॑भ्याम् ॥
verses.transliteration: maśakān keśairindraṃ svapasā vahena bṛhaspatiṃ śakunisādena kūrmāñchaphairākramaṇaṃ sthūrābhyāmṛkṣalābhiḥ kapiñjalāñjavaṃ jaṅghābhyāmadhvānaṃ bāhubhyāṃ jāmbīlenāraṇyamagnimatirugbhyāṃ pūṣaṇaṃ dorbhyāmaśvināvaṃsābhyāṃ rudraṃ rorābhyām ||
verses.translation: I gratify Flies with his hair; Indra with his active shoulder; Brihaspati with his quick spring; Tortoises with his hoofs; Approach with his fetlocks; Kapiñjalas with his heel-ropes; Speed with his two thighs; the Way with his two fore-legs; the Forest-God with a kneepan; Agni with his two knees; Pûshan with his two fore-feet; the Asvins with his shoulders; Rudra with his shoulder-joints,

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नेः प॑क्ष॒तिर्वा॒योर्निप॑क्षति॒रिन्द्र॑स्य तृ॒तीया॒ सोम॑स्य चतु॒र्थ्यदि॑त्यै पञ्च॒मीन्द्रा॒ण्यै ष॒ष्ठी म॒रुता॑ᳪ सप्त॒मी बृह॒स्पते॑रष्ट॒म्य॒र्य॒म्णो न॑व॒मी धा॒तुर्द॑श॒मीन्द्र॑स्यैकाद॒शी वरु॑णस्य द्वाद॒शी य॒मस्य॑ त्रयोद॒शी ॥
verses.transliteration: agneḥ pakṣatirvāyornipakṣatirindrasya tṛtīyā somasya caturthyadityai pañcamīndrāṇyai ṣaṣṭhī marutāṃ saptamī bṛhaspateraṣṭamyaryamṇo navamī dhāturdaśamīndrasyaikādaśī varuṇasya dvādaśī yamasya trayodaśī ||
verses.translation: The first rib is Agni's; the second Vâyu's; the third Indra's; the fourth Soma's; the fifth Aditi's; the sixth Indrânî's; the seventh the Maruts; the eighth Brihaspati's; the ninth Aryaman's; the tenth Dhâtar's; the eleventh Indra's; the twelfth Varuna's; the thirteenth Yama's.

verses.sanskrit: इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्न्योः प॑क्ष॒तिः सर॑स्वत्यै॒ निप॑क्षतिर्मि॒त्रस्य॑ तृ॒तीया॒पां च॑तु॒र्थी निरृ॑त्यै पञ्च॒म्यग्नीषोम॑योः ष॒ष्ठी स॒र्पाणा॑ᳪ सप्त॒मी विष्णो॑रष्ट॒मी पू॒ष्णो न॑व॒मी त्वष्टु॑र्दश॒मीन्द्र॑स्यैकाद॒शी वरु॑णस्य द्वाद॒शी य॒म्यै त्र॑योद॒शी द्यावा॑पृथि॒व्योर्दक्षि॑णं पा॒र्श्वं विश्वे॑षां दे॒वाना॒मुत्त॑रम् ॥
verses.transliteration: indrāgnyoḥ pakṣatiḥ sarasvatyai nipakṣatirmitrasya tṛtīyāpāṃ caturthī nirṛtyai pañcamyagnīṣomayoḥ ṣaṣṭhī sarpāṇāṃ saptamī viṣṇoraṣṭamī pūṣṇo navamī tvaṣṭurdaśamīndrasyaikādaśī varuṇasya dvādaśī yamyai trayodaśī dyāvāpṛthivyordakṣiṇaṃ pārśvaṃ viśveṣāṃ devānāmuttaram ||
verses.translation: (On the left side) the first rib belongs to Indra-Agni; the second to Sarasvatî; the third to Mitra; the fourth to the Waters; the fifth to Nirriti; the sixth to Agni-Soma; the seventh to the Serpents; the eighth to Vishnu; the ninth to Pûshan; the tenth to Tvashtar; the eleventh to Indra; the twelfth to Varuna; the thirteenth to Yama. The right flank belongs to Heaven and Earth, the left to the All-Gods.

verses.sanskrit: म॒रुता॑ᳪ स्कन्धा॒ विश्वे॑षां दे॒वानां॑ प्रथ॒मा कीक॑सा रु॒द्राणां॑ द्वि॒तीया॑ऽऽदि॒त्यानां॑ तृ॒तीया॑ वा॒योः पुच्छ॑म॒ग्नीषोम॑यो॒र्भास॑दौ॒ क्रुञ्चौ॒ श्रोणि॑भ्या॒मिन्द्रा॒बृह॒स्पती॑ ऊ॒रुभ्यां॑ मि॒त्रावरु॑णाव॒ल्गाभ्या॑मा॒क्रम॑णᳪ स्थू॒राभ्यां॒ बलं॒ कुष्ठा॑भ्याम् ॥
verses.transliteration: marutāṃ skandhā viśveṣāṃ devānāṃ prathamā kīkasā rudrāṇāṃ dvitīyā''dityānāṃ tṛtīyā vāyoḥ pucchamagnīṣomayorbhāsadau kruñcau śroṇibhyāmindrābṛhaspatī ūrubhyāṃ mitrāvaruṇāvalgābhyāmākramaṇaṃ sthūrābhyāṃ balaṃ kuṣṭhābhyām ||
verses.translation: The shoulders belong to the Maruts; the first rib-cartilages to the All-Gods; the second to the Rudras; the third to the Âdityas; the tail belongs to Vâyu; the hind-quarters to Agni-Soma. I gratify the two Curlews with the hips; Indra-Brihaspati with the thighs; Mitra-Varuna with the groins; Approach with the buttocks; Strength with the two cavities of the loins.

verses.sanskrit: पू॒षणं॑ वनि॒ष्ठुना॑ऽन्धा॒हीन्त्स्थू॑लगु॒दया॑ स॒र्पान्गुदा॑भिर्वि॒ह्रुत॑ आ॒न्त्रैर॒पो व॒स्तिना॒ वृष॑णमा॒ण्डाभ्यां॒ वाजि॑न॒ᳪ शेपे॑न प्र॒जाᳪ रेत॑सा॒ चाषा॑न् पि॒त्तेन॑ प्रद॒रान् पा॒युना॑ कू॒श्माञ्छ॑कपिण्डैः ॥
verses.transliteration: pūṣaṇaṃ vaniṣṭhunā'ndhāhīntsthūlagudayā sarpāngudābhirvihruta āntrairapo vastinā vṛṣaṇamāṇḍābhyāṃ vājinaṃ śepena prajāṃ retasā cāṣān pittena pradarān pāyunā kūśmāñchakapiṇḍaiḥ ||
verses.translation: I gratify Pûshan with the rectum; Blind-worms with the large intestines; Serpents with the entrails; Worms with the guts; the Waters with the bladder; Scrotum with the testicles; the Vâjins with his penis; Offspring with his seed; Blue jays with his bile; Fissures with his arms; Kûshmas with his lumps of dung.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑स्य क्री॒डोऽदि॑त्यै पाज॒स्यं॒ दि॒शां ज॒त्रवोऽदि॑त्यै भ॒सज्जी॒मूता॑न् हृदयौप॒शेना॒न्तरि॑क्षं पुरी॒तता॒ नभ॑ उद॒र्ये॒ण चक्रवा॒कौ मत॑स्नाभ्यां॒ दिवं॑ वृ॒क्काभ्यां॑ गि॒रीन् प्ला॒शिभि॒रुप॑लान् प्ली॒ह्ना व॒ल्मीका॑न् क्लो॒मभि॑र्ग्लौ॒भिर्गुल्मा॑न् हि॒राभिः॒ स्रव॑न्तीर्ह्र॒दान् कु॒क्षिभ्या॑ᳪ समु॒द्रमु॒दरे॑ण वैश्वान॒रं भस्म॑ना ॥
verses.transliteration: indrasya krīḍo'dityai pājasyaṃ diśāṃ jatravo'dityai bhasajjīmūtān hṛdayaupaśenāntarikṣaṃ purītatā nabha udaryeṇa cakravākau matasnābhyāṃ divaṃ vṛkkābhyāṃ girīn plāśibhirupalān plīhnā valmīkān klomabhirglaubhirgulmān hirābhiḥ sravantīrhradān kukṣibhyāṃ samudramudareṇa vaiśvānaraṃ bhasmanā ||
verses.translation: His chest belongs to Indra; his belly to Aditi; his clavicles to the Quarters; his nether hind-part to Aditi. I gratify Clouds with his aorta; Firmament with his pericardium; Mist with his belly; the two Chakravâkas with his cardiac bones; Sky with his kidneys; Mountains with his ducts; hocks with his spleen; Ant-hills with his lungs; Shrubs with his heart-vessels; Streams with his veins; Lakes with his flanks; Sea with his belly; Vaisvânara with his ashes.

verses.sanskrit: विधृ॑तिं॒ नाभ्या॑ धृ॒तᳪ रसे॑ना॒पो यू॒ष्णा मरी॑चीर्वि॒प्रुड्भि॑र्नीहा॒रमू॒ष्मणा॑ शी॒नं वस॑या॒ प्रुष्वा॒ अश्रु॑भिर्ह्रा॒दुनी॑र्दू॒षीका॑भिर॒स्ना रक्षा॑ᳪसि चि॒त्राण्यङ्गै॒र्नक्ष॑त्राणि रू॒पेण॑ पृथि॒वीं त्व॒चा जु॑म्ब॒काय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vidhṛtiṃ nābhyā dhṛtaṃ rasenāpo yūṣṇā marīcīrvipruḍbhirnīhāramūṣmaṇā śīnaṃ vasayā pruṣvā aśrubhirhrādunīrdūṣīkābhirasnā rakṣāṃsi citrāṇyaṅgairnakṣatrāṇi rūpeṇa pṛthivīṃ tvacā jumbakāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: I gratify Separation with his navel; Butter with his flavour; the Waters with his broth; Sunbeams with his drops of fat; Hoar-frost with his heat; Ice with his marrow; Hailstones with his tears; Thunderbolts with the rheum of his eyes; Râkshasas with his blood; Bright things with his limbs; Stars with his beauty; Earth with his skin. All-hail to Jumbaka!

verses.sanskrit:
हि॒र॒ण्य॒ग॒र्भः सम॑वर्त॒ताग्रे॑ भू॒तस्य॑ जा॒तः पति॒रेक॑ आसीत् ।
स दा॑धार पृथि॒वीं द्यामु॒तेमां कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyagarbhaḥ samavartatāgre bhūtasya jātaḥ patireka āsīt |
sa dādhāra pṛthivīṃ dyāmutemāṃ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
verses.translation: In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, etc., as in XIII. 4; XXIII. 1.

verses.sanskrit:
यः प्रा॑ण॒तो नि॑मिष॒तो म॑हित्वैक॒ इद्राजा॒ जग॑तो ब॒भूव॑ ।
य ईशे॑ अ॒स्य द्वि॒पद॒श्चतु॑ष्पदः॒ कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaḥ prāṇato nimiṣato mahitvaika idrājā jagato babhūva |
ya īśe asya dvipadaścatuṣpadaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
verses.translation: Who by his grandeur, etc., as in XXIII. 3.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ये॒मे हि॒मव॑न्तो महि॒त्वा यस्य॑ समु॒द्रᳪ र॒सया॑ स॒हाहुः ।
यस्ये॒माः प्र॒दिशो॒ यस्य॑ बा॒हू कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasyeme himavanto mahitvā yasya samudraṃ rasayā sahāhuḥ |
yasyemāḥ pradiśo yasya bāhū kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
verses.translation: Whose, by his might, are these snow-covered mountains, and men call sea and Rasâ his possession: Whose are these arms, whose are these heavenly regions. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sanskrit:
य आ॑त्म॒दा ब॑ल॒दा यस्य॒ विश्व॑ उ॒पास॑ते प्र॒शिषं॒ यस्य॑ दे॒वाः ।
यस्य॑ छा॒यामृतं॒ यस्य॑ मृ॒त्युः कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya ātmadā baladā yasya viśva upāsate praśiṣaṃ yasya devāḥ |
yasya chāyāmṛtaṃ yasya mṛtyuḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
verses.translation: Giver of vital breath, of power and vigour, he whose commandment all the Gods acknowledge: The Lord of death, whose shade is life immortal. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sanskrit:
आ नो॑ भ॒द्राः क्रत॑वो यन्तु वि॒श्वतोऽद॑ब्धासो॒ अप॑रीतास उ॒द्भिदः॑ ।
दे॒वा नो॒ यथा॒ सद॒मिद् वृ॒धे अस॒न्नप्रा॑युवो रक्षि॒तारो॑ दि॒वे-दि॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā no bhadrāḥ kratavo yantu viśvato'dabdhāso aparītāsa udbhidaḥ |
devā no yathā sadamid vṛdhe asannaprāyuvo rakṣitāro dive-dive ||
verses.translation: May powers auspicious come to us from every side, never deceived, unhindered and victorious, That the Gods ever may be with us for our gain, our guardians day by day, unceasing in their care.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वानां॑ भ॒द्रा सु॑म॒तिरृ॑जूय॒तां दे॒वाना॑ᳪ रा॒तिर॒भि नो॒ निव॑र्तताम् ।
दे॒वाना॑ᳪ स॒ख्यमुप॑सेदिमा व॒यं दे॒वा न॒ आयुः॒ प्रति॑रन्तु जी॒वसे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devānāṃ bhadrā sumatirṛjūyatāṃ devānāṃ rātirabhi no nivartatām |
devānāṃ sakhyamupasedimā vayaṃ devā na āyuḥ pratirantu jīvase ||
verses.translation: May the auspicious favour of the Gods be ours, on us descend the bounty of the righteous Gods. The friendship of the Gods have we devoutly sought: so may the Gods extend our life that we may live.

verses.sanskrit:
तान्पूर्व॑या नि॒विदा॑ हूमहे व॒यं भगं॑ मि॒त्रमदि॑तिं॒ दक्ष॑म॒स्रिध॑म् ।
अ॒र्य॒मणं॒ वरु॑ण॒ᳪ सोम॑म॒श्विना॒ सर॑स्वती नः सु॒भगा॒ मय॑स्करत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tānpūrvayā nividā hūmahe vayaṃ bhagaṃ mitramaditiṃ dakṣamasridham |
aryamaṇaṃ varuṇaṃ somamaśvinā sarasvatī naḥ subhagā mayaskarat ||
verses.translation: We call them hither with a hymn of olden time, Bhaga, the friendly Daksha, Mitra, Aditi, Aryaman, Varuna, Soma, the Asvins. May Sarasvatî, auspicious, grant felicity.

verses.sanskrit:
तन्नो॒ वातो॑ मयो॒भु वा॑तु भेष॒जं तन्मा॒ता पृ॑थि॒वी तत्पि॒ता द्यौः॑ ।
तद् ग्रावा॑णः सोम॒सुतो॑ मयो॒भुव॒स्तद॑श्विना शृणुतं धिष्ण्या यु॒वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tanno vāto mayobhu vātu bheṣajaṃ tanmātā pṛthivī tatpitā dyauḥ |
tad grāvāṇaḥ somasuto mayobhuvastadaśvinā śṛṇutaṃ dhiṣṇyā yuvam ||
verses.translation: May the Wind waft to us that pleasant medicine, may Earth our Mother give it, and our Father Heaven, And the joy-giving stones that press the Soma's juice. Asvins, may ye, for whom our spirits long, hear this.

verses.sanskrit:
तमीशा॑नं॒ जग॑तस्त॒स्थुष॒स्पतिं॑ धियञ्जि॒न्वमव॑से हूमहे व॒यम् ।
पू॒षा नो॒ यथा॒ वेद॑सा॒मस॑द् वृ॒धे र॑क्षि॒ता पा॒युरद॑ब्धः स्व॒स्तये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tamīśānaṃ jagatastasthuṣaspatiṃ dhiyañjinvamavase hūmahe vayam |
pūṣā no yathā vedasāmasad vṛdhe rakṣitā pāyuradabdhaḥ svastaye ||
verses.translation: Him we invoke for aid who reigns supreme, the Lord of all that stands or moves, inspirer of the soul, That Pûshan may promote the increase of our wealth, our keeper and our guard infallible for our good.

verses.sanskrit:
स्व॒स्ति न॒ इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒द्धश्र॑वाः स्व॒स्ति नः॑ पू॒षा वि॒श्ववे॑दाः ।
स्व॒स्ति न॒स्तार्क्ष्यो॒ अरि॑ष्टनेमिः स्व॒स्ति नो॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र्दधातु ॥
verses.transliteration:
svasti na indro vṛddhaśravāḥ svasti naḥ pūṣā viśvavedāḥ |
svasti nastārkṣyo ariṣṭanemiḥ svasti no bṛhaspatirdadhātu ||
verses.translation: Illustrious far and wide, may Indra prosper us: may Pûshan prosper us, the Master of all wealth. May Târkshya with uninjured fellies prosper us: Brihaspati vouchsafe to us prosperity.

verses.sanskrit:
पृष॑दश्वा म॒रुतः॒ पृश्नि॑मातरः शुभं॒यावा॑नो वि॒दथे॑षु॒ जग्म॑यः ।
अ॒ग्नि॒जि॒ह्वा मन॑वः॒ सूर॑चक्षसो॒ विश्वे॑ नो दे॒वा अव॒साग॑मन्नि॒ह ॥
verses.transliteration:
pṛṣadaśvā marutaḥ pṛśnimātaraḥ śubhaṃyāvāno vidatheṣu jagmayaḥ |
agnijihvā manavaḥ sūracakṣaso viśve no devā avasāgamanniha ||
verses.translation: The Maruts, Sons of Prisni, borne by spotted steeds, moving in glory, oft visiting holy rites, Sages whose tongue is Agni and their eyes the Sun,——hither let all the Gods for our protection come.

verses.sanskrit:
भ॒द्रं कर्णे॑भिः शृणुयाम देवा भ॒द्रं प॑श्येमा॒क्षभि॑र्यजत्राः ।
स्थि॒रैरङ्गै॑स्तुष्टु॒वाᳪस॑स्त॒नूभि॒र्व्य॒शेमहि दे॒वहि॑तं॒ यदायुः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhadraṃ karṇebhiḥ śṛṇuyāma devā bhadraṃ paśyemākṣabhiryajatrāḥ |
sthirairaṅgaistuṣṭuvāṃsastanūbhirvyaśemahi devahitaṃ yadāyuḥ ||
verses.translation: Gods, may we with our ears listen to what is good, and with our eyes see what is good, ye Holy Ones. With limbs and bodies firm may we extolling you attain the term of life appointed by the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
श॒तमिन्नु श॒रदो॒ अन्ति॑ देवा॒ यत्रा॑ नश्च॒क्रा ज॒रसं॑ त॒नूना॑म् ।
पु॒त्रासो॒ यत्र॑ पि॒तरो॒ भव॑न्ति॒ मा नो॑ म॒ध्या री॑रिष॒तायु॒र्गन्तोः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
śataminnu śarado anti devā yatrā naścakrā jarasaṃ tanūnām |
putrāso yatra pitaro bhavanti mā no madhyā rīriṣatāyurgantoḥ ||
verses.translation: A hundred autumns stand before us, O ye Gods, within whose space ye bring our bodies to decay; Within whose space our sons become fathers in turn. Break ye not in the midst our course of fleeting life.

verses.sanskrit:
अदि॑तिर्द्यौ॒रदि॑तिर॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒मदि॑तिर्मा॒ता स पि॒ता स पु॒त्रः ।
विश्वे॑ दे॒वा अदि॑तिः॒ पञ्च॒ जना॒ अदि॑तिर्जा॒तमदि॑ति॒र्जनि॑त्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aditirdyauraditirantarikṣamaditirmātā sa pitā sa putraḥ |
viśve devā aditiḥ pañca janā aditirjātamaditirjanitvam ||
verses.translation: Aditi is the heaven, Aditi is mid-air, Aditi is the Mother and the Sire and Son. Aditi is all Gods, Aditi five-classed men, Aditi all that hath been born and shall be born.

verses.sanskrit:
मा नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो अर्य॒मायुरिन्द्र॑ ऋभु॒क्षा म॒रुतः॒ परि॑ ख्यन् ।
यद्वा॒जिनो॑ दे॒वजा॑तस्य॒ सप्तेः॑ प्रव॒क्ष्यामो॑ वि॒दथे॑ वी॒र्या॒णि ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā no mitro varuṇo aryamāyurindra ṛbhukṣā marutaḥ pari khyan |
yadvājino devajātasya sapteḥ pravakṣyāmo vidathe vīryāṇi ||
verses.translation: Slight us not Varuna, Aryaman, or Mitra, Ribhukshan, Indra, Âyu, or the Maruts, When we declare amid the congregation the virtues of the Strong Steed, God-descended.

verses.sanskrit:
यन्नि॒र्णिजा॒ रेक्ण॑सा॒ प्रावृ॑तस्य रा॒तिं गृ॑भी॒तां मु॑ख॒तो नय॑न्ति ।
सुप्रा॑ङ॒जो मेम्य॑द्वि॒श्वरू॑प इन्द्रापू॒ष्णोः प्रि॒यमप्ये॑ति॒ पाथः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yannirṇijā rekṇasā prāvṛtasya rātiṃ gṛbhītāṃ mukhato nayanti |
suprāṅajo memyadviśvarūpa indrāpūṣṇoḥ priyamapyeti pāthaḥ ||
verses.translation: What time they bear before the Courser, covered with trappings and with wealth, the grasped oblation, The dappled goat goeth straightforward, bleating, to the place dear to Indra and to Pûshan.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒ष छागः॑ पु॒रो अश्वे॑न वा॒जिना॑ पू॒ष्णो भा॒गो नी॑यते वि॒श्वदे॑व्यः ।
अ॒भि॒प्रियं॒ यत्पु॑रो॒डाश॒मर्व॑ता॒ त्वष्टेदे॑नᳪ सौश्रव॒साय॑ जिन्वति ॥
verses.transliteration:
eṣa chāgaḥ puro aśvena vājinā pūṣṇo bhāgo nīyate viśvadevyaḥ |
abhipriyaṃ yatpuroḍāśamarvatā tvaṣṭedenaṃ sauśravasāya jinvati ||
verses.translation: Dear to all Gods, this goat, the share of Pûshan, is first led forward with the vigorous Courser, While Tvashtar sends him forward with the Charger, acceptable for sacrifice, to glory.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्ध॑वि॒ष्य॒मृतु॒शो दे॑व॒यानं॒ त्रिर्मानु॑षाः॒ पर्यश्वं॒ नय॑न्ति ।
अत्रा॑ पू॒ष्णः प्र॑थ॒मो भा॒ग ए॑ति य॒ज्ञं दे॒वेभ्यः॑ प्रतिवे॒दय॑न्न॒जः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaddhaviṣyamṛtuśo devayānaṃ trirmānuṣāḥ paryaśvaṃ nayanti |
atrā pūṣṇaḥ prathamo bhāga eti yajñaṃ devebhyaḥ prativedayannajaḥ ||
verses.translation: When thrice the men lead round the Steed, in order, who goeth to the Gods as meet oblation, The goat precedeth him, the share of Pûshan, and to the Gods the sacrifice announceth.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ध्व॒र्युराव॑या अग्निमि॒न्धो ग्रा॑वग्रा॒भ उ॒त शᳪस्ता॒ सुवि॑प्रः ।
तेन॑ य॒ज्ञेन॒ स्व॒रंकृतेन॒ स्वि॒ष्टेन व॒क्षणा॒ आ पृ॑णध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotādhvaryurāvayā agnimindho grāvagrābha uta śaṃstā suvipraḥ |
tena yajñena svaraṃkṛtena sviṣṭena vakṣaṇā ā pṛṇadhvam ||
verses.translation: Invoker, ministering priest, stoner, fire-kindler, Soma-presser, sage, reciter, With this well ordered sacrifice, well finished, do ye fill full the channels of the rivers.

verses.sanskrit:
यू॒प॒व्र॒स्का उ॒त ये यू॑पवा॒हाश्च॒षालं॒ ये अ॑श्वयू॒पाय॒ तक्ष॑ति ।
ये चार्व॑ते॒ पच॑नᳪ स॒म्भर॑न्त्यु॒तो तेषा॑म॒भिगू॑र्तिर्न इन्वतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yūpavraskā uta ye yūpavāhāścaṣālaṃ ye aśvayūpāya takṣati |
ye cārvate pacanaṃ sambharantyuto teṣāmabhigūrtirna invatu ||
verses.translation: The hewers of the post and those who carry it, and those who carve the knob to deck the Horse's stake; Those who prepare the cooking-vessels for the Steed,—may the approving help of these promote our work.

verses.sanskrit:
उप॒ प्रागा॑त्सु॒मन्मे॑ऽधायि॒ मन्म॑ दे॒वाना॒माशा॒ उप॑ वी॒तपृ॑ष्ठः ।
अन्वे॑नं॒ विप्रा॒ ऋष॑यो मदन्ति दे॒वानां॑ पु॒ष्टे च॑कृमा सु॒बन्धु॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
upa prāgātsumanme'dhāyi manma devānāmāśā upa vītapṛṣṭhaḥ |
anvenaṃ viprā ṛṣayo madanti devānāṃ puṣṭe cakṛmā subandhum ||
