verses.translation: Forth, for the regions of the Gods, the Charger with his smooth back is come; my prayer attends him. In him rejoice the singer and the sages. A good friend have we won for the Gods banquet.

verses.sanskrit:
यद्वा॒जिनो॒ दाम॑ स॒न्दान॒मर्व॑तो॒ या शी॑र्ष॒ण्या॒ रश॒ना रज्जु॑रस्य ।
यद्वा॑ घास्य॒ प्रभृ॑तमा॒स्ये तृण॒ᳪ सर्वा॒ ता ते॒ अपि॑ दे॒वेष्व॑स्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadvājino dāma sandānamarvato yā śīrṣaṇyā raśanā rajjurasya |
yadvā ghāsya prabhṛtamāsye tṛṇaṃ sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu ||
verses.translation: May the fleet Courser's halter and his heel-ropes, the headstall and the girths and cords about him, And the grass put within his mouth to bait him,—among the Gods, too, let all these be with thee.

verses.sanskrit:
यदश्व॑स्य क्र॒विषो॒ मक्षि॒काश॒ यद्वा॒ स्वरौ॒ स्वधि॑तौ रि॒प्तमस्ति॑ ।
यद्धस्त॑योः शमि॒तुर्यन्न॒खेषु॒ सर्वा॒ ता ते॒ अपि॑ दे॒वेष्व॑स्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadaśvasya kraviṣo makṣikāśa yadvā svarau svadhitau riptamasti |
yaddhastayoḥ śamituryannakheṣu sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu ||
verses.translation: What part of the Steed's flesh the fly hath eaten, or is left sticking to the post or hatchet, Or to the slayer's hands and nails adhereth,—among the Gods, tog, may all this he with thee.

verses.sanskrit:
यदूव॑ध्यमु॒दर॑स्याप॒वाति॒ य आ॒मस्य॑ क्र॒विषो॑ ग॒न्धो अस्ति॑ ।
सु॒कृ॒ता तच्छ॑मि॒तारः॑ कृण्वन्तू॒त मेध॑ᳪ शृत॒पाकं॑ पचन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadūvadhyamudarasyāpavāti ya āmasya kraviṣo gandho asti |
sukṛtā tacchamitāraḥ kṛṇvantūta medhaṃ śṛtapākaṃ pacantu ||
verses.translation: Food undigested steaming from his belly, and any odour of raw flesh remaining, This let the immolators set in order and dress the sacrifice with perfect cooking.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्ते॒ गात्रा॑द॒ग्निना॑ प॒च्यमा॑नाद॒भि शूलं॒ निह॑तस्याव॒धाव॑ति ।
मा तद्भूम्या॒माश्रि॑ष॒न्मा तृणे॑षु दे॒वेभ्य॒स्तदु॒शद्भ्यो॑ रा॒तम॑स्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatte gātrādagninā pacyamānādabhi śūlaṃ nihatasyāvadhāvati |
mā tadbhūmyāmāśriṣanmā tṛṇeṣu devebhyastaduśadbhyo rātamastu ||
verses.translation: What from thy body which with fire is roasted, when thou art set upon the spit, distilleth,— Let not that lie on earth or grass neglected, but to the longing Gods let all be offered.

verses.sanskrit:
ये वा॒जिनं॑ परि॒पश्य॑न्ति प॒क्वं य ई॑मा॒हुः सु॑र॒भिर्निर्ह॒रेति॑ ।
ये चार्व॑तो माᳪसभि॒क्षामु॒पास॑त उ॒तो तेषा॑म॒भिगू॑र्तिर्न इन्वतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye vājinaṃ paripaśyanti pakvaṃ ya īmāhuḥ surabhirnirhareti |
ye cārvato māṃsabhikṣāmupāsata uto teṣāmabhigūrtirna invatu ||
verses.translation: They who, observing that the Horse is ready, call out and say, The smell is good; remove it; And, craving meat, await the distribution,—may their approving help promote our labour.

verses.sanskrit:
यन्नीक्ष॑णं माँ॒स्पच॑न्या उ॒खाया॒ या पात्रा॑णि यू॒ष्ण आ॒सेच॑नानि ।
ऊ॒ष्म॒ण्या॒पि॒धाना॑ चरू॒णाम॒ङ्काः सू॒नाः परि॑ भूष॒न्त्यश्व॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yannīkṣaṇaṃ mām̐spacanyā ukhāyā yā pātrāṇi yūṣṇa āsecanāni |
ūṣmaṇyāpidhānā carūṇāmaṅkāḥ sūnāḥ pari bhūṣantyaśvam ||
verses.translation: The trial-fork of the flesh cooking caldron, the vessels out of which the broth is sprinkled, The warming-pots, the covers of the dishes, hooks, carving-boards,—all these attend the Charger.

verses.sanskrit:
मा त्वा॒ऽग्निर्ध्व॑नयीद्धू॒मग॑न्धि॒र्मोखा भ्राज॑न्त्य॒भि वि॑क्त॒ जघ्रिः॑ ।
इ॒ष्टं वी॒तम॒भिगू॑र्तं॒ वष॑ट्कृतं॒ तं दे॒वासः॒ प्रति॑ गृभ्ण॒न्त्यश्व॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā tvā'gnirdhvanayīddhūmagandhirmokhā bhrājantyabhi vikta jaghriḥ |
iṣṭaṃ vītamabhigūrtaṃ vaṣaṭkṛtaṃ taṃ devāsaḥ prati gṛbhṇantyaśvam ||
verses.translation: Let not the fire, smoke-scented, make thee crackle, nor glowing caldron smell and break to pieces. Offered, beloved, approved, and consecrated,—such Charger do the Gods accept with favour.

verses.sanskrit:
नि॒क्रम॑णं नि॒षद॑नं वि॒वर्त॑नं॒ यच्च॒ पड्वी॑श॒मर्व॑तः ।
यच्च॑ पपौ॒ यच्च॑ घा॒सिं ज॒घास॒ सर्वा॒ ता ते॒ अपि॑ दे॒वेष्व॑स्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
nikramaṇaṃ niṣadanaṃ vivartanaṃ yacca paḍvīśamarvataḥ |
yacca papau yacca ghāsiṃ jaghāsa sarvā tā te api deveṣvastu ||
verses.translation: The starting-place, his place of rest and rolling, the ropes wherewith the Charger's feet were fastened, The water that he drank, the food he tasted,—among the Gods, too, may all these attend thee.

verses.sanskrit:
यदश्वा॑य॒ वास॑ उपस्तृ॒णन्त्य॑धीवा॒सं या हिर॑ण्यान्यस्मै ।
स॒न्दान॒मर्व॑न्तं॒ पड्वी॑शं प्रि॒या दे॒वेष्वा या॑मयन्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadaśvāya vāsa upastṛṇantyadhīvāsaṃ yā hiraṇyānyasmai |
sandānamarvantaṃ paḍvīśaṃ priyā deveṣvā yāmayanti ||
verses.translation: The robe they spread upon the Horse to clothe him, the upper covering and the golden trappings, The halters which restrain the Steed, the heel-ropes,—all these, as grateful to the Gods, they offer.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्ते॑ सा॒दे मह॑सा॒ शूकृ॑तस्य॒ पार्ष्ण्या॑ वा॒ कश॑या वा तु॒तोद॑ ।
स्रु॒चेव॒ ता ह॒विषो॑ अध्व॒रेषु॒ सर्वा॒ ता ते॒ ब्रह्म॑णा सूदयामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatte sāde mahasā śūkṛtasya pārṣṇyā vā kaśayā vā tutoda |
sruceva tā haviṣo adhvareṣu sarvā tā te brahmaṇā sūdayāmi ||
verses.translation: If one, when seated, with excessive urging hath with his heel or with his whip distressed thee, All these thy woes, as with oblation's ladle at sacrifices, with my prayer I banish.

verses.sanskrit:
चतु॑स्त्रिᳪशद्वा॒जिनो॑ दे॒वब॑न्धो॒र्वङ्क्री॒रश्व॑स्य॒ स्वधि॑तिः॒ समे॑ति ।
अच्छि॑द्रा॒ गात्रा॑ व॒युना॑ कृणोत॒ परु॑ष्परुरनु॒घुष्या॒ विश॑स्त ॥
verses.transliteration:
catustriṃśadvājino devabandhorvaṅkrīraśvasya svadhitiḥ sameti |
acchidrā gātrā vayunā kṛṇota paruṣparuranughuṣyā viśasta ||
verses.translation: The four-and-thirty ribs of the swift Courser, kin to the Gods, the slayer's hatchet pierces. Cut ye with skill so that the parts be flawless, and piece by piece declaring them dissect them.

verses.sanskrit:
एक॒स्त्वष्टु॒रश्व॑स्या विश॒स्ता द्वा य॒न्तारा॑ भवत॒स्तथ॑ ऋ॒तुः ।
या ते॒ गात्रा॑णामृतु॒था कृ॒णोमि॒ ता-ता॒ पिण्डा॑नां॒ प्र जु॑होम्यग्नौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ekastvaṣṭuraśvasyā viśastā dvā yantārā bhavatastatha ṛtuḥ |
yā te gātrāṇāmṛtuthā kṛṇomi tā-tā piṇḍānāṃ pra juhomyagnau ||
verses.translation: Of Tvashtar's Courser there is one dissector: this is the custom: two there are who guide him. Such of his limbs as I divide in order, all these, amid the lumps, in fire I offer.

verses.sanskrit:
मा त्वा॑ तपत्प्रि॒य आ॒त्माऽपि॒यन्तं॒ मा स्वधि॑तिस्त॒न्व आ ति॑ष्ठिपत्ते ।
मा ते॑ गृ॒ध्नुर॑विश॒स्ताऽति॒हाय॑ छि॒द्रा गात्रा॑ण्य॒सिना॒ मिथू॑ कः ॥
verses.transliteration:
mā tvā tapatpriya ātmā'piyantaṃ mā svadhitistanva ā tiṣṭhipatte |
mā te gṛdhnuraviśastā'tihāya chidrā gātrāṇyasinā mithū kaḥ ||
verses.translation: Let not thy dear soul burn thee as thou comest, let not the hatchet linger in thy body. Let not a greedy clumsy immolator, missing the joints, mangle thy limbs unduly.

verses.sanskrit:
न वा उ॑ ए॒तन्म्रि॑यसे॒ न रि॑ष्यसि दे॒वाँ२ इदे॑षि प॒थिभिः॑ सु॒गेभिः॑ ।
हरी॑ ते॒ युञ्जा॒ पृष॑ती अभूता॒मुपा॑स्थाद्वा॒जी धु॒रि रास॑भस्य ॥
verses.transliteration:
na vā u etanmriyase na riṣyasi devām̐ ideṣi pathibhiḥ sugebhiḥ |
harī te yuñjā pṛṣatī abhūtāmupāsthādvājī dhuri rāsabhasya ||
verses.translation: No, here thou diest not, thou art not injured: only by easy paths to Gods thou goest. Both Bays, both Spotted Mares are now thy fellows, and to the Ass's pole is yoked the Courser.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒गव्यं॑ नो वा॒जी स्वश्व्यं॑ पु॒ᳪसः पु॒त्राँ२ उ॒त वि॑श्वा॒पुष॑ᳪ र॒यिम् ।
अ॒ना॒गा॒स्त्वं नो॒ अदि॑तिः कृणोतु क्ष॒त्रं नो॒ अश्वो॑ वनताᳪ ह॒विष्मा॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sugavyaṃ no vājī svaśvyaṃ puṃsaḥ putrām̐ uta viśvāpuṣaṃ rayim |
anāgāstvaṃ no aditiḥ kṛṇotu kṣatraṃ no aśvo vanatāṃ haviṣmān ||
verses.translation: May this Steed bring us all-sustaining riches, wealth in good kine, good horses, manly offspring. Freedom from sin may Aditi vouchsafe us; the Steed with our oblations gain us lordship!

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा नु कं॒ भुव॑ना सीषधा॒मेन्द्र॑श्च॒ विश्वे॑ च दे॒वाः ।
आ॒दि॒त्यैरिन्द्रः॒ सग॑णो म॒रुद्भि॑र॒स्मभ्यं॑ भेष॒जा क॑रत् ।
य॒ज्ञं च॑ नस्त॒न्वं॒ च प्र॒जां चा॑दित्यै॒रिन्द्रः॑ स॒ह सी॑षधाति ॥
verses.transliteration:
imā nu kaṃ bhuvanā sīṣadhāmendraśca viśve ca devāḥ |
ādityairindraḥ sagaṇo marudbhirasmabhyaṃ bheṣajā karat |
yajñaṃ ca nastanvaṃ ca prajāṃ cādityairindraḥ saha sīṣadhāti ||
verses.translation: We will, with Indra and all Gods to help us, bring these existing worlds into subjection. With the Âdityas, with the band of Maruts, may Indra give us medicine to heal us. Our sacrifice, our bodies, and our offspring may Indra regulate with the Âdityas.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ त्वं नो॒ अन्त॑म उ॒त त्रा॒ता शि॒वो भ॑व वरू॒थ्यः॒ ।
वसु॑र॒ग्निर्वसु॑श्रवा॒ अच्छा॑ नक्षि द्यु॒मत्त॑मᳪ र॒यिं दाः॑ ।
तं त्वा॑ शोचिष्ठ दीदिवः सु॒म्नाय॑ नू॒नमी॑महे॒ सखि॑भ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne tvaṃ no antama uta trātā śivo bhava varūthyaḥ |
vasuragnirvasuśravā acchā nakṣi dyumattamaṃ rayiṃ dāḥ |
taṃ tvā śociṣṭha dīdivaḥ sumnāya nūnamīmahe sakhibhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: O Agni, be our nearest Friend, etc., as in III. 25. To thee then, O Most Bright, etc., as in III. 26.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निश्च॑ पृथि॒वी च॒ सन्न॑ते॒ ते मे॒ सं न॑मताम॒दो वा॒युश्चा॒न्तरि॑क्षं च॒ सन्न॑ते॒ ते मे॒ सं न॑मताम॒द
आ॑दि॒त्यश्च द्यौश्च॒ सन्न॑ते॒ ते मे॒ सं न॑मताम॒द आप॑श्च॒ वरु॑णश्च॒ सन्न॑ते॒ ते मे॒ सं न॑मताम॒दः ।
स॒प्त स॒ᳪसदो॑ अष्ट॒मी भू॑त॒साध॑नी । सका॑माँ॒२अध्व॑नस्कुरु सं॒ज्ञान॑मस्तु मे॒ऽमुना॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
agniśca pṛthivī ca sannate te me saṃ namatāmado vāyuścāntarikṣaṃ ca sannate te me saṃ namatāmada
ādityaśca dyauśca sannate te me saṃ namatāmada āpaśca varuṇaśca sannate te me saṃ namatāmadaḥ |
sapta saṃsado aṣṭamī bhūtasādhanī | sakāmām̐adhvanaskuru saṃjñānamastu me'munā ||
verses.translation: Agni and Prithivî, closely connected, may they bring low for me the boon I mention. Vâyu and Firmament, closely connected, may they, etc. Closely connected Dyaus and the Âditya, may they, etc. Closely connected Varuna and Waters, may they, etc. Lord of the seven communities and her who forms all beings, eighth, Make our ways full of pleasantness: may So-and-So and I agree.

verses.sanskrit:
यथे॒मां वाचं॑ कल्या॒णीमा॒वदा॑नि॒ जने॑भ्यः ।
ब्र॒ह्म॒रा॒ज॒न्या॒भ्याᳪ शू॒द्राय॒ चार्या॑य च॒ स्वाय॒ चार॑णाय च ।
प्रि॒यो दे॒वानां॒ दक्षि॑णायै दा॒तुरि॒ह भू॑यासम॒यं मे॒ कामः॒ समृ॑ध्यता॒मुप॑ मा॒दो न॑मतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yathemāṃ vācaṃ kalyāṇīmāvadāni janebhyaḥ |
brahmarājanyābhyāṃ śūdrāya cāryāya ca svāya cāraṇāya ca |
priyo devānāṃ dakṣiṇāyai dāturiha bhūyāsamayaṃ me kāmaḥ samṛdhyatāmupa mādo namatu ||
verses.translation: That I to all the people may address this salutary speech, To priest and nobleman, Sûdra and Arya, to one of our own kin and to the stranger. Dear may I be to Gods and guerdon-giver. Fulfilled be this my hope: be that my portion!

verses.sanskrit:
बृह॑स्पते॒ अति॒ यद॒र्यो अर्हा॑द् द्यु॒मद्वि॒भाति॒ क्रतु॑म॒ज्जने॑षु ।
यद्दी॒दय॒च्छव॑स ऋतप्रजात॒ तद॒स्मासु॒ द्रवि॑णं धेहि चि॒त्रम् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि॒ बृह॒स्पत॑ये त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॒र्बृह॒स्पत॑ये त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhaspate ati yadaryo arhād dyumadvibhāti kratumajjaneṣu |
yaddīdayacchavasa ṛtaprajāta tadasmāsu draviṇaṃ dhehi citram |
upayāmagṛhīto'si bṛhaspataye tvaiṣa te yonirbṛhaspataye tvā ||
verses.translation: Give us, Brihaspati, that wondrous treasure, that which exceeds the merit of the foeman, Which shines among the folk effectual, splendid, that, Son of Law, which is with might refulgent. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Brihaspati. This is thy home. Thee for Brihaspati,

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॒ गोम॑न्नि॒हा या॑हि॒ पिबा॒ सोम॑ᳪ शतक्रतो । वि॒द्यद्भि॒र्ग्राव॑भिः सु॒तम् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ गोम॑त ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ गोम॑ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
indra gomannihā yāhi pibā somaṃ śatakrato | vidyadbhirgrāvabhiḥ sutam |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā gomata eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā gomate ||
verses.translation: Come hither, Indra, rich in kine! Drink Soma, Lord of Hundred Powers, Effused by braying pressing-stones. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Indra, rich in kine. This is thy home. Thee for Indra, rich in kine.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रा या॑हि वृत्रह॒न्पिबा॒ सोम॑ᳪ शतक्रतो । गोम॑द्भि॒र्ग्राव॑भिः सु॒तम् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतो॒ऽसीन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ गोम॑त ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॒रिन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ गोम॑ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrā yāhi vṛtrahanpibā somaṃ śatakrato | gomadbhirgrāvabhiḥ sutam |
upayāmagṛhīto'sīndrāya tvā gomata eṣa te yonirindrāya tvā gomate ||
verses.translation: O Indra, Vritra-slayer, come. Drink Soma, Lord of Hundred Powers, Expressed with stones whose wealth is kine. Taken upon a base art thou, etc., as in verse 4.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तावा॑नं वैश्वान॒रमृ॒तस्य॒ ज्योति॑ष॒स्पति॑म् । अज॑स्रं घ॒र्ममी॑महे ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि वैश्वान॒राय॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र्वैश्वान॒राय॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛtāvānaṃ vaiśvānaramṛtasya jyotiṣaspatim | ajasraṃ gharmamīmahe |
upayāmagṛhīto'si vaiśvānarāya tvaiṣa te yonirvaiśvānarāya tvā ||
verses.translation: Vaisvânara the righteous One, the Lord of sacrifice and light, The heat that wasteth not, we seek. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Vaisvânara. This is thy home: thee for Vaisvânara.

verses.sanskrit:
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रस्य॑ सुम॒तौ स्या॑म॒ राजा॒ हि कं॒ भुव॑नानामभि॒श्रीः ।
इ॒तो जा॒तो विश्व॑मि॒दं वि च॑ष्टे वैश्वान॒रो य॑तते॒ सूर्ये॑ण ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि वैश्वान॒राय॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र्वैश्वान॒राय॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
vaiśvānarasya sumatau syāma rājā hi kaṃ bhuvanānāmabhiśrīḥ |
ito jāto viśvamidaṃ vi caṣṭe vaiśvānaro yatate sūryeṇa |
upayāmagṛhīto'si vaiśvānarāya tvaiṣa te yonirvaiśvānarāya tvā ||
verses.translation: Still in Vaisvânara's grace may we continue: yea, he is King Supreme oer all things living. Sprung hence to life upon this All he looketh. Vaisvânara hath rivalry with Sûrya. Taken upon a base art thou, etc., as in verse 6.

verses.sanskrit:
वै॒श्वा॒न॒रो न ऊ॒तय॒ आ प्र या॑तु परा॒वतः॑ । अ॒ग्निरु॒क्थेन॒ वाह॑सा ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि वैश्वान॒राय॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र्वैश्वान॒राय॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
vaiśvānaro na ūtaya ā pra yātu parāvataḥ | agnirukthena vāhasā |
upayāmagṛhīto'si vaiśvānarāya tvaiṣa te yonirvaiśvānarāya tvā ||
verses.translation: Hitherward come Vaisvânara to succour us from far away, Agni through laud that brings him near! Taken upon a base, etc, as in verse 6.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निरृषिः॒ पव॑मानः॒ पाञ्च॑जन्यः पु॒रोहि॑तः । तमी॑महे महाग॒यम् ।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽस्य॒ग्नये॑ त्वा॒ वर्च॑स ए॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र॒ग्नये॑ त्वा॒ वर्च॑से ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnirṛṣiḥ pavamānaḥ pāñcajanyaḥ purohitaḥ | tamīmahe mahāgayam |
upayāmagṛhīto'syagnaye tvā varcasa eṣa te yoniragnaye tvā varcase ||
verses.translation: Agni is Pavamâna, Sage, the Tribe-Priest of the Races Five: To him of mighty wealth we pray. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for lustre. This is thy home. Thee for lustre.

verses.sanskrit:
म॒हाँ२ इन्द्रो॒ वज्र॑हस्तः षोड॒शी शर्म॑ यच्छतु । हन्तु॑ पा॒प्मानं॒ योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि॑ ।।
उ॒प॒या॒मगृ॑हीतोऽसि महे॒न्द्राय॑ त्वै॒ष ते॒ योनि॑र्महे॒न्द्राय॑ त्वा ॥
verses.transliteration:
mahām̐ indro vajrahastaḥ ṣoḍaśī śarma yacchatu | hantu pāpmānaṃ yo'smāndveṣṭi ||
upayāmagṛhīto'si mahendrāya tvaiṣa te yonirmahendrāya tvā ||
verses.translation: May mighty Indra, thunder-armed, may Shodasî protect us well, and slay the wicked man who hateth us. Taken upon a base art thou. Thee for Mahendra. This is thy home. Thee for Mahendra.

verses.sanskrit: तं वो॑ द॒स्ममृ॑ती॒षहं॒ वसो॑र्मन्दा॒नमन्ध॑सः । अ॒भि व॒त्सं न स्वस॑रेषु धे॒नव॒ इन्द्रं॑ गी॒र्भिर्न॑वामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: taṃ vo dasmamṛtīṣahaṃ vasormandānamandhasaḥ | abhi vatsaṃ na svasareṣu dhenava indraṃ gīrbhirnavāmahe ||
verses.translation: As cows low to their calves in stalls so with our songs we glorify This Indra, een your wondrous God who checks assault, who joys in the delicious juice.

verses.sanskrit: यद्वाहि॑ष्ठं॒ तद॒ग्नये॑ बृ॒हद॑र्च विभावसो । महि॑षीव॒ त्वद्र॒यिस्त्वद्वाजा॒ उदी॑रते ॥
verses.transliteration: yadvāhiṣṭhaṃ tadagnaye bṛhadarca vibhāvaso | mahiṣīva tvadrayistvadvājā udīrate ||
verses.translation: Agni's is the most fetching song. Shine mightily, thou rich in light! Like the Chief Consort of a King, riches and strength proceed from thee.

verses.sanskrit: एह्यू॒ षु ब्रवा॑णि॒ तेऽग्न॑ इ॒त्थेत॑रा॒ गिरः॑ । ए॒भिर्व॑र्धास॒ इन्दु॑भिः ॥
verses.transliteration: ehyū ṣu bravāṇi te'gna itthetarā giraḥ | ebhirvardhāsa indubhiḥ ||
verses.translation: Come, here, O Agni, will I sing verily other songs to thee, And with these drops shalt thou grow strong.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋ॒तव॑स्ते य॒ज्ञं वि त॑न्वन्तु॒ मासा॒ रक्ष॑न्तु ते॒ हविः॑ ।
सं॒व॒त्स॒रस्ते॑ य॒ज्ञं द॑धातु नः प्र॒जां च॒ परि॑ पातु नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛtavaste yajñaṃ vi tanvantu māsā rakṣantu te haviḥ |
saṃvatsaraste yajñaṃ dadhātu naḥ prajāṃ ca pari pātu naḥ ||
verses.translation: The Seasons spread thy sacrifice! the Mouths protect thine offering! May the Year guard our sacrifice for thee and keep our children safe.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒प॒ह्व॒रे गि॑री॒णाᳪ स॑ङ्ग॒मे च॑ न॒दी॒ना॑म् । धि॒या विप्रो॑ अजायत ॥
verses.transliteration: upahvare girīṇāṃ saṅgame ca nadīnām | dhiyā vipro ajāyata ||
verses.translation: There where the mountains downward slope, there by the meeting of the streams The sage was manifest with song.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒च्चा ते॑ जा॒तमन्ध॑सो दि॒वि सद्भूम्या द॑दे । उ॒ग्रᳪ शर्म॒ महि॒ श्रवः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: uccā te jātamandhaso divi sadbhūmyā dade | ugraṃ śarma mahi śravaḥ ||
verses.translation: High is thy juice's birth: though sat in heaven, on earth it hath obtained Strong sheltering power and great renown.

verses.sanskrit: स न॒ इन्द्रा॑य॒ यज्य॑वे॒ वरु॑णाय म॒रुद्भ्यः॑ । व॒रि॒वो॒वित्परि॑ स्रव ॥
verses.transliteration: sa na indrāya yajyave varuṇāya marudbhyaḥ | varivovitpari srava ||
verses.translation: Finder of room and freedom, flow for Indra, meet for worship, flow For Varuna and the Marut host.

verses.sanskrit: ए॒ना विश्वा॑न्य॒र्य आ द्यु॒म्नानि॒ मानु॑षाणाम् । सिषा॑सन्तो वनामहे ॥
verses.transliteration: enā viśvānyarya ā dyumnāni mānuṣāṇām | siṣāsanto vanāmahe ||
verses.translation: Striving to win, with him we gain all wealth of the ungodly one, Yea, all the glories of mankind.

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑ वीरै॒रनु॑ पुष्यास्म॒ गोभि॒रन्वश्वै॒रनु॒ सर्वे॑ण पु॒ष्टैः ।
अनु॒ द्विप॒दाऽनु॒ चतु॑ष्पदा व॒यं दे॒वा नो॑ य॒ज्ञमृ॑तु॒था न॑यन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
anu vīrairanu puṣyāsma gobhiranvaśvairanu sarveṇa puṣṭaiḥ |
anu dvipadā'nu catuṣpadā vayaṃ devā no yajñamṛtuthā nayantu ||
verses.translation: May we be prosperous with brave sons, cattle, horses, each wish of ours, and varied blessings, With quadrupeds, and with the men about us. May the Gods guide our sacrifice in season.

verses.sanskrit: अग्ने॒ पत्नी॑रि॒हा व॑ह दे॒वाना॑मुश॒तीरुप॑ । त्वष्टा॑र॒ᳪ सोम॑पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration: agne patnīrihā vaha devānāmuśatīrupa | tvaṣṭāraṃ somapītaye ||
verses.translation: O Agni, bring thou hitherward the yearning Consorts of the Gods Bring Tvashtar to the Soma-draught.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि य॒ज्ञं गृ॑णीहि नो॒ ग्नावो॒ नेष्टः॒ पिब॑ ऋ॒तुना॑ ।
त्वᳪ हि र॑त्न॒धा असि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhi yajñaṃ gṛṇīhi no gnāvo neṣṭaḥ piba ṛtunā |
tvaṃ hi ratnadhā asi ||
verses.translation: O Neshtar girt by Dames, accept our sacrifice: with Ritu drink, For thou art he who giveth wealth.

verses.sanskrit: द्र॒वि॒णो॒दाः पि॑पीषति जु॒होत॒ प्र च॑ तिष्ठत । ने॒ष्ट्रादृ॒तुभि॑रिष्यत ॥
verses.transliteration: draviṇodāḥ pipīṣati juhota pra ca tiṣṭhata | neṣṭrādṛtubhiriṣyata ||
verses.translation: He with the Ritus fain would drink, Wealth-river, from the Neshtar's bowl. Begin, pay offerings: hasten ye.

verses.sanskrit:
तवा॒यᳪ सोम॒स्त्वमेह्य॒र्वाड् श॑श्वत्त॒मᳪ सु॒मना॑ अ॒स्य पा॑हि ।
अ॒स्मिन् य॒ज्ञे ब॒र्हिष्या नि॒षद्या॑ दधि॒ष्वेमं ज॒ठर॒ इन्दु॑मिन्द्र ॥
verses.transliteration:
tavāyaṃ somastvamehyarvāḍ śaśvattamaṃ sumanā asya pāhi |
asmin yajñe barhiṣyā niṣadyā dadhiṣvemaṃ jaṭhara indumindra ||
verses.translation: Thine is this Soma: come thou near, approach it. Drink thou thereof, benevolent, and cease not. Sit on the sacred grass at this our worship, and take these drops into thy belly, Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒मेव॑ नः सुहवा॒ आ हि गन्त॑न॒ नि ब॒र्हिषि॑ सदतना॒ रणि॑ष्टन ।
अथा॑ मन्दस्व जुजुषा॒णो अन्ध॑स॒स्त्वष्ट॑र्दे॒वेभि॒र्जनि॑भिः सु॒मद्ग॑णः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ameva naḥ suhavā ā hi gantana ni barhiṣi sadatanā raṇiṣṭana |
athā mandasva jujuṣāṇo andhasastvaṣṭardevebhirjanibhiḥ sumadgaṇaḥ ||
verses.translation: Come unto us, ye swift to listen! as at home, upon the sacred grass sit and enjoy yourselves. And, Tvashtar, well content be joyful in the juice with Gods and Goddesses in gladsome company.

verses.sanskrit: स्वादि॑ष्ठया॒ मदि॑ष्ठया॒ पव॑स्व सोम॒ धार॑या । इन्द्रा॑य॒ पात॑वे सु॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration: svādiṣṭhayā madiṣṭhayā pavasva soma dhārayā | indrāya pātave sutaḥ ||
verses.translation: In sweetest and most gladdening stream flow pure, O Soma, on thy way, Pressed out for Indra, for his drink.

verses.sanskrit: र॒क्षो॒हा वि॒श्वच॑र्षणिर॒भि योनि॒मयो॑हते । द्रोणे॑ स॒धस्थ॒मास॑दत् ॥
verses.transliteration: rakṣohā viśvacarṣaṇirabhi yonimayohate | droṇe sadhasthamāsadat ||
verses.translation: Fiend-queller, Friend of all men, he hath in the vat attained unto His place, his iron-fashioned home.

verses.sanskrit:
समा॑स्त्वाग्न ऋ॒तवो॑ वर्धयन्तु संवत्स॒रा ऋष॑यो॒ यानि॑ स॒त्या ।
सं दि॒व्येन॑ दीदिहि रोच॒नेन॒ विश्वा॒ आ भा॑हि प्र॒दिश॒श्चत॑स्रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
samāstvāgna ṛtavo vardhayantu saṃvatsarā ṛṣayo yāni satyā |
saṃ divyena dīdihi rocanena viśvā ā bhāhi pradiśaścatasraḥ ||
verses.translation: Half-YEARS and Seasons strengthen thee, O Agni, the Years and all the Verities and Rishis! Flash forth with thy celestial effulgence: illumine all four regions of the heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
सं चे॒ध्यस्वा॑ग्ने॒ प्र च॑ बोधयैन॒मुच्च॑ तिष्ठ मह॒ते सौ॑भगाय ।
मा च॑ रिषदुपस॒त्ता ते॑ अग्ने ब्र॒ह्माण॑स्ते य॒शसः॑ सन्तु॒ मान्ये ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃ cedhyasvāgne pra ca bodhayainamucca tiṣṭha mahate saubhagāya |
mā ca riṣadupasattā te agne brahmāṇaste yaśasaḥ santu mānye ||
verses.translation: Kindle thee, Agni, rake this man to knowledge: rise up erect for great and happy fortune. Agni, be those uninjured who adore thee, thy priests be glorious and none beside them!

verses.sanskrit:
त्वाम॑ग्ने वृणते ब्राह्म॒णा इ॒मे शि॒वो अ॑ग्ने सं॒वर॑णे भवा नः ।
स॒प॒त्न॒हा नो॑ अभिमाति॒जिच्च॒ स्वे गये॑ गागृ॒ह्यप्र॑युच्छन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvāmagne vṛṇate brāhmaṇā ime śivo agne saṃvaraṇe bhavā naḥ |
sapatnahā no abhimātijicca sve gaye gāgṛhyaprayucchan ||
verses.translation: The Brahmans present here elect thee, Agni: be thou propitious in our sanctuary. Slayer of rivals, Agni, quell our foemen: watch in thy house with care that never ceases.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒है॒वाग्ने॒ अधि॑ धारया र॒यिं मा त्वा॒ नि क्र॑न्पूर्व॒चितो॑ निका॒रिणः॑ ।
क्ष॒त्रम॑ग्ने सु॒यम॑मस्तु॒ तुभ्य॑मुपस॒त्ता व॑र्धतां ते॒ अनि॑ष्टृतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ihaivāgne adhi dhārayā rayiṃ mā tvā ni kranpūrvacito nikāriṇaḥ |
kṣatramagne suyamamastu tubhyamupasattā vardhatāṃ te aniṣṭṛtaḥ ||
verses.translation: Even here do thou, O Agni, stablish wealth: let not oppressors injure thee by thinking of thee first. Light be thy task of ruling, Agni, with thy power: may he who worships thee wax strong, invincible.

verses.sanskrit:
क्ष॒त्रेणा॑ग्ने॒ स्वायुः॒ सᳪ र॑भस्व मि॒त्रेणा॑ग्ने मित्र॒धेये॑ यतस्व ।
स॒जा॒तानां॑ मध्यम॒स्था ए॑धि॒ राज्ञा॑मग्ने विह॒व्यो॒ दीदिही॒ह ॥
verses.transliteration:
kṣatreṇāgne svāyuḥ saṃ rabhasva mitreṇāgne mitradheye yatasva |
sajātānāṃ madhyamasthā edhi rājñāmagne vihavyo dīdihīha ||
verses.translation: Kind to the people, grasp thy power, O Agni: contend thou with the Friend by way of friendship. Placed, Agni, in the centre of our kinsmen, flash forth to be invoked by Kings around thee.

verses.sanskrit:
अति॒ निहो॒ अति॒ स्रिधोऽत्यचि॑त्ति॒मत्यरा॑तिमग्ने ।
विश्वा॒ ह्य॑ग्ने दुरि॒ता सह॒स्वाथा॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ स॒हवी॑राᳪ र॒यिं दाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ati niho ati sridho'tyacittimatyarātimagne |
viśvā hyagne duritā sahasvāthāsmabhyaṃ sahavīrāṃ rayiṃ dāḥ ||
verses.translation: Past those who slay, past enemies, past thoughtless men, past those who hate,— Yes, Agni, drive away all woe and trouble: vouchsafe us opulence with men about us.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ना॒धृ॒ष्यो जा॒तवे॑दा॒ अनि॑ष्टृतो वि॒राडग्ने॑ क्षत्र॒भृद्दी॑दिही॒ह ।
विश्वा॒ आशाः॑ प्रमु॒ञ्चन्मानु॑षीर्भि॒यः शि॒वेभि॑र॒द्य परि॑ पाहि नो वृ॒धे ॥
verses.transliteration:
anādhṛṣyo jātavedā aniṣṭṛto virāḍagne kṣatrabhṛddīdihīha |
viśvā āśāḥ pramuñcanmānuṣīrbhiyaḥ śivebhiradya pari pāhi no vṛdhe ||
verses.translation: Holder of sway, shine here refulgent, Agni! invincible, unconquered Jâtavedas. Light all the regions, chasing human terrors: with happy helps guard us to-day for increase.

verses.sanskrit:
बृह॑स्पते सवितर्बो॒धयै॑न॒ᳪ सᳪशि॑तं चित्सन्त॒राᳪ सᳪ शि॑शाधि ।
व॒र्धयै॑नं मह॒ते सौ॑भगाय॒ विश्व॑ एन॒मनु॑ मदन्तु दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bṛhaspate savitarbodhayainaṃ saṃśitaṃ citsantarāṃ saṃ śiśādhi |
vardhayainaṃ mahate saubhagāya viśva enamanu madantu devāḥ ||
verses.translation: Brihaspati, Savitar, give this man knowledge: sharpen him thoroughly though already sharpened. To great and high felicity exalt him: in him let all the Gods rejoice and triumph.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒मु॒त्र॒भूया॒दध॒ यद्य॒मस्य॒ बृह॑स्पते अ॒भिश॑स्ते॒रमु॑ञ्चः ।
प्रत्यौ॑हताम॒श्विना॑ मृ॒त्युम॑स्माद्दे॒वाना॑मग्ने भि॒षजा॒ शची॑भिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
amutrabhūyādadha yadyamasya bṛhaspate abhiśasteramuñcaḥ |
pratyauhatāmaśvinā mṛtyumasmāddevānāmagne bhiṣajā śacībhiḥ ||
verses.translation: As thou, Brihaspati, from curse hast freed us, from dwelling yonder in the realm of Yama, The Asvins, Leeches of the Gods, O Agni, have chased Death far from us with mighty powers.

verses.sanskrit:
उद्व॒यं तम॑स॒स्परि॒ स्वः पश्य॑न्त॒ उत्त॑रम् ।
दे॒वं दे॑व॒त्रा सूर्य॒मग॑न्म॒ ज्योति॑रुत्त॒मम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
udvayaṃ tamasaspari svaḥ paśyanta uttaram |
devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam ||
verses.translation: Looking upon the loftier light, etc., as in XX. 21.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊ॒र्ध्वा अ॑स्य स॒मिधो॑ भवन्त्यू॒र्ध्वा शु॒क्रा शो॒चीᳪष्य॒ग्नेः ।
द्यु॒मत्त॑मा सु॒प्रती॑कस्य सू॒नोः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrdhvā asya samidho bhavantyūrdhvā śukrā śocīṃṣyagneḥ |
dyumattamā supratīkasya sūnoḥ ||
verses.translation: Uplifted are the brands that are his fuel: lofty and brilliant are the flames of Agni, Splendidly bright of the Son fair of aspect.

verses.sanskrit:
तनू॒नपा॒दसु॑रो वि॒श्ववे॑दा दे॒वो दे॒वेषु॑ दे॒वः ।
प॒थो अ॑नक्तु॒ मध्वा॑ घृ॒तेन॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tanūnapādasuro viśvavedā devo deveṣu devaḥ |
patho anaktu madhvā ghṛtena ||
verses.translation: Tanûnapât the Asura, all-possessing, God among Gods, the God with mead and butter shall bedew the paths.

verses.sanskrit:
मध्वा॑ य॒ज्ञं न॑क्षसे प्रीणा॒नो नरा॒शᳪसो॑ अग्ने ।
सु॒कृद्दे॒वः स॑वि॒ता वि॒श्ववा॑रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
madhvā yajñaṃ nakṣase prīṇāno narāśaṃso agne |
sukṛddevaḥ savitā viśvavāraḥ ||
verses.translation: With mead to sacrifice thou comest, Agni, earnest as friendlyminded Narâsamsa, and Savitar righteous God who brings all blessings.

verses.sanskrit:
अच्छा॒यमे॑ति॒ शव॑सा घृ॒तेने॑डा॒नो वह्नि॒र्नम॑सा ।
अ॒ग्निᳪ स्रुचो॑ अध्व॒रेषु॑ प्र॒यत्सु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
acchāyameti śavasā ghṛteneḍāno vahnirnamasā |
agniṃ sruco adhvareṣu prayatsu ||
verses.translation: He cometh hitherward with power and fatness, the luminous, implored with adoration. While rites proceed the ladles move to Agni.

verses.sanskrit:
स य॑क्षदस्य महि॒मान॑म॒ग्नेः स ईं॑ म॒न्द्रा सु॑प्र॒यसः॑ ।
वसु॒श्चेति॑ष्ठो वसु॒धात॑मश्च ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa yakṣadasya mahimānamagneḥ sa īṃ mandrā suprayasaḥ |
vasuścetiṣṭho vasudhātamaśca ||
verses.translation: Let him pay worship to this Agni's greatness, daintily fed: he verily gives enjoyments: The wisest Vasu he, and best wealth giver.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वारो॑ दे॒वीरन्व॑स्य॒ विश्वे॑ व्र॒ता द॑दन्ते अ॒ग्नेः ।
उ॒रु॒व्यच॑सो॒ धाम्ना॒ पत्य॑मानाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dvāro devīranvasya viśve vratā dadante agneḥ |
uruvyacaso dhāmnā patyamānāḥ ||
verses.translation: Widely expansive, ruling by foundation, the Doors divine— and, after, all— Preserve this Agni's holy works.

verses.sanskrit:
ते अ॑स्य॒ योष॑णे दि॒व्ये न योना॑ उ॒षासा॒नक्ता॑ ।
इ॒मं य॒ज्ञमव॑तामध्व॒रं नः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
te asya yoṣaṇe divye na yonā uṣāsānaktā |
imaṃ yajñamavatāmadhvaraṃ naḥ ||
verses.translation: May Dawn and Night protect—his heavenly Consorts—in a his home this our sacrificial worship.

verses.sanskrit:
दै॑व्या॒ होतारा ऊ॒र्ध्वम॑ध्व॒रं नो॒ऽग्नेर्जु॒ह्वाम॒भि गृ॑णीतम् ।
कृ॒णु॒तं नः॒ स्वि॒ष्टम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
daivyā hotārā ūrdhvamadhvaraṃ no'gnerjuhvāmabhi gṛṇītam |
kṛṇutaṃ naḥ sviṣṭam ||
verses.translation: Ye two celestial Hotars, greet with praises this lofty rite of ours, the tongue of Agni. Cause that our sacrifice be well conducted.

verses.sanskrit:
ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्ब॒र्हिरेदᳪ स॑द॒न्त्विडा॒ सर॑स्वती॒ भार॑ती ।
म॒ही गृ॑णा॒ना ॥
verses.transliteration:
tisro devīrbarhiredaṃ sadantviḍā sarasvatī bhāratī |
mahī gṛṇānā ||
verses.translation: Upon this grass three Goddesses be seated, Idâ, Sarasvatî, Bhâratî the Mighty glorified with song.

verses.sanskrit:
तन्न॑स्तु॒रीप॒मद्भु॑तं पुरु॒क्षु त्वष्टा॑ सु॒वीर्य॑म् ।
रा॒यस्पोषं॒ वि ष्य॑तु॒ नाभि॑म॒स्मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
tannasturīpamadbhutaṃ purukṣu tvaṣṭā suvīryam |
rāyaspoṣaṃ vi ṣyatu nābhimasme ||
verses.translation: This our productive wondrous flow may Tvashtar pour down on this man's kin, and wealth and heroes.

verses.sanskrit:
वन॑स्प॒तेऽव॑ सृजा॒ ररा॑ण॒स्त्मना॑ दे॒वेषु॑ ।
अ॒ग्निर्ह॒व्यᳪ श॑मि॒ता सू॑दयाति ॥
verses.transliteration:
vanaspate'va sṛjā rarāṇastmanā deveṣu |
agnirhavyaṃ śamitā sūdayāti ||
verses.translation: Vanaspatî, presenting of thyself, send God-ward! Let Agni, Immolator, season our oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ स्वाहा॑ कृणुहि जातवेद॒ इन्द्रा॑य ह॒व्यम् ।
विश्वे॑ दे॒वा ह॒विरि॒दं जु॑षन्ताम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne svāhā kṛṇuhi jātaveda indrāya havyam |
viśve devā haviridaṃ juṣantām ||
verses.translation: Pay sacrifice to Indra, Jâtavedas Agni! with Hail! All Gods accept the gift we offer!

verses.sanskrit:
पीवो॑ अन्ना रयि॒वृधः॑ सुमे॒धाः श्वे॒तः सि॑षक्ति नि॒युता॑मभि॒श्रीः ।
ते वा॒यवे॒ सम॑नसो॒ वि त॑स्थु॒र्विश्वेन्नरः॑ स्वप॒त्यानि॑ चक्रुः ॥
verses.transliteration:
pīvo annā rayivṛdhaḥ sumedhāḥ śvetaḥ siṣakti niyutāmabhiśrīḥ |
te vāyave samanaso vi tasthurviśvennaraḥ svapatyāni cakruḥ ||
verses.translation: Wise, bright, arranger of his teams, he seeketh men with rich food whose treasures are abundant. They have stood firm of one accord with Vâyu: yea, the men wrought all noble operations.

verses.sanskrit:
रा॒ये नु यं ज॒ज्ञतू॒ रोद॑सी॒मे रा॒ये दे॒वी धि॒षणा॑ धाति दे॒वम् ।
अध॑ वा॒युं नि॒युतः॑ सश्चत॒ स्वा उ॒त श्वे॒तं वसु॑धितिं निरे॒के ॥
verses.transliteration:
rāye nu yaṃ jajñatū rodasīme rāye devī dhiṣaṇā dhāti devam |
adha vāyuṃ niyutaḥ saścata svā uta śvetaṃ vasudhitiṃ nireke ||
verses.translation: The God whom both these worlds brought forth for riches, whom heavenly Dhishanâ for our wealth appointeth— His team of harnessed horses waits on Vâyu and, foremost, on the radiant treasure-holder.

verses.sanskrit:
आपो॑ ह॒ यद्बृ॑ह॒तीर्विश्व॒माय॒न् गर्भं॒ दधा॑ना ज॒नय॑न्तीर॒ग्निम् ।
ततो॑ दे॒वाना॒ᳪ सम॑वर्त॒तासु॒रेकः॒ कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
āpo ha yadbṛhatīrviśvamāyan garbhaṃ dadhānā janayantīragnim |
tato devānāṃ samavartatāsurekaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
verses.translation: What time the mighty waters came containing the universal germ, producing Agni, Thence sprang the Gods one spirit into being. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sanskrit:
यश्चि॒दापो॑ महि॒ना प॒र्यप॑श्य॒द्दक्षं॒ दधा॑ना ज॒नय॑न्तीर्य॒ज्ञम् ।
यो दे॒वेष्वधि॑ दे॒व एक॒ आसी॒त् कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaścidāpo mahinā paryapaśyaddakṣaṃ dadhānā janayantīryajñam |
yo deveṣvadhi deva eka āsīt kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
verses.translation: Who in his might surveyed the floods enclosing productive force and generating Worship, He who is God mid Gods, and none beside him—What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sanskrit:
प्र याभि॒र्यासि॑ दा॒श्वाᳪस॒मच्छा॑ नि॒युद्भि॑र्वायवि॒ष्टये॑ दुरो॒णे ।
नि नो॑ र॒यिᳪ सु॒भोज॑सं युवस्व॒ नि वी॒रं गव्य॒मश्व्यं॑ च॒ राधः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra yābhiryāsi dāśvāṃsamacchā niyudbhirvāyaviṣṭaye duroṇe |
ni no rayiṃ subhojasaṃ yuvasva ni vīraṃ gavyamaśvyaṃ ca rādhaḥ ||
verses.translation: The teams wherewith thou seekest him who offers, within his house, O Vâyu, to direct him, Therewith send wealth to us with full enjoyment, a hero son and gifts of kine and horses.

verses.sanskrit:
आ नो॑ नि॒युद्भिः॑ श॒तिनी॑भिरध्व॒रᳪ स॑ह॒स्रिणी॑भि॒रुप॑ याहि य॒ज्ञम् ।
वायो॑ अ॒स्मिन्त्सव॑ने मादयस्व यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभिः॒ सदा॑ नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā no niyudbhiḥ śatinībhiradhvaraṃ sahasriṇībhirupa yāhi yajñam |
vāyo asmintsavane mādayasva yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
verses.translation: With thy yoked teams in hundreds and in thousands come to our sacrifice and solemn worship. O Vâyu, make thee glad at this libation. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit:
नि॒युत्वा॑न्वाय॒वा ग॑ह्य॒यᳪ शु॒क्रो अ॑यामि ते ।
गन्ता॑सि सुन्व॒तो गृ॒हम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
niyutvānvāyavā gahyayaṃ śukro ayāmi te |
gantāsi sunvato gṛham ||
verses.translation: Drawn by thy team, O Vâyu, come: to thee is offered this, the pure. Thou visitest the presser's house.

verses.sanskrit:
वायो॑ शु॒क्रो अ॑यामि ते॒ मध्वो॒ अग्रं॒ दिवि॑ष्टिषु ।
आ या॑हि॒ सोम॑पीतये स्पा॒र्हो दे॑व नि॒युत्व॑ता ॥
verses.transliteration:
vāyo śukro ayāmi te madhvo agraṃ diviṣṭiṣu |
ā yāhi somapītaye spārho deva niyutvatā ||
verses.translation: Vâyu, the bright is offered thee, best of the meath at holy rites. Come thou to drink the Soma juice, God longed-for, on thy team-drawn car.

verses.sanskrit:
वा॒युर॑ग्रे॒गा य॑ज्ञ॒प्रीः सा॒कं ग॒न्मन॑सा य॒ज्ञम् ।
शि॒वो नि॒युद्भिः॑ शि॒वाभिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vāyuragregā yajñaprīḥ sākaṃ ganmanasā yajñam |
śivo niyudbhiḥ śivābhiḥ ||
verses.translation: Lover of worship, leader, come Vâyu with thought, to sacrifice, Propitious with propitious teams!

verses.sanskrit:
वायो॒ ये ते॑ सह॒स्रिणो॒ रथा॑स॒स्तेभि॒रा ग॑हि ।
नि॒युत्वा॒न्त्सोम॑पीतये ॥
verses.transliteration:
vāyo ye te sahasriṇo rathāsastebhirā gahi |
niyutvāntsomapītaye ||
verses.translation: With all the thousand chariots that are thine, O Vâyu, come to us, Team-drawn, to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sanskrit:
एक॑या च द॒शभि॑श्च स्वभूते॒ द्वाभ्या॑मि॒ष्टये॑ विᳪश॒ती च॑ ।
ति॒सृभि॑श्च॒ वह॑से त्रि॒ᳪशता॑ च नि॒युद्भि॑र्वायवि॒ह ता वि मु॑ञ्च ॥
verses.transliteration:
ekayā ca daśabhiśca svabhūte dvābhyāmiṣṭaye viṃśatī ca |
tisṛbhiśca vahase triṃśatā ca niyudbhirvāyaviha tā vi muñca ||
verses.translation: Come thou with one, and ten, O Self-Existent! with two unto the sacrifice, and twenty. Three are the teams and thirty which convey thee. O Vâyu, in this place unyoke thy coursers.

verses.sanskrit:
तव॑ वायवृतस्पते॒ त्वष्टु॑र्जामातरद्भुत ।
अवा॒ᳪस्या वृ॑णीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
tava vāyavṛtaspate tvaṣṭurjāmātaradbhuta |
avāṃsyā vṛṇīmahe ||
verses.translation: Wonderful Vâyu, Lord of Truth, thou who art Tvashtar's Son in-law, Thy saving succour we elect.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भि त्वा॑ शूर नोनु॒मोऽदु॑ग्धा इव धे॒नवः॑ ।
ईशा॑नम॒स्य जग॑तः स्व॒र्दृश॒मीशा॑नमिन्द्र त॒स्थुषः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhi tvā śūra nonumo'dugdhā iva dhenavaḥ |
īśānamasya jagataḥ svardṛśamīśānamindra tasthuṣaḥ ||
verses.translation: Like kine unmilked we call aloud, Hero, to thee and sing thy praise, Looker on heavenly light, Lord of this moving world, Lord, Indra! of what moveth not.

verses.sanskrit:
न त्वावाँ॑२ अ॒न्यो दि॒व्यो न पार्थि॑वो॒ न जा॒तो न ज॑निष्यते ।
अ॒श्वा॒यन्तो॑ मघवन्निन्द्र वा॒जिनो॑ ग॒व्यन्त॑स्त्वा हवामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
na tvāvām̐ anyo divyo na pārthivo na jāto na janiṣyate |
aśvāyanto maghavannindra vājino gavyantastvā havāmahe ||
verses.translation: None other like to thee, of earth or of the heavens, hath been or ever will be born. Desiring horses, Indra, Bounteous Lord! and kine, as men of might we call on thee.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वामिद्धि हवा॑महे सा॒तौ वाज॑स्य का॒रवः॑ ।
त्वां वृ॒त्रेष्वि॑न्द्र॒ सत्प॑तिं॒ नर॒स्त्वां काष्ठा॒स्वर्व॑तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvāmiddhi havāmahe sātau vājasya kāravaḥ |
tvāṃ vṛtreṣvindra satpatiṃ narastvāṃ kāṣṭhāsvarvataḥ ||
verses.translation: That we may win us wealth and power, we poets call on only thee. In war men call on thee, Indra! the hero's Lord, in the steed's race-course call on thee.

verses.sanskrit:
स त्वं न॑श्चित्र वज्रहस्त धृष्णु॒या म॒ह स्त॑वा॒नो अ॑द्रिवः ।
गामश्व॑ᳪ र॒थ्य॒मिन्द्र॒ सं कि॑र स॒त्रा वाजं॒ न जि॒ग्युषे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa tvaṃ naścitra vajrahasta dhṛṣṇuyā maha stavāno adrivaḥ |
gāmaśvaṃ rathyamindra saṃ kira satrā vājaṃ na jigyuṣe ||
verses.translation: As such, O Wonderful, whose hand holds thunder, praised as mighty, Caster of the Stone! Pour on us boldly, Indra, kine and chariot-steeds ever to be the conqueror's strength.

verses.sanskrit:
कया॑ नश्चि॒त्र आ भु॑वदू॒ती स॒दावृ॑धः॒ सखा॑ ।
कया॒ शचि॑ष्ठया वृ॒ता ॥
verses.transliteration:
kayā naścitra ā bhuvadūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā |
kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā ||
verses.translation: What succour will he bring to us, wonderful, ever-prospering Friend? With what most mighty company?

verses.sanskrit:
कस्त्वा॑ स॒त्यो मदा॑नां॒ मᳪहि॑ष्ठो मत्स॒दन्ध॑सः ।
दृ॒ढा चि॑दा॒रुजे॒ वसु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
kastvā satyo madānāṃ maṃhiṣṭho matsadandhasaḥ |
dṛḍhā cidāruje vasu ||
verses.translation: What, genuine and most liberal draught will spirit thee with juice to burst Open een strongly-guarded wealth

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भी षु णः॒ सखी॑नामवि॒ता ज॑रितॄ॒णाम् ।
श॒तं भ॑वास्यू॒तये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhī ṣu ṇaḥ sakhīnāmavitā jaritṝṇām |
śataṃ bhavāsyūtaye ||
verses.translation: Do thou who art protector of us thy friends who praise thee With hundred aids approach us.

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञा-य॑ज्ञा वो अ॒ग्नये॑ गि॒रा-गि॑रा च॒ दक्ष॑से ।
प्र-प्र॑ व॒यम॒मृतं॑ जा॒तवे॑दसं प्रि॒यं मि॒त्रं न श॑ᳪसिषम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajñā-yajñā vo agnaye girā-girā ca dakṣase |
pra-pra vayamamṛtaṃ jātavedasaṃ priyaṃ mitraṃ na śaṃsiṣam ||
verses.translation: Sing to your Agni with each song, at every sacrifice, for strength. Come, let us praise the Wise and Everlasting God even as a well-belovèd Friend.

verses.sanskrit:
पा॒हि नो॑ अग्न॒ एक॑या पा॒ह्युत द्वि॒तीय॑या ।
पा॒हि गी॒र्भिस्ति॒सृभि॑रूर्जां पते पा॒हि च॑त॒सृभि॑र्वसो ॥
verses.transliteration:
pāhi no agna ekayā pāhyuta dvitīyayā |
pāhi gīrbhistisṛbhirūrjāṃ pate pāhi catasṛbhirvaso ||
verses.translation: Protect us, Agni, through the first, protect us through the second hymn. Protect us through three hymns, O Lord of Power and Might; through four hymns, Vasu! guard thou us.

verses.sanskrit:
ऊ॒र्जो नपा॑त॒ᳪ स हि॒नायम॑स्म॒युर्दाशे॑म ह॒व्यदा॑तये ।
भुव॒द्वाजे॑ष्ववि॒ता भुव॑द्वृ॒ध उ॒त त्रा॒ता त॒नूना॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ūrjo napātaṃ sa hināyamasmayurdāśema havyadātaye |
bhuvadvājeṣvavitā bhuvadvṛdha uta trātā tanūnām ||
verses.translation: The Son of Strength; for is he not our Friend? Let us serve him for offering our gifts. In battles may he be our help and strengthener, yea, be the saviour of our lives.

verses.sanskrit:
सं॒व॒त्स॒रो॒ऽसि परिवत्स॒रो॒ऽसीदावत्स॒रो॒ऽसीद्वत्स॒रो॒ऽसि वत्स॒रो॒ऽसि ।
उ॒षस॑स्ते कल्पन्तामहोरा॒त्रास्ते॑ कल्पन्तामर्धमा॒सास्ते॑ कल्पन्तां मा॒सास्ते कल्पन्तामृ॒तव॑स्ते कल्पन्ताᳪ संवत्स॒रस्ते॑ कल्पताम् । प्रेत्या॒ एत्यै॒ सं चाञ्च॒ प्र च॑ सारय ।
सुप॒र्ण॒चिद॑सि॒ तया॑ दे॒वत॑याऽङ्गिर॒स्वद् ध्रु॒वः सी॑द ॥
verses.transliteration:
saṃvatsaro'si parivatsaro'sīdāvatsaro'sīdvatsaro'si vatsaro'si |
uṣasaste kalpantāmahorātrāste kalpantāmardhamāsāste kalpantāṃ māsāste kalpantāmṛtavaste kalpantāṃ saṃvatsaraste kalpatām | pretyā etyai saṃ cāñca pra ca sāraya |
suparṇacidasi tayā devatayā'ṅgirasvad dhruvaḥ sīda ||
verses.translation: Thou art Samvatsara; thou art Parivatsara; thou art Idâvatsara; thou art Idvatsara; thou art Vatsara. Prosper thy Dawns! Prosper thy Day-and-Nights! Prosper thy Half-months, Months, Seasons, and Years! Combine them for their going and their coming, and send then forward on their ordered courses. In eagle's shape thou art piled up and layered. With that divinity, Angiras-like, lie steady.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षत्स॒मिधेन्द्र॑मि॒डस्प॒दे नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्या अधि॑ ।
दि॒वो वर्ष्म॒न्त्समि॑ध्यत॒ ओजि॑ष्ठश्चर्षणी॒सहां॒ वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣatsamidhendramiḍaspade nābhā pṛthivyā adhi |
divo varṣmantsamidhyata ojiṣṭhaścarṣaṇīsahāṃ vetvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: On the earth's centre, at libation's place let the Priest worship Indra with the kindling-stick. The mightiest of the lords of men is kindled on the height of heaven. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्तनू॒नपा॑तमू॒तिभि॒र्जेता॑र॒मप॑राजितम् ।
इन्द्रं॑ दे॒वᳪ स्व॒र्विदं॑ प॒थिभि॒र्मधु॑मत्तमै॒र्नरा॒शᳪसे॑न॒ तेज॑सा॒ वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣattanūnapātamūtibhirjetāramaparājitam |
indraṃ devaṃ svarvidaṃ pathibhirmadhumattamairnarāśaṃsena tejasā vetvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Him let the Hotar worship, him Tanûnapât with ready aids; the conqueror never overcome, Indra, the God who finds heaven's light on paths most rich in pleasant sweets, with Narâsamsa all aglow. Let him enjoy, etc., as in verse 1.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒दिडा॑भि॒रिन्द्र॑मीडि॒तमा॒जुह्वा॑न॒मम॑र्त्यम् ।
दे॒वो दे॒वैः सवी॑र्यो॒ वज्र॑हस्तः पुरन्द॒रो वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣadiḍābhirindramīḍitamājuhvānamamartyam |
devo devaiḥ savīryo vajrahastaḥ purandaro vetvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: With viands let the Hotar worship Indra immortal, praised, receiver of oblations. The God, the equal of the Gods in vigour, the thunder-wielder, breaker-down of castles. Let him enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॒ यक्षद्ब॒र्हिषीन्द्रं॑ निषद्व॒रं वृ॑ष॒भं नर्या॑पसम् ।
वसु॑भी रु॒द्रैरा॑दि॒त्यैः सु॒युग्भि॑र्ब॒र्हिरास॑द॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣadbarhiṣīndraṃ niṣadvaraṃ vṛṣabhaṃ naryāpasam |
vasubhī rudrairādityaiḥ suyugbhirbarhirāsadadvetvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship Indra, Bull who sitteth on sacred grass, doer of manly actions. Let him be seated on the grass with Vasus and Rudras and Âdityas for companions. Let him enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒दोजो॒ न वी॒र्यᳪ सहो॒ द्वार॒ इन्द्र॑मवर्धयन् ।
सुप्रा॒य॒णा अ॒स्मिन्य॒ज्ञे वि श्र॑यन्तामृता॒वृधो॒ द्वार॒ इन्द्रा॑य मी॒ढुषे॒ व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣadojo na vīryaṃ saho dvāra indramavardhayan |
suprāyaṇā asminyajñe vi śrayantāmṛtāvṛdho dvāra indrāya mīḍhuṣe vyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest sacrifice. The Doors have strengthened Indra, his force and conquering might and vigour. At this our worship let the Doors be opened, easy to pass, the strengtheners of Order: wide let them open out for bounteous Indra. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षदु॒षे इन्द्र॑स्य धे॒नू सु॒दुघे॑ मा॒तरा॑ म॒ही ।
स॒वा॒तरौ॒ न तेज॑सा व॒त्समिन्द्र॑मवर्धतां वी॒तामाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣaduṣe indrasya dhenū sudughe mātarā mahī |
savātarau na tejasā vatsamindramavardhatāṃ vītāmājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest sacrifice to Night and Morning, the teeming Cows of Indra, Mighty Mothers. Indra their calf with lustre have they strengthened, even as two mothers of a calf in common. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒द्दैव्या॒ होता॑रा भि॒षजा॒ सखा॑या ह॒विषेन्द्रं॑ भिषज्यतः ।
क॒वी देवौ॒ प्रचे॑तसा॒विन्द्रा॑य धत्त इन्द्रि॒यं वी॒तामाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣaddaivyā hotārā bhiṣajā sakhāyā haviṣendraṃ bhiṣajyataḥ |
kavī devau pracetasāvindrāya dhatta indriyaṃ vītāmājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship both the heavenly Hotars, Friends, Leeches, healing Indra with oblation. The sages, Gods preëminent for wisdom bestow on Indra his surpassing power. Let them enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षत्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्न भे॑ष॒जं त्रय॑स्त्रि॒धात॑वो॒ऽपस॒ इडा॒ सर॑स्वती॒ भार॑ती म॒हीः ।
इन्द्र॑पत्नीर्ह॒विष्म॑ती॒र्व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣattisro devīrna bheṣajaṃ trayastridhātavo'pasa iḍā sarasvatī bhāratī mahīḥ |
indrapatnīrhaviṣmatīrvyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest offer sacrifice to the three Goddesses and balm. Let the three triple active Ones, let Idâ and Sarasvatî and Bhâratî the mighty Dames, Consorts of Indra, who receive our sacrificial offerings, enjoy the butter, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्त्वष्टा॑र॒मिन्द्रं॑ दे॒वं भि॒षज॑ᳪ सु॒यजं॑ घृत॒श्रिय॑म् ।
पु॒रु॒रूप॑ᳪ सु॒रेत॑सं म॒घोन॒मिन्द्रा॑य॒ त्वष्टा॒ दध॑दिन्द्रि॒याणि॒ वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣattvaṣṭāramindraṃ devaṃ bhiṣajaṃ suyajaṃ ghṛtaśriyam |
pururūpaṃ suretasaṃ maghonamindrāya tvaṣṭā dadhadindriyāṇi vetvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship Tvashtar radiant Indra, Physician good at sacrifice, graced with butter, Multiform and prolific, rich and bounteous. Let Tvashtar, giving wondrous powers to Indra, enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒द्वन॒स्पति॑ᳪ शमि॒तार॑ᳪ श॒तक्र॑तुं धि॒यो जो॒ष्टार॑मिन्द्रि॒यम् ।
मध्वा॑ सम॒ञ्जन्प॒थिभिः॑ सु॒गेभिः॒ स्वदा॑ति य॒ज्ञं मधु॑ना घृ॒तेन॒ वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣadvanaspatiṃ śamitāraṃ śatakratuṃ dhiyo joṣṭāramindriyam |
madhvā samañjanpathibhiḥ sugebhiḥ svadāti yajñaṃ madhunā ghṛtena vetvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship him, the Forest-Sovran, the Immolator, Lord of Hundred Powers, the lover of the prayer, the friend of Indra. Balming with mead, may he on easy pathways sweeten our sacrifice with savoury butter. Let him enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒दिन्द्र॒ᳪ स्वाहाऽऽज्य॑स्य॒ स्वाहा॒ मेद॑सः॒ स्वाहा॑ स्तो॒काना॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ स्वाहा॑कृतीना॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ ह॒व्यसू॑क्तीनाम् ।
स्वाहा॑ दे॒वा आ॑ज्य॒पा जु॑षा॒णा इन्द्र॒ आज्य॑स्य॒ व्यन्तु॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣadindraṃ svāhā''jyasya svāhā medasaḥ svāhā stokānāṃ svāhā svāhākṛtīnāṃ svāhā havyasūktīnām |
svāhā devā ājyapā juṣāṇā indra ājyasya vyantu hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest offer sacrifice to Indra: with Hail! to Gods of butter; with Hail! to Gods of marrow; with Hail! to Gods of drops; with Hail! to Gods of offerings paid with Svâhâ; with Hail! to Gods of sacrificial hymns. All hail! May butter-drinking Gods and Indra rejoicing taste the butter. Hotar, worship.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वं ब॒र्हिरिन्द्र॑ᳪ सुदे॒वं दे॒वैर्वी॒रव॑त्स्ती॒र्णं वेद्या॑मवर्धयत् ।
वस्तो॑र्वृ॒तं प्राक्तोर्भृ॒तᳪ रा॒या ब॒र्हिष्म॒तोऽत्य॑गाद्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devaṃ barhirindraṃ sudevaṃ devairvīravatstīrṇaṃ vedyāmavardhayat |
vastorvṛtaṃ prāktorbhṛtaṃ rāyā barhiṣmato'tyagādvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja ||
verses.translation: Vigorous, strewn by Gods upon the altar the right Gods sacred Grass hath strengthened Indra. Cut in the day, cherished by night it hath surpassed those who have sacrificial Grass with wealth. For gain of riches let him taste. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वीर्द्वार॒ इन्द्र॑ᳪ सङ्घा॒ते वी॒ड्वीर्याम॑न्नवर्धयन् ।
आ व॒त्सेन॒ तरु॑णेन कुमा॒रेण॑ च मीव॒तापार्वा॑णᳪ रे॒णुक॑काटं नुदन्तां वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devīrdvāra indraṃ saṅghāte vīḍvīryāmannavardhayan |
ā vatsena taruṇena kumāreṇa ca mīvatāpārvāṇaṃ reṇukakāṭaṃ nudantāṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: Firm, closely joined, the Doors divine have strengthened Indra in the rite. Pressed by a calf or tender boy may they drive off the courser as he tosses up the sand. For gain of wealth let then enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी उ॒षासा॒नक्तेन्द्रं॑ य॒ज्ञे प्र॑य॒त्य॒ह्वेताम् ।
दैवी॒र्विशः॒ प्राया॑सिष्टा॒ᳪ सुप्री॑ते॒ सुधि॑ते वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devī uṣāsānaktendraṃ yajñe prayatyahvetām |
daivīrviśaḥ prāyāsiṣṭāṃ suprīte sudhite vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja ||
verses.translation: Morning and Night, the Goddesses, have called on Indra as the rite advanced. May they well-pleased and ordered well make the Celestial Tribes come forth. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी जोष्ट्री॒ वसु॑धिती दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धताम् ।
अया॑व्य॒न्याघा द्वेषा॒ᳪस्यान्या व॑क्ष॒द्वसु॒ वार्या॑णि॒ यज॑मानाय शिक्षि॒ते व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devī joṣṭrī vasudhitī devamindramavardhatām |
ayāvyanyāghā dveṣāṃsyānyā vakṣadvasu vāryāṇi yajamānāya śikṣite vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja ||
verses.translation: Two Goddesses, wealth-givers, kind, have heightened radiant Indra's strength. One drives away hatreds and sins; the other shall bring the Sacrificer boons and treasure. Instructed, let them both enjoy, for gain of wealth. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी ऊ॒र्जाहु॑ती॒ दुघे॒ सु॒दुघे॒ पय॒सेन्द्र॑मवर्धताम् ।
इष॒मूर्ज॑म॒न्या व॑क्ष॒त्सग्धि॒ᳪ सपी॑तिम॒न्या नवे॑न॒ पूर्वं॒ दय॑माने पुरा॒णेन॒ नव॒मधा॑ता॒मूर्ज॑मू॒र्जाहु॑ती ऊ॒र्जय॑माने॒ वसु॒ वार्या॑णि॒ यज॑मानाय शिक्षि॒ते व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devī ūrjāhutī dughe sudughe payasendramavardhatām |
iṣamūrjamanyā vakṣatsagdhiṃ sapītimanyā navena pūrvaṃ dayamāne purāṇena navamadhātāmūrjamūrjāhutī ūrjayamāne vasu vāryāṇi yajamānāya śikṣite vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja ||
verses.translation: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, the Goddesses, the teeming Cows, have prospered Indra with their milk. Let one bring food and energy, the other feast and banqueting. Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, allotting the several portions they have put together old energy with new and new with olden, strengthening boons and treasures for the Sacrificer. Instructed, let them, etc., as in verse 15.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वा दैव्या॒ होता॑रा दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धताम् ।
ह॒ताघ॑शᳪसा॒वाभा॑र्ष्टां॒ वसु॒ वार्या॑णि॒ यज॑मानाय शिक्षि॒तौ व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devā daivyā hotārā devamindramavardhatām |
hatāghaśaṃsāvābhārṣṭāṃ vasu vāryāṇi yajamānāya śikṣitau vasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja ||
verses.translation: The two Celestial Hotars, Gods, have heightened radiant Indra's might. Freed from slain sinners these have brought the Sacrificer wealth and boons. Instructed, let them, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वीस्ति॒स्रस्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीः पति॒मिन्द्र॑मवर्धयन् ।
अस्पृ॑क्ष॒द्भार॑ती॒ दिव॑ᳪ रु॒द्रैर्य॒ज्ञᳪ सर॑स्व॒तीडा॑ वसु॑मती गृ॒हान् व॑सु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devīstisrastisro devīḥ patimindramavardhayan |
aspṛkṣadbhāratī divaṃ rudrairyajñaṃ sarasvatīḍā vasumatī gṛhān vasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: Goddesses three, three Goddesses have heightened their Lord Indra's strength. One, Bhâratî, hath touched the sky, Sarasvatî the sacrifice with Rudras, and, enriched with wealth, Idâ the homesteads of the folk. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒व इन्द्रो॒ नरा॒शᳪस॑स्त्रिवरू॒थस्त्रि॑बन्धु॒रो दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धयत् ।
श॒तेन॑ शितिपृ॒ष्ठाना॒माहि॑तः स॒हस्रे॑ण॒ प्र व॑र्तते मि॒त्रावरु॒णेद॑स्य हो॒त्रमर्ह॑तो॒ बृह॒स्पति॑ स्तो॒त्रम॒श्विनाध्व॑र्यवं वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेत्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
deva indro narāśaṃsastrivarūthastribandhuro devamindramavardhayat |
śatena śitipṛṣṭhānāmāhitaḥ sahasreṇa pra vartate mitrāvaruṇedasya hotramarhato bṛhaspati stotramaśvinādhvaryavaṃ vasuvane vasudheyasya vettu yaja ||
verses.translation: The radiant Indra, Praise of Men, thrice-shielding, borne on three car-seats, hath heightened radiant Indra's strength. Set on a hundred white-backed cows, yea, on a thousand forth he goes. Mitra and Varuna alone deserve to be his Hotar-Priests, Brihaspati his Chanter, and the Asvins his Adhvaryavas. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वो देवै॒र्वन॒स्पति॒र्हिर॑ण्यपर्णो॒ मधु॑शाखः सुपिप्प॒लो दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धयत् ।
दिव॒मग्रे॑णास्पृक्ष॒दान्तरि॑क्षं पृथि॒वीम॑दृᳪहीद्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devo devairvanaspatirhiraṇyaparṇo madhuśākhaḥ supippalo devamindramavardhayat |
divamagreṇāspṛkṣadāntarikṣaṃ pṛthivīmadṛṃhīdvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja ||
verses.translation: Vanaspatî, a God with Gods, with golden leaves, sweet boughs, fair fruit, hath heightened radiant Indra's strength. Sky with his summit hath he touched, and firmament, and stablished earth. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वं ब॒र्हिर्वारि॑तीनां दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धयत् ।
स्वा॒स॒स्थमिन्द्रे॒णास॑न्नम॒न्या ब॒र्हीᳪष्य॒भ्य॒भूद्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devaṃ barhirvāritīnāṃ devamindramavardhayat |
svāsasthamindreṇāsannamanyā barhīṃṣyabhyabhūdvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja ||
verses.translation: The grassy robe of water-plants, divine, hath heightened Indra's strength. This, the fair seat where Indra sits, hath topped all other sacred grass. For gain of wealth let it enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वो अ॒ग्निः स्वि॑ष्ट॒कृद्दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धयत् ।
स्वि॑ष्टं कु॒र्वन्त्स्वि॑ष्ट॒कृत्स्वि॑ष्टम॒द्य क॑रोतु नो वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛddevamindramavardhayat |
sviṣṭaṃ kurvantsviṣṭakṛtsviṣṭamadya karotu no vasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja ||
verses.translation: Agni, Fair-offering-maker, bright, hath heightened radiant Indra's strength. To-day may Svishtakrit, Fair-offering-maker, paying good sacrifice, for us perform it. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निम॒द्य होता॑रमवृणीता॒यं यज॑मानः॒ पच॒न्पक्तीः॒ पच॑न्पुरो॒डाशं॑ ब॒ध्नन्निन्द्रा॑य॒ छाग॑म् ।
सू॒प॒स्था अ॒द्य दे॒वो वन॒स्पति॑रभव॒दिन्द्रा॑य॒ छागे॑न । अघ॒त्तं मे॑द॒स्तः प्रति॑ पच॒ताग्र॑भी॒दवी॑वृधत्पुरो॒डाशे॑न ।
त्वाम॒द्य ऋ॑षे ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnimadya hotāramavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamānaḥ pacanpaktīḥ pacanpuroḍāśaṃ badhnannindrāya chāgam |
sūpasthā adya devo vanaspatirabhavadindrāya chāgena | aghattaṃ medastaḥ prati pacatāgrabhīdavīvṛdhatpuroḍāśena |
tvāmadya ṛṣe ||
verses.translation: To-day the Sacrificer hath elected—dressing messes of cooked food and a rice-cake, binding a goat for Indra—Agni as his Hotar. To-day divine Vanaspatî hath with a goat served Indra well. He hath eaten from the fat, he hath accepted the cooked food, he hath waxed strong with the rice-cake. Thee, to-day, O Rishi, etc., as in XXI. 61.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षत्समिधा॒नं म॒हद्यशः॒ सुस॑मिद्धं॒ वरे॑ण्यम॒ग्निमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
गा॒य॒त्रीं छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं त्र्यविं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣatsamidhānaṃ mahadyaśaḥ susamiddhaṃ vareṇyamagnimindraṃ vayodhasam |
gāyatrīṃ chanda indriyaṃ tryaviṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvetvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship Agni, Indra, kindled, splendidly kindled, excellent strength-giver, Lending him mighty power, Gâyatrî metre, a cow aged eighteen months, and vital vigour. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्तनू॒नपा॑तमु॒द्भिदं॒ यं गर्भ॒मदि॑तिर्द॒धे शुचि॒मिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
उ॒ष्णिहं॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं दि॑त्य॒वाहं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣattanūnapātamudbhidaṃ yaṃ garbhamaditirdadhe śucimindraṃ vayodhasam |
uṣṇihaṃ chanda indriyaṃ dityavāhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvetvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest serve with sacrifice him who breaks forth, Tanûnapât, the germ which Aditi conceived, pure Indra who bestoweth strength, Bringing him mighty power, the Ushnih metre, an ox of two years old, and vital vigour. Let him enjoy; etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षदी॒डेन्य॑मीडि॒तं वृ॑त्र॒हन्त॑म॒मिडा॑भि॒रीड्यँ॒ सहः॒ सोम॒मिन्द्रँ॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
अ॒नु॒ष्टुभं॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं पञ्चा॑विं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣadīḍenyamīḍitaṃ vṛtrahantamamiḍābhirīḍyam̐ sahaḥ somamindram̐ vayodhasam |
anuṣṭubhaṃ chanda indriyaṃ pañcāviṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvetvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest sacrifice to Soma, Indra, adorable, adored, best Vritra-slayer, strength-giver, might, to be adored with viands, Bringing him mighty power, Anushtup metre, a cow of thirty months, and vital vigour. Let him enjoy, etc

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षत्सुब॒र्हिषं॑ पूष॒ण्वन्त॒मम॑र्त्य॒ᳪ सीद॑न्तं ब॒र्हिषि॑ प्रि॒येऽमृतेन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
बृ॒ह॒तीं छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं त्रि॑व॒त्सं गां वयो॒ दध॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣatsubarhiṣaṃ pūṣaṇvantamamartyaṃ sīdantaṃ barhiṣi priye'mṛtendraṃ vayodhasam |
bṛhatīṃ chanda indriyaṃ trivatsaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvetvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship Indra, strength-bestower, immortal, with fair grass, allied with Pûshan, seated on sacred grass, dear, everlasting, Bringing him mighty power, Brihatî metre, a steer of three years age and vital vigour. Let him enjoy, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒द्व्यच॑स्वतीः सुप्राय॒णा ऋ॑ता॒वृधो॒ द्वारो॑ दे॒वीर्हि॑र॒ण्ययी॑र्ब्र॒ह्माण॒मिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
प॒ङ्क्तिं छन्द॑ इ॒हेन्द्रि॒यं तु॑र्य॒वाहं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॒द्व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣadvyacasvatīḥ suprāyaṇā ṛtāvṛdho dvāro devīrhiraṇyayīrbrahmāṇamindraṃ vayodhasam |
paṅktiṃ chanda ihendriyaṃ turyavāhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship the wide-opening Portals, easy to pass, divine, Law-strengthening, golden, Indra, the Brahman Priest, the strength-bestower, Bringing him mighty power, the Pankti metre, a bullock four years old, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षत्सु॒पेश॑सा सुशि॒ल्पे बृ॑ह॒ती उ॒भे नक्तो॒षासा॒ न द॑र्श॒ते विश्व॒मिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
त्रि॒ष्टुभं॒ छन्द॑ इ॒हेन्द्रि॒यं प॑ष्ठ॒वाहं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॑द्वी॒तामाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣatsupeśasā suśilpe bṛhatī ubhe naktoṣāsā na darśate viśvamindraṃ vayodhasam |
triṣṭubhaṃ chanda ihendriyaṃ paṣṭhavāhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvītāmājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship lofty Night and Morning, well-decked, of varied hue, lovely to look on, Indra the Universal, strength-bestower, Bringing him mighty power, the Trishtup metre, a bullock four years old, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्प्रचे॑तसा दे॒वाना॑मुत्त॒मं यशो॒ होता॑रा दैव्या क॒वी स॒युजेन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
जग॑तीं॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यम॑न॒ड्वाहं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॑द्वी॒तामाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣatpracetasā devānāmuttamaṃ yaśo hotārā daivyā kavī sayujendraṃ vayodhasam |
jagatīṃ chanda indriyamanaḍvāhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvītāmājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship both celestial Hotars, the Gods best glory, sages famed for wisdom, the two companions, Indra strength-bestower, Bringing him mighty power, Jagatî metre, an ox that draws the wain, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्पेश॑स्वतीस्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्हि॑र॒ण्ययी॒र्भार॑तीर्बृह॒तीर्म॒हीः पति॒मिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
वि॒राजं॒ छन्द॑ इ॒हेन्द्रि॒यं धे॒नुं गां न वयो॒ दध॒द्व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣatpeśasvatīstisro devīrhiraṇyayīrbhāratīrbṛhatīrmahīḥ patimindraṃ vayodhasam |
virājaṃ chanda ihendriyaṃ dhenuṃ gāṃ na vayo dadhadvyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest sacrifice to three well-decorated Goddesses, gold-decked, great, lofty, Bhâratîs, Indra their Lord who giveth strength, Bringing him mighty power, Virâj the metre, and a cow in milk. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, worship.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्षत्सु॒रेत॑सं॒ त्वष्टा॑रं पुष्टि॒वर्ध॑नᳪ रू॒पाणि॒ बिभ्र॑तं॒ पृथ॒क् पुष्टि॒मिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
द्वि॒पदं॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यमु॒क्षाणं॒ गां न वयो॒ दध॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣatsuretasaṃ tvaṣṭāraṃ puṣṭivardhanaṃ rūpāṇi bibhrataṃ pṛthak puṣṭimindraṃ vayodhasam |
dvipadaṃ chanda indriyamukṣāṇaṃ gāṃ na vayo dadhadvetvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest worship Tvashtar the prolific, strengthener of growth, maintaining varied growth and form, Indra who giveth vital force, Bringing him Dvipad metre, mighty power, and an ox full-grown. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒द्वन॒स्पति॑ᳪ शमि॒तार॑ᳪ श॒तक्र॑तु॒ᳪ हिर॑ण्यपर्णमु॒क्थिन॑ᳪ रश॒नां बिभ्र॑तं व॒शिं भग॒मिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
क॒कुभं॒ छन्द॑ इ॒हेन्द्रि॒यं व॒शां वे॒हतं॒ गां वयो॒ दध॒द्वेत्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣadvanaspatiṃ śamitāraṃ śatakratuṃ hiraṇyaparṇamukthinaṃ raśanāṃ bibhrataṃ vaśiṃ bhagamindraṃ vayodhasam |
kakubhaṃ chanda ihendriyaṃ vaśāṃ vehataṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvetvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest serve with sacrifice the Forest Lord Vanaspatî, the Immolator, hundred-powered, praise-worthy, golden-leafed, who wears the girdle, loved, the gracious Lord, Indra who gives the strength of life, Giving him Kakup metre, mighty power, a barren, a calfslipping cow, and vital vigour. Let him enjoy the butter. Hotar, sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
होता॑ यक्ष॒त्स्वाहा॑कृतीर॒ग्निं गृ॒हप॑तिं॒ पृथ॒ग्वरु॑णं भेष॒जं क॒विं क्ष॒त्रमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धस॑म् ।
अति॑च्छन्दसं॒ छन्द॑ इन्द्रि॒यं बृ॒हदृ॑ष॒भं गां वयो॒ दध॒द्व्यन्त्वाज्य॑स्य॒ होत॒र्यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
hotā yakṣatsvāhākṛtīragniṃ gṛhapatiṃ pṛthagvaruṇaṃ bheṣajaṃ kaviṃ kṣatramindraṃ vayodhasam |
aticchandasaṃ chanda indriyaṃ bṛhadṛṣabhaṃ gāṃ vayo dadhadvyantvājyasya hotaryaja ||
verses.translation: Let the Priest offer worship to the Svâhâkriti Goddesses, to Agni Household Lord apart, to Varuna the Leech and Sage. might, Indra who bestoweth strength, Bringing him Atichhandas metre, great and mighty power, a strong bull, his prime, and vital vigour. Let them enjoy the butter. Hotar, sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वं ब॒र्हिर्व॑यो॒धसं॑ दे॒वमिन्द्र॑मवर्धयत् ।
गा॒य॒त्र्या छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं चक्षु॒रिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devaṃ barhirvayodhasaṃ devamindramavardhayat |
gāyatryā chandasendriyaṃ cakṣurindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja ||
verses.translation: The Grass divine hath added might to radiant Indra strength-giver, Laying in Indra wondrous power and sight and strength by Gâyatrî. For gain of wealth let him enjoy the butter. Offer sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वीर्द्वारो॑ वयो॒धस॒ᳪ शुचि॒मिन्द्र॑मवर्धयन् ।
उ॒ष्णिहा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं प्रा॒णमिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devīrdvāro vayodhasaṃ śucimindramavardhayan |
uṣṇihā chandasendriyaṃ prāṇamindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: The Doors divine have magnified bright Indra, who bestoweth strength. With Ushnih laying mighty power in Indra, vital breath and force. For gain of wealth let them enjoy the butter. Offer sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी उ॒षासा॒नक्ता॑ दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वी दे॒वम॑वर्धताम् ।
अ॒नु॒ष्टुभा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं बल॒मिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devī uṣāsānaktā devamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devī devamavardhatām |
anuṣṭubhā chandasendriyaṃ balamindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja ||
verses.translation: Morning and Night, divine Ones, have strengthened bright Indra, strength-giver, the Goddesses advanced the God, With the Anushtup laying power in Indra, strength and vital force. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी जोष्ट्री॒ वसु॑धिती दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वी दे॒वम॑वर्धताम् ।
बृ॒ह॒त्या छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यᳪ श्रोत्र॒मिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devī joṣṭrī vasudhitī devamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devī devamavardhatām |
bṛhatyā chandasendriyaṃ śrotramindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja ||
verses.translation: Kind, bounteous, and divine, they have strengthened bright Indra, force-giver, the Goddesses advanced the God, Laying in Indra power and force and hearing with the Brihatî. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वी ऊ॒र्जाहु॑ती॒ दुघे॑ सु॒दु॒घे॒ पय॒सेन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वी दे॒वम॑वर्धताम् ।
प॒ङ्क्त्या छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यᳪ शु॒क्रमिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devī ūrjāhutī dughe sudughe payasendraṃ vayodhasaṃ devī devamavardhatām |
paṅktyā chandasendriyaṃ śukramindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja ||
verses.translation: Bringers of strengthening sacrifice, the Goddesses, two teeming cows, have heightened Indra's power with milk, Laying bright power in Indra with Pankti, and vital energy. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वा दैव्या॒ होता॑रा दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वौ दे॒वम॑वर्धताम् ।
त्रि॒ष्टुभा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं त्विषि॒मिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वीतां॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devā daivyā hotārā devamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devau devamavardhatām |
triṣṭubhā chandasendriyaṃ tviṣimindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vītāṃ yaja ||
verses.translation: The Gods, two heavenly Hotars, have strengthened bright Indra, force-giver, those Gods have magnified the God, With Trishtup giving Indra power, impetuous might, and vital strength. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वीस्ति॒स्रस्ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्व॑यो॒धसं॒ पति॒मिन्द्र॑मवर्धयन् ।
जग॑त्या॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यᳪ शूष॒मिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य व्यन्तु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devīstisrastisro devīrvayodhasaṃ patimindramavardhayan |
jagatyā chandasendriyaṃ śūṣamindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vyantu yaja ||
verses.translation: Goddesses three, three Goddesses have heightened their Lord Indra's strength, his who bestoweth vital force, Laying in Indra power and might and vital strength with Jagatî. For gain of wealth let them enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वो नरा॒शᳪसो॑ दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वो दे॒वम॑वर्धयत् ।
वि॒राजा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यᳪ रु॒पमिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devo narāśaṃso devamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devo devamavardhayat |
virājā chandasendriyaṃ rupamindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja ||
verses.translation: The God, the Praise of all men, hath strengthened bright Indra force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, Laying in Indra with Virâj beauty and power and vital force. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वो वन॒स्पति॑र्दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वो दे॒वम॑वर्धयत् ।
द्विप॑दा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं भग॒मिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devo vanaspatirdevamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devo devamavardhayat |
dvipadā chandasendriyaṃ bhagamindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja ||
verses.translation: The God the Forest Sovran hath strengthened bright Indra, force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, With Dvipad storing Indra with fortune and power and vital strength. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वं ब॒र्हिर्वारि॑तीनां दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वं दे॒वम॑वर्धयत् ।
क॒कुभा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं यश॒ इन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devaṃ barhirvāritīnāṃ devamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devaṃ devamavardhayat |
kakubhā chandasendriyaṃ yaśa indre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja ||
verses.translation: The Grass divine of water-plants hath helped bright Indra force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, Laying in Indra mighty power with Kakup, fame and vital strength. For gain of wealth let it enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वो अ॒ग्निः स्वि॑ष्ट॒कृद्दे॒वमिन्द्रं॑ वयो॒धसं॑ दे॒वम॑वर्धयत् ।
अति॑च्छन्दसा॒ छन्द॑सेन्द्रि॒यं क्ष॒त्रमिन्द्रे॒ वयो॒ दध॑द्वसु॒वने॑ वसु॒धेय॑स्य वेतु॒ यज॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devo agniḥ sviṣṭakṛddevamindraṃ vayodhasaṃ devamavardhayat |
aticchandasā chandasendriyaṃ kṣatramindre vayo dadhadvasuvane vasudheyasya vetu yaja ||
verses.translation: Agni, the God who makes fair rites, hath strengthened Indra force-giver, the God hath magnified the God, Laying with Atichhandas power in Indra, sway, and vital strength. For gain of wealth let him enjoy. Pay sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒ग्निम॒द्य होता॑रमवृणीता॒यं यज॑मानः॒ पच॒न्पक्तीः॒ पच॑न्पुरो॒डाशं॑ ब॒ध्नन्निन्द्रा॑य वयो॒धसे॒ छाग॑म् ।
सू॒प॒स्था अ॒द्य दे॒वो वन॒स्पति॑रभव॒दिन्द्रा॑य वयो॒धसे॒ छागे॑न ।
अघ॒त्तं मे॑द॒स्तः प्रति॑पच॒ताग्र॑भी॒दवी॑वृधत्पुरो॒डाशे॑न । त्वाम॒द्य ऋ॑षे ॥
verses.transliteration:
agnimadya hotāramavṛṇītāyaṃ yajamānaḥ pacanpaktīḥ pacanpuroḍāśaṃ badhnannindrāya vayodhase chāgam |
sūpasthā adya devo vanaspatirabhavadindrāya vayodhase chāgena |
aghattaṃ medastaḥ pratipacatāgrabhīdavīvṛdhatpuroḍāśena | tvāmadya ṛṣe ||
verses.translation: To-day the Sacrificer hath elected, etc., as in verse 23. To-day divine Vanaspatî, etc. . . . . . . Thee, to-day, O Rishi, etc. . . . . . .

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑द्धो अ॒ञ्जन् कृद॑रं मती॒नां घृ॒तम॑ग्ने॒ मधु॑म॒त्पिन्व॑मानः ।
वा॒जी वह॑न् वा॒जिनं॑ जातवेदो दे॒वानां॑ वक्षि प्रि॒यमा स॒धस्थ॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
samiddho añjan kṛdaraṃ matīnāṃ ghṛtamagne madhumatpinvamānaḥ |
vājī vahan vājinaṃ jātavedo devānāṃ vakṣi priyamā sadhastham ||
verses.translation: Decking the treasure-house of prayers, O Agni, enkindled, pouring forth sweet-tasted butter, Swift-moving, bearing curd, O Jâtavedas, bear what they love to the Gods habitation.

verses.sanskrit:
घृ॒तेना॒ञ्जन्त्सं प॒थो दे॑व॒याना॑न् प्रजा॒नन् वा॒ज्यप्ये॑तु दे॒वान् ।
अनु॑ त्वा सप्ते प्र॒दिशः॑ सचन्ताᳪ स्व॒धाम॒स्मै॒ यज॑मानाय धेहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ghṛtenāñjantsaṃ patho devayānān prajānan vājyapyetu devān |
anu tvā sapte pradiśaḥ sacantāṃ svadhāmasmai yajamānāya dhehi ||
verses.translation: Balming the paths that lead to heaven with fatness, let the Steed go unto the Gods well-knowing. Courser, the Quarters of the sky attend thee! Bestow thou food upon this Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit:
ईड्य॒श्चासि॒ वन्द्य॑श्च वाजिन्ना॒शुश्चासि॒ मेध्य॑श्च सप्ते ।
अ॒ग्निष्ट्वा॑ देवै॒र्वसु॑भिः स॒जोषाः॑ प्री॒तं वह्निं॑ वहतु जा॒तवे॑दाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
īḍyaścāsi vandyaśca vājinnāśuścāsi medhyaśca sapte |
agniṣṭvā devairvasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ prītaṃ vahniṃ vahatu jātavedāḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou, Steed, art meet for laud and veneration; swift, fit for sacrifice art thou, O Courser. In concert with the Gods and Vasus Agni Omniscient waft thee a contented bearer!

verses.sanskrit:
स्ती॒र्णं ब॒र्हिः सु॒ष्टरी॑मा जुषा॒णोरु पृ॒थु प्रथ॑मानं पृथि॒व्याम् ।
दे॒वेभि॑र्यु॒क्तमदि॑तिः स॒जोषाः॑ स्यो॒नं कृ॑ण्वा॒ना सु॑वि॒ते द॑धातु ॥
verses.transliteration:
stīrṇaṃ barhiḥ suṣṭarīmā juṣāṇoru pṛthu prathamānaṃ pṛthivyām |
devebhiryuktamaditiḥ sajoṣāḥ syonaṃ kṛṇvānā suvite dadhātu ||
verses.translation: Pleased with much Sacred Grass which we have scattered wide spread upon the earth, a pleasant carpet, Joined with the Gods may Aditi, accordant, bestowing bliss award it happy fortune.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒ता उ॑ वः सु॒भगा॑ वि॒श्वरू॑पा॒ वि पक्षो॑भिः॒ श्रय॑माणा॒ उदातैः॑ ।
ऋ॒ष्वाः स॒तीः क॒वषः॒ शुम्भ॑माना॒ द्वारो॑ दे॒वीः सु॑प्राय॒णा भ॑वन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
etā u vaḥ subhagā viśvarūpā vi pakṣobhiḥ śrayamāṇā udātaiḥ |
ṛṣvāḥ satīḥ kavaṣaḥ śumbhamānā dvāro devīḥ suprāyaṇā bhavantu ||
verses.translation: May these your Doors divine that wear all colours, auspicious, with uplifted leaves unfolding, Lofty and closely fitted and sonorous, rich in adornment, offer easy passage.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒न्त॒रा मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ चर॑न्ती॒ मुखं॑ य॒ज्ञाना॑म॒भि सं॑विदा॒ने ।
उ॒षासा॑ वाᳪ सुहिर॒ण्ये सु॑शि॒ल्पे ऋ॒तस्य॒ योना॑वि॒ह सा॑दयामि ॥
verses.transliteration:
antarā mitrāvaruṇā carantī mukhaṃ yajñānāmabhi saṃvidāne |
uṣāsā vāṃ suhiraṇye suśilpe ṛtasya yonāviha sādayāmi ||
verses.translation: Your two Dawns rich in gold and varied colour, travelling on twixt Varuna and Mitra, Acquainted with the face of sacrifices, I settle here within the home of Order.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒थ॒मा वा॑ᳪ सर॒थिना॑ सु॒वर्णा॑ देवौ॒ पश्य॑न्तौ॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
अपि॑प्रयं॒ चोद॑ना वां॒ मिमा॑ना॒ होता॑रा॒ ज्योतिः॑ प्र॒दिशा॑ दि॒शन्ता॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
prathamā vāṃ sarathinā suvarṇā devau paśyantau bhuvanāni viśvā |
apiprayaṃ codanā vāṃ mimānā hotārā jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā ||
verses.translation: Your two chief Hotars have I pleased, bright-coloured, borne on one car, Gods who behold all creatures, Those who prepare your rules and ordinances and make you see the light by their direction.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒दि॒त्यैर्नो॒ भार॑ती वष्टु य॒ज्ञᳪ सर॑स्वती स॒ह रु॒द्रैर्न॑ आवीत् ।
इडोप॑हूता॒ वसु॑भिः स॒जोषा॑ य॒ज्ञं नो॑ देवीर॒मृते॑षु धत्त ॥
verses.transliteration:
ādityairno bhāratī vaṣṭu yajñaṃ sarasvatī saha rudrairna āvīt |
iḍopahūtā vasubhiḥ sajoṣā yajñaṃ no devīramṛteṣu dhatta ||
verses.translation: Bhâratî with Âdityas love our worship! Sarasvatî with Rudras be our helper, And Idâ in accord, invoked with Vasus! Goddesses, place our rite among the Immortals.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वष्टा॑ वी॒रं दे॒वका॑मं जजान॒ त्वष्टु॒रर्वा॑ जायत आ॒शुरश्वः॑ ।
त्वष्टे॒दं विश्वं॒ भुव॑नं जजान ब॒होः क॒र्तार॑मि॒ह य॑क्षि होतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṣṭā vīraṃ devakāmaṃ jajāna tvaṣṭurarvā jāyata āśuraśvaḥ |
tvaṣṭedaṃ viśvaṃ bhuvanaṃ jajāna bahoḥ kartāramiha yakṣi hotaḥ ||
verses.translation: The God-devoted son Tvashtar produces: from Tvashtar springs to life your fleet-foot Courser. Tvashtar gave being to this All about us. Priest, worship here the mighty work's achiever.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्वो॑ घृ॒तेन॒ त्मन्या॒ सम॑क्त॒ उप॑ दे॒वाँ२ ऋ॑तु॒शः पाथ॑ एतु ।
वन॒स्पति॑र्देवलो॒कं प्र॑जा॒नन्न॒ग्निना॑ ह॒व्या स्व॑दि॒तानि॑ वक्षत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvo ghṛtena tmanyā samakta upa devām̐ ṛtuśaḥ pātha etu |
vanaspatirdevalokaṃ prajānannagninā havyā svaditāni vakṣat ||
verses.translation: Let the Steed seek his home, and balmed with butter go of himself unto the Gods in season. To the Gods world Vanaspatî, well-knowing, bear our oblations which the fire has tasted!

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जाप॑ते॒स्तप॑सा वावृधा॒नः स॒द्यो जा॒तो द॑धिषे य॒ज्ञम॑ग्ने ।
स्वाहा॑कृतेन ह॒विषा॑ पुरोगा या॒हि सा॒ध्या ह॒विर॑दन्तु दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajāpatestapasā vāvṛdhānaḥ sadyo jāto dadhiṣe yajñamagne |
svāhākṛtena haviṣā purogā yāhi sādhyā haviradantu devāḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou, waxing by Prajâpati's strong fervour, born quickly, guardest sacrifice, O Agni. With consecrated offering go, preceding, and let the Sâdhyas, Gods, eat our oblation.

verses.sanskrit:
यदक्र॑न्दः प्रथ॒मं जाय॑मान उ॒द्यन्त्स॑मु॒द्रादु॒त वा॒ पुरी॑षात् ।
श्ये॒नस्य॑ प॒क्षा ह॑रि॒णस्य॑ बा॒हू उ॑प॒स्तुत्यं॒ महि॑ जा॒तं ते॑ अर्वन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadakrandaḥ prathamaṃ jāyamāna udyantsamudrāduta vā purīṣāt |
śyenasya pakṣā hariṇasya bāhū upastutyaṃ mahi jātaṃ te arvan ||
verses.translation: What time, first springing into life, thou neighedst, proceeding from the sea or cloudy vapour, Limbs of the deer hadst thou, and eagle pinions. O Steed, thy birth is high and must be lauded.

verses.sanskrit:
य॒मेन॑ द॒त्तं त्रि॒त ए॑नमायुन॒गिन्द्र॑ एणं प्रथ॒मो अध्य॑तिष्ठत् ।
ग॒न्ध॒र्वो अ॑स्य रश॒नाम॑गृभ्णा॒त् सूरा॒दश्वं॑ वसवो॒ निर॑तष्ट ॥
verses.transliteration:
yamena dattaṃ trita enamāyunagindra eṇaṃ prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat |
gandharvo asya raśanāmagṛbhṇāt sūrādaśvaṃ vasavo nirataṣṭa ||
verses.translation: This Steed, bestowed by Yama, Trita harnessed, and Indra was the first to mount and ride him. His bridle the Gandharva grasped. O Vasus, from out the Sun ye fashioned forth the Courser.

verses.sanskrit:
असि॑ य॒मो अस्या॑दि॒त्यो अ॑र्व॒न्नसि॑ त्रि॒तो गुह्ये॑न व्र॒तेन॑ ।
असि॒ सोमे॑न स॒मया॒ विपृ॑क्त आ॒हुस्ते॒ त्रीणि॑ दि॒वि बन्ध॑नानि ॥
verses.transliteration:
asi yamo asyādityo arvannasi trito guhyena vratena |
asi somena samayā vipṛkta āhuste trīṇi divi bandhanāni ||
verses.translation: Yama art thou, O Horse; thou art Âditya; Trita art thou by secret operation. From Soma thou art thoroughly divided. They say there are three bonds in heaven that hold thee.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रीणि॑ त आहुर्दि॒वि बन्ध॑नानि॒ त्रीण्य॒प्सु त्रीण्य॒न्तः स॑मु॒द्रे ।
उ॒तेव॑ मे॒ वरु॑णश्छन्त्स्यर्व॒न् यत्रा॑ त आ॒हुः प॑र॒मं ज॒नित्र॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
trīṇi ta āhurdivi bandhanāni trīṇyapsu trīṇyantaḥ samudre |
uteva me varuṇaśchantsyarvan yatrā ta āhuḥ paramaṃ janitram ||
verses.translation: Three bonds, they say, thou hast in heaven to bind thee, three in the waters, three within the ocean. To me thou seemest Varuna, O Courser, there where they say is thy sublimest birthplace.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा ते॑ वाजिन्नव॒मार्ज॑नानी॒मा श॒फाना॑ᳪ सनि॒तुर्नि॒धाना॑ ।
अत्रा॑ ते भ॒द्रा र॑श॒ना अ॑पश्यमृ॒तस्य॒ या अ॑भि॒रक्ष॑न्ति गो॒पाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
imā te vājinnavamārjanānīmā śaphānāṃ saniturnidhānā |
atrā te bhadrā raśanā apaśyamṛtasya yā abhirakṣanti gopāḥ ||
verses.translation: Here, Courser, are the places where they groomed thee; here are the traces of thy hooves as winner. Here have I seen the auspicious reins that guide thee, which those who guard the holy Law keep safely.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒त्मानं॑ ते॒ मन॑सा॒राद॑जानाम॒वो दि॒वा प॒तय॑न्तं पत॒ङ्गम् ।
शिरो॑ अपश्यं प॒थिभिः॑ सु॒गेभि॑ररे॒णुभि॒र्जेह॑मानं पत॒त्रि ॥
verses.transliteration:
ātmānaṃ te manasārādajānāmavo divā patayantaṃ pataṅgam |
śiro apaśyaṃ pathibhiḥ sugebhirareṇubhirjehamānaṃ patatri ||
verses.translation: Thyself from far I recognized in spirit, a Bird that from below flew through the heaven. I saw thy head still soaring, striving upward by paths unsoiled by dust, pleasant to travel.

verses.sanskrit:
अत्रा॑ ते रू॒पमु॑त्त॒मम॑पश्यं॒ जिगी॑षमाणमि॒ष आ प॒दे गोः ।
य॒दा ते॒ मर्तो॒ अनु॒ भोग॒मान॒डादिद् ग्रसि॑ष्ठ॒ ओष॑धीरजीगः ॥
verses.transliteration:
atrā te rūpamuttamamapaśyaṃ jigīṣamāṇamiṣa ā pade goḥ |
yadā te marto anu bhogamānaḍādid grasiṣṭha oṣadhīrajīgaḥ ||
verses.translation: Here I beheld thy form matchless in beauty, eager to win thee food at the Cow's station. Wheneer a man brings thee to thine enjoyment, thou swallowest the herbs, most greedy eater.

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑ त्वा॒ रथो॒ अनु॒ मर्यो॑ अर्व॒न्ननु॒ गावोऽनु॒ भगः॑ क॒नीना॑म् ।
अनु॒ व्राता॑स॒स्तव॑ स॒ख्यमी॑यु॒रनु॑ दे॒वा म॑मिरे वी॒र्यं॒ ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
anu tvā ratho anu maryo arvannanu gāvo'nu bhagaḥ kanīnām |
anu vrātāsastava sakhyamīyuranu devā mamire vīryaṃ te ||
verses.translation: After thee, Courser, come the car, the bridegroom, the kine come after, and the charm of maidens. Full companies have followed for thy friendship: the pattern of thy vigour Gods have followed.

verses.sanskrit:
हिर॑ण्यशृ॒ङ्गोऽयो॑ अस्य॒ पादा॒ मनो॑जवा॒ अव॑र॒ इन्द्र॑ आसीत् ।
दे॒वा इद॑स्य हवि॒रद्य॑माय॒न् यो अर्व॑न्तं प्रथ॒मो अ॒ध्यति॑ष्ठत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyaśṛṅgo'yo asya pādā manojavā avara indra āsīt |
devā idasya haviradyamāyan yo arvantaṃ prathamo adhyatiṣṭhat ||
verses.translation: His horns are golden and his feet are iron. Less fleet than he, though swift as thought, was Indra. The Gods came only to the oblation-banquet of him who mounted first of all the Courser.

verses.sanskrit:
ई॒र्मान्ता॑सः॒ सिलि॑कमध्यमासः॒ सᳪ शूर॑णासो दि॒व्यासो॒ अत्याः॑ ।
ह॒सा इ॑व श्रेणि॒शो य॑तन्ते॒ यदाक्षि॑षुर्दि॒व्यमज्म॒मश्वाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
īrmāntāsaḥ silikamadhyamāsaḥ saṃ śūraṇāso divyāso atyāḥ |
hasā iva śreṇiśo yatante yadākṣiṣurdivyamajmamaśvāḥ ||
verses.translation: Symmetrical in flank, with rounded haunches, mettled like heroes, the celestial Coursers Put forth their strength like swans in lengthened order when they, the Steeds, have reached the heavenly causeway.

verses.sanskrit:
तव॒ शरी॑रं पतयि॒ष्ण्व॒र्व॒न्तव॑ चि॒त्तं वात॑ इव॒ ध्रजी॑मान् ।
तव॒ शृङ्गा॑णि॒ विष्ठि॑ता पुरु॒त्रार॑ण्येषु॒ जर्भु॑राणा चरन्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
tava śarīraṃ patayiṣṇvarvantava cittaṃ vāta iva dhrajīmān |
tava śṛṅgāṇi viṣṭhitā purutrāraṇyeṣu jarbhurāṇā caranti ||
verses.translation: A body formed for flight hast thou, O Charger; swift as the wind in motion is thy spirit. Thy horns are spread abroad in all directions; they move with restless beat in wildernesses.

verses.sanskrit:
उप॒ प्रागा॒च्छस॑नं वा॒ज्यर्वा॑ देव॒द्रीचा॒ मन॑सा॒ दीध्या॑नः ।
अ॒जः पु॒रो नी॑यते॒ नाभि॑र॒स्यानु॑ प॒श्चात्क॒वयो॑ यन्ति रे॒भाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
upa prāgācchasanaṃ vājyarvā devadrīcā manasā dīdhyānaḥ |
ajaḥ puro nīyate nābhirasyānu paścātkavayo yanti rebhāḥ ||
verses.translation: The strong Steed hath come forward to the slaughter, pondering with a mind directed God-ward. The goat who is his kin is led before him: the sages and the singers follow after.

verses.sanskrit:
उप॒ प्रागा॑त्पर॒मं यत्स॒धस्थ॒मर्वाँ॒२ अच्छा॑ पि॒तरं॑ मा॒तरं॑ च ।
अ॒द्या दे॒वाञ्जुष्ट॑तमो॒ हि ग॒म्या अथा शा॑स्ते दा॒शुषे॒ वार्या॑णि ॥
verses.transliteration:
upa prāgātparamaṃ yatsadhasthamarvām̐ acchā pitaraṃ mātaraṃ ca |
