adyā devāñjuṣṭatamo hi gamyā athā śāste dāśuṣe vāryāṇi ||
verses.translation: The Steed is come unto the noblest mansion, is come unto his Father and his Mother. This day shall he approach the Gods, most welcome: then he declares good gifts to him who worships.

verses.sanskrit:
समि॑द्धो अ॒द्य मनु॑षो दुरो॒णे दे॒वो दे॒वान् य॑जसि जातवेदः ।
आ च॒ वह॑ मित्रमहश्चिकि॒त्वान्त्वं दू॒तः क॒विर॑सि॒ प्रचे॑ताः ॥
verses.transliteration:
samiddho adya manuṣo duroṇe devo devān yajasi jātavedaḥ |
ā ca vaha mitramahaścikitvāntvaṃ dūtaḥ kavirasi pracetāḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou in the house of man this day enkindled worshippest Gods, a God, O Jâtavedas. Wealthy in friends! observant, bring them hither. Thou art a sapient envoy, full of wisdom.

verses.sanskrit:
तनू॑नपात्प॒थ ऋ॒तस्य॒ याना॒न्मध्वा॑ सम॒ञ्जन्त्स्व॑दया सुजिह्व ।
मन्मा॑नि धी॒भिरु॒त य॒ज्ञमृ॒न्धन् दे॑व॒त्रा च॑ कृणुह्यध्व॒रं नः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tanūnapātpatha ṛtasya yānānmadhvā samañjantsvadayā sujihva |
manmāni dhībhiruta yajñamṛndhan devatrā ca kṛṇuhyadhvaraṃ naḥ ||
verses.translation: Tanûnapât, fair-tongued, with sweet mead balming the paths and ways of Order, make them pleasant. Convey our sacrifice to heaven, exalting with holy thoughts our hymns of praise and worship.

verses.sanskrit:
नरा॒शᳪस॑स्य महि॒मान॑मेषा॒मुप॑ स्तोषाम यज॒तस्य॑ य॒ज्ञैः ।
ये सु॒क्रत॑वः॒ शुच॑यो धिय॒न्धाः स्वद॑न्ति दे॒वा उ॒भया॑नि ह॒व्या ॥
verses.transliteration:
narāśaṃsasya mahimānameṣāmupa stoṣāma yajatasya yajñaiḥ |
ye sukratavaḥ śucayo dhiyandhāḥ svadanti devā ubhayāni havyā ||
verses.translation: With sacrifice to these we with laudations will honour holy Narâsamsa's greatness— To these the pure, most wise, the thought-inspirers, Gods who enjoy both sorts of our oblations.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒जुह्वा॑न॒ ईड्यो॒ वन्द्य॒श्चा या॑ह्यग्ने॒ वसु॑भिः स॒जोषाः॑ ।
त्वं दे॒वाना॑मसि यह्व॒ होता॒ स ए॑नान्यक्षीषि॒तो यजी॑यान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ājuhvāna īḍyo vandyaścā yāhyagne vasubhiḥ sajoṣāḥ |
tvaṃ devānāmasi yahva hotā sa enānyakṣīṣito yajīyān ||
verses.translation: Invoked, deserving laud and adoration, O Agni, come accordant with the Vasus. Thou art, O vigorous One, the Gods Invoker, so, best of Sacrificers, bring them quickly.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒चीनं॑ ब॒र्हिः प्र॒दिशा॑ पृथि॒व्या वस्तो॑र॒स्या वृ॑ज्यते॒ अग्रे॒ अह्ना॑म् ।
व्यु॑ प्रथते वित॒रं वरी॑यो दे॒वेभ्यो॒ अदि॑तये स्यो॒नम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
prācīnaṃ barhiḥ pradiśā pṛthivyā vastorasyā vṛjyate agre ahnām |
vyu prathate vitaraṃ varīyo devebhyo aditaye syonam ||
verses.translation: By rule the Sacred Grass is scattered eastward, a robe to clothe the earth when dawns are breaking. Widely it spreads around and far extended, fair for the Gods and bringing peace and freedom.

verses.sanskrit:
व्यच॑स्वतीरुर्वि॒या वि श्र॑यन्तां॒ पति॑भ्यो॒ न जन॑यः॒ शुम्भ॑मानाः ।
देवी॑र्द्वारो बृहतीर्विश्वमिन्वा दे॒वेभ्यो॑ भवत सुप्राय॒णाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
vyacasvatīrurviyā vi śrayantāṃ patibhyo na janayaḥ śumbhamānāḥ |
devīrdvāro bṛhatīrviśvaminvā devebhyo bhavata suprāyaṇāḥ ||
verses.translation: Let the expansive Doors be widely opened, like wives who deck their beauty for their husbands. Lofty, celestial, all-impelling Portals, admit the Gods and give them easy access.

verses.sanskrit:
आ सु॒ष्वय॑न्ती यज॒ते उपा॑के उ॒षासा॒नक्ता॑ सदतां॒ नि योनौ॑ ।
दि॒व्ये योष॑णे बृह॒ती सु॑रु॒क्मे अधि॒ श्रिय॑ᳪ शुक्र॒पिशं॒ दधा॑ने ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā suṣvayantī yajate upāke uṣāsānaktā sadatāṃ ni yonau |
divye yoṣaṇe bṛhatī surukme adhi śriyaṃ śukrapiśaṃ dadhāne ||
verses.translation: Pouring sweet dews, let holy Night and Morning, each close to each, be seated at their station— Lofty, celestial Dames, with gold to deck them, assuming all their fair and radiant beauty.

verses.sanskrit:
दैव्या॒ होता॑रा प्रथ॒मा सु॒वाचा॒ मिमा॑ना य॒ज्ञं मनु॑षो॒ यज॑ध्यै ।
प्र॒चो॒दय॑न्ता वि॒दथे॑षु का॒रू प्रा॒चीनं॒ ज्योतिः॑ प्र॒दिशा॑ दि॒शन्ता॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
daivyā hotārā prathamā suvācā mimānā yajñaṃ manuṣo yajadhyai |
pracodayantā vidatheṣu kārū prācīnaṃ jyotiḥ pradiśā diśantā ||
verses.translation: Come the two chief celestial sweet-voiced Hotars, arranging sacrifice for man to worship, As singers who inspire us in assemblies, showing the eastward light with their direction!

verses.sanskrit:
आ नो॑ य॒ज्ञं भार॑ती॒ तूय॑मे॒त्विडा॑ मनु॒ष्वदि॒ह चे॒तय॑न्ती ।
ति॒स्रो दे॒वीर्ब॒र्हिरेदᳪ स्यो॒नᳪ सर॑स्वती॒ स्वप॑सः सदन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā no yajñaṃ bhāratī tūyametviḍā manuṣvadiha cetayantī |
tisro devīrbarhiredaṃ syonaṃ sarasvatī svapasaḥ sadantu ||
verses.translation: Let Bhâratî come quickly to our worship, and Idâ showing like a human being. So let Sarasvatî and both her fellows, deft Goddesses, on this fair grass be seated.

verses.sanskrit:
य इ॒मे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी जनि॑त्री रूपै॒रपि॑ᳪश॒द्भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
तम॒द्य हो॑तरिषि॒तो यजी॑यान् दे॒वं त्वष्टा॑रमि॒ह य॑क्षि वि॒द्वान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ya ime dyāvāpṛthivī janitrī rūpairapiṃśadbhuvanāni viśvā |
tamadya hotariṣito yajīyān devaṃ tvaṣṭāramiha yakṣi vidvān ||
verses.translation: Hotar more skilled in sacrifice, bring hither with speed today God Tvashtar, thou who knowest, Even him who framed these two, the Earth and Heaven, the Parents, with their forms, and every creature.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒पाव॑सृज॒ त्मन्या॑ सम॒ञ्जन् दे॒वानां॒ पाथ॑ ऋतु॒था ह॒वीᳪषि॑ ।
वन॒स्पतिः॑ शमि॒ता दे॒वो अ॒ग्निः स्वद॑न्तु ह॒व्यं मधु॑ना घृ॒तेन॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
upāvasṛja tmanyā samañjan devānāṃ pātha ṛtuthā havīṃṣi |
vanaspatiḥ śamitā devo agniḥ svadantu havyaṃ madhunā ghṛtena ||
verses.translation: Send to our offerings which thyself thou balmest the Companies of Gods in ordered season. Agni, Vanaspatî, the Immolator sweeten our offered gift with mead and butter.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒द्यो जा॒तो व्य॑मिमीत य॒ज्ञम॒ग्निर्दे॒वाना॑मभवत् पुरो॒गाः ।
अ॒स्य होतुः॑ प्र॒दिश्यृ॒तस्य॑ वा॒चि स्वाहा॑कृतᳪ ह॒विर॑दन्तु दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sadyo jāto vyamimīta yajñamagnirdevānāmabhavat purogāḥ |
asya hotuḥ pradiśyṛtasya vāci svāhākṛtaṃ haviradantu devāḥ ||
verses.translation: Agni as soon as he was born made ready the sacrifice and was the Gods preceder. May the Gods eat our offering consecrated according to the true Priest's voice and guidance.

verses.sanskrit:
के॒तुं कृ॒ण्वन्न॑के॒तवे॒ पेशो॑ मर्या अपे॒शसे॑ ।
समु॒षद्भि॑रजायथाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ketuṃ kṛṇvannaketave peśo maryā apeśase |
samuṣadbhirajāyathāḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou, making light where no light was, and form, O men! where form was not, Wast born together with the Dawns.

verses.sanskrit:
जी॒मूत॑स्येव भवति॒ प्रती॑कं॒ यद्व॒र्मी याति॑ स॒मदा॑मु॒पस्थे॑ ।
अना॑विद्धया त॒न्वा॒ जय॒ त्वᳪ स त्वा॒ वर्म॑णो महि॒मा पि॑पर्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
jīmūtasyeva bhavati pratīkaṃ yadvarmī yāti samadāmupasthe |
anāviddhayā tanvā jaya tvaṃ sa tvā varmaṇo mahimā pipartu ||
verses.translation: The warrior's look is like a thunderous rain-cloud's when, armed with mail, he seeks the lap of battle. Be thou victorious with unwounded body: so let the thickness of thine armour save thee.

verses.sanskrit:
धन्व॑ना॒ गा धन्व॑ना॒ऽऽजिं ज॑येम॒ धन्व॑ना ती॒व्राः स॒मदो॑ जयेम ।
धनुः॒ शत्रो॑रपका॒मं कृ॑णोति॒ धन्व॑ना॒ सर्वाः॑ प्र॒दिशो॑ जयेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhanvanā gā dhanvanā''jiṃ jayema dhanvanā tīvrāḥ samado jayema |
dhanuḥ śatrorapakāmaṃ kṛṇoti dhanvanā sarvāḥ pradiśo jayema ||
verses.translation: With Bow let us win kine, with Bow the battle, with Bow be victors in our hot encounters. The Bow brings grief and sorrow to the foeman: armed with the Bow may we subdue all regions.

verses.sanskrit:
व॒क्ष्यन्ती॒वेदा ग॑नीगन्ति॒ कर्णं॑ प्रि॒यᳪ सखा॑यं परिषस्वजा॒ना ।
योषे॑व शिङ्क्ते॒ वित॒ताधि॒ धन्व॒ञ्ज्या इ॒यᳪ सम॑ने पा॒रय॑न्ती ॥
verses.transliteration:
vakṣyantīvedā ganīganti karṇaṃ priyaṃ sakhāyaṃ pariṣasvajānā |
yoṣeva śiṅkte vitatādhi dhanvañjyā iyaṃ samane pārayantī ||
verses.translation: Close to his ear, as fain to speak, She presses, holding her well-loved Friend in her embraces. Strained on the Bow, She whispers like a woman—this Bow-string that preserves us in the combat.

verses.sanskrit:
ते आ॒चर॑न्ती॒ सम॑नेव॒ योषा॑ मा॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रं बि॑भृतामु॒पस्थे॑ ।
अप॒ शत्रू॑न् विध्यताᳪ संविदा॒ने आर्त्नी॑ इ॒मे वि॑ष्फु॒रन्ती॑ अ॒मित्रा॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
te ācarantī samaneva yoṣā māteva putraṃ bibhṛtāmupasthe |
apa śatrūn vidhyatāṃ saṃvidāne ārtnī ime viṣphurantī amitrān ||
verses.translation: These, meeting like a woman and her lover, bear, mother-like, their child upon their bosom. May the two Bow-ends, starting swift asunder scatter, in unison, the foes who hate us.

verses.sanskrit:
ब॒ह्वी॒नां पि॒ता ब॒हुर॑स्य पु॒त्रश्चि॒श्चा कृ॑णोति॒ सम॑नाव॒गत्य॑ ।
इ॒षु॒धिः सङ्का॒ पृत॑नाश्च॒ सर्वाः॑ पृ॒ष्ठे निन॑द्धो जयति॒ प्रसू॑तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
bahvīnāṃ pitā bahurasya putraściścā kṛṇoti samanāvagatya |
iṣudhiḥ saṅkā pṛtanāśca sarvāḥ pṛṣṭhe ninaddho jayati prasūtaḥ ||
verses.translation: With many a son, father of many daughters, He clangs and clashes as he goes to battle. Slung on the back, pouring his brood, the Quiver vanquishes all opposing bauds and armies.

verses.sanskrit:
रथे॒ तिष्ठ॑न् नयति वा॒जिनः॑ पु॒रो यत्र॑-यत्र का॒मय॑ते सुषार॒थिः ।
अ॒भीशू॑नां महि॒मानं॑ पनायत॒ मनः॑ प॒श्चादनु॑ यच्छन्ति र॒श्मयः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
rathe tiṣṭhan nayati vājinaḥ puro yatra-yatra kāmayate suṣārathiḥ |
abhīśūnāṃ mahimānaṃ panāyata manaḥ paścādanu yacchanti raśmayaḥ ||
verses.translation: Upstanding in the Car the skilful Charioteer guides his strong Horses on whithersoer he will. See and admire the strength of those controlling Reins which from behind declare the will of him who drives

verses.sanskrit:
ती॒व्रान् घोषा॑न् कृण्वते॒ वृष॑पाण॒योऽश्वा॒ रथे॑भिः स॒ह वा॒जय॑न्तः ।
अ॒व॒क्राम॑न्तः॒ प्रप॑दैर॒मित्रा॑न् क्षि॒णन्ति॒ शत्रूँ॒१ रन॑पव्ययन्तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tīvrān ghoṣān kṛṇvate vṛṣapāṇayo'śvā rathebhiḥ saha vājayantaḥ |
avakrāmantaḥ prapadairamitrān kṣiṇanti śatrūm̐ ranapavyayantaḥ ||
verses.translation: Horses whose hoofs rain dust are neighing loudly, yoked to the Chariots, showing forth their vigour. With their forefeet descending on the foemen, they, never flinching, trample and destroy them.

verses.sanskrit:
र॒थ॒वाह॑णᳪ ह॒विर॑स्य॒ नाम॒ यत्रायु॑धं॒ निहि॑तमस्य॒ वर्म॑ ।
तत्रा॒ रथ॒मुप॑ श॒ग्मᳪ स॑देम वि॒श्वाहा॑ व॒यᳪ सु॑मन॒स्यमा॑नाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
rathavāhaṇaṃ havirasya nāma yatrāyudhaṃ nihitamasya varma |
tatrā rathamupa śagmaṃ sadema viśvāhā vayaṃ sumanasyamānāḥ ||
verses.translation: Car-bearer is the name of his oblation, whereon are laid his Weapons and his Armour. So let us here, each day that passes, honour the helpful Car with hearts exceeding joyful.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वा॒दु॒ष॒ᳪसदः॑ पि॒तरो॑ वयो॒धाः कृ॑च्छ्रे॒श्रितः॒ शक्ती॑वन्तो गभी॒राः ।
चि॒त्रसे॑ना॒ इषु॑बला॒ अमृ॑ध्राः स॒तोवी॑रा उ॒रवो॑ व्रातसा॒हाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
svāduṣaṃsadaḥ pitaro vayodhāḥ kṛcchreśritaḥ śaktīvanto gabhīrāḥ |
citrasenā iṣubalā amṛdhrāḥ satovīrā uravo vrātasāhāḥ ||
verses.translation: In sweet association lived the fathers who gave us life, profound and strong in trouble, Unwearied, armed with shafts and wondrous weapons, free, real heroes, conquerors of armies.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्राह्म॑णासः॒ पित॑रः॒ सोम्या॑सः शि॒वे नो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑ने॒हसा॑ ।
पू॒षा नः॑ पातु दुरि॒तादृ॑तावृधो॒ रक्षा॒ माकि॑र्नो अ॒घश॑ᳪस ईशत ॥
verses.transliteration:
brāhmaṇāsaḥ pitaraḥ somyāsaḥ śive no dyāvāpṛthivī anehasā |
pūṣā naḥ pātu duritādṛtāvṛdho rakṣā mākirno aghaśaṃsa īśata ||
verses.translation: The Brâhmans, and the Fathers meet for Soma draughts, and, graciously inclined, unequalled Heaven and Earth. Guard us from evil, Pûshan! guard us strengtheners of Law! let not the evil-wisher master us.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒प॒र्णं व॑स्ते मृ॒गो अ॑स्या॒ दन्तो॒ गोभिः॒ सन्न॑द्धा पतति॒ प्रसू॑ता ।
यत्रा॒ नरः॒ सं च॒ वि च॒ द्रव॑न्ति॒ तत्रा॒स्मभ्य॒मिष॑वः॒ शर्म॑ यᳪसन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
suparṇaṃ vaste mṛgo asyā danto gobhiḥ sannaddhā patati prasūtā |
yatrā naraḥ saṃ ca vi ca dravanti tatrāsmabhyamiṣavaḥ śarma yaṃsan ||
verses.translation: Her tooth a deer, dressed in an eagle's feathers, bound with cow-hide, launched forth, She flieth onward. There where the heroes speed hither and thither, there may the arrows shelter and protect us.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋजी॑ते॒ परि॑ वृङ्धि॒ नोऽश्मा॑ भवतु नस्त॒नूः ।
सोमो॒ अधि॑ ब्रवीतु॒ नोऽदि॑तिः॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛjīte pari vṛṅdhi no'śmā bhavatu nastanūḥ |
somo adhi bravītu no'ditiḥ śarma yacchatu ||
verses.translation: Avoid as thou whose flight is straight, and let our bodies be as stone. May Soma kindly speak to us, and Aditi protect us well.

verses.sanskrit:
आ ज॑ङ्घन्ति॒ सान्वे॑षां ज॒घनाँ॒२ उप॑ जिघ्नते ।
अश्वा॑जनि॒ प्रचे॑त॒सोऽश्वा॑न्त्स॒मत्सु॑ चोदय ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā jaṅghanti sānveṣāṃ jaghanām̐ upa jighnate |
aśvājani pracetaso'śvāntsamatsu codaya ||
verses.translation: He lays his blows upon their backs, He deals his strokes upon their thighs. Thou Whip who urgest horses, drive sagacious chargers in the fray.

verses.sanskrit:
अहि॑रिव भोगैः॒ पर्ये॑ति बा॒हुं ज्याया॑ हे॒तिं प॑रि॒बाध॑मानः ।
ह॒स्त॒घ्नो विश्वा॑ व॒युना॑नि वि॒द्वान् पुमा॒न् पुमा॑ᳪसं॒ परि॑ पातु वि॒श्वतः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahiriva bhogaiḥ paryeti bāhuṃ jyāyā hetiṃ paribādhamānaḥ |
hastaghno viśvā vayunāni vidvān pumān pumāṃsaṃ pari pātu viśvataḥ ||
verses.translation: It compasses the arm with serpent windings, fending away the friction of the bowstring: So may the Brace, well skilled in all its duties, guard manfully the man from every quarter.

verses.sanskrit:
वन॑स्पते वी॒ड्व॒ङ्गो॒ हि भू॒या अ॒स्मत्स॑खा प्र॒तर॑णः सु॒वीरः॑ ।
गोभिः॒ सन्न॑द्धो असि वी॒डय॑स्वास्था॒ता ते॑ जयतु॒ जेत्वा॑नि ॥
verses.transliteration:
vanaspate vīḍvaṅgo hi bhūyā asmatsakhā prataraṇaḥ suvīraḥ |
gobhiḥ sannaddho asi vīḍayasvāsthātā te jayatu jetvāni ||
verses.translation: Lord of the Wood, be firm and strong in body: be, bearing us, a brave victorious hero. Show forth thy strength, compact with straps of leather, and let thy rider win all spoils of battle.

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒वः पृ॑थि॒व्याः पर्योज॒ उद्भृ॑तं॒ वन॒स्पति॑भ्यः॒ पर्याभृ॑त॒ᳪ सहः॑ ।
अ॒पामो॒ज्मानं॒ परि॒ गोभि॒रावृ॑त॒मिन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्र॑ᳪ ह॒विषा॒ रथं॑ यज ॥
verses.transliteration:
divaḥ pṛthivyāḥ paryoja udbhṛtaṃ vanaspatibhyaḥ paryābhṛtaṃ sahaḥ |
apāmojmānaṃ pari gobhirāvṛtamindrasya vajraṃ haviṣā rathaṃ yaja ||
verses.translation: Its mighty strength was borrowed from the heaven and earth its conquering force was brought from sovrans of the wood. Honour with holy gifts the Car like Indra's bolt, the Car bound round with straps, the vigour of the floods.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ वज्रो॑ म॒रुता॒मनी॑कं मि॒त्रस्य॒ गर्भो॒ वरु॑णस्य॒ नाभिः॑ ।
सेमां नो॑ ह॒व्यदा॑तिं जुषा॒णो देव॑ रथ॒ प्रति॑ ह॒व्या गृ॑भाय ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasya vajro marutāmanīkaṃ mitrasya garbho varuṇasya nābhiḥ |
semāṃ no havyadātiṃ juṣāṇo deva ratha prati havyā gṛbhāya ||
verses.translation: Thou bolt of Indra, Vanguard of the Maruts, close knit to Varuna and Child of Mitra,— As such, accepting gifts which here we offer, receive, O Godlike Chariot, these oblations.

verses.sanskrit:
उप॑ श्वासय पृथि॒वीमु॒त द्यां पु॑रु॒त्रा ते॑ मनुतां॒ विष्ठि॑तं॒ जग॑त् ।
स दु॑न्दुभे स॒जूरिन्द्रे॑ण दे॒वैर्दू॒राद्दवी॑यो॒ अप॑ सेध॒ शत्रू॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
upa śvāsaya pṛthivīmuta dyāṃ purutrā te manutāṃ viṣṭhitaṃ jagat |
sa dundubhe sajūrindreṇa devairdūrāddavīyo apa sedha śatrūn ||
verses.translation: Send forth thy voice aloud through earth and heaven, and let the world in all its breadth regard thee; O Drum, accordant with the Gods and Indra, drive thou afar, yea, very far, our foemen.

verses.sanskrit:
आ क्र॑न्दय॒ बल॒मोजो॑ न॒ आधा॒ निष्ट॑निहि दुरि॒ता बाध॑मानः ।
अप॑ प्रोथ दुन्दुभे दु॒च्छुना॑ इ॒त इन्द्र॑स्य मु॒ष्टिर॑सि वी॒डय॑स्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā krandaya balamojo na ādhā niṣṭanihi duritā bādhamānaḥ |
apa protha dundubhe ducchunā ita indrasya muṣṭirasi vīḍayasva ||
verses.translation: Thunder out strength and fill us fall of vigour: yea, thunder forth and drive away all dangers. Drive hence, O War-drum, drive away misfortune: thou art the Fist of Indra: show thy firmness.

verses.sanskrit:
आमूर॑ज प्र॒त्याव॑र्तये॒माः के॑तु॒मद्दु॑न्दु॒भिर्वा॑वदीति ।
समश्व॑पर्णा॒श्चर॑न्ति नो॒ नरो॒ऽस्माक॑मिन्द्र र॒थिनो॑ जयन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
āmūraja pratyāvartayemāḥ ketumaddundubhirvāvadīti |
samaśvaparṇāścaranti no naro'smākamindra rathino jayantu ||
verses.translation: Drive hither those, and these again bring hither: the War-drum speaks aloud as battle's signal. Our heroes, winged with horses, come together. Let our car-warriors, Indra, be triumphant.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒ग्ने॒यः कृ॒ष्णग्री॑वः सारस्व॒ती मे॒षी ब॒भ्रुः सौ॒म्यः पौ॒ष्णः श्या॒मः शि॑तिपृ॒ष्ठो बा॑र्हस्प॒त्यः शि॒ल्पो वै॑श्वदे॒व ऐ॒न्द्रो॒ऽरु॒णो मा॑रु॒तः क॒ल्माष॑ ऐन्द्रा॒ग्नः स॑ᳪहि॒तोऽधोरा॑मः सावि॒त्रो वा॑रु॒णः कृ॒ष्ण एक॑शितिपा॒त्पेत्वः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: āgneyaḥ kṛṣṇagrīvaḥ sārasvatī meṣī babhruḥ saumyaḥ pauṣṇaḥ śyāmaḥ śitipṛṣṭho bārhaspatyaḥ śilpo vaiśvadeva aindro'ruṇo mārutaḥ kalmāṣa aindrāgnaḥ saṃhito'dhorāmaḥ sāvitro vāruṇaḥ kṛṣṇa ekaśitipātpetvaḥ ||
verses.translation: The black-necked victim belongs to Agni; the ewe to Sarasvatî; the brown victim is Soma's; the dusky Pûshan's; the white-backed is Brihaspati's; the dappled belongs to the All-Gods; the red to Indra; the spotted to the Maruts; the strong-bodied to Indra-Agni; one with white marks below to Savitar; to Varuna a black ram with one white foot

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नयेऽनी॑कवते॒ रोहि॑ताञ्जिरन॒ड्वान॒धोरा॑मौ सावि॒त्रौ पौ॒ष्णौ र॑ज॒तना॑भी वैश्वदे॒वौ पि॒शङ्गौ॑ तूप॒रौ मा॑रु॒तः क॒ल्माष॑ आग्ने॒यः कृ॒ष्णोऽजः सा॑रस्व॒ती मे॒षी वा॑रु॒णः पेत्वः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: agnaye'nīkavate rohitāñjiranaḍvānadhorāmau sāvitrau pauṣṇau rajatanābhī vaiśvadevau piśaṅgau tūparau mārutaḥ kalmāṣa āgneyaḥ kṛṣṇo'jaḥ sārasvatī meṣī vāruṇaḥ petvaḥ ||
verses.translation: To Agni Anîkavân is sacrificed a red-marked ox; two with white spots below are for Savitar; two with silvery navels for Pûshan; two yellow hornless he-goats for the All-Gods; a spotted one for the Maruts; the black-faced he-goat is Agni's; the ewe is Sarasvatî's; the ram is Varuna's.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नये॑ गाय॒त्राय॑ त्रि॒वृते॒ राथ॑न्तराया॒ष्टाक॑पाल॒ इन्द्रा॑य त्रैष्टु॑भाय पञ्चद॒शाय॒ बार्ह॑ता॒यैका॑दशकपालो॒ विश्वे॑भ्यो दे॒वेभ्यो॒ जाग॑तेभ्यः सप्तद॒शेभ्यो॑ वैरू॒पेभ्यो॒ द्वाद॑शकपालो मि॒त्रावरु॑णाभ्या॒मानु॑ष्टुभाभ्यामेकवि॒ᳪशाभ्यां॑ वैरा॒जाभ्यां॑ पय॒स्या बृह॒स्पत॑ये॒ पाङ्क्ता॑य त्रिण॒वाय॑ शाक्व॒राय॑ च॒रुः स॑वि॒त्र औष्णि॑हाय त्रयस्त्रि॒ᳪशाय॑ रैव॒ताय॒ द्वाद॑शकपालः प्राजाप॒त्यश्च॒रुरदि॑त्यै॒ विष्णु॑पत्न्यै च॒रुर॒ग्नये॑ वैश्वान॒राय॒ द्वाद॑शकपा॒लोऽनु॑मत्या अ॒ष्टाक॑पालः ॥
verses.transliteration: agnaye gāyatrāya trivṛte rāthantarāyāṣṭākapāla indrāya traiṣṭubhāya pañcadaśāya bārhatāyaikādaśakapālo viśvebhyo devebhyo jāgatebhyaḥ saptadaśebhyo vairūpebhyo dvādaśakapālo mitrāvaruṇābhyāmānuṣṭubhābhyāmekaviṃśābhyāṃ vairājābhyāṃ payasyā bṛhaspataye pāṅktāya triṇavāya śākvarāya caruḥ savitra auṣṇihāya trayastriṃśāya raivatāya dvādaśakapālaḥ prājāpatyaścaruradityai viṣṇupatnyai caruragnaye vaiśvānarāya dvādaśakapālo'numatyā aṣṭākapālaḥ ||
verses.translation: To Agni of the Gâyatrî, of the Trivrit hymn and of the Rathantara Sâman is to be offered a rice-cake on eight potsherds; to Indra of the Trishtup, the Pañchadasa hymn and the Brihat Sâman one on eleven potsherds; to the All-Gods of the Jagatî, the Seventeenfold hymn and the Vairûpa Sâman, one on twelve potsherds; to Mitra-Varuna of the Anushtup, the Ekavimsa hymn, and the Vairâja Sâman, a mess of curdled milk; to Brihaspati of the Pankti metre, the Trinava hymn, and the Sâkvara Sâman, an oblation of rice boded in milk; to Savitar of the Ushnih, the Thirty-threefold hymn, and the Raivata Sâman, a rice-cake on eight potsherds; a mess of boiled rice is to be made for Prajâpati; the same for Vishnu's Consort Aditi; to Agni Vaisvânara is to be offered a rice-cake on twelve potsherds, and to Anumati one on eight.

verses.sanskrit:
देव॑ सवितः॒ प्र सु॑व य॒ज्ञं प्र सु॑व य॒ज्ञप॑तिं॒ भगा॑य ।
दि॒व्यो ग॑न्ध॒र्वः के॑तु॒पूः केतं॑ नः पुनातु वा॒चस्पति॒र्वाजं॑ नः स्वदतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
deva savitaḥ pra suva yajñaṃ pra suva yajñapatiṃ bhagāya |
divyo gandharvaḥ ketupūḥ ketaṃ naḥ punātu vācaspatirvājaṃ naḥ svadatu ||
verses.translation: Our sacrifice, God Savitar! speed onward: speed to his share the sacrifice's patron. May the Celestial Gandharva, cleanser of thought and will, make clean our thoughts and wishes. The Lord of Speech sweeten the words we utter!

verses.sanskrit:
तत्स॑वि॒तुर्वरे॑ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि ।
धियो॒ यो नः॑ प्रचो॒दयात् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi |
dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
verses.translation: May we attain that excellent glory of Savitar the God: So may he stimulate our prayers.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वा॑नि देव सवितर्दुरि॒तानि॒ परा॑ सुव ।
यद्भ॒द्रं तन्न॒ आ सु॑व ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvāni deva savitarduritāni parā suva |
yadbhadraṃ tanna ā suva ||
verses.translation: Savitar, God, send far away all troubles and calamities, And send us only what is good.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒भ॒क्तार॑ᳪ हवामहे॒ वसो॑श्चि॒त्रस्य॒ राध॑सः ।
स॒वि॒तारं॑ नृ॒चक्ष॑सम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vibhaktāraṃ havāmahe vasościtrasya rādhasaḥ |
savitāraṃ nṛcakṣasam ||
verses.translation: We call on him distributer of wondrous bounty and of wealth, On Savitar who looks on men.

verses.sanskrit: ब्रह्म॑णे ब्राह्म॒णं क्ष॒त्राय॑ राज॒न्यं॒ म॒रुद्भ्यो॒ वैश्यं॒ तप॑से शू॒द्रं तम॑से॒ तस्क॑रं नार॒काय॑ वीर॒हणं॑ पा॒प्मने॑ क्ली॒बमा॑क्र॒याया॑ अयो॒गूं कामा॑य पुँश्च॒लूमति॑क्रुष्टाय माग॒धम् ॥
verses.transliteration: brahmaṇe brāhmaṇaṃ kṣatrāya rājanyaṃ marudbhyo vaiśyaṃ tapase śūdraṃ tamase taskaraṃ nārakāya vīrahaṇaṃ pāpmane klībamākrayāyā ayogūṃ kāmāya pum̐ścalūmatikruṣṭāya māgadham ||
verses.translation: For Brahman (Priesthood) he binds a Brahman to the stake; for Kshatra (Royalty) a Râjanya; for the Maruts a Vaisya; for Penance a Sûdra; for Darkness a robber; for Hell a homicide or a man who has lost his consecrated fire; for Misfortune a eunuch; for Venality an Ayogû; for Kâma a harlot; for Excessive Noise a Mâgadha;

verses.sanskrit: नृ॒त्ताय॑ सू॒तं गी॒ताय॑ शैलू॒षं धर्मा॑य सभाच॒रं न॒रिष्ठा॑यै भीम॒लं न॒र्माय॑ रे॒भᳪ हसा॑य॒ कारि॑मान॒न्दाय॑ स्त्रीष॒खं प्र॒मदे॑ कुमारीपु॒त्रं मे॒धायै॑ रथका॒रं धै॑र्याय॒ तक्षा॑णम् ॥
verses.transliteration: nṛttāya sūtaṃ gītāya śailūṣaṃ dharmāya sabhācaraṃ nariṣṭhāyai bhīmalaṃ narmāya rebhaṃ hasāya kārimānandāya strīṣakhaṃ pramade kumārīputraṃ medhāyai rathakāraṃ dhairyāya takṣāṇam ||
verses.translation: For Dance a stable-master; for Song a public dancer; for Duty one who attends court; for Pastime a timid man; for Sport a chatterer; for Laughter an artist; for Pleasure a woman-lover; for Desire a damsel's son; for Dexterity a car-builder; for Firmness a carpenter;

verses.sanskrit: तप॑से कौला॒लं मा॒यायै॑ क॒र्मार॑ᳪ रू॒पाय॑ मणिका॒रᳪ शु॒भे व॒पᳪ श॑र॒व्या॒या इषुका॒रᳪ हे॒त्यै ध॑नुष्का॒रं कर्म॑णे ज्याका॒रं दि॒ष्टाय॑ रज्जुस॒र्जं मृ॒त्यवे॑ मृग॒युमन्त॑काय श्व॒निन॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: tapase kaulālaṃ māyāyai karmāraṃ rūpāya maṇikāraṃ śubhe vapaṃ śaravyāyā iṣukāraṃ hetyai dhanuṣkāraṃ karmaṇe jyākāraṃ diṣṭāya rajjusarjaṃ mṛtyave mṛgayumantakāya śvaninam ||
verses.translation: For Trouble a potter's son; for Device an artificer; for Beauty a jeweller; for Welfare a sower; for the Arrow-deity a maker of shafts; for Injury a bowyer; for Action a bowstring-maker; for Fate a rope-maker; for Death a hunter; for the Finisher a dog-leader;

verses.sanskrit: न॒दीभ्यः॑ पौञ्जि॒ष्ठमृ॒क्षीका॑भ्यो॒ नैषादं पुरुषव्या॒घ्राय॑ दु॒र्मदं॑ गन्धर्वाप्स॒रोभ्यो॒ व्रात्यं॑ प्र॒युग्भ्य॒ उन्म॑त्तᳪ सर्पदेवज॒नेभ्योऽप्र॑तिपद॒मये॑भ्यः कित॒वमी॒र्यता॑या॒ अकि॑तवं पिशा॒चेभ्यो॑ बिदलका॒रीं या॑तु॒धाने॑भ्यः कण्टकीका॒रीम् ॥
verses.transliteration: nadībhyaḥ pauñjiṣṭhamṛkṣīkābhyo naiṣādaṃ puruṣavyāghrāya durmadaṃ gandharvāpsarobhyo vrātyaṃ prayugbhya unmattaṃ sarpadevajanebhyo'pratipadamayebhyaḥ kitavamīryatāyā akitavaṃ piśācebhyo bidalakārīṃ yātudhānebhyaḥ kaṇṭakīkārīm ||
verses.translation: For Rivers a fisherman; for Rikshîkâs a Nishâda's son; for the Man-tiger a madman; for the Gandharvas and Apsarases a Vrâtya; for Motives one demented; for Serpents and Genii an untrustworthy man; for Dice a gambler; for Excitement a non-gambler; for Pisâchas a woman who splits cane; for Yâtudhânas a woman who works in thorns;

verses.sanskrit: स॒न्धये॑ जा॒रं गे॒हायो॑पप॒तिमार्त्यै॒ परि॑वित्तं॒ निरृ॑त्यै परिविविदा॒नमरा॑द्ध्या एदिधिषुः प॒तिं निष्कृ॑त्यै पेशस्का॒रीᳪ सं॒ज्ञाना॑य स्मरका॒रीं प्र॑का॒मोद्या॑योप॒सदं॒ वर्णा॑यानु॒रुधं॒ बला॑योप॒दाम् ॥
verses.transliteration: sandhaye jāraṃ gehāyopapatimārtyai parivittaṃ nirṛtyai parivividānamarāddhyā edidhiṣuḥ patiṃ niṣkṛtyai peśaskārīṃ saṃjñānāya smarakārīṃ prakāmodyāyopasadaṃ varṇāyānurudhaṃ balāyopadām ||
verses.translation: For Rendezvous a lover; for Homestead a paramour; for Trouble an unmarried elder brother; for Nirriti a younger brother who has married before his elder; for Misfortune the husband of a younger sister whose elder sister has not been married; for Representation a woman who embroiders; for Agreement a woman who deals in love-charms; for Garrulity a by-sitter; for Colour an obstinate man; for Strength a yielding man;

verses.sanskrit: उ॒त्सा॒देभ्यः॑ कु॒ब्जं प्र॒मुदे॑ वाम॒नं द्वा॒र्भ्यः स्रा॒मᳪ स्वप्ना॑या॒न्धमध॑र्माय बधि॒रं प॒वित्रा॑य भि॒षजं॑ प्र॒ज्ञाना॑य नक्षत्रद॒र्शमा॑शि॒क्षायै॑ प्र॒श्निन॑मुपशि॒क्षाया॑ अभिप्र॒श्निनं॑ म॒र्यादा॑यै प्रश्नविवा॒कम् ॥
verses.transliteration: utsādebhyaḥ kubjaṃ pramude vāmanaṃ dvārbhyaḥ srāmaṃ svapnāyāndhamadharmāya badhiraṃ pavitrāya bhiṣajaṃ prajñānāya nakṣatradarśamāśikṣāyai praśninamupaśikṣāyā abhipraśninaṃ maryādāyai praśnavivākam ||
verses.translation: For Interruptions a hunch-back; for Delight a dwarf, for Doors a blear-eyed man; for Sleep a blind man; for Unrighteousness a deaf man; for Purifying Medium a physician; for Insight an astrologer; for Craving for Knowledge an inquisitive man; for Desire of extra Knowledge an extra-inquisitive man; for Moral Law a question solver;

verses.sanskrit: अर्मे॑भ्यो हस्ति॒पं ज॒वाया॑श्व॒पं पुष्ट्यै॑ गोपा॒लं वी॒र्या॒याविपा॒लं तेज॑सेऽजपा॒लमिरा॑यै की॒नाशं॑ की॒लाला॑य सुराका॒रं भ॒द्राय॑ गृह॒पᳪ श्रेय॑से वित्त॒धमाध्य॑क्ष्यायानुक्ष॒तार॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: armebhyo hastipaṃ javāyāśvapaṃ puṣṭyai gopālaṃ vīryāyāvipālaṃ tejase'japālamirāyai kīnāśaṃ kīlālāya surākāraṃ bhadrāya gṛhapaṃ śreyase vittadhamādhyakṣyāyānukṣatāram ||
verses.translation: For Eye-diseases an elephant-keeper; for Speed a horse-keeper; for Nourishment a cowherd; for Manliness a shepherd; for Keenness a goatherd; for Refreshment a ploughman; for Sweet Beverage a preparer of Surâ; for Weal a house-guard; for Well-being a possessor of wealth; for Supervision a doorkeeper's attendant;

verses.sanskrit: भायै॑ दार्वा॒हारं॑ प्र॒भाया॑ अग्न्ये॒धं ब्र॒ध्नस्य॑ वि॒ष्टपा॑याभिषे॒क्तारं॒ वर्षि॑ष्ठाय॒ नाका॑य परिवे॒ष्टारं॑ देवलो॒काय॑ पेशि॒तारं॑ मनुष्यलो॒काय॑ प्रकरि॒तार॒ᳪ सर्वे॑भ्यो लो॒केभ्य॑ उपसे॒क्तार॒मव॑ ऋत्यै व॒धायो॑पमन्थि॒तारं॒ मेधा॑य वासः पल्पू॒लीं प्र॑का॒माय॑ रजयि॒त्रीम् ॥
verses.transliteration: bhāyai dārvāhāraṃ prabhāyā agnyedhaṃ bradhnasya viṣṭapāyābhiṣektāraṃ varṣiṣṭhāya nākāya pariveṣṭāraṃ devalokāya peśitāraṃ manuṣyalokāya prakaritāraṃ sarvebhyo lokebhya upasektāramava ṛtyai vadhāyopamanthitāraṃ medhāya vāsaḥ palpūlīṃ prakāmāya rajayitrīm ||
verses.translation: For Light a wood-bringer; for Brightness a fire-kindler; for the Sun's Station a besprinkler; for Highest Heaven a high steward; for the World of Gods a carver; for the World of Men a distributer; for All-Worlds a pourer-out: for Poverty, Affliction a stirrer-up of strife; for Sacrifice a washerwoman; for Delight a female dyer;

verses.sanskrit: ऋ॒तये॑ स्ते॒नहृ॑दयं वैर॑हत्याय॒ पिशु॑नं॒ विवि॑क्त्यै क्ष॒त्तार॒मौप॑द्रष्ट्र्यायानुक्ष॒त्तारं॒ बला॑यानुच॒रं भू॒म्ने प॑रिष्क॒न्दं प्रि॒याय॑ प्रियवा॒दिन॒ मरि॑ष्ट्या अश्वसा॒दᳪ स्व॒र्गा॑य लो॒काय॑ भागदु॒घं वर्षि॑ष्ठाय॒ नाका॑य परिवे॒ष्टार॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛtaye stenahṛdayaṃ vairahatyāya piśunaṃ viviktyai kṣattāramaupadraṣṭryāyānukṣattāraṃ balāyānucaraṃ bhūmne pariṣkandaṃ priyāya priyavādina mariṣṭyā aśvasādaṃ svargāya lokāya bhāgadughaṃ varṣiṣṭhāya nākāya pariveṣṭāram ||
verses.translation: For Assault a thievish-hearted man; for Homicide a slanderer; for Discrimination a door-keeper; for Inspection a door-keeper's attendant; for Strength a servant; for Plenty a running footman; for the Beloved a sweet speaker; for Safety the rider of a horse; for the World of Svarga a dealer-out of portions; for Highest Heaven a high steward;

verses.sanskrit: म॒न्यवे॑ऽयस्ता॒पं क्रोधा॑य निस॒रं योगा॑य यो॒क्तार॒ᳪ शोका॑याभिस॒र्तारं॒ क्षेमा॑य विमो॒क्तार॑मुत्कूलनिकू॒लेभ्य॑स्त्रि॒ष्ठिनं॒ वपु॑षे मानस्कृ॒तᳪ शीला॑याञ्जनीका॒रीं निरृ॑त्यै कोशका॒रीं य॒माया॒सूम् ॥
verses.transliteration: manyave'yastāpaṃ krodhāya nisaraṃ yogāya yoktāraṃ śokāyābhisartāraṃ kṣemāya vimoktāramutkūlanikūlebhyastriṣṭhinaṃ vapuṣe mānaskṛtaṃ śīlāyāñjanīkārīṃ nirṛtyai kośakārīṃ yamāyāsūm ||
verses.translation: For Passion an iron-smelter; for Anger a remover; for Yoking a yoker; for Pain an assailant; for Quiet an unyoker; for Up-hill and Down-hill one who stands on three legs; for Form a conceited man; for Virtue a female ointment-maker; for Nirriti a female scabbard-maker; for Yama a barren woman;

verses.sanskrit: य॒माय॑ यम॒सूमथ॑र्व॒भ्योऽव॑तोकाᳪ संवत्स॒राय॑ पर्या॒यिणीं॑ परिवत्स॒रायावि॑जातामिदावत्स॒राया॒तीत्व॑रीमिद्वत्स॒राया॑ति॒ष्कद्व॑रीं वत्स॒राय॒ विज॑र्जराᳪ संवत्स॒राय॒ पलि॑क्नीमृ॒भुभ्यो॑ऽजिनस॒न्धᳪ सा॒ध्येभ्य॑श्चर्म॒म्नम् ॥
verses.transliteration: yamāya yamasūmatharvabhyo'vatokāṃ saṃvatsarāya paryāyiṇīṃ parivatsarāyāvijātāmidāvatsarāyātītvarīmidvatsarāyātiṣkadvarīṃ vatsarāya vijarjarāṃ saṃvatsarāya paliknīmṛbhubhyo'jinasandhaṃ sādhyebhyaścarmamnam ||
verses.translation: For Yama a mother of twins; for the Atharvans a woman who has miscarried; for the First Year a gad-about; for the Parivatsara one who has not borne a child; for the Idâvatsara one who exceeds; for the Idvatsara one who transgresses; for the Vatsara one who is worn out; for the Samvatsara one with grey hair; for the Ribhus a hide-dresser; for the Sâdhyas a currier;

verses.sanskrit: सरो॑भ्यो धैव॒रमु॑प॒स्थाव॑राभ्यो॒ दाशं॑ वैश॒न्ताभ्यो॑ बै॒न्दं न॑ड्व॒लाभ्यः शौष्क॑लं पा॒राय॑ मार्गा॒रम॑वा॒राय॑ कै॒वर्तं॑ ती॒र्थेभ्य॑ आ॒न्दं विष॑मेभ्यो मैना॒लᳪ स्वने॑भ्यः॒ पर्ण॑कं॒ गुहा॑भ्यः॒ किरा॑त॒ᳪ सानु॑भ्यो॒ जम्भ॑कं॒ पर्व॑तेभ्यः किम्पूरु॒षम् ॥
verses.transliteration: sarobhyo dhaivaramupasthāvarābhyo dāśaṃ vaiśantābhyo baindaṃ naḍvalābhyaḥ śauṣkalaṃ pārāya mārgāramavārāya kaivartaṃ tīrthebhya āndaṃ viṣamebhyo mainālaṃ svanebhyaḥ parṇakaṃ guhābhyaḥ kirātaṃ sānubhyo jambhakaṃ parvatebhyaḥ kimpūruṣam ||
verses.translation: For Lakes a fisherman; for Standing Waters a fisher; for Tank-waters a Nishâda; for Reed-beds a fish-vender; for the Opposite Bank one who gropes for fish; for This Bank a fish-catcher; for Fords an Âuda; for shallows a Mainâla; for Sounds a Bhilla; for Caverns a Kirâta; for Mountain-heights a destructive savage; for Mountains a wild man;

verses.sanskrit: बी॒भ॒त्सायै॑ पौल्क॒सं वर्णा॑य हिरण्यका॒रं तु॒लायै॑ वाणि॒जं प॑श्चादो॒षाय॑ ग्ला॒विनं॒ विश्वे॑भ्यो भू॒तेभ्यः॑ सिध्म॒लं भूत्यै॑ जागर॒णमभू॑त्यै स्वप॒नमार्त्यै॑ जनवा॒दिनं॒ व्यृ॒र्द्ध्या अपग॒ल्भᳪ स॑ᳪश॒राय॑ प्र॒च्छिद॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: bībhatsāyai paulkasaṃ varṇāya hiraṇyakāraṃ tulāyai vāṇijaṃ paścādoṣāya glāvinaṃ viśvebhyo bhūtebhyaḥ sidhmalaṃ bhūtyai jāgaraṇamabhūtyai svapanamārtyai janavādinaṃ vyṛrddhyā apagalbhaṃ saṃśarāya pracchidam ||
verses.translation: For Abhorrence a Paulkasa; for Colour a goldsmith; for Balance a merchant; for Repentance a sluggard; for All Spirits a leper; for Prosperity a watchful man; for Failure a sleepy man; for Mischief a chatterer; for Misfortune a shameless man; for Undoing one who cuts up into small pieces;

verses.sanskrit: अ॒क्ष॒रा॒जाय॑ कित॒वं कृ॒ताया॑दिनवद॒र्शं त्रेता॑यै क॒ल्पिनं॑ द्वा॒परा॑याधिक॒ल्पिन॑मास्क॒न्दाय॑ सभास्था॒णुं मृ॒त्यवे॑ गोव्य॒च्छमन्त॑काय गोघा॒तं क्षु॒धे यो गां वि॑कृ॒न्तन्तं॒ भिक्ष॑माण उप॒तिष्ठ॑ति दुष्कृ॒ताय॒ चर॑काचार्यं पा॒प्मने॑ सैल॒गम् ॥
verses.transliteration: akṣarājāya kitavaṃ kṛtāyādinavadarśaṃ tretāyai kalpinaṃ dvāparāyādhikalpinamāskandāya sabhāsthāṇuṃ mṛtyave govyacchamantakāya goghātaṃ kṣudhe yo gāṃ vikṛntantaṃ bhikṣamāṇa upatiṣṭhati duṣkṛtāya carakācāryaṃ pāpmane sailagam ||
verses.translation: For the Dice-king a gambler; for the die Krita one who contemplates his adversary's ill luck, for the Tretâ a gamble-manager; for the Dvâpara a chief manager; for Askanda one who will not leave the gambling-hall; for Mrityu one who approaches cows; for Antaka a Cow-killer; for Hunger one who goes begging to a man who is cutting up a cow; for Misdeed a leader of the Charakas; for Misery a robber;

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒ति॒श्रुत्का॑या अर्त॒नं घोषा॑य भ॒षमन्ता॑य बहुवा॒दिन॑मन॒न्ताय॒ मूक॒ᳪ शब्दा॑याडम्बराघा॒तं मह॑से वीणावा॒दं क्रोशा॑य तूणव॒ध्मम॑वरस्प॒राय॑ शङ्ख॒ध्मं वना॑य वन॒पम॒न्यतो॑रण्याय दाव॒पम् ॥
verses.transliteration: pratiśrutkāyā artanaṃ ghoṣāya bhaṣamantāya bahuvādinamanantāya mūkaṃ śabdāyāḍambarāghātaṃ mahase vīṇāvādaṃ krośāya tūṇavadhmamavarasparāya śaṅkhadhmaṃ vanāya vanapamanyatoraṇyāya dāvapam ||
verses.translation: For Echo a reviler; for Noise a snarler; for End a very talkative man; for Endless a mute; for Sound a drummer; for Might a lute-player; for Cry a flute-blower; for Confused Tone a Conch-blower; for the Wood a wood-ranger; for Partly-wooded Land a forest fire guard;

verses.sanskrit:
न॒र्माय॑ पुँश्च॒लूᳪ हसा॑य॒ कारिं॒ याद॑से शाब॒ल्यां ग्रा॑म॒ण्यं गण॑कमभि॒क्रोश॑कं॒ तान्मह॑से वीणावा॒दं पा॑णि॒घ्नं तू॑णव॒ध्मं तान्नृ॒त्ताया॑न॒न्दाय॑
तल॒वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
narmāya pum̐ścalūṃ hasāya kāriṃ yādase śābalyāṃ grāmaṇyaṃ gaṇakamabhikrośakaṃ tānmahase vīṇāvādaṃ pāṇighnaṃ tūṇavadhmaṃ tānnṛttāyānandāya
talavam ||
verses.translation: For Pastime a harlot; for Laughter a jester; for Lust a woman with spotty skin; for Might these, the head-man of a village, an astrologer, and a watchman; a lute-player; a hand-clapper, a flutist, these for Dance; for Pleasure a musician;

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्नये॒ पीवा॑नं पृथि॒व्यै पी॑ठस॒र्पिणं॑ वा॒यवे॑ चाण्डा॒लम॒न्तरि॑क्षाय वᳪशन॒र्तिनं॑ दि॒वे ख॑ल॒तिᳪ सूर्या॑य हर्य॒क्षं नक्ष॑त्रेभ्यः किर्मि॒रं च॒न्द्रम॑से कि॒लास॒मह्ने॑ शु॒क्लं पि॑ङ्गा॒क्षᳪ रात्र्यै॑ कृ॒ष्णं पि॑ङ्गा॒क्षम् ॥
verses.transliteration: agnaye pīvānaṃ pṛthivyai pīṭhasarpiṇaṃ vāyave cāṇḍālamantarikṣāya vaṃśanartinaṃ dive khalatiṃ sūryāya haryakṣaṃ nakṣatrebhyaḥ kirmiraṃ candramase kilāsamahne śuklaṃ piṅgākṣaṃ rātryai kṛṣṇaṃ piṅgākṣam ||
verses.translation: For Fire a fat man; for Earth a cripple; for Wind a Chândâla; for Mid-Air a pole-dancer; for Sky a bald-head; for the Sun a green-eyed man; for Stars a spotty man; for the Moon a leper; for Day a white yellow-eyed man; for Night a black man with yellow eyes.

verses.sanskrit:
अथै॒तान॒ष्टौ विरू॑पा॒ना ल॑भ॒तेऽति॑दीर्घं॒ चाति॑ह्रस्वं॒ चाति॑स्थूलं॒ चाति॑कृशं॒ चाति॑शुक्लं॒ चाति॑कृष्णं॒ चाति॑कुल्वं॒ चाति॑लोमशं च ।
अशू॑द्रा॒ अब्रा॑ह्मणा॒स्ते प्रा॑जाप॒त्याः ।
मा॒ग॒धः पुँ॑श्च॒ली कि॑त॒वः क्ली॒बोऽशू॑द्रा॒ अब्रा॑ह्मणा॒स्ते प्रा॑जाप॒त्याः ॥
verses.transliteration:
athaitānaṣṭau virūpānā labhate'tidīrghaṃ cātihrasvaṃ cātisthūlaṃ cātikṛśaṃ cātiśuklaṃ cātikṛṣṇaṃ cātikulvaṃ cātilomaśaṃ ca |
aśūdrā abrāhmaṇāste prājāpatyāḥ |
māgadhaḥ pum̐ścalī kitavaḥ klībo'śūdrā abrāhmaṇāste prājāpatyāḥ ||
verses.translation: Now he ties up the eight following variform men: one too tall, one too short, one too stout, one too thin, one too white, one too black, one too bald, one too airy. These must be neither Sûdras nor Brâhmans, and must be dedicated to Prajâpati. A minstrel, a harlot, a gambler, and a eunuch—neither of Sûdra nor Brâhman caste—are to be dedicated to Prajâpati.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒हस्र॑शीर्षा॒ पुरु॑षः सहस्रा॒क्षः स॒हस्र॑पात् ।
स भूमि॑ᳪ स॒र्वत॑ स्पृ॒त्वाऽत्य॑तिष्ठद्दशाङ्गु॒॒लम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahasraśīrṣā puruṣaḥ sahasrākṣaḥ sahasrapāt |
sa bhūmiṃ sarvata spṛtvā'tyatiṣṭhaddaśāṅgulam ||
verses.translation: Purusha hath a thousand heads, a thousand eyes, a thousand feet. Pervading earth on every side he fills a space ten fingers broad.

verses.sanskrit:
पुरु॑ष ए॒वेदᳪ सर्वं॒ यद्भू॒तं यच्च॑ भा॒व्य॒म् ।
उ॒तामृ॑त॒त्वस्येशा॑नो॒ यदन्ने॑नाति॒रोह॑ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
puruṣa evedaṃ sarvaṃ yadbhūtaṃ yacca bhāvyam |
utāmṛtatvasyeśāno yadannenātirohati ||
verses.translation: Purusha is in truth this All, what hath been and what yet shall be; Lord, too, of immortality which waxes greater still by food.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒तावा॑नस्य महि॒मातो॒ ज्यायाँ॑श्च॒ पूरु॑षः ।
पादो॑ऽस्य॒ विश्वा॑ भू॒तानि॑ त्रि॒पाद॑स्या॒मृतं॑ दि॒वि ॥
verses.transliteration:
etāvānasya mahimāto jyāyām̐śca pūruṣaḥ |
pādo'sya viśvā bhūtāni tripādasyāmṛtaṃ divi ||
verses.translation: So mighty in his grandeur; yea, greater than this is Purusha. All creatures are one fourth of him, three fourths eternal life in heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रि॒पादू॒र्ध्व उदै॒त्पुरु॑षः॒ पादो॑ऽस्ये॒हाभ॑व॒त् पुनः॑ ।
ततो॒ विष्व॒ङ् व्य॒क्रामत्साशनानश॒ने अ॒भि ॥
verses.transliteration:
tripādūrdhva udaitpuruṣaḥ pādo'syehābhavat punaḥ |
tato viṣvaṅ vyakrāmatsāśanānaśane abhi ||
verses.translation: With three fourths Purusha rose up: one fourth of him again was here. Thence he moved forth to every side over what eats not and what eats.

verses.sanskrit:
ततो॑ वि॒राड॑जायत वि॒राजो॒ अधि॒ पूरु॑षः ।
स जा॒तो अत्य॑रिच्यत प॒श्चाद्भूमि॒मथो॑ पु॒रः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tato virāḍajāyata virājo adhi pūruṣaḥ |
sa jāto atyaricyata paścādbhūmimatho puraḥ ||
verses.translation: From him Virâj was born; again Purusha from Virâj was born. When born, he spread to west and east beyond the boundaries of earth.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मा॑द्य॒ज्ञात्स॑र्व॒हुतः॒ सम्भृ॑तं पृषदा॒ज्यम् ।
प॒शूँस्ताँश्च॑क्रे वाय॒व्या॒नार॒ण्या ग्रा॒म्याश्च॒ ये ॥
verses.transliteration:
tasmādyajñātsarvahutaḥ sambhṛtaṃ pṛṣadājyam |
paśūm̐stām̐ścakre vāyavyānāraṇyā grāmyāśca ye ||
verses.translation: From that great General Sacrifice the dripping fat was gathered up. He formed the creatures of the air and animals both wild and tame.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मा॑द्य॒ज्ञात् स॑र्व॒हुत॒ ऋचः॒ सामा॑नि जज्ञिरे ।
छन्दा॑ᳪसि जज्ञिरे॒ तस्मा॒द्यजु॒स्तस्मा॑दजायत ॥
verses.transliteration:
tasmādyajñāt sarvahuta ṛcaḥ sāmāni jajñire |
chandāṃsi jajñire tasmādyajustasmādajāyata ||
verses.translation: From that great General Sacrifice Richas and Sâma hymns were born: Therefrom were spells and charms produced; the Yajus had its birth from it.

verses.sanskrit:
तस्मा॒दश्वा॑ अजायन्त॒ ये के चो॑भ॒याद॑तः ।
गावो॑ ह जज्ञिरे॒ तस्मा॒त्तस्मा॑ज्जा॒ता अ॑जा॒वयः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tasmādaśvā ajāyanta ye ke cobhayādataḥ |
gāvo ha jajñire tasmāttasmājjātā ajāvayaḥ ||
verses.translation: From it were horses born, from it all cattle with two rows of teeth From it were generated kine, from it were goats and sheep produced.

verses.sanskrit:
तं य॒ज्ञं ब॒र्हिषि॒ प्रौक्ष॒न् पुरु॑षं जा॒तम॑ग्र॒तः ।
तेन॑ दे॒वा अ॑यजन्त सा॒ध्या ऋष॑यश्च॒ ये ॥
verses.transliteration:
taṃ yajñaṃ barhiṣi praukṣan puruṣaṃ jātamagrataḥ |
tena devā ayajanta sādhyā ṛṣayaśca ye ||
verses.translation: They balmed as victim on the grass Purusha born in earliest time. With him the Deities and all Sâdhyas and Rishis sacrificed.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्पुरु॑षं॒ व्यद॑धुः कति॒धा व्य॑कल्पयन् ।
मुखं॒ किम॑स्यासी॒त् किं बा॒हू किमू॒रू पादा॑ उच्येते ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatpuruṣaṃ vyadadhuḥ katidhā vyakalpayan |
mukhaṃ kimasyāsīt kiṃ bāhū kimūrū pādā ucyete ||
verses.translation: When they divided Purusha how many portions did they make? What was his mouth? what were his arms? what are the names of thighs and feet?

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रा॒ह्म॒णो॒ऽस्य॒ मुख॑मासीद्बा॒हू रा॑ज॒न्यः॒ कृ॒तः ।
ऊ॒रू तद॑स्य॒ यद्वै॑श्यः प॒द्भ्याᳪ शू॒द्रो अ॑जायत ॥
verses.transliteration:
brāhmaṇo'sya mukhamāsīdbāhū rājanyaḥ kṛtaḥ |
ūrū tadasya yadvaiśyaḥ padbhyāṃ śūdro ajāyata ||
verses.translation: The Brâhman was his mouth, of both his arms was the Râjanya made. His thighs became the Vaisya, from his feet the Sûdra was produced.

verses.sanskrit:
च॒न्द्रमा॒ मन॑सो जा॒तश्चक्षोः॒ सूर्यो॑ अजायत ।
श्रोत्रा॑द्वा॒युश्च॑ प्रा॒णश्च॒ मुखा॑द॒ग्निर॑जायत ॥
verses.transliteration:
candramā manaso jātaścakṣoḥ sūryo ajāyata |
śrotrādvāyuśca prāṇaśca mukhādagnirajāyata ||
verses.translation: The Moon was gendered from his mind, and from his eye the Sun had birth; Vâyu and Prâna from his ear, and from his mouth was Agni born.

verses.sanskrit:
नाभ्या॑ आसीद॒न्तरि॑क्षᳪ शी॒र्ष्णो द्यौः॒ सम॑वर्तत ।
प॒द्भ्यां भूमि॒र्दिशः॒ श्रोत्रा॒त्तथा॑ लो॒काँ२ अ॑कल्पयन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
nābhyā āsīdantarikṣaṃ śīrṣṇo dyauḥ samavartata |
padbhyāṃ bhūmirdiśaḥ śrotrāttathā lokām̐ akalpayan ||
verses.translation: Forth from his navel came mid-air; the sky was fashioned from his head; Earth from his feet, and from his ear the Quarters. Thus they formed the worlds.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्पुरु॑षेण ह॒विषा॑ दे॒वा य॒ज्ञमत॑न्वत ।
व॒स॒न्तो॒ऽस्यासी॒दाज्यं॑ ग्री॒ष्म इ॒ध्मः श॒रद्ध॒विः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatpuruṣeṇa haviṣā devā yajñamatanvata |
vasanto'syāsīdājyaṃ grīṣma idhmaḥ śaraddhaviḥ ||
verses.translation: When Gods performed the sacrifice with Purusha as offering Spring was the butter, Autumn the oblation, Summer was the wood.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒प्तास्या॑सन् परि॒धय॒स्त्रिः स॒प्त स॒मिधः॑ कृ॒ताः ।
दे॒वा यद्य॒ज्ञं त॑न्वा॒ना अब॑ध्न॒न् पुरु॑षं प॒शुम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
saptāsyāsan paridhayastriḥ sapta samidhaḥ kṛtāḥ |
devā yadyajñaṃ tanvānā abadhnan puruṣaṃ paśum ||
verses.translation: Then seven were his enclosing-sticks, his kindling-brands were three times seven, When Gods, performing sacrifice, bound as their victim Purusha.

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञेन॑ य॒ज्ञम॑यजन्त दे॒वास्तानि॒ धर्मा॑णि प्रथ॒मान्या॑सन् ।
ते ह॒ नाकं॑ महि॒मानः॑ सचन्त॒ यत्र॒ पूर्वे॑ सा॒ध्याः सन्ति॑ दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajñena yajñamayajanta devāstāni dharmāṇi prathamānyāsan |
te ha nākaṃ mahimānaḥ sacanta yatra pūrve sādhyāḥ santi devāḥ ||
verses.translation: Gods, sacrificing, sacrificed the victim: these were the earliest holy ordinances. The Mighty Ones attained the height of heaven, there where the Sâdhyas, Gods of old, are dwelling.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒द्भ्यः सम्भृ॑तः पृथिव्यै॒ रसा॑च्च वि॒श्वक॑र्मणः॒ सम॑वर्त॒ताग्रे॑ ।
तस्य॒ त्वष्टा॑ वि॒दध॑द्रू॒पमे॑ति॒ तन्मर्त्य॑स्य देव॒त्वमा॒जान॒मग्रे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
adbhyaḥ sambhṛtaḥ pṛthivyai rasācca viśvakarmaṇaḥ samavartatāgre |
tasya tvaṣṭā vidadhadrūpameti tanmartyasya devatvamājānamagre ||
verses.translation: In the beginning he was formed, collected from waters, earth, and Visvakarman's essence. Fixing the form thereof Tvashtar proceedeth. This was at first the mortal's birth and godhead.

verses.sanskrit:
वेदा॒हमे॒तं पुरु॑षं म॒हान्त॑मादि॒त्यव॑र्णं॒ तम॑सः प॒रस्ता॑त् ।
तमे॒व वि॑दि॒त्वाति॑ मृ॒त्युमे॑ति॒ नान्यः पन्था॑ विद्य॒तेऽय॑नाय ॥
verses.transliteration:
vedāhametaṃ puruṣaṃ mahāntamādityavarṇaṃ tamasaḥ parastāt |
tameva viditvāti mṛtyumeti nānyaḥ panthā vidyate'yanāya ||
verses.translation: I know this mighty Purusha whose colour is like the Sun, beyond the reach of darkness. He only who knows him leaves Death behind him. There is no path save this alone to travel.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र॒जाप॑तिश्च॒रति॒ गर्भे॑ अ॒न्तरजा॑यमानो बहु॒धा वि जा॑यते ।
तस्य॒ योनिं॒ परि॑ पश्यन्ति॒ धीरा॒स्तस्मि॑न् ह तस्थु॒र्भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
prajāpatiścarati garbhe antarajāyamāno bahudhā vi jāyate |
tasya yoniṃ pari paśyanti dhīrāstasmin ha tasthurbhuvanāni viśvā ||
verses.translation: In the womb moves Prajâpati: he, never becoming born, is born in sundry figures. The wise discern the womb from which he springeth. In him alone stand all existing creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
यो दे॒वेभ्य॑ आ॒तप॑ति॒ यो दे॒वानां॑ पु॒रोहि॑तः ।
पूर्वो॒ यो दे॒वेभ्यो॑ जा॒तो नमो॑ रु॒चाय॒ ब्राह्म॑ये ॥
verses.transliteration:
yo devebhya ātapati yo devānāṃ purohitaḥ |
pūrvo yo devebhyo jāto namo rucāya brāhmaye ||
verses.translation: He who gives light and heat to Gods, first, foremost Agent of the Gods, Born ere the Gods—to him the bright, the holy One, be reverence

verses.sanskrit:
रु॒चं ब्रा॒ह्म्यं ज॒नय॑न्तो दे॒वा अग्रे॒ तद॑ब्रुवन् ।
यस्त्वै॒वं ब्रा॑ह्म॒णो वि॒द्यात्तस्य॑ दे॒वा अ॑स॒न् वशे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
rucaṃ brāhmyaṃ janayanto devā agre tadabruvan |
yastvaivaṃ brāhmaṇo vidyāttasya devā asan vaśe ||
verses.translation: Thus spake the Gods at first, as they begat the bright and holy One: The Brahman who may know thee thus shall have the Gods in his control.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रीश्च॑ ते ल॒क्ष्मीश्च॒ पत्न्या॑वहोरा॒त्रे पा॒र्श्वे नक्ष॑त्राणि रू॒पम॒श्विनौ॒ व्यात्त॑म् ।
इ॒ष्णन्नि॑षाणा॒मुं म॑ इषाण सर्वलो॒कं म॑ इषाण ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrīśca te lakṣmīśca patnyāvahorātre pārśve nakṣatrāṇi rūpamaśvinau vyāttam |
iṣṇanniṣāṇāmuṃ ma iṣāṇa sarvalokaṃ ma iṣāṇa ||
verses.translation: Beauty and Fortune are thy wives: each side of thee are Day and Night. The constellations are thy form: the Asvins are thine open jaws. Wishing, wish yonder world for me, wish that the Universe be mine.

verses.sanskrit:
तदे॒वाग्निस्तदा॑दि॒त्यस्तद्वा॒युस्तदु॑ च॒न्द्रमाः॑ ।
तदे॒व शु॒क्रं तद्ब्रह्म॒ ता आपः॒ स प्र॒जाप॑तिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tadevāgnistadādityastadvāyustadu candramāḥ |
tadeva śukraṃ tadbrahma tā āpaḥ sa prajāpatiḥ ||
verses.translation: Agni is That; the Sun is That; Vâyu and Chandramâs are That. The Bright is That; Brahma is That, those Waters, that Prajâpati.

verses.sanskrit:
सर्वे॑ निमे॒षा ज॑ज्ञिरे वि॒द्युतः॒ पुरु॑षा॒दधि॑ ।
नै॑नमू॒र्ध्वं न ति॒र्यञ्चं॒ न मध्ये॒ परि॑ जग्रभत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sarve nimeṣā jajñire vidyutaḥ puruṣādadhi |
nainamūrdhvaṃ na tiryañcaṃ na madhye pari jagrabhat ||
verses.translation: All twinklings of the eyelid sprang from Purusha, resplendent One. No one hath comprehended him above, across, or in the midst.

verses.sanskrit:
न तस्य॑ प्रति॒मा अ॑स्ति॒ यस्य॒ नाम॑ म॒हद्यशः॑ ।
हि॒र॒ण्य॒ग॒र्भ इत्ये॒षः मा मा॑ हिᳪसी॒दित्ये॒षा यस्मा॒न्न जा॒त इत्ये॒षः ॥
verses.transliteration:
na tasya pratimā asti yasya nāma mahadyaśaḥ |
hiraṇyagarbha ityeṣaḥ mā mā hiṃsīdityeṣā yasmānna jāta ityeṣaḥ ||
verses.translation: There is no counterpart of him whose glory verily is great. In the beginning rose Hiranyagarbha, etc. Let not him harm me, etc. Than whom there is no other born, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒षो ह॑ दे॒वः प्र॒दिशोऽनु॒ सर्वाः॒ पूर्वो॑ ह जा॒तः स उ॒ गर्भे॑ अ॒न्तः ।
स ए॒व जा॒तः स ज॑नि॒ष्यमा॑णः प्र॒त्यङ् जना॑स्तिष्ठति स॒र्वतो॑मुखः ॥
verses.transliteration:
eṣo ha devaḥ pradiśo'nu sarvāḥ pūrvo ha jātaḥ sa u garbhe antaḥ |
sa eva jātaḥ sa janiṣyamāṇaḥ pratyaṅ janāstiṣṭhati sarvatomukhaḥ ||
verses.translation: This very God pervadeth all the regions; yea, born aforetime, in the womb he dwelleth. He verily born and to be born hereafter meeteth his offspring, facing all directions.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मा॑ज्जा॒तं न पु॒रा किं चनै॒व य आ॑ब॒भूव॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
प्र॒जाप॑तिः प्र॒जया॑ सᳪररा॒णस्त्रीणि॒ ज्योती॑ᳪषि सचते॒ स षो॑ड॒शी ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasmājjātaṃ na purā kiṃ canaiva ya ābabhūva bhuvanāni viśvā |
prajāpatiḥ prajayā saṃrarāṇastrīṇi jyotīṃṣi sacate sa ṣoḍaśī ||
verses.translation: Before whom naught whatever sprang to being; who with his presence aids all living creatures, Prajâpati, rejoicing in his offspring, he, Shodasî, maintains the Three great Lustres.

verses.sanskrit:
येन॒ द्यौरु॒ग्रा पृ॑थि॒वी च॑ दृ॒ढा येन॒ स्व॒ स्तभि॒तं येन॒ नाकः॑ ।
यो अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ रज॑सो वि॒मानः॒ कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
yena dyaurugrā pṛthivī ca dṛḍhā yena sva stabhitaṃ yena nākaḥ |
yo antarikṣe rajaso vimānaḥ kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema ||
verses.translation: By whom the heavens are strong and earth stands firmly, by whom light's realm and sky-vault are supported; By whom the regions in mid-air were measured. What God shall we adore with our oblation?

verses.sanskrit:
यं क्रन्द॑सी॒ अव॑सा तस्तभा॒ने अ॒भ्यैक्षे॑तां॒ मन॑सा॒ रेज॑माने ।
यत्राधि॒ सूर॒ उदि॑तो वि॒भाति॒ कस्मै॑ दे॒वाय॑ ह॒विषा॑ विधेम ।
आपो॑ ह॒ यद्बृ॑ह॒तीर्यश्चि॒दापः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaṃ krandasī avasā tastabhāne abhyaikṣetāṃ manasā rejamāne |
yatrādhi sūra udito vibhāti kasmai devāya haviṣā vidhema |
āpo ha yadbṛhatīryaścidāpaḥ ||
verses.translation: To whom, supported by his help, two armies embattled look while trembling in their spirit, Where over them the risen Sun is shining. What God shall we adore with our oblation? What time the mighty waters, etc. He in his might surveyed, etc.

verses.sanskrit:
वे॒नस्तत्प॑श्य॒न्निहि॑तं॒ गुहा॒ सद्यत्र॒ विश्वं॒ भव॒त्येक॑नीडम् ।
तस्मि॑न्नि॒दᳪ सं च॒ वि चै॑ति॒ सर्व॒ᳪ स ओतः॒ प्रोत॑श्च वि॒भूः प्र॒जासु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
venastatpaśyannihitaṃ guhā sadyatra viśvaṃ bhavatyekanīḍam |
tasminnidaṃ saṃ ca vi caiti sarvaṃ sa otaḥ protaśca vibhūḥ prajāsu ||
verses.translation: The Sage beholdeth That mysterious Being wherein this All hath found one only dwelling. Therein unites the Whole, and thence it issues: far-spread it is the warp and woof in creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र तद्वो॑चेद॒मृतं॒ नु वि॒द्वान् ग॑न्ध॒र्वो धाम॒ विभृ॑तं॒ गुहा॒ सत् ।
त्रीणि॑ प॒दानि॒ निहि॑ता॒ गुहा॑स्य॒ यस्तानि॒ वेद॒ स पि॒तुः पि॒ताऽस॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra tadvocedamṛtaṃ nu vidvān gandharvo dhāma vibhṛtaṃ guhā sat |
trīṇi padāni nihitā guhāsya yastāni veda sa pituḥ pitā'sat ||
verses.translation: Knowing Eternity, may the Gandharva declare that station, parted, kept in secret. Three steps thereof in mystery are hidden: he who knows these shall be the father's father.

verses.sanskrit:
स नो॒ बन्धु॑र्जनि॒ता स वि॑धा॒ता धामा॑नि वेद॒ भुव॑नानि॒ विश्वा॑ ।
यत्र॑ दे॒वा अ॒मृत॑मानशा॒नास्तृ॒तीये॒ धाम॑न्न॒ध्यैर॑यन्त ॥
verses.transliteration:
sa no bandhurjanitā sa vidhātā dhāmāni veda bhuvanāni viśvā |
yatra devā amṛtamānaśānāstṛtīye dhāmannadhyairayanta ||
verses.translation: He is our kin, our Father and Begetter: he knows all beings and all Ordinances, In whom the Gods obtaining life eternal have risen upward to the third high station.

verses.sanskrit:
प॒रीत्य॑ भू॒तानि॑ प॒रीत्य॑ लो॒कान् प॒रीत्य॒ सर्वाः॑ प्र॒दिशो॒ दिश॑श्च ।
उ॒प॒स्थाय॑ प्रथम॒जामृ॒तस्या॒त्मना॒ऽऽत्मान॑म॒भि सं वि॑वेश ॥
verses.transliteration:
parītya bhūtāni parītya lokān parītya sarvāḥ pradiśo diśaśca |
upasthāya prathamajāmṛtasyātmanā''tmānamabhi saṃ viveśa ||
verses.translation: Having encompassed round existing creatures, the world; and all the Quarters and Mid-quarters, Having approached the first-born Child of Order he with his Self into The Self hath entered.

verses.sanskrit:
परि॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी स॒द्य इ॒त्वा परि॑ लो॒कान् परि॒ दिशः॒ परि॒ स्वः॒ ।
ऋ॒तस्य॒ तन्तुं॒ वित॑तं वि॒चृत्य॒ तद॑पश्य॒त्तद॑भव॒त्तदा॑सीत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pari dyāvāpṛthivī sadya itvā pari lokān pari diśaḥ pari svaḥ |
ṛtasya tantuṃ vitataṃ vicṛtya tadapaśyattadabhavattadāsīt ||
verses.translation: Having gone swiftly round the earth and heaven, around the worlds, around the sky, the Quarters, Having spread out the lengthened thread of Order, he views, and he becomes and is That Being.

verses.sanskrit: सद॑स॒स्पति॒मद्भु॑तं प्रि॒यमिन्द्र॑स्य॒ काम्य॑म् । स॒निं मे॒धाम॑यासिष॒ᳪस्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: sadasaspatimadbhutaṃ priyamindrasya kāmyam | saniṃ medhāmayāsiṣaṃsvāhā ||
verses.translation: To the Assembly's wondrous Lord, to Indra's lovely Friend who gives Wisdom. have I drawn near in prayer.

verses.sanskrit:
यां मे॒धां दे॑वग॒णाः पि॒तर॑श्चो॒पास॑ते ।
तया॒ माम॒द्य मे॒धयाऽग्ने॑ मे॒धावि॑नं कुरु॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yāṃ medhāṃ devagaṇāḥ pitaraścopāsate |
tayā māmadya medhayā'gne medhāvinaṃ kuru svāhā ||
verses.translation: That wisdom which the Companies of Gods, and Fathers, recognize, Even with that intelligence, O Agni, make me wise to-day. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
मे॒धां मे॒ वरु॑णो ददातु मे॒धाम॒ग्निः प्र॒जाप॑तिः ।
मे॒धामिन्द्र॑श्च वा॒युश्च॑ मे॒धां धा॒ता द॑दातु मे॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
medhāṃ me varuṇo dadātu medhāmagniḥ prajāpatiḥ |
medhāmindraśca vāyuśca medhāṃ dhātā dadātu me svāhā ||
verses.translation: Varuna grant me wisdom! grant it Agni and Prajâpati! Wisdom may Indra, Vâyu grant. May the Creator grant it me. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒दं मे॒ ब्रह्म॑ च क्ष॒त्रं चो॒भे श्रिय॑मश्नुताम् ।
मयि॑ दे॒वा द॑धतु॒ श्रिय॒मुत्त॑मां॒ तस्यै॑ ते॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
idaṃ me brahma ca kṣatraṃ cobhe śriyamaśnutām |
mayi devā dadhatu śriyamuttamāṃ tasyai te svāhā ||
verses.translation: Let these the Priests and Nobles both enjoy the splendour that is mine. Best splendour may the Gods bestow on me. To thee, that splendour, hail!

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒स्याजरा॑सो द॒माम॒रित्रा॑ अ॒र्चद्धू॑मासो अ॒ग्नयः॑ पाव॒काः ।
श्वि॒ती॒चयः॑ श्वा॒त्रासो॑ भुर॒ण्यवो॑ वन॒र्षदो॑ वा॒यवो॒ न सोमाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
asyājarāso damāmaritrā arcaddhūmāso agnayaḥ pāvakāḥ |
śvitīcayaḥ śvātrāso bhuraṇyavo vanarṣado vāyavo na somāḥ ||
verses.translation: His be the fires, eternal, purifying, protectors of our homes, whose smoke is shining, White, waxing in their strength, for ever stirring, and seated in the wood: like winds are Somas.

verses.sanskrit: हर॑यो धू॒मके॑तवो॒ वात॑जूता॒ उप॒ द्यवि॑ । यत॑न्ते॒ वृथ॑ग॒ग्नयः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: harayo dhūmaketavo vātajūtā upa dyavi | yatante vṛthagagnayaḥ ||
verses.translation: Gold-coloured, bannered with the smoke, urged by the wind, aloft to heaven Rise, lightly borne, the flames of fire.

verses.sanskrit:
यजा॑ नो मि॒त्रावरु॑णा॒ यजा॑ दे॒वाँ२ ऋ॒तं बृ॒हत् ।
अग्ने॒ यक्षि॒ स्वं दम॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajā no mitrāvaruṇā yajā devām̐ ṛtaṃ bṛhat |
agne yakṣi svaṃ damam ||
verses.translation: Bring to us Mitra-Varuna, bring the Gods to the great sacrifice; Bring them, O Agni, to thine home.

verses.sanskrit: यु॒क्ष्वा हि दे॑व॒हूत॑माँ॒२ अश्वाँ॑२ अग्ने र॒थीरि॑व । नि होता॑ पू॒र्व्यः स॑दः ॥
verses.transliteration: yukṣvā hi devahūtamām̐ aśvām̐ agne rathīriva | ni hotā pūrvyaḥ sadaḥ ||
verses.translation: Yoke, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invoke the Gods: As ancient Hotar take thy seat.

verses.sanskrit:
द्वे विरू॑पे चरतः॒ स्वर्थे॑ अ॒न्याऽन्या॑ व॒त्समुप॑ धापयेते ।
हरि॑र॒न्यस्यां॒ भव॑ति स्व॒धावा॑ञ्छु॒क्रो अ॒न्यस्यां॑ ददृशे सु॒वर्चाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
dve virūpe carataḥ svarthe anyā'nyā vatsamupa dhāpayete |
hariranyasyāṃ bhavati svadhāvāñchukro anyasyāṃ dadṛśe suvarcāḥ ||
verses.translation: To fair goals travel Two unlike in semblance: each in succession nourishes an infant. One bears a Godlike Babe of golden colour: bright and fair-shining is be with the other.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यमि॒ह प्र॑थ॒मो धा॑यि धा॒तृभि॒र्होता॒ यजि॑ष्ठो अध्व॒रेष्वीड्यः॑ ।
यमप्न॑वानो॒ भृग॑वो विरुरु॒चुर्वने॑षु चि॒त्रं वि॒भ्वं॒ वि॒शे-वि॑शे ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayamiha prathamo dhāyi dhātṛbhirhotā yajiṣṭho adhvareṣvīḍyaḥ |
yamapnavāno bhṛgavo virurucurvaneṣu citraṃ vibhvaṃ viśe-viśe ||
verses.translation: Here by ordainers was this God appointed first Invoker, best at worship, to be praised at rites, Whom Apnavâna and the Bhrigus caused to shine, bright-coloured in the wood, spreading to every house.

verses.sanskrit:
त्रीणि॑ श॒ता त्री स॒हस्रा॑ण्य॒ग्निं त्रि॒ᳪशच्च॑ दे॒वा नव॑ चासपर्यन् ।
औक्ष॑न् घृ॒तैरस्तृ॑णन् ब॒र्हिर॑स्मा॒ आदिद्धोता॑रं॒ न्य॒सादयन्त ॥
verses.transliteration:
trīṇi śatā trī sahasrāṇyagniṃ triṃśacca devā nava cāsaparyan |
aukṣan ghṛtairastṛṇan barhirasmā ādiddhotāraṃ nyasādayanta ||
verses.translation: Three times a hundred Gods, and thrice a thousand, and three times ten, and nine have worshipped Agni, For him spread sacred grass, balmed him with butter, and stablished him as Priest and Sacrificer.

verses.sanskrit:
मू॒र्धानं॑ दि॒वो अ॑र॒तिं पृ॑थि॒व्या वै॑श्वान॒रमृ॒त आ जा॒तम॒ग्निम् ।
क॒विᳪ स॒म्राज॒मति॑थिं॒ जना॑नामा॒सन्ना पात्रं॑ जनयन्त दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
mūrdhānaṃ divo aratiṃ pṛthivyā vaiśvānaramṛta ā jātamagnim |
kaviṃ samrājamatithiṃ janānāmāsannā pātraṃ janayanta devāḥ ||
verses.translation: Him, messenger of earth and head of heaven, Agni Vaisvânara, born in holy Order, The Sage, the King, the Guest of men, a vessel fit for their mouths, the Gods have generated.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒ग्निर्वृ॒त्राणि॑ जङ्घनद्द्रविण॒स्युर्वि॑प॒न्यया॑ । समि॑द्धः शु॒क्र आहु॑तः ॥
verses.transliteration: agnirvṛtrāṇi jaṅghanaddraviṇasyurvipanyayā | samiddhaḥ śukra āhutaḥ ||
verses.translation: May Agni slay the foemen,—fain for riches, through the love of song Kindled, bright, served with sacrifice.

verses.sanskrit: विश्वे॑भिः सो॒म्यं मध्वग्न॒ इन्द्रे॑ण वा॒युना॑ । पिबा॑ मि॒त्रस्य॒ धाम॑भिः ॥
verses.transliteration: viśvebhiḥ somyaṃ madhvagna indreṇa vāyunā | pibā mitrasya dhāmabhiḥ ||
verses.translation: With the All-Gods, with Indra and with Vâyu drink the Soma mead, O Agni, after Mitra's laws.

verses.sanskrit:
आ यदि॒षे नृ॒पतिं॒ तेज॒ आन॒ट् शुचि॒ रेतो॒ निषि॑क्तं॒ द्यौर॒भीके॑ ।
अ॒ग्निः शर्ध॑मनव॒द्यं युवा॑नᳪ स्वा॒ध्यं॒ जनयत् सू॒दय॑च्च ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā yadiṣe nṛpatiṃ teja ānaṭ śuci reto niṣiktaṃ dyaurabhīke |
agniḥ śardhamanavadyaṃ yuvānaṃ svādhyaṃ janayat sūdayacca ||
verses.translation: When splendour reached the Lord of men to speed him, down from the heaven was shed the brilliant moisture. Agni brought forth to light and filled with spirit the youthful host benevolent and blameless.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्ने॒ शर्ध॑ मह॒ते सौ॑भगाय॒ तव॑ द्यु॒म्नान्यु॑त्त॒मानि॑ सन्तु ।
सं जा॑स्प॒त्यᳪ सु॒यम॒मा कृ॑णुष्व शत्रूय॒ताम॒भि ति॑ष्ठा॒ महा॑ᳪसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
agne śardha mahate saubhagāya tava dyumnānyuttamāni santu |
saṃ jāspatyaṃ suyamamā kṛṇuṣva śatrūyatāmabhi tiṣṭhā mahāṃsi ||
verses.translation: Show thyself strong for mighty bliss, O Agni; most excellent be thine effulgent splendours. Make easy to maintain our household lordship and trample down the might of those who hate us.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वाᳪ हि म॒न्द्रत॑ममर्कशो॒कैर्व॑वृ॒महे॒ महि॑ नः॒ श्रोष्य॑ग्ने ।
इन्द्रं॒ न त्वा॒ शव॑सा दे॒वता॑ वा॒युं पृ॑णन्ति॒ राध॑सा॒ नृत॑माः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvāṃ hi mandratamamarkaśokairvavṛmahe mahi naḥ śroṣyagne |
indraṃ na tvā śavasā devatā vāyuṃ pṛṇanti rādhasā nṛtamāḥ ||
verses.translation: We have elected thee as most delightful for thy beams glow: hear our great laud, O Agni. The best men praise thee as the peer of Indra in strength, mid Gods, like Vâyu in thy bounty.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वे अ॑ग्ने स्वाहुत प्रि॒यासः॑ सन्तु सू॒रयः॑ ।
य॒न्तारो॒ ये म॒घवा॑नो॒ जना॑नामू॒र्वान् दय॑न्त॒ गोना॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tve agne svāhuta priyāsaḥ santu sūrayaḥ |
yantāro ye maghavāno janānāmūrvān dayanta gonām ||
verses.translation: O Agni who art worshipped well, dear let our princes be to thee, Our wealthy patrons who are governors of men, who part in gifts their stalls of kine.

verses.sanskrit:
श्रु॒धि श्रु॑त्कर्ण॒ वह्नि॑भिर्दे॒वैर॑ग्ने स॒याव॑भिः ।
आ सी॑दन्तु ब॒र्हिषि॑ मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा प्रा॑त॒र्यावा॑णो अध्व॒रम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrudhi śrutkarṇa vahnibhirdevairagne sayāvabhiḥ |
ā sīdantu barhiṣi mitro aryamā prātaryāvāṇo adhvaram ||
verses.translation: Hear, Agni who hast ears to hear, with all thy train of escort Gods. Let Mitra, Aryaman, seeking betimes our rite, seat them upon the sacred grass.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वे॑षा॒मदि॑तिर्य॒ज्ञिया॑नां॒ विश्वे॑षा॒मति॑थि॒र्मानु॑षाणाम् ।
अ॒ग्निर्दे॒वाना॒मव॑ आवृणा॒नः सु॑मृडी॒को भ॑वतु जा॒तवे॑दाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśveṣāmaditiryajñiyānāṃ viśveṣāmatithirmānuṣāṇām |
agnirdevānāmava āvṛṇānaḥ sumṛḍīko bhavatu jātavedāḥ ||
verses.translation: The Freedom of all Gods who merit worship, freely received as Guest in all men's houses, Agni who hath secured the Gods high favour, may he be gracious to us, Jâtavedas.

verses.sanskrit:
म॒हो अ॒ग्नेः स॑मिधा॒नस्य॒ शर्म॒ण्यना॑गा मि॒त्रे वरु॑णे स्व॒स्तये॑ ।
श्रेष्ठे॑ स्याम सवि॒तुः सवी॑मनि॒ तद्दे॒वाना॒मवो॑ अ॒द्या वृ॑णीमहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
maho agneḥ samidhānasya śarmaṇyanāgā mitre varuṇe svastaye |
śreṣṭhe syāma savituḥ savīmani taddevānāmavo adyā vṛṇīmahe ||
verses.translation: In great enkindled Agni's keeping and, for bliss, free from all sin before Mitra and Varuna, May we share Savitar's best animating help. We crave this gracious favour of the Gods to-day.

verses.sanskrit:
आप॑श्चित्पिप्यु स्त॒र्यो न गावो॒ नक्ष॑न्नृ॒तं ज॑रि॒तार॑स्त इन्द्र ।
या॒हि वा॒युर्न नि॒युतो॑ नो॒ अच्छा॒ त्वᳪ हि धी॒भिर्दय॑से॒ वि वाजा॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
āpaścitpipyu staryo na gāvo nakṣannṛtaṃ jaritārasta indra |
yāhi vāyurna niyuto no acchā tvaṃ hi dhībhirdayase vi vājān ||
verses.translation: Like barren cows, moreover, swelled the waters: singers approached thy holy cult, O Indra. Come thou to us as to his team comes Vâyu. Thou through our solemn hymns bestowest bounty.

verses.sanskrit: गाव॒ उपा॑वताव॒तं म॒ही य॒ज्ञस्य॑ र॒प्सुदा॑ । उ॒भा कर्णा॑ हिर॒ण्यया॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: gāva upāvatāvataṃ mahī yajñasya rapsudā | ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā ||
verses.translation: Ye Cows, protect the fount. The two mighty Ones bless the sacrifice. The handles twain are wrought of gold.

verses.sanskrit:
यद॒द्य सूर॒ उदि॒तेऽना॑गा मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा ।
सु॒वाति॑ सवि॒ता भगः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadadya sūra udite'nāgā mitro aryamā |
suvāti savitā bhagaḥ ||
verses.translation: Now when the Sun hath risen to-day may sinless Mitra, Aryaman, Bhaga, and Savitar speed us forth.

verses.sanskrit: आ सु॒ते सि॑ञ्चत॒ श्रिय॒ᳪ रोद॑स्योरभि॒श्रिय॑म् । र॒सा द॑धीत वृष॒भम् ।।तं प्र॒त्नथा॒ ऽयं वे॒नः ॥
verses.transliteration: ā sute siñcata śriyaṃ rodasyorabhiśriyam | rasā dadhīta vṛṣabham ||taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ venaḥ ||
verses.translation: Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the heaven and earth; Supply the liquid to the Bull. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena.

verses.sanskrit:
आ॒तिष्ठ॑न्तं॒ परि॒ विश्वे॑ अभूष॒ञ्छ्रियो॒ वसा॑नश्चरति॒ स्वरो॑चिः ।
म॒हत्तद्वृष्णो॒ असु॑रस्य॒ नामा वि॒श्वरू॑पो अ॒मृता॑नि तस्थौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ātiṣṭhantaṃ pari viśve abhūṣañchriyo vasānaścarati svarociḥ |
mahattadvṛṣṇo asurasya nāmā viśvarūpo amṛtāni tasthau ||
verses.translation: As he was rising up they all revered him: self-luminous he travels, clothed in splendour. That is the Bull's, the Asura's lofty nature: he, Omniform, hath reached the eternal waters.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र वो॑ म॒हे मन्द॑माना॒यान्ध॒सोऽर्चा॑ वि॒श्वान॑राय विश्वा॒भुवे॑ ।
इन्द्र॑स्य॒ यस्य॒ सुम॑ख॒ᳪ सहो॒ महि॒ श्रवो॑ नृ॒म्णं च॒ रोद॑सी सप॒र्यतः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra vo mahe mandamānāyāndhaso'rcā viśvānarāya viśvābhuve |
indrasya yasya sumakhaṃ saho mahi śravo nṛmṇaṃ ca rodasī saparyataḥ ||
verses.translation: I laud your Mighty One who joyeth in the juice, him who is good to all men, who pervadeth all; Indra whose conquering strength is powerful in war, whose fame and manly vigour Heaven and Earth revere.

verses.sanskrit: बृ॒हन्निदि॒ध्म ए॑षां॒ भूरि॑ श॒स्तं पृ॒थुः स्वरुः॑ । येषा॒मिन्द्रो॒ युवा॒ सखा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: bṛhannididhma eṣāṃ bhūri śastaṃ pṛthuḥ svaruḥ | yeṣāmindro yuvā sakhā ||
verses.translation: Great is their fuel, strung their laud, wide is their sacrificial post Whose Friend is Indra, ever young.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रेहि॒ मत्स्यन्ध॑सो॒ विश्वे॑भिः सोम॒पर्व॑भिः ।
म॒हाँ२ अ॑भि॒ष्टिरोज॑सा ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrehi matsyandhaso viśvebhiḥ somaparvabhiḥ |
mahām̐ abhiṣṭirojasā ||
verses.translation: Come, Indra, and delight thee with the juice at all the Soma feasts, Conqueror, mighty in thy strength.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रो॑ वृ॒त्रम॑वृणो॒च्छर्ध॑नीतिः॒ प्र मा॒यिना॑ममिना॒द्वर्प॑णीतिः ।
अह॒न् व्य॒ᳪसमु॒शध॒ग्वने॑ष्वा॒विर्धेना॑ अकृणोद्रा॒म्याणा॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indro vṛtramavṛṇocchardhanītiḥ pra māyināmaminādvarpaṇītiḥ |
ahan vyaṃsamuśadhagvaneṣvāvirdhenā akṛṇodrāmyāṇām ||
verses.translation: Leading his band, Indra encompassed Vritra; weak grew the wily leader of enchanters. He who burns fierce in forests slaughtered Vyamsa, and made the milch-kine of the nights apparent.

verses.sanskrit:
कुत॒स्त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ माहि॑नः॒ सन्नेको॑ यासि सत्पते॒ किं त॑ इ॒त्था ।
सं पृ॑च्छसे समरा॒णः शु॑भा॒नैर्वो॒चेस्तन्नो॑ हरिवो॒ यत्ते॑ अ॒स्मे ।
म॒हाँ२ इन्द्रो॒ य ओज॑सा क॒दा च॒न स्त॒रीर॑सि क॒दा च॒न प्र यु॑च्छसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
kutastvamindra māhinaḥ sanneko yāsi satpate kiṃ ta itthā |
saṃ pṛcchase samarāṇaḥ śubhānairvocestanno harivo yatte asme |
mahām̐ indro ya ojasā kadā cana starīrasi kadā cana pra yucchasi ||
verses.translation: Whence comest thou alone, thou who art mighty, Indra, Lord of the Brave? What is thy purpose? Thou greetest us, encountering us the Bright Ones. Lord of Bay Steeds, say what thou hast against us. Indra, great in his power and might. Neer art thou fruitless. Never art thou neglectful.

verses.sanskrit:
आ तत्त॑ इन्द्रा॒यवः॑ पनन्ता॒भि य ऊ॒र्वं गोम॑न्तं॒ तितृ॑त्सान् ।
स॒कृ॒त्स्वं ये पु॑रुपु॒त्रां म॒हीᳪ स॒हस्र॑धारां बृह॒तीं दुदु॑क्षन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā tatta indrāyavaḥ panantābhi ya ūrvaṃ gomantaṃ titṛtsān |
sakṛtsvaṃ ye puruputrāṃ mahīṃ sahasradhārāṃ bṛhatīṃ dudukṣan ||
verses.translation: Those men extolled that deed of thine, O Indra, those who would fain burst through the stall of cattle, Fain to milk her who bare but once, great, lofty, whose sons are many and her streams a thousand.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मां ते॒ धियं॒ प्र भ॑रे म॒हो म॒हीम॒स्य स्तो॒त्रे धि॒षणा॒ यत्त॑ आन॒जे ।
तमु॑त्स॒वे च॑ प्रस॒वे च॑ सास॒हिमिन्द्रं॑ दे॒वासः॒ शव॑सामद॒न्ननु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
imāṃ te dhiyaṃ pra bhare maho mahīmasya stotre dhiṣaṇā yatta ānaje |
tamutsave ca prasave ca sāsahimindraṃ devāsaḥ śavasāmadannanu ||
verses.translation: To thee the Mighty One I bring this mighty hymn, for thy desire hath been gratified by my laud. In Indra, yea, in him victorious through his might, the Gods have joyed at feast and when the Soma flowed.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒भ्राड् बृ॒हत्पि॑बतु सो॒म्यं मध्वायु॒र्दध॑द्य॒ज्ञप॑ता॒ववि॑ह्रुतम् ।
वात॑जूतो॒ यो अ॑भि॒रक्ष॑ति॒ त्मना॑ प्र॒जाः पु॑पोष पुरु॒धा वि रा॑जति ॥
verses.transliteration:
vibhrāḍ bṛhatpibatu somyaṃ madhvāyurdadhadyajñapatāvavihrutam |
vātajūto yo abhirakṣati tmanā prajāḥ pupoṣa purudhā vi rājati ||
verses.translation: May the Bright God drink glorious Soma-mingled mead, giving the sacrifice's lord uninjured life; He who, wind-urged, in person guard our offspring well, hath nourished them with food and shone oer many a land.

verses.sanskrit: उदु॒ त्यं जा॒तवे॑दसं दे॒वं व॑हन्ति के॒तवः॑ । दृ॒शे विश्वा॑य॒ सूर्य॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: udu tyaṃ jātavedasaṃ devaṃ vahanti ketavaḥ | dṛśe viśvāya sūryam ||
verses.translation: His bright rays bear him up aloft, the God who knoweth all that lives, Sûrya, that all may look on him.

verses.sanskrit: येना॑ पावक॒ चक्ष॑सा भुर॒ण्यन्तं॒ जनाँ॒२ अनु॑ । त्वं व॑रुण॒ पश्य॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration: yenā pāvaka cakṣasā bhuraṇyantaṃ janām̐ anu | tvaṃ varuṇa paśyasi ||
verses.translation: Pure Varuna, with that same eye wherewith thou lookest upon one Actively stirring mid the folk—

verses.sanskrit:
दैव्या॑वध्वर्यू॒ आ ग॑त॒ᳪ रथे॑न॒ सूर्य॑त्वचा । मध्वा॑ य॒ज्ञᳪ सम॑ञ्जाथे ।
तं प्र॒त्नथा॒ ऽयं वे॒नश्चि॒त्रं दे॒वाना॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
daivyāvadhvaryū ā gataṃ rathena sūryatvacā | madhvā yajñaṃ samañjāthe |
taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ venaścitraṃ devānām ||
verses.translation: Ye two divine Adhvaryus, come hither upon a sun-bright car: Bedew our sacrifice with stead. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena. The brilliant presence.

verses.sanskrit:
आ न॒ इडा॑भिर्वि॒दथे॑ सुश॒स्ति वि॒श्वान॑रः सवि॒ता दे॒व ए॑तु ।
अपि॒ यथा॑ युवानो॒ मत्स॑था नो॒ विश्वं॒ जग॑दभिपि॒त्वे म॑नी॒षा ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā na iḍābhirvidathe suśasti viśvānaraḥ savitā deva etu |
api yathā yuvāno matsathā no viśvaṃ jagadabhipitve manīṣā ||
verses.translation: Loved of all men, may Savitar through praises offered as sacred food come to our synod, That ye too, through our hymns, ye ever youthful, may gladden at your visit all our people.

verses.sanskrit: यद॒द्य कच्च॑ वृत्रहन्नु॒दगा॑ अ॒भि सू॑र्य । सर्वं॒ तदि॑न्द्र ते॒ वशे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yadadya kacca vṛtrahannudagā abhi sūrya | sarvaṃ tadindra te vaśe ||
verses.translation: Whatever, Vritra-slayer! thou Surya hast risen on to-day, That, Indra, all is in thy power.

verses.sanskrit: त॒रणि॑र्वि॒श्वद॑र्शतो ज्योति॒ष्कृद॑सि सूर्य । विश्व॒मा भा॑सि रोच॒नम् ॥
verses.transliteration: taraṇirviśvadarśato jyotiṣkṛdasi sūrya | viśvamā bhāsi rocanam ||
verses.translation: Swift, visible to all art thou, O Sûrya, maker of the light, Illuming all the radiant realm.

verses.sanskrit:
तत्सूर्य॑स्य देव॒त्वं तन्म॑हि॒त्वं म॒ध्या कर्तो॒र्वित॑त॒ᳪ सं ज॑भार ।
य॒देदयु॑क्त ह॒रितः॑ स॒धस्था॒दाद्रात्री॒ वास॑स्तनुते सि॒मस्मै॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tatsūryasya devatvaṃ tanmahitvaṃ madhyā kartorvitataṃ saṃ jabhāra |
yadedayukta haritaḥ sadhasthādādrātrī vāsastanute simasmai ||
verses.translation: This is the Godhead, this the might of Sûrya: he hath withdrawn what spread oer work unfinished. When he hath loosed his horses from their station, straight over all Night spreadeth out her garment.

verses.sanskrit:
तन्मि॒त्रस्य॒ वरु॑णस्याभि॒चक्षे॒ सूर्यो॑ रू॒पं कृ॑णुते॒ द्योरु॒पस्थे॑ ।
अ॒न॒न्तम॒न्यद्रुश॑दस्य॒ पाजः॑ कृ॒ष्णम॒न्यद्ध॒रितः॒ सं भ॑रन्ति ॥
verses.transliteration:
tanmitrasya varuṇasyābhicakṣe sūryo rūpaṃ kṛṇute dyorupasthe |
anantamanyadruśadasya pājaḥ kṛṣṇamanyaddharitaḥ saṃ bharanti ||
verses.translation: In the sky's lap the Sun this form assumeth that Varuna and Mitra may behold it. His Bay Steeds well maintain their power eternal, at one time bright, and darksome at another.

verses.sanskrit:
बण्म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि सूर्य॒ बडा॑दित्य म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि ।
म॒हस्ते॑ स॒तो म॑हि॒मा प॑नस्यते॒ऽद्धा दे॑व म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
baṇmahām̐ asi sūrya baḍāditya mahām̐ asi |
mahaste sato mahimā panasyate'ddhā deva mahām̐ asi ||
verses.translation: Verily, Sûrya, thou art great; truly, Âditya, thou art great. As thou art great indeed thy greatness is admired: yea, verily thou, God, art great.

verses.sanskrit:
बट् सू॑र्य॒ श्रव॑सा म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि स॒त्रा दे॑व म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि ।
म॒ह्ना दे॒वाना॑मसु॒र्यः॒ पु॒रोहि॑तो वि॒भु ज्योति॒रदा॑भ्यम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
baṭ sūrya śravasā mahām̐ asi satrā deva mahām̐ asi |
mahnā devānāmasuryaḥ purohito vibhu jyotiradābhyam ||
verses.translation: Yea, Sûrya, thou art great in fame: thou, evermore, O God, art great. Thou by thy greatness art the Gods Home-Priest, divine, far-spread, unconquerable light.

verses.sanskrit:
श्राय॑न्त इव॒ सूर्यं॒ विश्वेदिन्द्र॑स्य भक्षत ।
वसू॑नि जा॒ते जन॑मान॒ ओज॑सा॒ प्रति॑ भा॒गं न दी॑धिम ॥
verses.transliteration:
śrāyanta iva sūryaṃ viśvedindrasya bhakṣata |
vasūni jāte janamāna ojasā prati bhāgaṃ na dīdhima ||
verses.translation: Turning, as twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things. When he who will be horn is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒द्या दे॑वा॒ उदि॑ता॒ सूर्य॑स्य॒ निरᳪह॑सः पिपृ॒ता निर॑व॒द्यात् ।
तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑तिः॒ सिन्धुः॑ पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः ॥
verses.transliteration:
adyā devā uditā sūryasya niraṃhasaḥ pipṛtā niravadyāt |
tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
verses.translation: To-day, ye Gods, when Sûrya hath ascended, deliver us front trouble and dishonour. This boon may Varuna and Mitra grant us, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
आ कृ॒ष्णेन॒ रज॑सा॒ वर्त॑मानो निवे॒शय॑न्न॒मृतं॒ मर्त्यं॑ च ।
हि॒र॒ण्यये॑न सवि॒ता रथे॒ना दे॒वो या॑ति॒ भुव॑नानि॒ पश्य॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā kṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca |
hiraṇyayena savitā rathenā devo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan ||
verses.translation: Throughout the dusky firmament advancing, laying to rest the immortal and the mortal, Borne on his golden chariot he cometh, Savitar, God, beholding living creatures.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र वा॑वृजे सुप्र॒या ब॒र्हिरे॑षा॒मा वि॒श्पती॑व॒ व्वीरि॑ट इयाते ।
वि॒शाम॒क्तोरु॒षसः॑ पू॒र्वहू॑तौ वा॒युः पू॒षा स्व॒स्तये॑ नि॒युत्वा॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra vāvṛje suprayā barhireṣāmā viśpatīva vvīriṭa iyāte |
viśāmaktoruṣasaḥ pūrvahūtau vāyuḥ pūṣā svastaye niyutvān ||
verses.translation: Soft to the tread the sacred grass is scattered: these go like Kings amid the band around them, At the folk's early call on Night and Morning,—Vâyu, and Pûshan with his team to bless us.

verses.sanskrit: इ॒न्द्र॒वा॒यू बृह॒स्पतिं॑ मि॒त्राग्निं पू॒षणं भग॑म् । आ॒दि॒त्यान् मारु॑तं ग॒णम् ॥
verses.transliteration: indravāyū bṛhaspatiṃ mitrāgniṃ pūṣaṇaṃ bhagam | ādityān mārutaṃ gaṇam ||
verses.translation: Indra, Vâyu, Brihaspati, Mitra, Agni, Pûshan, Bhaga, Âdityas, and the Marut host.

verses.sanskrit: वरु॑णः प्रावि॒ता भु॑वन्मि॒त्रो विश्वा॑भिरू॒तिभिः॑ । कर॑तां नः सु॒राध॑सः ॥
verses.transliteration: varuṇaḥ prāvitā bhuvanmitro viśvābhirūtibhiḥ | karatāṃ naḥ surādhasaḥ ||
verses.translation: Be Varuna our chief defence, let Mitra guard us with all aids: Both make us rich exceedingly!

verses.sanskrit:
अधि॑ न इन्द्रैषां॒ विष्णो॑ सजा॒त्या॒नाम् । इ॒ता मरु॑तो॒ अश्वि॑ना ।
तं प्र॒त्नथा॒ ऽयं वे॒नो ये दे॑वास॒ आ न॒ इडा॑भि॒र्विश्वे॑भिः सो॒म्यं मध्वोमा॑सश्चर्षणीधृतः ॥
verses.transliteration:
adhi na indraiṣāṃ viṣṇo sajātyānām | itā maruto aśvinā |
taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ veno ye devāsa ā na iḍābhirviśvebhiḥ somyaṃ madhvomāsaścarṣaṇīdhṛtaḥ ||
verses.translation: Regard us, Indra, Vishnu, here, ye Asvins, and the Marut host, us who are kith and kin to you. Thou in the first old time. See, Vena. O ye eleven Gods. Loved of all men, may Savitar. With the All-Gods. Ye Visvedevas who protect.

verses.sanskrit:
अग्न॒ इन्द्र॒ वरु॑ण॒ मित्र॒ देवाः॒ शर्धः॒ प्र य॑न्त॒ मारु॑तो॒त वि॑ष्णो ।
उ॒भा नास॑त्या रु॒द्रो अध॒ ग्नाः पू॒षा भगः॒ सर॑स्वती जुषन्त ॥
verses.transliteration:
agna indra varuṇa mitra devāḥ śardhaḥ pra yanta mārutota viṣṇo |
ubhā nāsatyā rudro adha gnāḥ pūṣā bhagaḥ sarasvatī juṣanta ||
verses.translation: O Agni, Indra, Varuna, and Mitra, give, O ye Gods, and Marut host, and Vishnu. May both Nâsatyas, Rudra, heavenly Matrons, Pûshan, Sarasvatî, Bhaga accept us.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒न्द्रा॒ग्नी मि॒त्रावरु॒णादि॑ति॒ᳪ स्वः॑ पृथि॒वीं द्यां म॒रुतः॒ पर्व॑ताँ२ अ॒पः ।
हु॒वे विष्णुं॑ पू॒षणं॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिं॒ भगं॒ नु शᳪस॑ᳪ सवि॒तार॑मू॒तये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrāgnī mitrāvaruṇāditiṃ svaḥ pṛthivīṃ dyāṃ marutaḥ parvatām̐ apaḥ |
huve viṣṇuṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ bhagaṃ nu śaṃsaṃ savitāramūtaye ||
verses.translation: Indra, Agni, Mitra, Varuna, Aditi, the Waters, Mountains, Maruts, Sky, and Earth and Heaven, Vishnu I call, Pûshan and Brahmanaspati, and Bhaga, Samsa, Savitar that they may help.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒स्मे रु॒द्रा मे॒हना॒ पर्व॑तासो वृत्र॒हत्ये॒ भर॑हूतौ स॒जोषाः॑ ।
यः शᳪस॑ते स्तुव॒ते धायि॑ प॒ज्र इन्द्र॑ज्येष्ठा अ॒स्माँ२ अ॑वन्तु दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
asme rudrā mehanā parvatāso vṛtrahatye bharahūtau sajoṣāḥ |
yaḥ śaṃsate stuvate dhāyi pajra indrajyeṣṭhā asmām̐ avantu devāḥ ||
verses.translation: With us are raining Rudras, clouds accordant in call to battle at the death of Vritra, The strong, assigned to him who sings and praises. May Gods with Indra as their chief protect us.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒र्वाञ्चो॑ अ॒द्या भ॑वता यजत्रा॒ आ वो॒ हार्दि॒ भय॑मानो व्ययेयम् ।
त्राध्वं॑ नो देवा नि॒जुरो॒ वृक॑स्य॒ त्राध्वं॑ क॒र्ताद॑व॒पदो॑ यजत्राः ॥
verses.transliteration:
arvāñco adyā bhavatā yajatrā ā vo hārdi bhayamāno vyayeyam |
trādhvaṃ no devā nijuro vṛkasya trādhvaṃ kartādavapado yajatrāḥ ||
verses.translation: Turn yourselves hitherward this day, ye Holy, that fearing in my heart I may approach you. Protect us, Gods, let not the wolf destroy us. Save us, ye Holy, from the pit and falling.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वे॑ अ॒द्य म॒रुतो॒ विश्व॑ ऊ॒ती विश्वे॑ भवन्त्व॒ग्नयः॒ समि॑द्धाः ।
विश्वे॑ नो दे॒वा अव॒सा ग॑मन्तु॒ विश्व॑मस्तु॒ द्रवि॑णं॒ वाजो॑ अ॒स्मे ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśve adya maruto viśva ūtī viśve bhavantvagnayaḥ samiddhāḥ |
viśve no devā avasā gamantu viśvamastu draviṇaṃ vājo asme ||
verses.translation: This day come all the Maruts, etc., as in XVIII. 31.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वे॑ देवाः शृणु॒तेमᳪ हवं॑ मे॒ ये अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ य उप॒ द्यवि॒ ष्ठ ।
ये अ॑ग्निजि॒ह्वा उ॒त वा॒ यज॑त्रा आ॒सद्या॒स्मिन्ब॒र्हिषि॑ मादयध्वम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśve devāḥ śṛṇutemaṃ havaṃ me ye antarikṣe ya upa dyavi ṣṭha |
ye agnijihvā uta vā yajatrā āsadyāsminbarhiṣi mādayadhvam ||
verses.translation: Listen, All-Gods, to this mine invocation, ye who inhabit heaven and air's mid-region. All ye; O Holy Ones, whose tongue is Agni, seated upon this sacred grass be joyful.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वेभ्यो॒ हि प्र॑थ॒मं य॒ज्ञिये॑भ्योऽमृत॒त्वᳪ सु॒वसि॑ भा॒गमु॑त्त॒मम् ।
आदिद्दा॒मान॑ᳪ सवित॒र्व्यू॒र्णुषेऽनूची॒ना जी॑वि॒ता मानु॑षेभ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration:
devebhyo hi prathamaṃ yajñiyebhyo'mṛtatvaṃ suvasi bhāgamuttamam |
ādiddāmānaṃ savitarvyūrṇuṣe'nūcīnā jīvitā mānuṣebhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: For thou at first producest for the holy Gods the noblest of all portions, immortality. Thereafter as a gift to men, O Savitar, thou openest existence, life succeeding life.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र वा॒युमच्छा॑ बृह॒ती म॑नी॒षा बृ॒हद्र॑यिं वि॒श्ववा॑रᳪ रथ॒प्राम् ।
द्यु॒तद्या॑मा नि॒युतः॒ पत्य॑मानः क॒विः क॒विमि॑यक्षसि प्रयज्यो ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra vāyumacchā bṛhatī manīṣā bṛhadrayiṃ viśvavāraṃ rathaprām |
dyutadyāmā niyutaḥ patyamānaḥ kaviḥ kavimiyakṣasi prayajyo ||
verses.translation: I with a lofty song call hither Vâyu all-bounteous, filler of his car, most wealthy. Thou, Sage, with bright path, Lord of harnessed horses, impetuous, promptly honourest the prudent.

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्र॑वायू इ॒मे सु॒ता उप॒ प्रयो॑भि॒रा ग॑तम् । इन्द॑वो वामु॒शन्ति॒ हि ॥
verses.transliteration: indravāyū ime sutā upa prayobhirā gatam | indavo vāmuśanti hi ||
verses.translation: These, Indra-Vâyu, have been shed, etc., as in VII. 8.

verses.sanskrit: मि॒त्रᳪ हु॑वे पू॒तद॑क्षं॒ वरु॑णं च रि॒शाद॑सम् । धियं॑ घृ॒ताची॒ᳪ साध॑न्ता ॥
verses.transliteration: mitraṃ huve pūtadakṣaṃ varuṇaṃ ca riśādasam | dhiyaṃ ghṛtācīṃ sādhantā ||
verses.translation: Mitra of holy strength I call, and foe-destroying Varuna, Who make the oil-fed rite complete.

verses.sanskrit: दस्रा॑ यु॒वाक॑वः सु॒ता नास॑त्या वृ॒क्तब॑र्हिषः । आ या॑तᳪ रुद्रवर्तनी ।। तं प्र॒त्नथा॒ ऽयं वे॒नः ॥
verses.transliteration: dasrā yuvākavaḥ sutā nāsatyā vṛktabarhiṣaḥ | ā yātaṃ rudravartanī || taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ venaḥ ||
verses.translation: Nâsatyas, Wonder-workers, yours are these libations with clipt grass. Come ye whose paths are bright with glow.

verses.sanskrit:
वि॒दद्यदी॑ स॒रमा॑ रु॒ग्णमद्रे॒र्महि॒ पाथः॑ पू॒र्व्यᳪ स॒ध्र्य॒क्कः ।
अग्रं॑ नयत्सु॒पद्यक्ष॑राणा॒मच्छा॒ रवं॑ प्रथ॒मा जा॑न॒ती गा॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
vidadyadī saramā rugṇamadrermahi pāthaḥ pūrvyaṃ sadhryakkaḥ |
agraṃ nayatsupadyakṣarāṇāmacchā ravaṃ prathamā jānatī gāt ||
verses.translation: When Saramâ had, found the mountain's fissure, that vast and ancient place she plundered thoroughly. In the floods van she led them forth, light-footed: she who well knew came first unto their lowing.

verses.sanskrit:
न॒हि स्पश॒मवि॑दन्न॒न्यम॒स्माद्वै॑श्वान॒रात्पु॑र ए॒तार॑म॒ग्नेः ।
एमे॑नमवृधन्न॒मृता॒ अम॑र्त्यं वैश्वान॒रं क्षै॑त्रजित्याय दे॒वाः ॥
verses.transliteration:
nahi spaśamavidannanyamasmādvaiśvānarātpura etāramagneḥ |
emenamavṛdhannamṛtā amartyaṃ vaiśvānaraṃ kṣaitrajityāya devāḥ ||
verses.translation: For nowhere did they find another envoy to lead the way than this Vaisvânara Agni. The Gods immortal strengthened the immortal Vaisvânara to win the land in battle.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒ग्रा वि॑घ॒निना॒ मृध॑ इन्द्रा॒ग्नी ह॑वामहे । ता नो॑ मृडात ई॒दृशे॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ugrā vighaninā mṛdha indrāgnī havāmahe | tā no mṛḍāta īdṛśe ||
verses.translation: The strong, dispellers of the foe, Indra and Agni, we invoke: May they be kind to one like me.

verses.sanskrit: उपा॑स्मै गायता नरः॒ पव॑माना॒येन्द॑वे । अ॒भि दे॒वाँ२ इय॑क्षते ॥
verses.transliteration: upāsmai gāyatā naraḥ pavamānāyendave | abhi devām̐ iyakṣate ||
verses.translation: Sing forth to Indu, O ye men, to him as he is purified, Fain to pay worship to the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
ये त्वा॑ऽहि॒हत्ये॑ मघव॒न्नव॑र्ध॒न्ये शा॑म्ब॒रे ह॑रिवो॒ ये गवि॑ष्टौ ।
ये त्वा॑ नू॒नम॑नु॒मद॑न्ति॒ विप्राः॒ पिबे॑न्द्र॒ सोम॒ᳪ सग॑णो म॒रुद्भिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye tvā'hihatye maghavannavardhanye śāmbare harivo ye gaviṣṭau |
ye tvā nūnamanumadanti viprāḥ pibendra somaṃ sagaṇo marudbhiḥ ||
verses.translation: Drink Soma, Indra, handed with the Maruts who, Boon Lord! strengthened thee at Ahi's slaughter, Gainst Sambara, Lord of Bays! in winning cattle, and now rejoice in thee, the holy singers.

verses.sanskrit:
जनि॑ष्ठा उ॒ग्रः सह॑से तु॒राय॑ म॒न्द्र ओजि॑ष्ठो बहु॒लाभि॑मानः ।
अव॑र्ध॒न्निन्द्रं॑ म॒रुत॑श्चि॒दत्र॑ मा॒ता यद्वी॒रं द॒धन॒द्धनि॑ष्ठा ॥
verses.transliteration:
janiṣṭhā ugraḥ sahase turāya mandra ojiṣṭho bahulābhimānaḥ |
avardhannindraṃ marutaścidatra mātā yadvīraṃ dadhanaddhaniṣṭhā ||
verses.translation: Thou vast born mighty for victorious valour, exulting, strongest, full of pride and courage. There, even there the Maruts strengthened Indra when his most rapid Mother stirred the Hero.

verses.sanskrit: आ तू न॑ इन्द्र वृत्रहन्न॒स्माक॑म॒र्धमा ग॑हि । म॒हान्म॒हीभि॑रू॒तिभिः॑ ॥
