verses.transliteration: ā tū na indra vṛtrahannasmākamardhamā gahi | mahānmahībhirūtibhiḥ ||
verses.translation: O thou who slewest Vritra, come, O Indra, hither to our side, Mighty One with thy mighty aids.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमि॑न्द्र॒ प्रतू॑र्तिष्व॒भि विश्वा॑ असि॒ स्पृधः॑ ।
अ॒श॒स्ति॒हा ज॑नि॒ता वि॑श्व॒तूर॑सि॒ त्वं तू॑र्य तरुष्य॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvamindra pratūrtiṣvabhi viśvā asi spṛdhaḥ |
aśastihā janitā viśvatūrasi tvaṃ tūrya taruṣyataḥ ||
verses.translation: Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands. Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse: vanquish the men who fight with us.

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑ ते॒ शुष्मं॑ तु॒रय॑न्तमीयतुः क्षो॒णी शिशुं॒ न मा॒तरा॑ ।
विश्वा॑स्ते॒ स्पृधः॑ श्नथयन्त म॒न्यवे॑ वृ॒त्रं यदि॑न्द्र॒ तूर्व॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
anu te śuṣmaṃ turayantamīyatuḥ kṣoṇī śiśuṃ na mātarā |
viśvāste spṛdhaḥ śnathayanta manyave vṛtraṃ yadindra tūrvasi ||
verses.translation: Heaven and Earth cling close to thy victorious might As sire and mother to their child.

verses.sanskrit:
य॒ज्ञो दे॒वानां॒ प्रत्ये॑ति सु॒म्नमादि॑त्यासो॒ भव॑ता मृड॒यन्तः॑ ।
आ वो॒ऽर्वाची॑ सुम॒तिर्व॑वृत्याद॒ᳪहो॑श्चि॒द्या व॑रिवो॒वित्त॒रास॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajño devānāṃ pratyeti sumnamādityāso bhavatā mṛḍayantaḥ |
ā vo'rvācī sumatirvavṛtyādaṃhościdyā varivovittarāsat ||
verses.translation: The sacrifice obtains the Gods acceptance, etc., as in VIII. 4.

verses.sanskrit:
अद॑ब्धेभिः सवितः पा॒युभि॒ष्ट्वᳪ शि॒वेभि॑र॒द्य परि॑ पाहि नो॒ गय॑म् ।
हिर॑ण्यजिह्वः सुवि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से॒ रक्षा॒ माकि॑र्नो अ॒घश॑ᳪस ईशत ॥
verses.transliteration:
adabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣṭvaṃ śivebhiradya pari pāhi no gayam |
hiraṇyajihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣā mākirno aghaśaṃsa īśata ||
verses.translation: Protect our habitation, Savitar, this day with guardian aids around, propitious, neer beguiled. God of the golden tongue, keep us for newest bliss: let not the evil-wisher have us in his power.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र वी॑र॒या शुच॑यो दद्रिरे वामध्व॒र्युभि॒र्मधु॑मन्तः सु॒तासः॑ ।
वह॑ वायो नि॒युतो॑ या॒ह्यच्छा॒ पिबा॑ सु॒तस्यान्ध॑सो॒ मदा॑य ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra vīrayā śucayo dadrire vāmadhvaryubhirmadhumantaḥ sutāsaḥ |
vaha vāyo niyuto yāhyacchā pibā sutasyāndhaso madāya ||
verses.translation: For you have flowed, through noble ministration, pressed by Adhvaryus, bright sweet-flavoured juices. Drive on thy team and come thou hither, Vâyu: drink for thy rapture of the sap of Soma.

verses.sanskrit: गाव॒ उपा॑वताव॒तं म॒ही य॒ज्ञस्य॑ र॒प्सुदा॑ । उ॒भा कर्णा॑ हिर॒ण्यया॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: gāva upāvatāvataṃ mahī yajñasya rapsudā | ubhā karṇā hiraṇyayā ||
verses.translation: Ye Cows, protect, etc., as in verse 14.

verses.sanskrit: काव्य॑योरा॒जाने॑षु॒ क्रत्वा॒ दक्ष॑स्य दुरो॒णे । रि॒शाद॑सा स॒धस्थ॒ आ ॥
verses.transliteration: kāvyayorājāneṣu kratvā dakṣasya duroṇe | riśādasā sadhastha ā ||
verses.translation: Come ye foe-slayers to the place of meeting, to the birth-places of the two great Sages, With force of intellect unto the dwelling.

verses.sanskrit:
दै॑व्यावध्वर्यू॒ आ ग॑त॒ᳪ रथे॑न॒ सूर्य॑त्वचा । मध्वा॑ य॒ज्ञᳪ सम॑ञ्जाथे ।
तं प्र॒त्नथा॒ ऽयं वे॒नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
daivyāvadhvaryū ā gataṃ rathena sūryatvacā | madhvā yajñaṃ samañjāthe |
taṃ pratnathā 'yaṃ venaḥ ||
verses.translation: Ye two divine Adhvaryus, etc., as in verse 33. Thou in the time of old. See, Vena.

verses.sanskrit:
ति॒र॒श्चीनो॒ वित॑तो र॒श्मिरे॑षाम॒धः स्वि॑दा॒सी३दु॒परि॑ स्विदासी३त् ।
रे॒तो॒धा आ॑सन्महि॒मान॑ आसन्त्स्व॒धा अ॒वस्ता॒त्प्रय॑तिः प॒रस्ता॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
tiraścīno vitato raśmireṣāmadhaḥ svidāsīdupari svidāsīt |
retodhā āsanmahimāna āsantsvadhā avastātprayatiḥ parastāt ||
verses.translation: Transversely was the severing line extended: was it above, or was it, haply, under? There were begetters, there were mighty forces, free action here and energy up yonder.

verses.sanskrit:
आ रोद॑सी अपृण॒दा स्व॑र्म॒हज्जा॒तं यदे॑नम॒पसो॒ अधा॑रयन् ।
सो अ॑ध्व॒राय॒ परि॑ णीयते क॒विरत्यो॒ न वाज॑सातये॒ चनो॑हितः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā rodasī apṛṇadā svarmahajjātaṃ yadenamapaso adhārayan |
so adhvarāya pari ṇīyate kaviratyo na vājasātaye canohitaḥ ||
verses.translation: He hath filled heaven and earth and the great realm of light, when at his birth the skilful held him in their hold. He like a steed is led forth to the sacrifice, Sage, graciously inclined, that he may win us wealth.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒क्थेभि॑र्वृत्र॒हन्त॑मा॒ या म॑न्दा॒ना चि॒दा गि॒रा । आ॒ङ्गू॒षैरा॒विवा॑सतः ॥
verses.transliteration: ukthebhirvṛtrahantamā yā mandānā cidā girā | āṅgūṣairāvivāsataḥ ||
verses.translation: Call hither with the song and lauds the two best slayers of the foe, Delighting even in our hymn.

verses.sanskrit: उप॑ नः सू॒नवो॒ गिरः॑ शृ॒ण्वन्त्व॒मृत॑स्य॒ ये । सु॒मृ॒डी॒का भ॑वन्तु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: upa naḥ sūnavo giraḥ śṛṇvantvamṛtasya ye | sumṛḍīkā bhavantu naḥ ||
verses.translation: All Sons of Immortality shall listen to the songs we sing, And be exceeding good to us.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्मा॑णि मे म॒तयः॒ शᳪ सु॒तासः॒ शुष्म॑ इयर्ति॒ प्रभृ॑तो मे॒ अद्रिः॑ ।
आ शा॑सते॒ प्रति॑ हर्यन्त्यु॒क्थेमा हरी॑ वहत॒स्ता नो॒ अच्छ॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmāṇi me matayaḥ śaṃ sutāsaḥ śuṣma iyarti prabhṛto me adriḥ |
ā śāsate prati haryantyukthemā harī vahatastā no accha ||
verses.translation: Mine are devotions, hymns, sweet are libations. Strength stirs, and hurled forth is my rocky weapon. They call for me, for me their lauds are longing. To their libations these my Bay Steeds bear me.

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑त्त॒मा ते॑ मघव॒न्नकि॒र्नु न त्वावाँ॑२ अस्ति दे॒वता॒ विदा॑नः ।
न जाय॑मानो॒ नश॑ते॒ न जा॒तो यानि॑ करि॒ष्या कृ॑णु॒हि प्र॑वृद्ध ॥
verses.transliteration:
anuttamā te maghavannakirnu na tvāvām̐ asti devatā vidānaḥ |
na jāyamāno naśate na jāto yāni kariṣyā kṛṇuhi pravṛddha ||
verses.translation: Nothing, O Bounteous Lord, stands firm before thee: among the Gods not one is found thine equal. None born or springing into life comes near thee. Do what thou hast to do, exceeding mighty!

verses.sanskrit:
तदिदा॑स॒ भुव॑नेषु॒ ज्येष्ठं॒ यतो॑ ज॒ज्ञ उ॒ग्रस्त्वे॒षनृ॑म्णः ।
स॒द्यो ज॑ज्ञा॒नो नि रि॑णाति॒ शत्रू॒ननु॒ यं विश्वे॒ मद॒न्त्यूमाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tadidāsa bhuvaneṣu jyeṣṭhaṃ yato jajña ugrastveṣanṛmṇaḥ |
sadyo jajñāno ni riṇāti śatrūnanu yaṃ viśve madantyūmāḥ ||
verses.translation: In all the worlds That was the Best and Highest whence sprang the mighty God of splendid valour. Quickly when born he overcomes his foemen, he in whom all who lend him aid are joyful.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा उ॑ त्वा पुरूवसो॒ गिरो॑ वर्धन्तु॒ या मम॑ ।
पा॒व॒कव॑र्णाः॒ शुच॑यो विप॒श्चितो॒ऽभि स्तोमै॑रनूषत ॥
verses.transliteration:
imā u tvā purūvaso giro vardhantu yā mama |
pāvakavarṇāḥ śucayo vipaścito'bhi stomairanūṣata ||
verses.translation: May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth. Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्या॒यं विश्व॒ आर्यो॒ दासः॑ शेवधि॒पा अ॒रिः ।
ति॒रश्चि॑द॒र्ये रु॒शमे॒ पवी॑रवि॒ तुभ्येत्सो अ॑ज्यते र॒यिः ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasyāyaṃ viśva āryo dāsaḥ śevadhipā ariḥ |
tiraścidarye ruśame pavīravi tubhyetso ajyate rayiḥ ||
verses.translation: Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Âryas, Dâsas here belong. Een over unto thee, the pious Rusama Pavîru, is that wealth brought nigh.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒यᳪ स॒हस्र॒मृषि॑भिः॒ सह॑स्कृतः समु॒द्र इ॑व पप्रथे ।
स॒त्यः सो अ॑स्य महि॒मा गृ॑णे॒ शवो॑ य॒ज्ञेषु॑ विप्र॒राज्ये॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ayaṃ sahasramṛṣibhiḥ sahaskṛtaḥ samudra iva paprathe |
satyaḥ so asya mahimā gṛṇe śavo yajñeṣu viprarājye ||
verses.translation: He, with his might advanced by Rishis thousandfold, hath like an ocean spread himself. His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule.

verses.sanskrit:
अद॑ब्धेभिः सवितः पा॒युभि॒ष्ट्वᳪ शि॒वेभि॑र॒द्य परि॑ पाहि नो॒ गय॑म् ।
हिर॑ण्यजिह्वः सुवि॒ताय॒ नव्य॑से॒ रक्षा॒ माकि॑र्नो अ॒घश॑ᳪस ईशत ॥
verses.transliteration:
adabdhebhiḥ savitaḥ pāyubhiṣṭvaṃ śivebhiradya pari pāhi no gayam |
hiraṇyajihvaḥ suvitāya navyase rakṣā mākirno aghaśaṃsa īśata ||
verses.translation: Protect our habitation, Savitar, etc., as in verse 69.

verses.sanskrit:
आ नो॑ य॒ज्ञं दि॑वि॒स्पृशं॒ वायो॑ या॒हि सु॒मन्म॑भिः ।
अ॒न्तः प॒वित्र॑ उ॒परि॑ श्रीणा॒नोऽयᳪ शु॒क्रो अ॑यामि ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā no yajñaṃ divispṛśaṃ vāyo yāhi sumanmabhiḥ |
antaḥ pavitra upari śrīṇāno'yaṃ śukro ayāmi te ||
verses.translation: Come, Vâyu, drawn by fair hymns, to our sacrifice that reaches heaven. Poured on the middle of the straining-cloth and dressed, this bright drink hath been offered thee.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒न्द्र॒वा॒यू सु॑स॒न्दृशा॑ सु॒हवे॒ह ह॑वामहे ।
यथा॑ नः॒ सर्व॒ इज्जनो॑ऽनमी॒वः स॒ङ्गमे॑ सु॒मना॒ अस॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indravāyū susandṛśā suhaveha havāmahe |
yathā naḥ sarva ijjano'namīvaḥ saṅgame sumanā asat ||
verses.translation: Indra and Vâyu, fair to see and swift to hear, we call to us, That in assembly all, yea, all the folk may be benevolent to us and free from malady.

verses.sanskrit:
ऋध॑गि॒त्था स मर्त्यः॑ शश॒मे दे॒वता॑तये ।
यो नू॒नं मि॒त्रावरु॑णाव॒भिष्ट॑य आच॒क्रे ह॒व्यदा॑तये ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛdhagitthā sa martyaḥ śaśame devatātaye |
yo nūnaṃ mitrāvaruṇāvabhiṣṭaya ācakre havyadātaye ||
verses.translation: Yea, specially that mortal man hath toiled for service of the Gods, Who quickly hath brought near Mitra and Varuna to share his sacrificial gifts.

verses.sanskrit:
आ या॑त॒मुप॑ भूषतं॒ मध्वः॑ पिबतमश्विना ।
दु॒ग्धं पयो॑ वृषणा जेन्यावसू॒ मा नो॑ मर्धिष्ट॒मा ग॑तम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā yātamupa bhūṣataṃ madhvaḥ pibatamaśvinā |
dugdhaṃ payo vṛṣaṇā jenyāvasū mā no mardhiṣṭamā gatam ||
verses.translation: Approach ye, and be near to us. Drink, O ye Asvins, of the mead. Draw forth the milk, ye mighty, rich in genuine wealth! Injure us not, and come to us.

verses.sanskrit: प्रैतु॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिः॒ प्र दे॒व्ये॒तु सू॒नृता॑ । अच्छा॑ वी॒रं नर्यं॑ प॒ङ्क्तिरा॑धसं दे॒वा य॒ज्ञं न॑यन्तु नः ॥
verses.transliteration: praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ pra devyetu sūnṛtā | acchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ ||
verses.translation: May Brahmanaspati draw nigh, may Sûnritâ the Goddess come, And Gods bring to our rite which gives the fivefold gift the Hero, lover of mankind.

verses.sanskrit:
च॒न्द्रमा॑ अ॒प्स्वन्तरा सु॑प॒र्णो धा॑वते दि॒वि ।
र॒यिं पि॒शङ्गं॑ बहु॒लं पु॑रु॒स्पृह॒ᳪ हरि॑रेति॒ कनि॑क्रदत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
candramā apsvantarā suparṇo dhāvate divi |
rayiṃ piśaṅgaṃ bahulaṃ puruspṛhaṃ harireti kanikradat ||
verses.translation: Within the Waters runs the Moon, he with the beauteous wings, in heaven. To yellow-hued abundant wealth, object of many a man's desire, loud-neighing goes the tawny Steed.

verses.sanskrit: दे॒वं-दे॑वं॒ वोऽव॑से दे॒वं-दे॑वम॒भिष्ट॑ये । दे॒वं-दे॑वᳪ हुवेम॒ वाज॑सातये गृ॒णन्तो॑ दे॒व्या धि॒या ॥
verses.transliteration: devaṃ-devaṃ vo'vase devaṃ-devamabhiṣṭaye | devaṃ-devaṃ huvema vājasātaye gṛṇanto devyā dhiyā ||
verses.translation: Singing their praise with godlike hymn let us invoke each God for grace, Each God to bring you help, each God to strengthen you.

verses.sanskrit:
दि॒वि पृ॒ष्टो अ॑रोचता॒ग्निर्वै॑श्वान॒रो बृ॒हन् ।
क्ष्मया॑ वृधा॒न ओज॑सा॒ चनो॑हितो॒ ज्योति॑षा बाधते॒ तमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
divi pṛṣṭo arocatāgnirvaiśvānaro bṛhan |
kṣmayā vṛdhāna ojasā canohito jyotiṣā bādhate tamaḥ ||
verses.translation: Agni Vaisvânara, set in heaven, with mighty splendour hath shone forth. Increasing in his power on earth, benevolent, he quells the darkness with his light.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रा॑ग्नी अ॒पादि॒यं पूर्वागा॑त् प॒द्वती॑भ्यः ।
हि॒त्वी शिरो॑ जि॒ह्वया॒ वाव॑द॒च्चर॑त्त्रि॒ᳪशत्प॒दा न्य॑क्रमीत् ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrāgnī apādiyaṃ pūrvāgāt padvatībhyaḥ |
hitvī śiro jihvayā vāvadaccarattriṃśatpadā nyakramīt ||
verses.translation: First, Indra Agni! hath this Maid come footless unto those with feet. Stretching her head and speaking loudly with her tongue, she hath gone downward thirty steps.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वासो॒ हि ष्मा॒ मन॑वे॒ सम॑न्यवो॒ विश्वे॑ सा॒कᳪ सरा॑तयः ।
ते नो॑ अ॒द्य ते अ॑प॒रं तु॒चे तु नो॒ भव॑न्तु वरिवो॒विदः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devāso hi ṣmā manave samanyavo viśve sākaṃ sarātayaḥ |
te no adya te aparaṃ tuce tu no bhavantu varivovidaḥ ||
verses.translation: For of one spirit are the Gods with mortal man, co-sharers all of gracious gifts. May they increase our strength hereafter and to-day, providing ease and ample room.

verses.sanskrit:
अपा॑धमद॒भिश॑स्तीरशस्ति॒हाथेन्द्रो॑ द्यु॒म्न्याभ॑वत् ।
द॒वास्त॑ इन्द्र स॒ख्याय॑ येमिरे॒ बृह॑द्भानो॒ मरु॑द्गण ॥
verses.transliteration:
apādhamadabhiśastīraśastihāthendro dyumnyābhavat |
davāsta indra sakhyāya yemire bṛhadbhāno marudgaṇa ||
verses.translation: Indra who quells the curse blew curses far away, and then in splendour came to us. Indra, refulgent with the Marut host! the Gods eagerly strove to win thy love.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र व॒ इन्द्रा॑य बृह॒ते मरु॑तो॒ ब्रह्मा॑र्चत ।
वृ॒त्रᳪ ह॑नति वृत्र॒हा श॒तक्र॑तु॒र्वज्रे॑ण श॒तप॑र्वणा ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra va indrāya bṛhate maruto brahmārcata |
vṛtraṃ hanati vṛtrahā śatakraturvajreṇa śataparvaṇā ||
verses.translation: To Indra, to your mighty Chief, Maruts, sing forth a mighty prayer. Let Satakratu, Vritra-slayer, kill the fiend with hundred-knotted thunderbolt.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒स्येदिन्द्रो॑ वावृधे॒ वृष्ण्य॒ᳪ शवो॒ मदे॑ सु॒तस्य॒ विष्ण॑वि ।
अ॒द्या तम॑स्य महि॒मान॑मा॒यवोऽनु॑ ष्टुवन्ति पू॒र्वथा॑ ।
इ॒मा उ॑ त्वा यस्या॒यम॒यᳪ स॒हस्र॑मू॒र्ध्व ऊ॒ षु णः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
asyedindro vāvṛdhe vṛṣṇyaṃ śavo made sutasya viṣṇavi |
adyā tamasya mahimānamāyavo'nu ṣṭuvanti pūrvathā |
imā u tvā yasyāyamayaṃ sahasramūrdhva ū ṣu ṇaḥ ||
verses.translation: Indra increased his manly strength at sacrifice, in the wild rapture of this juice; And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their praises to his majesty. May these. Good Lord of wealth. He with his might. Stand up erect.

verses.sanskrit:
यज्जाग्र॑तो दू॒रमु॒दैति॒ दैवं॒ तदु॑ सु॒प्तस्य॒ तथै॒वैति॑ ।
दू॒र॒ङ्ग॒मं ज्योति॑षां॒ ज्योति॒रेकं॒ तन्मे॒ मनः॑ शि॒वस॑ङ्कल्पमस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yajjāgrato dūramudaiti daivaṃ tadu suptasya tathaivaiti |
dūraṅgamaṃ jyotiṣāṃ jyotirekaṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu ||
verses.translation: That which, divine, mounts far when man is waking, that which returns to him when he is sleeping, The lights one light that goeth to a distance, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.

verses.sanskrit:
येन॒ कर्मा॑ण्य॒पसो॑ मनी॒षिणो॑ य॒ज्ञे कृ॒ण्वन्ति॑ वि॒दथे॑षु॒ धीराः॑ ।
यद॑पू॒र्वं य॒क्षम॒न्तः प्र॒जानां॒ तन्मे॒ मनः॑ शि॒वस॑ङ्कल्पमस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yena karmāṇyapaso manīṣiṇo yajñe kṛṇvanti vidatheṣu dhīrāḥ |
yadapūrvaṃ yakṣamantaḥ prajānāṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu ||
verses.translation: Whereby the wise and thoughtful in assemblies, active in sacrifice, perform their duties, The peerless spirit stored in living creatures, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.

verses.sanskrit:
यत्प्र॒ज्ञान॑मु॒त चेतो॒ धृति॑श्च॒ यज्ज्योति॑र॒न्तर॒मृतं॑ प्र॒जासु॑ ।
यस्मा॒न्न ऋ॒ते किं च॒न कर्म॑ क्रि॒यते॒ तन्मे॒ मनः॑ शि॒वस॑ङ्कल्पमस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yatprajñānamuta ceto dhṛtiśca yajjyotirantaramṛtaṃ prajāsu |
yasmānna ṛte kiṃ cana karma kriyate tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu ||
verses.translation: That which is wisdom, intellect, and firmness, immortal light which creatures have within them, That without which men do no single action, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.

verses.sanskrit:
येने॒दं भू॒तं भुव॑नं भवि॒ष्यत् परि॑गृहीतम॒मृते॑न॒ सर्व॑म् ।
येन॑ य॒ज्ञस्ता॒यते॑ स॒प्तहो॑ता॒ तन्मे॒ मनः॑ शि॒वस॑ङ्कल्पमस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yenedaṃ bhūtaṃ bhuvanaṃ bhaviṣyat parigṛhītamamṛtena sarvam |
yena yajñastāyate saptahotā tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu ||
verses.translation: Whereby, immortal, all is comprehended, the world which is, and what shall be hereafter, Whereby spreads sacrifice with seven Hotars, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.

verses.sanskrit:
यस्मि॒न्नृचः॒ साम॒ यजू॑ᳪषि॒ यस्मि॒न् प्रति॑ष्ठिता रथना॒भावि॑वा॒राः ।
यस्मिँ॑श्चि॒त्तᳪ सर्व॒मोतं॑ प्र॒जानां॒ तन्मे॒ मनः॑ शि॒वस॑ङ्कल्पमस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
yasminnṛcaḥ sāma yajūṃṣi yasmin pratiṣṭhitā rathanābhāvivārāḥ |
yasmim̐ścittaṃ sarvamotaṃ prajānāṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu ||
verses.translation: Wherein the Richas, Sâmans, Yajur-verses, like spokes within a car's nave, are included, And all the thought of creatures is inwoven, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.

verses.sanskrit:
सु॒षा॒र॒थिरश्वा॑निव॒ यन्म॑नु॒ष्या॒न्नेनी॒यते॒ऽभीशु॑भिर्वा॒जिन॑ इव ।
हृ॒त्प्रति॑ष्ठं॒ यद॑जि॒रं जवि॑ष्ठं॒ तन्मे॒ मनः॑ शि॒वस॑ङ्कल्पमस्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
suṣārathiraśvāniva yanmanuṣyānnenīyate'bhīśubhirvājina iva |
hṛtpratiṣṭhaṃ yadajiraṃ javiṣṭhaṃ tanme manaḥ śivasaṅkalpamastu ||
verses.translation: Controlling men, as, with the reins that guide them, a skilful charioteer drives fleet-foot horses, Which dwells within the heart, agile, most rapid, may that, my mind, be moved by right intention.

verses.sanskrit:
पि॒तुं नु स्तो॑षं म॒हो ध॒र्माणं॒ तवि॑षीम् ।
यस्य॑ त्रि॒तो व्योज॑सा वृ॒त्रं विप॑र्वम॒र्दय॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pituṃ nu stoṣaṃ maho dharmāṇaṃ taviṣīm |
yasya trito vyojasā vṛtraṃ viparvamardayat ||
verses.translation: Now will I glorify great strength's upholder, Food, By whose invigorating might Trita rent Vritra limb from limb.

verses.sanskrit:
अन्विद॑नुमते॒ त्वं मन्या॑सै॒ शं च॑ नस्कृधि ।
क्रत्वे॒ दक्षा॑य नो हिनु॒ प्र ण॒ आयू॑ᳪषि तारिषः ॥
verses.transliteration:
anvidanumate tvaṃ manyāsai śaṃ ca naskṛdhi |
kratve dakṣāya no hinu pra ṇa āyūṃṣi tāriṣaḥ ||
verses.translation: Do thou, in truth, Anumati, assent and grant us happiness. Urge us to strength and energy: prolong the days we have to live.

verses.sanskrit:
अनु॑ नो॒ऽद्यानु॑मतिर्य॒ज्ञं दे॒वेषु॑ मन्यताम् ।
अ॒ग्निश्च॑ हव्य॒वाह॑नो॒ भव॑तं दा॒शुषे॒ मयः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
anu no'dyānumatiryajñaṃ deveṣu manyatām |
agniśca havyavāhano bhavataṃ dāśuṣe mayaḥ ||
verses.translation: Anumati this day approve our sacrifice among the Gods! Oblation-bearing Agni be, and thou, bliss to the worshipper!

verses.sanskrit:
सिनी॑वालि॒ पृथु॑ष्टुके॒ या दे॒वाना॒मसि॒ स्वसा॑ ।
जु॒षस्व॑ ह॒व्यमाहु॑तं प्र॒जां दे॑वि दिदिड्ढि नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
sinīvāli pṛthuṣṭuke yā devānāmasi svasā |
juṣasva havyamāhutaṃ prajāṃ devi didiḍḍhi naḥ ||
verses.translation: O broad-tressed Sinîvâlî, thou who art the sister of the Gods, Accept the offered sacrifice, and, Goddess, grant us progeny.

verses.sanskrit:
पञ्च॑ न॒द्यः सर॑स्वती॒मपि॑ यन्ति॒ सस्रो॑तसः ।
सर॑स्वती॒ तु प॑ञ्च॒धा सो दे॒शेऽभ॑वत्स॒रित् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pañca nadyaḥ sarasvatīmapi yanti sasrotasaḥ |
sarasvatī tu pañcadhā so deśe'bhavatsarit ||
verses.translation: Five rivers flowing on their way speed onward to Sarasvatî, But then became Sarasvatî a fivefold river in the land.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वम॑ग्ने प्रथ॒मो अङ्गि॑रा॒ ऋषि॑र्दे॒वो दे॒वाना॑मभवः शि॒वः सखा॑ ।
तव॑ व्र॒ते क॒वयो॑ विद्म॒नाप॒सोऽजा॑यन्त म॒रुतो॒ भ्राज॑दृष्टयः ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvamagne prathamo aṅgirā ṛṣirdevo devānāmabhavaḥ śivaḥ sakhā |
tava vrate kavayo vidmanāpaso'jāyanta maruto bhrājadṛṣṭayaḥ ||
verses.translation: O Agni, thou the earliest Angiras, the Seer, hast, God thyself, become the Gods auspicious Friend. After thy holy ordinance the Maruts, sage, active through wisdom, with their glittering spears, were born.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वं नो॑ अग्ने॒ तव॑ देव पा॒युभि॑र्म॒घोनो॑ रक्ष त॒न्व॒श्च वन्द्य ।
त्रा॒ता तो॒कस्य॒ तन॑ये॒ गवा॑म॒स्यनि॑मेष॒ᳪ रक्ष॑माण॒स्तव॑ व्र॒ते ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvaṃ no agne tava deva pāyubhirmaghono rakṣa tanvaśca vandya |
trātā tokasya tanaye gavāmasyanimeṣaṃ rakṣamāṇastava vrate ||
verses.translation: Worthy to be revered, O Agni, God, preserve our wealthy patrons with thy succours, and ourselves. Guard art thou of our seed and progeny and cows, incessantly protecting in thy holy law.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒त्ता॒नाया॒मव॑ भरा चिकि॒त्वान्त्स॒द्यः प्रवी॑ता॒ वृष॑णं जजान ।
अ॒रु॒षस्तू॑पो॒ रुश॑दस्य॒ पाज॒ इडा॑यास्पु॒त्रो व॒युने॑ऽजनिष्ट ॥
verses.transliteration:
uttānāyāmava bharā cikitvāntsadyaḥ pravītā vṛṣaṇaṃ jajāna |
aruṣastūpo ruśadasya pāja iḍāyāsputro vayune'janiṣṭa ||
verses.translation: Lay this with care on her who lies extended: straight, when impregned, hath she brought forth the Hero. With his bright pillar—radiant is his lustre—in our skilled task is born the Son of Idâ.

verses.sanskrit:
इडा॑यास्त्वा प॒दे व॒यं नाभा॑ पृथि॒व्या अधि॑ ।
जात॑वेदो॒ निधी॑म॒ह्यग्ने॑ ह॒व्याय॒ वोढ॑वे ॥
verses.transliteration:
iḍāyāstvā pade vayaṃ nābhā pṛthivyā adhi |
jātavedo nidhīmahyagne havyāya voḍhave ||
verses.translation: In Idâ's place, the centre of the earth, will we deposit thee, That, Agni Jâtavedas, thou mayst bear our offerings to the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र म॑न्महे शवसा॒नाय॑ शू॒षमा॑ङ्गू॒षं गिर्व॑णसे अङ्गिर॒स्वत् ।
सु॒वृ॒क्तिभि॑ स्तुव॒त ऋ॑ग्मि॒यायार्चा॑मा॒र्कं नरे॒ विश्रु॑ताय ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra manmahe śavasānāya śūṣamāṅgūṣaṃ girvaṇase aṅgirasvat |
suvṛktibhi stuvata ṛgmiyāyārcāmārkaṃ nare viśrutāya ||
verses.translation: Like Angiras a gladdening laud we ponder to him who loveth song, exceeding mighty. Let us sing glory to the far-famed Hero who must be praised with fair hymns by the singer.

verses.sanskrit:
प्र वो॑ म॒हे महि॒ नमो॑ भरध्वमाङ्गू॒ष्य॒ᳪ शवसा॒नाय॒ साम॑ ।
येना॑ नः॒ पूर्वे॑ पि॒तरः॑ पद॒ज्ञा अर्च॑न्तो॒ अङ्गि॑रसो॒ गा अवि॑न्दन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pra vo mahe mahi namo bharadhvamāṅgūṣyaṃ śavasānāya sāma |
yenā naḥ pūrve pitaraḥ padajñā arcanto aṅgiraso gā avindan ||
verses.translation: Unto the Great One bring great adoration, a chant of praise to him the very potent, Through whom our sires, Angirases, singing praises, and knowing well the places, found the cattle.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒च्छन्ति॑ त्वा सो॒म्यासः॒ सखा॑यः सु॒न्वन्ति॒ सोमं॒ दध॑ति॒ प्रया॑ᳪसि ।
तिति॑क्षन्ते अ॒भिश॑स्तिं॒ जना॑ना॒मिन्द्र॒ त्वदा कश्च॒न हि प्र॑के॒तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
icchanti tvā somyāsaḥ sakhāyaḥ sunvanti somaṃ dadhati prayāṃsi |
titikṣante abhiśastiṃ janānāmindra tvadā kaścana hi praketaḥ ||
verses.translation: The friends who offer Soma long to find thee: they pour forth Soma and present their viands. They bear, Unmoved, the cursing of the people, for all our wisdom comes from thee, O Indra.

verses.sanskrit:
न ते॑ दू॒रे प॑र॒मा चि॒द्रजा॒ᳪस्या तु प्र या॑हि हरिवो॒ हरि॑भ्याम् ।
स्थि॒राय॒ वृष्णे॒ सव॑ना कृ॒तेमा यु॒क्ता ग्रावा॑णः समिधा॒ने अग्नौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
na te dūre paramā cidrajāṃsyā tu pra yāhi harivo haribhyām |
sthirāya vṛṣṇe savanā kṛtemā yuktā grāvāṇaḥ samidhāne agnau ||
verses.translation: Not far for thee are mid-air's loftiest regions: start hither, Lord of Bays, with both Bay Horses. Pressed for the Firm and Strong are these libations. The pressing-stones are set, the fire is kindled.

verses.sanskrit:
अषा॑ढं यु॒त्सु पृत॑नासु॒ पप्रि॑ᳪ स्व॒र्षाम॒प्सां वृ॒जन॑स्य गो॒पाम् ।
भ॒रे॒षु॒जाᳪ सु॑क्षि॒तिᳪ सु॒श्रव॑सं॒ जय॑न्तं॒ त्वामनु॑ मदेम सोम ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṣāḍhaṃ yutsu pṛtanāsu papriṃ svarṣāmapsāṃ vṛjanasya gopām |
bhareṣujāṃ sukṣitiṃ suśravasaṃ jayantaṃ tvāmanu madema soma ||
verses.translation: Invincible in fight, saviour in battles, guard of our camp, winner of light and water, Born amid hymns, well-housed, exceeding famous, victor, in thee may we rejoice, O Soma.

verses.sanskrit:
सोमो॑ धे॒नुᳪ सोमो॒ अर्व॑न्तमा॒शुᳪ सोमो॑ वी॒रं क॑र्म॒ण्यं॒ ददाति ।
सा॒द॒न्यं॒ विद॒थ्य॒ᳪ स॒भेयं॑ पितृ॒श्रव॑णं॒ यो ददा॑शदस्मै ॥
verses.transliteration:
somo dhenuṃ somo arvantamāśuṃ somo vīraṃ karmaṇyaṃ dadāti |
sādanyaṃ vidathyaṃ sabheyaṃ pitṛśravaṇaṃ yo dadāśadasmai ||
verses.translation: To him who worships Soma gives a milch cow, a fleet steed, and a man of active knowledge, Skilled in home duties, competent in council, meet for the court, the glory of his father.

verses.sanskrit:
त्वमि॒मा ओष॑धीः सोम॒ विश्वा॒स्त्वम॒पो अ॑जनय॒स्त्वं गाः ।
त्वमा त॑तन्थो॒र्वन्तरि॑क्षं॒ त्वं ज्योति॑षा॒ वि तमो॑ ववर्थ ॥
verses.transliteration:
tvamimā oṣadhīḥ soma viśvāstvamapo ajanayastvaṃ gāḥ |
tvamā tatanthorvantarikṣaṃ tvaṃ jyotiṣā vi tamo vavartha ||
verses.translation: These herbs, these milch-kine, and these running waters, all these, O Soma, thou hast generated. The spacious firmament hast thou expanded, and with the light thou hast dispelled the darkness.

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वेन॑ नो॒ मन॑सा देव सोम रा॒यो भा॒गᳪ स॑हसावन्न॒भि यु॑ध्य ।
मा त्वा त॑न॒दीशि॑षे वी॒र्य॒स्यो॒भये॑भ्यः॒ प्रचि॑कित्सा॒ गवि॑ष्टौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
devena no manasā deva soma rāyo bhāgaṃ sahasāvannabhi yudhya |
mā tvā tanadīśiṣe vīryasyobhayebhyaḥ pracikitsā gaviṣṭau ||
verses.translation: Do thou, God Soma, with thy God-like spirit, victorious, win for us a share of riches. Let none prevent thee: thou art Lord of valour. Provide for these and those in fight for cattle.

verses.sanskrit:
अष्टौ॒ व्य॑ख्यत् क॒कुभः॑ पृथि॒व्यास्त्री धन्व॒ योज॑ना स॒प्त सिन्धू॑न् ।
हि॒र॒ण्या॒क्षः स॑वि॒ता दे॒व आगा॒द्दध॒द्रत्ना॑ दा॒शुषे॒ वार्या॑णि ॥
verses.transliteration:
aṣṭau vyakhyat kakubhaḥ pṛthivyāstrī dhanva yojanā sapta sindhūn |
hiraṇyākṣaḥ savitā deva āgāddadhadratnā dāśuṣe vāryāṇi ||
verses.translation: The earth's eight points his brightness hath illumined, three desert regions, and the Seven Rivers. God Savitar the gold-eyed hath come hither, giving choice treasures to the man who worships.

verses.sanskrit:
हिर॑ण्यपाणिः सवि॒ता विच॑र्षणिरु॒भे द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॒न्तरी॑यते ।
अपामी॑वां॒ बाध॑ते॒ वेति॒ सूर्य॑म॒भि कृ॒ष्णेन॒ रज॑सा॒ द्यामृ॑णोति ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyapāṇiḥ savitā vicarṣaṇirubhe dyāvāpṛthivī antarīyate |
apāmīvāṃ bādhate veti sūryamabhi kṛṣṇena rajasā dyāmṛṇoti ||
verses.translation: Savitar, golden-handed, swiftly moving, goes on his way between the earth and heaven, Drives away sickness, bids the Sun approach us, and spreads the bright sky through the darksome region.

verses.sanskrit:
हिर॑ण्यहस्तो॒ असु॑रः सुनी॒थः सु॑मृडी॒कः स्ववाँ॑ यात्व॒र्वाङ् ।
अ॒प॒सेध॑न् र॒क्षसो॑ यातु॒धाना॒नस्था॑द्दे॒वः प्र॑तिदो॒षं गृ॑णा॒नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
hiraṇyahasto asuraḥ sunīthaḥ sumṛḍīkaḥ svavām̐ yātvarvāṅ |
apasedhan rakṣaso yātudhānānasthāddevaḥ pratidoṣaṃ gṛṇānaḥ ||
verses.translation: May, he, gold-handed Asura, kind leader, come hitherward to us with help and favour. Driving off Râkshasas and Yâtudhânas, the God is present, praised in hymns at evening.

verses.sanskrit:
ये ते॒ पन्थाः॑ सवितः पू॒र्व्यासो॑ऽरे॒णवः॒ सुकृ॑ता अ॒न्तरि॑क्षे ।
तेभि॑र्नो अ॒द्य प॒थिभिः॑ सु॒गेभी॒ रक्षा॑ च नो॒ अधि॑ च ब्रूहि देव ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye te panthāḥ savitaḥ pūrvyāso'reṇavaḥ sukṛtā antarikṣe |
tebhirno adya pathibhiḥ sugebhī rakṣā ca no adhi ca brūhi deva ||
verses.translation: O Savitar, thine ancient dustless pathways are well established in the air's mid-region. O God, come by those paths so fair to travel: preserve thou us from harm this day and bless us.

verses.sanskrit: उ॒भा पि॑बतमश्विनो॒भा नः॒ शर्म॑ यच्छतम् । अ॒वि॒द्रि॒याभि॑रू॒तिभिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: ubhā pibatamaśvinobhā naḥ śarma yacchatam | avidriyābhirūtibhiḥ ||
verses.translation: Drink our libations, Asvins twain, grant us protection, both of you, With aids which none may interrupt.

verses.sanskrit:
अप्न॑स्वतीमश्विना॒ वाच॑म॒स्मे कृ॒तं नो॑ दस्रा॒ वृषणा मनी॒षाम् ।
अ॒द्यू॒त्येऽव॑से॒ नि ह्व॑ये वां वृ॒धे च॑ नो भवतं॒ वाज॑सातौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
apnasvatīmaśvinā vācamasme kṛtaṃ no dasrā vṛṣaṇā manīṣām |
adyūtye'vase ni hvaye vāṃ vṛdhe ca no bhavataṃ vājasātau ||
verses.translation: Make ye our speech effectual, O Asvins, and this our hymn, ye mighty Wonder-workers. In luckless game I call on you for succour: strengthen us also on the field of battle.

verses.sanskrit:
द्युभि॑र॒क्तुभिः॒ परि॑ पातम॒स्मानरि॑ष्टेभिरश्विना॒ सौभ॑गेभिः ।
तन्नो॑ मि॒त्रो वरु॑णो मामहन्ता॒मदि॑तिः॒ सिन्धुः॑ पृथि॒वी उ॒त द्यौः ॥
verses.transliteration:
dyubhiraktubhiḥ pari pātamasmānariṣṭebhiraśvinā saubhagebhiḥ |
tanno mitro varuṇo māmahantāmaditiḥ sindhuḥ pṛthivī uta dyauḥ ||
verses.translation: With undiminished blessings, O ye Asvins, through days and nights on every side protect us. This prayer of ours may Varuna grant, and Mitra, and Aditi and Sindhu, Earth and Heaven.

verses.sanskrit:
आ कृ॒ष्णेन॒ रज॑सा॒ वर्त॑मानो निवे॒शय॑न्न॒मृतं॒ मर्त्यं॑ च ।
हि॒र॒ण्यये॑न सवि॒ता रथे॒ना दे॒वो या॑ति॒ भुव॑नानि॒ पश्य॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā kṛṣṇena rajasā vartamāno niveśayannamṛtaṃ martyaṃ ca |
hiraṇyayena savitā rathenā devo yāti bhuvanāni paśyan ||
verses.translation: Throughout the dusky firmament, etc., as in XXXIII. 43.

verses.sanskrit:
आ रा॑त्रि॒ पार्थिव॒ᳪ रजः॑ पि॒तुर॑प्रायि॒ धाम॑भिः ।
दि॒वः सदा॑ᳪसि बृह॒ती वि ति॑ष्ठस॒ आ त्वे॒षं व॑र्तते॒ तमः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā rātri pārthivaṃ rajaḥ pituraprāyi dhāmabhiḥ |
divaḥ sadāṃsi bṛhatī vi tiṣṭhasa ā tveṣaṃ vartate tamaḥ ||
verses.translation: Night! the terrestrial realm hath been filled with the Father's power and might. Thou spreadest thee on high unto the seats of heaven: terrific darkness cometh nigh.

verses.sanskrit: उष॒स्तच्चि॒त्रमा भ॑रा॒स्मभ्यं॑ वाजिनीवति । येन॑ तो॒कं च॒ तन॑यं च॒ धाम॑हे ॥
verses.transliteration: uṣastaccitramā bharāsmabhyaṃ vājinīvati | yena tokaṃ ca tanayaṃ ca dhāmahe ||
verses.translation: O Dawn enriched with ample wealth, bestow on us that wondrous gift Wherewith we may support children and children's sons.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒तर॒ग्निं प्रा॒तरिन्द्र॑ᳪ हवामहे प्रा॒तर्मि॒त्रावरु॑णा प्रा॒तर॒श्विना॑ ।
प्रा॒तर्भगं॑ पू॒षणं॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिं॑ प्रा॒तः सोम॑मु॒त रु॒द्रᳪ हु॑वेम ॥
verses.transliteration:
prātaragniṃ prātarindraṃ havāmahe prātarmitrāvaruṇā prātaraśvinā |
prātarbhagaṃ pūṣaṇaṃ brahmaṇaspatiṃ prātaḥ somamuta rudraṃ huvema ||
verses.translation: Agni at dawn, and Indra we invoke at dawn, and Varuna and Mitra and the Asvins twain, Bhaga at dawn, Pûshan and Brahmanaspati, Soma at dawn, Rudra may we invoke at dawn.

verses.sanskrit:
प्रा॒त॒र्जितं॒ भग॑मु॒ग्रᳪ हु॑वेम व॒यं पु॒त्रमदि॑ते॒र्यो वि॑ध॒र्ता ।
आ॒ध्रश्चि॒द्यं मन्य॑मानस्तु॒रश्चि॒द्राजा॑ चि॒द्यं भगं॑ भ॒क्षीत्याह॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
prātarjitaṃ bhagamugraṃ huvema vayaṃ putramaditeryo vidhartā |
ādhraścidyaṃ manyamānasturaścidrājā cidyaṃ bhagaṃ bhakṣītyāha ||
verses.translation: May we invoke strong early-conquering Bhaga, the Son of Aditi, the great Arranger, Thinking of whom the poor, yea, even the mighty, even the King says, Let me share in Bhaga.

verses.sanskrit:
भग॒ प्रणे॑त॒र्भग॒ सत्य॑राधो॒ भगे॒मां धिय॒मुद॑वा॒ दद॑न्नः ।
भग॒ प्र नो॑ जनय॒ गोभि॒रश्वै॒र्भग॒ प्र नृभि॑र्नृ॒वन्तः॑ स्याम ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhaga praṇetarbhaga satyarādho bhagemāṃ dhiyamudavā dadannaḥ |
bhaga pra no janaya gobhiraśvairbhaga pra nṛbhirnṛvantaḥ syāma ||
verses.translation: Bhaga our guide, Bhaga whose gifts are faithful, favour this prayer and give us wealth, O Bhaga. Bhaga, increase our store of kine and horses: Bhaga, may we be rich in men and heroes.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒तेदानीं॒ भग॑वन्तः स्यामो॒त प्र॑पि॒त्व उ॒त मध्ये॒ अह्ना॑म् ।
उ॒तोदि॑ता मघव॒न्त्सूर्य॑स्य व॒यं दे॒वाना॑ᳪ सुम॒तौ स्या॑म ॥
verses.transliteration:
utedānīṃ bhagavantaḥ syāmota prapitva uta madhye ahnām |
utoditā maghavantsūryasya vayaṃ devānāṃ sumatau syāma ||
verses.translation: So may felicity be ours at present, and when the day approaches, and at noontide; And may we still, O Bounteous One, at sunset be happy in the Deities loving-kindness.

verses.sanskrit:
भग॑ ए॒व भग॑वाँ२ अस्तु देवा॒स्तेन॑ व॒यं भग॑वन्तः स्याम ।
तं त्वा॑ भग॒ सर्व॒ इज्जो॑हवीति॒ स नो॑ भग पुर ए॒ता भ॑वे॒ह ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhaga eva bhagavām̐ astu devāstena vayaṃ bhagavantaḥ syāma |
taṃ tvā bhaga sarva ijjohavīti sa no bhaga pura etā bhaveha ||
verses.translation: May Bhaga verily he Bliss-bestower, and through him, Gods! may happiness attend us. As such, O Bhaga, all with might invoke thee: as such be thou our Champion here, O Bhaga.

verses.sanskrit:
सम॑ध्व॒रायो॒षसो॑ नमन्त दधि॒क्रावे॑व॒ शुच॑ये प॒दाय॑ ।
अ॒र्वा॒ची॒नं व॑सु॒विदं॒ भगं॑ नो॒ रथ॑मि॒वाश्वा॑ वा॒जिन॒ आ व॑हन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
samadhvarāyoṣaso namanta dadhikrāveva śucaye padāya |
arvācīnaṃ vasuvidaṃ bhagaṃ no rathamivāśvā vājina ā vahantu ||
verses.translation: To this our worship may the Dawns incline them, and come to the pure place like Dadhikrâvan. As strong steeds draw a chariot shay they bring us hitherward Bhaga who discovers treasure.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्वा॑वती॒र्गोम॑तीर्न उ॒षासो॑ वी॒रव॑तीः॒ सद॑मुच्छन्तु भ॒द्राः ।
घृ॒तं दुहा॑ना वि॒श्वतः॒ प्रपी॑ता यू॒यं पा॑त स्व॒स्तिभिः॒ सदा॑ नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvāvatīrgomatīrna uṣāso vīravatīḥ sadamucchantu bhadrāḥ |
ghṛtaṃ duhānā viśvataḥ prapītā yūyaṃ pāta svastibhiḥ sadā naḥ ||
verses.translation: May friendly Mornings dawn on us for ever, with wealth of kine, of horses, and of heroes, Streaming with all abundance, pouring fatness. Preserve us evermore, ye Gods, with blessings.

verses.sanskrit: पूष॒न् तव॑ व्र॒ते व॒यं न रि॑ष्येम॒ कदा॑ च॒न । स्तो॒तार॑स्त इ॒ह स्म॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration: pūṣan tava vrate vayaṃ na riṣyema kadā cana | stotārasta iha smasi ||
verses.translation: Secure in thy protecting care, O Pûshan, never may we fail: We here are singers of thy praise.

verses.sanskrit:
प॒थस्प॑थः॒ परि॑पतिं वच॒स्या कामे॑न कृ॒तो अ॒भ्या॒नड॒र्कम् ।
स नो॑ रासच्छु॒रुध॑श्च॒न्द्राग्रा॒ धियं॑-धियᳪ सीषधाति॒ प्र पू॒षा ॥
verses.transliteration:
pathaspathaḥ paripatiṃ vacasyā kāmena kṛto abhyānaḍarkam |
sa no rāsacchurudhaścandrāgrā dhiyaṃ-dhiyaṃ sīṣadhāti pra pūṣā ||
verses.translation: I praise with eloquence hire who guards all pathways. He, when his love impelled him, went to Arka. May he vouchsafe us gear with gold to grace it: may Pûshan make each prayer of ours effective.

verses.sanskrit: त्रीणि॑ प॒दा वि च॑क्रमे॒ विष्णु॑र्गो॒पा अदा॑भ्यः । अतो॒ धर्मा॑णि धा॒रय॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration: trīṇi padā vi cakrame viṣṇurgopā adābhyaḥ | ato dharmāṇi dhārayan ||
verses.translation: Vishnu the undeceivable Protector strode three steps, thenceforth Establishing his high decrees.

verses.sanskrit: तद्विप्रा॑सो विप॒न्यवो॑ जागृ॒वाᳪसः॒ समि॑न्धते । विष्णो॒र्यत्प॑र॒मं प॒दम् ॥
verses.transliteration: tadviprāso vipanyavo jāgṛvāṃsaḥ samindhate | viṣṇoryatparamaṃ padam ||
verses.translation: This, Vishnu's station most sublime, the singers ever vigilant. Lovers of holy song, light up.

verses.sanskrit:
घृ॒तव॑ती॒ भुव॑नानामभि॒श्रियो॒र्वी पृ॒थ्वी म॑धु॒दुघे॑ सु॒पेश॑सा ।
द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी वरु॑णस्य॒ धर्म॑णा॒ विष्क॑भिते अ॒जरे॒ भूरि॑रेतसा ॥
verses.transliteration:
ghṛtavatī bhuvanānāmabhiśriyorvī pṛthvī madhudughe supeśasā |
dyāvāpṛthivī varuṇasya dharmaṇā viṣkabhite ajare bhūriretasā ||
verses.translation: Filled full of fatness, compassing all things that be, wide, spacious, dropping meath, beautiful in their form, The Heaven and the Earth by Varuna's decree, unwasting, rich in seed, stand parted each from each.

verses.sanskrit:
ये नः॑ स॒पत्ना॒ अप॒ ते भ॑वन्त्विन्द्रा॒ग्निभ्या॒मव॑ बाधामहे॒ तान् ।
वस॑वो रु॒द्रा आ॑दि॒त्या उ॑परि॒स्पृशं॑ मो॒ग्रं चेत्ता॑रमधिरा॒जम॑क्रन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
ye naḥ sapatnā apa te bhavantvindrāgnibhyāmava bādhāmahe tān |
vasavo rudrā ādityā uparispṛśaṃ mograṃ cettāramadhirājamakran ||
verses.translation: Let those who are our foemen stand afar from us: with Indra and with Agni we will drive them off. Vasus, Âdityas, Rudras have exalted me, made me preëminent, mighty, thinker, sovran lord.

verses.sanskrit:
आ ना॑सत्या त्रि॒भिरे॑काद॒शैरि॒ह दे॒वेभि॑र्यातं मधु॒पेय॑मश्विना ।
प्रायु॒स्तारि॑ष्टं॒ नी रपा॑ᳪसि मृक्षत॒ᳪ सेध॑तं॒ द्वेषो॒ भव॑तᳪ सचा॒भुवा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ā nāsatyā tribhirekādaśairiha devebhiryātaṃ madhupeyamaśvinā |
prāyustāriṣṭaṃ nī rapāṃsi mṛkṣataṃ sedhataṃ dveṣo bhavataṃ sacābhuvā ||
verses.translation: Come, O Nâsatyas, with the thrice eleven Gods: come, O ye Asvins, to the drinking of the meath. Prolong our days of life, and wipe out all our sins: ward off our enemies; be with us evermore.

verses.sanskrit:
ए॒ष व॒ स्तोमो॑ मरुत इ॒यं गीर्मा॑न्दा॒र्यस्य॑ मा॒न्यस्य॑ का॒रोः ।
एषा या॑सीष्ट त॒न्वे॒ व॒यां वि॒द्यामे॒षं वृ॒जनं॑ जी॒रदा॑नुम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
eṣa va stomo maruta iyaṃ gīrmāndāryasya mānyasya kāroḥ |
eṣā yāsīṣṭa tanve vayāṃ vidyāmeṣaṃ vṛjanaṃ jīradānum ||
verses.translation: May this your praise, may this your song, O Maruts, sung by the poet, Mâna's son, Mândârya, Bring offspring for ourselves with food to feed us. May we find strengthening food in full abundance.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒हस्तो॑माः स॒हच्छ॑न्दस आ॒वृतः॑ स॒हप्र॑मा॒ ऋष॑यः स॒प्त दै॑व्याः ।
पूर्वे॑षां॒ पन्था॑मनु॒दृश्य॒ धीरा॑ अ॒न्वाले॑भिरे र॒थ्यो न र॒श्मीन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
sahastomāḥ sahacchandasa āvṛtaḥ sahapramā ṛṣayaḥ sapta daivyāḥ |
pūrveṣāṃ panthāmanudṛśya dhīrā anvālebhire rathyo na raśmīn ||
verses.translation: They who were versed in ritual and metre, in hymns and rules, were the Seven godlike Rishis. Viewing the path of those of old, the sages have taken up the reins like chariot-drivers.

verses.sanskrit: आ॒यु॒ष्यं॒ वर्च॒स्य॒ᳪ रा॒यस्पोष॒मौद्भि॑दम् । इ॒दᳪ हिर॑ण्यं॒ वर्च॑स्व॒ज्जैत्रा॒यावि॑शतादु॒ माम् ॥
verses.transliteration: āyuṣyaṃ varcasyaṃ rāyaspoṣamaudbhidam | idaṃ hiraṇyaṃ varcasvajjaitrāyāviśatādu mām ||
verses.translation: Bestowing splendour, length of life, increase of wealth, and conquering power, This brightly shining gold shall be attached to me for victory.

verses.sanskrit:
न तद्रक्षा॑ᳪसि॒ न पि॑शा॒चास्त॑रन्ति दे॒वाना॒मोजः॑ प्रथम॒जᳪ ह्ये॒तत् ।
यो बि॒भर्ति॑ दाक्षाय॒णᳪ हिर॑ण्य॒ᳪ स दे॒वेषु॑ कृणुते दी॒र्घमायुः॒ स म॑नु॒ष्ये॒षु कृणुते दी॒र्घमायुः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
na tadrakṣāṃsi na piśācāstaranti devānāmojaḥ prathamajaṃ hyetat |
yo bibharti dākṣāyaṇaṃ hiraṇyaṃ sa deveṣu kṛṇute dīrghamāyuḥ sa manuṣyeṣu kṛṇute dīrghamāyuḥ ||
verses.translation: This gold no demons injure, no Pisâchas; for this is might of Gods, their primal offspring. Whoever wears the gold of Daksha's children lives a long life among the Gods, lives a long life among mankind.

verses.sanskrit:
यदाब॑ध्नन् दाक्षाय॒णा हिर॑ण्यᳪ श॒तानी॑काय सुमन॒स्यमा॑नाः ।
तन्म॒ आ ब॑ध्नामि श॒तशा॑रदा॒यायु॑ष्माञ्ज॒रद॑ष्टि॒र्यथास॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
yadābadhnan dākṣāyaṇā hiraṇyaṃ śatānīkāya sumanasyamānāḥ |
tanma ā badhnāmi śataśāradāyāyuṣmāñjaradaṣṭiryathāsam ||
verses.translation: This ornament of gold which Daksha's children bound, with benevolent thoughts, on Satânîka, I bind on me for life through hundred autumns, that I may live till ripe old age oertakes me.

verses.sanskrit:
उ॒त नोऽहि॑र्बु॒ध्न्यः॒ शृणोत्व॒ज एक॑पात्पृथि॒वी स॑मु॒द्रः ।
विश्वे॑ दे॒वा ऋ॑ता॒वृधो॑ हुवा॒ना स्तु॒ता मन्त्राः॑ कविश॒स्ता अ॑वन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration:
uta no'hirbudhnyaḥ śṛṇotvaja ekapātpṛthivī samudraḥ |
viśve devā ṛtāvṛdho huvānā stutā mantrāḥ kaviśastā avantu ||
verses.translation: Let Ahibudhnya also hear our calling, and Aja-Ekapâd and Earth and Ocean. All Gods Law-strengtheners, invoked and lauded, and Texts recited by the sages, help us!

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मा गिर॑ आदि॒त्येभ्यो॑ घृ॒तस्नूः॑ स॒नाद्राज॑भ्यो जु॒ह्वा॒ जुहोमि ।
शृ॒णोतु॑ मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा भगो॑ नस्तुविजा॒तो वरु॑णो॒ दक्षो॒ अᳪशः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
imā gira ādityebhyo ghṛtasnūḥ sanādrājabhyo juhvā juhomi |
śṛṇotu mitro aryamā bhago nastuvijāto varuṇo dakṣo aṃśaḥ ||
verses.translation: These hymns that drop down fatness, with the ladle I ever offer to the Kings Âdityas. May Mitra, Aryaman, and Bhaga hear us, the mighty Varuna, Daksha, and Amsa.

verses.sanskrit:
स॒प्त ऋष॑यः॒ प्रति॑हिताः॒ शरी॑रे स॒प्त र॑क्षन्ति॒ सद॒मप्र॑मादम् ।
स॒प्तापः॒ स्वप॑तो लो॒कमी॑यु॒स्तत्र॑ जागृतो॒ अस्व॑प्नजौ सत्र॒सदौ॑ च दे॒वौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
sapta ṛṣayaḥ pratihitāḥ śarīre sapta rakṣanti sadamapramādam |
saptāpaḥ svapato lokamīyustatra jāgṛto asvapnajau satrasadau ca devau ||
verses.translation: Seven Rishis are established in the body: seven guard it evermore with care unceasing. Seven waters seek the world of him who lies asleep: two sleepless Gods are feast-fellows of him who wakes.

verses.sanskrit: उत्ति॑ष्ठ ब्रह्मणस्पते देव॒यन्त॑स्त्वेमहे । उप॒ प्र य॑न्तु म॒रुतः॑ सु॒दान॑व॒ इन्द्र॑ प्रा॒शूर्भ॑वा॒ सचा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: uttiṣṭha brahmaṇaspate devayantastvemahe | upa pra yantu marutaḥ sudānava indra prāśūrbhavā sacā ||
verses.translation: O Brahmanaspati, arise. God-fearing men, we pray to thee. May they who give good gifts, the Maruts, come to us. Indra, be thou most swift with them.

verses.sanskrit: प्र नू॒नं ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पति॒र्मन्त्रं॑ वदत्यु॒क्थ्य॒म् । यस्मि॒न्निन्द्रो॒ वरु॑णो मि॒त्रो अ॑र्य॒मा दे॒वा ओका॑ᳪसि चक्रि॒रे ॥
verses.transliteration: pra nūnaṃ brahmaṇaspatirmantraṃ vadatyukthyam | yasminnindro varuṇo mitro aryamā devā okāṃsi cakrire ||
verses.translation: Now Brahmanaspati speaks forth aloud the solemn hymn of praise. Wherein Indra and Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, the Gods have made their dwelling-place.

verses.sanskrit:
ब्रह्म॑णस्पते॒ त्वम॒स्य य॒न्ता सू॒क्तस्य॑ बोधि॒ तन॑यं च जिन्व ।
विश्वं॒ तद्भ॒द्रं यदव॑न्ति दे॒वा बृ॒हद्व॑देम वि॒दथे॑ सु॒वीराः॑ ।।
य इ॒मा विश्वा॑ वि॒श्वक॑र्मा॒ यो नः॑ पि॒ता ऽन्न॑प॒तेऽन्न॑स्य नो देहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
brahmaṇaspate tvamasya yantā sūktasya bodhi tanayaṃ ca jinva |
viśvaṃ tadbhadraṃ yadavanti devā bṛhadvadema vidathe suvīrāḥ ||
ya imā viśvā viśvakarmā yo naḥ pitā 'nnapate'nnasya no dehi ||
verses.translation: O Brahmanaspati, be thou controller of this our hymn, and prosper thou our children. All that the Gods regard with love is blessèd. Loud may we speak, with brave sons, in assembly. He who sate down. Mighty in mind. Father who made us. A share of good, O Lord of Food.

verses.sanskrit:
अपे॒तो य॑न्तु प॒णयोऽसु॑म्ना देवपी॒यवः॑ । अ॒स्य लो॒कः सु॒ताव॑तः ।
द्युभि॒रहो॑भिर॒क्तुभि॒र्व्य॒क्तं य॒मो द॑दात्वव॒सान॑मस्मै ॥
verses.transliteration:
apeto yantu paṇayo'sumnā devapīyavaḥ | asya lokaḥ sutāvataḥ |
dyubhirahobhiraktubhirvyaktaṃ yamo dadātvavasānamasmai ||
verses.translation: Begone the Panis, hence away, rebellious, scorners of the Gods! The place is his who poured the juice.

verses.sanskrit: स॒वि॒ता ते॒ शरी॑रेभ्यः पृथि॒व्याँल्लो॒कमि॑च्छतु । तस्मै॑ युज्यन्तामु॒स्रियाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: savitā te śarīrebhyaḥ pṛthivyām̐llokamicchatu | tasmai yujyantāmusriyāḥ ||
verses.translation: Let Savitar approve a spot upon the earth for thy remains: And let the bulls be yoked for it.

verses.sanskrit: वा॒युः पु॑नातु स॑वि॒ता पु॑नात्व॒ग्नेर्भ्राज॑सा॒ सूर्य॑स्य॒ वर्च॑सा । वि मु॑च्यन्तामु॒स्रियाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: vāyuḥ punātu savitā punātvagnerbhrājasā sūryasya varcasā | vi mucyantāmusriyāḥ ||
verses.translation: Let Vâyu purify. Let Savitar purify. With Agni's glitter. With Savitar's lustre. Let the bulls be unyoked.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्व॒त्थे वो॑ नि॒षद॑नं प॒र्णे वो॑ वस॒तिष्कृ॒ता ।
गो॒भाज॒ इत्किला॑सथ॒ यत्स॒नव॑थ॒ पूरु॑षम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvatthe vo niṣadanaṃ parṇe vo vasatiṣkṛtā |
gobhāja itkilāsatha yatsanavatha pūruṣam ||
verses.translation: The Holy Fig Tree is your home, your mansion is the Parna Tree: Winners of cattle shall ye be if ye regain for me this man.

verses.sanskrit: स॒वि॒ता ते॒ शरी॑राणि मा॒तुरु॒पस्थ॒ आ व॑पतु । तस्मै॑ पृथिवि॒ शं भ॑व ॥
verses.transliteration: savitā te śarīrāṇi māturupastha ā vapatu | tasmai pṛthivi śaṃ bhava ||
verses.translation: Let Savitar lay down thy bones committed to the Mother's lap. Be pleasant to this man, O Earth.

verses.sanskrit: प्र॒जाप॑तौ त्वा दे॒वता॑या॒मुपो॑दके लो॒के नि द॑धाम्यसौ । अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घम् ॥
verses.transliteration: prajāpatau tvā devatāyāmupodake loke ni dadhāmyasau | apa naḥ śośucadagham ||
verses.translation: Here in the God Prajâpati, near water, Man, I lay thee down: May his light drive mishap from us.

verses.sanskrit:
परं॑ मृत्यो॒ अनु॒ परे॑हि॒ पन्थां॒ यस्ते॑ अ॒न्य इत॑रो देव॒याना॑त् ।
चक्षु॑ष्मते शृण्व॒ते ते॑ ब्रवीमि॒ मा नः॑ प्र॒जाᳪ री॑रिषो॒ मोत वी॒रान् ॥
verses.transliteration:
paraṃ mṛtyo anu parehi panthāṃ yaste anya itaro devayānāt |
cakṣuṣmate śṛṇvate te bravīmi mā naḥ prajāṃ rīriṣo mota vīrān ||
verses.translation: Go hence, O Death, pursue thy special pathway apart from that which Gods are wont to travel. To thee I say it who hast eyes and hearest: Touch not our offspring, injure not our heroes.

verses.sanskrit:
शं वातः॒ शᳪ हि ते॒ घृणिः॒ शं ते॑ भव॒न्त्विष्ट॑काः ।
शं ते॑ भवन्त्व॒ग्नयः॒ पार्थि॑वासो॒ मा त्वा॒ऽभि शू॑शुचन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ vātaḥ śaṃ hi te ghṛṇiḥ śaṃ te bhavantviṣṭakāḥ |
śaṃ te bhavantvagnayaḥ pārthivāso mā tvā'bhi śūśucan ||
verses.translation: Pleasant to thee be wind and sun, and pleasant be the bricks to thee. Pleasant to thee be the terrestrial fires: let them not scorch thee in their flames.

verses.sanskrit:
कल्प॑न्तां ते॒ दिश॒स्तुभ्य॒मापः॑ शि॒वत॑मा॒स्तुभ्यं॑ भवन्तु॒ सिन्ध॑वः ।
अ॒न्तरि॑क्षᳪ शि॒वं तुभ्यं॒ कल्प॑न्तां ते॒ दिशः॒ सर्वाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
kalpantāṃ te diśastubhyamāpaḥ śivatamāstubhyaṃ bhavantu sindhavaḥ |
antarikṣaṃ śivaṃ tubhyaṃ kalpantāṃ te diśaḥ sarvāḥ ||
verses.translation: Prosper for thee the regions and the waters, and let the seas for thee be most propitious. Auspicious unto thee be Air. Prosper all Quarters well for thee!

verses.sanskrit:
अश्म॑न्वती रीयते॒ सᳪ र॑भध्व॒मुत्ति॑ष्ठत॒ प्र त॑रता॒ सखा॑यः ।
अत्रा॑ जही॒मोऽशि॑वा॒ ये अस॑ञ्छि॒वान्व॒यमुत्त॑रेमा॒भि वाजा॑न् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśmanvatī rīyate saṃ rabhadhvamuttiṣṭhata pra taratā sakhāyaḥ |
atrā jahīmo'śivā ye asañchivānvayamuttaremābhi vājān ||
verses.translation: On flows the stony flood: hold fast each other, keep yourselves up, my friends, and pass the river. Here let us leave the powers that brought no profit, and cross the flood to Powers that are auspicious.

verses.sanskrit: अपा॒घमप॒ किल्वि॑ष॒मप॑ कृ॒त्यामपो॒ रपः॑ । अपा॑मार्ग॒ त्वम॒स्मदप॑ दुः॒ष्वप्न्य॑ᳪ सुव ॥
verses.transliteration: apāghamapa kilviṣamapa kṛtyāmapo rapaḥ | apāmārga tvamasmadapa duḥṣvapnyaṃ suva ||
verses.translation: Drive away evil, drive away fault, sorcery, and guiltiness. Do thou, O Apâmârga, drive the evil dream away from us.

verses.sanskrit: सु॒मि॒त्रि॒या न॒ आप॒ ओष॑धयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रि॒यास्तस्मै॑ सन्तु॒ योऽस्मान्द्वेष्टि॒ यं च॑ व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ॥
verses.transliteration: sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyāstasmai santu yo'smāndveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
verses.translation: To us let waters and the plants be friendly, to him who hates us, whom we hate, unfriendly.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒न॒ड्वाह॑म॒न्वार॑भामहे॒ सौर॑भेयᳪ स्व॒स्तये॑ । स न॒ इन्द्र॑ इव दे॒वेभ्यो॒ वह्निः॑ स॒न्तार॑णो भव ॥
verses.transliteration: anaḍvāhamanvārabhāmahe saurabheyaṃ svastaye | sa na indra iva devebhyo vahniḥ santāraṇo bhava ||
verses.translation: For our prosperity we touch the ox the son of Surabhi. Be bearer and deliverer to us as Indra to the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
उद्व॒यं तम॑स॒स्परि॒ स्वः पश्य॑न्त॒ उत्त॑रम् ।
दे॒वं दे॑व॒त्रा सूर्य॒मग॑न्म॒ ज्योति॑रुत्त॒मम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
udvayaṃ tamasaspari svaḥ paśyanta uttaram |
devaṃ devatrā sūryamaganma jyotiruttamam ||
verses.translation: Looking upon the loftiest light, etc., as in XX. 21.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒मं जी॒वेभ्यः॑ परि॒धिं द॑धामि॒ मैषां॒ नु गा॒दप॑रो॒ अर्थ॑मे॒तम् ।
श॒तं जी॑वन्तु श॒रदः॑ पुरू॒चीर॒न्तर्मृ॒त्युं द॑धतां॒ पर्व॑तेन ॥
verses.transliteration:
imaṃ jīvebhyaḥ paridhiṃ dadhāmi maiṣāṃ nu gādaparo arthametam |
śataṃ jīvantu śaradaḥ purūcīrantarmṛtyuṃ dadhatāṃ parvatena ||
verses.translation: Here I erect this rampart for the living: let none of these, none other, reach this limit. May they survive a hundred lengthened autumns, and may they bury Death beneath this mountain.

verses.sanskrit: अग्न॒ आयू॑ᳪषि पवस्व॒ आ सु॒वोर्ज॒मिषं॑ च नः । आ॒रे बा॑धस्व दु॒च्छुना॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: agna āyūṃṣi pavasva ā suvorjamiṣaṃ ca naḥ | āre bādhasva ducchunām ||
verses.translation: Agni, thou pourest life, etc., as in XIX. 38.

verses.sanskrit:
आयु॑ष्मानग्ने ह॒विषा॑ वृधा॒नो घृ॒तप्र॑तीको घृ॒तयो॑निरेधि ।
घृ॒तं पी॒त्वा मधु॒ चारु॒ गव्यं॑ पि॒तेव॑ पु॒त्रम॒भि र॑क्षतादि॒मान्त्स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
āyuṣmānagne haviṣā vṛdhāno ghṛtapratīko ghṛtayoniredhi |
ghṛtaṃ pītvā madhu cāru gavyaṃ piteva putramabhi rakṣatādimāntsvāhā ||
verses.translation: Waxing with sacrifice live long, O Agni, with butter on thy face and homed in fatness. When thou hast drunk the cows fair savoury butter, guard, as a father guards his son, these people.

verses.sanskrit: परी॒मे गाम॑नेषत॒ पर्य॒ग्निम॑हृषत । दे॒वेष्व॑क्रत॒ श्रवः॒ क इ॒माँ२ आ द॑धर्षति ॥
verses.transliteration: parīme gāmaneṣata paryagnimahṛṣata | deveṣvakrata śravaḥ ka imām̐ ā dadharṣati ||
verses.translation: These men have led about the ox, have duly carried Agni round, And raised their glory to the Gods. Who will attack them with success?

verses.sanskrit:
क्र॒व्याद॑म॒ग्निं प्र हि॑णोमि दू॒रं य॑म॒राज्यं॑ गच्छतु रिप्रवा॒हः ।
इहै॒वायमित॑रो जा॒तवे॑दा दे॒वेभ्यो॑ ह॒व्यं व॑हतु प्रजा॒नन् ॥
verses.transliteration:
kravyādamagniṃ pra hiṇomi dūraṃ yamarājyaṃ gacchatu ripravāhaḥ |
ihaivāyamitaro jātavedā devebhyo havyaṃ vahatu prajānan ||
verses.translation: I drive Corpse-eating Agni to a distance: sin-laden let him go to Yama's kingdom. Here let this other, Jâtavedas, carry oblation to the Deities, foreknowing.

verses.sanskrit:
वह॑ व॒पां जा॑तवेदः पि॒तृभ्यो॒ यत्रै॑ना॒न्वेत्थ॒ निहि॑तान् परा॒के ।
मेद॑सः कु॒ल्या उप॒ तान्त्स्र॑वन्तु स॒त्या ए॑षामा॒शिषः॒ सं न॑मन्ता॒ᳪ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
vaha vapāṃ jātavedaḥ pitṛbhyo yatrainānvettha nihitān parāke |
medasaḥ kulyā upa tāntsravantu satyā eṣāmāśiṣaḥ saṃ namantāṃ svāhā ||
verses.translation: Carry the fat to Fathers, Jâtavedas, where, far away, thou knowest, them established. Let rivulets of marrow flow to meet them, and let their truthful wishes be accomplished. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
स्यो॒ना पृ॑थिवि नो भवानृक्ष॒रा नि॒वेश॑नी । यच्छा॑ नः॒ शर्म॑ स॒प्रथाः॑ ।
अप॑ नः॒ शोशु॑चद॒घम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
syonā pṛthivi no bhavānṛkṣarā niveśanī | yacchā naḥ śarma saprathāḥ |
apa naḥ śośucadagham ||
verses.translation: Pleasant be thou to us, O Earth, without a thorn, our resting-place. Vouchsafe us shelter reaching far. May thy light drive mishap from us.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒स्मात्त्वमधि॑ जा॒तो॒ऽसि॒ त्वद॒यं जा॑यतां॒ पुनः॑ । अ॒सौ स्व॒र्गाय॑ लो॒काय॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: asmāttvamadhi jāto'si tvadayaṃ jāyatāṃ punaḥ | asau svargāya lokāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: Born art thou, Agni, from this man: let him again be born from thee, For Svarga's world, the man I name. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
ऋचं॒ वाचं॒ प्र प॑द्ये॒ मनो॒ यजुः॒ प्र प॑द्ये॒ साम॑ प्रा॒णं प्र प॑द्ये॒ चक्षुः॒ श्रोत्रं॒ प्र प॑द्ये ।
वागोजः॑ स॒हौजो॒ मयि॑ प्राणापा॒नौ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ṛcaṃ vācaṃ pra padye mano yajuḥ pra padye sāma prāṇaṃ pra padye cakṣuḥ śrotraṃ pra padye |
vāgojaḥ sahaujo mayi prāṇāpānau ||
verses.translation: Refuge I take in Speech as Rich: refuge in Mind as Yajus-text; refuge in Breath as Sâma-chant; refuge in Hearing and in Sight. Speech-energy endowed with strength, inbreath and outbreath are in me.

verses.sanskrit:
यन्मे॑ छि॒द्रं चक्षु॑षो॒ हृद॑यस्य॒ मन॑सो॒ वाति॑तृण्णं॒ बृह॒स्पति॑र्मे॒ तद्द॑धातु ।
शं नो॑ भवतु॒ भुव॑नस्य॒ यस्पतिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yanme chidraṃ cakṣuṣo hṛdayasya manaso vātitṛṇṇaṃ bṛhaspatirme taddadhātu |
śaṃ no bhavatu bhuvanasya yaspatiḥ ||
verses.translation: Whatever deeply-sunk defect I have of eye, or mind, or heart, that way Brihaspati amend! Gracious to us be he, Protector of the world.

verses.sanskrit:
भूर्भुवः॒ स्वः॒ तत्स॑वि॒तुर्वरे॑ण्यं॒ भर्गो॑ दे॒वस्य॑ धीमहि ।
धियो॒ यो नः॑ प्रचो॒दया॑त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
bhūrbhuvaḥ svaḥ tatsaviturvareṇyaṃ bhargo devasya dhīmahi |
dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
verses.translation: Earth! Ether! Heaven! May we attain that excellent, etc., as in III. 33.

verses.sanskrit: कया॑ नश्चि॒त्र आ भु॑वदू॒ती स॒दावृ॑धः॒ सखा॑ । कया॒ शचि॑ष्ठया वृ॒ता ॥
verses.transliteration: kayā naścitra ā bhuvadūtī sadāvṛdhaḥ sakhā | kayā śaciṣṭhayā vṛtā ||
verses.translation: With what help will he come to us etc., as in XXVII. 39.

verses.sanskrit: कस्त्वा॑ स॒त्यो मदा॑नां॒ मᳪहि॑ष्ठो मत्स॒दन्ध॑सः । दृ॒ढा चि॑दा॒रुजे॒ वसु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: kastvā satyo madānāṃ maṃhiṣṭho matsadandhasaḥ | dṛḍhā cidāruje vasu ||
verses.translation: What genuine, etc., as in XXVII. 40.

verses.sanskrit: अ॒भी षु णः॒ सखी॑नामवि॒ता ज॑रितॄ॒णाम् । श॒तं भ॑वास्यू॒तिभिः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: abhī ṣu ṇaḥ sakhīnāmavitā jaritṝṇām | śataṃ bhavāsyūtibhiḥ ||
verses.translation: Do thou who art, etc., as in XXVII. 41.

verses.sanskrit: कया॒ त्वं न ऊ॒त्याभि प्र म॑न्दसे वृषन् । कया॑ स्तो॒तृभ्य॒ आ भ॑र ॥
verses.transliteration: kayā tvaṃ na ūtyābhi pra mandase vṛṣan | kayā stotṛbhya ā bhara ||
verses.translation: O Hero, with what aid dost thou delight us, with what succour bring Riches to those who worship thee?

verses.sanskrit: इन्द्रो॒ विश्व॑स्य राजति । शं नो॑ अस्तु द्वि॒पदे॒ शं चतु॑ष्पदे ॥
verses.transliteration: indro viśvasya rājati | śaṃ no astu dvipade śaṃ catuṣpade ||
verses.translation: Indra is king of all that is: may weal attend our bipeds and our quadrupeds.

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॑ मि॒त्रः शं वरु॑णः॒ शं नो॑ भवत्वर्य॒मा ।
शं न॒ इन्द्रो॒ बृह॒स्पतिः॒ शं नो॒ विष्णु॑रुरुक्र॒मः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no mitraḥ śaṃ varuṇaḥ śaṃ no bhavatvaryamā |
śaṃ na indro bṛhaspatiḥ śaṃ no viṣṇururukramaḥ ||
verses.translation: Gracious he Mitra unto us, and Varuna and Aryaman; Indra, Brihaspati be kind, and Vishnu of the mighty stride.

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॒ वातः॑ पवता॒ᳪ शं न॑स्तपतु॒ सूर्यः॑ ।
शं नः॒ कनि॑क्रदद्दे॒वः प॒र्जन्यो॑ अ॒भि व॑र्षतु ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no vātaḥ pavatāṃ śaṃ nastapatu sūryaḥ |
śaṃ naḥ kanikradaddevaḥ parjanyo abhi varṣatu ||
verses.translation: Pleasantly blow the wind for us, may Sûrya warm us pleasantly. Pleasantly, with a roar, the God Parjanya send the rain on us.

verses.sanskrit:
अहा॑नि॒ शं भव॑न्तु नः॒ शᳪ रात्रीः॒ प्रति॑ धीयताम् ।
शं न॑ इन्द्रा॒ग्नी भ॑वता॒मवो॑भिः॒ शं न॒ इन्द्रा॒वरु॑णा रा॒तह॑व्या ।
शं न॑ इन्द्रापू॒षणा॒ वाज॑सातौ॒ शमिन्द्रा॒सोमा॑ सुवि॒ताय॒ शं योः ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahāni śaṃ bhavantu naḥ śaṃ rātrīḥ prati dhīyatām |
śaṃ na indrāgnī bhavatāmavobhiḥ śaṃ na indrāvaruṇā rātahavyā |
śaṃ na indrāpūṣaṇā vājasātau śamindrāsomā suvitāya śaṃ yoḥ ||
verses.translation: May days pass pleasantly for us, may nights draw near delightfully. Befriend us with their aids Indra and Agni, Indra and Varuna who taste oblations. Indra and Pûshan be our help in battle, Indra and Soma give health, strength, and comfort.

verses.sanskrit:
शं नो॑ दे॒वीर॒भिष्ट॑य॒ आपो॑ भवन्तु पी॒तये॑ ।
शं योर॒भि स्र॑वन्तु नः ॥
verses.transliteration:
śaṃ no devīrabhiṣṭaya āpo bhavantu pītaye |
śaṃ yorabhi sravantu naḥ ||
verses.translation: May the celestial Waters, our helpers, be sweet for us to drink, And flow with health and strength to us.

verses.sanskrit:
स्यो॒ना पृ॑थिवि नो भवानृक्ष॒रा नि॒वेश॑नी ।
यच्छा॑ नः॒ शर्म॑ स॒प्रथाः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
syonā pṛthivi no bhavānṛkṣarā niveśanī |
yacchā naḥ śarma saprathāḥ ||
verses.translation: Pleasant be thou to us, O Earth, etc., as in XXXV. 21.

verses.sanskrit: आपो॒ हि ष्ठा म॑यो॒भुव॒स्ता न॑ ऊ॒र्जे द॑धातन । म॒हे रणा॑य॒ चक्ष॑से ॥
verses.transliteration: āpo hi ṣṭhā mayobhuvastā na ūrje dadhātana | mahe raṇāya cakṣase ||
verses.translation: Ye, Waters, are, etc., as in XL 50.

verses.sanskrit: यो वः॑ शि॒वत॑मो॒ रस॒स्तस्य॑ भाजयते॒ह नः॑ । उ॒श॒तीरि॑व मा॒तरः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yo vaḥ śivatamo rasastasya bhājayateha naḥ | uśatīriva mātaraḥ ||
verses.translation: Give us a portion, etc., as in XI. 51.

verses.sanskrit: तस्मा॒ अरं॑ गमाम वो॒ यस्य॒ क्षया॑य॒ जिन्व॑थ । आपो॑ ज॒नय॑था च नः ॥
verses.transliteration: tasmā araṃ gamāma vo yasya kṣayāya jinvatha | āpo janayathā ca naḥ ||
verses.translation: To you we gladly come, etc., as in XI. 52,

verses.sanskrit:
द्यौः शान्ति॑र॒न्तरि॑क्ष॒ᳪ शान्तिः॑ पृथि॒वी शान्ति॒रापः॒ शान्ति॒रोष॑धयः॒ शान्तिः॑ ।
वन॒स्पत॑यः॒ शान्ति॒र्विश्वे॑ दे॒वाः शान्ति॒र्ब्रह्म॒ शान्तिः॒ सर्व॒ᳪ शान्तिः॒ शान्ति॑रे॒व शान्तिः॒ सा मा॒ शान्ति॑रेधि ॥
verses.transliteration:
dyauḥ śāntirantarikṣaṃ śāntiḥ pṛthivī śāntirāpaḥ śāntiroṣadhayaḥ śāntiḥ |
vanaspatayaḥ śāntirviśve devāḥ śāntirbrahma śāntiḥ sarvaṃ śāntiḥ śāntireva śāntiḥ sā mā śāntiredhi ||
verses.translation: Sky alleviation, Air alleviation, Earth alleviation, Plants alleviation, Trees alleviation, All-Gods alleviation, Brahma alleviation, Universe alleviation, just Alleviation alleviation—may that alleviation come to me!

verses.sanskrit:
दृते॒ दृᳪह॑ मा मि॒त्रस्य॑ मा॒ चक्षु॑षा॒ सर्वा॑णि भू॒तानि॒ समी॑क्षन्ताम् ।
मि॒त्रस्या॒हं चक्षु॑षा॒ सर्वा॑णि भू॒तानि॒ समी॑क्षे ।
मि॒त्रस्य॒ चक्षु॑षा॒ समी॑क्षामहे ॥
verses.transliteration:
dṛte dṛṃha mā mitrasya mā cakṣuṣā sarvāṇi bhūtāni samīkṣantām |
mitrasyāhaṃ cakṣuṣā sarvāṇi bhūtāni samīkṣe |
mitrasya cakṣuṣā samīkṣāmahe ||
verses.translation: Caldron, strengthen me. May all beings regard me with the eye of a friend. May I regard all beings with the eye of a friend. With the eye of a friend do we regard one another.

verses.sanskrit: दृते॒ दृᳪह॑ मा । ज्योक्ते॑ स॒न्दृशि॑ जीव्यासं॒ ज्योक्ते॑ स॒न्दृशि॑ जीव्यासम् ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛte dṛṃha mā | jyokte sandṛśi jīvyāsaṃ jyokte sandṛśi jīvyāsam ||
verses.translation: Do thou, O Caldron, strengthen me. Long may I live to look on thee. Long may I live to look on thee.

verses.sanskrit:
नम॑स्ते॒ हर॑से शो॒चिषे॒ नम॑स्ते अस्त्व॒र्चिषे॑ ।
अ॒न्याँस्ते॑ अ॒स्मत्त॑पन्तु हे॒तयः॑ पाव॒को अ॒स्मभ्य॑ᳪ शि॒वो भ॑व ॥
verses.transliteration:
namaste harase śociṣe namaste astvarciṣe |
anyām̐ste asmattapantu hetayaḥ pāvako asmabhyaṃ śivo bhava ||
verses.translation: Obeisance to thy wrath and glow, etc., as in XXII. 11.

verses.sanskrit: नम॑स्ते अस्तु वि॒द्युते॒ नम॑स्ते स्तनयि॒त्नवे॑ । नम॑स्ते भगवन्नस्तु॒ यतः॒ स्वः॒ स॒मीह॑से ॥
verses.transliteration: namaste astu vidyute namaste stanayitnave | namaste bhagavannastu yataḥ svaḥ samīhase ||
verses.translation: Homage to thee the lightning flash, homage to thee the thunder's roar! Homage, O Bounteous Lord, to thee whereas thou fain wouldst win to heaven!

verses.sanskrit: यतो॑-यतः स॒मीह॑से॒ ततो॑ नो॒ अभ॑यं कुरु । शं नः॑ कुरु प्र॒जाभ्योऽभ॑यं नः प॒शुभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: yato-yataḥ samīhase tato no abhayaṃ kuru | śaṃ naḥ kuru prajābhyo'bhayaṃ naḥ paśubhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: From whatsoever trouble thou desirest, give us safety thence. Give to our children happiness and to our beasts security.

verses.sanskrit: सु॒मि॒त्रि॒या न॒ आप॒ ओष॑धयः सन्तु दुर्मित्रि॒यास्तस्मै॑ सन्तु॒ योऽस्मान् द्वेष्टि॒ यं च॑ व॒यं द्वि॒ष्मः ॥
verses.transliteration: sumitriyā na āpa oṣadhayaḥ santu durmitriyāstasmai santu yo'smān dveṣṭi yaṃ ca vayaṃ dviṣmaḥ ||
verses.translation: To us let Waters and let Plants be friendly, etc., as in VI. 23.

verses.sanskrit: तच्चक्षु॑र्दे॒वहि॑तं पु॒रस्ता॑च्छु॒क्रमुच्च॑रत् । पश्ये॑म श॒रदः॑ श॒तं जीवे॑म श॒रदः॑ श॒तᳪ शृणु॑याम श॒रदः॑ श॒तं प्र ब्र॑वाम श॒रदः॑ श॒तमदी॑नाः स्याम श॒रदः॑ श॒तं भूय॑श्च श॒रदः॑ श॒तात् ॥
verses.transliteration: taccakṣurdevahitaṃ purastācchukramuccarat | paśyema śaradaḥ śataṃ jīvema śaradaḥ śataṃ śṛṇuyāma śaradaḥ śataṃ pra bravāma śaradaḥ śatamadīnāḥ syāma śaradaḥ śataṃ bhūyaśca śaradaḥ śatāt ||
verses.translation: Through hundred autumns may we see that bright Eye, God-appointed, rise, A hundred autumns may we live. Through hundred autumns may we hear; through hundred autumns clearly speak: through hundred autumns live content; a hundred autumns, yea, beyond a hundred autumns may we see.

verses.sanskrit: दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् । आ द॑दे॒ नारि॑रसि ॥
verses.transliteration: devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām | ā dade nārirasi ||
verses.translation: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee, etc. Spade art thou. Woman art thou, etc., as in XI. 9, 10.

verses.sanskrit:
यु॒ञ्जते॒ मन॑ उ॒त यु॑ञ्जते॒ धियो॒ विप्रा॒ विप्र॑स्य बृह॒तो वि॑प॒श्चितः॑ ।
वि होत्रा॑ दधे वयुना॒विदेक॒ इन्म॒ही दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुः परि॑ष्टुतिः॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yuñjate mana uta yuñjate dhiyo viprā viprasya bṛhato vipaścitaḥ |
vi hotrā dadhe vayunāvideka inmahī devasya savituḥ pariṣṭutiḥ svāhā ||
verses.translation: The priests of him the lofty Priest, etc., as in V. 14.

verses.sanskrit:
देवी॑ द्यावापृथिवी म॒खस्य॑ वाम॒द्य शिरो॑ राध्यासं देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः ।
म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ॥
verses.transliteration:
devī dyāvāpṛthivī makhasya vāmadya śiro rādhyāsaṃ devayajane pṛthivyāḥ |
makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe ||
verses.translation: O Heaven and Earth divine, may I duly prepare for you this day the head of Makha on the place of earth where the Gods sacrificed. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

verses.sanskrit:
देव्यो॑ वम्र्यो भू॒तस्य॑ प्रथम॒जा म॒खस्य॑ वो॒ऽद्य शिरो॑ राध्यासं देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः ।
म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ॥
verses.transliteration:
devyo vamryo bhūtasya prathamajā makhasya vo'dya śiro rādhyāsaṃ devayajane pṛthivyāḥ |
makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe ||
verses.translation: Ye who were born the earliest of creation, Ants divine, may I duly prepare for you this day the head of Makha on the place of earth where the Gods sacrificed. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

verses.sanskrit:
इय॒त्यग्र॑ आसीन्म॒खस्य॑ ते॒ऽद्य शिरो॑ राध्यासं देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः ।
म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ॥
verses.transliteration:
iyatyagra āsīnmakhasya te'dya śiro rādhyāsaṃ devayajane pṛthivyāḥ |
makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe ||
verses.translation: Only so large was it at first. Duly may I prepare for you this day the head of Makha on earth's place where the Gods sacrificed. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्र॒स्यौज॑ स्थ म॒खस्य॑ वो॒ऽद्य शिरो॑ राध्यासं देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः ।
म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ शी॒र्ष्णे । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrasyauja stha makhasya vo'dya śiro rādhyāsaṃ devayajane pṛthivyāḥ |
makhāya tvā makhasya śīrṣṇe | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe ||
verses.translation: Indra's effective might are ye. Duly may I prepare for you this day the head of Makha on earth's place where the Gods sacrificed. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

verses.sanskrit:
प्रैतु॒ ब्रह्म॑ण॒स्पतिः॒ प्र दे॒व्ये॒तु सू॒नृता॑ । अच्छा॑ वी॒रं नर्यं॑ प॒ङ्क्तिरा॑धसं दे॒वा य॒ज्ञं न॑यन्तु नः ।
म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ॥
verses.transliteration:
praitu brahmaṇaspatiḥ pra devyetu sūnṛtā | acchā vīraṃ naryaṃ paṅktirādhasaṃ devā yajñaṃ nayantu naḥ |
makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe ||
verses.translation: May Brahmanaspati draw nigh, etc., as in XXXIII. 89. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha, etc., as in verse 6.

verses.sanskrit:
म॒खस्य॒ शिरो॑ऽसि । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।
म॒खस्य॒ शिरो॑ऽसि । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।
म॒खस्य॒ शिरो॑ऽसि । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।
म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ॥
verses.transliteration:
makhasya śiro'si | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe |
makhasya śiro'si | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe |
makhasya śiro'si | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe |
makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe ||
verses.translation: Thou art the head of Makha. Thee for Makha, thee for Makha's head! Thou art the head of Makha. Thee for Makha, thee for Makha's head! Thou art the head of Makha, thee for Makha, thee for Makha's head! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha, etc., as in verse 6.

verses.sanskrit:
अश्व॑स्य त्वा॒ वृष्णः॑ श॒क्ना धू॑पयामि देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।
अश्व॑स्य त्वा॒ वृष्णः॑ श॒क्ना धू॑पयामि देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।
अश्व॑स्य त्वा॒ वृष्णः॑ श॒क्ना धू॑पयामि देव॒यज॑ने पृथि॒व्याः । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ।
म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvasya tvā vṛṣṇaḥ śaknā dhūpayāmi devayajane pṛthivyāḥ | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe |
aśvasya tvā vṛṣṇaḥ śaknā dhūpayāmi devayajane pṛthivyāḥ | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe |
aśvasya tvā vṛṣṇaḥ śaknā dhūpayāmi devayajane pṛthivyāḥ | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe |
makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe ||
verses.translation: Thee on Gods sacrificial ground with stallion's dung I fumigate. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

verses.sanskrit: ऋ॒जवे॑ त्वा सा॒धवे॑ त्वा सुक्षि॒त्यै त्वा॑ । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे । म॒खाय॑ त्वा म॒खस्य॑ त्वा शी॒र्ष्णे ॥
verses.transliteration: ṛjave tvā sādhave tvā sukṣityai tvā | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe | makhāya tvā makhasya tvā śīrṣṇe ||
verses.translation: Thee for the True. Thee for the Good. Thee for the place of happy rest. For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha! For Makha thee, thee for the head of Makha!

verses.sanskrit: य॒माय॑ त्वा म॒खाय॑ त्वा॒ सूर्य॑स्य त्वा॒ तप॑से । दे॒वस्त्वा॑ सवि॒ता मध्वा॑नक्तु पृथि॒व्याः स॒ᳪस्पृश॑स्पाहि । अ॒र्चिर॑सि शो॒चिर॑सि॒ तपो॑ऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration: yamāya tvā makhāya tvā sūryasya tvā tapase | devastvā savitā madhvānaktu pṛthivyāḥ saṃspṛśaspāhi | arcirasi śocirasi tapo'si ||
verses.translation: For Yama thee. For Makha thee. For Sûrya's fervent ardour thee. May Savitar the God with balm anoint thee. Guard thou the touches of the earth. Flame art thou; thou art radiance; thou art heat.

verses.sanskrit:
अना॑धृष्टा पु॒रस्ता॑द॒ग्नेराधि॑पत्य॒ आयु॑र्मे दाः पु॒त्रव॑ती दक्षिण॒त इन्द्र॒स्याधि॑पत्ये प्र॒जां मे॑ दाः ।
सु॒षदा॑ प॒श्चाद्दे॒वस्य॑ सवि॒तुराधि॑पत्ये॒ चक्षु॑र्मे दा आस्रु॑तिरुत्तर॒तो धा॒तुराधि॑पत्ये रा॒यस्पोषं॑ मे दाः ।
विधृ॑तिरु॒परि॑ष्टा॒द्बृह॒स्पते॒राधि॑पत्ये॒ ओजो॑ मे दा विश्वा॑भ्यो मा ना॒ष्ट्राभ्य॑स्पाहि मनो॒रश्वा॑सि ॥
verses.transliteration:
anādhṛṣṭā purastādagnerādhipatya āyurme dāḥ putravatī dakṣiṇata indrasyādhipatye prajāṃ me dāḥ |
suṣadā paścāddevasya saviturādhipatye cakṣurme dā āsrutiruttarato dhāturādhipatye rāyaspoṣaṃ me dāḥ |
vidhṛtirupariṣṭādbṛhaspaterādhipatye ojo me dā viśvābhyo mā nāṣṭrābhyaspāhi manoraśvāsi ||
verses.translation: Unconquerable, eastward, in Agni's overlordship, give me life. Rich in sons, southward, in Indra's overlordship give me offspring. Fair-seated, westward, in God. Savitar's overlordship, give me sight. Range of hearing, northward, in Dhâtar's overlordship, give me increase of wealth. Arrangement, upward, in Brihaspati's overlordship, give me energy. From all destructive spirits guard us. Thou art Manu's mare.

verses.sanskrit: स्वाहा॑ म॒रुद्भिः॒ परि॑ श्रीयस्व दि॒वः स॒ᳪस्पृश॑स्पाहि । मधु॒ मधु॒ मधु॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: svāhā marudbhiḥ pari śrīyasva divaḥ saṃspṛśaspāhi | madhu madhu madhu ||
verses.translation: All-hail! By Maruts be thou compassed round. Guard the sky's touches. Mead, mead, mead.

verses.sanskrit: गर्भो॑ दे॒वानां॑ पि॒ता म॑ती॒नां पतिः॑ प्र॒जाना॑म् । सं दे॒वो दे॒वेन॑ सवि॒त्रा ग॑त॒ सᳪसूर्ये॑ण रोचते ॥
verses.transliteration: garbho devānāṃ pitā matīnāṃ patiḥ prajānām | saṃ devo devena savitrā gata saṃsūryeṇa rocate ||
verses.translation: Germ of the Gods, Father of hymns, all living creatures guardian Lord, Radiant, with radiant Savitar united, with the Sun he shines.

verses.sanskrit:
सम॒ग्निर॒ग्निना॑ गत॒ सं दैवे॑न सवि॒त्रा सᳪ सूर्ये॑णारोचिष्ट ।
स्वाहा॒ सम॒ग्निस्तप॑सा गत॒ सं दैव्ये॑न सवि॒त्रा सᳪसूर्ये॑णारूरुचत ॥
verses.transliteration:
samagniragninā gata saṃ daivena savitrā saṃ sūryeṇārociṣṭa |
svāhā samagnistapasā gata saṃ daivyena savitrā saṃsūryeṇārūrucata ||
verses.translation: Agni combined with flaming fire, combined with Savitar divine, hath shone together with the Sun.

verses.sanskrit:
ध॒र्ता दि॒वो वि भा॑ति॒ तप॑सस्पृथि॒व्यां ध॒र्ता दे॒वो दे॒वाना॒मम॑र्त्यस्तपो॒जाः ।
वाच॑म॒स्मे नि य॑च्छ देवा॒युव॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration:
dhartā divo vi bhāti tapasaspṛthivyāṃ dhartā devo devānāmamartyastapojāḥ |
vācamasme ni yaccha devāyuvam ||
verses.translation: He shines on earth upholder of the sky and heat, the Gods upholder, God, immortal, born of heat. To him address a speech devoted to the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
अप॑श्यं गो॒पामनि॑पद्यमान॒मा च॒ परा॑ च प॒थिभि॒श्चर॑न्तम् ।
स स॒ध्रीचीः॒ स विषू॑ची॒र्वसा॑न॒ आ व॑रीवर्त्ति॒ भुव॑नेष्व॒न्तः ॥
verses.transliteration:
apaśyaṃ gopāmanipadyamānamā ca parā ca pathibhiścarantam |
sa sadhrīcīḥ sa viṣūcīrvasāna ā varīvartti bhuvaneṣvantaḥ ||
verses.translation: I saw the Herdsman, him who never stumbles, approaching by his pathways and departing. He, clothed with gathered and diffusive splendour, within the worlds continually travels.

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वा॑सां भुवां पते॒ विश्व॑स्य मनसस्पते॒ विश्व॑स्य वचसस्पते॒ सर्व॑स्य वचसस्पते ।
दे॒व॒श्रुत्त्वं दे॑व घर्म दे॒वो दे॒वान् पा॒ह्यत्र॒ प्रावी॒रनु॑ वां दे॒ववी॑तये ।
मधु॒ माध्वी॑भ्यां॒ मधु॒ माधू॑चीभ्याम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvāsāṃ bhuvāṃ pate viśvasya manasaspate viśvasya vacasaspate sarvasya vacasaspate |
devaśruttvaṃ deva gharma devo devān pāhyatra prāvīranu vāṃ devavītaye |
madhu mādhvībhyāṃ madhu mādhūcībhyām ||
verses.translation: Lord of all earths, Lord of all mind, Lord of all speech, thou Lord of speech entire. Heard by the Gods, Caldron divine, do thou, a God, protect the Gods. Here, after, let it speed you twain on to the banquet of the Gods. Sweetness for both the sweetness-lovers! Sweetness for those the twain who take delight in sweetness!

verses.sanskrit:
हृ॒दे त्वा॒ मन॑से त्वा दि॒वे त्वा॒ सूर्या॑य त्वा ।
ऊ॒र्ध्वो अ॑ध्व॒रं दि॒वि दे॒वेषु॑ धेहि ॥
verses.transliteration:
hṛde tvā manase tvā dive tvā sūryāya tvā |
ūrdhvo adhvaraṃ divi deveṣu dhehi ||
verses.translation: Thee for the heart, thee for the mind, thee for the sky, for Sûrya thee. Standing erect lay thou the sacrifice in heaven among the Gods.

verses.sanskrit:
पि॒ता नो॑ऽसि पि॒ता नो॑ बोधि॒ नम॑स्ते अतु॒ मा मा॑ हिᳪसीः ।
त्वष्टृ॑मन्तस्त्वा सपेम पु॒त्रान्प॒शून्मयि॑ धेहि प्र॒जाम॒स्मासु॑ धे॒ह्यरि॑ष्टा॒ऽहᳪ स॒ह प॑त्या भूयासम् ॥
verses.transliteration:
pitā no'si pitā no bodhi namaste atu mā mā hiṃsīḥ |
tvaṣṭṛmantastvā sapema putrānpaśūnmayi dhehi prajāmasmāsu dhehyariṣṭā'haṃ saha patyā bhūyāsam ||
verses.translation: Thou art our Father, father-like regard us. Obeisance be to thee. Do not thou harm us. May we, accompanied by Tvashtar, win thee. Vouchsafe me sons and cattle. Grant us offspring. Safe may I be together with my husband.

verses.sanskrit:
अहः॑ के॒तुना॑ जुषताᳪ सु॒ज्योति॒र्ज्योति॑षा॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
रात्रिः॑ के॒तुना॑ जुषताᳪ सु॒ज्योति॒र्ज्योति॑षा॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
ahaḥ ketunā juṣatāṃ sujyotirjyotiṣā svāhā |
rātriḥ ketunā juṣatāṃ sujyotirjyotiṣā svāhā ||
verses.translation: May Day together with his sheen, pair-lighted with his light, accept. All-hail! May Night together with her sheen, fair lighted with her. light, accept. All-hail!

verses.sanskrit:
दे॒वस्य॑ त्वा सवि॒तुः प्र॑स॒वेऽश्विनो॑र्बा॒हुभ्यां॑ पू॒ष्णो हस्ता॑भ्याम् ।
आ द॒देऽदि॑त्यै॒ रास्ना॑ऽसि ॥
verses.transliteration:
devasya tvā savituḥ prasave'śvinorbāhubhyāṃ pūṣṇo hastābhyām |
ā dade'dityai rāsnā'si ||
verses.translation: By impulse of God Savitar I take thee with arms of Asvins, with the Hands of Pûshan. A zone for Aditi art thou.

verses.sanskrit: इड॒ एह्यदि॑त॒ एहि॒ सर॑स्व॒त्त्येहि॑ । असा॒वेह्यसा॒वेह्यसा॒वेहि॑ ॥
verses.transliteration: iḍa ehyadita ehi sarasvattyehi | asāvehyasāvehyasāvehi ||
verses.translation: Idâ, come hither. Aditi, come hither. Sarasvatî, come hither. Come hither, So-and-So. Come hither, So-and-So. Come hither, So-and-So.

verses.sanskrit:
अदि॑त्यै॒ रास्ना॑ऽसीन्द्रा॒ण्या उ॒ष्णीषः॑ ।
पू॒षाऽसि॑ घ॒र्माय॑ दीष्व ॥
verses.transliteration:
adityai rāsnā'sīndrāṇyā uṣṇīṣaḥ |
pūṣā'si gharmāya dīṣva ||
verses.translation: Thou art a zone for Aditi, a diadem for Indrânî. Pûshan art thou. Spare some for the Gharma.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒श्विभ्यां॑ पिन्वस्व॒ सर॑स्वत्यै पिन्व॒स्वेन्द्रा॑य पिन्वस्व ।
स्वाहेन्द्र॑व॒त् स्वाहेन्द्र॑व॒त् स्वाहेन्द्र॑व॒त् ॥
verses.transliteration:
aśvibhyāṃ pinvasva sarasvatyai pinvasvendrāya pinvasva |
svāhendravat svāhendravat svāhendravat ||
verses.translation: Overflow for the Asvins. Overflow for Sarasvatî. Overflow for Indra All-hail, what belongs to Indra! All-hail, what belongs to Indra! All-hail, what belongs to Indra!

verses.sanskrit:
यस्ते॒ स्तनः॑ शश॒यो यो म॑यो॒भूर्यो र॑त्न॒धा व॑सु॒विद्यः सु॒दत्रः॑ ।
येन॒ विश्वा॒ पुष्य॑सि॒ वार्या॑णि॒ सर॑स्वति॒ तमि॒ह धात॑वेऽकः । उ॒र्वन्तरि॑क्ष॒मन्वे॑मि ॥
verses.transliteration:
yaste stanaḥ śaśayo yo mayobhūryo ratnadhā vasuvidyaḥ sudatraḥ |
yena viśvā puṣyasi vāryāṇi sarasvati tamiha dhātave'kaḥ | urvantarikṣamanvemi ||
verses.translation: That breast of thine, exhaustless, fount of pleasure, wealth-giver, treasure-finder, free-bestower, Wherewith thou rearest all things that are choicest,—bring that, Sarasvatî, that we may drain it. Throughout the spacious middle air I travel.

verses.sanskrit:
गा॒य॒त्रं छन्दो॑ऽसि॒ त्रै॑ष्टुभं॒ छन्दो॑ऽसि॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्यां॑ त्वा॒ परि॑ गृह्णाम्य॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒णोप॑ यच्छामि ।
इन्द्रा॑श्विना॒ मधु॑नः सार॒घस्य॑ घ॒र्मं पा॑त॒ वस॑वो॒ यज॑त॒ वाट् ।
स्वाहा॒ सूर्य॑स्य र॒श्मये॑ वृष्टि॒वन॑ये ॥
verses.transliteration:
gāyatraṃ chando'si traiṣṭubhaṃ chando'si dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ tvā pari gṛhṇāmyantarikṣeṇopa yacchāmi |
indrāśvinā madhunaḥ sāraghasya gharmaṃ pāta vasavo yajata vāṭ |
svāhā sūryasya raśmaye vṛṣṭivanaye ||
verses.translation: Thou art Gâyatra metre. Thou art Trishtup metre. With Heaven and Earth I grasp thee. With the Firmament I raise thee up. Indra and Asvins, drink ye the hot draught of sweet honey: sacrifice, ye Vasus. Vât! All-hail to the rain-winning beam of the Sun!

verses.sanskrit:
स॒मु॒द्राय॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ सरि॒राय॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
अ॒ना॒धृ॒ष्याय॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽप्रतिधृ॒ष्याय॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
अ॒व॒स्यवे॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ऽशिमि॒दाय॑ त्वा॒ वाता॑य॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
samudrāya tvā vātāya svāhā sarirāya tvā vātāya svāhā |
anādhṛṣyāya tvā vātāya svāhā 'pratidhṛṣyāya tvā vātāya svāhā |
avasyave tvā vātāya svāhā 'śimidāya tvā vātāya svāhā ||
verses.translation: Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the sea. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the flood. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the unconquerable. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the irresistible. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the protection-seeker. Thee with Svâhâ to Vâta the non-destructive.

verses.sanskrit:
इन्द्रा॑य त्वा॒ वसु॑मते रु॒द्रव॑ते॒ स्वाहेन्द्रा॑य त्वाऽऽदि॒त्यव॑ते॒ स्वाहेन्द्रा॑य त्वाऽभिमाति॒घ्ने स्वाहा ।
स॒वि॒त्रे त्व॑ ऋभु॒मते॑ विभु॒मते॒ वाज॑वते॒ स्वाहा॒ बृह॒स्पत॑ये त्वा वि॒श्वदे॑व्यावते॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
indrāya tvā vasumate rudravate svāhendrāya tvā''dityavate svāhendrāya tvā'bhimātighne svāhā |
savitre tva ṛbhumate vibhumate vājavate svāhā bṛhaspataye tvā viśvadevyāvate svāhā ||
verses.translation: Thee with Svâhâ to Indra Lord of Vasus. Thee with Svâhâ to Indra Lord of Rudras. Thee with Svâhâ to Indra killer of foes. Thee with Svâhâ to Savitar attended by Ribhu, Vibhu, and Vâja. Thee with Svâhâ to Brihaspati beloved of all the Gods.

verses.sanskrit: य॒माय॒ त्वाऽङ्गि॑रस्वते पितृ॒मते॒ स्वाहा॑ । स्वाहा॑ घ॒र्माय॒ स्वाहा॑ घ॒र्मः पि॒त्रे ॥
verses.transliteration: yamāya tvā'ṅgirasvate pitṛmate svāhā | svāhā gharmāya svāhā gharmaḥ pitre ||
verses.translation: Svâhâ to Yama attended by the Angirases, attended by the Fathers! Svâhâ to the Gharma! The Gharma for the Father!

verses.sanskrit:
विश्वा॒ आशा॑ दक्षिण॒सद्विश्वा॑न् दे॒वानया॑डि॒ह ।
स्वाहा॑कृतस्य घ॒र्मस्य॒ मधोः॑ पिबतमश्विना ॥
verses.transliteration:
viśvā āśā dakṣiṇasadviśvān devānayāḍiha |
svāhākṛtasya gharmasya madhoḥ pibatamaśvinā ||
verses.translation: Here hath he worshipped, seated south, all the sky-regions, all the Gods. Drink, Asvins, of the heated draught, the Svâhâ-consecrated mead.

verses.sanskrit: दि॒वि धा॑ इ॒मं य॒ज्ञमि॒मं य॒ज्ञं दि॒वि धाः॑ । स्वाहा॒ऽग्नये॑ य॒ज्ञिया॑य॒ शं यजु॑र्भ्यः ॥
verses.transliteration: divi dhā imaṃ yajñamimaṃ yajñaṃ divi dhāḥ | svāhā'gnaye yajñiyāya śaṃ yajurbhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: In heaven lay thou this sacrifice; lay thou this sacrifice in heaven. To sacrificial Agni hail! May bliss be ours from Yajus texts.

verses.sanskrit: अश्वि॑ना घ॒र्मं पा॑त॒ᳪ हार्द्वा॑न॒मह॑र्दि॒वाभि॑रू॒तिभिः॑ । तन्त्रा॒यिणे॒ नमो॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्या॑म् ॥
verses.transliteration: aśvinā gharmaṃ pātaṃ hārdvānamahardivābhirūtibhiḥ | tantrāyiṇe namo dyāvāpṛthivībhyām ||
verses.translation: Drink, Asvins, with your daily helps, the Gharma, strengthener of hearts. To him who draweth out the thread be homage, and to Heaven and Earth.

verses.sanskrit: अपा॑ताम॒श्विना॑ घ॒र्ममनु॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वी अ॑मᳪसाताम् । इहै॒व रा॒तयः॑ सन्तु ॥
verses.transliteration: apātāmaśvinā gharmamanu dyāvāpṛthivī amaṃsātām | ihaiva rātayaḥ santu ||
verses.translation: The Gharma have the Asvins drunk: with Heaven and Earth have they agreed. Here, verily, be their boons bestowed.

verses.sanskrit:
इ॒षे पि॑न्वस्वो॒र्जे पि॑न्वस्व॒ ब्रह्म॑णे पिन्वस्व क्ष॒त्राय॑ पिन्वस्व॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्यां॑ पिन्वस्व ।
धर्मा॑सि सु॒धर्मामे॑न्य॒स्मे नृ॒म्णानि॑ धारय॒ ब्रह्म॑ धारय क्ष॒त्रं धा॑रय॒ विशं॑ धारय ॥
verses.transliteration:
iṣe pinvasvorje pinvasva brahmaṇe pinvasva kṣatrāya pinvasva dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ pinvasva |
dharmāsi sudharmāmenyasme nṛmṇāni dhāraya brahma dhāraya kṣatraṃ dhāraya viśaṃ dhāraya ||
verses.translation: Overflow for food. Overflow for energy. Overflow for the Priesthood. Overflow for the Nobility. Overflow for Heaven and Earth. Thou, O duteous one, art Duty. Innocent one, in us establish manly powers; establish the People.

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाहा॑ पू॒ष्णे शर॑से॒ स्वाहा॒ ग्राव॑भ्यः स्वाहा॑ प्रतिर॒वेभ्यः॑ ।
स्वाहा॑ पि॒तृभ्य॑ ऊ॒र्ध्वब॑र्हिर्भ्यो घर्म॒पाव॑भ्यः॒ स्वाहा॒ द्यावा॑पृथि॒वीभ्या॒ᳪ स्वाहा॒ विश्वे॑भ्यो दे॒वेभ्यः॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
svāhā pūṣṇe śarase svāhā grāvabhyaḥ svāhā pratiravebhyaḥ |
svāhā pitṛbhya ūrdhvabarhirbhyo gharmapāvabhyaḥ svāhā dyāvāpṛthivībhyāṃ svāhā viśvebhyo devebhyaḥ ||
verses.translation: All-hail to Pûshan, to the milk's skin! All-hail to the press-stones! All-hail to their echoes! All-hail to the Fathers who are above the grass, who drink the Gharma! All-hail to Heaven and Earth! All-hail to the All-Gods!

verses.sanskrit:
स्वाहा॑ रु॒द्राय॑ रु॒द्रहू॑तये॒ स्वाहा॒ सं ज्योति॑षा॒ ज्योतिः॑ ।
अहः॑ के॒तुना॑ जुषताᳪ सु॒ज्योति॒र्ज्योति॑षा॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
रात्रिः॑ के॒तुना॑ जुषताᳪ सु॒ज्योति॒र्ज्योति॑षा॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
मधु॑ हु॒तमिन्द्र॑तमे अ॒ग्नाव॒श्याम॑ ते देव॒ घर्म॒ नम॑स्ते अस्तु॒ मा मा॑ हिᳪसीः ॥
verses.transliteration:
svāhā rudrāya rudrahūtaye svāhā saṃ jyotiṣā jyotiḥ |
ahaḥ ketunā juṣatāṃ sujyotirjyotiṣā svāhā |
rātriḥ ketunā juṣatāṃ sujyotirjyotiṣā svāhā |
madhu hutamindratame agnāvaśyāma te deva gharma namaste astu mā mā hiṃsīḥ ||
verses.translation: All-hail to Rudra invoked by worshippers! All-hail! Let light combine with light. May Day together with his sheen, fair-lighted with his light, accept. All hail! May Night together with her sheen, fair-lighted with her light, accept. All-hail! May we enjoy the mead offered in most Indra-like Agni. Homage to thee, divine Gharma! Do not thou injure me.

verses.sanskrit:
अ॒भीमं म॑हि॒मा दिवं॒ विप्रो॑ बभूव स॒प्रथाः॑ ।
उ॒त श्रव॑सा पृथि॒वीᳪ सᳪ सी॑दस्व म॒हाँ२ अ॑सि॒ रोच॑स्व देव॒वीत॑मः ॥
verses.transliteration:
abhīmaṃ mahimā divaṃ vipro babhūva saprathāḥ |
uta śravasā pṛthivīṃ saṃ sīdasva mahām̐ asi rocasva devavītamaḥ ||
verses.translation: Thy far-spread majesty, instinct with wisdom, hath surpassed this heaven, And, with its glorious fame, the earth. Seat thee, for thou art mighty: shine, best entertainer of the Gods. Worthy of sacred food, praised Agni! loose the smoke ruddy and beautiful to see.

verses.sanskrit:
या ते॑ घर्म दि॒व्या शुग्या गा॑य॒त्र्याᳪ ह॑वि॒र्धाने॑ ।
सा त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒ निष्टया॑यतां॒ तस्यै॑ ते॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
या ते॑ घर्मा॒न्तरि॑क्षे॒ शुग्या त्रि॒ष्टुभ्याग्नी॑ध्रे ।
सा त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒ निष्टया॑यतां॒ तस्यै॑ ते॒ स्वाहा॑ ।
या ते॑ घर्म पृथि॒व्याᳪ शुग्या जग॑त्याᳪ सद॒स्या॒ ।
सा त॒ आ प्या॑यतां॒ निष्टया॑यतां॒ तस्यै॑ ते॒ स्वाहा॑ ॥
verses.transliteration:
yā te gharma divyā śugyā gāyatryāṃ havirdhāne |
sā ta ā pyāyatāṃ niṣṭayāyatāṃ tasyai te svāhā |
yā te gharmāntarikṣe śugyā triṣṭubhyāgnīdhre |
sā ta ā pyāyatāṃ niṣṭayāyatāṃ tasyai te svāhā |
yā te gharma pṛthivyāṃ śugyā jagatyāṃ sadasyā |
sā ta ā pyāyatāṃ niṣṭayāyatāṃ tasyai te svāhā ||
verses.translation: Gharma, that heavenly light of thine in Gâyatrî, in the Soma-store,— May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light. Gharma, that light of thine in air, in Trishtup, in the sacred hearth,— May it increase and be confirmed for thee, that light.
